Exodus 23:22 If by hearing you all hear my voice, and you do all that I command you, and you all keep my covenant, you all shall be to me a special people beyond all the nations, for all the earth is mine; and you all shall be to me a royal priesthood and a holy nation. These words you shall say to the sons of Israel: If by hearing you all hear my voice, and you do all that I say to you, I will be an enemy to your enemies and I will oppose those who oppose you.
Exodus 23:23 For my angel shall go, leading you, and shall bring you to the Amorrite and Chettite and Pherezite and Chanaanite and Gergesite and Evite and Jebousite, and I will wipe them out.
Exodus 23:24 You shall not worship their gods, nor shall you serve them; you shall not act according to their works, but with tearing down you shall tear down, and with crushing you shall crush their pillars.
Exodus 23:25 And you shall serve the Lord your God, and I will bless your bread and your wine and your water, and I will turn sickness away from you.
Exodus 23:26 There shall be no barren or sterile one upon your land; I will fulfill the number of your days.
Exodus 23:27 And I will send fear leading you, and I will astound all the nations into whom you enter, and I will make all your adversaries fugitives.
Exodus 23:28 And I will send the hornets before you, and they shall drive the Amorrites and the Evites and the Chanaanites and the Chettites away from you.
Exodus 23:29 I will not drive them out in one year, lest the land become desolate and the beasts of the land become many against you;
Exodus 23:30 little by little I will drive them away from you, until you increase and inherit the land.
Exodus 23:31 And I will set your boundaries from the Red Sea as far as the sea of Phylistiim and from the wilderness as far as the great river Euphrates; and I will deliver into your hands those settled in the land and drive them away from you.
Exodus 23:32 You shall not agree to a covenant with them and with their gods,
Exodus 23:33 and they shall not settle in your land, so that they do not cause you to sin against me; for if you serve their gods, these will be a stumbling block to you.

## Chapter 24

Exodus 24:1 And he said to Moses: Go up to the Lord, you and Aaron and Nadab and Abioud and seventy of the elders of Israel, and they shall worship the Lord from afar;
Exodus 24:2 and Moses alone shall draw near to God, but they shall not draw near; and the people shall not go up together with them.
Exodus 24:3 And Moses entered and recounted to the people all the words of God and the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, saying: All the words that the Lord spoke we will do and we will hear.
Exodus 24:4 And Moses wrote all the words of the Lord. And rising early in the morning, Moses built an altar beneath the mountain and twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel;
Exodus 24:5 and he sent out the young men of the sons of Israel, and they offered whole burnt offerings and sacrificed calves as a sacrifice of salvation to God.
Exodus 24:6 And Moses, taking half of the blood, poured it into bowls, but half of the blood he poured toward the altar.
Exodus 24:7 And taking the book of the covenant, he read it into the ears of the people, and they said: All the things that the Lord spoke we will do and we will hear.
Exodus 24:8 And Moses, taking the blood, scattered it over the people and said: Behold the blood of the covenant that the Lord made with you concerning all these words.
Exodus 24:9 And Moses and Aaron and Nadab and Abioud and seventy of the council of elders of Israel went up,
Exodus 24:10 and they saw the place where the God of Israel stood; and the things beneath his feet were like a work of sapphire brick and like the appearance of the firmament of heaven in its purity.
Exodus 24:11 And not even one of the chosen of Israel was missing; and they appeared in the place of God and ate and drank.
Exodus 24:12 And the Lord said to Moses: Go up to me into the mountain and be there; and I will give you the stone tablets, the law and the commandments, which I wrote to legislate for them.
Exodus 24:13 And Moses rose, and Jesus who stood beside him, and they went up into the mountain of God;
Exodus 24:14 and they said to the elders: Remain quiet here until we return to you; and behold, Aaron and Or are with you; if a judgment happens to anyone, let them approach them.
Exodus 24:15 And Moses and Jesus went up into the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.
Exodus 24:16 And the glory of God descended upon Mount Sina, and the cloud covered it six days; and the Lord called Moses on the seventh day from the midst of the cloud.
Exodus 24:17 And the appearance of the glory of the Lord was like a burning fire upon the summit of the mountain before the sons of Israel.
Exodus 24:18 And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain and was there on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

## Chapter 25

Exodus 25:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 25:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and take firstfruits for me from all those to whom it seems good in their heart, and you shall receive my firstfruits.
Exodus 25:3 And this is the firstfruit that you shall receive from them: gold and silver and bronze,
Exodus 25:4 and hyacinth and purple and double scarlet and spun linen and goat hair,
Exodus 25:5 and red-dyed ram skins and hyacinth-colored skins and incorruptible wood,
Exodus 25:7 and sardius stones and stones for engraving for the shoulder piece and the full-length robe.
Exodus 25:8 And you shall make a sanctuary for me, and I will appear among you;
Exodus 25:9 and you shall make for me according to all that I show you on the mountain: the model of the tabernacle and the model of all its vessels; thus you shall make it.
Exodus 25:10 And you shall make an ark of testimony from incorruptible wood, two cubits and a half in length and a cubit and a half in width and a cubit and a half in height.
Exodus 25:11 And you shall overlay it with pure gold, outside and inside you shall overlay it; and you shall make twisted golden moldings for it all around.
Exodus 25:12 And you shall hammer out for it four golden rings and place them upon the four sides, two rings upon the one side and two rings upon the second side.
Exodus 25:13 And you shall make carrying poles of incorruptible wood and overlay them with gold;
Exodus 25:14 and you shall insert the carrying poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to carry the ark with them;
Exodus 25:15 the carrying poles shall remain immovable in the rings of the ark.
Exodus 25:16 And you shall put into the ark the testimonies that I give you.
Exodus 25:17 And you shall make a propitiatory covering of pure gold, two cubits and a half in length and a cubit and a half in width.
Exodus 25:18 And you shall make two golden cherubim, worked in relief, and you shall place them on both sides of the propitiatory;
Exodus 25:19 one cherub shall be made from this side and one cherub from the second side of the propitiatory; and you shall make the two cherubim upon the two sides.
Exodus 25:20 The cherubim shall extend their wings above, overshadowing the propitiatory with their wings, and their faces shall be toward one another; the faces of the cherubim shall be toward the propitiatory.
Exodus 25:21 And you shall place the propitiatory upon the ark above; and you shall put into the ark the testimonies that I give you.
Exodus 25:22 And I will be known to you from there and will speak to you from above the propitiatory, between the two cherubim that are upon the ark of testimony, and according to all that I command you for the sons of Israel.
Exodus 25:23 And you shall make a table of pure gold, two cubits in length and a cubit in width and a cubit and a half in height.
Exodus 25:24 And you shall make twisted golden moldings for it all around.
Exodus 25:25 And you shall make for it a rim a handbreadth all around; and you shall make a twisted molding for the rim all around.
Exodus 25:26 And you shall make four golden rings and place the rings upon the four parts of its feet,
Exodus 25:27 beneath the rim, and the rings shall be sockets for the carrying poles, so as to carry the table with them.
Exodus 25:28 And you shall make the carrying poles from incorruptible wood and overlay them with pure gold, and the table shall be carried with them.
Exodus 25:29 And you shall make its dishes and censers and libation vessels and cups, with which you shall pour libations in them; you shall make them of pure gold.
Exodus 25:30 And you shall place upon the table breads set before the face, before me continually.
Exodus 25:31 And you shall make a lampstand from pure gold; you shall make the lampstand worked in relief: its stem and branches and bowls and knobs and lilies shall be from it.
Exodus 25:32 And six branches shall go out from its sides, three branches of the lampstand from its one side and three branches of the lampstand from the second side.
Exodus 25:33 And three bowls shaped like small nuts in the one branch, a knob and a lily; thus for the six branches going out from the lampstand.
Exodus 25:34 And in the lampstand there shall be four bowls shaped like small nuts; in the one branch, its knobs and its lilies.
Exodus 25:35 The knob beneath the two branches shall be from it, and a knob beneath the four branches shall be from it; thus for the six branches going out from the lampstand.
Exodus 25:36 Their knobs and their branches shall be from it; the whole shall be worked in relief from one piece of pure gold.
Exodus 25:37 And you shall make its seven lamps; and you shall set the lamps, and they shall shine from one face.
Exodus 25:38 And you shall make its oil-drawer and its supports from pure gold.
Exodus 25:39 All these vessels: a talent of pure gold.
Exodus 25:40 See that you make them according to the pattern shown to you on the mountain.

## Chapter 26

Exodus 26:1 And you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains from spun linen and hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet; you shall make them with cherubim, the work of a weaver.
Exodus 26:2 The length of the one curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of the one curtain shall be four cubits; the same measure shall be for all the curtains.
Exodus 26:3 And five curtains shall be holding onto one another, one from the other, and five curtains shall be joined, one to the other.
Exodus 26:4 And you shall make hyacinth loops for them upon the edge of the one curtain, from the one part at the joining, and thus you shall make upon the edge of the outer curtain at the second joining.
Exodus 26:5 You shall make fifty loops for the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops from the part of the curtain at the joining of the second; facing one another, they shall meet one another, each one.
Exodus 26:6 And you shall make fifty golden rings and join the curtains, one to the other, with the rings, and the tabernacle shall be one. –
Exodus 26:7 And you shall make coverings of hair as a cover over the tabernacle; you shall make them eleven coverings.
Exodus 26:8 The length of the one covering shall be thirty cubits, and the width of the one covering four cubits; the same measure shall be for the eleven coverings.
Exodus 26:9 And you shall join the five coverings together and the six coverings together; and you shall fold the sixth covering double at the face of the tabernacle.
Exodus 26:10 And you shall make fifty loops upon the edge of the one covering in the middle at the joining, and you shall make fifty loops upon the edge of the covering that joins the second.
Exodus 26:11 And you shall make fifty bronze rings and join the rings from the loops and join the coverings, and it shall be one.
Exodus 26:12 And you shall put beneath the excess among the coverings of the tabernacle; the half of the covering that remains you shall cover down, and the excess of the coverings of the tabernacle you shall cover down behind the tabernacle;
Exodus 26:13 a cubit from this side and a cubit from that side, from the part of the coverings exceeding the length of the coverings of the tabernacle, shall cover over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, so that it may cover it.
Exodus 26:14 And you shall make a covering for the tabernacle of red-dyed ram skins and upper coverings of hyacinth-colored skins above. –
Exodus 26:15 And you shall make pillars for the tabernacle from incorruptible wood;
Exodus 26:16 you shall make the one pillar ten cubits, and the width of the one pillar a cubit and a half;
Exodus 26:17 two tenons for the one pillar, meeting one another; thus you shall make for all the pillars of the tabernacle.
Exodus 26:18 And you shall make pillars for the tabernacle, twenty pillars from the side toward the north.
Exodus 26:19 And you shall make forty silver bases for the twenty pillars, two bases for the one pillar for both its parts, and two bases for the one pillar for both its parts.
Exodus 26:20 And for the second side, the one toward the south, twenty pillars;
Exodus 26:21 and their forty silver bases, two bases for the one pillar for both its parts, and two bases for the one pillar for both its parts.
Exodus 26:22 And from the back of the tabernacle, along the part toward the sea, you shall make six pillars.
Exodus 26:23 And you shall make two pillars upon the corners of the tabernacle from the rear,
Exodus 26:24 and it shall be equal below; in the same manner they shall be equal from the capitals into one joining; thus you shall make for both, let them be for the two corners.
Exodus 26:25 And there shall be eight pillars, and their silver bases sixteen; two bases for the one pillar for both its parts, and two bases for the one pillar. –
Exodus 26:26 And you shall make bars from incorruptible wood, five for the one pillar from the one side of the tabernacle,
Exodus 26:27 and five bars for the pillar on the second side of the tabernacle and five bars for the rear pillar, on the side of the tabernacle toward the sea;
Exodus 26:28 and let the middle bar between the pillars pass through from the one side to the other side.
Exodus 26:29 And you shall overlay the pillars with gold and make their rings golden, into which you shall insert the bars, and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
Exodus 26:30 And you shall erect the tabernacle according to the appearance shown to you on the mountain. –
Exodus 26:31 And you shall make a veil from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen; you shall make it a woven work with cherubim.
Exodus 26:32 And you shall place it upon four pillars of incorruptible wood overlaid with gold; and their capitals shall be golden, and their four bases silver.
Exodus 26:33 And you shall place the veil upon the pillars and bring the ark of testimony there, inside the veil; and the veil shall divide for you between the holy place and between the Holy of Holies.
Exodus 26:34 And you shall cover the ark of testimony with the veil in the Holy of Holies.
Exodus 26:35 And you shall place the table outside the veil and the lampstand opposite the table, on the part of the tabernacle toward the south, and you shall place the table on the part of the tabernacle toward the north.
Exodus 26:36 And you shall make a screen from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen, the work of an embroiderer.
Exodus 26:37 And you shall make five pillars for the screen and overlay them with gold, and their capitals shall be golden, and you shall cast five bronze bases for them.

## Chapter 27

Exodus 27:1 And you shall make an altar from incorruptible wood, five cubits in length and five cubits in width—the altar shall be square—and three cubits in height.
Exodus 27:2 And you shall make the horns upon the four corners; its horns shall be from it; and you shall cover them with bronze.
Exodus 27:3 And you shall make a rim for the altar and its cover and its bowls and its flesh-hooks and its fire-pan; and you shall make all its vessels bronze.
Exodus 27:4 And you shall make for it a bronze grate of network work; and you shall make for the grate four bronze rings upon the four sides.
Exodus 27:5 And you shall put them beneath the grate of the altar below; and the grate shall be as far as the middle of the altar.
Exodus 27:6 And you shall make carrying poles for the altar from incorruptible wood and cover them around with bronze.
Exodus 27:7 And you shall insert the carrying poles into the rings, and let the carrying poles be along the sides of the altar when it is carried.
Exodus 27:8 You shall make it hollow, built of boards; according to what was shown to you on the mountain, thus you shall make it.
Exodus 27:9 And you shall make a court for the tabernacle; for the side toward the southwest wind, the hangings of the court shall be from spun linen, a length of one hundred cubits for the one side;
Exodus 27:10 and their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty, of bronze, and their rings and clasps silver.
Exodus 27:11 Thus for the side toward the east wind there shall be hangings, a length of one hundred cubits; and their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty, of bronze, and the rings and the clasps of the pillars and their bases plated with silver.
Exodus 27:12 And the width of the court toward the sea shall have hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their bases ten.
Exodus 27:13 And the width of the court toward the south shall have hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their bases ten.
Exodus 27:14 And the height of the hangings for the one side shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their bases three.
Exodus 27:15 And for the second side, the height of the hangings shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their bases three.
Exodus 27:16 And for the gate of the court there shall be a covering, its height twenty cubits, from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen, with the embroidery of a needleworker; their pillars four, and their bases four.
Exodus 27:17 All the pillars of the court all around shall be plated with silver, and their capitals silver, and their bases bronze.
Exodus 27:18 And the length of the court shall be one hundred by one hundred, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, from spun linen, and their bases bronze.
Exodus 27:19 And all the construction and all the implements and the stakes of the court shall be bronze.
Exodus 27:20 And you, command the sons of Israel, and let them take for you clear, pure, beaten oil from olives for light to burn, so that a lamp may burn continually.
Exodus 27:21 In the tabernacle of testimony, outside the veil that is over the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it burning from evening until morning before the Lord; an eternal ordinance for your generations from the sons of Israel.

## Chapter 28

Exodus 28:1 And you, bring near to yourself both Aaron your brother and his sons from the sons of Israel to serve me as priests: Aaron and Nadab and Abioud and Eleazar and Ithamar, sons of Aaron.
Exodus 28:2 And you shall make a holy vestment for Aaron your brother, for honor and glory.
Exodus 28:3 And you shall speak to all those wise in understanding, whom I filled with a spirit of perception, and they shall make the holy vestment of Aaron for the holy place, in which he shall serve me as priest.
Exodus 28:4 And these are the vestments that they shall make: the breastpiece and the shoulder piece and the full-length robe and a tasseled tunic and a turban and a sash; and they shall make holy vestments for Aaron and his sons, for them to serve me as priests.
Exodus 28:5 And they shall take the gold and the hyacinth and the purple and the scarlet and the linen. –
Exodus 28:6 And they shall make the shoulder piece from spun linen, the woven work of an embroiderer;
Exodus 28:7 two shoulder pieces joining one another shall be for him, hanging from the two parts;
Exodus 28:8 and the woven fabric of the shoulder pieces that is upon it shall be of the same workmanship, from it, of gold and hyacinth and purple and finely spun scarlet and spun linen.
Exodus 28:9 And you shall take the two stones, emerald stones, and engrave in them the names of the sons of Israel,
Exodus 28:10 six names upon the one stone and the remaining six names upon the second stone, according to their births.
Exodus 28:11 As the work of the stonecutter’s craft, an engraving of a seal, you shall thoroughly engrave the two stones with the names of the sons of Israel.
Exodus 28:12 And you shall place the two stones upon the shoulders of the shoulder piece; they are stones of memorial for the sons of Israel; and Aaron shall take up the names of the sons of Israel before the Lord upon his two shoulders, as a memorial concerning them.
Exodus 28:13 And you shall make small shields from pure gold;
Exodus 28:14 and you shall make two fringed pieces from pure gold, interwoven with flowers, a work of braiding; and you shall place the braided fringed pieces upon the small shields along their shoulder pieces from the front. –
Exodus 28:15 And you shall make an oracle of judgments, the work of an embroiderer; according to the pattern of the shoulder piece you shall make it; from gold and hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen you shall make it.
Exodus 28:16 It shall be square, doubled, a span in length and a span in width.
Exodus 28:17 And you shall weave into it fabric studded with stones in four rows. One row of stones shall be sardius, topaz, and emerald, the one row;
Exodus 28:18 and the second row, carbuncle and sapphire and jasper;
Exodus 28:19 and the third row, ligure, agate, and amethyst;
Exodus 28:20 and the fourth row, chrysolite and beryl and onyx; covered with gold, let them be bound in gold according to their row.
Exodus 28:21 And the stones shall be twelve, from the names of the sons of Israel, according to their names; engravings of seals, each according to the name, let them be for the twelve tribes.
Exodus 28:22 And you shall make upon the oracle braided fringes, a work of chainwork from pure gold.
Exodus 28:29 And Aaron shall take the names of the sons of Israel upon the oracle of judgment, upon his breast, when he enters into the holy place, as a memorial before God.
Exodus 28:29 a And you shall place the fringes upon the oracle of judgment; you shall place the chainwork upon both sides of the oracle, and you shall place the two small shields upon both shoulders of the shoulder piece toward the front.
Exodus 28:30 And you shall place upon the oracle of judgment the Manifestation and the Truth, and it shall be upon the breast of Aaron when he enters into the holy place before the Lord; and Aaron shall bear the judgments of the sons of Israel upon his breast before the Lord continually. –
Exodus 28:31 And you shall make a full-length undergarment, entirely hyacinth-colored.
Exodus 28:32 And its neck opening shall be from it, in the middle, having a border around the neck opening, the work of a weaver, the joining woven together from it, so that it may not tear.
Exodus 28:33 And upon the hem of the undergarment below you shall make small pomegranates, as of a blossoming pomegranate, from hyacinth and purple and finely spun scarlet and spun linen, upon the hem of the undergarment all around; and in the same pattern, golden pomegranates and bells between them all around;
Exodus 28:34 beside a golden pomegranate, a bell and a flower upon the hem of the undergarment all around.
Exodus 28:35 And when Aaron ministers, his sound shall be audible when he enters into the holy place before the Lord and when he goes out, so that he does not die. –
Exodus 28:36 And you shall make a plate of pure gold and imprint in it the imprint of a seal: A Holy Thing of the Lord.
Exodus 28:37 And you shall place it upon spun hyacinth, and it shall be upon the miter; it shall be upon the front of the miter.
Exodus 28:38 And it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron, and Aaron shall bear away the offenses of the holy things, whatever the sons of Israel sanctify, of every gift of their holy things; and it shall be upon the forehead of Aaron continually, acceptable for them before the Lord. –
Exodus 28:39 And the tassels of the tunics shall be from linen; and you shall make a linen turban and shall make a sash, the work of an embroiderer.
Exodus 28:40 And for the sons of Aaron you shall make tunics and sashes, and you shall make turbans for them, for honor and glory.
Exodus 28:41 And you shall clothe Aaron your brother with them and his sons with him; and you shall anoint them and fill their hands and sanctify them, so that they may serve me as priests.
Exodus 28:42 And you shall make linen breeches for them to cover the nakedness of their flesh; they shall be from the waist as far as the thighs.
Exodus 28:43 And Aaron and his sons shall have them when they enter into the tabernacle of testimony or when they approach to minister at the altar of the holy place, and they shall not bring sin upon themselves, so that they do not die; an eternal ordinance for him and for his seed after him.

## Chapter 29

Exodus 29:1 And these are the things that you shall do for them to sanctify them, so that they may serve me as priests. You shall take one calf from the cattle and two unblemished rams,
Exodus 29:2 and unleavened loaves mixed with oil and unleavened flatcakes anointed with oil; you shall make them from fine wheat flour.
Exodus 29:3 And you shall place them upon one basket and bring them upon the basket, and the calf and the two rams.
Exodus 29:4 And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony and wash them with water.
Exodus 29:5 And taking the vestments, you shall clothe Aaron your brother with the full-length tunic and the shoulder piece and the oracle, and you shall join the oracle to the shoulder piece for him.
Exodus 29:6 And you shall place the miter upon his head and place the plate, the Holy Thing, upon the miter.
Exodus 29:7 And you shall take from the oil of anointing and pour it upon his head and anoint him.
Exodus 29:8 And you shall bring his sons near and clothe them with tunics,
Exodus 29:9 and you shall gird them with the sashes and place the turbans around them, and the priesthood shall be theirs for me for the age. And you shall perfect the hands of Aaron and the hands of his sons.
Exodus 29:10 And you shall bring the calf to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands upon the head of the calf before the Lord, beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony;
Exodus 29:11 and you shall slaughter the calf before the Lord beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
Exodus 29:12 And you shall take from the blood of the calf and place it upon the horns of the altar with your finger; but all the remaining blood you shall pour out beside the base of the altar.
Exodus 29:13 And you shall take all the fat upon the belly and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat upon them and place them upon the altar.
Exodus 29:14 But the flesh of the calf and the skin and the dung you shall burn with fire outside the camp, for it is of sin.
Exodus 29:15 And you shall take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands upon the head of the ram;
Exodus 29:16 and you shall slaughter it, and taking the blood you shall pour it toward the altar all around.
Exodus 29:17 And you shall divide the ram limb by limb and wash the inward parts and the feet with water and place them upon the divided parts together with the head.
Exodus 29:18 And you shall offer the whole ram upon the altar as a whole burnt offering to the Lord for an odor of sweetness; it is a sacrifice to the Lord.
Exodus 29:19 And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall place their hands upon the head of the ram;
Exodus 29:20 and you shall slaughter it and take from its blood and place it upon the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and upon the tip of his right hand and upon the tip of his right foot, and upon the lobes of the right ears of his sons and upon the tips of their right hands and upon the tips of their right feet.
Exodus 29:21 And you shall take from the blood from the altar and from the oil of anointing and sprinkle it upon Aaron and upon his vestment and upon his sons and upon the vestments of his sons with him, and he shall be sanctified, and his vestment and his sons and the vestments of his sons with him; but you shall pour the blood of the ram toward the altar all around.
Exodus 29:22 And you shall take from the ram its fat and the fat covering the belly and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat upon them and the right arm—for this is a perfection—
Exodus 29:23 and one loaf made with oil and one flatcake from the basket of unleavened things set before the Lord,
Exodus 29:24 and you shall place all the things upon the hands of Aaron and upon the hands of his sons and shall separate them as a separation before the Lord.
Exodus 29:25 And you shall take them from their hands and offer them upon the altar of whole burnt offering for an odor of sweetness before the Lord; it is an offering to the Lord.
Exodus 29:26 And you shall take the breast from the ram of perfection, which belongs to Aaron, and shall separate it as a separation before the Lord, and it shall be a portion for you.
Exodus 29:27 And you shall sanctify the breast as a separation and the arm of the removal offering, which was separated and which was removed from the ram of perfection, from Aaron and from his sons,
Exodus 29:28 and it shall be an eternal ordinance for Aaron and his sons from the sons of Israel; for this is a removal offering, and it shall be a removal offering from the sons of Israel, from the sacrifices of salvation of the sons of Israel, a removal offering to the Lord. –
Exodus 29:29 And the vestment of the holy place, which belongs to Aaron, shall be for his sons after him, for them to be anointed in them and to perfect their hands.
Exodus 29:30 For seven days the priest who is in his place from among his sons shall wear them, he who shall enter into the tabernacle of testimony to minister in the holy places.
Exodus 29:31 And you shall take the ram of perfection and boil the flesh in a holy place,
Exodus 29:32 and Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the loaves in the basket beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony;
Exodus 29:33 they shall eat those things by which they were sanctified, to perfect their hands, to sanctify them; and a foreigner shall not eat from them, for they are holy.
Exodus 29:34 But if anything remains from the flesh of the sacrifice of perfection and from the loaves until morning, you shall burn the remaining things with fire; it shall not be eaten, for it is a sanctified thing.
Exodus 29:35 And thus you shall do for Aaron and his sons according to all the things that I commanded you; for seven days you shall perfect their hands.
Exodus 29:36 And you shall make the calf of sin on the day of cleansing and shall cleanse the altar when you sanctify upon it, and you shall anoint it so as to sanctify it.
Exodus 29:37 For seven days you shall cleanse the altar and sanctify it, and the altar shall be holy of the holy; everyone who touches the altar shall be sanctified.
Exodus 29:38 And these are the things that you shall make upon the altar: two unblemished year-old lambs each day upon the altar continually, a continual offering.
Exodus 29:39 The one lamb you shall make in the morning, and the second lamb you shall make in the evening;
Exodus 29:40 and a tenth of fine flour mixed with beaten oil, a fourth of a hin, and a libation of wine, a fourth of a hin, for the one lamb;
Exodus 29:41 and the second lamb you shall make in the evening; according to the morning sacrifice and according to its libation you shall make it, for an odor of sweetness, an offering to the Lord,
Exodus 29:42 a continual sacrifice for your generations at the doors of the tabernacle of testimony before the Lord, where I will be known to you from there so as to speak to you.
Exodus 29:43 And I will appoint myself there for the sons of Israel and will be sanctified in my glory;
Exodus 29:44 and I will sanctify the tabernacle of testimony and the altar; and I will sanctify Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.
Exodus 29:45 And I will be called upon among the sons of Israel and will be their God,
Exodus 29:46 and they shall know that I am the Lord their God, who brought them out of the land of Egypt to be called upon for them and to be their God.

## Chapter 30

Exodus 30:1 And you shall make an altar of incense from incorruptible wood; and you shall make it
Exodus 30:2 a cubit in length and a cubit in width—it shall be square—and two cubits in height; its horns shall be from it.
Exodus 30:3 And you shall overlay them with pure gold, its grate and its walls all around and its horns, and you shall make for it a twisted golden rim all around.
Exodus 30:4 And you shall make two pure golden rings beneath its twisted rim; you shall make them on the two sides, on the two flanks; and they shall be clasps for the rods, so as to carry it with them.
Exodus 30:5 And you shall make rods from incorruptible wood and overlay them with gold.
Exodus 30:6 And you shall place it opposite the veil that is over the ark of the testimonies, among which I will be known to you from there.
Exodus 30:7 And Aaron shall burn upon it fine compound incense; morning by morning, whenever he prepares the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it,
Exodus 30:8 and whenever Aaron kindles the lamps in the evening, he shall burn incense upon it; an incense of continuity continually before the Lord for their generations.
Exodus 30:9 And you shall not offer upon it another incense, an offering, a sacrifice; and you shall not pour a libation upon it.
Exodus 30:10 And Aaron shall make atonement upon it, upon its horns, once in the year; from the blood of the cleansing of sins of atonement, once in the year he shall cleanse it for their generations; it is Holy of Holies to the Lord.
Exodus 30:11 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 30:12 If you take the reckoning of the sons of Israel in their visitation, then each shall give a ransom for his soul to the Lord, and there shall not be a fall among them in their visitation.
Exodus 30:13 And this is what they shall give, as many as pass through the visitation: half of the didrachma, which is according to the holy didrachma; twenty obols are the didrachma, and the half of the didrachma is an offering to the Lord.
Exodus 30:14 Everyone who passes through into the visitation, from twenty years old and above, shall give the offering to the Lord.
Exodus 30:15 The one who is rich shall not add, and the one who is poor shall not lessen from the half of the didrachma when giving the offering to the Lord, to make atonement for your souls.
Exodus 30:16 And you shall take the silver of the offering from the sons of Israel and give it for the service of the tabernacle of testimony, and it shall be a memorial for the sons of Israel before the Lord, to make atonement for your souls.
Exodus 30:17 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 30:18 Make a bronze washing basin and a bronze base for it, so as to wash; and you shall place it between the tabernacle of testimony and between the altar and shall pour water into it,
Exodus 30:19 and Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it with water.
Exodus 30:20 Whenever they enter into the tabernacle of testimony, they shall wash with water and shall certainly not die; or whenever they approach the altar to minister and to offer the whole burnt offerings to the Lord,
Exodus 30:21 they shall wash their hands and their feet with water; whenever they enter into the tabernacle of testimony, they shall wash with water, so that they do not die; and it shall be an eternal ordinance for them, for him and his generations after him.
Exodus 30:22 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 30:23 And you, take spices: the flower of selected myrrh, five hundred shekels, and half this amount of fragrant cinnamon, two hundred fifty, and fragrant cane, two hundred fifty,
Exodus 30:24 and iris, five hundred holy shekels, and a hin of oil from olives,
Exodus 30:25 and you shall make it a holy anointing oil, a perfumed ointment by the craft of a perfumer; it shall be a holy anointing oil.
Exodus 30:26 And with it you shall anoint the tabernacle of testimony and the ark of testimony,
Exodus 30:27 and the lampstand and all its vessels and the altar of incense,
Exodus 30:28 and the altar of whole burnt offerings and all its vessels and the table and all its vessels and the washing basin and its base,
Exodus 30:29 and you shall sanctify them, and they shall be Holy of Holies; everyone who touches them shall be sanctified.
Exodus 30:30 And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and sanctify them to serve me as priests.
Exodus 30:31 And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying: This shall be for you a holy oil, an ointment of anointing, for your generations.
Exodus 30:32 It shall not be anointed upon human flesh, and according to this composition you shall not make the same for yourselves; it is holy and shall be a sanctified thing for you.
Exodus 30:33 Whoever makes the same and whoever gives from it to a foreigner shall be utterly destroyed from his people. –
Exodus 30:34 And the Lord said to Moses: Take spices for yourself, stacte, onycha, perfumed galbanum, and transparent frankincense; it shall be equal for equal;
Exodus 30:35 and they shall make with them incense, a perfumed work of a perfumer, mixed, pure, a holy work.
Exodus 30:36 And you shall beat some of these fine and place it opposite the testimonies in the tabernacle of testimony, from where I will be known to you from there; it shall be Holy of Holies for you.
Exodus 30:37 You shall not make incense for yourselves according to this composition; it shall be a sanctified thing for you to the Lord;
Exodus 30:38 whoever makes the same so as to smell it shall perish from his people.

## Chapter 31

Exodus 31:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 31:2 Behold, I have called by name Beseleel the son of Ouri, the son of Or, of the tribe of Judas,
Exodus 31:3 and I have filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and knowledge in every work,
Exodus 31:4 to devise and to master-build, to work the gold and the silver and the bronze and the hyacinth and the purple and the spun scarlet and the spun linen,
Exodus 31:5 and the works of stonecutting and the works of carpentry in wood, to work according to all the works.
Exodus 31:6 And I have given him also Eliab the son of Achisamach from the tribe of Dan, and to everyone understanding in heart I have given understanding, and they shall make all the things that I commanded you:
Exodus 31:7 the tabernacle of testimony and the ark of the covenant and the propitiatory upon it and the equipment of the tabernacle,
Exodus 31:8 and the altars and the table and all its vessels and the pure lampstand and all its vessels,
Exodus 31:9 and the washing basin and its base,
Exodus 31:10 and the ministering vestments of Aaron and the vestments of his sons for them to serve me as priests,
Exodus 31:11 and the oil of anointing and the compound incense of the holy place; according to all that I commanded you, they shall make them.
Exodus 31:12 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 31:13 And you, command the sons of Israel, saying: See that you also keep my Sabbaths; it is a sign with me and among you for your generations, so that you may know that I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
Exodus 31:14 And you shall keep the Sabbaths, because this is a holy thing of the Lord for you; the one who profanes it shall be put to death by death; everyone who does work on it, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of his people.
Exodus 31:15 Six days you shall do works, but on the seventh day there shall be Sabbaths, a holy rest for the Lord; everyone who does work on the seventh day shall be put to death by death.
Exodus 31:16 And the sons of Israel shall keep the Sabbaths, to perform them for their generations; an eternal covenant.
Exodus 31:17 It is an eternal sign in me and the sons of Israel, because in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he ceased and rested.
Exodus 31:18 And when he ceased speaking to him on Mount Sina, he gave Moses the two tablets of testimony, stone tablets written by the finger of God.

## Chapter 32

Exodus 32:1 And when the people saw that Moses had delayed to come down from the mountain, the people assembled around Aaron and said to him: Rise and make gods for us who shall go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.
Exodus 32:2 And Aaron says to them: Remove the golden earrings that are in the ears of your women and daughters and bring them to me.
Exodus 32:3 And all the people removed the golden earrings that were in their ears and brought them to Aaron.
Exodus 32:4 And he received them from their hands and shaped them with the engraving tool and made them into a molten calf and said: These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
Exodus 32:5 And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar opposite it, and Aaron proclaimed, saying: A feast of the Lord is tomorrow.
Exodus 32:6 And rising early on the next day, he offered whole burnt offerings and brought a sacrifice of salvation, and the people sat down to eat and drink and rose to play.
Exodus 32:7 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: Go quickly from here; descend, for your people, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt, have acted lawlessly;
Exodus 32:8 they quickly transgressed from the way that you commanded them; they made a calf for themselves and have worshiped it and have sacrificed to it and said: These are your gods, Israel, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.
Exodus 32:10 And now let me be, and being angered with wrath against them, I will wipe them out and make you into a great nation.
Exodus 32:11 And Moses entreated before the Lord God and said: Why, Lord, are you angered with wrath against your people, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt with great strength and with your high arm?
Exodus 32:12 Lest the Egyptians say: With wickedness he brought them out to kill them in the mountains and to consume them from the earth. Cease from the anger of your wrath and be propitious concerning the wickedness of your people,
Exodus 32:13 remembering Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, your household servants, to whom you swore by yourself and spoke to them, saying: I will greatly multiply your seed like the stars of heaven in multitude, and all this land that you said you would give to their seed, and they shall possess it for the age.
Exodus 32:14 And the Lord was propitiated concerning the wickedness that he said he would do to his people.
Exodus 32:15 And Moses, turning back, came down from the mountain, and the two tablets of testimony were in his hands, stone tablets inscribed on both their parts, written on this side and on that side;
Exodus 32:16 and the tablets were a work of God, and the writing is a writing of God carved in the tablets.
Exodus 32:17 And Jesus, hearing the voice of the people crying out, says to Moses: A voice of war is in the camp.
Exodus 32:18 And he says: It is not the voice of those beginning a song in strength, nor the voice of those beginning a song in defeat, but I hear the voice of those beginning a song in wine.
Exodus 32:19 And when he drew near the camp, he sees the calf and the dances, and Moses, angered with wrath, threw the two tablets from his hands and shattered them beneath the mountain.
Exodus 32:20 And taking the calf that they made, he burned it in fire and ground it fine and scattered it upon the water and made the sons of Israel drink it.
Exodus 32:21 And Moses said to Aaron: What did this people do to you, that you brought a great sin upon them?
Exodus 32:22 And Aaron said to Moses: Do not be angry, lord; for you know the impulse of this people.
Exodus 32:23 For they say to me: Make gods for us who shall go before us; for this Moses, the man who brought us out of Egypt, we do not know what has happened to him.
Exodus 32:24 And I said to them: If anyone has pieces of gold, remove them. And they gave them to me; and I threw them into the fire, and this calf came out.
Exodus 32:25 And Moses saw that the people had been scattered—for Aaron had scattered them, a delight to their adversaries—,
Exodus 32:26 and Moses stood at the gate of the camp and said: Whoever is for the Lord, let him come to me. Therefore all the sons of Levi gathered to him.
Exodus 32:27 And he says to them: Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: Let each one place his own double-edged sword upon his thigh, and pass through and return from gate to gate through the camp, and let each one kill his brother and each one his neighbor and each one the one nearest him.
Exodus 32:28 And the sons of Levi did as Moses spoke to them, and about three thousand men from the people fell on that day.
Exodus 32:29 And Moses said to them: You filled your hands today for the Lord, each one with his son or his brother, so that a blessing may be given upon you.
Exodus 32:30 And it happened after the morrow that Moses said to the people: You have sinned a great sin; and now I will go up to God, so that I may make atonement concerning your sin.
Exodus 32:31 And Moses returned to the Lord and said: I beg, Lord; this people has sinned a great sin and made golden gods for themselves.
Exodus 32:32 And now, if you forgive their sin, forgive; but if not, wipe me out from your book that you wrote.
Exodus 32:33 And the Lord said to Moses: If anyone has sinned before me, I will wipe him out from my book.
Exodus 32:34 But now go, descend, and guide this people into the place that I told you; behold, my angel goes before your face; and on whatever day I visit, I will bring their sin upon them.
Exodus 32:35 And the Lord struck the people concerning the making of the calf that Aaron made.

## Chapter 33

Exodus 33:1 And the Lord said to Moses: Go, ascend from here, you and your people whom you brought out of the land of Egypt, into the land that I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, saying: I will give it to your seed.
Exodus 33:2 And I will send my angel together before your face, and he shall drive out the Amorrite and Chettite and Pherezite and Gergesite and Evite and Jebousite.
Exodus 33:3 And I will bring you into a land flowing with milk and honey; for I will certainly not go up together with you, because you are a stiff-necked people, lest I utterly consume you on the way.
Exodus 33:4 And when the people heard this evil word, they mourned in mourning garments.
Exodus 33:5 And the Lord said to the sons of Israel: You are a stiff-necked people; see that I do not bring another blow upon you and utterly consume you; now therefore remove the vestments of your glories and the adornment, and I will show you what I will do to you.
Exodus 33:6 And the sons of Israel removed their adornment and their array from Mount Choreb.
Exodus 33:7 And Moses, taking his tent, pitched it outside the camp, far from the camp, and it was called the tabernacle of testimony; and it happened that everyone seeking the Lord went out to the tabernacle outside the camp.
Exodus 33:8 And whenever Moses entered the tabernacle outside the camp, all the people stood watching, each one beside the doors of his tent, and they observed Moses departing until he entered the tabernacle.
Exodus 33:9 And whenever Moses entered the tabernacle, the pillar of cloud descended and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and he spoke to Moses;
Exodus 33:10 and all the people saw the pillar of cloud standing at the door of the tabernacle, and all the people stood and worshiped, each one from the door of his tent.
Exodus 33:11 And the Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as if someone would speak to his own friend. And he would depart into the camp, but the attendant Jesus, the young son of Nave, did not go out from the tabernacle.
Exodus 33:12 And Moses said to the Lord: Behold, you say to me: Bring up this people; but you have not shown me whom you will send together with me; but you said to me: I know you beyond all, and you have grace with me.
Exodus 33:13 If therefore I have found grace before you, reveal yourself to me; let me see you knowingly, so that I may be one who has found grace before you, and so that I may know that this great nation is your people.
Exodus 33:14 And he says: I myself will go before you and give you rest.
Exodus 33:15 And he says to him: If you yourself do not go, do not bring me up from here;
Exodus 33:16 and how shall it be truly known that I have found grace with you, I and your people, except by your going together with us? And I and your people shall be glorified beyond all the nations that are upon the earth.
Exodus 33:17 And the Lord said to Moses: I will also do for you this word that you have spoken; for you have found grace before me, and I know you beyond all.
Exodus 33:18 And he says: Show me your own glory.
Exodus 33:19 And he said: I will pass before you in my glory and will call by my name, Lord, before you; and I will show mercy to whomever I show mercy, and I will have compassion on whomever I have compassion.
Exodus 33:20 And he said: You will not be able to see my face; for a man shall certainly not see my face and live.
Exodus 33:21 And the Lord said: Behold, there is a place beside me; you shall stand upon the rock;
Exodus 33:22 and whenever my glory passes, I will place you in a cleft of the rock and cover you with my hand over you until I pass;
Exodus 33:23 and I will remove my hand, and then you shall see my back parts, but my face shall not appear to you.

## Chapter 34

Exodus 34:1 And the Lord said to Moses: Hew two stone tablets for yourself, just as the first ones, and go up to me into the mountain, and I will write upon the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you shattered.
Exodus 34:2 And be ready for the morning, and you shall go up upon Mount Sina and stand there for me upon the summit of the mountain.
Exodus 34:3 And let no one go up with you, nor let anyone appear on the whole mountain; and let neither the sheep nor the cattle graze near that mountain.
Exodus 34:4 And he hewed two stone tablets just as the first ones; and rising early, Moses went up into Mount Sina, just as the Lord commanded him; and Moses took the two stone tablets.
Exodus 34:5 And the Lord descended in a cloud and stood beside him there; and he called by the name of the Lord.
Exodus 34:6 And the Lord passed before his face and called: The Lord, the God compassionate and merciful, longsuffering and abundant in mercy and true,
Exodus 34:7 and preserving righteousness and doing mercy to thousands, taking away lawlessness and injustice and sins, and he will not cleanse the guilty, bringing the lawlessness of fathers upon children and upon children’s children, upon the third and fourth generation.
Exodus 34:8 And Moses, hastening, bowed toward the earth and worshiped,
Exodus 34:9 and said: If I have found grace before you, let my Lord go together with us; for the people are stiff-necked, and you shall take away our sins and our lawlessness, and we shall be yours.
Exodus 34:10 And the Lord said to Moses: Behold, I establish a covenant for you; before all your people I will do glorious things that have not happened in all the earth and in any nation, and all the people among whom you are shall see the works of the Lord, because the things that I will do for you are marvelous.
Exodus 34:11 You attend to all the things that I command you. Behold, I drive out before you all the Amorrite and Chanaanite and Chettite and Pherezite and Evite and Gergesite and Jebousite;
Exodus 34:12 attend to yourself, lest you establish a covenant with those settled upon the land into which you enter, lest it become a stumbling block for you among you all.
Exodus 34:13 You shall tear down their altars and crush their pillars and cut down their groves and burn the carved images of their gods with fire.
Exodus 34:14 For you shall certainly not worship another god; for the Lord God is a jealous name, he is a jealous God.
Exodus 34:15 Lest you establish a covenant with those settled with the foreigners upon the land, and they prostitute themselves after their gods and sacrifice to their gods and call you and you eat from their sacrifices,
Exodus 34:16 and you take from their daughters for your sons and give from your daughters to their sons, and your daughters prostitute themselves after their gods and make your sons prostitute themselves after their gods.
Exodus 34:17 And you shall not make molten gods for yourself.
Exodus 34:18 And you shall keep the feast of unleavened bread; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, just as I commanded you, at the season in the month of the new things; for in the month of the new things you came out of Egypt.
Exodus 34:19 Every male that opens the womb is mine: the firstborn of a calf and the firstborn of a sheep.
Exodus 34:20 And you shall redeem the firstborn of a pack animal with a sheep; but if you do not redeem it, you shall give its price. You shall redeem every firstborn of your sons. You shall not appear before me empty.
Exodus 34:21 Six days you shall work, but on the seventh you shall rest; at sowing and at harvest you shall rest.
Exodus 34:22 And you shall make for me a feast of weeks, the beginning of the wheat harvest, and a feast of gathering while the year is midway.
Exodus 34:23 Three seasons of the year every male of yours shall appear before the Lord, the God of Israel;
Exodus 34:24 for whenever I drive out the nations before your face and broaden your boundaries, no one shall covet your land whenever you go up to appear before the Lord your God three seasons of the year.
Exodus 34:25 You shall not slaughter the blood of my incense offerings upon leaven. And the sacrifices of the feast of Pascha shall not sleep until morning.
Exodus 34:26 You shall place the first produce of your land in the house of the Lord your God. You shall not bring a lamb in its mother’s milk.
Exodus 34:27 And the Lord said to Moses: Write these words for yourself; for upon these words I have established a covenant for you and for Israel.
Exodus 34:28 And Moses was there before the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did not eat bread and did not drink water; and he wrote these words upon the tablets of the covenant, the ten words. –
Exodus 34:29 And as Moses was coming down from the mountain, the two tablets were upon the hands of Moses; and while he was coming down from the mountain, Moses did not know that the appearance of the complexion of his face had been glorified while he spoke to him.
Exodus 34:30 And Aaron and all the elders of Israel saw Moses, and the appearance of the complexion of his face had been glorified, and they were afraid to draw near him.
Exodus 34:31 And Moses called them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation turned toward him, and Moses spoke to them.
Exodus 34:32 And after these things all the sons of Israel approached him, and he commanded them all the things that the Lord spoke to him on Mount Sina.
Exodus 34:33 And when he ceased speaking to them, he placed a covering upon his face.
Exodus 34:34 But whenever Moses entered before the Lord to speak to him, he removed the covering until he went out. And going out, he spoke to all the sons of Israel the things that the Lord commanded him,
Exodus 34:35 and the sons of Israel saw the face of Moses, that it had been glorified, and Moses placed a covering upon his own face until he entered to speak together with him.

## Chapter 35

Exodus 35:1 And Moses gathered the whole congregation of the sons of Israel and said to them: These are the words that the Lord said to do.
Exodus 35:2 Six days you shall do works, but on the seventh day there shall be rest, a holy thing, Sabbaths, a rest for the Lord; let everyone who does work on it end.
Exodus 35:3 You shall not kindle fire in any of your dwellings on the day of the Sabbaths; I am the Lord.
Exodus 35:4 And Moses said to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: This is the word that the Lord commanded, saying:
Exodus 35:5 Take from yourselves a removal offering for the Lord; all who accept in the heart shall bring the firstfruits to the Lord: gold, silver, bronze,
Exodus 35:6 hyacinth, purple, finely spun double scarlet and spun linen and goat hair,
Exodus 35:7 and red-dyed ram skins and hyacinth-colored skins and incorruptible wood,
Exodus 35:9 and sardius stones and stones for engraving for the shoulder piece and the full-length robe.
Exodus 35:10 And let everyone wise in heart among you come and work all the things that the Lord commanded:
Exodus 35:11 the tabernacle and the side curtains and the coverings and the stretchers and the bars and the pillars,
Exodus 35:12 and the ark of testimony and its carrying poles and its propitiatory and the veil,
Exodus 35:12 a And the hangings of the court and its pillars and the emerald stones and the incense and the oil of anointing,
Exodus 35:13 and the table and all its vessels,
Exodus 35:14 and the lampstand of light and all its vessels,
Exodus 35:16 and the altar and all its vessels,
Exodus 35:19 and the holy vestments of Aaron the priest and the vestments in which they shall minister in them and the tunics for the sons of Aaron for the priesthood and the oil of anointing and the compound incense. –
Exodus 35:20 And the whole congregation of the sons of Israel went out from Moses,
Exodus 35:21 and each brought the things that their heart bore, and as many as it seemed good to in their soul brought a removal offering to the Lord for all the works of the tabernacle of testimony and for all its services and for all the vestments of the holy place.
Exodus 35:22 And the men brought from the women; everyone to whom it seemed good in the understanding brought seals and earrings and rings and braided ornaments and bracelets, every golden vessel, and all who brought removal offerings of gold to the Lord.
Exodus 35:23 And everyone with whom linen and hyacinth-colored skins and red-dyed ram skins were found brought them.
Exodus 35:24 And everyone removing a removal offering of silver and bronze brought the removal offerings to the Lord, and those with whom incorruptible wood was found for all the works of the construction brought it.
Exodus 35:25 And every woman wise in understanding to spin with her hands brought the things they had spun: the hyacinth and the purple and the scarlet and the linen;
Exodus 35:26 and all the women to whom it seemed good in their understanding, with wisdom, spun the goat hair.
Exodus 35:27 And the rulers brought the emerald stones and the stones of filling for the shoulder piece and for the oracle,
Exodus 35:28 and the compounds and the oil of anointing and the compound of incense.
Exodus 35:29 And every man and woman whose understanding bore them, having entered to do all the works that the Lord commanded to be done through Moses, the sons of Israel brought a removal offering to the Lord.
Exodus 35:30 And Moses said to the sons of Israel: Behold, God has called by name Beseleel the son of Ouri, the son of Or, from the tribe of Judas,
Exodus 35:31 and filled him with a divine spirit of wisdom and understanding and knowledge of all things,
Exodus 35:32 to master-build according to all the works of master-building, to make the gold and the silver and the bronze,
Exodus 35:33 and to work stone as a stonecutter and to work the wood and to make every work of wisdom;
Exodus 35:34 and indeed he gave it to him in his understanding to teach, both to him and Eliab the son of Achisamach from the tribe of Dan;
Exodus 35:35 he filled them with wisdom and understanding of mind, to understand how to make the works of the holy place and the woven and embroidered things, to weave with the scarlet and the linen, to make every work of master-building and embroidery.

## Chapter 36

Exodus 36:1 And Beseleel and Eliab and everyone wise in understanding, to whom wisdom and knowledge had been given among them to understand how to make all the works according to the holy duties, did according to all that the Lord commanded.
Exodus 36:2 And Moses called Beseleel and Eliab and all those possessing wisdom, to whom God had given knowledge in the heart, and all those willingly desiring to approach the works so as to complete them,
Exodus 36:3 and they received from Moses all the removal offerings that the sons of Israel had brought for all the works of the holy place to make them, and they still continued to receive the things offered by those bringing them morning by morning.
Exodus 36:4 And all the wise people making the works of the holy place came, each according to his own work that they were working,
Exodus 36:5 and they said to Moses: The people are bringing an abundance beyond the works that the Lord commanded to be made.
Exodus 36:6 And Moses commanded and proclaimed in the camp, saying: Let man and woman no longer work for the firstfruits of the holy place; and the people were prevented from offering any more.
Exodus 36:7 And the works were sufficient for them to make the construction, and they left over besides.
Exodus 36:8 And everyone wise among those working made the holy vestments that belong to Aaron the priest, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
Exodus 36:9 And they made the shoulder piece from gold and hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen.
Exodus 36:10 And the plates of gold were cut into threads so as to be woven together with the hyacinth and the purple and with the finely spun scarlet and with the spun linen, a woven work;
Exodus 36:11 they made it with shoulder pieces joining from both parts,
Exodus 36:12 a woven work braided together with one another, in itself from itself; they made it according to its workmanship from gold and hyacinth and purple and finely spun scarlet and spun linen, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
Exodus 36:13 And they made both emerald stones clasped and set around with gold, engraved and carved with the carving of a seal from the names of the sons of Israel;
Exodus 36:14 and he placed them upon the shoulders of the shoulder piece, stones of memorial for the sons of Israel, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
Exodus 36:15 And they made an oracle, a woven work with embroidery, according to the work of the shoulder piece, from gold and hyacinth and purple and finely spun scarlet and spun linen;
Exodus 36:16 they made the oracle square and doubled, a span in length and a span in width, doubled.
Exodus 36:17 And fabric studded with stones in four rows was woven into it; one row of stones was sardius and topaz and emerald, the one row;
Exodus 36:18 and the second row, carbuncle and sapphire and jasper;
Exodus 36:19 and the third row, ligure and agate and amethyst;
Exodus 36:20 and the fourth row, chrysolite and beryl and onyx, encircled with gold and bound with gold.
Exodus 36:21 And the stones were twelve, from the names of the sons of Israel, from their names, inscribed as seals, each from his own name, for the twelve tribes.
Exodus 36:22 And they made braided fringes upon the oracle, a work of braiding from pure gold;
Exodus 36:23 and they made two golden small shields and two golden rings and placed the two golden rings upon both ends of the oracle;
Exodus 36:24 and they placed the braids of gold upon the rings on both parts of the oracle,
Exodus 36:25 and the two braids into the two joinings, and they placed them upon the two small shields and placed them upon the shoulders of the shoulder piece opposite, toward the front.
Exodus 36:26 And they made two golden rings and placed them upon the two wings at the edge of the oracle, upon the edge of the rear of the shoulder piece, inside.
Exodus 36:27 And they made two golden rings and placed them upon both shoulders of the shoulder piece, below it toward the front, at the joining above the woven band of the shoulder piece.
Exodus 36:28 And he fastened the oracle from the rings upon it to the rings of the shoulder piece, held together by the hyacinth and braided into the fabric of the shoulder piece, so that the oracle would not loosen from the shoulder piece, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
Exodus 36:29 And they made the undergarment beneath the shoulder piece, a woven work entirely hyacinth-colored;
Exodus 36:30 and the neck opening of the undergarment was interwoven and knitted in the middle, having an unbreakable border around the neck opening.
Exodus 36:31 And upon the hem of the undergarment below they made small pomegranates, as of a blossoming pomegranate, from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen,
Exodus 36:32 and they made golden bells and placed the bells upon the hem of the undergarment all around, between the small pomegranates;
Exodus 36:33 a golden bell and a small pomegranate upon the hem of the undergarment all around for ministering, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
Exodus 36:34 And they made woven linen tunics for Aaron and his sons,
Exodus 36:35 and the turbans from linen and the miter from linen and the breeches from spun linen,
Exodus 36:36 and their sashes from linen and hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet, the work of an embroiderer, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses.
Exodus 36:37 And they made the golden plate, a separation of the holy place, from pure gold; and he wrote upon it letters imprinted as a seal: A Holy Thing to the Lord;
Exodus 36:38 and they placed a hyacinth hem upon it so that it would lie upon the miter above, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses.

## Chapter 37

Exodus 37:1 And they made ten curtains for the tabernacle,
Exodus 37:2 the length of the one curtain twenty-eight cubits—they were all the same—and the width of the one curtain four cubits.
Exodus 37:3 And they made the veil from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen, a woven work with cherubim,
Exodus 37:4 and they placed it upon four incorruptible pillars overlaid with gold, and their capitals were golden, and their four bases silver.
Exodus 37:5 And they made the veil of the door of the tabernacle of testimony from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen, a woven work with cherubim,
Exodus 37:6 and its five pillars and the rings; and they overlaid their capitals and their clasps with gold, and their five bases were bronze.
Exodus 37:7 And they made the court; the hangings of the court toward the southwest wind were from spun linen, one hundred by one hundred,
Exodus 37:8 and their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty;
Exodus 37:9 and the side toward the north one hundred by one hundred, and their pillars twenty, and their bases twenty;
Exodus 37:10 and the side toward the sea had curtains of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their bases ten;
Exodus 37:11 and the side toward the east was fifty cubits,
Exodus 37:12 hangings of fifteen cubits along the rear, and their pillars three, and their bases three,
Exodus 37:13 and upon the second rear, on this side and that side along the gate of the court, curtains of fifteen cubits, and their pillars three, and their bases three.
Exodus 37:14 All the curtains of the court were from spun linen,
Exodus 37:15 and the bases of the pillars bronze, and their loops silver, and their capitals plated with silver, and the pillars plated with silver, all the pillars of the court. –
Exodus 37:16 And the veil of the gate of the court was the work of an embroiderer, from hyacinth and purple and spun scarlet and spun linen, twenty cubits in length, and the height and the width five cubits, equal to the hangings of the court;
Exodus 37:17 and their pillars four, and their four bases bronze, and their loops silver, and their capitals plated with silver;
Exodus 37:18 and they themselves plated with silver, and all the stakes of the court all around bronze.
Exodus 37:19 And this is the arrangement of the tabernacle of testimony, just as it was ordered to Moses for the ministry to belong to the Levites through Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
Exodus 37:20 And Beseleel the son of Ouri from the tribe of Judas made it just as the Lord commanded Moses,
Exodus 37:21 and Eliab the son of Achisamach from the tribe of Dan, who master-built the woven and needleworked and embroidered things, to weave with the scarlet and the linen.

## Chapter 38

Exodus 38:1 And Beseleel made the ark,
Exodus 38:2 and he overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside.
Exodus 38:3 And he cast four golden rings for it, two upon the one side and two upon the second side,
Exodus 38:4 wide enough for the carrying poles so as to carry it with them.
Exodus 38:5 And he made the propitiatory above the ark from gold,
Exodus 38:6 and the two golden cherubim,
Exodus 38:7 one cherub upon the one end of the propitiatory and one cherub upon the second end of the propitiatory,
Exodus 38:8 overshadowing the propitiatory with their wings.
Exodus 38:9 And he made the table that is set forth from pure gold;
Exodus 38:10 and he cast four rings for it, two upon the one side and two upon the second side, wide enough so as to carry it with the carrying poles in them.
Exodus 38:11 And he made the carrying poles of the ark and of the table and overlaid them with gold.
Exodus 38:12 And he made the vessels of the table, both the dishes and the censers and the cups and the libation vessels in which he shall pour with them, golden.
Exodus 38:13 And he made the lampstand that gives light, golden, with a solid stem,
Exodus 38:14 and the branches from both its parts;
Exodus 38:15 from its branches the shoots protruding, three from this side and three from that side, equal to one another;
Exodus 38:16 and their lamp-cups, which are upon the ends, nut-shaped from them; and the settings from them, so that the lamps may be upon them, and the seventh setting from the end of the lamp-cup upon the summit above, solid, entirely golden;
Exodus 38:17 and seven golden lamps upon it and its golden tongs and their golden oil-drawers.
Exodus 38:18 This one plated the pillars with silver and cast golden rings for the pillar and overlaid the bars with gold and overlaid the pillars of the veil with gold and made the loops golden.
Exodus 38:19 This one also made the rings of the tabernacle golden, and the rings of the court, and bronze rings for stretching the covering above.
Exodus 38:20 This one cast the silver capitals of the tabernacle and the bronze capitals of the door of the tabernacle and the gate of the court, and made silver loops for the pillars upon the pillars; this one plated them with silver.
Exodus 38:21 This one also made the stakes of the tabernacle and the stakes of the court bronze.
Exodus 38:22 This one made the bronze altar from the bronze fire-pans that belonged to the men who rebelled with the congregation of Kore.
Exodus 38:23 This one made all the vessels of the altar and its fire-pan and the base and the bowls and the flesh-hooks bronze.
Exodus 38:24 This one made for the altar an appendage, a work of network, below the fire-pan under it as far as its middle, and placed upon it four bronze rings from the four parts of the appendage of the altar, wide enough for the bars so as to carry the altar with them.
Exodus 38:25 This one made the holy oil of anointing and the compound incense, a pure work of a perfumer.
Exodus 38:26 This one made the bronze washing basin and its bronze base from the mirrors of the women who fasted, who fasted beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony on the day when he set it up;
Exodus 38:27 and he made the washing basin so that Moses and Aaron and his sons might wash their hands and their feet from it; when they entered into the tabernacle of testimony or whenever they approached the altar to minister, they washed from it, just as the Lord commanded Moses.

## Chapter 39

Exodus 39:1 All the gold that was worked for the works, according to all the workmanship of the holy things, came to twenty-nine talents and seven hundred twenty shekels of the gold of the firstfruit, according to the holy shekel;
Exodus 39:2 and the removal offering of silver from the inspected men of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels,
Exodus 39:3 one drachma per head, half of the shekel according to the holy shekel, from everyone passing through the visitation, from twenty years old and above, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
Exodus 39:4 And the one hundred talents of silver were for casting the one hundred capitals of the tabernacle and for the capitals of the veil, one hundred capitals for the one hundred talents, a talent for each capital.
Exodus 39:5 And the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels they made into the loops for the pillars, and he overlaid their capitals with gold and adorned them.
Exodus 39:6 And the bronze of the removal offering was seventy talents and one thousand five hundred shekels.
Exodus 39:7 And he made from it the bases of the door of the tabernacle of testimony,
Exodus 39:8 and the bases of the court all around and the bases of the gate of the court and the stakes of the tabernacle and the stakes of the court all around,
Exodus 39:9 and the bronze appendage of the altar and all the vessels of the altar and all the implements of the tabernacle of testimony.
Exodus 39:10 And the sons of Israel did just as the Lord commanded Moses; thus they did.
Exodus 39:11 And the remaining gold of the removal offering they made into vessels for ministering with them before the Lord.
Exodus 39:12 And the remaining hyacinth and purple and scarlet they made into ministering vestments for Aaron, so as to minister in them in the holy place.
Exodus 39:13 And they brought the vestments to Moses and the tabernacle and its vessels and the bases and its bars and the pillars,
Exodus 39:14 and the ark of the covenant and its carrying poles,
Exodus 39:15 and the altar and all its vessels and the oil of anointing and the compound incense,
Exodus 39:16 and the pure lampstand and its lamps, lamps of burning, and the oil of light,
Exodus 39:17 and the table of the presentation and all its vessels and the breads set forth,
Exodus 39:18 and the vestments of the holy place that belong to Aaron and the vestments of his sons for the priesthood,
Exodus 39:19 and the hangings of the court and the pillars and the veil of the door of the tabernacle and of the gate of the court and all the vessels of the tabernacle and all its implements,
Exodus 39:20 and the leathers, the red-dyed ram skins, and the coverings of hyacinth-colored skins and the upper coverings of the remaining things,
Exodus 39:21 and the stakes and all the implements for the works of the tabernacle of testimony;
Exodus 39:22 all that the Lord commanded Moses, thus the sons of Israel made all the equipment.
Exodus 39:23 And Moses saw all the works, and they had made them in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses, thus they made them; and Moses blessed them.

## Chapter 40

Exodus 40:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Exodus 40:2 On day one of the first month, at the new moon, you shall erect the tabernacle of testimony,
Exodus 40:3 and you shall place the ark of testimony and cover the ark with the veil,
Exodus 40:4 and you shall bring in the table and set forth its presentation, and you shall bring in the lampstand and place its lamps,
Exodus 40:5 and you shall place the golden altar for burning incense opposite the ark and place a covering of the veil upon the door of the tabernacle of testimony,
Exodus 40:6 and you shall place the altar of offerings beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony,
Exodus 40:8 and you shall surround the tabernacle and sanctify all its things all around.
Exodus 40:9 And you shall take the oil of anointing and anoint the tabernacle and all the things in it and sanctify it and all its vessels, and it shall be holy.
Exodus 40:10 And you shall anoint the altar of offerings and all its vessels and sanctify the altar, and the altar shall be Holy of Holies.
Exodus 40:12 And you shall bring Aaron and his sons to the doors of the tabernacle of testimony and wash them with water,
Exodus 40:13 and you shall clothe Aaron with the holy vestments and anoint him and sanctify him, and he shall serve me as priest;
Exodus 40:14 and you shall bring his sons and clothe them with tunics,
Exodus 40:15 and you shall anoint them in the manner that you anointed their father, and they shall serve me as priests; and it shall be that an anointing of priesthood is theirs for the age, for their generations.
Exodus 40:16 And Moses did all the things that the Lord commanded him; thus he did.
Exodus 40:17 And it happened in the first month, in the second year of their going out of Egypt, at the new moon, that the tabernacle was erected;
Exodus 40:18 and Moses erected the tabernacle and placed the capitals and inserted the bars through and erected the pillars,
Exodus 40:19 and stretched the curtains over the tabernacle and placed the covering of the tabernacle upon it above, just as the Lord commanded Moses. –
Exodus 40:20 And taking the testimonies, he put them into the ark and placed the carrying poles beneath the ark,
Exodus 40:21 and he brought the ark into the tabernacle and placed the covering of the veil and covered the ark of testimony, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses. –
Exodus 40:22 And he placed the table in the tabernacle of testimony upon the side of the tabernacle of testimony toward the north, outside the veil of the tabernacle,
Exodus 40:23 and set forth upon it the breads of the presentation before the Lord, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses. –
Exodus 40:24 And he placed the lampstand in the tabernacle of testimony, on the side of the tabernacle toward the south,
Exodus 40:25 and placed its lamps before the Lord, in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses. –
Exodus 40:26 And he placed the golden altar in the tabernacle of testimony opposite the veil,
Exodus 40:27 and burned the compound incense upon it, just as the Lord commanded Moses. –
Exodus 40:29 And he placed the altar of offerings beside the doors of the tabernacle,
Exodus 40:33 and erected the court all around the tabernacle and the altar. And Moses completed all the works.
Exodus 40:34 And the cloud covered the tabernacle of testimony, and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of the Lord;
Exodus 40:35 and Moses was not able to enter into the tabernacle of testimony, because the cloud overshadowed it and the tabernacle was filled with the glory of the Lord.
Exodus 40:36 And whenever the cloud rose from the tabernacle, the sons of Israel broke camp with their equipment;
Exodus 40:37 but if the cloud did not rise, they did not break camp until the day on which the cloud rose;
Exodus 40:38 for a cloud was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was upon it by night before all Israel in all their departures.

# Leviticus

The Apostolic Bible. Public domain. https://apostolic-bible.ysys9.chatgpt.site/license.html


## Chapter 1

Leviticus 1:1 And the Lord called Moses back and spoke to him from the tabernacle of testimony, saying:
Leviticus 1:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: If a man from among you presents gifts to the Lord, from the livestock, from the cattle and from the sheep, you shall present your gifts.
Leviticus 1:3 If his gift from the cattle is a whole burnt offering, he shall present an unblemished male; he shall bring it to the door of the tabernacle of testimony, acceptable before the Lord.
