Leviticus 16:20 And he shall finish making atonement for the holy place and the tabernacle of testimony and the altar, and concerning the priests he shall cleanse; and he shall bring the living male kid.
Leviticus 16:21 And Aaron shall place his hands upon the head of the living male kid and shall declare over it all the lawless deeds of the sons of Israel and all their injustices and all their sins, and shall place them upon the head of the living male kid and shall send it away by the hand of a ready person into the wilderness.
Leviticus 16:22 And the male kid shall take their injustices upon itself into an untrodden land, and he shall send away the male kid into the wilderness.
Leviticus 16:23 And Aaron shall enter into the tabernacle of testimony and shall take off the linen robe that he had put on when he entered into the holy place and shall lay it there.
Leviticus 16:24 And he shall bathe his body in water in a holy place and shall put on his robe, and going out, he shall make his whole offering and the whole offering of the people and shall make atonement concerning himself and his house and concerning the people as concerning the priests.
Leviticus 16:25 And the fat concerning sins he shall offer upon the altar.
Leviticus 16:26 And the one who sends away the male kid that was separated for release shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and after these things he shall enter into the camp.
Leviticus 16:27 And the calf concerning sin and the male kid concerning sin, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, they shall carry them outside the camp and shall burn them with fire, both their hides and their flesh and their dung.
Leviticus 16:28 And the one who burns them shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and after these things he shall enter into the camp.
Leviticus 16:29 And this shall be an eternal ordinance for you: in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month, humble your souls, and you shall do no work, the native and the proselyte who is attached among you.
Leviticus 16:30 For on this day he shall make atonement concerning you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord, and you shall be cleansed.
Leviticus 16:31 It shall be a Sabbath of Sabbaths, a rest for you, and you shall humble your souls; it is an eternal ordinance.
Leviticus 16:32 The priest shall make atonement, the one whom they anoint and whose hands they perfect to serve as priest after his father, and he shall put on the linen robe, a holy robe.
Leviticus 16:33 And he shall make atonement for the Holy of Holies, and he shall make atonement for the tabernacle of testimony and the altar, and he shall make atonement concerning the priests and concerning the whole congregation.
Leviticus 16:34 And this shall be an eternal ordinance for you, to make atonement concerning the sons of Israel for all their sins; once in the year it shall be done, just as the Lord instructed Moses.

## Chapter 17

Leviticus 17:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 17:2 Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: This is the word that the Lord commanded, saying:
Leviticus 17:3 Any person from the sons of Israel or from the proselytes who are attached among you, who slaughters a calf or sheep or goat in the camp or who slaughters it outside the camp
Leviticus 17:4 and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of testimony so as to make it a whole burnt offering or a salvation acceptable to the Lord for an aroma of fragrance, and whoever slaughters it outside and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of testimony so as not to offer a gift to the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord, blood shall be reckoned to that person; he has shed blood; that soul shall be utterly destroyed from its people.
Leviticus 17:5 This is so that the sons of Israel may bring their sacrifices, as many as they themselves slaughter in the plains, and they shall bring them to the Lord at the doors of the tabernacle of testimony, to the priest, and shall sacrifice them as a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord.
Leviticus 17:6 And the priest shall pour the blood upon the altar all around before the Lord beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony and shall offer the fat as an aroma of fragrance to the Lord.
Leviticus 17:7 And they shall no longer sacrifice their sacrifices to the vain things after which they themselves prostitute themselves; it shall be an eternal ordinance for you throughout your generations.
Leviticus 17:8 And you shall say to them: Any person from the sons of Israel and from the sons of the proselytes who are attached among you who makes a whole burnt offering or a sacrifice
Leviticus 17:9 and does not bring it to the door of the tabernacle of testimony to make it for the Lord, that person shall be utterly destroyed from his people.
Leviticus 17:10 And any person from the sons of Israel or from the proselytes who are attached among you who eats any blood, I shall set my face against the soul that eats the blood and shall destroy it from its people.
Leviticus 17:11 For the soul of all flesh is its blood, and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement concerning your souls; for its blood shall make atonement instead of the soul.
Leviticus 17:12 Therefore I have said to the sons of Israel: No soul from among you shall eat blood, and the proselyte who is attached among you shall not eat blood.
Leviticus 17:13 And any person from the sons of Israel and from the proselytes who are attached among you who hunts as game a wild animal or bird that is eaten shall pour out the blood and cover it with earth.
Leviticus 17:14 For the soul of all flesh is its blood, and I said to the sons of Israel: You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, because the soul of all flesh is its blood; everyone who eats it shall be utterly destroyed.
Leviticus 17:15 And every soul that eats a carcass or something caught by a wild beast, among the natives or among the proselytes, shall wash his garments and bathe in water and shall be unclean until evening, and then he shall be clean.
Leviticus 17:16 But if he does not wash his garments and does not bathe his body in water, then he shall bear his lawlessness.

## Chapter 18

Leviticus 18:1 And the Lord said to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 18:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 18:3 You shall not do according to the practices of the land of Egypt, in which you dwelt, and you shall not do according to the practices of the land of Chanaan, into which I am bringing you there, and you shall not walk in their ordinances.
Leviticus 18:4 You shall do my judgments and keep my ordinances, to walk in them; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 18:5 And you shall keep all my ordinances and all my judgments and shall do them, which, if a person does, he shall live by them; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 18:6 No person shall approach any relative of his flesh to uncover shamefulness; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 18:7 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your father and the shamefulness of your mother; for she is your mother, and you shall not uncover her shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:8 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:9 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your sister from your father or from your mother, whether born within or born outside.
Leviticus 18:10 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, because it is your shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:11 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of the daughter of your father’s wife; she is your sister by the same father; you shall not uncover her shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:12 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your father’s sister, for she is a relative of your father.
Leviticus 18:13 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your mother’s sister, for she is a relative of your mother.
Leviticus 18:14 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your father’s brother, and you shall not enter into his wife, for she is your relative.
Leviticus 18:15 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your daughter-in-law, for she is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:16 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:17 You shall not uncover the shamefulness of a woman and her daughter; you shall not take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter to uncover their shamefulness, for they are your relatives; it is an impiety.
Leviticus 18:18 You shall not take a woman in addition to her sister as a rival, to uncover her shamefulness in addition to her while she is still living.
Leviticus 18:19 And you shall not approach a woman in the separation of her uncleanness to uncover her shamefulness.
Leviticus 18:20 And you shall not give the bed of your seed to the wife of your neighbor, to be defiled with her.
Leviticus 18:21 And you shall not give any of your seed to serve a ruler, and you shall not profane the holy name; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 18:22 And you shall not lie with a male in the bed of a woman, for it is an abomination.
Leviticus 18:23 And you shall not give your bed to any quadruped for insemination, to be defiled with it, and a woman shall not stand before any quadruped to be mounted, for it is loathsome.
Leviticus 18:24 Do not defile yourselves by any of these things, for by all these things the nations that I send away from before you were defiled,
Leviticus 18:25 and the land was defiled, and I repaid injustice to them because of it, and the land was disgusted with those dwelling upon it.
Leviticus 18:26 And you shall keep all my ordinances and all my commands and shall not do any of all these abominations, the native and the proselyte who has come among you.
Leviticus 18:27 For all these abominations were done by the people of the land who were before you, and the land was defiled;
Leviticus 18:28 and this is so that the land may not be disgusted with you when you defile it, in the manner that it was disgusted with the nations that were before you.
Leviticus 18:29 Because everyone who does any of all these abominations—the souls that do them shall be utterly destroyed from their people.
Leviticus 18:30 And you shall keep my commands so that you do not do any of all the abominated ordinances that occurred before you, and you shall not be defiled by them, because I am the Lord your God.

## Chapter 19

Leviticus 19:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 19:2 Speak to the congregation of the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: You shall be holy, because I am holy, the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:3 Let each one fear his father and his mother, and you shall keep my Sabbaths; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:4 You shall not follow idols, and you shall not make molten gods for yourselves; I am the Lord your God. –
Leviticus 19:5 And if you sacrifice a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, you shall sacrifice it as acceptable for you.
Leviticus 19:6 On whatever day you sacrifice it, it shall be eaten, and on the next day; and if it remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
Leviticus 19:7 But if, with eating, it is eaten on the third day, it is unsacrificed; it shall not be accepted.
Leviticus 19:8 And the one who eats it shall bear sin, because he profaned the holy things of the Lord; and the souls that eat it shall be utterly destroyed from their people.
Leviticus 19:9 And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the harvest of your field, and you shall not gather the things that fall from your harvest.
Leviticus 19:10 And you shall not gather your vineyard again, nor shall you gather the grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the proselyte; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:11 You shall not steal. You shall not lie. Each one shall not slander his neighbor.
Leviticus 19:12 And you shall not swear by my name for an unjust thing, and you shall not profane the name of your God; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:13 You shall not wrong your neighbor, and you shall not rob, and the wage of the hired worker shall certainly not sleep with you until morning.
Leviticus 19:14 You shall not speak evil of a deaf person, and you shall not place a stumbling block before a blind person, and you shall fear the Lord your God; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:15 You shall not do injustice in judgment; you shall not accept the face of a poor person, nor shall you admire the face of a powerful person; in righteousness you shall judge your neighbor.
Leviticus 19:16 You shall not go by deceit in your nation; you shall not conspire against the blood of your neighbor; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:17 You shall not hate your brother in your mind; with reproof you shall reprove your neighbor, and you shall not bear sin because of him.
Leviticus 19:18 And your hand shall not avenge you, and you shall not bear a grudge against the sons of your people, and you shall love your neighbor as yourself; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 19:19 You shall keep my law; you shall not mate your animals with a different yoke, and you shall not sow your vineyard with diverse seed, and you shall not put upon yourself an adulterated garment woven from two things.
Leviticus 19:20 And if anyone lies with a woman with an emission of semen, and she is a female servant reserved for a man and she has not been ransomed with a ransom or freedom has not been given to her, there shall be an examination for them; they shall not die, because she had not been freed.
Leviticus 19:21 And he shall bring for his trespass to the Lord, beside the door of the tabernacle of testimony, a ram of trespass.
Leviticus 19:22 And the priest shall make atonement concerning him with the ram of trespass before the Lord concerning the sin that he sinned, and the sin that he sinned shall be forgiven him.
Leviticus 19:23 And when you enter into the land that the Lord your God gives you and plant every food-bearing tree, then you shall cleanse away its uncleanness all around; its fruit shall be uncleansed all around for you three years; it shall not be eaten.
Leviticus 19:24 And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, praiseworthy to the Lord.
Leviticus 19:25 But in the fifth year you shall eat the fruit; its produce shall be an addition for you; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:26 Do not eat upon the mountains, and you shall not practice augury or observe birds for omens.
Leviticus 19:27 You shall not make a sisoe from the hair of your head, nor shall you destroy the appearance of your beard.
Leviticus 19:28 And you shall not make incisions for a soul in your body, and you shall not make tattooed letters upon yourselves; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:29 You shall not profane your daughter by prostituting her, and the land shall not prostitute itself and the land shall not be filled with lawlessness.
Leviticus 19:30 You shall keep my Sabbaths and shall fear because of my holy things; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 19:31 You shall not follow belly-speakers, and you shall not join yourselves to enchanters, to be defiled by them; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:32 You shall rise up before the face of a gray-haired person and shall honor the face of an elder and shall fear your God; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:33 And if any proselyte approaches you in your land, you shall not afflict him.
Leviticus 19:34 The proselyte who comes to you shall be like the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself, because you became proselytes in the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 19:35 You shall not do injustice in judgment, in measures and in weights and in balances.
Leviticus 19:36 Just balances and just weights and a just chous shall be for you; I am the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt.
Leviticus 19:37 And you shall keep all my law and all my commands and shall do them; I am the Lord your God.

## Chapter 20

Leviticus 20:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 20:2 And to the sons of Israel you shall speak: If anyone from the sons of Israel or from the proselytes who have come to Israel gives any of his seed to a ruler, by death let him be put to death; the nation that is upon the land shall stone him with stones.
Leviticus 20:3 And I shall set my face against that person and shall destroy him from his people, because he gave some of his seed to a ruler, so that he might defile my holy things and profane the name of the things sanctified to me.
Leviticus 20:4 But if, with overlooking, the natives of the land overlook with their eyes that person when he gives some of his seed to a ruler, so as not to kill him,
Leviticus 20:5 then I shall set my face against that person and his kin and shall destroy him and all those who are of one mind with him, so as to prostitute him to the rulers, from their people.
Leviticus 20:6 And a soul that follows belly-speakers or enchanters so as to prostitute itself after them, I shall set my face against that soul and shall destroy it from its people.
Leviticus 20:7 And you shall be holy, because I am holy, the Lord your God.
Leviticus 20:8 And you shall keep my commands and shall do them; I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
Leviticus 20:9 Any person who speaks evil of his father or his mother, by death let him be put to death; he spoke evil of his father or his mother; he shall be guilty.
Leviticus 20:10 A person who commits adultery with a man’s wife, or who commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, by death let them be put to death, both the one committing adultery and the one with whom adultery is committed.
Leviticus 20:11 If anyone lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered the shamefulness of his father; by death let both be put to death; they are guilty.
Leviticus 20:12 And if anyone lies with his daughter-in-law, by death let both be put to death, for they have acted impiously; they are guilty.
Leviticus 20:13 And whoever lies with a male in the bed of a woman, both have done an abomination; let them be put to death; they are guilty.
Leviticus 20:14 Whoever takes a woman and her mother, it is lawlessness; they shall burn him and them with fire, and there shall be no lawlessness among you.
Leviticus 20:15 And whoever gives his lying down in a quadruped, by death let him be put to death, and you shall kill the quadruped.
Leviticus 20:16 And a woman who approaches any animal to be mounted by it, you shall kill the woman and the animal; by death let them be put to death; they are guilty.
Leviticus 20:17 Whoever takes his sister from his father or from his mother and sees her shamefulness, and she sees his shamefulness, it is a reproach; they shall be utterly destroyed before the sons of their race; he uncovered the shamefulness of his sister; they shall bear sin.
Leviticus 20:18 And a man who lies with a woman sitting apart and uncovers her shamefulness has uncovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the flow of her blood; both shall be utterly destroyed from their race.
Leviticus 20:19 And you shall not uncover the shamefulness of your father’s sister or your mother’s sister, for he has uncovered the kinship; they shall bear sin.
Leviticus 20:20 Whoever lies with his female relative has uncovered the shamefulness of his kin; they shall die childless.
Leviticus 20:21 Whoever takes his brother’s wife, it is uncleanness; he has uncovered the shamefulness of his brother; they shall die childless.
Leviticus 20:22 And you shall keep all my commands and my judgments and shall do them, and the land into which I am bringing you there to dwell upon it shall certainly not be disgusted with you.
Leviticus 20:23 And you shall by no means walk in the ordinances of the nations that I send away from you, because they did all these things and I abominated them.
Leviticus 20:24 And I said to you: You shall inherit their land, and I shall give it to you as a possession, a land flowing with milk and honey; I am the Lord your God, who separated you from all the nations.
Leviticus 20:25 And you shall separate them between the clean animals and between the unclean animals and between the clean birds and the unclean, and you shall not make your souls abominable by the animals and by the birds and by any of the creeping things of the earth that I separated for you in uncleanness.
Leviticus 20:26 And you shall be holy to me, because I am holy, the Lord your God, who separated you from all the nations to be mine.
Leviticus 20:27 And a man or a woman who becomes among them a belly-speaker or an enchanter, by death let both be put to death; stone them with stones; they are guilty.

## Chapter 21

Leviticus 21:1 And the Lord said to Moses, saying: Say to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and you shall say to them: They shall not be defiled among the souls in their nation,
Leviticus 21:2 except by their nearest relative, by a father and mother and sons and daughters, by a brother,
Leviticus 21:3 and by a virgin sister who is near to him, who has not been given to a man; by these he shall be defiled.
Leviticus 21:4 He shall not be defiled suddenly among his people, to his profanation.
Leviticus 21:5 And you shall not shave baldness on the head for a dead person, and they shall not shave the appearance of the beard, and they shall not cut incisions into their flesh.
Leviticus 21:6 They shall be holy to their God and shall not profane the name of their God, for they themselves offer the sacrifices of the Lord, gifts of their God, and they shall be holy.
Leviticus 21:7 They shall not take a woman who is a prostitute and profaned, or a woman cast out from her husband, for he is holy to the Lord his God.
Leviticus 21:8 And you shall sanctify him; he offers the gifts of the Lord your God. He shall be holy, because I am holy, the Lord who sanctifies them.
Leviticus 21:9 And if a daughter of a man who is a priest is profaned by prostituting herself, she profanes the name of her father; she shall be burned upon fire.
Leviticus 21:10 And the great priest from among his brothers, upon whose head the oil of the anointed one has been poured and who has been perfected to put on the garments, shall not remove the turban from his head and shall not tear his garments.
Leviticus 21:11 And he shall not enter upon any soul that has died; he shall not be defiled by his father or by his mother.
Leviticus 21:12 And he shall not go out from the holy things and shall not profane the thing sanctified to his God, because the holy oil, the anointed thing of God, is upon him; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 21:13 He shall take a virgin woman from his race.
Leviticus 21:14 But a widow and one cast out and one profaned and a prostitute, these he shall not take; rather, he shall take as wife a virgin from his race.
Leviticus 21:15 And he shall not profane his seed among his people; I am the Lord who sanctifies him.
Leviticus 21:16 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 21:17 Say to Aaron: A person from your race throughout your generations, whoever has a blemish in him, shall not approach to offer the gifts of his God.
Leviticus 21:18 Every person in whom there is a blemish shall not approach: a person who is lame or blind or has a mutilated nose or a cut ear,
Leviticus 21:19 or a person in whom there is a broken hand or a broken foot,
Leviticus 21:20 or one who is hunchbacked or has a white spot or has a film over the eyes, or a person in whom there is severe scabies or lichen, or who has one testicle.
Leviticus 21:21 Everyone in whom there is a blemish, from the seed of Aaron the priest, shall not draw near to offer the sacrifices to your God; because there is a blemish in him, he shall not approach to offer the gifts of God.
Leviticus 21:22 He shall eat the gifts of God, the Holy of Holies and some of the holy things.
Leviticus 21:23 Except he shall not approach the veil and shall not draw near the altar, because he has a blemish; and he shall not profane the holy place of his God, because I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
Leviticus 21:24 And Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons and to all the sons of Israel.

## Chapter 22

Leviticus 22:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 22:2 Say to Aaron and to his sons, and let them keep away from the holy things of the sons of Israel, and they shall not profane my holy name in the things that they themselves sanctify to me; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 22:3 Say to them: Throughout your generations, every person from all your seed who approaches the holy things, whatever the sons of Israel sanctify to the Lord, while his uncleanness is upon him, that soul shall be utterly destroyed from me; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 22:4 And a person from the seed of Aaron the priest, if he is leprous or has a seminal discharge, shall not eat from the holy things until he is cleansed; and the one who touches any uncleanness of a soul, or a person from whom an emission of semen goes out,
Leviticus 22:5 or whoever touches any unclean creeping thing that defiles him, or touches a person by whom he defiles himself according to all his uncleanness,
Leviticus 22:6 a soul that touches them shall be unclean until evening; he shall not eat from the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
Leviticus 22:7 And the sun shall set, and he shall be clean, and then he shall eat from the holy things, because it is his bread.
Leviticus 22:8 He shall not eat a carcass or something caught by a wild beast, to be defiled by them; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 22:9 And they shall keep my observances, so that they do not bear sin because of them and die because of them if they profane them; I am the Lord God who sanctifies them. –
Leviticus 22:10 And no foreigner shall eat holy things; a sojourner of a priest or a hired worker shall not eat holy things.
Leviticus 22:11 But if a priest acquires a soul as a possession with silver, this one shall eat from his bread; and those born in his house, these also shall eat from his bread.
Leviticus 22:12 And if a daughter of a man who is a priest becomes the wife of a foreign man, she shall not eat from the firstfruits of the holy things.
Leviticus 22:13 And if a daughter of a priest becomes a widow or is cast out, but there was no seed for her, she shall return to her paternal house as in her youth; she shall eat from the bread of her father. And no foreigner shall eat from them.
Leviticus 22:14 And a person who eats holy things in ignorance shall also add its fifth to it and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
Leviticus 22:15 And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, which they themselves remove for the Lord,
Leviticus 22:16 and they shall bring upon themselves the lawlessness of trespass when they eat their holy things, because I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
Leviticus 22:17 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 22:18 Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to the whole congregation of Israel, and you shall say to them: Any person from the sons of Israel or from the sons of the proselytes who are attached to them in Israel who offers his gifts according to any confession of theirs or according to any choice of theirs, whatever they offer to God as a whole burnt offering,
Leviticus 22:19 acceptable for you shall be unblemished males from the herds and from the sheep and from the goats.
Leviticus 22:20 Anything that has a blemish in it they shall not bring to the Lord, because it shall not be acceptable for you.
Leviticus 22:21 And a person who offers a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord, distinguishing a vow according to a choice or at your festivals, from the herds or from the sheep, shall be unblemished for acceptance; no blemish shall be in it.
Leviticus 22:22 Anything blind or crushed or with its tongue cut or covered in warts or having severe scabies or lichens, they shall not bring these to the Lord, and you shall not give any of them as an offering upon the altar to the Lord.
Leviticus 22:23 And a calf or sheep with a cut ear or a docked tail, you shall make them slaughtered things for yourself, but for your vow it shall not be accepted.
Leviticus 22:24 Anything with its testicles bruised or crushed or cut out or torn away, you shall not bring them to the Lord, and you shall not do this upon your land.
Leviticus 22:25 And from the hand of a foreigner you shall not offer the gifts of your God from any of these, because corruptions are in them; a blemish is in them; these shall not be accepted for you.
Leviticus 22:26 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 22:27 A calf or sheep or goat, when it is born, shall be seven days under its mother, but from the eighth day and beyond it shall be accepted as gifts, an offering to the Lord.
Leviticus 22:28 And a calf or sheep, her and her young you shall not slaughter on one day.
Leviticus 22:29 But if you sacrifice a sacrifice, a vow of joy to the Lord, you shall sacrifice it as acceptable for you.
Leviticus 22:30 On that same day it shall be eaten; you shall not leave any of the flesh until morning; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 22:31 And you shall keep my commandments and shall do them.
Leviticus 22:32 And you shall not profane the name of the Holy One, and I shall be sanctified in the midst of the sons of Israel; I am the Lord who sanctifies you,
Leviticus 22:33 who brought you out from the land of Egypt so as to be your God; I am the Lord.

## Chapter 23

Leviticus 23:1 And the Lord said to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 23:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: The feasts of the Lord, which you shall call holy convocations, these are my feasts. –
Leviticus 23:3 Six days you shall do works, and on the seventh day there shall be Sabbaths, a rest, a holy convocation to the Lord; you shall do no work; it is Sabbaths to the Lord in every dwelling of yours.
Leviticus 23:4 These are the feasts to the Lord, holy convocations, which you shall call at their appointed times.
Leviticus 23:5 In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, between the evenings, is Pascha to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:6 And on the fifteenth day of this month is the feast of unleavened things to the Lord; seven days you shall eat unleavened things.
Leviticus 23:7 And the first day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no work of service.
Leviticus 23:8 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord for seven days; and the seventh day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no work of service.
Leviticus 23:9 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 23:10 Say to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: When you enter into the land that I give you and reap its harvest, then you shall bring a sheaf, the firstfruit of your harvest, to the priest.
Leviticus 23:11 And he shall offer the sheaf before the Lord, acceptable for you; on the day after the first day the priest shall offer it.
Leviticus 23:12 And on the day on which you bring the sheaf, you shall make a year-old unblemished sheep as a whole burnt offering to the Lord,
Leviticus 23:13 and its sacrifice shall be two tenths of fine flour worked up in oil—a sacrifice to the Lord, an aroma of fragrance to the Lord—and its libation shall be the fourth of a hin of wine.
Leviticus 23:14 And you shall not eat bread or roasted new groats until this same day, until you offer the gifts to your God; it is an eternal ordinance throughout your generations in every dwelling of yours.
Leviticus 23:15 And you shall count from the day after the Sabbaths, from the day on which you offer the sheaf of the presentation, seven complete weeks;
Leviticus 23:16 until the day after the last week you shall count fifty days, and you shall offer a new sacrifice to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:17 From your dwelling you shall offer loaves as a presentation, two loaves; they shall be from two tenths of fine flour; they shall be baked leavened as first produce to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:18 And with the loaves you shall bring seven year-old unblemished lambs and one calf from the herd and two unblemished rams—they shall be a whole burnt offering to the Lord—and their sacrifices and their libations, a sacrifice, an aroma of fragrance to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:19 And they shall make one male kid from the goats concerning sin and two year-old lambs as a sacrifice of salvation with the loaves of the first produce.
Leviticus 23:20 And the priest shall place them with the loaves of the first produce as a presentation before the Lord with the two lambs; they shall be holy to the Lord; they shall belong to the priest who offers them to him.
Leviticus 23:21 And you shall call this day a convocation; it shall be holy for you; you shall do no work of service on it; it is an eternal ordinance throughout your generations in every dwelling of yours. –
Leviticus 23:22 And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the remainder of the harvest of your field when you reap, and you shall not gather the things that fall from your harvest; you shall leave them for the poor and the proselyte; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 23:23 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 23:24 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: On the first of the seventh month there shall be a rest for you, a memorial of trumpets; it shall be a holy convocation for you.
Leviticus 23:25 You shall do no work of service and shall bring a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:26 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 23:27 And on the tenth of this seventh month is a day of atonement; it shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall humble your souls and bring a whole burnt offering to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:28 You shall do no work on this same day, for it is a day of atonement for you, to make atonement concerning you before the Lord your God.
Leviticus 23:29 Every soul that is not humbled on this same day shall be utterly destroyed from its people.
Leviticus 23:30 And every soul that does work on this same day, that soul shall perish from its people.
Leviticus 23:31 You shall do no work; it is an eternal ordinance throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Leviticus 23:32 It shall be Sabbaths of Sabbaths for you, and you shall humble your souls; from the ninth of the month, from evening until evening, you shall keep your Sabbaths.
Leviticus 23:33 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 23:34 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: On the fifteenth of this seventh month is the feast of tents for seven days to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:35 And the first day is a holy convocation; you shall do no work of service.
Leviticus 23:36 For seven days you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord; and the eighth day shall be a holy convocation for you, and you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord; it is a closing; you shall do no work of service.
Leviticus 23:37 These are the feasts to the Lord, which you shall call holy convocations, so as to offer offerings to the Lord, whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices and their libations, each day’s for the day,
Leviticus 23:38 apart from the Sabbaths of the Lord and apart from your gifts and apart from all your vows and apart from your voluntary offerings, whatever you give to the Lord.
Leviticus 23:39 And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month, when you have finished the produce of the land, you shall feast to the Lord seven days; on the first day there shall be rest, and on the eighth day rest.
Leviticus 23:40 And on the first day you shall take beautiful fruit of a tree and adornments of palms and leafy branches of a tree and willows and branches of the chaste tree from a torrent, to rejoice before the Lord your God for seven days
Leviticus 23:41 of the year; it is an eternal ordinance throughout your generations; in the seventh month you shall feast it.
Leviticus 23:42 You shall dwell in tents seven days; every native in Israel shall dwell in tents,
Leviticus 23:43 so that your generations may see that I caused the sons of Israel to dwell in tents when I brought them out from the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 23:44 And Moses spoke the feasts of the Lord to the sons of Israel.

## Chapter 24

Leviticus 24:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 24:2 Command the sons of Israel, and let them take for me pure pounded olive oil for light, to burn a lamp continually.
Leviticus 24:3 Outside the veil in the tabernacle of testimony, Aaron and his sons shall burn it from evening until morning before the Lord continually; it is an eternal ordinance throughout your generations.
Leviticus 24:4 Upon the pure lampstand you shall burn the lamps before the Lord until morning.
Leviticus 24:5 And you shall take fine flour and make it into twelve loaves; each one loaf shall be of two tenths.
Leviticus 24:6 And you shall place them in two sets, six loaves in one set, upon the pure table before the Lord.
Leviticus 24:7 And you shall place pure frankincense and salt upon the set, and they shall be loaves set before the Lord for remembrance.
Leviticus 24:8 On the day of the Sabbaths it shall be set before the Lord continually, before the sons of Israel, as an eternal covenant.
Leviticus 24:9 And it shall belong to Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat them in a holy place, for this is Holy of Holies for him from the things sacrificed to the Lord, an eternal ordinance.
Leviticus 24:10 And a son of an Israelite woman went out, and he was the son of an Egyptian among the sons of Israel, and the one from the Israelite woman and the Israelite man fought in the camp.
Leviticus 24:11 And the son of the Israelite woman, having named the Name, cursed, and they brought him to Moses; and the name of his mother was Salomith daughter of Dabri from the tribe of Dan.
Leviticus 24:12 And they put him into custody, to judge him by the command of the Lord.
Leviticus 24:13 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 24:14 Bring the one who cursed outside the camp, and all those who heard shall place their hands upon his head, and the whole congregation shall stone him.
Leviticus 24:15 And speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: A person who curses a god shall bear sin.
Leviticus 24:16 But one who names the name of the Lord, by death let him be put to death; let the whole congregation of Israel stone him with stones; whether a proselyte or a native, when he names the name of the Lord, let him die.
Leviticus 24:17 And a person who strikes the soul of a person and he dies, by death let him be put to death.
Leviticus 24:18 And whoever strikes an animal and it dies, let him repay soul for soul.
Leviticus 24:19 And if anyone gives a blemish to his neighbor, as he did to him, so also shall it be done back to him:
Leviticus 24:20 break for break, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; according as he gives a blemish to the person, so it shall be given to him.
Leviticus 24:21 Whoever strikes a person and he dies, by death let him be put to death.
Leviticus 24:22 There shall be one ordinance for the proselyte and for the native, because I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 24:23 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and they brought the one who cursed outside the camp and stoned him with stones; and the sons of Israel did just as the Lord instructed Moses.

## Chapter 25

Leviticus 25:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sina, saying:
Leviticus 25:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: If you enter into the land that I give you, then the land that I give you shall rest, Sabbaths to the Lord.
Leviticus 25:3 Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall trim your vine and gather its fruit.
Leviticus 25:4 But in the seventh year there shall be Sabbaths, a rest for the land, Sabbaths to the Lord; you shall not sow your field, and you shall not trim your vine.
Leviticus 25:5 And you shall not reap the spontaneous things that rise from your field, and you shall not harvest the grape of your sanctification; it shall be a year of rest for the land.
Leviticus 25:6 And the Sabbaths of the land shall be food for you and for your male servant and your female servant and your hired worker and the sojourner who is attached to you,
Leviticus 25:7 and for your animals and for the wild animals that are in your land; all its produce shall be for food.
Leviticus 25:8 And you shall count for yourself seven rests of years, seven years seven times, and the seven weeks of years shall be for you forty-nine years.
Leviticus 25:9 And you shall announce with the sound of a trumpet in all your land, in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month; on the day of propitiation you shall announce with a trumpet in all your land.
Leviticus 25:10 And you shall sanctify the fiftieth year and proclaim a release upon the land to all those dwelling in it; this shall be a sign of a year of release for you, and each one shall depart to his possession, and each one of you shall depart to his fatherland.
Leviticus 25:11 This sign of release, the fiftieth year, shall be a year for you; you shall not sow, nor shall you reap its spontaneous things that rise, and you shall not harvest its sanctified things,
Leviticus 25:12 because it is a sign of release; it shall be holy for you; from the plains you shall eat its produce.
Leviticus 25:13 In the year of its sign of release, each one shall return to his possession.
Leviticus 25:14 But if you give a sale to your neighbor, or if you acquire something from your neighbor, let no person afflict his neighbor.
Leviticus 25:15 According to the number of years after the sign you shall acquire it from your neighbor; according to the number of years of produce he shall sell it to you.
Leviticus 25:16 According as the years are more, you shall increase its acquisition price, and according as the years are fewer, you shall lessen its acquisition price, because thus he sells to you the number of its yields.
Leviticus 25:17 Let no person afflict his neighbor, and you shall fear the Lord your God; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 25:18 And you shall do all my ordinances and all my judgments, and you shall keep and do them, and you shall dwell upon the land with confidence.
Leviticus 25:19 And the land shall give its produce, and you shall eat to fullness and shall dwell upon it with confidence.
Leviticus 25:20 But if you say: What shall we eat in this seventh year if we do not sow or gather our produce?
Leviticus 25:21 Then I shall send my blessing to you in the sixth year, and it shall make its produce for three years.
Leviticus 25:22 And you shall sow in the eighth year and shall eat from the old produce; until the ninth year, until its produce comes, you shall eat old things of old things.
Leviticus 25:23 And the land shall not be sold for confirmation, for the land is mine, because you are proselytes and sojourners before me.
Leviticus 25:24 And throughout every land of your possession you shall give a ransom for the land. –
Leviticus 25:25 But if your brother who is with you becomes poor and sells some of his possession, and the kinsman who is nearest to him comes, then he shall ransom the sale of his brother.
Leviticus 25:26 But if someone has no kinsman and his hand prospers and what is sufficient for his ransom is found for him,
Leviticus 25:27 then he shall calculate the years of his sale and shall repay the surplus to the person to whom he sold himself, and he shall depart to his possession.
Leviticus 25:28 But if his hand does not prosper enough to repay him, then the sale shall belong to the one who acquired it until the sixth year of the release; and it shall go out at the release, and he shall depart to his possession.
Leviticus 25:29 And if anyone sells an inhabited house in a walled city, then its redemption shall be until a year of days is fulfilled; its redemption shall be within that time.
Leviticus 25:30 But if it is not redeemed until its whole year is fulfilled, the house that is in the city that has a wall shall be confirmed permanently to the one who acquired it throughout his generations, and it shall not go out at the release.
Leviticus 25:31 But the houses in farmsteads that do not have a wall around them shall be reckoned with the field of the land; they shall always be redeemable and shall go out at the release.
Leviticus 25:32 And as for the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession shall always be redeemable for the Levites.
Leviticus 25:33 And whoever redeems from the Levites, the sale of their houses in the city of their possession shall also go out at the release, because the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession in the midst of the sons of Israel.
Leviticus 25:34 And the fields set apart for their cities shall not be sold, because this is their eternal possession.
Leviticus 25:35 But if your brother becomes poor and is weak in his hands beside you, you shall support him as a proselyte and a sojourner, and your brother shall live with you.
Leviticus 25:36 You shall not take interest from him or anything in addition, and you shall fear your God—I am the Lord—and your brother shall live with you.
Leviticus 25:37 You shall not give him your silver at interest, and you shall not give him your food for increase.
Leviticus 25:38 I am the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give you the land of Chanaan so as to be your God.
Leviticus 25:39 But if your brother is humbled beside you and is sold to you, he shall not serve you with the service of a household servant.
Leviticus 25:40 He shall be with you as a hired worker or a sojourner; until the year of the release he shall work beside you.
Leviticus 25:41 And he shall go out at the release, and his children with him, and he shall depart to his race; he shall run back to his paternal possession.
Leviticus 25:42 Because these are my household servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt, he shall not be sold with the sale of a household servant.
Leviticus 25:43 You shall not stretch him in labor, and you shall fear the Lord your God.
Leviticus 25:44 And as many male servants and female servants as you have from the nations that are around you, from them you shall acquire a male slave and a female slave.
Leviticus 25:45 And from the sons of the sojourners who are among you, from these you shall acquire, and from their relatives, as many as are born in your land; let them be a possession for you.
Leviticus 25:46 And you shall allot them to your children after you, and they shall be held by you in perpetuity; but from your brothers, the sons of Israel, each one shall not stretch his brother in labors.
Leviticus 25:47 But if the hand of the proselyte or the sojourner beside you finds means, and your brother, being in need, is sold to the proselyte or the sojourner beside you, to a native-born proselyte,
Leviticus 25:48 after he is sold to him, there shall be redemption for him; one of his brothers shall ransom him,
Leviticus 25:49 or his father’s brother or the son of his father’s brother shall ransom him, or one of the relatives of his flesh from his tribe shall ransom him; but if, prospering in his hands, he ransoms himself,
Leviticus 25:50 then he shall calculate with the one who acquired him from the year in which he sold himself to him until the year of the release, and the silver of his sale shall be as a wage; it shall be year by year with him.
Leviticus 25:51 But if there are more of the years for anyone, according to these he shall repay his ransom from the silver of his sale.
Leviticus 25:52 But if few of the years remain until the year of the release, then he shall calculate it for him according to his years and shall repay his ransom.
Leviticus 25:53 He shall be with him as a hired worker year by year; you shall not stretch him in labor before you.
Leviticus 25:54 But if he is not ransomed according to these things, he shall go out in the year of the release, he and his children with him.
Leviticus 25:55 Because the sons of Israel are household servants to me; these are my servants whom I brought out from the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.

## Chapter 26

Leviticus 26:1 You shall not make for yourselves handmade things or carved things, nor shall you raise up a pillar for yourselves, nor shall you place a watch-stone in your land to worship it; I am the Lord your God.
Leviticus 26:2 You shall keep my Sabbaths and shall fear because of my holy things; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 26:3 If you walk in my commands and keep my commandments and do them,
Leviticus 26:4 then I shall give you the rain at its appointed time, and the land shall give its produce, and the trees of the plains shall give back their fruit.
Leviticus 26:5 And the threshing shall overtake the vintage for you, and the vintage shall overtake the sowing, and you shall eat your bread to fullness and shall dwell with security upon your land.
Leviticus 26:6 And war shall not pass through your land, and I shall give peace in your land, and you shall sleep, and there shall be no one frightening you, and I shall destroy evil wild animals from your land.
Leviticus 26:7 And you shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall before you by slaughter.
Leviticus 26:8 And five of you shall pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you shall pursue myriads, and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
Leviticus 26:9 And I shall look upon you and increase you and multiply you and establish my covenant with you.
Leviticus 26:10 And you shall eat old things and old things of old things, and you shall carry out old things from before the new.
Leviticus 26:11 And I shall place my covenant among you, and my soul shall not abominate you.
Leviticus 26:12 And I shall walk about among you and shall be your God, and you shall be my people.
Leviticus 26:13 I am the Lord your God who brought you out from the land of Egypt while you were slaves, and I broke the bond of your yoke and led you with boldness.
Leviticus 26:14 But if you do not obey me or do these commands of mine,
Leviticus 26:15 but disobey them and your soul is disgusted with my judgments, so that you do not do all my commandments, so as to scatter my covenant,
Leviticus 26:16 then I also shall do thus to you, and I shall raise up against you distress, both scabies and jaundice, causing your eyes to waste away and your soul to melt, and you shall sow your seed in vain, and your adversaries shall eat it.
Leviticus 26:17 And I shall set my face against you, and you shall fall before your enemies, and those who hate you shall pursue you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you. –
Leviticus 26:18 And if up to this point you do not obey me, then I shall add to disciplining you sevenfold for your sins.
Leviticus 26:19 And I shall break the arrogance of your pride and shall make the heaven iron for you and your earth like bronze,
Leviticus 26:20 and your strength shall be in vain, and your land shall not give its seed, and the tree of your field shall not give its fruit. –
Leviticus 26:21 And if after these things you walk crookedly and do not wish to obey me, I shall add seven blows to you according to your sins.
Leviticus 26:22 And I shall send against you the wild animals of the land, and they shall devour you and utterly consume your animals and make you few, and your roads shall be made desolate. –
Leviticus 26:23 And if by these things you are not disciplined but walk crookedly toward me,
Leviticus 26:24 then I also shall walk with you in crooked wrath, and I also shall strike you sevenfold in return for your sins.
Leviticus 26:25 And I shall bring against you a sword avenging the justice of the covenant, and you shall flee for refuge into your cities; and I shall send death into you, and you shall be delivered into the hands of enemies.
Leviticus 26:26 When you are afflicted by a famine of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven and shall give back your bread by weight, and you shall eat and certainly shall not be filled. –
Leviticus 26:27 But if by these things you do not obey me and walk crookedly toward me,
Leviticus 26:28 then I myself shall walk with you in crooked wrath and shall discipline you sevenfold according to your sins.
Leviticus 26:29 And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
Leviticus 26:30 And I shall make your pillars desolate and utterly destroy your wooden handmade things and place your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols, and my soul shall be disgusted with you.
Leviticus 26:31 And I shall make your cities desolate and utterly desolate your holy places, and I shall certainly not smell the aroma of your sacrifices.
Leviticus 26:32 And I myself shall utterly desolate your land, and your enemies who dwell in it shall marvel at it.
Leviticus 26:33 And I shall scatter you among the nations, and the sword passing after you shall utterly consume you; and your land shall be desolate, and your cities shall be desolate.
Leviticus 26:34 Then the land shall delight in its Sabbaths all the days of its desolation, and you shall be in the land of your enemies; then the land shall keep Sabbath and delight in its Sabbaths.
Leviticus 26:35 All the days of its desolation it shall keep Sabbath, which it did not keep during your Sabbaths when you dwelt in it.
Leviticus 26:36 And upon those of you who are left, I shall bring cowardice into their heart in the land of their enemies, and the sound of a leaf being carried shall pursue them, and they shall flee as those fleeing from war and shall fall when no one pursues.
Leviticus 26:37 And brother shall overlook brother as though in war when no one runs after them, and you shall not be able to withstand your enemies.
Leviticus 26:38 And you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall devour you.
Leviticus 26:39 And those left from you shall be destroyed because of your sins; in the land of their enemies they shall melt away.
Leviticus 26:40 And they shall declare their sins and the sins of their fathers, because they transgressed and overlooked me and because they walked crookedly against me,
Leviticus 26:41 and I walked with them in crooked wrath and shall destroy them in the land of their enemies; then their uncircumcised heart shall be turned, and then they shall be well pleased with their sins.
Leviticus 26:42 And I shall remember the covenant of Jacob and the covenant of Isaac and the covenant of Abraham, and I shall remember the land.
Leviticus 26:43 And the land shall be abandoned by them; then the land shall accept its Sabbaths when it is made desolate because of them, and they themselves shall accept their lawlessnesses, because they overlooked my judgments and their soul was disgusted with my commands.
Leviticus 26:44 And not even thus, while they are in the land of their enemies, did I overlook them or become disgusted with them so as to utterly consume them, to scatter my covenant with them, because I am the Lord their God.
Leviticus 26:45 And I shall remember for them the former covenant, when I brought them out from the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery, before the nations, to be their God; I am the Lord.
Leviticus 26:46 These are the judgments and the commands and the law that the Lord gave between himself and between the sons of Israel on Mount Sina by the hand of Moses.

## Chapter 27

Leviticus 27:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Leviticus 27:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: Whoever vows a vow so that there is a valuation of his soul to the Lord,
Leviticus 27:3 the valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty didrachms of silver by the holy weight.
Leviticus 27:4 And the assessment of a female shall be thirty didrachms.
Leviticus 27:5 But if from five years old to twenty years, the valuation of a male shall be twenty didrachms and of a female ten didrachms.
Leviticus 27:6 And from a month old to five years old, the valuation of a male shall be five didrachms of silver and of a female three didrachms.
Leviticus 27:7 But if from sixty years and above, if it is a male, the valuation shall be fifteen didrachms of silver, but if a female, ten didrachms.
Leviticus 27:8 But if he is too poor for the valuation, he shall stand before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according as the hand of the one who vowed has strength, the priest shall value him.
Leviticus 27:9 But if it is from the animals from which a gift is offered to the Lord, whatever one gives from these to the Lord shall be holy.
Leviticus 27:10 He shall not exchange it, good for bad or bad for good; but if, with exchanging, he exchanges an animal for an animal, both it and the exchange shall be holy.
Leviticus 27:11 But if it is any unclean animal from which a gift is not offered to the Lord, then he shall stand the animal before the priest,
Leviticus 27:12 and the priest shall value it between good and bad, and according as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
Leviticus 27:13 But if, with redeeming, he redeems it, he shall add the fifth to its valuation.
Leviticus 27:14 And a person who sanctifies his house as holy to the Lord, the priest shall value it between good and bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.
Leviticus 27:15 But if the one who sanctified it redeems his house, he shall add to it the fifth of the silver of its valuation, and it shall be his.
Leviticus 27:16 But if a person sanctifies to the Lord some of the field of his possession, then the valuation shall be according to its seed: for a kor of barley, fifty didrachms of silver.
Leviticus 27:17 But if he sanctifies his field from the year of the release, it shall stand according to its valuation.
Leviticus 27:18 But if he sanctifies his field later after the release, the priest shall calculate the silver for him according to the years remaining until the year of the release, and it shall be deducted from his assessment.
Leviticus 27:19 But if the one who sanctified the field redeems it, he shall add the fifth of the silver to its valuation, and it shall be his.
Leviticus 27:20 But if he does not redeem the field and sells the field to another person, he shall no longer redeem it.
Leviticus 27:21 Rather, when the release has gone out, the field shall be holy to the Lord, like the land that has been set apart; it shall be a possession for the priest.
Leviticus 27:22 But if he sanctifies to the Lord some of the field that he acquired, which is not from the field of his possession,
Leviticus 27:23 the priest shall calculate for him the completion of the valuation from the year of the release, and he shall repay the valuation on that day as holy to the Lord.
Leviticus 27:24 And in the year of the release the field shall be returned to the person from whom he acquired it, whose possession of the land it was.
Leviticus 27:25 And every valuation shall be by holy weights; the didrachm shall be twenty obols.
Leviticus 27:26 And every firstborn that arises among your animals shall belong to the Lord, and no one shall sanctify it; whether a calf or a sheep, it belongs to the Lord.
Leviticus 27:27 But if it is from the unclean quadrupeds, he shall exchange it according to its valuation and shall add the fifth to it, and it shall be his; but if he does not redeem it, it shall be sold according to its assessed value.
Leviticus 27:28 And every anathema that a person devotes to the Lord from all that belongs to him, from person to animal and from the field of his possession, shall not be sold or redeemed; every anathema shall be Holy of Holies to the Lord.
Leviticus 27:29 And anything from among people that is devoted shall not be redeemed, but by death it shall be put to death.
Leviticus 27:30 Every tenth of the land, from the seed of the land and the fruit of the tree, belongs to the Lord; it is holy to the Lord.
Leviticus 27:31 But if a person redeems his tenth with a ransom, he shall add the fifth to it, and it shall be his.
Leviticus 27:32 And every tenth of cattle and sheep, and everything that comes in the count under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the Lord.
Leviticus 27:33 You shall not exchange good for bad; but if, with exchanging, you exchange it, then its exchange also shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
Leviticus 27:34 These are the commandments that the Lord commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sina.

# Numbers

The Apostolic Bible. Public domain. https://apostolic-bible.ysys9.chatgpt.site/license.html


## Chapter 1

Numbers 1:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sina, in the tabernacle of testimony, on the first of the second month of the second year after they had gone out from the land of Egypt, saying:
Numbers 1:2 Take the head-count of the whole congregation of the sons of Israel according to their kinships, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number from their names, head by head, every male
Numbers 1:3 from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force of Israel; muster them with their force; you and Aaron shall muster them.
Numbers 1:4 And with you there shall be one from each tribe, from the rulers of each; they shall be according to the houses of their paternal families.
Numbers 1:5 And these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from Reuben, Elisour son of Sediour;
Numbers 1:6 from Symeon, Salamiel son of Sourisadai;
Numbers 1:7 from Judas, Naasson son of Aminadab;
Numbers 1:8 from Issachar, Nathanael son of Sogar;
Numbers 1:9 from Zaboulon, Eliab son of Chailon;
Numbers 1:10 from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elisama son of Emioud; from Manasse, Gamaliel son of Phadassour;
Numbers 1:11 from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gadeoni;
Numbers 1:12 from Dan, Achiezer son of Amisadai;
Numbers 1:13 from Aser, Phagaiel son of Echran;
Numbers 1:14 from Gad, Elisaph son of Ragouel;
Numbers 1:15 from Nephthali, Achire son of Ainan.
Numbers 1:16 These are those called from the congregation, rulers of the tribes according to paternal families; they are commanders of thousands of Israel.
Numbers 1:17 And Moses and Aaron took these men who had been called by name,
Numbers 1:18 and they assembled the whole congregation on the first of the second month of the year, and they were enrolled according to their generations, according to their paternal families, according to the number of their names, from twenty years old and above, every male, head by head,
Numbers 1:19 in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses; and they were mustered in the wilderness of Sina.
Numbers 1:20 And the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:21 their muster from the tribe of Reuben was forty-six thousand five hundred. –
Numbers 1:22 For the sons of Symeon, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:23 their muster from the tribe of Symeon was fifty-nine thousand three hundred. –
Numbers 1:24 For the sons of Judas, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:25 their muster from the tribe of Judas was seventy-four thousand six hundred. –
Numbers 1:26 For the sons of Issachar, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:27 their muster from the tribe of Issachar was fifty-four thousand four hundred. –
Numbers 1:28 For the sons of Zaboulon, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:29 their muster from the tribe of Zaboulon was fifty-seven thousand four hundred. –
Numbers 1:30 For the sons of Joseph, the sons of Ephraim, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:31 their muster from the tribe of Ephraim was forty thousand five hundred. –
Numbers 1:32 For the sons of Manasse, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:33 their muster from the tribe of Manasse was thirty-two thousand two hundred. –
Numbers 1:34 For the sons of Benjamin, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:35 their muster from the tribe of Benjamin was thirty-five thousand four hundred. –
Numbers 1:36 For the sons of Gad, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:37 their muster from the tribe of Gad was forty-five thousand six hundred fifty. –
Numbers 1:38 For the sons of Dan, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:39 their muster from the tribe of Dan was sixty-two thousand seven hundred. –
Numbers 1:40 For the sons of Aser, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:41 their muster from the tribe of Aser was forty-one thousand five hundred. –
Numbers 1:42 For the sons of Nephthali, according to their kinships, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to the number of their names, head by head, all males from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out in the force,
Numbers 1:43 their muster from the tribe of Nephthali was fifty-three thousand four hundred. –
Numbers 1:44 This is the muster that Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel mustered, twelve men; there was one man according to each one tribe, according to the tribe of the houses of the paternal family.
Numbers 1:45 And the whole muster of the sons of Israel with their force, from twenty years old and above, everyone who goes out to be arrayed for battle in Israel, was
Numbers 1:46 six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
Numbers 1:47 But the Levites from the tribe of their paternal family were not mustered among the sons of Israel.
Numbers 1:48 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 1:49 See that you do not also muster the tribe of Levi and do not take their number in the midst of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 1:50 And you, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony and over all its vessels and over all the things that are in it; they shall carry the tabernacle and all its vessels, and they shall minister in it and shall encamp around the tabernacle.
Numbers 1:51 And when the tabernacle moves, the Levites shall take it down, and when the tabernacle encamps, they shall raise it up; and let the foreigner who approaches die.
Numbers 1:52 And the sons of Israel shall encamp, each man in his own order and each man according to his own leadership with their force.
Numbers 1:53 But let the Levites encamp before the Lord around the tabernacle of testimony, and there shall be no sin among the sons of Israel. And the Levites themselves shall keep the watch of the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 1:54 And the sons of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron; thus they did.

## Chapter 2

Numbers 2:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 2:2 Let the sons of Israel encamp, each man next to him by order, by standards, according to the houses of their paternal families; opposite, around the tabernacle of testimony, the sons of Israel shall encamp.
Numbers 2:3 And those encamping first toward the east shall be the order of the camp of Judas with their force, and the ruler of the sons of Judas shall be Naasson son of Aminadab.
Numbers 2:4 His force, those mustered, was seventy-four thousand six hundred.
Numbers 2:5 And those encamping next shall be of the tribe of Issachar, and the ruler of the sons of Issachar shall be Nathanael son of Sogar.
Numbers 2:6 His force, those mustered, was fifty-four thousand four hundred.
Numbers 2:7 And those encamping next shall be of the tribe of Zaboulon, and the ruler of the sons of Zaboulon shall be Eliab son of Chailon.
Numbers 2:8 His force, those mustered, was fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
Numbers 2:9 All those mustered from the camp of Judas were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred with their force; they shall set out first.
Numbers 2:10 The order of the camp of Reuben toward the southwest with their force, and the ruler of the sons of Reuben shall be Elisour son of Sediour.
Numbers 2:11 His force, those mustered, was forty-six thousand five hundred.
Numbers 2:12 And those encamping next to him shall be of the tribe of Symeon, and the ruler of the sons of Symeon shall be Salamiel son of Sourisadai.
Numbers 2:13 His force, those mustered, was fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
Numbers 2:14 And those encamping next to him shall be of the tribe of Gad, and the ruler of the sons of Gad shall be Elisaph son of Ragouel.
Numbers 2:15 His force, those mustered, was forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
Numbers 2:16 All those mustered from the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty with their force; they shall set out second. –
Numbers 2:17 And the tabernacle of testimony and the camp of the Levites shall be taken up in the midst of the camps; as they encamp, so also shall they set out, each one next to the other according to leadership.
Numbers 2:18 The order of the camp of Ephraim by the sea with their force, and the ruler of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elisama son of Emioud.
Numbers 2:19 His force, those mustered, was forty thousand five hundred.
Numbers 2:20 And those encamping next shall be of the tribe of Manasse, and the ruler of the sons of Manasse shall be Gamaliel son of Phadassour.
Numbers 2:21 His force, those mustered, was thirty-two thousand two hundred.
Numbers 2:22 And those encamping next shall be of the tribe of Benjamin, and the ruler of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan son of Gadeoni.
Numbers 2:23 His force, those mustered, was thirty-five thousand four hundred.
Numbers 2:24 All those mustered from the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred with their force; they shall set out third.
Numbers 2:25 The order of the camp of Dan toward the north with their force, and the ruler of the sons of Dan shall be Achiezer son of Amisadai.
Numbers 2:26 His force, those mustered, was sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
Numbers 2:27 And those encamping next to him shall be of the tribe of Aser, and the ruler of the sons of Aser shall be Phagaiel son of Echran.
Numbers 2:28 His force, those mustered, was forty-one thousand five hundred.
Numbers 2:29 And those encamping next shall be of the tribe of Nephthali, and the ruler of the sons of Nephthali shall be Achire son of Ainan.
Numbers 2:30 His force, those mustered, was fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Numbers 2:31 All those mustered from the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred; they shall set out last according to their order.
Numbers 2:32 This is the muster of the sons of Israel according to the houses of their paternal families; the whole muster of the camps with their forces was six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
Numbers 2:33 But the Levites were not mustered together among them, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
Numbers 2:34 And the sons of Israel did all that the Lord instructed Moses; thus they encamped according to their order and thus they set out, each one next to the others according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families.

## Chapter 3

Numbers 3:1 And these are the generations of Aaron and Moses on the day on which the Lord spoke to Moses on Mount Sina.
Numbers 3:2 And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn Nadab, and Abioud, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Numbers 3:3 These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose hands they perfected to serve as priests.
Numbers 3:4 And Nadab and Abioud died before the Lord when they offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sina, and there were no children for them; and Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with Aaron their father.
Numbers 3:5 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 3:6 Take the tribe of Levi and stand them before Aaron the priest, and they shall minister to him.
Numbers 3:7 And they shall keep his watches and the watches of the sons of Israel before the tabernacle of testimony, to perform the works of the tabernacle.
Numbers 3:8 And they shall keep all the vessels of the tabernacle of testimony and the watches of the sons of Israel concerning all the works of the tabernacle.
Numbers 3:9 And you shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons the priests; a gift, given, these are mine from the sons of Israel.
Numbers 3:10 And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons over the tabernacle of testimony, and they shall keep their priesthood and all the things around the altar and inside the veil; and the foreigner who touches shall die.
Numbers 3:11 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 3:12 And I, behold, have taken the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn that opens the womb among the sons of Israel; they shall be their ransom, and the Levites shall be mine.
Numbers 3:13 For every firstborn is mine; on the day on which I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified to myself every firstborn in Israel, from person to animal; they shall be mine; I am the Lord.
Numbers 3:14 And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sina, saying:
Numbers 3:15 Muster the sons of Levi according to the houses of their paternal families, according to their clans, according to their kinships; every male from a month old and above, you shall muster them.
Numbers 3:16 And Moses and Aaron mustered them through the voice of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord instructed them.
Numbers 3:17 And these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gedson, Kaath, and Merari.
Numbers 3:18 And these are the names of the sons of Gedson according to their clans: Lobeni and Semei.
Numbers 3:19 And the sons of Kaath according to their clans: Amram and Issaar, Chebron and Oziel.
Numbers 3:20 And the sons of Merari according to their clans: Mooli and Mousi. These are the clans of the Levites according to the houses of their paternal families.
Numbers 3:21 To Gedson belonged the clan of Lobeni and the clan of Semei; these are the clans of Gedson.
Numbers 3:22 Their muster, according to the number of every male from a month old and above, their muster was seven thousand five hundred.
Numbers 3:23 And the sons of Gedson shall encamp behind the tabernacle by the sea,
Numbers 3:24 and the ruler of the house of the paternal family of the clan of Gedson shall be Elisaph son of Lael.
Numbers 3:25 And the watch of the sons of Gedson in the tabernacle of testimony shall be the tabernacle and the covering and the covering of the door of the tabernacle of testimony,
Numbers 3:26 and the curtains of the court and the veil of the gate of the court that is upon the tabernacle and the remaining things of all its works.
Numbers 3:27 To Kaath belonged the clan of Amramis and the clan of Saaris and the clan of Chebronis and the clan of Ozielis; these are the clans of Kaath.
Numbers 3:28 According to the number of every male from a month old and above, eight thousand six hundred, keeping the watches of the holy things.
Numbers 3:29 The clans of the sons of Kaath shall encamp at the sides of the tabernacle toward the southwest,
Numbers 3:30 and the ruler of the house of the paternal families of the clans of Kaath shall be Elisaphan son of Oziel.
Numbers 3:31 And their watch shall be the ark and the table and the lampstand and the altars and the vessels of the holy place with which they minister and the covering and all their works.
Numbers 3:32 And the ruler over the rulers of the Levites shall be Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, appointed to keep the watches of the holy things.
Numbers 3:33 To Merari belonged the clan of Mooli and the clan of Mousi; these are the clans of Merari.
Numbers 3:34 Their muster according to number, every male from a month old and above, was six thousand fifty.
Numbers 3:35 And the ruler of the house of the paternal families of the clan of Merari shall be Souriel son of Abichail; they shall encamp at the sides of the tabernacle toward the north.
Numbers 3:36 The muster, the watch of the sons of Merari, shall be the capitals of the tabernacle and its bars and its pillars and its bases and all their vessels and their works,
Numbers 3:37 and the pillars of the court all around and their bases and the stakes and their cords.
Numbers 3:38 And those encamping before the tabernacle of testimony toward the east shall be Moses and Aaron and his sons, keeping the watches of the holy place for the watches of the sons of Israel; and the foreigner who touches shall die.
Numbers 3:39 The whole muster of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron mustered through the voice of the Lord according to their clans, every male from a month old and above, was twenty-two thousand.
Numbers 3:40 And the Lord said to Moses, saying: Muster every male firstborn of the sons of Israel from a month old and above and take their number by name.
Numbers 3:41 And you shall take the Levites for me—I am the Lord—in place of all the firstborn of the sons of Israel, and the animals of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the animals of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 3:42 And Moses mustered, in the manner that the Lord commanded, every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
Numbers 3:43 And all the male firstborn, according to the number by name, from a month old and above, from their muster, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
Numbers 3:44 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 3:45 Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the sons of Israel and the animals of the Levites in place of their animals, and the Levites shall be mine; I am the Lord.
Numbers 3:46 And as the ransom of the two hundred seventy-three who exceed the Levites from among the firstborn of the sons of Israel,
