Numbers 3:47 you shall take five shekels per head; according to the holy didrachm you shall take them, twenty obols to the shekel.
Numbers 3:48 And you shall give the silver to Aaron and his sons as the ransom of those who exceed among them.
Numbers 3:49 And Moses took the silver, the ransom of those who exceeded, for the redemption from the Levites.
Numbers 3:50 From the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the silver, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels according to the holy shekel.
Numbers 3:51 And Moses gave the ransom of those who exceeded to Aaron and his sons through the voice of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses.

## Chapter 4

Numbers 4:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 4:2 Take the head-count of the sons of Kaath from the midst of the sons of Levi according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families,
Numbers 4:3 from twenty-five years old and above and up to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister, to perform all the works in the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 4:4 And these are the works of the sons of Kaath in the tabernacle of testimony: the Holy of Holies.
Numbers 4:5 And Aaron and his sons shall enter when the camp sets out, and they shall take down the overshadowing veil and shall cover the ark of testimony with it.
Numbers 4:6 And they shall place upon it a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and shall throw over it a cloth entirely hyacinth-colored above and shall insert the carrying poles.
Numbers 4:7 And upon the table set forth they shall throw a cloth entirely purple and the dishes and the censers and the cups and the libation vessels with which he pours libations, and the continual loaves shall be upon it.
Numbers 4:8 And they shall throw a scarlet cloth over it and cover it with a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and shall insert the carrying poles through it.
Numbers 4:9 And they shall take a hyacinth-colored cloth and cover the lampstand that gives light and its lamps and its tongs and its oil-drawers and all the vessels of oil with which they minister,
Numbers 4:10 and they shall put it and all its vessels into a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and shall place it upon carrying poles.
Numbers 4:11 And over the golden altar they shall cover a hyacinth-colored cloth and shall cover it with a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and shall insert its carrying poles.
Numbers 4:12 And they shall take all the ministering vessels with which they minister in the holy things and shall put them into a hyacinth-colored cloth and cover them with a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and shall place them upon carrying poles.
Numbers 4:13 And he shall place the cover upon the altar, and they shall cover it over with a cloth entirely purple.
Numbers 4:14 And they shall place upon it all the vessels with which they minister upon it, both the fire-pans and the flesh-hooks and the bowls and the cover and all the vessels of the altar; and they shall throw over it a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and shall insert its carrying poles; and they shall take a purple cloth and cover together the laver and its base and put them into a covering of hyacinth-colored skin and place them upon carrying poles.
Numbers 4:15 And Aaron and his sons shall finish covering the holy things and all the holy vessels when the camp sets out, and after these things the sons of Kaath shall enter to carry them, but they shall not touch the holy things, so that they do not die; these things the sons of Kaath shall carry in the tabernacle of testimony. –
Numbers 4:16 The overseer shall be Eleazar son of Aaron the priest: the oil of the light and the compounded incense and the daily sacrifice and the oil of anointing, the oversight of the whole tabernacle and all that is in it, in the holy place, in all the works. –
Numbers 4:17 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 4:18 Do not utterly destroy the clan of Kaath from the midst of the Levites.
Numbers 4:19 Do this for them, and they shall live and certainly shall not die when they approach the Holy of Holies: let Aaron and his sons approach and appoint them, each one according to his load.
Numbers 4:20 And they shall certainly not enter to see the holy things suddenly, and they will die.
Numbers 4:21 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 4:22 Take the head-count of the sons of Gedson, these also, according to the houses of their paternal families, according to their clans.
Numbers 4:23 From twenty-five years old and above up to fifty years old, muster them, everyone who enters to minister and to perform his works in the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 4:24 This is the ministry of the clan of Gedson, to minister and to carry:
Numbers 4:25 and he shall carry the skins of the tabernacle and the tabernacle of testimony and its covering and the hyacinth-colored covering that is upon it above and the covering of the door of the tabernacle of testimony,
Numbers 4:26 and the curtains of the court, as many as are upon the tabernacle of testimony, and the excesses and all the ministering vessels with which they minister; they shall perform these things.
Numbers 4:27 According to the mouth of Aaron and his sons shall be the ministry of the sons of Gedson, according to all their ministries and according to all the things carried by them; and you shall muster them by name for all the things carried by them.
Numbers 4:28 This is the ministry of the sons of Gedson in the tabernacle of testimony, and their watch shall be in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
Numbers 4:29 The sons of Merari, according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, you shall muster them.
Numbers 4:30 From twenty-five years old and above up to fifty years old, you shall muster them, everyone who enters to minister in the works of the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 4:31 And these are the observances of the things carried by them, according to all their works in the tabernacle of testimony: the capitals of the tabernacle and the bars and its pillars and its bases and the covering and their bases and their pillars and the covering of the door of the tabernacle,
Numbers 4:32 and the pillars of the court all around and their bases and the pillars of the veil of the gate of the court and their bases and their stakes and their cords and all their vessels and all their ministries; you shall muster them by name for all the vessels of the watch of the things carried by them.
Numbers 4:33 This is the ministry of the clan of the sons of Merari in all their works in the tabernacle of testimony, in the hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
Numbers 4:34 And Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel mustered the sons of Kaath according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families,
Numbers 4:35 from twenty-five years old and above up to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister and to work in the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 4:36 And their muster according to their clans was two thousand two hundred fifty.
Numbers 4:37 This is the muster of the clan of Kaath, everyone who ministers in the tabernacle of testimony, as Moses and Aaron mustered them through the voice of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
Numbers 4:38 And the sons of Gedson were mustered according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families,
Numbers 4:39 from twenty-five years old and above up to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister and to perform the works in the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 4:40 And their muster according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, was two thousand six hundred thirty.
Numbers 4:41 This is the muster of the clan of the sons of Gedson, everyone who ministers in the tabernacle of testimony, whom Moses and Aaron mustered through the voice of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
Numbers 4:42 And the clan of the sons of Merari also was mustered according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families,
Numbers 4:43 from twenty-five years old and above up to fifty years old, everyone who enters to minister at the works of the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 4:44 And their muster according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families, was three thousand two hundred.
Numbers 4:45 This is the muster of the clan of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron mustered through the voice of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
Numbers 4:46 All those mustered, whom Moses and Aaron and the rulers of Israel mustered, the Levites according to their clans, according to the houses of their paternal families,
Numbers 4:47 from twenty-five years old and above up to fifty years old, everyone who enters for the work of the works and for the works that are carried in the tabernacle of testimony,
Numbers 4:48 and those mustered were eight thousand five hundred eighty.
Numbers 4:49 Through the voice of the Lord he mustered them by the hand of Moses, man by man over their works and over the things that they themselves carry; and they were mustered in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses.

## Chapter 5

Numbers 5:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 5:2 Command the sons of Israel, and let them send out from the camp every leprous person and everyone with a seminal discharge and everyone unclean by a soul.
Numbers 5:3 From male to female, send them outside the camp, and they shall certainly not defile their camps, in which I dwell among them.
Numbers 5:4 And the sons of Israel did thus and sent them outside the camp; just as the Lord spoke to Moses, thus the sons of Israel did.
Numbers 5:5 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 5:6 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: A man or woman, whoever does any of the human sins and, with overlooking, overlooks and that soul trespasses,
Numbers 5:7 shall declare the sin that he committed and shall repay the trespass, the principal, and shall add its fifth to it and repay it to the one against whom he trespassed.
Numbers 5:8 But if the person has no kinsman so as to repay the trespass to him, the trespass repaid to the Lord shall belong to the priest, apart from the ram of propitiation through which he shall make atonement with it concerning him.
Numbers 5:9 And every firstfruit, according to all the things sanctified among the sons of Israel, as many as they offer to the Lord, shall belong to the priest himself.
Numbers 5:10 And each person’s sanctified things shall be his; whatever a man gives to the priest shall belong to him.
Numbers 5:11 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 5:12 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: If the wife of any man transgresses and, with overlooking, overlooks him,
Numbers 5:13 and someone lies with her with an emission of semen and it escapes the eyes of her husband and she conceals it, and she is defiled and there was no witness with her and she was not caught,
Numbers 5:14 and a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife, and she has been defiled; or a spirit of jealousy comes upon him and he is jealous of his wife, but she has not been defiled,
Numbers 5:15 then the man shall bring his wife to the priest and shall offer the gift concerning her, a tenth of an oiphi of barley flour; he shall not pour oil upon it or place frankincense upon it, for it is a sacrifice of jealousy, a sacrifice of memorial that brings sin to remembrance.
Numbers 5:16 And the priest shall bring her near and shall stand her before the Lord.
Numbers 5:17 And the priest shall take pure living water in an earthen vessel and some of the earth that is upon the floor of the tabernacle of testimony, and the priest, taking it, shall put it into the water.
Numbers 5:18 And the priest shall stand the woman before the Lord and shall uncover the woman’s head and shall put into her hands the sacrifice of memorial, the sacrifice of jealousy, but in the priest’s hand shall be the water of reproof, this cursed water.
Numbers 5:19 And the priest shall put her under oath and shall say to the woman: If no one has lain with you, if you have not transgressed to be defiled while under your own husband, be guiltless from the water of reproof, this cursed water.
Numbers 5:20 But if you have transgressed while being under a husband, or have been defiled and someone has given his bed in you besides your husband—
Numbers 5:21 then the priest shall put the woman under oath with the oaths of this curse, and the priest shall say to the woman: May the Lord give you for a curse and a thing sworn in the midst of your people, when the Lord gives your thigh fallen and your belly swollen,
Numbers 5:22 and this cursed water shall enter into your belly, to swell the stomach and cause your thigh to fall. And the woman shall say: May it be, may it be.
Numbers 5:23 And the priest shall write these curses in a book and shall wipe them into the water of reproof, the cursed water.
Numbers 5:24 And he shall make the woman drink the water of reproof, the cursed water, and the cursed water of reproof shall enter into her.
Numbers 5:25 And the priest shall take the sacrifice of jealousy from the woman’s hand and shall present the sacrifice before the Lord and shall bring it to the altar.
Numbers 5:26 And the priest shall grasp from the sacrifice its memorial portion and shall offer it upon the altar, and after these things he shall make the woman drink the water.
Numbers 5:27 And it shall be, if she has been defiled and, with escaping notice, escapes the notice of her husband, then the water of reproof, the cursed water, shall enter into her, and her belly shall swell and her thigh shall fall, and the woman shall become a curse among her people.
Numbers 5:28 But if the woman was not defiled and is clean, then she shall be guiltless and shall produce seed. –
Numbers 5:29 This is the law of jealousy, when a woman transgresses while being under a husband and is defiled,
Numbers 5:30 or when a spirit of jealousy comes upon a person and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall stand his wife before the Lord, and the priest shall perform for her all this law.
Numbers 5:31 And the man shall be guiltless from sin, and that woman shall bear her sin.

## Chapter 6

Numbers 6:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 6:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: A man or woman who greatly vows a vow to purify a purification to the Lord
Numbers 6:3 shall be purified from wine and sikera; he shall not drink vinegar from wine or vinegar from sikera, and he shall not drink anything produced from grapes, and he shall not eat fresh grapes or raisins.
Numbers 6:4 All the days of his vow he shall not eat anything that comes from the vine, from pressed grape skins to grape-seed.
Numbers 6:5 All the days of the vow of purification, a razor shall not come upon his head; until the days that he vowed to the Lord are fulfilled, he shall be holy, growing the hair of his head long.
Numbers 6:6 All the days of the vow to the Lord he shall not enter upon any soul that has died.
Numbers 6:7 By father and by mother and by brother and by sister, he shall not be defiled by them when they have died, because the vow of his God is upon him, upon his head.
Numbers 6:8 All the days of his vow he shall be holy to the Lord. –
Numbers 6:9 But if someone dies suddenly beside him, immediately the head of his vow shall be defiled, and he shall shave his head on whatever day he is cleansed; on the seventh day he shall be shaved.
Numbers 6:10 And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 6:11 And the priest shall make one concerning sin and one as a whole burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement concerning him for the things in which he sinned concerning the soul, and he shall sanctify his head on that day,
Numbers 6:12 on which he was sanctified to the Lord for the days of the vow, and he shall bring a year-old lamb for trespass; and the former days shall be unreckoned, because the head of his vow was defiled.
Numbers 6:13 And this is the law of the one who vowed: on whatever day he fulfills the days of his vow, he himself shall bring it beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony.
Numbers 6:14 And he shall bring his gift to the Lord: one year-old unblemished lamb as a whole burnt offering and one year-old unblemished ewe lamb concerning sin and one unblemished ram as a salvation,
Numbers 6:15 and a basket of unleavened things of fine flour, loaves worked up in oil and unleavened flat cakes anointed with oil, and their sacrifice and their libation.
Numbers 6:16 And the priest shall offer them before the Lord and shall make his thing concerning sin and his whole burnt offering.
Numbers 6:17 And he shall make the ram a sacrifice of salvation to the Lord with the basket of unleavened things, and the priest shall make his sacrifice and his libation.
Numbers 6:18 And the one who vowed shall shave the head of his vow beside the doors of the tabernacle of testimony and shall place the hairs upon the fire that is under the sacrifice of salvation.
Numbers 6:19 And the priest shall take the boiled arm from the ram and one unleavened loaf from the basket and one unleavened flat cake and shall place them upon the hands of the one who vowed after he has shaved his vow.
Numbers 6:20 And the priest shall offer them as a presentation before the Lord; it shall be holy for the priest in addition to the breast of presentation and in addition to the arm of the removal offering; and after these things the one who vowed shall drink wine. –
Numbers 6:21 This is the law of the one who vowed, whoever vows to the Lord his gift to the Lord concerning the vow, apart from whatever his hand finds according to the ability of his vow that he vows, according to the law of purification.
Numbers 6:22 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 6:23 Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying: Thus you shall bless the sons of Israel, saying to them: [and they shall place my name upon the sons of Israel, and I the Lord shall bless them]
Numbers 6:24 May the Lord bless you and keep you;
Numbers 6:25 may the Lord make his face appear upon you and have mercy on you;
Numbers 6:26 may the Lord lift up his face upon you and give you peace.

## Chapter 7

Numbers 7:1 And it happened on the day when Moses finished erecting the tabernacle, that he anointed it and sanctified it and all its vessels and the altar and all its vessels, and he anointed them and sanctified them,
Numbers 7:2 and the rulers of Israel presented, twelve rulers of the houses of their paternal families—these were rulers of tribes, these were the ones who stood over the muster—
Numbers 7:3 and they brought their gifts before the Lord: six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon from every two rulers and a calf from each, and they brought them before the tent.
Numbers 7:4 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 7:5 Take them from them, and they shall be for the ministerial works of the tent of testimony, and you shall give them to the Levites, to each according to his ministry.
Numbers 7:6 And Moses took the wagons and the oxen and gave them to the Levites;
Numbers 7:7 the two wagons and the four oxen he gave to the sons of Gedson according to their ministries,
Numbers 7:8 and the four wagons and the eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari according to their ministries through Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
Numbers 7:9 But to the sons of Kaath he gave none, because they have the ministries of the sanctuary; they shall carry them upon shoulders.
Numbers 7:10 And the rulers presented offerings for the inauguration of the altar on the day when he anointed it, and the rulers presented their gifts before the altar.
Numbers 7:11 And the Lord said to Moses: One ruler per day, one ruler per day, shall present their gifts for the inauguration of the altar.
Numbers 7:12 And the one presenting his gift on the first day was Naasson son of Aminadab, ruler of the tribe of Judas.
Numbers 7:13 And he presented his gift: one silver dish, one hundred thirty its weight; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour worked with oil, for a sacrifice;
Numbers 7:14 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:15 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:16 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:17 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Naasson son of Aminadab.
Numbers 7:18 On the second day Nathanael son of Sogar, ruler of the tribe of Issachar, presented.
Numbers 7:19 And he presented his gift: one silver dish, one hundred thirty its weight; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour worked with oil, for a sacrifice;
Numbers 7:20 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:21 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:22 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:23 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Nathanael son of Sogar.
Numbers 7:24 On the third day, the ruler of the sons of Zaboulon, Eliab son of Chailon.

Numbers 7:26 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:27 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:28 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:29 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Eliab son of Chailon.
Numbers 7:30 On the fourth day, the ruler of the sons of Reuben, Elisour son of Sediour.
Numbers 7:31 His gift: one silver dish, one hundred thirty its weight; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour worked with oil, for a sacrifice;
Numbers 7:32 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:33 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:34 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;

Numbers 7:36 On the fifth day, the ruler of the sons of Symeon, Salamiel son of Sourisadai.

Numbers 7:38 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:39 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:40 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:41 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Salamiel son of Sourisadai.
Numbers 7:42 On the sixth day, the ruler of the sons of Gad, Elisaph son of Ragouel.
Numbers 7:43 His gift: one silver dish, one hundred thirty its weight; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour worked with oil, for a sacrifice;
Numbers 7:44 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:45 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:46 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:47 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Elisaph son of Ragouel.
Numbers 7:48 On the seventh day, the ruler of the sons of Ephraim, Elisama son of Emioud.

Numbers 7:50 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:51 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:52 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:53 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Elisama son of Emioud.
Numbers 7:54 On the eighth day, the ruler of the sons of Manasse, Gamaliel son of Phadassour.
Numbers 7:55 His gift: one silver dish, one hundred thirty its weight; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour worked with oil, for a sacrifice;
Numbers 7:56 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:57 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:58 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:59 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Gamaliel son of Phadassour.
Numbers 7:60 On the ninth day, the ruler of the sons of Benjamin, Abidan son of Gadeoni.

Numbers 7:62 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;

Numbers 7:70 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;

Numbers 7:72 On the eleventh day, the ruler of the sons of Aser, Phagaiel son of Echran.
Numbers 7:73 His gift: one silver dish, one hundred thirty its weight; one silver bowl of seventy shekels according to the holy shekel; both full of fine flour worked with oil, for a sacrifice;
Numbers 7:74 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:75 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:76 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:77 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Phagaiel son of Echran.

Numbers 7:80 one censer of ten gold pieces, full of incense;
Numbers 7:81 one calf from cattle, one ram, one year-old lamb for a whole burnt offering;
Numbers 7:82 and one male kid from goats concerning sin;
Numbers 7:83 and for a sacrifice of salvation, two heifers, five rams, five male goats, five year-old ewe lambs. This was the gift of Achire son of Ainan.
Numbers 7:84 This was the inauguration of the altar, on the day when he anointed it, from the rulers of the sons of Israel: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver bowls, twelve gold censers;
Numbers 7:85 the one dish was one hundred thirty shekels and the one bowl seventy shekels; all the silver of the vessels was two thousand four hundred shekels according to the holy shekel.
Numbers 7:86 Twelve gold censers full of incense; all the gold of the censers was one hundred twenty gold pieces.
Numbers 7:87 All the cattle for the whole burnt offering: twelve calves, twelve rams, twelve year-old lambs, and their sacrifices and their libations; and twelve male kids from goats concerning sin.
Numbers 7:88 All the cattle for a sacrifice of salvation: twenty-four heifers, sixty rams, sixty male goats, sixty unblemished year-old ewe lambs. This was the inauguration of the altar after filling its hands and after anointing it. –
Numbers 7:89 When Moses entered the tent of testimony to speak to him, he also heard the voice of the Lord speaking to him from above the propitiatory that is upon the ark of testimony, between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

## Chapter 8

Numbers 8:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 8:2 Speak to Aaron, and you shall say to him: Whenever you set the lamps, from the side facing the lampstand the seven lamps shall give light.
Numbers 8:3 And Aaron did so; from the one side facing the lampstand he lit its lamps, in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses.
Numbers 8:4 And this was the construction of the lampstand: solid gold, its shaft and its lilies, entirely solid; according to the form that the Lord showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.
Numbers 8:5 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 8:6 Take the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel and purify them.
Numbers 8:7 And thus you shall perform their purification for them: you shall sprinkle water of purification all around them, and a razor shall pass over all their body, and they shall wash their garments and shall be clean.
Numbers 8:8 And they shall take one calf from cattle and its sacrifice of fine flour worked with oil, and you shall take a year-old calf from cattle concerning sin.
Numbers 8:9 And you shall bring the Levites before the tent of testimony and shall gather the entire congregation of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 8:10 And you shall bring the Levites before the Lord, and the sons of Israel shall place their hands upon the Levites,
Numbers 8:11 and Aaron shall set apart the Levites as a return-gift before the Lord from the sons of Israel, and they shall be for performing the works of the Lord.
Numbers 8:12 And the Levites shall place their hands upon the heads of the calves, and he shall make the one concerning sin and the one as a whole burnt offering to the Lord, to make atonement concerning them.
Numbers 8:13 And you shall stand the Levites before the Lord and before Aaron and before his sons, and you shall give them back as a return-gift before the Lord;
Numbers 8:14 and you shall distinguish the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, and they shall be mine.
Numbers 8:15 And after these things the Levites shall enter to perform the works of the tent of testimony, and you shall cleanse them and give them back before the Lord.
Numbers 8:16 For these have been given back to me as a return-gift from the midst of the sons of Israel; in place of those opening every womb, all the firstborn from the sons of Israel, I have taken them for myself.
Numbers 8:17 For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is mine, from human to livestock; on the day when I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them to myself,
Numbers 8:18 and I took the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
Numbers 8:19 And I have given back the Levites, given as a return-gift to Aaron and his sons from the midst of the sons of Israel, to perform the works of the sons of Israel in the tent of testimony and to make atonement concerning the sons of Israel, and there shall be no one among the sons of Israel approaching the holy things. –
Numbers 8:20 And Moses and Aaron and the entire congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites; thus the sons of Israel did to them.
Numbers 8:21 And the Levites purified themselves and washed their garments, and Aaron gave them back as a return-gift before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement concerning them, to purify them.
Numbers 8:22 And after these things the Levites entered to minister their ministry in the tent of testimony before Aaron and before his sons; just as the Lord instructed Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
Numbers 8:23 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 8:24 This is the matter concerning the Levites: from twenty-five years old and above they shall enter to be active in the tent of testimony;
Numbers 8:25 and from fifty years old he shall withdraw from the ministry and shall no longer work,
Numbers 8:26 and his brother shall minister in the tent of testimony to keep watches, but he shall not perform works. Thus you shall do to the Levites in their watches.

## Chapter 9

Numbers 9:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sina in the second year after they went out from the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying:
Numbers 9:2 Say, and let the sons of Israel perform the Passover at its appointed time;
Numbers 9:3 on the fourteenth day of the first month toward evening you shall perform it according to appointed times; according to its law and according to its comparison you shall perform it.
Numbers 9:4 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel to perform the Passover.
Numbers 9:5 When it was beginning on the fourteenth day of the month in the wilderness of Sina, in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
Numbers 9:6 And the men arrived who were unclean on account of a human soul and were unable to perform the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day,
Numbers 9:7 and those men said to him: We are unclean on account of a human soul; shall we then fail to present the gift to the Lord at its appointed time in the midst of the sons of Israel?
Numbers 9:8 And Moses said to them: Stand there, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you. –
Numbers 9:9 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 9:10 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: Person by person, whoever becomes unclean on account of a human soul or is on a journey far away, among you or among your generations, shall also perform the Passover to the Lord;
Numbers 9:11 in the second month, on the fourteenth day, toward evening they shall perform it; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
Numbers 9:12 They shall leave none of it until morning, and they shall not break a bone from it; according to the law of the Passover they shall perform it.
Numbers 9:13 And a person who is clean and is not on a distant journey and fails to perform the Passover—that soul shall be utterly destroyed from its people; because he did not present the gift to the Lord at its appointed time, that person shall receive his sin. –
Numbers 9:14 And if a proselyte comes to you in your land and performs the Passover to the Lord, according to the law of the Passover and according to its ordinance he shall perform it; there shall be one law for you and for the proselyte and for the native of the land.
Numbers 9:15 And on the day when the tent was set up, the cloud covered the tent, the house of testimony; and in the evening it was upon the tent like the appearance of fire until morning.
Numbers 9:16 Thus it happened continually; the cloud covered it by day and the appearance of fire by night.
Numbers 9:17 And whenever the cloud rose from the tent, after these things the sons of Israel set out; and at the place where the cloud stood, there the sons of Israel encamped.
Numbers 9:18 By the command of the Lord the sons of Israel shall encamp, and by the command of the Lord they shall set out; all the days in which the cloud overshadows the tent, the sons of Israel shall encamp;
Numbers 9:19 and whenever the cloud remains over the tent for more days, the sons of Israel shall also keep the watch of God and shall certainly not set out;
Numbers 9:20 and it shall be, whenever the cloud covers the tent for a number of days, by the voice of the Lord they shall encamp and by the command of the Lord they shall set out;
Numbers 9:21 and it shall be, whenever the cloud remains from evening until morning and the cloud rises in the morning, then they shall set out by day or by night;
Numbers 9:22 for a month of days, while the cloud continues overshadowing it, the sons of Israel shall encamp and shall certainly not set out.
Numbers 9:23 For by the command of the Lord they shall set out; they kept the watch of the Lord by the command of the Lord through the hand of Moses.

## Chapter 10

Numbers 10:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 10:2 Make for yourself two silver trumpets; you shall make them hammered, and they shall be for you for calling together the congregation and making the camps set out.
Numbers 10:3 And you shall sound them, and the entire congregation shall be gathered at the door of the tent of testimony;
Numbers 10:4 but if they sound with one, all the rulers, the leaders of Israel, shall come to you.
Numbers 10:5 And you shall sound a signal, and the camps encamping toward the east shall set out;
Numbers 10:6 and you shall sound a second signal, and the camps encamping toward the southwest shall set out; and you shall sound a third signal, and the camps encamping by the sea shall set out; and you shall sound a fourth signal, and the camps encamping toward the north shall set out; they shall sound with a signal at their setting out.
Numbers 10:7 And whenever you gather the congregation, you shall sound, but not with a signal.
Numbers 10:8 And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall sound the trumpets, and it shall be an eternal ordinance for you throughout your generations.
Numbers 10:9 And if you go out to war in your land against the adversaries who oppose you, then you shall signal with the trumpets and shall be remembered before the Lord and shall be delivered from your enemies.
Numbers 10:10 And on the days of your rejoicing and at your festivals and at your new moons you shall sound the trumpets over the whole burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your salvation, and it shall be a remembrance for you before your God; I am the Lord your God.
Numbers 10:11 And it happened in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth of the month, that the cloud rose from the tent of testimony,
Numbers 10:12 and the sons of Israel set out with their equipment in the wilderness of Sina, and the cloud stood in the wilderness of Pharan.
Numbers 10:13 And they set out first by the voice of the Lord through the hand of Moses. –
Numbers 10:14 And the order of the camp of the sons of Judas set out first with their force; and over their force was Naasson son of Aminadab,
Numbers 10:15 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Issachar was Nathanael son of Sogar,
Numbers 10:16 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Zaboulon was Eliab son of Chailon.
Numbers 10:17 And they shall take down the tent, and the sons of Gedson and the sons of Merari shall set out carrying the tent. –
Numbers 10:18 And the order of the camp of Reuben set out with their force; and over their force was Elisour son of Sediour,
Numbers 10:19 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Symeon was Salamiel son of Sourisadai,
Numbers 10:20 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Gad was Elisaph, the one of Ragouel.
Numbers 10:21 And the sons of Kaath shall set out carrying the holy things, and they shall set up the tent until they arrive. –
Numbers 10:22 And the order of the camp of Ephraim shall set out with their force; and over their force was Elisama son of Emioud,
Numbers 10:23 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Manasse was Gamaliel, the one of Phadassour,
Numbers 10:24 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin was Abidan, the one of Gadeoni. –
Numbers 10:25 And the order of the camp of the sons of Dan shall set out last of all the camps with their force; and over their force was Achiezer, the one of Amisadai,
Numbers 10:26 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Aser was Phagaiel son of Echran,
Numbers 10:27 and over the force of the tribe of the sons of Nephthali was Achire son of Ainan.
Numbers 10:28 These were the armies of the sons of Israel, and they set out with their force.
Numbers 10:29 And Moses said to Jobab son of Ragouel the Midianite, Moses's in-law: We are setting out for the place of which the Lord said, This I will give you. Come with us, and we will do you good, because the Lord has spoken good things concerning Israel.
Numbers 10:30 And he said to him: I will not go, but to my land and to my generation.
Numbers 10:31 And he said: Do not abandon us, since you were with us in the wilderness, and you shall be an elder among us;
Numbers 10:32 and it shall be, if you go with us, and those good things shall be, as many as the Lord may do good to us, and we will do good to you.
Numbers 10:33 And they set out from the mountain of the Lord on a journey of three days, and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went ahead of them on a journey of three days to scout out rest for them.
Numbers 10:34 And it happened when the ark set out that Moses said: Rise up, Lord; let your enemies be scattered; let all who hate you flee.
Numbers 10:35 And when it rested he said: Turn back, Lord, thousands of myriads in Israel.
Numbers 10:36 And the cloud was overshadowing them by day when they set out from the camp.

## Chapter 11

Numbers 11:1 And the people were murmuring evil things before the Lord, and the Lord heard and was enraged with wrath, and fire from the Lord was kindled among them and devoured a certain part of the camp.
Numbers 11:2 And the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to the Lord, and the fire abated.
Numbers 11:3 And the name of that place was called Burning, because fire from the Lord was kindled among them.
Numbers 11:4 And the mixed multitude among them desired a desire, and the sons of Israel also sat down and wept and said: Who will feed us meat?
Numbers 11:5 We remembered the fish that we ate freely in Egypt, and the cucumbers and the melons and the leeks and the onions and the garlic;
Numbers 11:6 but now our soul is utterly dry; there is nothing except our eyes toward the manna.
Numbers 11:7 And the manna is like coriander seed, and its appearance is the appearance of crystal;
Numbers 11:8 and the people went about and gathered it and ground it in the mill and pounded it in the mortar and boiled it in the pot and made it into cakes baked in ashes, and its flavor was like the taste of a cake made with oil;
Numbers 11:9 and whenever the dew descended upon the camp by night, the manna descended upon it.
Numbers 11:10 And Moses heard them weeping according to their communities, each one at his door; and the Lord was exceedingly enraged with wrath, and it was evil before Moses.
Numbers 11:11 And Moses said to the Lord: Why have you afflicted your attendant, and why have I not found favor before you, that you should place the onrush of this people upon me?
Numbers 11:12 Did I conceive all this people in the womb, or did I bear them, that you say to me, Take him into your bosom, as a nurse might carry the nursing child, into the land that you swore to their fathers?
Numbers 11:13 From where is there meat for me to give to all this people? For they weep against me, saying: Give us meat, that we may eat.
Numbers 11:14 I shall not be able to bear this people alone, because this matter is heavier for me.
Numbers 11:15 But if you deal thus with me, kill me by slaying me, if I have found mercy with you, so that I may not see my affliction. –
Numbers 11:16 And the Lord said to Moses: Gather for me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you yourself know, that these are elders of the people and their scribes, and you shall bring them to the tent of testimony, and they shall stand there with you.
Numbers 11:17 And I will descend and speak there with you, and I will take away from the spirit that is upon you and place it upon them, and they shall take hold together with you of the onrush of the people, and you shall not bear them alone.
Numbers 11:18 And you shall say to the people: Purify yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat, because you wept before the Lord, saying: Who will feed us meat? Because it is good for us in Egypt. And the Lord will give you meat to eat, and you shall eat meat.
Numbers 11:19 You shall eat not one day, nor two, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days;
Numbers 11:20 up to a month of days you shall eat, until it comes out from your nostrils, and it shall become cholera for you, because you disobeyed the Lord, who is among you, and wept before him, saying: Why did we come out of Egypt?
Numbers 11:21 And Moses said: The people among whom I am are six hundred thousand on foot, and you said: I will give them meat to eat, and they shall eat for a month of days?
Numbers 11:22 Surely sheep and cattle will not be slaughtered for them and suffice for them? Or will all the food of the sea be gathered for them and suffice for them?
Numbers 11:23 And the Lord said to Moses: Will the hand of the Lord not be sufficient? Now you shall know whether my word will overtake you or not.
Numbers 11:24 And Moses went out and spoke the words of the Lord to the people and gathered seventy men from the elders of the people and stood them around the tent.
Numbers 11:25 And the Lord descended in a cloud and spoke to him; and he took from the spirit that was upon him and placed it upon the seventy men, the elders; and when the spirit rested upon them, they also prophesied and did not add any more.
Numbers 11:26 And two men had been left behind in the camp, the name of the one Eldad and the name of the second Modad, and the spirit rested upon them – and these were among those enrolled and did not come to the tent – and they prophesied in the camp.
Numbers 11:27 And the young man ran and reported to Moses and said: Eldad and Modad are prophesying in the camp.
Numbers 11:28 And Jesus, the one of Nave, who stood beside Moses, the chosen one, answered and said: Lord Moses, prevent them.
Numbers 11:29 And Moses said to him: Are you jealous for me? And who might give all the people of the Lord as prophets, whenever the Lord gives his spirit upon them?
Numbers 11:30 And Moses went away into the camp, he and the elders of Israel. –
Numbers 11:31 And a wind went out from the Lord and carried quail across from the sea and cast it over the camp, a day's journey on this side and a day's journey on that side, around the camp, about two cubits from the ground.
Numbers 11:32 And the people rose for the whole day and the whole night and the whole following day and gathered the quail; the one who gathered little gathered ten cors, and they spread them to cool for themselves around the camp.
Numbers 11:33 The meat was still in their teeth before it ran out, and the Lord was enraged against the people, and the Lord struck the people with an exceedingly great plague.
Numbers 11:34 And the name of that place was called Graves of Desire, because there they buried the people who desired.
Numbers 11:35 From Graves of Desire the people set out for Aseroth, and the people were in Aseroth.

## Chapter 12

Numbers 12:1 And Mariam and Aaron spoke against Moses on account of the Ethiopian woman whom Moses took, because he took an Ethiopian woman,
Numbers 12:2 and they said: Has the Lord spoken only to Moses? Has he not also spoken to us? And the Lord heard.
Numbers 12:3 And the man Moses was exceedingly gentle beyond all the people who were upon the earth.
Numbers 12:4 And the Lord immediately said to Moses and Mariam and Aaron: You three, come out to the tent of testimony. And the three came out to the tent of testimony.
Numbers 12:5 And the Lord descended in a pillar of cloud and stood at the door of the tent of testimony, and Aaron and Mariam were called, and both came out.
Numbers 12:6 And he said to them: Hear my words. If there is a prophet of yours for the Lord, I shall be known to him in a vision, and in sleep I shall speak to him.
Numbers 12:7 Not so my attendant Moses; in my whole house he is faithful;
Numbers 12:8 mouth to mouth I shall speak to him, in form and not through riddles, and he saw the glory of the Lord; and why were you not afraid to speak against my attendant Moses?
Numbers 12:9 And the wrath of the Lord's anger was upon them, and he departed.
Numbers 12:10 And the cloud withdrew from the tent, and behold, Mariam was leprous like snow; and Aaron looked upon Mariam, and behold, she was leprous.
Numbers 12:11 And Aaron said to Moses: Please, my lord, may he not lay sin upon us together, because we acted ignorantly in that we sinned;
Numbers 12:12 let her not become as one equal to death, like an aborted fetus coming out of a mother's womb and devouring half of her flesh.
Numbers 12:13 And Moses cried out to the Lord, saying: O God, I ask you, heal her.
Numbers 12:14 And the Lord said to Moses: If her father, spitting, had spat into her face, would she not be ashamed for seven days? Let her be set apart outside the camp for seven days, and after these things she shall enter.
Numbers 12:15 And Mariam was set apart outside the camp for seven days; and the people did not set out until Mariam was cleansed.
Numbers 12:16 And after these things the people set out from Aseroth and encamped in the wilderness of Pharan.

## Chapter 13

Numbers 13:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 13:2 Send men for yourself, and let them spy out the land of the Chananeans that I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession; one man per tribe according to the communities of their paternal families you shall send them, every one a leader from among them.
Numbers 13:3 And Moses sent them out from the wilderness of Pharan by the voice of the Lord; all these men were leaders of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 13:4 And these are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Salamiel son of Zacchour;
Numbers 13:5 from the tribe of Symeon, Saphat son of Souri;
Numbers 13:6 from the tribe of Judas, Chaleb son of Jephonne;
Numbers 13:7 from the tribe of Issachar, Igaal son of Joseph;
Numbers 13:8 from the tribe of Ephraim, Ause son of Nave;
Numbers 13:9 from the tribe of Benjamin, Phalti son of Raphou;
Numbers 13:10 from the tribe of Zaboulon, Goudiel son of Soudi;
Numbers 13:11 from the tribe of Joseph, from the sons of Manasse, Gaddi son of Sousi;
Numbers 13:12 from the tribe of Dan, Amiel son of Gamali;
Numbers 13:13 from the tribe of Aser, Sathour son of Michael;
Numbers 13:14 from the tribe of Nephthali, Nabi son of Jabi;
Numbers 13:15 from the tribe of Gad, Goudiel son of Machi.
Numbers 13:16 These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses named Ause son of Nave Jesus.
Numbers 13:17 And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Chanaan and said to them: Go up by this wilderness, and you shall go up into the mountain,
Numbers 13:18 and you shall see the land, what it is, and the people settled upon it, whether it is stronger or weak, whether they are few or many;
Numbers 13:19 and what is the land upon which these are settled, whether it is good or evil; and what are the cities in which these dwell, whether walled or unwalled;
Numbers 13:20 and what is the land, whether rich or neglected, whether there are trees in it or not; and persevere, and you shall take from the fruits of the land. And the days were days of spring, forerunners of the grape.
Numbers 13:21 And they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Sin as far as Raab, as they enter Ephaath.
Numbers 13:22 And they went up by the wilderness and came as far as Chebron, and there were Achiman and Sessi and Thelamin, generations of Enach; and Chebron was built seven years before Tanin of Egypt.
Numbers 13:23 And they came as far as the Ravine of the Cluster and spied it out; and they cut from there a vine branch and one cluster of grapes upon it and carried it upon carrying poles, and some of the pomegranates and some of the figs.
Numbers 13:24 They named that place Ravine of the Cluster because of the cluster that the sons of Israel cut from there.
Numbers 13:25 And they returned from there after spying out the land, after forty days,
Numbers 13:26 and they traveled and came to Moses and Aaron and to the entire congregation of the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Pharan Kades, and they answered a word to them and to the entire congregation and showed the fruit of the land.
Numbers 13:27 And they recounted to him and said: We came into the land into which you sent us, a land flowing with milk and honey, and this is its fruit;
Numbers 13:28 except that the nation inhabiting it is bold, and the cities are fortified, walled, and exceedingly great, and we have seen the generation of Enach there,
Numbers 13:29 and Amalek dwells in the land toward the south, and the Chettite and the Evite and the Jebousite and the Amorrite dwell in the hill country, and the Chananite dwells by the sea and by the Jordan River.
Numbers 13:30 And Chaleb silenced the people before Moses and said to him: No, but having gone up, we shall go up and inherit it, because, being able, we shall be able against them.
Numbers 13:31 And the men who went up together with him said: We are not going up, because we shall certainly not be able to go up against the nation, because it is stronger than us by far.
Numbers 13:32 And they brought out consternation concerning the land that they had spied out to the sons of Israel, saying: The land through which we passed to spy it out is a land devouring those who inhabit it; all the people whom we saw in it are exceedingly tall men;
Numbers 13:33 and there we saw the giants, and we were before them like locusts, and thus we also were before them.

## Chapter 14

Numbers 14:1 And the entire congregation took up and gave voice, and the people wept that whole night.
Numbers 14:2 And all the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron, and the entire congregation said to them: Would that we had died in the land of Egypt, or if we had died in this wilderness!
Numbers 14:3 And why does the Lord bring us into this land to fall in war? Our wives and children shall be for plunder; now, therefore, it is better for us to turn back to Egypt.
Numbers 14:4 And they said to one another: Let us appoint a leader and turn back to Egypt.
Numbers 14:5 And Moses and Aaron fell upon their face before the entire congregation of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 14:6 But Jesus, the one of Nave, and Chaleb, the one of Jephonne, from those who spied out the land, tore their garments
Numbers 14:7 and spoke to the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, saying: The land that we spied out is exceedingly, exceedingly good;
Numbers 14:8 if the Lord chooses us, he will bring us into this land and give it to us, a land that is flowing with milk and honey.
Numbers 14:9 But do not become apostates from the Lord; and you, do not fear the people of the land, because they are food for us; for their time has departed from them, but the Lord is among us; do not fear them.
Numbers 14:10 And the entire congregation said to stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in a cloud upon the tent of testimony among all the sons of Israel.
Numbers 14:11 And the Lord said to Moses: How long does this people provoke me, and how long do they not believe me amid all the signs that I performed among them?
Numbers 14:12 I will strike them with death and destroy them, and I will make you and the house of your father into a great nation, and much more than this.
Numbers 14:13 And Moses said to the Lord: And Egypt will hear that by your strength you brought this people up from among them,
Numbers 14:14 but all those inhabiting this land have also heard that you are the Lord among this people, that you, Lord, appear eye to eye, and your cloud stands over them, and in a pillar of cloud you go before them by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
Numbers 14:15 And you will destroy this people as one man, and the nations, as many as have heard your name, will speak, saying:
Numbers 14:16 Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land that he swore to them, he laid them low in the wilderness.
Numbers 14:17 And now let your strength be exalted, Lord, in the manner that you spoke, saying:
Numbers 14:18 The Lord is long-suffering and abundant in mercy and true, taking away lawlessnesses and injustices and sins, and by cleansing he will not cleanse the guilty, repaying the sins of fathers upon children to the third and fourth.
Numbers 14:19 Forgive the sin for this people according to your great mercy, just as you became gracious to them from Egypt until now.
Numbers 14:20 And the Lord said to Moses: I am gracious to them according to your word;
Numbers 14:21 but I live, and my name is living, and the glory of the Lord shall fill all the earth,
Numbers 14:22 because all the men who see my glory and the signs that I performed in Egypt and in this wilderness, and tested me this tenth time and did not listen to my voice,
Numbers 14:23 surely shall not see the land that I swore to their fathers, except their children who are here with me, as many as do not know good or evil, every inexperienced younger person; to these I will give the land, but all who provoked me shall not see it.
Numbers 14:24 But my servant Chaleb, because another spirit came to be in him and he followed me, I will bring him into the land into which he entered there, and his seed shall inherit it.
Numbers 14:25 But Amalek and the Chananite dwell in the valley; tomorrow turn back and set out into the wilderness by the road toward the Red Sea.
Numbers 14:26 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 14:27 How long this evil congregation? I have heard the things that they themselves murmur before me, the murmuring of the sons of Israel that they murmured about you.
Numbers 14:28 Say to them: I live, says the Lord; surely, in the manner that you spoke into my ears, so I will do to you.
Numbers 14:29 In this wilderness your carcasses shall fall, and all your muster and those of you who were counted from twenty years old and above, as many as murmured against me;
Numbers 14:30 you shall certainly not enter the land upon which I stretched out my hand to settle you upon it, except Chaleb son of Jephonne and Jesus, the one of Nave.
Numbers 14:31 And the children whom you said would be for plunder, I will bring them into the land, and they shall inherit the land from which you turned away.
Numbers 14:32 And your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness,
Numbers 14:33 but your sons shall be grazing in the wilderness for forty years and shall bear your fornication, until your carcasses are consumed in the wilderness.
Numbers 14:34 According to the number of the days for which you spied out the land, forty days, a day for a year, you shall receive your sins for forty years and shall know the fury of my wrath.
Numbers 14:35 I, the Lord, have spoken; surely thus I will do to this evil congregation that has banded together against me; in this wilderness they shall be utterly consumed, and there they shall die.
Numbers 14:36 And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and caused the congregation to murmur against it by bringing out evil words concerning the land,
Numbers 14:37 the men who spoke evil against the land also died in the plague before the Lord;
Numbers 14:38 and Jesus son of Nave and Chaleb son of Jephonne lived from among those men who had gone to spy out the land.
Numbers 14:39 And Moses spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, and the people mourned exceedingly.
Numbers 14:40 And rising early in the morning, they went up to the summit of the mountain, saying: Behold, here we are; we will go up to the place that the Lord spoke of, because we sinned.
Numbers 14:41 And Moses said: Why are you transgressing the word of the Lord? It shall not be prosperous for you.
Numbers 14:42 Do not go up, for the Lord is not with you, and you shall fall before the face of your enemies.
Numbers 14:43 For Amalek and the Chananite are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword; because you turned away, disobeying the Lord, the Lord shall not be among you.
Numbers 14:44 And forcing their way, they went up to the summit of the mountain; but the ark of the covenant of the Lord and Moses did not move from the camp.
Numbers 14:45 And Amalek and the Chananite who dwelt on that mountain came down and routed them and cut them down as far as Erman; and they returned to the camp.

## Chapter 15

Numbers 15:1 And the Lord said to Moses, saying:
Numbers 15:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: Whenever you enter into the land of your dwelling that I am giving you,
Numbers 15:3 and you make whole burnt offerings to the Lord, a whole offering or a sacrifice, to magnify a vow or according to a voluntary offering or at your festivals, to make an odor of sweetness to the Lord, whether from the cattle or from the sheep,
Numbers 15:4 then the one presenting his gift to the Lord shall present a sacrifice of fine flour, one-tenth of an oiphi, worked with oil in one-fourth of a hin;
Numbers 15:5 and as wine for a libation you shall make one-fourth of a hin upon the whole burnt offering or upon the sacrifice; for the one lamb you shall make this much, an offering, an odor of sweetness to the Lord.
Numbers 15:6 And for the ram, whenever you make it either as a whole burnt offering or as a sacrifice, you shall make a sacrifice of fine flour, two-tenths worked with oil, one-third of a hin;
Numbers 15:7 and as wine for a libation you shall present one-third of a hin for an odor of sweetness to the Lord.
Numbers 15:8 But if you make something from the cattle as a whole burnt offering or as a sacrifice to magnify a vow or as salvation to the Lord,
Numbers 15:9 then he shall present upon the calf a sacrifice of fine flour, three-tenths worked with oil, half of a hin,
Numbers 15:10 and as wine for a libation half of a hin, an offering, an odor of sweetness to the Lord.
Numbers 15:11 Thus you shall do for the one calf or the one ram or the one lamb from the sheep or from the goats;
Numbers 15:12 according to the number of those that you make, thus you shall do for each one according to their number.
Numbers 15:13 Every native shall thus make such things, to present offerings for an odor of sweetness to the Lord.
Numbers 15:14 And if a proselyte comes to be among you in your land, or whoever comes to be among you throughout your generations, and makes an offering, an odor of sweetness to the Lord, in the manner that you do, so the congregation shall do to the Lord.
Numbers 15:15 There shall be one law for you and for the proselytes attached among you, an eternal law throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the proselyte be before the Lord;
Numbers 15:16 there shall be one law and there shall be one ordinance for you and for the proselyte attached among you.
Numbers 15:17 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 15:18 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: When you enter into the land into which I am bringing you there,
Numbers 15:19 then it shall be, whenever you eat from the breads of the land, that you shall remove a removal offering, a separation, for the Lord;
Numbers 15:20 as first produce of your dough, bread, you shall separate it as a removal offering; as a removal offering from a threshing floor, so you shall remove it,
Numbers 15:21 as first produce of your dough, and you shall give a removal offering to the Lord throughout your generations.
Numbers 15:22 But whenever you err and do not perform all these commandments that the Lord spoke to Moses,
Numbers 15:23 in the manner that the Lord instructed you through the hand of Moses, from the day when the Lord instructed you and onward throughout your generations,
Numbers 15:24 then it shall be, if it happens involuntarily from the eyes of the congregation, that the entire congregation shall make one unblemished calf from cattle as a whole burnt offering for an odor of sweetness to the Lord, and its sacrifice and its libation according to the ordinance, and one male kid from goats concerning sin.
Numbers 15:25 And the priest shall make atonement concerning the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, because it is involuntary, and they themselves brought their gift, an offering to the Lord concerning their sin before the Lord, concerning their involuntary acts.
Numbers 15:26 And it shall be forgiven throughout the entire congregation of the sons of Israel and the proselyte attached to you, because it was involuntary for all the people. –
Numbers 15:27 But if one soul sins involuntarily, he shall bring one year-old female goat concerning sin,
Numbers 15:28 and the priest shall make atonement concerning the soul that acted involuntarily and sinned involuntarily before the Lord, to make atonement concerning him.
Numbers 15:29 For the native among the sons of Israel and for the proselyte attached among them, there shall be one law for them, whoever acts involuntarily.
Numbers 15:30 And a soul who acts with a hand of arrogance, whether from the natives or from the proselytes, this person provokes God; that soul shall be utterly destroyed from its people,
Numbers 15:31 because it held the word of the Lord cheap and scattered his commandments; with an obliteration that soul shall be obliterated; its sin is in it.
Numbers 15:32 And the sons of Israel were in the wilderness and found a man gathering wood on the day of the Sabbaths.
Numbers 15:33 And those who found him gathering wood on the day of the Sabbaths brought him to Moses and Aaron and to the entire congregation of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 15:34 And they placed him in custody, for they had not determined what they should do to him.
Numbers 15:35 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: Let the man be put to death by death; the entire congregation, stone him with stones.
Numbers 15:36 And the entire congregation brought him outside the camp, and the entire congregation stoned him with stones outside the camp, in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses.
Numbers 15:37 And the Lord said to Moses, saying:
Numbers 15:38 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: And let them make for themselves fringes upon the wings of their garments throughout their generations, and you shall place upon the fringes of the wings a hyacinth-colored thread.
Numbers 15:39 And it shall be for you in the fringes, and you shall see them and remember all the commandments of the Lord and perform them, and you shall not turn aside after your minds and after your eyes, in which you commit fornication after them,
Numbers 15:40 so that you may remember and perform all my commandments and shall be holy to your God.
Numbers 15:41 I am the Lord your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt to be your God; I am the Lord your God.

## Chapter 16

Numbers 16:1 And Kore spoke, son of Issaar son of Kaath son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiron, sons of Eliab, and Aun son of Phaleth son of Reuben,
Numbers 16:2 and they rose before Moses, along with two hundred fifty men from the sons of Israel, leaders of the congregation, summoned members of the council and men of renown.
Numbers 16:3 They banded together against Moses and Aaron and said: Let it be enough for you, because the entire congregation, all of them, are holy, and the Lord is among them; and why do you rise up against the congregation of the Lord?
Numbers 16:4 And Moses heard and fell upon his face,
Numbers 16:5 and he spoke to Kore and to his entire congregation, saying: God has mustered and known those who are his and the holy ones and brought them to himself, and those whom he chose for himself he brought to himself.
Numbers 16:6 Do this: take fire-pans for yourselves, Kore and his entire congregation,
Numbers 16:7 and place fire upon them and place incense upon them before the Lord tomorrow, and it shall be that the man whom the Lord chooses, this one is holy; let it be sufficient for you, sons of Levi.
Numbers 16:8 And Moses said to Kore: Listen to me, sons of Levi.
Numbers 16:9 Is this a small thing for you, that the God of Israel distinguished you from the congregation of Israel and brought you to himself to minister the ministries of the tent of the Lord and to stand before the congregation to serve them?
Numbers 16:10 And he brought you and all your brothers, the sons of Levi, with you, and do you seek to serve as priests?
Numbers 16:11 Thus you and your entire congregation are gathered together against God; and who is Aaron, that you murmur against him?
Numbers 16:12 And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiron, sons of Eliab. And they said: We are not going up.
Numbers 16:13 Is this not a small thing, that you brought us up from a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness, that you rule over us as a ruler?
Numbers 16:14 Even if you had brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey and given us an allotment of field and vineyards, would you have cut out the eyes of those men? We are not going up.
Numbers 16:15 And Moses became exceedingly heavy-spirited and said to the Lord: Do not attend to their sacrifice; I have taken no desirable thing from any of them, nor have I harmed any of them.
Numbers 16:16 And Moses said to Kore: Sanctify your congregation, and be ready before the Lord, you and they and Aaron, tomorrow;
Numbers 16:17 and each of you take his fire-pan and you shall place incense upon them and shall bring before the Lord, each one, his fire-pan, two hundred fifty fire-pans, and you and Aaron, each his fire-pan.
Numbers 16:18 And each took his fire-pan, and they placed fire upon them and put incense upon it. And Moses and Aaron stood by the doors of the tent of testimony.
Numbers 16:19 And Kore gathered his entire congregation together against them by the door of the tent of testimony. And the glory of the Lord appeared to the entire congregation.
Numbers 16:20 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 16:21 Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, and I will utterly consume them at once.
Numbers 16:22 And they fell upon their face and said: God, God of the spirits and of all flesh, if one person sinned, shall the wrath of the Lord be upon the entire congregation?
Numbers 16:23 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 16:24 Speak to the congregation, saying: Withdraw all around from the congregation of Kore.
Numbers 16:25 And Moses rose and went to Dathan and Abiron, and all the elders of Israel went together with him.
Numbers 16:26 And he spoke to the congregation, saying: Separate yourselves from the tents of these hard men, and do not touch any of the things that are theirs, lest you perish together in all their sin.
Numbers 16:27 And they withdrew from the tent of Kore all around; and Dathan and Abiron came out and stood by the doors of their tents, along with their wives and their children and their equipment.
Numbers 16:28 And Moses said: By this you shall know that the Lord sent me to perform all these works, because they are not from myself:
Numbers 16:29 if these die according to the death of all people, and if according to the muster of all people there shall be a muster of them, the Lord has not sent me;
Numbers 16:30 but rather, the Lord shall show it by a spectacle, and the earth, opening its mouth, shall swallow them and their houses and their tents and all that is theirs, and they shall descend alive into Hades, and you shall know that these men provoked the Lord.
Numbers 16:31 And when he ceased speaking all these words, the earth split beneath them,
Numbers 16:32 and the earth opened and swallowed them and their houses and all the people who were with Kore and their livestock.
Numbers 16:33 And they and all that was theirs descended alive into Hades, and the earth covered them, and they perished from the midst of the congregation.
Numbers 16:34 And all Israel who were around them fled from their voice, saying: Lest the earth swallow us.
Numbers 16:35 And fire went out from the Lord and devoured the two hundred fifty men who were presenting the incense.

## Chapter 17

Numbers 17:1 And the Lord said to Moses,
Numbers 17:2 and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest: Take up the bronze fire-pans from the midst of those who were burned up, and scatter this strange fire there, because they sanctified
Numbers 17:3 the fire-pans of these sinners in their souls; and make them into hammered plates, a covering for the altar, because they were presented before the Lord and were sanctified and became a sign for the sons of Israel.
Numbers 17:4 And Eleazar son of Aaron the priest took the bronze fire-pans, as many as those who had been burned up presented, and they added them as a covering for the altar,
Numbers 17:5 a memorial for the sons of Israel, so that no foreigner who is not from the seed of Aaron may approach to place incense before the Lord, and he shall not be like Kore and his conspiracy, in the manner that the Lord spoke through the hand of Moses.
Numbers 17:6 And on the next day the sons of Israel murmured against Moses and Aaron, saying: You have killed the people of the Lord.
Numbers 17:7 And it happened, when the congregation gathered together against Moses and Aaron and rushed toward the tent of testimony, that the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
Numbers 17:8 And Moses and Aaron entered before the face of the tent of testimony,
Numbers 17:9 and the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 17:10 Move out from the midst of this congregation, and I will utterly consume them at once. And they fell upon their face.
Numbers 17:11 And Moses said to Aaron: Take the fire-pan and place fire from the altar upon it and put incense upon it and carry it away with speed into the camp and make atonement concerning them; for wrath has gone out from the face of the Lord; it has begun to break the people.
Numbers 17:12 And Aaron took it, just as Moses spoke to him, and ran into the congregation; and the breaking had already begun among the people; and he put on the incense and made atonement concerning the people,
Numbers 17:13 and he stood between the dead and the living, and the breaking abated.
Numbers 17:14 And those who died in the breaking were fourteen thousand seven hundred, apart from those who died on account of Kore.
Numbers 17:15 And Aaron returned to Moses at the door of the tent of testimony, and the breaking abated.
Numbers 17:16 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 17:17 Speak to the sons of Israel, and take from them a staff, a staff according to their paternal houses, from all their rulers according to their paternal houses, twelve staffs, and inscribe the name of each one upon his staff.
Numbers 17:18 And inscribe the name of Aaron upon the staff of Levi; for there is one staff; according to a tribe of their paternal house they shall give.
Numbers 17:19 And you shall place them in the tent of testimony opposite the testimony, where I shall be known to you there.
Numbers 17:20 And it shall be that the man whom I choose, his staff shall sprout; and I shall take away from me the murmuring of the sons of Israel that they themselves murmur against you.
Numbers 17:21 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their rulers gave him a staff, for the one ruler a staff, a staff according to each ruler according to their paternal houses, twelve staffs, and the staff of Aaron was among their staffs.
Numbers 17:22 And Moses placed the staffs before the Lord in the tent of testimony.
Numbers 17:23 And it happened on the next day that Moses and Aaron entered the tent of testimony, and behold, the staff of Aaron for the house of Levi had sprouted, and it brought out a shoot and blossomed flowers and sprouted nuts.
Numbers 17:24 And Moses brought out all the staffs from before the Lord to all the sons of Israel, and they saw, and each took his staff.
Numbers 17:25 And the Lord said to Moses: Place the staff of Aaron before the testimonies for preservation, as a sign to the sons of the disobedient, and let their murmuring cease from me, and they shall certainly not die.
Numbers 17:26 And Moses and Aaron did in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses; so they did.
Numbers 17:27 And the sons of Israel spoke to Moses, saying: Behold, we have been utterly consumed, we have perished, we have been consumed away;
Numbers 17:28 everyone who touches the tent of the Lord dies; shall we die to the end?

## Chapter 18

Numbers 18:1 And the Lord said to Aaron, saying: You and your sons and the house of your paternal family shall receive the sins of the holy things, and you and your sons shall receive the sins of your priesthood.
Numbers 18:2 And bring your brothers, the tribe of Levi, the community of your father, to yourself, and let them be added to you and minister to you; and you and your sons with you shall be before the tent of testimony.
Numbers 18:3 And they shall keep your watches and the watches of the tent, except they shall not approach the holy vessels or the altar, and both these and you shall not die.
Numbers 18:4 And they shall be added to you and shall keep the watches of the tent of testimony according to all the ministries of the tent, and the foreigner shall not approach you.
Numbers 18:5 And you shall keep the watches of the holy things and the watches of the altar, and there shall be no wrath among the sons of Israel.
Numbers 18:6 And I have taken your brothers the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel, a gift given to the Lord to minister the ministries of the tent of testimony;
Numbers 18:7 and you and your sons with you shall preserve your priesthood according to every manner of the altar and what is within the veil, and you shall minister the ministries as a gift of your priesthood; and the foreigner who approaches shall die.
Numbers 18:8 And the Lord spoke to Aaron: And I, behold, have given you the custody of the first produce; from all the things sanctified to me by the sons of Israel I have given them to you as an honorary portion, and to your sons after you, as an eternal ordinance.
Numbers 18:9 And this shall be for you from the sanctified holy things of the offerings: from all their gifts and from all their sacrifices and from every trespass of theirs and from all the sins, as many things as they render to me; from all the holy things it shall belong to you and your sons.
Numbers 18:10 In the Holy of Holies you shall eat them; every male shall eat them, you and your sons; they shall be holy things for you.
Numbers 18:11 And this shall be for you as first produce of their gifts: from all the placements of the sons of Israel I have given them to you and your sons and your daughters with you, as an eternal ordinance; every clean person in your house shall eat them.
Numbers 18:12 Every first produce of oil and every first produce of wine and grain, their first produce, as much as they give to the Lord, I have given them to you.
Numbers 18:13 All the first products, as many as are in their land, as much as they bring to the Lord, shall be yours; every clean person in your house shall eat them.
Numbers 18:14 Everything anathematized among the sons of Israel shall be yours.
Numbers 18:15 And everything opening the womb from all flesh that they present to the Lord, from human to livestock, shall be yours; except the firstborn of humans shall be redeemed with ransoms, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean livestock.
Numbers 18:16 And its redemption shall be from one month old; the valuation is five shekels according to the holy shekel [they are twenty obols].
Numbers 18:17 Except you shall not redeem firstborn calves or firstborn sheep or firstborn goats; they are holy; and you shall pour their blood toward the altar and bring up the fat as an offering for an odor of sweetness to the Lord;
Numbers 18:18 and the flesh shall be yours; just as the breast of the placement and according to the right arm, it shall be yours.
Numbers 18:19 Every removal offering from the holy things, as much as the sons of Israel remove for the Lord, I have given to you and your sons and your daughters with you, as an eternal ordinance; it is an eternal covenant of salt before the Lord for you and your seed after you.
Numbers 18:20 And the Lord spoke to Aaron: In their land you shall not inherit, and there shall be no portion for you among them, because I am your portion and your inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 18:21 And to the sons of Levi, behold, I have given every tithe in Israel as an allotment in exchange for their ministries, as many things as they themselves minister as a ministry in the tent of testimony.
Numbers 18:22 And the sons of Israel shall no longer approach the tent of testimony to receive death-bearing sin.
Numbers 18:23 And the Levite himself shall minister the ministry of the tent of testimony, and they shall receive their sins, an eternal ordinance throughout their generations; and in the midst of the sons of Israel they shall not inherit an inheritance;
Numbers 18:24 because the tithes of the sons of Israel, as many as they set apart for the Lord as a removal offering, I have given to the Levites as an allotment; therefore I have said to them: In the midst of the sons of Israel they shall not inherit an allotment.
Numbers 18:25 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
