Numbers 18:26 And you shall speak to the Levites and say to them: If you receive from the sons of Israel the tithe that I gave you from them as an allotment, then you shall remove from it a removal offering to the Lord, a tithe from the tithe.
Numbers 18:27 And your removal offerings shall be reckoned to you as grain from a threshing floor and a removal offering from a winepress.
Numbers 18:28 Thus you also shall remove from the removal offerings of the Lord, from all your tithes, as many as you receive from the sons of Israel, and you shall give from them a removal offering to the Lord, to Aaron the priest.
Numbers 18:29 From all your gifts you shall remove a removal offering to the Lord, or from all the first produce, the thing sanctified from it.
Numbers 18:30 And you shall say to them: Whenever you remove the first produce from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as produce from a threshing floor and as produce from a winepress.
Numbers 18:31 And you and your households shall eat it in every place, because this is wages for you in exchange for your ministries in the tent of testimony;
Numbers 18:32 and you shall not receive sin through it, because you remove the first produce from it; and you shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, so that you may not die.

## Chapter 19

Numbers 19:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying:
Numbers 19:2 This is the distinction of the law, as many things as the Lord instructed, saying: Speak to the sons of Israel, and let them take for you an unblemished red heifer that has no blemish in it and upon which no yoke has been laid.
Numbers 19:3 And you shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and they shall lead her outside the camp to a clean place and shall slaughter her before him.
Numbers 19:4 And Eleazar shall take from her blood and shall sprinkle some of her blood seven times opposite the face of the tent of testimony.
Numbers 19:5 And they shall burn her up before him, and her skin and her flesh and her blood together with her dung shall be burned up.
Numbers 19:6 And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and they shall throw them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
Numbers 19:7 And the priest shall wash his garments and bathe his body with water and after these things shall enter the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until evening.
Numbers 19:8 And the one burning her shall wash his garments and bathe his body and shall be unclean until evening.
Numbers 19:9 And a clean person shall gather the ash of the heifer and deposit it outside the camp in a clean place, and it shall be for the congregation of the sons of Israel for custody, water of sprinkling; it is purification.
Numbers 19:10 And the one gathering the ash of the heifer shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening. And it shall be an eternal ordinance for the sons of Israel and the proselytes attached to them.
Numbers 19:11 The one who touches the dead body of any human person shall be unclean for seven days;
Numbers 19:12 this one shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day and shall be clean; but if he is not thoroughly purified on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
Numbers 19:13 Everyone who touches the dead body of a human person when he dies and is not thoroughly purified has defiled the tent of the Lord; that soul shall be obliterated from Israel; because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled around upon him, he is unclean; his uncleanness is still in him.
Numbers 19:14 And this is the law: if a person dies in a house, everyone entering the house and as many things as are in the house shall be unclean for seven days;
Numbers 19:15 and every opened vessel, as many as have no fastening bound down upon them, are unclean.
Numbers 19:16 And everyone who touches upon the face of the open country a wounded person or a dead person or a human bone or a tomb shall be unclean for seven days.
Numbers 19:17 And they shall take for the unclean person some of the ash of the burned purification and shall pour living water upon it into a vessel;
Numbers 19:18 and a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it into the water and sprinkle it around upon the house and upon the vessels and upon the souls, as many as are there, and upon the one who touched the human bone or the wounded person or the one who died or the tomb;
Numbers 19:19 and the clean person shall sprinkle it around upon the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall be thoroughly purified on the seventh day and shall wash his garments and bathe with water and shall be unclean until evening.
Numbers 19:20 And a person who is defiled and is not thoroughly purified—that soul shall be utterly destroyed from the midst of the congregation, because he defiled the holy things of the Lord, because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled around upon him; he is unclean.
Numbers 19:21 And it shall be an eternal ordinance for you; and the one sprinkling around the water of sprinkling shall wash his garments, and the one touching the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening;
Numbers 19:22 and everything that the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.

## Chapter 20

Numbers 20:1 And the sons of Israel, the entire congregation, came into the wilderness of Sin in the first month, and the people remained in Kades, and Mariam died there and was buried there.
Numbers 20:2 And there was no water for the congregation, and they gathered together against Moses and Aaron.
Numbers 20:3 And the people reviled Moses, saying: Would that we had died in the destruction of our brothers before the Lord;
Numbers 20:4 and why did you bring the congregation of the Lord up into this wilderness, to kill us and our livestock?
Numbers 20:5 And why did you bring us up from Egypt for this, to arrive at this evil place? A place where there is no sowing, nor fig trees, nor vines, nor pomegranates, nor water to drink.
Numbers 20:6 And Moses and Aaron went from before the face of the congregation to the door of the tent of testimony and fell upon their face, and the glory of the Lord appeared to them.
Numbers 20:7 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 20:8 Take the staff and assemble the congregation, you and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before them, and it shall give its waters, and you shall bring out water for them from the rock and give drink to the congregation and their livestock.
Numbers 20:9 And Moses took the staff that was before the Lord, in the manner that the Lord instructed;
Numbers 20:10 and Moses and Aaron assembled the congregation before the rock and said to them: Listen to me, disobedient ones; shall we bring water out for you from this rock?
Numbers 20:11 And Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock twice with the staff, and much water came out, and the congregation and their livestock drank.
Numbers 20:12 And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron: Because you did not believe so as to sanctify me before the sons of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this congregation into the land that I have given them.
Numbers 20:13 This is water of contradiction, because the sons of Israel reviled before the Lord, and he was sanctified among them.
Numbers 20:14 And Moses sent messengers from Kades to the king of Edom, saying: Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the hardship that found us,
Numbers 20:15 and our fathers went down into Egypt, and we sojourned in Egypt for more days, and the Egyptians harmed us and our fathers,
Numbers 20:16 and we cried out to the Lord, and the Lord listened to our voice and, sending an angel, brought us out of Egypt; and now we are in Kades, a city at the edge of your borders;
Numbers 20:17 we shall pass through your land; we shall not pass through fields or through vineyards, nor shall we drink water from your cistern; we shall travel by the royal road; we shall not turn right or left until we have passed your borders.
Numbers 20:18 And Edom said to him: You shall not pass through me; otherwise I will go out in war to meet you.
Numbers 20:19 And the sons of Israel said to him: We shall pass along the mountain; and if I and the livestock drink from your water, I will give you a price; but the matter is nothing; we shall pass along the mountain.
Numbers 20:20 But he said: You shall not pass through me; and Edom went out to meet him with a heavy crowd and with a strong hand.
Numbers 20:21 And Edom did not wish to allow Israel to pass through his borders; and Israel turned away from him.
Numbers 20:22 And they departed from Kades; and the sons of Israel, the entire congregation, arrived at Or the mountain.
Numbers 20:23 And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron at Or the mountain, upon the borders of the land of Edom, saying:
Numbers 20:24 Let Aaron be added to his people, because you shall certainly not enter into the land that I gave to the sons of Israel, because you provoked me at the water of reviling.
Numbers 20:25 Take Aaron and Eleazar his son and bring them up to Or the mountain before the entire congregation,
Numbers 20:26 and strip Aaron of his robe and clothe Eleazar his son, and let Aaron, being added, die there.
Numbers 20:27 And Moses did in the manner that the Lord instructed, and he brought him up to Or the mountain before the entire congregation.
Numbers 20:28 And he stripped Aaron of his garments and clothed Eleazar his son with them; and Aaron died upon the summit of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
Numbers 20:29 And the entire congregation saw that Aaron had been released, and the entire house of Israel wept for Aaron for thirty days.

## Chapter 21

Numbers 21:1 And Chananis, king of Arad, who dwelt along the wilderness, heard – for Israel came by the road Atharin – and he waged war against Israel, and they took captives from them as plunder.
Numbers 21:2 And Israel vowed a vow to the Lord and said: If you deliver this people under my hand, I will anathematize him and his cities.
Numbers 21:3 And the Lord listened to the voice of Israel and delivered Chananis under his hand, and he anathematized him and his cities; and they called the name of that place Anathema.
Numbers 21:4 And setting out from Or the mountain by the road toward the Red Sea, they went around the land of Edom; and the people became fainthearted on the road.
Numbers 21:5 And the people spoke against God and against Moses, saying: Why did you bring us out of Egypt to kill us in the wilderness? Because there is no bread or water, and our soul is disgusted with the empty bread.
Numbers 21:6 And the Lord sent among the people the serpents that cause death, and they bit the people, and many people from the sons of Israel died.
Numbers 21:7 And the people came to Moses and said: We sinned because we spoke against the Lord and against you; therefore pray to the Lord, and let him take the serpent away from us. And Moses prayed to the Lord concerning the people.
Numbers 21:8 And the Lord said to Moses: Make a serpent for yourself and place it upon a sign, and it shall be that if a serpent bites a person, every person who has been bitten, seeing it, shall live.
Numbers 21:9 And Moses made a bronze serpent and stood it upon a sign, and it happened whenever a serpent bit a person and he looked upon the bronze serpent that he lived.
Numbers 21:10 And the sons of Israel departed and encamped in Oboth.
Numbers 21:11 And setting out from Oboth, they encamped in Achelgai from beyond, in the wilderness that is opposite Moab toward the rising of the sun.
Numbers 21:12 From there they departed and encamped in the ravine Zaret.
Numbers 21:13 And setting out from there, they encamped beyond Arnon in the wilderness that extends from the borders of the Amorrites; for Arnon is the boundary of Moab, between Moab and between the Amorrite.
Numbers 21:14 Therefore it is said in a book, War of the Lord: He set Zoob aflame and the torrents of Arnon,
Numbers 21:15 and he established the torrents to settle Er, and it lies adjacent to the borders of Moab.
Numbers 21:16 And from there to the well; this is the well of which the Lord said to Moses: Gather the people, and I will give them water to drink.
Numbers 21:17 Then Israel sang this song at the well: Begin for it;
Numbers 21:18 a well—the rulers dug it; kings of nations quarried it in their kingdom, when they ruled them. And from the well to Manthanain;
Numbers 21:19 and from Manthanain to Naaliel; and from Naaliel to Bamoth;
Numbers 21:20 and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the plain of Moab, from the summit of the hewn rock that looks toward the face of the wilderness.
Numbers 21:21 And Moses sent ambassadors to Seon king of the Amorrites with peaceful words, saying:
Numbers 21:22 We shall pass through your land; we shall travel by the road; we shall not turn aside into a field or into a vineyard; we shall not drink water from your well; we shall travel by the royal road until we have passed your borders.
Numbers 21:23 And Seon did not allow Israel to pass through his borders, and Seon gathered all his people and went out to array himself against Israel in the wilderness and came to Jassa and arrayed himself against Israel.
Numbers 21:24 And Israel struck him with slaughter of the sword and took mastery of his land from Arnon as far as Jabok, as far as the sons of Amman; because Jazer is the boundary of the sons of Ammon.
Numbers 21:25 And Israel took all these cities, and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorrites, in Esebon and in all those contiguous to it.
Numbers 21:26 For Esebon is a city of Seon king of the Amorrites, and this one formerly waged war against the king of Moab, and they took all his land from Aroer as far as Arnon.
Numbers 21:27 Therefore the speakers of riddles will say: Come to Esebon, so that the city of Seon may be built and prepared.
Numbers 21:28 Because fire went out from Esebon, a flame from the city of Seon, and devoured as far as Moab and swallowed the pillars of Arnon.
Numbers 21:29 Woe to you, Moab; you perished, people of Chamos. Their sons were given over to be preserved, and their daughters as captives to Seon king of the Amorrites;
Numbers 21:30 and their seed shall perish, Esebon as far as Daibon, and the women still kindled fire further against Moab.
Numbers 21:31 And Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorrites.
Numbers 21:32 And Moses sent to spy out Jazer, and they took it and its villages and drove out the Amorrite who dwelt there. –
Numbers 21:33 And turning, they went up the road to Basan; and Og king of Basan went out to meet them, and all his people, for war at Edrain.
Numbers 21:34 And the Lord said to Moses: Do not fear him, because I have delivered him and all his people and all his land into your hands, and you shall do to him just as you did to Seon king of the Amorrites, who dwelt in Esebon.
Numbers 21:35 And he struck him and his sons and all his people until no living captive of his was left; and they inherited their land.

## Chapter 22

Numbers 22:1 And the sons of Israel departed and encamped west of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
Numbers 22:2 And Balak son of Sepphor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorrite,
Numbers 22:3 and Moab feared the people exceedingly because they were many, and Moab was disgusted because of the face of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 22:4 And Moab said to the council of elders of Madian: Now this congregation will lick up all those around us, as the calf licks up the green things from the field. And Balak son of Sepphor was king of Moab at that time.
Numbers 22:5 And he sent ambassadors to Balaam son of Beor at Phathoura, which is upon the river of the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying: Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and behold, it has covered the face of the land, and this one is settled next to me;
Numbers 22:6 and now come, curse this people for me, because this one is stronger than we are, if we may be able to strike some of them, and I will drive them out of the land; because I know that those whom you bless have been blessed, and those whom you curse have been cursed.
Numbers 22:7 And the council of elders of Moab and the council of elders of Madian went, with the divinations in their hands, and came to Balaam and told him the words of Balak.
Numbers 22:8 And he said to them: Lodge here for the night, and I will answer you with the matters that the Lord may speak to me. And the rulers of Moab remained beside Balaam.
Numbers 22:9 And God came to Balaam and said to him: Who are these people beside you?
Numbers 22:10 And Balaam said to God: Balak son of Sepphor, king of Moab, sent them to me, saying:
Numbers 22:11 Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and behold, it has covered the face of the land, and this one is settled next to me; and now come, curse him for me, if perhaps I may be able to strike him and drive him out of the land.
Numbers 22:12 And God said to Balaam: You shall not go with them, nor shall you curse the people, for it is blessed.
Numbers 22:13 And Balaam rose in the morning and said to the rulers of Balak: Run back to your lord; God does not permit me to go with you.
Numbers 22:14 And the rulers of Moab rose and came to Balak and said: Balaam does not wish to go with us.
Numbers 22:15 And Balak added still more rulers to send, more numerous and more honorable than these.
Numbers 22:16 And they came to Balaam and said to him: Thus says Balak, the one of Sepphor: I entreat you, do not hesitate to come to me;
Numbers 22:17 for with honor I will honor you, and whatever you say, I will do for you; and come, curse this people down for me.
Numbers 22:18 And Balaam answered and said to the rulers of Balak: If Balak gives me his house full of silver and gold, I shall not be able to transgress the word of the Lord God to do it small or great in my mind;
Numbers 22:19 and now you also remain here this night, and I shall know what the Lord will add to speak to me.
Numbers 22:20 And God came to Balaam by night and said to him: If these men are present to call you, rise and follow them; but the word that I speak to you, this you shall do.
Numbers 22:21 And Balaam rose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the rulers of Moab. –
Numbers 22:22 And God was enraged with anger because he went, and the angel of God rose to oppose him; and he was mounted upon his donkey, and his two servants were with him.
Numbers 22:23 And the donkey saw the angel of God standing against him on the road, with the broadsword drawn in his hand, and the donkey turned aside from the road and went into the plain; and he struck the donkey with the staff to direct her on the road.
Numbers 22:24 And the angel of God stood in the furrows of the vineyards, a fence on this side and a fence on that side;
Numbers 22:25 and the donkey saw the angel of God and pressed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot; and he added still more to whip her.
Numbers 22:26 And the angel of God moved on and went and stood in a narrow place in which there was no turning to the right or the left.
Numbers 22:27 And the donkey saw the angel of God and sat down beneath Balaam; and Balaam was angered and struck the donkey with the staff.
Numbers 22:28 And God opened the mouth of the donkey, and she says to Balaam: What have I done to you, that you have struck me this third time?
Numbers 22:29 And Balaam said to the donkey: Because you have mocked me; and if I had a sword in my hand, I would already have pierced you.
Numbers 22:30 And the donkey says to Balaam: Am I not your donkey, upon whom you have ridden from your youth until this day? Have I, with contempt, despised you and done thus to you? And he said: No.
Numbers 22:31 And God uncovered the eyes of Balaam, and he sees the angel of the Lord standing against him on the road, with the sword drawn in his hand, and bending down he worshiped upon his face.
Numbers 22:32 And the angel of God said to him: Why did you strike your donkey this third time? And behold, I came out in opposition to you, because your road is not graceful before me.
Numbers 22:33 And the donkey saw me and turned aside from me this third time; and if she had not turned aside, now therefore I would have killed you but preserved her.
Numbers 22:34 And Balaam said to the angel of the Lord: I have sinned, for I did not know that you stood against me on the road for a meeting; and now, if it is not pleasing to you, I will turn back.
Numbers 22:35 And the angel of God said to Balaam: Go together with the men; except the word that I say to you, this you shall guard to speak. And Balaam went with the rulers of Balak.
Numbers 22:36 And Balak heard that Balaam had come and went out to meet him at a city of Moab that is upon the borders of Arnon, which is at the edge of the borders.
Numbers 22:37 And Balak said to Balaam: Did I not send to you to call you? Why did you not come to me? Really, shall I not be able to honor you?
Numbers 22:38 And Balaam said to Balak: Behold, I have come to you; now shall I be able to speak anything? The word that God puts into my mouth, this I shall speak.
Numbers 22:39 And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to cities of farmsteads.
Numbers 22:40 And Balak sacrificed sheep and calves and sent some to Balaam and to the rulers who were with him.
Numbers 22:41 And it happened in the morning that Balak took Balaam and brought him up upon the pillar of Baal and showed him from there a certain part of the people.

## Chapter 23

Numbers 23:1 And Balaam said to Balak: Build seven altars for me here and prepare seven calves and seven rams for me here.
Numbers 23:2 And Balak did in the manner that Balaam told him, and he brought up a calf and a ram upon the altar.
Numbers 23:3 And Balaam said to Balak: Stand beside your sacrifice, and I will go, in case God appears to me in a meeting, and whatever word he shows me, I will report to you. And Balak stood beside his sacrifice, and Balaam went to inquire of God and went straight.
Numbers 23:4 And God appeared to Balaam, and Balaam said to him: I prepared the seven altars and brought up a calf and a ram upon the altar.
Numbers 23:5 And God put a word into the mouth of Balaam and said: Turn back to Balak; thus you shall speak.
Numbers 23:6 And he turned back to him, and this one was standing over his whole burnt offerings, and all the rulers of Moab with him.
Numbers 23:7 And the spirit of God came upon him, and taking up his parable, he said: From Mesopotamia Balak summoned me, king of Moab from the mountains from the east, saying: Come, call down a curse upon Jacob for me, and come, curse Israel down for me.
Numbers 23:8 How shall I call down a curse upon one whom the Lord does not curse, or how shall I curse one whom God does not curse?
Numbers 23:9 Because from the summit of mountains I shall see him, and from hills I shall consider him. Behold, a people shall dwell alone and shall not be reckoned among nations.
Numbers 23:10 Who accurately counted the seed of Jacob, and who shall number the communities of Israel? May my soul die among the souls of the righteous, and may my seed become like the seed of these.
Numbers 23:11 And Balak said to Balaam: What have you done to me? I called you for a curse upon my enemies, and behold, you have blessed a blessing.
Numbers 23:12 And Balaam said to Balak: Shall I not guard to speak whatever God puts into my mouth?
Numbers 23:13 And Balak said to him: Come still with me to another place, from which you shall not see him from there, except you shall see a certain part of him, but you shall certainly not see them all; and curse him for me from there.
Numbers 23:14 And he took him to a lookout point of a field upon the summit of the hewn rock, and he built seven altars there and brought up a calf and a ram upon the altar.
Numbers 23:15 And Balaam said to Balak: Stand beside your sacrifice, but I will go to inquire of God.
Numbers 23:16 And God met Balaam and put a word into his mouth and said: Turn back to Balak, and thus you shall speak.
Numbers 23:17 And he turned back to him, and this one was standing over his whole burnt offering, and all the rulers of Moab with him. And Balak said to him: What did the Lord speak?
Numbers 23:18 And taking up his parable, he said: Rise, Balak, and hear; give ear, witness, son of Sepphor.
Numbers 23:19 God is not like a human, to be deceived, nor like a son of man, to be threatened. Having said, will he not do? Will he speak and not remain by it?
Numbers 23:20 Behold, I have received to bless; I will bless and shall certainly not turn back.
Numbers 23:21 There shall be no hardship in Jacob, nor shall pain be seen in Israel; the Lord his God is with him, the glorious things of rulers are in him.
Numbers 23:22 God is the one who brought them out of Egypt; like the glory of a unicorn for him.
Numbers 23:23 For there is no augury in Jacob nor divination in Israel; at the appointed time it shall be said to Jacob and to Israel what God shall accomplish.
Numbers 23:24 Behold, a people shall rise like a lion cub and shall exult like a lion; it shall not sleep until it eats prey, and it shall drink the blood of the wounded.
Numbers 23:25 And Balak said to Balaam: Neither with curses shall you curse him for me, nor, blessing, shall you bless him.
Numbers 23:26 And Balaam answered and said to Balak: Did I not speak to you, saying: The word that God speaks, this I shall do?
Numbers 23:27 And Balak said to Balaam: Come, let me take you to another place, in case it pleases God also that you curse him for me from there.
Numbers 23:28 And Balak took Balaam to the summit of Phogor that extends into the wilderness.
Numbers 23:29 And Balaam said to Balak: Build seven altars for me here and prepare seven calves and seven rams for me here.
Numbers 23:30 And Balak did just as Balaam told him, and brought up a calf and a ram upon the altar.

## Chapter 24

Numbers 24:1 And Balaam saw that it was good before the Lord to bless Israel, and he did not go according to his custom to meet with the omens, and he turned his face toward the wilderness.
Numbers 24:2 And Balaam lifted up his eyes and beheld Israel encamped according to tribes. And the spirit of God came to be in him,
Numbers 24:3 and taking up his parable, he said: Balaam son of Beor says, the man who truly sees says,
Numbers 24:4 the one hearing oracles of God says, who saw a vision of God in sleep, his eyes unveiled:
Numbers 24:5 How beautiful are your houses, Jacob, your tents, Israel;
Numbers 24:6 like valleys giving shade and like gardens along rivers and like tents that the Lord pitched, like cedars beside waters.
Numbers 24:7 A man shall come out from his seed and shall rule many nations, and his kingdom shall be exalted beyond Gog, and his kingdom shall increase.
Numbers 24:8 God guided him out of Egypt; like the glory of a unicorn for him. He shall eat nations of his enemies and shall draw out the marrow of their stout parts, and with his missiles he shall shoot down an enemy.
Numbers 24:9 Reclining, he rested like a lion and like a lion cub; who shall raise him? Those who bless you have been blessed, and those who curse you have been cursed.
Numbers 24:10 And Balak was angered against Balaam and clapped his hands together, and Balak said to Balaam: I called you to curse my enemy, and behold, blessing, you have blessed this third time;
Numbers 24:11 now therefore flee to your place. I said, I will honor you, and now the Lord has deprived you of glory.
Numbers 24:12 And Balaam said to Balak: Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying:
Numbers 24:13 If Balak gives me his house full of silver and gold, I shall not be able to transgress the word of the Lord to do it evil or good from myself; whatever God says, these things I shall say?
Numbers 24:14 And now, behold, I am running back to my place; come, I will counsel you what this people shall do to your people at the end of the days.
Numbers 24:15 And taking up his parable, he said: Balaam son of Beor says, the man who truly sees says,
Numbers 24:16 the one hearing oracles of God, knowing knowledge from the Most High and seeing a vision of God in sleep, his eyes unveiled:
Numbers 24:17 I shall show him, but not now; I call him blessed, but he does not draw near; a star shall rise from Jacob, and a man shall rise from Israel and shall break the rulers of Moab and shall plunder all the sons of Seth.
Numbers 24:18 And Edom shall be an inheritance, and Esau his enemy shall be an inheritance; and Israel acted with strength.
Numbers 24:19 And one shall be raised from Jacob and shall destroy one being saved from a city.
Numbers 24:20 And seeing Amalek and taking up his parable, he said: Amalek is the beginning of nations, and their seed shall perish.
Numbers 24:21 And seeing the Kenite and taking up his parable, he said: Your dwelling is strong; and if you place your nest in a rock,
Numbers 24:22 and if a brood of cunning comes to be for Beor, Assyrians shall take you captive.
Numbers 24:23 And seeing Og and taking up his parable, he said: Oh, oh, who shall live whenever God establishes these things?
Numbers 24:24 And one shall come out from the hand of the Kitians, and they shall harm Assour and shall harm the Hebrews, and they themselves shall perish with one accord.
Numbers 24:25 And Balaam rose and went away, returning to his place, and Balak went away to himself.

## Chapter 25

Numbers 25:1 And Israel lodged in Sattin; and the people were profaned so as to commit fornication with the daughters of Moab.
Numbers 25:2 And they called them to the sacrifices of their idols, and the people ate from their sacrifices and worshiped their idols.
Numbers 25:3 And Israel was perfected to Beelphegor; and the Lord was enraged with wrath toward Israel.
Numbers 25:4 And the Lord said to Moses: Take all the leaders of the people and make an example of them for the Lord before the sun, and the wrath of the Lord's anger shall turn away from Israel.
Numbers 25:5 And Moses said to the tribes of Israel: Each of you kill his own kinsman who has been perfected to Beelphegor.
Numbers 25:6 And behold, a man from the sons of Israel came and brought his brother to the Madianite woman before Moses and before the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping by the door of the tent of testimony.
Numbers 25:7 And Phinees son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest saw and rose up from the midst of the congregation and took a spear in his hand,
Numbers 25:8 and he entered behind the Israelite man into the furnace and pierced both of them, the Israelite man and the woman through her womb; and the plague ceased from the sons of Israel.
Numbers 25:9 And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
Numbers 25:10 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 25:11 Phinees son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest stopped my wrath from the sons of Israel by being zealous with my zeal among them, and I did not utterly consume the sons of Israel in my jealousy.
Numbers 25:12 Thus say: Behold, I am giving him a covenant of peace,
Numbers 25:13 and it shall be for him and his seed after him an eternal covenant of priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement concerning the sons of Israel.
Numbers 25:14 And the name of the stricken Israelite man, who was struck with the Madianite woman, was Zambri son of Salo, ruler of a paternal house of the Symeonites;
Numbers 25:15 and the name of the stricken Madianite woman was Chasbi daughter of Sour, ruler of the nation Ommoth; he is of a paternal house of the Madianites.
Numbers 25:16 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: Speak to the sons of Israel, saying:
Numbers 25:17 Be hostile to the Madianites and strike them,
Numbers 25:18 because they themselves act with hostility toward you in deceit, as many things as they deceive you through Phogor and through Chasbi daughter of a ruler of Madian, their sister, who was struck on the day of the plague through Phogor.

## Chapter 26

Numbers 26:1 And it happened after the plague that the Lord spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the priest, saying:
Numbers 26:2 Take the head-count of the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and above, according to the houses of their paternal families, everyone who goes out to be arrayed for battle in Israel.
Numbers 26:3 And Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke in Araboth Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying:
Numbers 26:4 From twenty years old and above, in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses. And the sons of Israel who came out of Egypt:
Numbers 26:5 Reuben, the firstborn of Israel. And the sons of Reuben: Enoch, and the community of Enoch; for Phallou, the community of Phalloui;
Numbers 26:6 for Asron, the community of Asroni; for Charmi, the community of Charmi.
Numbers 26:7 These are the communities of Reuben; and their muster was forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty. –
Numbers 26:8 And the sons of Phallou: Eliab.
Numbers 26:9 And the sons of Eliab: Namouel and Dathan and Abiron. These were those called from the congregation; these are the ones who rose together against Moses and Aaron in the congregation of Kore, in the rising together against the Lord,
Numbers 26:10 and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Kore in the death of his congregation, when the fire consumed the two hundred fifty, and they became a sign;
Numbers 26:11 but the sons of Kore did not die.
Numbers 26:12 And the sons of Symeon, the community of the sons of Symeon: for Namouel, the community of Namoueli; for Jamin, the community of Jamini; for Jachin, the community of Jachini;
Numbers 26:13 for Zara, the community of Zarai; for Saul, the community of Sauli.
Numbers 26:14 These are the communities of Symeon from their muster, twenty-two thousand two hundred.
Numbers 26:15 And the sons of Judas: Er and Aunan; and Er and Aunan died in the land of Chanaan.
Numbers 26:16 And the sons of Judas according to their communities were: for Selon, the community of Seloni; for Phares, the community of Phares; for Zara, the community of Zarai.
Numbers 26:17 And the sons of Phares were: for Asron, the community of Asroni; for Jamoun, the community of Jamouni.
Numbers 26:18 These are the communities for Judas according to their muster, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
Numbers 26:19 And the sons of Issachar according to their communities: for Thola, the community of Tholai; for Phoua, the community of Phouai;
Numbers 26:20 for Jasoub, the community of Jasoubi; for Samaran, the community of Samarani.
Numbers 26:21 These are the communities of Issachar from their muster, sixty-four thousand three hundred.
Numbers 26:22 The sons of Zaboulon according to their communities: for Sared, the community of Saredi; for Allon, the community of Alloni; for Allel, the community of Alleli.
Numbers 26:23 These are the communities of Zaboulon from their muster, sixty thousand five hundred.
Numbers 26:24 The sons of Gad according to their communities: for Saphon, the community of Saphoni; for Angi, the community of Angi; for Souni, the community of Souni;
Numbers 26:25 for Azeni, the community of Azeni; for Addi, the community of Addi;
Numbers 26:26 for Aroadi, the community of Aroadi; for Ariel, the community of Arieli.
Numbers 26:27 These are the communities of the sons of Gad from their muster, forty thousand five hundred.
Numbers 26:28 The sons of Aser according to their communities: for Jamin, the community of Jamini; for Jesou, the community of Jesoui; for Baria, the community of Bariai;
Numbers 26:29 for Chober, the community of Choberi; for Melchiel, the community of Melchieli.
Numbers 26:30 And the name of the daughter of Aser was Sara.
Numbers 26:31 These are the communities of Aser from their muster, fifty-three thousand four hundred.
Numbers 26:32 The sons of Joseph according to their communities: Manasse and Ephraim. –
Numbers 26:33 The sons of Manasse: for Machir, the community of Machiri; and Machir begot Galaad; for Galaad, the community of Galaadi.
Numbers 26:34 And these are the sons of Galaad: for Achiezer, the community of Achiezeri; for Cheleg, the community of Chelegi;
Numbers 26:35 for Esriel, the community of Esrieli; for Sychem, the community of Sychemi;
Numbers 26:36 for Symaer, the community of Symaeri; and for Opher, the community of Opheri.
Numbers 26:37 And for Salpaad son of Opher there were no sons, but only daughters, and these are the names of the daughters of Salpaad: Mala and Noua and Egla and Melcha and Thersa.
Numbers 26:38 These are the communities of Manasse from their muster, fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
Numbers 26:39 And these are the sons of Ephraim: for Soutala, the community of Soutalai; for Tanach, the community of Tanachi.
Numbers 26:40 These are the sons of Soutala: for Eden, the community of Edeni.
Numbers 26:41 These are the communities of Ephraim from their muster, thirty-two thousand five hundred. – These are the communities of the sons of Joseph according to their communities.
Numbers 26:42 The sons of Benjamin according to their communities: for Bale, the community of Balei; for Asyber, the community of Asyberi; for Jachiran, the community of Jachirani;
Numbers 26:43 for Sophan, the community of Sophani.
Numbers 26:44 And the sons of Bale were Adar and Noeman: for Adar, the community of Adari; for Noeman, the community of Noemani.
Numbers 26:45 These are the sons of Benjamin according to their communities, from their muster, forty-five thousand six hundred.
Numbers 26:46 And the sons of Dan according to their communities: for Sami, the community of Sami. These are the communities of Dan according to their communities.
Numbers 26:47 All the communities of Sami, according to their muster, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
Numbers 26:48 The sons of Nephthali according to their communities: for Asiel, the community of Asieli; for Gauni, the community of Gauni;
Numbers 26:49 for Jeser, the community of Jeseri; for Sellem, the community of Sellemi.
Numbers 26:50 These are the communities of Nephthali from their muster, forty-five thousand four hundred.
Numbers 26:51 This is the muster of the sons of Israel: six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
Numbers 26:52 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 26:53 To these the land shall be apportioned to inherit, from the number of names;
Numbers 26:54 for the greater number you shall increase the inheritance, and for the lesser number you shall decrease their inheritance; to each one, according as they were mustered, their inheritance shall be given.
Numbers 26:55 Through lots the land shall be apportioned; by the names according to the tribes of their paternal families they shall inherit;
Numbers 26:56 from the lot you shall apportion their inheritance between many and few.
Numbers 26:57 And the sons of Levi according to their communities: for Gedson, the community of Gedsoni; for Kaath, the community of Kaathi; for Merari, the community of Merari.
Numbers 26:58 These are the communities of the sons of Levi: the community of Lobeni, the community of Chebroni, the community of Kore, and the community of Mousi. And Kaath begot Amram.
Numbers 26:59 And the name of his wife was Jochabed, a daughter of Levi, who bore these to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Mariam their sister.
Numbers 26:60 And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abioud and Eleazar and Ithamar.
Numbers 26:61 And Nadab and Abioud died when they themselves offered strange fire before the Lord in the wilderness of Sina.
Numbers 26:62 And from their muster they were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above; for they were not mustered together in the midst of the sons of Israel, because no allotment is given to them in the midst of the sons of Israel.
Numbers 26:63 And this is the muster of Moses and Eleazar the priest, who mustered the sons of Israel in Araboth Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
Numbers 26:64 And among these there was not a man of those mustered by Moses and Aaron, whom they mustered, the sons of Israel, in the wilderness of Sina;
Numbers 26:65 because the Lord said to them: By death they shall die in the wilderness. And not even one of them was left except Chaleb son of Jephonne and Jesus, the one of Nave.

## Chapter 27

Numbers 27:1 And the daughters of Salpaad son of Opher son of Galaad son of Machir, of the community of Manasse, of the sons of Joseph, approached [and these are their names: Mala and Noua and Egla and Melcha and Thersa],
Numbers 27:2 and standing before Moses and before Eleazar the priest and before the rulers and before the entire congregation at the door of the tabernacle of testimony, they say:
Numbers 27:3 Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the midst of the congregation that rose together against the Lord in the congregation of Kore, because he died through his own sin, and there were no sons for him.
Numbers 27:4 Let the name of our father not be wiped out from the midst of his community, because there is no son for him. Give us a possession in the midst of our father’s brothers.
Numbers 27:5 And Moses brought their judgment before the Lord.
Numbers 27:6 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 27:7 The daughters of Salpaad have spoken correctly. As a gift you shall give them a possession of inheritance in the midst of their father’s brothers, and you shall place the allotment of their father upon them.
Numbers 27:8 And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying: If a person dies and there is no son for him, you shall place his inheritance upon his daughter;
Numbers 27:9 but if there is no daughter for him, you shall give the inheritance to his brother;
Numbers 27:10 but if there are no brothers for him, you shall give the inheritance to the brother of his father;
Numbers 27:11 but if there are no brothers of his father, you shall give the inheritance to the member of his household who is nearest to him from his tribe, and he shall inherit his things. And this shall be an ordinance of judgment for the sons of Israel, in the manner that the Lord instructed Moses.
Numbers 27:12 And the Lord said to Moses: Go up into the mountain that is across [this is Mount Nabau], and see the land of Chanaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel as a possession;
Numbers 27:13 and you shall see it and shall be added to your people, you also, in the manner that Aaron your brother was added on Or the mountain,
Numbers 27:14 because you transgressed my word in the wilderness of Sin, when the congregation opposed, to sanctify me; you did not sanctify me at the water before them [this is the water of contention of Cades in the wilderness of Sin].
Numbers 27:15 And Moses said to the Lord:
Numbers 27:16 Let the Lord, the God of the spirits and of all flesh, muster a man over this congregation,
Numbers 27:17 who shall go out before their face and who shall enter before their face and who shall lead them out and who shall lead them in, and the congregation of the Lord shall not be like sheep for whom there is no shepherd.
Numbers 27:18 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying: Take to yourself Jesus son of Nave, a man who has spirit in himself, and you shall place your hands upon him;
Numbers 27:19 and you shall stand him before Eleazar the priest and shall command him before the entire congregation and shall command concerning him before them,
Numbers 27:20 and you shall give some of your glory upon him, so that the sons of Israel may listen to him.
Numbers 27:21 And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, and they shall inquire of him concerning the judgment of the Manifestations before the Lord; at his mouth they shall go out, and at his mouth they shall enter, he and the sons of Israel with one accord and the entire congregation.
Numbers 27:22 And Moses did in the manner that the Lord commanded him, and taking Jesus, he stood him before Eleazar the priest and before the entire congregation,
Numbers 27:23 and he placed his hands upon him and appointed him, just as the Lord instructed Moses.

## Chapter 28

Numbers 28:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 28:2 Command the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, saying: My gifts, my given things, my offerings for an odor of sweetness, you shall carefully keep to offer to me at my festivals.
Numbers 28:3 And you shall say to them: These are the offerings, as many as you shall bring to the Lord: two unblemished year-old lambs each day as a continual whole burnt offering;
Numbers 28:4 you shall make the one lamb in the morning, and you shall make the second lamb toward evening;
Numbers 28:5 and you shall make a tenth of an oiphi of fine flour as a sacrifice, worked with oil in a fourth of a hin.
Numbers 28:6 It is a continual whole burnt offering, which was made on Mount Sina for an odor of sweetness to the Lord;
Numbers 28:7 and its libation shall be a fourth of a hin for the one lamb; in the holy place you shall pour a libation of sikera to the Lord.
Numbers 28:8 And you shall make the second lamb toward evening; according to its sacrifice and according to its libation you shall make it, for an odor of sweetness to the Lord.
Numbers 28:9 And on the day of the Sabbaths you shall bring two unblemished year-old lambs and two-tenths of fine flour worked with oil as a sacrifice, and a libation;
Numbers 28:10 a whole burnt offering of Sabbaths on the Sabbaths, upon the continual whole burnt offering and its libation.
Numbers 28:11 And at the new moons you shall bring whole burnt offerings to the Lord: two calves from cattle and one ram, seven unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 28:12 three-tenths of fine flour worked with oil for the one calf, and two-tenths of fine flour worked with oil for the one ram;
Numbers 28:13 a tenth of fine flour worked with oil for the one lamb, a sacrifice, an odor of sweetness, an offering to the Lord.
Numbers 28:14 Their libation shall be half of a hin for the one calf, and a third of a hin for the one ram, and a fourth of a hin of wine for the one lamb. This is a whole burnt offering, month from month, for the months of the year.
Numbers 28:15 And one male kid from goats concerning sin to the Lord; upon the continual whole burnt offering it shall be made, and its libation.
Numbers 28:16 And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Pascha to the Lord.
Numbers 28:17 And on the fifteenth day of this month is a festival; for seven days you shall eat unleavened things.
Numbers 28:18 And the first day shall be designated holy for you; you shall do no work of service.
Numbers 28:19 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings, offerings to the Lord: two calves from cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished for you.
Numbers 28:20 And their sacrifice shall be fine flour worked with oil, three-tenths for the one calf and two-tenths for the one ram;
Numbers 28:21 a tenth, a tenth, you shall make for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
Numbers 28:22 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, to make atonement concerning you;
Numbers 28:23 apart from the morning continual whole burnt offering, which is a continual whole burnt offering.
Numbers 28:24 These things, according to these things, you shall make each day for the seven days, a gift, an offering for an odor of sweetness to the Lord; upon the continual whole burnt offering you shall make its libation.
Numbers 28:25 And the seventh day shall be a holy convocation for you; you shall do no work of service on it.
Numbers 28:26 And on the day of the new things of the weeks, when you present a new sacrifice to the Lord, it shall be designated holy for you; you shall do no work of service.
Numbers 28:27 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings for an odor of sweetness to the Lord: two calves from cattle, one ram, seven unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 28:28 their sacrifice shall be fine flour worked with oil, three-tenths for the one calf and two-tenths for the one ram;
Numbers 28:29 a tenth, a tenth, for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
Numbers 28:30 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, to make atonement concerning you;
Numbers 28:31 apart from the continual whole burnt offering; and you shall make their sacrifice for me – they shall be unblemished for you – and their libations.

## Chapter 29

Numbers 29:1 And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, it shall be designated holy for you; you shall do no work of service. It shall be a day of signaling for you.
Numbers 29:2 And you shall make whole burnt offerings for an odor of sweetness to the Lord: one calf from cattle, one ram, seven unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:3 their sacrifice shall be fine flour worked with oil, three-tenths for the one calf and two-tenths for the one ram;
Numbers 29:4 a tenth, a tenth, for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
Numbers 29:5 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, to make atonement concerning you;
Numbers 29:6 apart from the whole burnt offerings of the new moon, and their sacrifices and their libations, and the continual whole burnt offering and their sacrifices and their libations, according to their comparison, for an odor of sweetness to the Lord.
Numbers 29:7 And on the tenth of this month it shall be designated holy for you, and you shall afflict your souls and shall do no work.
Numbers 29:8 And you shall offer whole burnt offerings for an odor of sweetness, offerings to the Lord: one calf from cattle, one ram, seven year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished for you;
Numbers 29:9 their sacrifice shall be fine flour worked with oil, three-tenths for the one calf and two-tenths for the one ram;
Numbers 29:10 a tenth, a tenth, for the one lamb, for the seven lambs;
Numbers 29:11 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, to make atonement concerning you; apart from the thing concerning the sin of atonement and the continual whole burnt offering, its sacrifice and its libation according to the comparison, for an odor of sweetness, an offering to the Lord.
Numbers 29:12 And on the fifteenth day of this seventh month it shall be designated holy for you; you shall do no work of service, and you shall celebrate it as a festival to the Lord for seven days.
Numbers 29:13 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings, offerings for an odor of sweetness to the Lord: on the first day, thirteen calves from cattle, two rams, fourteen year-old lambs; they shall be unblemished;
Numbers 29:14 their sacrifices shall be fine flour worked with oil, three-tenths for the one calf, for the thirteen calves, and two-tenths for the one ram, for the two rams;
Numbers 29:15 a tenth, a tenth, for the one lamb, for the fourteen lambs;
Numbers 29:16 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:17 And on the second day: twelve calves, two rams, fourteen unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:18 their sacrifice and their libation for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:19 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:20 On the third day: eleven calves, two rams, fourteen unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:21 their sacrifice and their libation for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:22 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:23 On the fourth day: ten calves, two rams, fourteen unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:24 their sacrifices and their libations for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:25 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:26 On the fifth day: nine calves, two rams, fourteen unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:27 their sacrifices and their libations for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:28 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:29 On the sixth day: eight calves, two rams, fourteen unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:30 their sacrifices and their libations for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:31 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:32 On the seventh day: seven calves, two rams, fourteen unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:33 their sacrifices and their libations for the calves and for the rams and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:34 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations. –
Numbers 29:35 And on the eighth day there shall be a closing for you; you shall do no work of service on it.
Numbers 29:36 And you shall bring whole burnt offerings for an odor of sweetness, offerings to the Lord: one calf, one ram, seven unblemished year-old lambs;
Numbers 29:37 their sacrifices and their libations for the calf and for the ram and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their comparison;
Numbers 29:38 and one male kid from goats concerning sin, apart from the continual whole burnt offering; their sacrifices and their libations.
Numbers 29:39 These things you shall make to the Lord at your festivals, apart from your vows and your voluntary offerings and your whole burnt offerings and your sacrifices and your libations and your salvations.

## Chapter 30

Numbers 30:1 And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all the things that the Lord commanded Moses.
Numbers 30:2 And Moses spoke to the rulers of the tribes of Israel, saying: This is the word that the Lord instructed:
Numbers 30:3 A person, a person, who vows a vow to the Lord or swears an oath or determines a determination concerning his soul shall not profane his word; everything that comes out of his mouth he shall do.
Numbers 30:4 But if a woman vows a vow to the Lord or determines a determination in the house of her father in her youth,
Numbers 30:5 and her father hears her vows and her determinations that she determined against her soul, and her father remains silent toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the determinations that she determined against her soul shall remain for her.
Numbers 30:6 But if her father refuses with a refusal on whatever day he hears all her vows and the determinations that she determined against her soul, they shall not stand; and the Lord shall purify her, because her father refused. –
Numbers 30:7 But if she indeed becomes a man’s wife, and her vows are upon her according to the distinction of her lips, the determinations that she determined against her soul,
Numbers 30:8 and her husband hears and remains silent toward her on whatever day he hears, then thus all her vows shall stand, and her determinations that she determined against her soul shall stand.
Numbers 30:9 But if her husband refuses with a refusal on whatever day he hears, all her vows and her determinations that she determined against her soul shall not remain, because her husband refused them away from her; and the Lord shall purify her.
Numbers 30:10 And the vow of a widow and of one cast out, as many things as she vows against her soul, shall remain for her. –
Numbers 30:11 But if in the house of her husband her vow or the determination against her soul is with an oath,
Numbers 30:12 and her husband hears and remains silent toward her and does not refuse her, then all her vows shall stand, and all her determinations that she determined against her soul shall stand against her.
Numbers 30:13 But if her husband, removing, removes them on whatever day he hears, then everything that comes out from her lips according to her vows and according to the determinations against her soul shall not remain for her; her husband removed it, and the Lord shall purify her.
Numbers 30:14 Every vow and every oath of a bond to afflict a soul, her husband shall cause to stand for her, and her husband shall remove.
Numbers 30:15 But if, being silent, he remains silent toward her day from day, then he shall cause all her vows to stand for her and shall cause the determinations upon her to stand for her, because he was silent toward her on the day that he heard.
Numbers 30:16 But if, removing, he removes them from her after the day on which he heard, then he shall receive his sin. –
Numbers 30:17 These are the ordinances, as many as the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife and between a father and a daughter in youth in a father’s house.

## Chapter 31

Numbers 31:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 31:2 Avenge the vengeance of the sons of Israel from the Madianites, and afterward you shall be added to your people.
Numbers 31:3 And Moses spoke to the people, saying: Arm men from among you to be arrayed before the Lord against Madian, to repay vengeance from the Lord to Madian.
Numbers 31:4 A thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, from all the tribes of Israel you shall send to be arrayed.
Numbers 31:5 And from the thousands of Israel they numbered out a thousand from a tribe, twelve thousand armed for battle array.
Numbers 31:6 And Moses sent them, a thousand from a tribe, a thousand from a tribe, with their force, and Phinees son of Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; and the holy vessels and the trumpets of the signals were in their hands.
Numbers 31:7 And they arrayed themselves against Madian, just as the Lord commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
Numbers 31:8 And they killed the kings of Madian together with their wounded: Evin and Sour and Rokom and Our and Robok, five kings of Madian; and Balaam son of Beor they killed by broadsword together with their wounded.
Numbers 31:9 And they plundered the women of Madian and their equipment, and they plundered their livestock and all their acquired possessions and their force.
Numbers 31:10 And all their cities, the ones in their houses, and their farmsteads they burned with fire.
Numbers 31:11 And they took all the plunder and all their spoils, from human to livestock,
Numbers 31:12 and they brought the captivity and the spoils and the plunder to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to all the sons of Israel, to the camp at Araboth Moab, which is on the Jordan opposite Jericho.
Numbers 31:13 And Moses and Eleazar the priest and all the rulers of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
Numbers 31:14 And Moses became angry with the overseers of the force, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds who were coming from the battle array of the war,
Numbers 31:15 and Moses said to them: Why did you keep every female alive?
Numbers 31:16 For these were the ones who, according to the word of Balaam, caused the sons of Israel to revolt and overlook the word of the Lord because of Phogor, and the blow came among the congregation of the Lord.
Numbers 31:17 And now kill every male in the entire company, and kill every woman who has known a male’s bed.
Numbers 31:18 But keep alive the entire company of the women who have not known a male’s bed.
Numbers 31:19 And you, camp outside the camp for seven days. Everyone who killed and who touches the wounded one shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captivity.
Numbers 31:20 And every covering and every leather vessel and every work made from goat and every wooden vessel you shall purify.
Numbers 31:21 And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the force who were coming from the battle array of the war: This is the ordinance of the law that the Lord prescribed to Moses:
Numbers 31:22 except for the gold and the silver and bronze and iron and lead and tin,
Numbers 31:23 every thing that shall pass through fire shall also be cleansed; but rather, it shall be purified with the water of purification. And all things that do not pass through fire shall pass through water.
Numbers 31:24 And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and shall be cleansed, and after these things you shall enter into the camp.
Numbers 31:25 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 31:26 Take the head-count of the spoils of the captivity, from human to livestock, you and Eleazar the priest and the rulers of the paternal families of the congregation,
Numbers 31:27 and you shall divide the spoils between the warriors who go out into the battle array and between the entire congregation.
Numbers 31:28 And you shall remove a tribute for the Lord from the warrior men who have gone out into the battle array: one soul from five hundred, from the humans and from the livestock and from the cattle and from the sheep and from the goats.
Numbers 31:29 And from their half you shall take it, and you shall give the first produce of the Lord to Eleazar the priest.
Numbers 31:30 And from the half belonging to the sons of Israel you shall take one from the fifty, from the humans and from the cattle and from the sheep and from the donkeys and from all the livestock, and you shall give them to the Levites who keep the watches in the tent of the Lord.
Numbers 31:31 And Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the Lord prescribed to Moses.
Numbers 31:32 And the surplus of the plunder that the warrior men plundered was, from the sheep, six hundred seventy-five thousand,
Numbers 31:33 and seventy-two thousand cattle,
Numbers 31:34 and sixty-one thousand donkeys,
Numbers 31:35 and human souls from the women who had not known a man’s bed, all the souls, thirty-two thousand.
Numbers 31:36 And the half share, the portion of those who had gone out to the war, was, from the number of the sheep, three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred,
Numbers 31:37 and the tribute for the Lord from the sheep was six hundred seventy-five;
Numbers 31:38 and the cattle were thirty-six thousand, and the tribute for the Lord, seventy-two;
Numbers 31:39 and the donkeys, thirty thousand five hundred, and the tribute for the Lord, sixty-one;
Numbers 31:40 and the human souls, sixteen thousand, and their tribute for the Lord, thirty-two souls.
Numbers 31:41 And Moses gave the tribute for the Lord, the removal offering of God, to Eleazar the priest, just as the Lord prescribed to Moses.
Numbers 31:42 From the half share of the sons of Israel, whom Moses divided from the warrior men –
Numbers 31:43 and the half share belonging to the congregation was, from the sheep, three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred,
Numbers 31:44 and thirty-six thousand cattle,
Numbers 31:45 thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
Numbers 31:46 and sixteen thousand human souls –
Numbers 31:47 and Moses took from the half share of the sons of Israel the one from the fifty, from the humans and from the livestock, and gave them to the Levites who keep the watches of the tent of the Lord, in the manner that the Lord prescribed to Moses.
Numbers 31:48 And all those appointed over the thousands of the force, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, approached Moses,
Numbers 31:49 and they said to Moses: Your servants have taken the head-count of the warrior men who are with us, and not even one of them has been missing.
Numbers 31:50 And we have brought the gift for the Lord, each man what he found, a gold vessel: anklet and bracelet and ring and armlet and braided ornament, to make atonement for us before the Lord.
Numbers 31:51 And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, every worked vessel.
Numbers 31:52 And all the gold, the removal offering that they removed for the Lord, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the commanders of thousands and from the commanders of hundreds.
Numbers 31:53 And the warrior men each plundered for himself.
Numbers 31:54 And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of thousands and from the commanders of hundreds and brought them into the tent of the testimony as a memorial of the sons of Israel before the Lord.

## Chapter 32

Numbers 32:1 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad had a multitude of livestock, a very great multitude; and they saw the region of Jazer and the region of Galaad, and the place was a place for livestock.
Numbers 32:2 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad approached and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the rulers of the congregation, saying:
Numbers 32:3 Ataroth and Daibon and Jazer and Nambra and Esebon and Eleale and Sebama and Nabau and Baian,
Numbers 32:4 the land that the Lord delivered before the sons of Israel, is livestock-feeding land, and your servants possess livestock.
Numbers 32:5 And they said: If we have found favor before you, let this land be given to your household servants as a possession, and do not take us across the Jordan.
Numbers 32:6 And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben: Your brothers are going to war, and will you sit here?
Numbers 32:7 And why do you turn aside the minds of the sons of Israel so that they do not cross over into the land that the Lord is giving them?
Numbers 32:8 Did your fathers not do so when I sent them from Cades Barne to observe the land?
Numbers 32:9 And they went up to the Ravine of the Cluster and observed the land, and they turned away the heart of the sons of Israel so that they would not enter into the land that the Lord gave them.
Numbers 32:10 And the Lord became angry with fury on that day and swore, saying:
Numbers 32:11 These men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and above, those knowing evil and good, surely shall not see the land that I swore to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, for they did not follow after me,
Numbers 32:12 except Chaleb son of Jephonne, the one separated, and Jesus, the one of Nave, because he followed after the Lord.
Numbers 32:13 And the Lord became angry with fury against Israel and made them whirl about in the wilderness for forty years, until the entire generation, those doing wicked things before the Lord, was completely consumed.
Numbers 32:14 Behold, you rose up in place of your fathers, a band of sinful men, to add still more to the fury of the wrath of the Lord against Israel,
Numbers 32:15 because you will turn away from him, to add still more to leave him in the wilderness, and you will act lawlessly against this entire congregation.
Numbers 32:16 And they approached him and said: Let us build sheep farmsteads here for our livestock and cities for our equipment,
Numbers 32:17 and we will be armed as a vanguard ahead of the sons of Israel until we bring them to their own place; and our equipment shall dwell in walled cities because of those who inhabit the land.
Numbers 32:18 We certainly shall not return to our houses until the sons of Israel have each been apportioned into his inheritance.
Numbers 32:19 And we shall no longer inherit among them from across the Jordan and beyond, because we hold our allotments beyond the Jordan in the east.
Numbers 32:20 And Moses said to them: If you act according to this word, if you arm yourselves before the Lord for war,
Numbers 32:21 and every armed man of yours passes over the Jordan before the Lord until his enemy is destroyed from before his face,
Numbers 32:22 and the land is brought under mastery before the Lord, then after these things you shall return and shall be innocent before the Lord and from Israel, and this land shall be yours as a possession before the Lord.
Numbers 32:23 But if you do not act in this way, you shall sin before the Lord, and you shall know your sin when evils overtake you.
Numbers 32:24 And you shall build for yourselves cities for your equipment and farmsteads for your livestock, and you shall do what proceeds from your mouth.
Numbers 32:25 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad spoke to Moses, saying: Your servants shall do just as our lord commands.
Numbers 32:26 Our equipment and our wives and all our livestock shall be in the cities of Galaad,
Numbers 32:27 but your servants shall all pass over, armed and arrayed before the Lord for war, in the manner that our lord says.
Numbers 32:28 And Moses appointed to them Eleazar the priest and Jesus son of Nave and the rulers of the paternal families of the tribes of Israel.
Numbers 32:29 And Moses said to them: If the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad pass over the Jordan with you, every one armed for war before the Lord, and you gain mastery over the land before you, then you shall give them the land of Galaad as a possession.
Numbers 32:30 But if they do not pass over armed with you for war before the Lord, then you shall take their equipment and their wives and their livestock across ahead of you into the land of Chanaan, and they shall be made co-inheritors among you in the land of Chanaan.
Numbers 32:31 And the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad answered, saying: As many things as the Lord says to his attendants, so shall we do.
Numbers 32:32 We shall cross over armed before the Lord into the land of Chanaan, and you shall give us the possession beyond the Jordan.
Numbers 32:33 And Moses gave to them, to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben and to half the tribe of Manasse of the sons of Joseph, the kingdom of Seon king of the Amorrites and the kingdom of Og king of Basan, the land and the cities with its borders, cities of the land round about.
Numbers 32:34 And the sons of Gad built Daibon and Ataroth and Aroer,
Numbers 32:35 and Sophar and Jazer, and they raised them up,
Numbers 32:36 and Nambra and Baitharan, strong cities and sheep farmsteads. –
Numbers 32:37 And the sons of Reuben built Esebon and Eleale and Kariathaim,
Numbers 32:38 and Beelmeon, encircled cities, and Sebama; and they named the names of the cities that they built according to their names. –
Numbers 32:39 And a son of Machir son of Manasse went to Galaad and took it and destroyed the Amorrite who inhabited it.
Numbers 32:40 And Moses gave Galaad to Machir son of Manasse, and he dwelt there.
Numbers 32:41 And Jair, the one of Manasse, went and took their farmsteads and named them Farmsteads of Jair.
Numbers 32:42 And Nabau went and took Kanaath and its villages and named them Naboth from his own name.

## Chapter 33

Numbers 33:1 And these are the stations of the sons of Israel, as they went out from the land of Egypt with their force by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Numbers 33:2 And Moses wrote down their departures and their stations through the word of the Lord, and these are the stations of their journey.
Numbers 33:3 They departed from Ramesses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Pascha, the sons of Israel went out with hand held high before all the Egyptians,
Numbers 33:4 while the Egyptians were burying from among themselves all the dead whom the Lord struck, every firstborn in the land of Egypt; and among their gods the Lord carried out the vengeance.
Numbers 33:5 And the sons of Israel departed from Ramesses and encamped at Sokchoth.
Numbers 33:6 And they departed from Sokchoth and encamped at Bouthan, which is some part of the wilderness.
Numbers 33:7 And they departed from Bouthan and encamped at the mouth of Eiroth, which is opposite Beelsepphon, and they encamped opposite Magdol.
Numbers 33:8 And they departed from opposite Eiroth and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness, and they themselves traveled a road of three days through the wilderness and encamped at Pikriai.
Numbers 33:9 And they departed from Pikriai and came to Ailim; and in Ailim were twelve springs of waters and seventy trunks of palm trees, and they encamped there beside the water.
Numbers 33:10 And they departed from Ailim and encamped at Red Sea.
Numbers 33:11 And they departed from Red Sea and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
Numbers 33:12 And they departed from the wilderness of Sin and encamped at Raphaka.
Numbers 33:13 And they departed from Raphaka and encamped at Ailous.
Numbers 33:14 And they departed from Ailous and encamped at Raphidin, and there was no water there for the people to drink.
Numbers 33:15 And they departed from Raphidin and encamped in the wilderness of Sina.
Numbers 33:16 And they departed from the wilderness of Sina and encamped at Memorials of Desire.
Numbers 33:17 And they departed from Memorials of Desire and encamped at Aseroth.
Numbers 33:18 And they departed from Aseroth and encamped at Rathama.
Numbers 33:19 And they departed from Rathama and encamped at Remmon Phares.
Numbers 33:20 And they departed from Remmon Phares and encamped at Lemona.
Numbers 33:21 And they departed from Lemona and encamped at Dessa.
Numbers 33:22 And they departed from Dessa and encamped at Makellath.
Numbers 33:23 And they departed from Makellath and encamped at Saphar.
Numbers 33:24 And they departed from Saphar and encamped at Charadath.
Numbers 33:25 And they departed from Charadath and encamped at Makeloth.
Numbers 33:26 And they departed from Makeloth and encamped at Kataath.
Numbers 33:27 And they departed from Kataath and encamped at Tarath.
Numbers 33:28 And they departed from Tarath and encamped at Matekka.
Numbers 33:29 And they departed from Matekka and encamped at Selmona.
Numbers 33:30 And they departed from Selmona and encamped at Massourouth.
Numbers 33:31 And they departed from Massourouth and encamped at Banaia.
Numbers 33:32 And they departed from Banaia and encamped at Mount Gadgad.
Numbers 33:33 And they departed from Mount Gadgad and encamped at Etebatha.
Numbers 33:34 And they departed from Etebatha and encamped at Ebrona.
Numbers 33:35 And they departed from Ebrona and encamped at Gesiongaber.
Numbers 33:36 And they departed from Gesiongaber and encamped in the wilderness of Sin. And they departed from the wilderness of Sin and encamped in the wilderness of Pharan; this is Cades.
Numbers 33:37 And they departed from Cades and encamped at Or the mountain, near the land of Edom.
Numbers 33:38 And Aaron the priest went up by the command of the Lord and died there in the fortieth year of the exodus of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month.
Numbers 33:39 And Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he was dying at Or the mountain.
Numbers 33:40 And Chananis king of Arad heard, and this one dwelt in the land of Chanaan, when the sons of Israel were entering.
Numbers 33:41 And they departed from Or the mountain and encamped at Selmona.
Numbers 33:42 And they departed from Selmona and encamped at Phino.
Numbers 33:43 And they departed from Phino and encamped at Oboth.
Numbers 33:44 And they departed from Oboth and encamped at Gai, across at the borders of Moab.
Numbers 33:45 And they departed from Gai and encamped at Daibon Gad.
Numbers 33:46 And they departed from Daibon Gad and encamped at Gelmon Deblathaim.
Numbers 33:47 And they departed from Gelmon Deblathaim and encamped at the mountains of Abarim opposite Nabau.
Numbers 33:48 And they departed from the mountains of Abarim and encamped at the west of Moab beside the Jordan opposite Jericho,
Numbers 33:49 and they encamped beside the Jordan between Aisimoth and Belsattim, toward the west of Moab.
Numbers 33:50 And the Lord spoke to Moses at the west of Moab beside the Jordan opposite Jericho, saying:
Numbers 33:51 Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: You are crossing over the Jordan into the land of Chanaan,
Numbers 33:52 and you shall destroy all those who inhabit the land before your face, and you shall remove their watch-posts, and all their cast images you shall destroy, and all their pillars you shall remove.
Numbers 33:53 And you shall destroy all those who inhabit the land and shall dwell in it, for I have given their land to you as an allotment.
Numbers 33:54 And you shall inherit their land by allotment according to your tribes. For those who are more, you shall increase their possession, and for those who are fewer, you shall decrease their possession. Wherever his name goes out there, it shall be his; according to the tribes of your paternal families you shall inherit.
Numbers 33:55 But if you do not destroy those who inhabit the land from before your face, then those whom you leave from among them shall be thorns in your eyes and darts in your sides, and they shall be hostile on the land upon which you dwell.
Numbers 33:56 And it shall be that, just as I had determined to do to them, I shall do to you.

## Chapter 34

Numbers 34:1 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 34:2 Command the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them: You are entering into the land of Chanaan. This shall be for you as an inheritance: the land of Chanaan with its borders.
Numbers 34:3 And your side toward southwest shall be from the wilderness of Sin as far as what adjoins Edom, and your borders toward southwest shall be from part of the Salt Sea, from east.
Numbers 34:4 And the borders shall go around you from southwest toward the Ascent of Akrabin and shall pass Senna, and its outlet shall be southwest of Cades Barne, and it shall go out to the farmstead of Arad and shall pass Asemona.
Numbers 34:5 And the border shall turn around from Asemona to the winter-stream of Egypt, and its outlet shall be the sea.
Numbers 34:6 And the borders of the sea shall be for you. The Great Sea shall define; this shall be for you the borders of the sea.
Numbers 34:7 And this shall be the borders for you toward north: from the Great Sea you shall measure out for yourselves beside the mountain, the mountain.
Numbers 34:8 And from the mountain, the mountain, you shall measure out for them as they enter into Emath, and its outlet shall be the borders of Sarada.
Numbers 34:9 And the borders shall go out to Dephrona, and its outlet shall be Asernain; this shall be borders for you from north.
Numbers 34:10 And you shall measure out for yourselves the borders of the east from Asernain to Sepphama.
Numbers 34:11 And the border shall descend from Seppham to Arbela, from east, to the springs; and the border shall descend to Bela upon the back of Sea Chenara from east.
Numbers 34:12 And the border shall descend to the Jordan, and its outlet shall be the Salt Sea. This shall be the land for you and its borders round about.
Numbers 34:13 And Moses commanded the sons of Israel, saying: This is the land that you shall inherit by lot, in the manner that the Lord prescribed to Moses to give it to the nine tribes and to half the tribe of Manasse.
Numbers 34:14 For the tribe of the sons of Reuben and the tribe of the sons of Gad took according to the houses of their paternal families, and half the tribe of Manasse received their allotments.
Numbers 34:15 Two tribes and half a tribe took their allotments beyond the Jordan opposite Jericho, from south toward east.
Numbers 34:16 And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Numbers 34:17 These are the names of the men who shall inherit the land for you: Eleazar the priest and Jesus, the one of Nave.
Numbers 34:18 And you shall take one ruler from a tribe to apportion the land for you.
Numbers 34:19 And these are the names of the men: from the tribe of Judas, Chaleb son of Jephonne;
Numbers 34:20 from the tribe of Symeon, Salamiel son of Emioud;
Numbers 34:21 from the tribe of Benjamin, Eldad son of Chaslon;
Numbers 34:22 from the tribe of Dan, the ruler Bakchir son of Egli;
