Joshua 18:11 And the lot of the tribe of Benjamin came out first according to their clans, and the boundaries of their lot came out between Judas and the sons of Joseph.
Joshua 18:12 And their boundaries from the north were from the Jordan; the boundary shall ascend behind Jericho on the north and ascend to the mountain toward the sea, and its outlet shall be the Madbarite region of Baethon,
Joshua 18:13 and the boundary shall pass from there to Louza behind Louza on the south [this is Baethel], and the boundary shall descend to Maatarothorech to the hill country south of Lower Baethoron,
Joshua 18:14 and the boundary shall pass and go around to the side facing toward the sea from the south of the mountain opposite Baethoron to the south, and its outlet shall be to Kariathbaal [this is Kariathiarin, a city of the sons of Judas]; this is the side toward the sea.
Joshua 18:15 And the southern side from the region of Kariathbaal, and the boundary shall pass to Gasin at the spring of the water of Naphtho,
Joshua 18:16 and the boundary shall descend to the region of the mountain opposite the wooded valley of Onnam, which is in the region of Emekraphain on the north, and shall descend to Gaienna behind Jebusai on the south and descend to the spring Rogel
Joshua 18:17 and pass to the spring Baethsamys and pass to Galiloth, which is opposite the ascent of Aithamin, and descend to the stone of Baion of the sons of Reuben
Joshua 18:18 and pass behind Baetharaba on the north and descend
Joshua 18:19 to the boundaries behind Baethagla on the north, and the outlet of the boundaries shall be to the ridge of the Salt Sea on the north at the region of the Jordan on the south; these are the boundaries from the south.
Joshua 18:20 And the Jordan shall bound it from the eastern side. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin, its boundaries all around according to clans. –
Joshua 18:21 And the cities of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans were Jericho and Baetheglio and Amekasis
Joshua 18:22 and Baethabara and Sara and Besana
Joshua 18:23 and Aiin and Phara and Ephratha
Joshua 18:24 and Karapha and Kephira and Moni and Gabaa, twelve cities and their villages;
Joshua 18:25 Gabaon and Rama and Beerotha
Joshua 18:26 and Massema and Miron and Amoke
Joshua 18:27 and Phira and Kaphan and Nakan and Selekan and Thareela
Joshua 18:28 and Jebus [this is Jerusalem] and cities and Gabaothiarim, thirteen cities and their villages. This is the inheritance of the sons of Benjamin according to their clans.

## Chapter 19

Joshua 19:1 And the second lot of the sons of Symeon came out, and their inheritance was in the midst of the allotments of the sons of Judas.
Joshua 19:2 And their lot was Bersabee and Samaa and Koladam
Joshua 19:3 and Arsola and Bola and Asom
Joshua 19:4 and Elthoula and Boula and Erma
Joshua 19:5 and Sikelak and Baethmachereb and Sarsousin
Joshua 19:6 and Batharoth and their fields, thirteen cities and their villages;
Joshua 19:7 Eremmon and Thalcha and Ether and Asan, four cities and their villages
Joshua 19:8 around their cities as far as Barek, going to Bameth toward the south. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Symeon according to their clans.
Joshua 19:9 From the lot of Judas was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Symeon, because the portion of the sons of Judas was greater than theirs; and the sons of Symeon inherited in the midst of their lot.
Joshua 19:10 And the third lot came out for Zabulon according to their clans. The boundaries of their inheritance shall be Esedek,
Joshua 19:11 Gola; their boundaries were the sea and Maragella and shall join Baetharaba at the ravine opposite Jekman,
Joshua 19:12 and it turned from Sedduk opposite, from the east of Baethsamys to the boundaries of Chaselothaith, and shall pass to Dabiroth and ascend to Phanggai
Joshua 19:13 and from there shall go around opposite on the east to Gebere to the city of Katasem and shall pass to Remmona Amathar Aoza
Joshua 19:14 and the boundary shall go around on the north to Amoth, and their outlet shall be at Gaiphael
Joshua 19:15 and Katanath and Nabaal and Symoon and Jericho and Baethman.
Joshua 19:16 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zabulon according to their clans, cities and their villages.
Joshua 19:17 And for Issachar the fourth lot came out.
Joshua 19:18 And their boundaries were Jazel and Chasaloth and Sounan
Joshua 19:19 and Agin and Siona and Reeroth and Anachereth
Joshua 19:20 and Dabiron and Kison and Rebes
Joshua 19:21 and Remmas and Jeon and Tomman and Aimarek and Bersaphes,
Joshua 19:22 and the boundaries shall join Gaithbor and Salim toward the sea and Baethsamys, and its boundary outlet shall be the Jordan.
Joshua 19:23 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their clans, the cities and their villages.
Joshua 19:24 And the fifth lot came out for Aser.

Joshua 19:26 and Elimelek and Amiel and Maasa, and it will join Carmel by the sea and Sion and Labanath
Joshua 19:27 and it will turn from the rising of the sun and Baithegeneth and will join Zabulon, and from Gai and Phthaiel toward the north, and the boundaries will enter Saphthaibaithme and Inael and will pass into Choba Masomel
Joshua 19:28 and Elbon and Raab and Ememaon and Kanthan as far as great Sidon,
Joshua 19:29 and the boundaries will turn to Rama and as far as the spring of Masphassat and of the Tyrians, and the boundaries will turn toward Iasiph, and its outlet will be the sea and from Leb and Echozob
Joshua 19:30 and Archob and Aphek and Raau.
Joshua 19:31 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Aser according to their divisions, cities and their villages.
Joshua 19:32 And for Nephthali the sixth lot came out.
Joshua 19:33 And their boundaries were Moolam and Mola and Besemiin and Arme and Nabok and Iephthamai as far as Dodam, and its outlets were the Jordan;
Joshua 19:34 and the boundaries will turn toward the sea to Enath Thabor and will pass from there to Iakana and will join Zabulon from the south, and Aser will join toward the sea, and the Jordan from the rising of the sun.
Joshua 19:35 And the walled cities of the Tyrians: Tyre and Omatha, Daketh and Kenereth
Joshua 19:36 and Armaith and Arael and Asor
Joshua 19:37 and Kades and Assari and the spring of Asor
Joshua 19:38 and Keroe and Megala, Arim and Baiththame and Thessamys.
Joshua 19:39 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Nephthali.
Joshua 19:40 And for Dan the seventh lot came out.
Joshua 19:41 And their boundaries were Sarath and Asa, the cities Sammaus
Joshua 19:42 and Salabin and Ammon and Silatha
Joshua 19:43 and Ailon and Thamnatha and Akkaron
Joshua 19:44 and Alkatha and Begethon and Gebeelan
Joshua 19:45 and Azor and Banaibakat and Gethremmon,
Joshua 19:46 and from the sea Ierakon, a boundary near Ioppe.
Joshua 19:47 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their divisions, their cities and their villages.
Joshua 19:47 a And the sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorite who was pressing them in the mountain; and the Amorites did not allow them to descend into the valley and pressed away from them the boundary of their portion.
Joshua 19:48 And the sons of Judah went and fought Lachis and took it and struck it with the edge of the sword and inhabited it and called its name Lasendak.
Joshua 19:48 a And the Amorite persisted in dwelling in Elom and in Salamin; and the hand of Ephraim was heavy upon them, and they became tribute for them.
Joshua 19:49 And they went to take possession of the land according to their boundary. And the sons of Israel gave a lot to Jesus the son of Naue among them
Joshua 19:50 by command of God; and they gave him the city that he asked for, Thamnasarach, which is in the mountain of Ephraim; and he built the city and dwelt in it.
Joshua 19:51 These are the divisions which Eleazar the priest and Jesus the son of Naue and the chiefs of the fathers' houses among the tribes of Israel distributed by lot in Selo before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and they went to take possession of the land.
Joshua 19:1 And the second lot came out for Symeon, and their inheritance was in the midst of the lot of the sons of Judah.
Joshua 19:2 And their lot was Bersabee and Sabee and Molada
Joshua 19:3 and Asersoual and Bathoul and Bola and Asom
Joshua 19:4 and Elthoulad and Erma
Joshua 19:5 and Sekela and Baithammarchaboth and Asersousim
Joshua 19:6 and Baithlabath and their fields, thirteen cities and their villages;
Joshua 19:7 Ain and Remmon and Ether and Asan, four cities and their villages
Joshua 19:8 around these cities as far as Baalethberramoth of those going to Iameth toward the southwest. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Symeon according to their divisions.
Joshua 19:9 From the lot of Judah was the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Symeon, because the portion of the sons of Judah was greater than theirs; and the sons of Symeon inherited in the midst of their lot.
Joshua 19:10 And the third lot came out for Zabulon according to their divisions. And the boundaries of their inheritance will be as far as Sarid;
Joshua 19:11 their boundaries, the sea and Marala, and it will join at Dabasthai in the ravine that is opposite Ieknam,
Joshua 19:12 and it will turn from Sarid opposite, from the rising of Sams, toward the boundaries of Chasaloth Thabor and pass toward Dabrath and go up further toward Iaphagai
Joshua 19:13 and from there go around opposite toward the east to Geththa to the city Kasim and pass toward Remmon Ammatharim Annoua
Joshua 19:14 and go around to the northern boundaries toward Ennathoth, and their outlet will be toward Gaiiephthael
Joshua 19:15 and Kattath and Naalol and Semron and Iadela and Bethlehem.
Joshua 19:16 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Zabulon according to their divisions, these cities and their villages.
Joshua 19:17 And for Issachar the fourth lot came out.
Joshua 19:18 And their boundaries were Iezrael and Achaseloth and Sounam
Joshua 19:19 and Apheraiim and Sian and Renath and Anareth
Joshua 19:20 and Rabboth and Kesion and Aeme
Joshua 19:21 and Ramath and Engannim and Enadda and Baithphases,
Joshua 19:22 and the boundaries will join at Thaboth and at Sasima toward the sea and Baithsmas, and the outlet of their boundaries will be the Jordan.
Joshua 19:23 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Issachar according to their divisions, the cities and their settlements.
Joshua 19:24 And the fifth lot came out for Aser according to their divisions.
Joshua 19:25 And their boundaries were Chelkath and Ooli and Batne and Achsaph
Joshua 19:26 and Amad and Masal, and it will join Carmel toward the sea and Sior and Labanath
Joshua 19:27 and it will turn from the rising of the sun to Bethdagon and join Zabulon and in the valley of Iephthael toward the north, and the boundaries will enter Saphthabethaemek and the border will go to Aniel and pass into Chabol on the left
Joshua 19:28 and Achran and Roob and Amon and Kana as far as great Sidon,
Joshua 19:29 and the boundaries will turn to Rama and as far as the fortified city of the Tyrians, and the boundaries will turn toward Osa, and its outlet will be the sea and from the measured portion of Achziph
Joshua 19:30 and Amma and Aphek and Raob, twenty-two cities.
Joshua 19:31 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Aser according to their divisions, their cities and their villages.
Joshua 19:32 And for Nephthali the sixth lot came out.
Joshua 19:33 And their boundaries were Meeleph and Maelon and Besenanim and Armai and Nakeb and Iabnel as far as Lakou, and its outlets were the Jordan;
Joshua 19:34 and the boundaries will turn toward the sea to Azanoth Thabor and pass from there to Ikok and join Zabulon from the south and join Aser toward the sea, and the Jordan from the rising of the sun.
Joshua 19:35 And the walled cities of the Tyrians: Tyre and Amath and Rekkath and Chenereth
Joshua 19:36 and Adami and Rama and Asor
Joshua 19:37 and Kedes and Edrai and the spring of Asor
Joshua 19:38 and Iarion and Magdaliel, Oram and Baithanath and Thasmous, nineteen cities.
Joshua 19:39 This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Nephthali.
Joshua 19:40 And for Dan the seventh lot came out.
Joshua 19:41 And their boundaries were Saraa and Esthaol and the city Sames
Joshua 19:42 and Salabin and Iaalon and Iethla
Joshua 19:43 and Ailon and Thamna and Akkaron
Joshua 19:44 and Eltheko and Gabathon and Baalon
Joshua 19:45 and Iouth and Banebarak and Gethremmon,

## Chapter 20

Joshua 20:1 And the Lord spoke to Jesus, saying,
Joshua 20:2 Speak to the sons of Israel, saying: Give the cities of places of refuge, which I spoke to you through Moses,
Joshua 20:3 a place of refuge for the slayer who struck a soul unintentionally; and the cities shall be for you a place of refuge, and the slayer shall not die at the hand of the one who is next of kin to the blood, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
Joshua 20:7 And he set apart Kades in Galilee in the mountain of Nephthali, and Sychem in the mountain of Ephraim, and the city of Arbok [this is Chebron] in the mountain of Judah.
Joshua 20:8 And beyond the Jordan he gave Bosor in the wilderness in the plain from the tribe of Rouben, and Aremoth in Galaad from the tribe of Gad, and Gaulon in Basanitis from the tribe of Manasse.
Joshua 20:9 These are the cities designated for the sons of Israel and for the sojourner attached among them, for everyone striking a soul unintentionally to flee there, so that he might not die by the hand of the one who is next of kin to the blood, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

## Chapter 21

Joshua 21:1 And the heads of the fathers' houses of the sons of Levi approached Eleazar the priest and Jesus the son of Naue and the chiefs of the tribes of the fathers' houses from the tribes of Israel
Joshua 21:2 and said to them in Selo in the land of Canaan, saying: The Lord commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in and the surrounding lands for our cattle.
Joshua 21:3 And the sons of Israel gave the Levites, in the allotting of inheritance by command of the Lord, the cities and their surrounding lands.
Joshua 21:4 And the lot came out for the division of Kaath, and for the sons of Aaron, the priests, the Levites, from the tribe of Judah and from the tribe of Symeon and from the tribe of Benjamin, there were by lot thirteen cities,
Joshua 21:5 and for the sons of Kaath who remained, from the tribe of Ephraim and from the tribe of Dan and from the half tribe of Manasse, by lot ten cities;
Joshua 21:6 and for the sons of Gedson, from the tribe of Issachar and from the tribe of Aser and from the tribe of Nephthali and from the half tribe of Manasse in Basan, thirteen cities;
Joshua 21:7 and for the sons of Merari according to their divisions, from the tribe of Rouben and from the tribe of Gad and from the tribe of Zabulon, by lot twelve cities.
Joshua 21:8 And the sons of Israel gave the Levites the cities and their surrounding lands, in the manner the Lord commanded Moses, by lot.
Joshua 21:9 And the tribe of the sons of Judah and the tribe of the sons of Symeon and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin gave the cities, and they were named
Joshua 21:10 for the sons of Aaron from the division of Kaath of the sons of Levi, because the lot fell to these.
Joshua 21:11 And he gave them Kariatharbok, the mother city of the Enak [this is Chebron], in the mountain of Judah; but the surrounding lands around it
Joshua 21:12 and the fields of the city and its villages Jesus gave to the sons of Chaleb son of Iephonne as a possession;
Joshua 21:13 and to the sons of Aaron the city of refuge for the slayer, Chebron, and the lands set apart with it, and Lemna and the lands set apart beside it,
Joshua 21:14 and Ailom and the lands set apart for it, and Tema and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:15 and Gella and the lands set apart for it, and Dabir and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:16 and Asa and the lands set apart for it, and Tany and the lands set apart for it, and Baithsamys and the lands set apart for it, nine cities from these two tribes.
Joshua 21:17 And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and the lands set apart for it, and Gathed and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:18 and Anathoth and the lands set apart for it, and Gamala and the lands set apart for it, four cities.
Joshua 21:19 All the cities of the sons of Aaron the priests: thirteen.
Joshua 21:20 And for the divisions of the sons of Kaath, the Levites who remained of the sons of Kaath, there was a city of their boundaries from the tribe of Ephraim,
Joshua 21:21 and they gave them the city of refuge for the slayer, Sychem, and the lands set apart for it, and Gazara and the things beside it and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:22 and Kabsaim and the lands set apart beside it, and upper Baithoron and the lands set apart for it, four cities.
Joshua 21:23 And from the tribe of Dan, Elkothaim and the lands set apart for it, and Gethedan and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:24 and Ailon and the lands set apart for it, and Gethremmon and the lands set apart for it, four cities.
Joshua 21:25 And from the half tribe of Manasse, Tanach and the lands set apart for it, and Iebatha and the lands set apart for it, two cities.
Joshua 21:26 All the cities: ten, and the lands set apart beside them, for the divisions of the sons of Kaath who remained.
Joshua 21:27 And for the sons of Gedson, the Levites, from the half tribe of Manasse, the cities set apart for the slayers: Gaulon in Basanitis and the lands set apart for it, and Bosoran and the lands set apart for it, two cities,
Joshua 21:28 and from the tribe of Issachar, Kison and the lands set apart for it, and Debba and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:29 and Remmath and the lands set apart for it, and the Spring of Letters and the lands set apart for it, four cities.
Joshua 21:30 And from the tribe of Aser, Basellan and the lands set apart for it, and Dabbon and the lands set apart for it,
Joshua 21:31 and Chelkat and the lands set apart for it, and Raab and the lands set apart for it, four cities.
Joshua 21:32 And from the tribe of Nephthali, the city set apart for the slayer, Kades in Galilee, and the lands set apart for it, and Emmath and the lands set apart for it, and Themmon and the lands set apart for it, three cities.
Joshua 21:33 All the cities of Gedson according to their divisions: thirteen cities.
Joshua 21:34 And for the division of the sons of Merari, the remaining Levites, from the tribe of the sons of Zabulon, Maan and its surrounding lands, and Kades and its surrounding lands,
Joshua 21:35 and Demna and its surrounding lands, and Sella and its surrounding lands, four cities.
Joshua 21:36 And beyond the Jordan opposite Iericho, from the tribe of Rouben, the city of refuge for the slayer, Bosor in the wilderness, in Misor, and its surrounding lands, and Iazer and its surrounding lands,
Joshua 21:37 and Dekmon and its surrounding lands, and Mapha and its surrounding lands, four cities.

Joshua 21:40 All the cities for the sons of Merari according to their divisions, those remaining of the tribe of Levi; and the boundaries were twelve cities.
Joshua 21:41 All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the sons of Israel: forty-eight cities and their surrounding lands
Joshua 21:42 around these cities, a city and the surrounding lands around the city, for all these cities.
Joshua 21:42 a And Jesus finished dividing the land within their boundaries.
Joshua 21:43 And the sons of Israel gave Jesus a portion according to the command of the Lord; they gave him the city which he asked for; they gave him Thamnasarach in the mountain of Ephraim.
Joshua 21:44 And Jesus built the city and dwelt in it.
Joshua 21:45 And Jesus took the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel who were born on the way in the wilderness, and placed them in Thamnasarach.
Joshua 21:43 And the Lord gave Israel all the land which he swore to give to their fathers, and they inherited it and dwelt in it.
Joshua 21:44 And the Lord gave them rest all around, just as he swore to their fathers; no one of all their enemies stood before them; the Lord delivered all their enemies into their hands.
Joshua 21:45 Not one of all the good words which the Lord spoke to the sons of Israel fell away; all came to pass.

## Chapter 22

Joshua 22:1 Then Jesus called together the sons of Rouben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasse
Joshua 22:2 and said to them: You have heard all that Moses the servant of the Lord commanded you, and you listened to my voice in all that I commanded you.
Joshua 22:3 You have not abandoned your brothers these days and more, until this day; you kept the command of the Lord your God.
Joshua 22:4 And now the Lord our God has given our brothers rest, in the manner he told them; now therefore turn and go to your houses and to the land of your possession, which Moses gave you beyond the Jordan.
Joshua 22:5 But take great care to do the commandments and the law which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded us to do: to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, to keep his commandments and to cling to him and to serve him with all your mind and with all your soul.
Joshua 22:6 And Jesus blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their houses. –
Joshua 22:7 And to half the tribe of Manasse Moses gave in Basanitis, and to the half Jesus gave with his brothers beyond the Jordan toward the sea. And when Jesus sent them away to their houses and blessed them,
Joshua 22:8 then with many possessions they went to their houses, and very many cattle and silver and gold and iron and much clothing, and they divided the spoil of the enemies with their brothers.
Joshua 22:9 And the sons of Rouben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of the sons of Manasse departed from the sons of Israel from Selo in the land of Canaan to go to the land of Galaad, to the land of their possession which they inherited by command of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
Joshua 22:10 And they came to Galgala of the Jordan, which is in the land of Canaan, and the sons of Gad and the sons of Rouben and the half tribe of Manasse built there an altar on the Jordan, a great altar to behold.
Joshua 22:11 And the sons of Israel heard people saying: Behold, the sons of Gad and the sons of Rouben and the half tribe of Manasse built an altar at the boundaries of the land of Canaan, at Galaad of the Jordan, across from the sons of Israel.
Joshua 22:12 And all the sons of Israel gathered at Selo to go up and wage war against them.
Joshua 22:13 And the sons of Israel sent to the sons of Rouben and to the sons of Gad and to the half tribe of Manasse in the land of Galaad Phinees son of Eleazar son of Aaron the high priest
Joshua 22:14 and ten of the rulers with him, one ruler from a father's house from each of the tribes of Israel; they are rulers of fathers' houses, commanders of thousands of Israel.
Joshua 22:15 And they came to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Rouben and to the halves of the tribe of Manasse in the land of Galaad and spoke to them, saying:
Joshua 22:16 Thus says the whole congregation of the Lord: What is this offense that you have committed before the God of Israel, to turn away today from the Lord, building an altar for yourselves, that you might become rebels against the Lord?
Joshua 22:17 Is the sin of Phogor a small thing for us? For we have not been cleansed from it until this day, and a plague came upon the congregation of the Lord.
Joshua 22:18 And will you turn away today from the Lord? And it will be, if you rebel today against the Lord, tomorrow wrath will be upon all Israel.
Joshua 22:19 And now if the land of your possession is small for you, cross into the land of the Lord's possession, where the tent of the Lord dwells, and inherit among us; and do not become rebels against God and do not rebel against the Lord by your building an altar apart from the altar of the Lord our God.
Joshua 22:20 Was it not Achar son of Zara who committed an offense from the devoted thing, and wrath came upon all the congregation of Israel? And he was one man alone; did he alone die for his own sin?
Joshua 22:21 And the sons of Rouben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasse answered and spoke to the commanders of thousands of Israel, saying:
Joshua 22:22 God is God, the Lord, and God is God, the Lord; he himself knows, and Israel itself will know. If we committed an offense in rebellion before the Lord, may he not deliver us in this;
Joshua 22:23 and if we built an altar for ourselves so as to rebel against the Lord our God, so as to offer upon it a sacrifice of whole burnt offerings or to make upon it a sacrifice of deliverance, the Lord will seek it out.
Joshua 22:24 But because of concern about a word we did this, saying: Lest tomorrow your children say to our children: What have you to do with the Lord the God of Israel?
Joshua 22:25 And the Lord set the Jordan as a boundary between us and you, and there is no portion of the Lord for you. And your sons will estrange our sons, so that they do not revere the Lord.
Joshua 22:26 And we said to do thus, to build this altar, not for offerings nor for sacrifices,
Joshua 22:27 but so that this may be a witness between us and you and between our generations after us, to perform service to the Lord before him with our offerings and with our sacrifices and with our sacrifices of deliverance; and your children will not say to our children tomorrow: There is no portion of the Lord for you.
Joshua 22:28 And we said: If ever it happens that they speak to us and to our generations tomorrow, then they will say: See the likeness of the altar of the Lord, which our fathers made not for offerings nor for sacrifices, but it is a witness between you and us and between our sons.
Joshua 22:29 May it not happen, then, that we turn away from the Lord in these days, to rebel against the Lord so as to build an altar for offerings and sacrifices of salamin and for a sacrifice of deliverance, besides the altar of the Lord which is before his tent.
Joshua 22:30 And Phinees the priest and all the rulers of the congregation of Israel who were with him heard the words which the sons of Rouben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasse spoke, and it pleased them.
Joshua 22:31 And Phinees the priest said to the sons of Rouben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasse: Today we have known that the Lord is with us, because you have not committed an offense before the Lord, and because you have delivered the sons of Israel from the hand of the Lord.
Joshua 22:32 And Phinees the priest and the rulers returned from the sons of Rouben and from the sons of Gad and from the half tribe of Manasse, from the land of Galaad to the land of Canaan, to the sons of Israel, and reported the words to them,
Joshua 22:33 and it pleased the sons of Israel. And they spoke to the sons of Israel, and they blessed the God of the sons of Israel and said that they would no longer go up against them in war to destroy the land of the sons of Rouben and the sons of Gad and the half tribe of Manasse. And they dwelt upon it.
Joshua 22:34 And Jesus named the altar of the Roubenites and the Gadites and the half tribe of Manasse and said: It is a witness between them that the Lord is their God.

## Chapter 23

Joshua 23:1 And it happened after many days, after the Lord had given Israel rest from all their enemies round about, and Jesus was old, advanced in days,
Joshua 23:2 that Jesus called together all the sons of Israel and their council of elders and their rulers and their scribes and their judges and said to them: I have grown old and advanced in days.
Joshua 23:3 And you have seen all that the Lord your God did to all these nations before you, for it was the Lord your God who fought for you.
Joshua 23:4 See that I have cast to you these nations remaining for you among the lots for your tribes; from the Jordan, all the nations which I destroyed, and from the great sea it will bound toward the setting of the sun.
Joshua 23:5 And the Lord your God, he will destroy them from before you until they perish, and will send wild beasts against them until he destroys them and their kings from before you, and you will inherit their land, just as the Lord your God spoke to you.
Joshua 23:6 Be very strong, then, to keep and do all the things written in the book of the law of Moses, so that you do not turn aside to the right or the left,
Joshua 23:7 so that you do not go in among these remaining nations, and the names of their gods shall not be named among you, nor shall you bow down to them or serve them,
Joshua 23:8 but you shall cleave to the Lord your God, just as you have done until this day.
Joshua 23:9 And the Lord destroyed them from before you, great and strong nations, and no one stood against you before you until this day;
Joshua 23:10 one of you pursued a thousand, because the Lord your God fought for you, just as he told you.
Joshua 23:11 And take great care to love the Lord your God.
Joshua 23:12 For if you turn away and attach yourselves to these remaining nations that are with you, and make marriages with them and mingle with them and they with you,
Joshua 23:13 know that the Lord will no longer continue to destroy these nations from before you, and they will be snares and stumbling blocks for you and nails in your heels and darts in your eyes, until you perish from this good land which the Lord your God gave you.
Joshua 23:14 And I am running the way, as also all those on the earth, and you will know in your heart and in your soul that not one word of all the words that the Lord your God spoke concerning all that pertains to you fell away; none of them failed.
Joshua 23:15 And it will be that, in the manner all the good words which the Lord spoke to you have come upon you, so the Lord God will bring upon you all the evil words until he destroys you from this good land which the Lord gave you,
Joshua 23:16 when you transgress the covenant of the Lord your God which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them.

## Chapter 24

Joshua 24:1 And Jesus gathered all the tribes of Israel at Selo and called together their elders and their scribes and their judges and stood them before God.
Joshua 24:2 And Jesus said to all the people: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel: Beyond the river your fathers dwelt from the beginning, Thara the father of Abraham and the father of Nachor, and they served other gods.
Joshua 24:3 And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river and led him in all the land and multiplied his seed and gave him Isaac,
Joshua 24:4 and to Isaac Jacob and Esau; and I gave Esau Mount Seir for him to inherit, and Jacob and his sons went down into Egypt and became there a great and numerous and strong nation.
Joshua 24:5 And the Egyptians afflicted them, and the Lord struck Egypt with the things he did to them, and after these things he brought you out
Joshua 24:6 from Egypt, and you entered the Red Sea. And the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horses into the Red Sea,
Joshua 24:7 and we cried out to the Lord, and he placed a cloud and darkness between us and the Egyptians and brought the sea upon them and covered them, and your eyes saw all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt. And you were in the wilderness many days.
Joshua 24:8 And he led you into the land of the Amorites who dwelt beyond the Jordan, and they drew up for battle against you, and the Lord delivered them into your hands, and you inherited their land and destroyed them from before you.
Joshua 24:9 And Balak son of Sepphor, king of Moab, arose and drew up for battle against Israel and sent and called Balaam to curse you;
Joshua 24:10 and the Lord your God did not wish to destroy you, and he blessed you with a blessing, and rescued you from their hands and delivered them.
Joshua 24:11 And you crossed the Jordan and came to Iericho; and the inhabitants of Iericho fought against you, the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Pherezite and the Euaite and the Iebusite and the Chettite and the Gergesite, and the Lord delivered them into your hands.
Joshua 24:12 And he sent the hornet ahead of you, and drove them out from before you, twelve kings of the Amorites, not by your sword or by your bow.
Joshua 24:13 And he gave you land on which you did not labor, and cities which you did not build, and you settled in them; and vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant, you will eat.
Joshua 24:14 And now fear the Lord and serve him in uprightness and in righteousness, and remove the foreign gods whom your fathers served beyond the river and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.
Joshua 24:15 But if it does not please you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve, whether the gods of your fathers beyond the river or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell; but I and my house will serve the Lord, for he is holy.
Joshua 24:16 And the people answered and said: May it not happen to us to abandon the Lord so as to serve other gods.
Joshua 24:17 The Lord our God, he is God; he brought us and our fathers up from Egypt and guarded us in all the way in which we went and among all the nations through whom we passed;
Joshua 24:18 and the Lord drove out the Amorite and all the nations dwelling in the land from before us. But we too will serve the Lord, for he is our God.
Joshua 24:19 And Jesus said to the people: You will not be able to serve the Lord, for he is a holy God, and being zealous he will not release your sins and your lawless deeds;
Joshua 24:20 whenever you abandon the Lord and serve other gods, he will come and afflict you and consume you in return for his having done you good.
Joshua 24:21 And the people said to Jesus: No, but we will serve the Lord.
Joshua 24:22 And Jesus said to the people: You are witnesses against yourselves that you chose the Lord to serve him;
Joshua 24:23 and now remove the foreign gods among you and direct your heart toward the Lord God of Israel.
Joshua 24:24 And the people said to Jesus: We will serve the Lord and listen to his voice.
Joshua 24:25 And Jesus made a covenant with the people on that day and gave them a law and a judgment in Selo before the tent of the God of Israel.
Joshua 24:26 And he wrote these words in a book, a law of God; and Jesus took a great stone and set it under the terebinth before the Lord.
Joshua 24:27 And Jesus said to the people: Behold, this stone will be a witness among you, for it has heard all that was said to it by the Lord, whatever he spoke to us today; and it will be a witness among you at the last of the days, whenever you lie to the Lord my God.
Joshua 24:28 And Jesus sent the people away, and each went to his place.
Joshua 24:29 And Israel served the Lord all the days of Jesus and all the days of the elders who prolonged their time after Jesus and who saw all the works of the Lord which he did for Israel.
Joshua 24:30 And it happened after those things that Jesus son of Naue, servant of the Lord, died at one hundred and ten years of age.
Joshua 24:31 And they buried him by the boundaries of his lot at Thamnathasachara in the mountain of Ephraim to the north of Mount Gaas;
Joshua 24:31 a There they placed with him in the tomb in which they buried him there the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel at Galgalois when he brought them out of Egypt, as the Lord directed them, and they are there until this day. –
Joshua 24:32 And the sons of Israel brought Joseph's bones up from Egypt and buried them in Sikimois in the portion of the field which Jacob acquired from the Amorites dwelling in Sikimois for a hundred lambs, and he gave it to Joseph as a portion.
Joshua 24:33 And it happened after these things that Eleazar son of Aaron the high priest died and was buried in Gabaath of Phinees his son, which he gave him in the mountain of Ephraim.
Joshua 24:33 a On that day the sons of Israel took the ark of God and carried it about among themselves, and Phinees served as priest in place of Eleazar his father until he died and was buried in his own Gabaath.
Joshua 24:34 And the sons of Israel departed, each to their place and to their own city. And the sons of Israel revered Astarte and Astaroth and the gods of the nations around them; and the Lord delivered them into the hands of Eglom the king of Moab, and he ruled them for eighteen years. # 1 Judges

## Chapter 1

1 Judges 1:1 And it happened after the death of Jesus that the sons of Israel asked in the Lord, saying: Who will go up for us against the Canaanite, taking the lead to fight against him?
1 Judges 1:2 And the Lord said: Judah will go up; behold, I have given the land into his hand.
1 Judges 1:3 And Judah said to Symeon his brother: Come up with me in my lot, and let us fight against the Canaanite, and I too will go with you in your lot. And Symeon went with him.
1 Judges 1:4 And Judah went up, and the Lord gave the Canaanite and the Pherezite into his hand, and he struck them at Bezek, ten thousand men,
1 Judges 1:5 and they found Adonibezek at Bezek and fought against him and struck the Canaanite and the Pherezite.
1 Judges 1:6 And Adonibezek fled, and they pursued after him and took him and cut off the extremities of his hands and his feet.
1 Judges 1:7 And Adonibezek said: Seventy kings, the extremities of their hands and their feet cut off, were gathering what was under my table; as I did, so God has repaid me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
1 Judges 1:8 And the sons of Judah fought in Jerusalem and took it and struck it with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
1 Judges 1:9 And after these things the sons of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanite dwelling in the hill country and the south and the plain.
1 Judges 1:10 And Judah went against the Canaanite dwelling in Chebron, and Chebron came out opposite; but the name of Chebron formerly was Kariatharboksepher. And he struck Sesi and Achiman and Tholmi, offspring of Enak.
1 Judges 1:11 And they went from there against those dwelling in Dabir; and the name of Dabir formerly was City of Letters.
1 Judges 1:12 And Chaleb said: Whoever strikes the City of Letters and takes it first, I will give him Aschan my daughter for a wife.
1 Judges 1:13 And Gothoniel son of Kenez, the younger brother of Chaleb, took it first, and he gave him Aschan his daughter for a wife.
1 Judges 1:14 And it happened as she was going in that he urged her to ask her father for the field, and she murmured upon the beast of burden and cried out from the beast of burden: You have given me away into a land of the south. And Chaleb said to her: What is it for you?
1 Judges 1:15 And Ascha said to him: Give me a blessing, because you have given me away into a land of the south, and you will give me a redemption of water. And Chaleb gave her according to her heart the redemption of the heights and the redemption of the lowlands.
1 Judges 1:16 And the sons of Iobab the Kenite, father-in-law of Moses, went up from the city of palms with the sons of Judah into the wilderness that is in the south by the descent of Arad, and he went and dwelt with the people. –
1 Judges 1:17 And Judah went with Symeon his brother and they struck the Canaanite dwelling in Sepheth and devoted it and destroyed it and called the name of the city Destruction.
1 Judges 1:18 And Judah did not inherit Gaza and its boundary and Ascalon and its boundary and Akkaron and its boundary and Azotus and its surrounding lands.
1 Judges 1:19 And the Lord was with Judah, and he inherited the mountain; because he was not able to inherit those dwelling in the valley, because Rechab had divided it.
1 Judges 1:20 And he gave Chebron to Chaleb, as Moses spoke; and he inherited from there the three cities and removed from there the three sons of Enak.
1 Judges 1:21 And the sons of Benjamin did not remove the Iebusite dwelling in Jerusalem, and the Iebusite dwelt with the sons of Benjamin until this day.
1 Judges 1:22 And the sons of Joseph, they too, went up to Bethel, and Judah with them.
1 Judges 1:23 And the house of Israel encamped against Bethel; but the name of the city formerly was Louza.
1 Judges 1:24 And those keeping watch saw a man going out of the city and took him and said to him: Show us the entrance of the city, and we will deal mercifully with you.
1 Judges 1:25 And he showed them the entrance of the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword, but the man and his kin they sent away.
1 Judges 1:26 And the man departed to the land of the Chettites and built a city there and called its name Louza; that is its name until this day.
1 Judges 1:27 And Manasse did not inherit Baithsan, which is the city of the Scythians, nor its daughter towns nor its surrounding lands, nor Ekthanaad and its daughter towns, nor those dwelling in Dor and its daughter towns, nor those dwelling in Balaam and its daughter towns, nor those dwelling in Magedon and its daughter towns, nor those dwelling in Ieblaam nor its daughter towns; and the Canaanite began to dwell in this land.
1 Judges 1:28 And it happened when Israel grew strong that he put the Canaanite to tribute, and in removing him he did not remove him.
1 Judges 1:29 And Ephraim did not remove the Canaanite dwelling in Gazer; and the Canaanite dwelt in his midst in Gazer and became tribute.
1 Judges 1:30 And Zabulon did not remove those dwelling in Kedron and those dwelling in Enaala; and the Canaanite dwelt in his midst and became tribute.
1 Judges 1:31 And Aser did not remove those dwelling in Akcho, and it became tribute for him, nor those dwelling in Dor and those dwelling in Sidon and those dwelling in Aalaph and Achazib and Chelba and Aphek and Roob.
1 Judges 1:32 And Aser dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite dwelling in the land, because he was unable to remove him.
1 Judges 1:33 And Nephthali did not remove those dwelling in Baithsamys nor those dwelling in Baitheneth, and Israel dwelt in the midst of the Canaanite dwelling in the land; but those dwelling in Baithsamys and Baitheneth became tribute for them.
1 Judges 1:34 And the Amorite pressed the sons of Dan into the mountain, because he did not allow him to go down into the valley.
1 Judges 1:35 And the Amorite began to dwell on the mountain of Myrsinon, where the bears and the foxes are; and the hand of the house of Joseph was heavy upon the Amorite, and he became tribute.
1 Judges 1:36 And the boundary of the Amorite was the Idumaean above Akrabin at the Rock and above.

## Chapter 2

1 Judges 2:1 And an angel of the Lord went up from Galgal to Klauchmon and to Bethel and to the house of Israel and said to them: The Lord, the Lord, brought you up from Egypt and brought you into the land which he swore to your fathers to give you, and said to you: I will not scatter my covenant with you forever;
1 Judges 2:2 and you shall not make a covenant with those settled in this land, nor shall you bow down to their gods, but you shall shatter their carved images and tear down their altars. And you did not listen to my voice when you did these things.
1 Judges 2:3 And I said: I will no longer continue to remove the people whom I said I would destroy from before you, and they will be constraints for you, and their gods will be a stumbling block for you.
1 Judges 2:4 And it happened when the angel of the Lord spoke these words to all Israel that the people raised their voice and wept.
1 Judges 2:5 Therefore the name of that place was called Weeping; and they sacrificed there to the Lord.
1 Judges 2:6 And Jesus sent the people away, and the sons of Israel departed, each to his house and to his inheritance to inherit the land.
1 Judges 2:7 And the people served the Lord all the days of Jesus and all the days of the elders who lived long after Jesus, who knew all the great work of the Lord which he did for Israel.
1 Judges 2:8 And Jesus son of Naue, servant of the Lord, died at one hundred and ten years of age.
1 Judges 2:9 And they buried him within the boundary of his inheritance in Thamnathares in Mount Ephraim to the north of Mount Gaas.
1 Judges 2:10 And all that generation were added to their fathers, and another generation arose after them who did not know the Lord and the work which he did for Israel.
1 Judges 2:11 And the sons of Israel did what was evil before the Lord and served the Baalim.
1 Judges 2:12 And they abandoned the Lord God of their fathers who brought them out of the land of Egypt and went after other gods from the gods of the peoples around them and bowed down to them and provoked the Lord to anger,
1 Judges 2:13 and they abandoned the Lord and served Baal and the Astartes.
1 Judges 2:14 And the Lord was angry with Israel in wrath and delivered them into the hand of plunderers, and they plundered them; and he sold them into the hand of their enemies round about, and they were unable to stand before their enemies.
1 Judges 2:15 In all the things in which they committed harlotry, the hand of the Lord was against them for evils, as the Lord had spoken and as the Lord had sworn, and he pressed them very hard.
1 Judges 2:16 And the Lord raised up judges for them and saved them from the hand of those plundering them.
1 Judges 2:17 And even their judges they did not listen to, because they went whoring after other gods and bowed down to them and provoked the Lord to anger; and they turned aside quickly from the way in which their fathers walked to obey the commandments of the Lord; they did not do thus.
1 Judges 2:18 And because the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge, because the Lord was moved by their groaning before those besieging them and afflicting them.
1 Judges 2:19 And it happened when the judge died that they turned back and again acted more corruptly than their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them; they did not cast aside their practices and did not depart from their hard way.
1 Judges 2:20 And the Lord was angry in wrath with Israel and said: Because this nation abandoned my covenant which I commanded their fathers and did not obey my voice,
1 Judges 2:21 I too will no longer continue to remove a man from before them from the nations which Jesus left and allowed to remain,
1 Judges 2:22 to test Israel by them, whether they keep the way of the Lord to walk in it as their fathers kept it, or not.
1 Judges 2:23 And the Lord allowed these nations to remain, not removing them quickly, and did not deliver them into the hand of Jesus.

## Chapter 3

1 Judges 3:1 And these are the nations Jesus allowed to remain in order to test Israel by them, all those who had not known all the wars of Canaan,
1 Judges 3:2 except on account of the generations of the sons of Israel to teach them war, except that those before them had not known them;
1 Judges 3:3 the five satrapies of the foreigners and all the Canaanite and the Sidonian and the Euaite dwelling in Lebanon from Mount Balaermon as far as Lobohamath.
1 Judges 3:4 And it happened so as to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commandments of the Lord which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
1 Judges 3:5 And the sons of Israel dwelt among the Canaanite and the Chettite and the Amorite and the Pherezite and the Euaite and the Iebusite,
1 Judges 3:6 and took their daughters for themselves as wives and gave their daughters to their sons and served their gods.
1 Judges 3:7 And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord and forgot the Lord their God and served the Baalim and the groves.
1 Judges 3:8 And the Lord was angry in wrath with Israel and sold them into the hands of Chousarsathom king of Syria of the Rivers, and they served him eight years.
1 Judges 3:9 And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord; and the Lord raised up a savior for Israel and saved them, Gothoniel son of Kenez, the younger brother of Chaleb, and he listened to him.
1 Judges 3:10 And the spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel and went out to war; and the Lord delivered Chousarsathom king of Syria into his hand, and his hand became strong against Chousarsathom.
1 Judges 3:11 And the land was quiet fifty years; and Gothoniel son of Kenez died.
1 Judges 3:12 And the sons of Israel again did evil before the Lord. And the Lord strengthened Eglom king of Moab against Israel because they had done evil before the Lord.
1 Judges 3:13 And he brought to him all the sons of Ammon and Amalek, and he went and struck Israel and inherited the city of palms.
1 Judges 3:14 And the sons of Israel served Eglom king of Moab eighteen years.
1 Judges 3:15 And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord; and the Lord raised up for them a savior, Aod son of Gera son of the Iemeni, a man right-handed on both sides. And the sons of Israel sent gifts by his hand to Eglom king of Moab.
1 Judges 3:16 And Aod made for himself a double-edged knife, a span in length, and girded it under his cloak on his right thigh.
1 Judges 3:17 And he brought the gifts to Eglom king of Moab; and Eglom was a very handsome man.
1 Judges 3:18 And it happened when Aod finished bringing the gifts that he sent away those carrying the gifts.
1 Judges 3:19 And Eglom turned back from the carved images near Galgal, and Aod said: I have a secret word for you, king. And Eglom said to all: Out from the midst; and all those standing by him went out from him.
1 Judges 3:20 And Aod entered to him, and he was sitting in his summer upper room, utterly alone. And Aod said: I have a word of God for you, king; and Eglom rose from the throne near him.
1 Judges 3:21 And it happened as he rose that Aod stretched out his left hand and took the knife from his right thigh and thrust it into Eglom's belly,
1 Judges 3:22 and he brought in even the handle behind the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, because he did not pull the knife out of his belly.
1 Judges 3:23 And Aod went out into the porch and closed the doors of the upper room upon him and wedged them shut;
1 Judges 3:24 and he went out. And his servants entered and saw, and behold, the doors of the upper room were shut, and they said: Perhaps he is sitting at stools in the withdrawal of the bedchamber?
1 Judges 3:25 And they waited until they were ashamed, and behold, there was no one opening the doors of the upper room; and they took the key and opened, and behold, their lord lay fallen upon the ground, dead.
1 Judges 3:26 And Aod escaped while they were disturbed, and there was no one attending to him; and he passed the carved images and escaped to Seirotha.
1 Judges 3:27 And it happened when he came that he sounded a horn on Mount Ephraim; and the sons of Israel went down with him, and he before them.
1 Judges 3:28 And he said to them: Go down after me, because the Lord God has delivered your enemies, Moab, into your hand. And they went down after him and seized ahead of time the crossings of the Jordan of Moab and did not allow a man to cross.
1 Judges 3:29 And they struck Moab at that time, about ten thousand men, all the fighters among them and every man of strength, and not a man escaped.
1 Judges 3:30 And Moab was put to shame on that day under the hand of Israel, and the land was quiet eighty years, and Aod judged them until he died.
1 Judges 3:31 And after him Samegar son of Anath arose and struck the foreigners, six hundred men apart from calves of the cattle; and he saved Israel.

## Chapter 4

1 Judges 4:1 And the sons of Israel again did evil before the Lord.
1 Judges 4:2 And the Lord sold them into the hand of Iabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Asor; and the ruler of his force was Sisara, and he dwelt in Arisoth of the nations.
1 Judges 4:3 And the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord, because he had nine hundred iron chariots, and he pressed Israel forcefully for twenty years.
1 Judges 4:4 And Debbora, a woman prophet, the wife of Laphidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
1 Judges 4:5 And she sat under the palm of Debbora between Rama and Bethel in Mount Ephraim, and the sons of Israel went up to her there to be judged.
1 Judges 4:6 And Debbora sent and called Barak son of Abineem from Kedes of Nephthali and said to him: Did not the Lord the God of Israel command you, and you shall go to Mount Thabor and take with yourself ten thousand men from the sons of Nephthali and from the sons of Zabulon?
1 Judges 4:7 And I will lead to you at the torrent Kison Sisara, ruler of Iabin's force, and his chariots and his multitude, and I will deliver him into your hand.
1 Judges 4:8 And Barak said to her: If you go with me, I will go, and if you do not go with me, I will not go; for I do not know the day on which the Lord prospers the angel with me.
1 Judges 4:9 And Debbora said to him: Going, I will go with you; only know that your precedence will not be in the way on which you go, because the Lord will deliver Sisara into the hand of a woman. And Debbora arose and went with Barak to Kedes.
1 Judges 4:10 And Barak gave orders to Zabulon and Nephthali at Kedes, and ten thousand men went up at his heels; and Debbora went up with him.
1 Judges 4:11 And the neighbors of the Kenite separated from the sons of Iobab, father-in-law of Moses, and he pitched his tent by the oak of those resting, which is next to Kedes.
1 Judges 4:12 And they reported to Sisara that Barak son of Abineem had gone up onto Mount Thabor.
1 Judges 4:13 And Sisara summoned all his chariots [for he had nine hundred iron chariots] and all the people with him from Arisoth of the nations to the torrent Kison.
1 Judges 4:14 And Debbora said to Barak: Arise, for this is the day on which the Lord has delivered Sisara into your hand; behold, will not the Lord go before you? And Barak went down from Mount Thabor and ten thousand men after him.
1 Judges 4:15 And the Lord threw Sisara and all his chariots and all his camp into confusion by the edge of the sword before Barak; and Sisara got down from his chariot and fled on his feet.
1 Judges 4:16 And Barak pursued after the chariots and after the camp as far as the forest of the nations; and all the camp of Sisara fell by the edge of the sword; not one was left.
1 Judges 4:17 And Sisara withdrew on his feet to the tent of Iael wife of Chaber the Kenite, because there was peace between Iabin king of Asor and the house of Chaber the Kenite.
1 Judges 4:18 And Iael went out to meet Sisara and said to him: Turn aside, my lord, turn aside to me, do not fear; and he turned aside to her into the tent, and she covered him with her hide covering.
1 Judges 4:19 And Sisara said to her: Give me, please, a little water to drink, for I am thirsty; and she opened the skin of milk and gave him drink and covered his face.
1 Judges 4:20 And he said to her: Stand at the door of the tent, and it will be that if someone comes to you and asks you and says to you, Is there a man here? you shall say, There is not; and she covered him with her hide covering.
1 Judges 4:21 And Iael wife of Chaber took the tent peg and placed the hammer in her hand and came in to him quietly and drove the peg into his jaw and drove it through into the ground, and he twitched between her knees and expired and died.
1 Judges 4:22 And behold, Barak was pursuing Sisara, and Iael went out to meet him and said to him: Come and I will show you the man whom you seek. And he entered to her, and behold, Sisara lay dead, and the peg was in his jaw.
1 Judges 4:23 And the Lord God humbled Iabin king of Canaan on that day before the sons of Israel.
1 Judges 4:24 And the hand of the sons of Israel went on, going and growing hard against Iabin king of Canaan, until they destroyed him.

## Chapter 5

1 Judges 5:1 And Debbora and Barak son of Abineem sang on that day and said:
1 Judges 5:2 When leaders began to lead in Israel, when the people chose, bless the Lord.
1 Judges 5:3 Hear, kings; give ear, mighty satraps; I will sing to the Lord, I will make music to the God of Israel.
1 Judges 5:4 Lord, at your going out from Seir, at your departing from the field of Edom, the earth shook, and heaven was astonished, and the clouds dripped water;
1 Judges 5:5 mountains were shaken before the Lord, this Sinai before the Lord God of Israel.
1 Judges 5:6 In the days of Samegar son of Anath, in the days of Iael, kings failed and they traveled paths, they traveled twisted roads.
1 Judges 5:7 One speaking failed in Israel, failed, until Debbora arose, because a mother arose in Israel.
1 Judges 5:8 They chose new gods as barley bread; a covering, if I see, of siromastai among forty thousands.
1 Judges 5:9 My heart is upon those appointed for Israel; mighty ones of the people, bless the Lord.
1 Judges 5:10 Those mounted on beasts of burden, those seated upon covered carriages,
1 Judges 5:11 utter a voice of those playing among those rejoicing; there they will give righteousness to the Lord. Righteous ones grew strong in Israel; then the people of the Lord went down to their cities.
1 Judges 5:12 Awake, awake, Debbora, awaken myriads with the people, awake, awake, speak with song; being strong arise, Barak, and strengthen Barak, Debbora; take captive your captivity, son of Abineem.
1 Judges 5:13 When was his strength magnified? Lord, humble for me those stronger than I.
1 Judges 5:14 The people of Ephraim took vengeance on them in the valley of your brother Benjamin among your peoples. From me Machir those searching went down, and from Zabulon the Lord fought for me among the mighty, from there with a scepter of one strengthening leadership.
1 Judges 5:15 Among Issachar with Debbora he sent his foot soldiers into the valley. Why do you dwell in the midst of lips? He stretched out at his feet. Among the divisions of Rouben were great examinations of heart.
1 Judges 5:16 Why do you sit for me among the mosphathaim to listen to the whistles of those awakening? To pass into the things of Rouben were great tracings of heart.
1 Judges 5:17 Galaad encamped beyond the Jordan; and Dan, why does he sojourn among ships? Aser sojourned by the shore of seas and encamped at his openings.
1 Judges 5:18 Zabulon, a people who reproached his soul unto death, and Nephthali upon the heights of the field.
1 Judges 5:19 Kings came and drew up for battle. Then kings of Canaan fought at Thennach by the water of Mageddo; they took no gain of silver.
1 Judges 5:20 From heaven the stars fought, from their array they fought with Sisara.
1 Judges 5:21 The torrent Kison cast them out, the torrent kademim, the torrent Kison; my strong soul will trample them.
1 Judges 5:22 Then the heels of a horse were cut off, amadaroth of his mighty ones.
1 Judges 5:23 Curse Maroz, said the angel of the Lord, curse with a curse its inhabitants, because they did not come to the help of the Lord; our helper is the Lord, mighty among fighters.
1 Judges 5:24 May Iael wife of Chaber the Kenite be blessed among women, among women in a tent may she be blessed.
1 Judges 5:25 He asked her for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl of mighty ones she brought butter near.
1 Judges 5:26 She stretched out her left hand to a peg, her right to cuttings of those who strike, and she cut Sisara, rubbed away his head and crushed and drove through his jaw.
1 Judges 5:27 Between her feet, bending down, he fell, he lay down between her feet; where he bent down, there he fell, wretched.
1 Judges 5:28 Through the little window the mother of Sisara peered, looking through the lattice at those returning with Sisara: Why was his chariot so late in arriving? Why were the tracks of his chariots delayed?
1 Judges 5:29 Wise women among her rulers answered her, and she answered with her own words:
1 Judges 5:30 Will they not find him dividing spoils? Being friendly with friends for the head of a mighty one; spoils of dyed things for Sisara, spoils of dyed things of varied work, a dye of varied things around his neck as spoil.
1 Judges 5:31 Thus may all your enemies perish, Lord; and those who love him, like the rising of the sun in his powers. And the land was quiet forty years.

## Chapter 6

1 Judges 6:1 And the sons of Israel did evil before the Lord, and the Lord delivered them into the hand of Madiam for seven years.
1 Judges 6:2 And the hand of Madiam prevailed over Israel; and the sons of Israel made for themselves, because of Madiam, enclosures in the mountains and the caves and the strongholds.
1 Judges 6:3 And it happened whenever a man of Israel sowed that Madiam and Amalek and the sons of the east went up against him;
1 Judges 6:4 and they encamped against them and destroyed the produce of the land as far as Gaza, and they left no subsistence of life in Israel, nor flock nor calf nor donkey;
1 Judges 6:5 because they and their cattle went up and carried their tents along and arrived in number like locusts, and neither they nor their camels had a number, and they arrived in the land of Israel to destroy it.
1 Judges 6:6 And Israel became very poor because of Madiam, and the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord.
1 Judges 6:7 And it happened when the sons of Israel cried out to the Lord because of Madiam
1 Judges 6:8 that the Lord sent a man, a prophet, to the sons of Israel, and he said to them: Thus says the Lord the God of Israel: I am the one who brought you up from Egypt, and I brought you out of a house of slavery
1 Judges 6:9 and rescued you from the hand of Egypt and from the hand of all those oppressing you and drove them out from before you and gave you their land,
1 Judges 6:10 and I said to you: I am the Lord your God; you shall not fear the gods of the Amorite among whom you dwell in their land. And you did not listen to my voice.
1 Judges 6:11 And an angel of the Lord came and sat under the oak that was in Ephratha belonging to Ioas father of Abiezri, and Gedeon his son was beating wheat with a rod in a winepress to escape from Madiam.
1 Judges 6:12 And an angel of the Lord appeared to him and said to him: The Lord is with you, mighty in strength.
1 Judges 6:13 And Gedeon said to him: In me, lord, and if the Lord is with us, why have all these evils found us? And where are all his wonders which our fathers recounted to us, saying: Did not the Lord bring us up from Egypt? And now he has cast us off and delivered us into the hand of Madiam.
1 Judges 6:14 And the angel of the Lord looked upon him and said to him: Go in your strength and you will save Israel, and behold, I have sent you.
1 Judges 6:15 And Gedeon said to him: In me, lord, by what shall I save Israel? Behold, my thousand is the lowest in Manasse, and I am small in my father's house.
1 Judges 6:16 And the angel of the Lord said to him: The Lord will be with you, and you will strike Madiam as one man.
1 Judges 6:17 And Gedeon said to him: And if I have found favor in your eyes, you will make for me a sign that you are speaking with me;
1 Judges 6:18 do not move from here until I come to you, and I will bring my sacrifice and place it before you. And he said: I am; I will sit until you return.
1 Judges 6:19 And Gedeon entered and made a kid of the goats and unleavened bread from an oiphi of flour, and placed the meat upon the basket and poured the broth into a pot and brought it out to him under the oak and bowed down.
1 Judges 6:20 And the angel of the Lord said to him: Take the meat and the unleavened loaves and put them by that rock and pour out the broth; and he did so.
1 Judges 6:21 And the angel of the Lord stretched out the end of the staff in his hand and touched the meat and the unleavened bread, and fire was kindled from the rock and devoured the meat and the unleavened bread; and the angel of the Lord departed from his sight.
1 Judges 6:22 And Gedeon saw that it was an angel of the Lord, and Gedeon said: Ah, ah, Lord, Lord, for I saw the angel of the Lord face to face.
1 Judges 6:23 And the Lord said to him: Peace to you; do not fear, do not die.
1 Judges 6:24 And Gedeon built an altar there to the Lord and called it Peace of the Lord; to this day it is still in Ephratha of the father of Ezri.
1 Judges 6:25 And it happened that night that the Lord said to him: Take your father's fattened calf, a seven-year-old calf, and pull down the altar of Baal which belongs to your father and cut down the grove upon it;
1 Judges 6:26 and you shall build an altar to the Lord your God who appeared to you upon the summit of this Mount Maoz in the array, and take the calf and offer a whole burnt offering with the wood of the grove which you will cut down.
1 Judges 6:27 And Gedeon took thirteen men from his servants and did as the Lord spoke to him; and it happened that because he feared his father's house and the men of the city to do it by day, he did it by night.
1 Judges 6:28 And the men of the city rose early in the morning, and behold, the altar of Baal had been torn down and the grove upon it had been cut down and the fattened calf had been offered as a whole burnt offering on the altar that had been built.
1 Judges 6:29 And each man said to his neighbor: Who did this thing? And they examined and searched and said: Gedeon son of Ioas did this thing.
1 Judges 6:30 And the men of the city said to Ioas: Bring out your son and let him die, because he tore down the altar of Baal and cut down the grove upon it.
1 Judges 6:31 And Ioas said to the men standing against him: Are you now pleading a case for Baal? Or are you saving him? Whoever contended against him will die by morning; if he is a god, he himself will vindicate himself because he tore down his altar.
1 Judges 6:32 And he called it on that day Tribunal of Baal, because he tore down his altar.
1 Judges 6:33 And all Madiam and Amalek and the sons of the east gathered together and crossed over and encamped in the valley of Iezrael.
1 Judges 6:34 And a spirit of God clothed Gedeon, and he sounded a horn, and Abiezer cried out after him.
1 Judges 6:35 And he sent messengers throughout Manasse, and he too cried out after him; and he sent messengers in Aser and in Zabulon and in Nephthali, and they went up to meet him.
1 Judges 6:36 And Gedeon said to God: If you are saving Israel by my hand, in the manner you spoke,
1 Judges 6:37 behold, I am placing a fleece of wool on the threshing floor, and if dew comes upon the fleece alone and dryness upon all the land, then I will know that you are saving Israel by my hand, in the manner you spoke.
1 Judges 6:38 And it happened thus; and Gedeon rose early the next day and squeezed the fleece, and dew flowed out from the fleece, a full basin of water.
1 Judges 6:39 And Gedeon said to God: Let your wrath not be angry with me, and I will speak once more; and I will test once more with the fleece, and let there be dryness upon the fleece alone, but upon all the land let there be dew.
1 Judges 6:40 And God did thus on that night, and there was dryness upon the fleece alone, but upon all the land there was dew.

## Chapter 7

1 Judges 7:1 And Ierobaal [he is Gedeon] and all the people with him rose early and encamped upon the land of Aroed, and the camp of Madiam and Amalek was north of him from the hill of Abor in the valley.
1 Judges 7:2 And the Lord said to Gedeon: The people with you are too many for me to deliver Madiam into their hand, lest Israel boast against me, saying: My hand saved me.
1 Judges 7:3 And the Lord said to him: Speak, then, in the ears of the people, saying: Who is timid and afraid? Let him turn back. And they set out from Mount Galaad and twenty-two thousand turned back from the people, and ten thousand remained.
1 Judges 7:4 And the Lord said to Gedeon: The people are still many; bring them down to the water, and I will test them for you there; and it will be that whomever I say to you, This one will go with you, he will go with you; and whomever I say to you that he will not go with you, he will not go with you.
1 Judges 7:5 And he brought the people down to the water; and the Lord said to Gedeon: Everyone who laps with his tongue from the water as the dog laps, you shall stand him alone, and everyone who bends upon his knees to drink, you shall set him apart by himself.
1 Judges 7:6 And the whole number of those who lapped with their tongue was three hundred men, and all the rest of the people bent upon their knees to drink water.
1 Judges 7:7 And the Lord said to Gedeon: By the three hundred men who lapped I will save you and deliver Madiam into your hand, and let all the people run back, each man to his place.
1 Judges 7:8 And they took the people's provisions in their hand and their horns, and he sent every man of Israel to his dwelling, each man, but retained the three hundred men. And the camp of Madiam was below him in the valley.
1 Judges 7:9 And it happened on that night that the Lord said to him: Arise, go down quickly from here into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand;
1 Judges 7:10 but if you fear to go down, go down, you and Phara your young servant, into the camp
1 Judges 7:11 and you will hear what they are saying; and after these things your hands will be strong, and you will go down into the camp. And he and Phara his young servant went down to a part of the fifty in the camp.
1 Judges 7:12 And Madiam and Amalek and all the sons of the east had encamped in the valley, numerous as locusts, and their camels had no number, but were as the sand upon the shore of the sea in multitude.
1 Judges 7:13 And Gedeon entered, and behold, a man was recounting a dream to his neighbor and said: Behold the dream I dreamed: a cake of barley bread was rolling in the camp of Madiam and came as far as the tent of Madiam and struck it and overturned it, and the tent fell.
1 Judges 7:14 And his neighbor answered and said: This is nothing other than the sword of Gedeon son of Ioas, a man of Israel; the Lord has delivered Madiam and all the camp into his hand.
1 Judges 7:15 And it happened when Gedeon heard the recounting of the dream and its interpretation that he bowed down to the Lord and returned to the camp of Israel and said: Arise, for the Lord has delivered the camp of Madiam into your hands.
1 Judges 7:16 And he divided the three hundred men into three groups and gave horns into the hands of all and empty jars and torches in the midst of the jars
1 Judges 7:17 and said to them: Watch me and do likewise; and behold, I am entering into the midst of the camp, and it will be that as I do, so you shall do;
1 Judges 7:18 and I and all those with me will sound the horn, and you too shall sound the horns around the camp and say: For the Lord and for Gedeon.
1 Judges 7:19 And Gedeon and a hundred men with him entered a part of the camp as the middle watch began; but he woke the guards with a waking, and they sounded the horns and shook out the jars in their hands.
1 Judges 7:20 And the three groups sounded the horns and broke the jars and took the torches in their left hand, and in their right hand the horns to sound, and cried out: A sword for the Lord and for Gedeon.
1 Judges 7:21 And each stood by himself around the camp, and all the camp ran and sounded a signal and fled.
1 Judges 7:22 And the three hundred horns sounded, and the Lord set each man's sword against his neighbor throughout the camp, and the camp fled as far as Baithasetta and gathered as far as the edge of Abelmeoula and toward Tabath.
1 Judges 7:23 And a man of Israel cried out from Nephthali and from Aser and from all Manasse, and they pursued after Madiam.
1 Judges 7:24 And Gedeon sent messengers throughout the boundary of Ephraim, saying: Go down to meet Madiam and seize for yourselves the water as far as Baithbera and the Jordan; and every man of Ephraim cried out and they seized the water ahead of them as far as Baithbera and the Jordan.
1 Judges 7:25 And they captured the two rulers of Madiam, Oreb and Zeb, and killed Oreb at Sourin and killed Zeb at Iakephzeb and pursued Madiam; and they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeb to Gedeon from beyond the Jordan.

## Chapter 8

1 Judges 8:1 And a man of Ephraim said to him: What is this thing you have done to us by not calling us when you went out to fight against Madiam? And they disputed strongly with him.
1 Judges 8:2 And he said to them: What have I done now like you? Are not the gleanings of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
1 Judges 8:3 Into your hands the Lord delivered the rulers of Madiam, Oreb and Zeb; and what was I able to do like you? And they ceased. Then their spirit relaxed from him when he spoke this word.
1 Judges 8:4 And Gedeon came to the Jordan, and he and the three hundred men with him crossed, fainthearted and hungry.
1 Judges 8:5 And he said to the men of Sokchoth: Give, please, loaves to the people with me, because they are hungry, and I am pursuing Zebee and Salmana, kings of Madiam.
1 Judges 8:6 And the rulers of Sokchoth said: Is the hand of Zebee and Salmana now in your hand, that we should give loaves to your army?
1 Judges 8:7 And Gedeon said: Not so; when the Lord gives Zebee and Salmana into my hand, I will card your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with the barkonnim.
1 Judges 8:8 And he went up from there to Phanouel and spoke to them in the same way, and the men of Phanouel answered him in the manner the men of Sokchoth answered him.
1 Judges 8:9 And he said to the men of Phanouel: When I return in peace I will tear down this tower. –
1 Judges 8:10 And Zebee and Salmana were in Karkar, and their camp with them, about fifteen thousand, those left in all the camp of the sons of the east, and those who had fallen were one hundred and twenty thousand men who drew the sword.
1 Judges 8:11 And Gedeon went up by the way of those dwelling in tents east of Nabeth opposite Zebee; and he struck the camp, while the camp was confident.
1 Judges 8:12 And Zebee and Salmana fled, and he pursued after them and seized the two kings of Madiam, Zebee and Salmana, and crushed all their camp. –
1 Judges 8:13 And Gedeon son of Ioas returned from the war by the ascent of Ares.
1 Judges 8:14 And they captured a young man from the men of Sokchoth, and he questioned him, and he wrote down for them the rulers of Sokchoth and its elders, seventy-seven men.
1 Judges 8:15 And Gedeon came to the rulers of Sokchoth and said to them: Behold Zebee and Salmana, on whose account you reproached me, saying: Is the hand of Zebee and Salmana now in your hand, that we should give loaves to your exhausted men?
1 Judges 8:16 And he took the rulers and the elders of the city and carded them with the thorns of the wilderness and the barakenim, and with them carded the men of Sokchoth.
1 Judges 8:17 And he tore down the tower of Phanouel and killed the men of the city. –
1 Judges 8:18 And he said to Zebee and Salmana: Where are the men whom you killed at Thabor? And they said: Like you, resembling you, resembling them, like the appearance of the form of sons of kings.
1 Judges 8:19 And Gedeon said: They are my brothers and sons of my mother. And he swore to them: As the Lord lives, if you had kept them alive, I would not have killed you.
1 Judges 8:20 And he said to Iether his firstborn: Rise and kill them; and his young son did not draw his knife, because he was afraid, because he was younger.
1 Judges 8:21 And Zebee and Salmana said: Rise, please, yourself and meet us, for as a man is, so is his strength. And Gedeon arose and killed Zebee and Salmana and took the crescents that were on the necks of their camels.
1 Judges 8:22 And a man of Israel said to Gedeon: Rule among us, you and your sons, because you saved us from the hand of Madiam.
1 Judges 8:23 And Gedeon said to them: I will not rule over you, and my son will not rule over you; the Lord will rule over you.
1 Judges 8:24 And Gedeon said to them: I will ask a request of you: Each man give me an earring from his spoils; for they had many gold earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.
1 Judges 8:25 And they said: Giving, we will give. And he spread out his cloak, and each man cast there a gold earring from his spoils.
1 Judges 8:26 And the weight of the gold earrings which he asked for was one thousand seven hundred shekels of gold, apart from the sirones and the little chains emphoth and the purple cloaks upon the kings of Madiam and apart from the gold collars on the necks of their camels.
1 Judges 8:27 And Gedeon made it into an ephoud and set it in his city in Ephratha; and all Israel went whoring after it there, and it became a stumbling block to Gedeon and his house.
1 Judges 8:28 And Madiam was put to shame before the sons of Israel and no longer raised its head. And the land was quiet forty years in the days of Gedeon. –
1 Judges 8:29 And Ierobaal son of Ioas went and dwelt in his house.
1 Judges 8:30 And Gedeon had seventy sons who came out of his thighs, for he had many wives.
1 Judges 8:31 And his concubine in Sikimois also bore him a son, and he gave him the name Abimelech.
1 Judges 8:32 And Gedeon son of Ioas died in a good old age and was buried in the tomb of Ioas his father in Ephratha of the father of Abiezri.
1 Judges 8:33 And it happened when Gedeon died that the sons of Israel turned back and went whoring after the Baalim and set Baalberith for themselves as a covenant, to be their god.
1 Judges 8:34 And the sons of Israel did not remember the Lord their God who rescued them from the hand of all their enemies round about.
1 Judges 8:35 And they did not show mercy to the house of Ierobaal Gedeon according to all the goodness which he had done with Israel.

## Chapter 9

1 Judges 9:1 And Abimelech son of Ierobaal went to Sikima to his mother's brothers and spoke to them and to all the kin of his mother's house, saying:
1 Judges 9:2 Speak, please, in the ears of the men of Sikimois: Which is better, for seventy men, all the sons of Ierobaal, to rule over you, or for one man to have dominion over you? And remember that I am your flesh and your bone.
1 Judges 9:3 And his mother's brothers spoke about him in the ears of all the men of Sikimois all these words, and their heart inclined after Abimelech, because they said: He is our brother.
1 Judges 9:4 And they gave him seventy pieces of silver from the house of Baal of the Covenant, and Abimelech hired with them empty and bewildered men, and they went after him.
1 Judges 9:5 And he entered his father's house in Ephratha and killed his brothers, the sons of Ierobaal, seventy men upon one stone; and Ioatham son of Ierobaal, the youngest, remained, because he hid.
1 Judges 9:6 And all the men of Sikimois and all the house of Maallon gathered and went and made Abimelech king by the acorn of the station in Sikimois.
1 Judges 9:7 And they reported to Ioatham, and he went and stood on the summit of Mount Garizin and raised his voice and called and said to them: Hear me, men of Sikimois, and may God hear you.
1 Judges 9:8 Going, the trees went to anoint a king for themselves and said to the olive tree: Reign over us.
1 Judges 9:9 And the olive tree said to them: Having left my fatness, by which God and people were glorified in me, shall I go to rule the trees?
1 Judges 9:10 And the trees said to the fig tree: Come, reign over us.
1 Judges 9:11 And the fig tree said to them: Having left my sweetness and my good fruit, shall I go to rule over trees?
1 Judges 9:12 And the trees said to the vine: Come, reign over us.
1 Judges 9:13 And the vine said to them: Having left my wine, the gladness from the God of men, shall I go to rule trees?
1 Judges 9:14 And the trees said to the bramble: Come, you reign over us.
