## Chapter 9

1 Chronicles 9:1 And all Israel, their enrollment, and these were recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah with those deported to Babylon for their lawless deeds.
1 Chronicles 9:2 And the first inhabitants in their holdings in the cities: Israel, the priests, the Levites and those given.
1 Chronicles 9:3 And in Jerusalem there dwelt some of the sons of Judah and of the sons of Benjamin and of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
1 Chronicles 9:4 Gothi son of Ammioud son of Amri son of the sons of Phares son of Judah.
1 Chronicles 9:5 And of the Selonites: Asaia his firstborn and his sons.
1 Chronicles 9:6 Of the sons of Zara: Jiel and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.
1 Chronicles 9:7 And of the sons of Benjamin: Salo son of Mosollam son of Odouia son of Sanaa
1 Chronicles 9:8 and Ibanaa son of Iraam, and these were sons of Ozi son of Machir; and Massalem son of Saphatia son of Ragouel son of Banaia
1 Chronicles 9:9 and their brothers according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six, all men rulers of families by their family houses.
1 Chronicles 9:10 And of the priests: Jodae and Joarim and Jachin
1 Chronicles 9:11 and Azarias son of Chelkias son of Mosollam son of Sadok son of Maraioth son of Achitob, leader of the house of God,
1 Chronicles 9:12 and Adaia son of Iraam son of Paschor son of Malchias and Maasaias son of Adiel son of Jediou son of Mosollam son of Maselmoth son of Emmer,
1 Chronicles 9:13 and their brothers, rulers of family houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty mighty in strength for the work of the service of the house of God.
1 Chronicles 9:14 And of the Levites: Samaia son of Asob son of Esrikam son of Asabia, of the sons of Merari,
1 Chronicles 9:15 and Bakbakar and Ares and Galal and Manthanias son of Micha son of Zechri son of Asaph,
1 Chronicles 9:16 and Abdia son of Samia son of Galal son of Idithon and Barachias son of Ossa son of Elkana, who dwelt in the villages of Netophathi.
1 Chronicles 9:17 The gatekeepers: Salom and Akoub and Talman and Aiman and their brothers, Salom the ruler;
1 Chronicles 9:18 and until then at the king's gate to the east; these were the gates of the camps of the sons of Levi.
1 Chronicles 9:19 And Salom son of Kore son of Abiasaph son of Kore and his brothers in his father's house, the Korites, over the works of service guarding the watches of the tent, and their fathers over the camp of the Lord guarding the entrance.
1 Chronicles 9:20 And Phinees son of Eleazar was leader over them before, and these were with him.
1 Chronicles 9:21 Zacharias son of Masalami was gatekeeper of the entrance of the tent of testimony.
1 Chronicles 9:22 All the chosen at the gates, at the gates, were two hundred twelve; these were in their courts, their enrollment; David and Samuel the seer appointed them in their faithfulness.
1 Chronicles 9:23 And they and their sons were over the gates in the house of the Lord, in the house of the tent, to guard it.
1 Chronicles 9:24 The gates were toward the four winds, east, sea, north, south.
1 Chronicles 9:25 And their brothers in their courts were to come in every seven days from time to time with these;
1 Chronicles 9:26 for four mighty men of the gates were in trust. The Levites were over the chambers and the treasuries of the house of God,
1 Chronicles 9:27 and they encamped around the house of God, for the guard was upon them, and they were over the keys to open the doors of the sanctuary morning by morning.
1 Chronicles 9:28 And some of them were over the vessels of service, for they brought them in by number and brought them out by number.
1 Chronicles 9:29 And some of them were appointed over the vessels and all the holy vessels and over the fine flour, wine, oil, frankincense and spices.
1 Chronicles 9:30 And some of the sons of the priests were makers of ointment for the ointment and for the spices.
1 Chronicles 9:31 And Mattathias of the Levites [he was the firstborn of Salom the Korite] was in trust over the work of the offering of the pan of the high priest.
1 Chronicles 9:32 And Banaia the Kaathite of their brothers was over the bread of the presentation to prepare it sabbath by sabbath.
1 Chronicles 9:33 And these were singers, rulers of the families of the Levites, assigned daily divisions, for day and night they had the work;
1 Chronicles 9:34 these were rulers of the families of the Levites according to their generations, rulers; they dwelt in Jerusalem.
1 Chronicles 9:35 And in Gabaon dwelt Jiel father of Gabaon, and his wife's name was Moocha;
1 Chronicles 9:36 and his firstborn son was Abadon, and Sir and Kis and Baal and Ner and Nadab
1 Chronicles 9:37 and Gedour and a brother and Zacharias and Makelloth.
1 Chronicles 9:38 And Makelloth fathered Samaa. And these dwelt among their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.
1 Chronicles 9:39 And Ner fathered Kis, and Kis fathered Saoul, and Saoul fathered Jonathan and Melchisoue and Aminadab and Isbaal.
1 Chronicles 9:40 And Jonathan's son was Maribaal, and Maribaal fathered Micha.
1 Chronicles 9:41 And sons of Micha: Phaithon and Malach and Tharach.
1 Chronicles 9:42 And Achaz fathered Jada, and Jada fathered Galemeth and Gazmoth and Zambri, and Zambri fathered Masa,
1 Chronicles 9:43 and Masa fathered Baana, Raphaia his son, Eleasa his son, Esel his son.
1 Chronicles 9:44 And Esel had six sons, and these were their names: Esdrikam his firstborn, Ismael and Saria and Abdia and Anan; these were sons of Esel.

## Chapter 10

1 Chronicles 10:1 And foreigners fought against Israel, and Israel fled from before the foreigners, and wounded men fell on Mount Gelboue.
1 Chronicles 10:2 And foreigners pursued after Saul and after his sons, and foreigners struck Jonathan and Aminadab and Melchisue, sons of Saul.
1 Chronicles 10:3 And the battle became heavy upon Saul, and the archers found him with bows and pains, and he was pained from the bows.
1 Chronicles 10:4 And Saul said to the one bearing his gear, “Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised come and mock me.” And the one bearing his gear was unwilling, because he feared greatly; and Saul took the sword and fell upon it.
1 Chronicles 10:5 And the one bearing his gear saw that Saul had died, and he too fell upon his sword and died.
1 Chronicles 10:6 And Saul and his three sons died on that day, and all his house died together.
1 Chronicles 10:7 And every man of Israel who was in the valley saw that Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, and they abandoned their cities and fled; and foreigners came and settled in them. —
1 Chronicles 10:8 And it came to pass on the next day that foreigners came to strip the wounded, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gelboue.
1 Chronicles 10:9 And they stripped him, and took his head and his gear, and sent them around to the land of the foreigners, to announce good news to their idols and to the people.
1 Chronicles 10:10 And they put his gear in the house of their god, and they put his head in the house of Dagon.
1 Chronicles 10:11 And all the inhabitants of all Galaad heard all that the foreigners had done to Saul and to Israel.
1 Chronicles 10:12 And every valiant man arose from Galaad, and they took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabis, and buried their bones beneath the oak in Jabis, and they fasted seven days. —
1 Chronicles 10:13 And Saul died in his iniquities, which he had committed against the Lord, according to the word of the Lord, because he did not keep it; because Saul inquired at the ventriloquist, to inquire, and Samuel the prophet answered him;
1 Chronicles 10:14 and he did not seek the Lord, and he slew him, and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.

## Chapter 11

1 Chronicles 11:1 And all Israel came to David at Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bones and your flesh.
1 Chronicles 11:2 And yesterday and the third day, when Saul was king, you were the one leading out and bringing in Israel; and the Lord your God said to you, ‘You shall shepherd my people Israel, and you shall be a leader over Israel.’”
1 Chronicles 11:3 And all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David as king over Israel according to the word of the Lord through the hand of Samuel.
1 Chronicles 11:4 And the king and the men of Israel went to Jerusalem [this is Jebus], and there were the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land.
1 Chronicles 11:5 And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You shall not enter here.” And he captured the stronghold of Zion [this is the city of David].
1 Chronicles 11:6 And David said, “Everyone striking a Jebusite first shall become ruler and commander.” And Joab son of Sarouia went up against it first, and became ruler.
1 Chronicles 11:7 And David dwelt in the stronghold; on account of this he called it City of David.
1 Chronicles 11:8 And he built the city round about; and he fought and took the city.
1 Chronicles 11:9 And David went on, going and becoming great, and the Lord Almighty was with him.
1 Chronicles 11:10 And these are the rulers of the mighty men who were with David, those strengthening with him in his kingdom, with all Israel, to make him king according to the word of the Lord over Israel.
1 Chronicles 11:11 And this is the number of David’s mighty men: Jesebaal son of Achamani, first of the thirty; he drew his sword once against three hundred wounded men at one time. —
1 Chronicles 11:12 And after him, Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite; he was among the three mighty men.
1 Chronicles 11:13 He was with David at Phasodomin, and the foreigners gathered there for war, and a portion of the field was full of barley, and the people fled from before the foreigners;
1 Chronicles 11:14 and he stood in the midst of the portion and saved it, and struck the foreigners, and the Lord worked a great salvation. —
1 Chronicles 11:15 And three of the thirty rulers went down to the rock, to David, to the cave of Odollam, and the camp of the foreigners had encamped in the valley of the giants.
1 Chronicles 11:16 And David was then in the stronghold, and the troop of the foreigners was then in Bethlehem.
1 Chronicles 11:17 And David desired and said, “Who will give me water from the well of Bethlehem, the one at the gate?”
1 Chronicles 11:18 And the three broke through the camp of the foreigners and drew water from the well in Bethlehem, the one at the gate, and took it and came to David; and David was unwilling to drink it, and poured it out as a libation to the Lord.
1 Chronicles 11:19 And he said, “May God be propitious to me to do this thing! Shall I drink the blood of these men with their lives? For with their lives they brought it.” And he was unwilling to drink it. These things the three mighty men did.
1 Chronicles 11:20 And Abessa, brother of Joab, he was ruler of the three; he drew his sword against three hundred wounded men at one time, and he was renowned among the three,
1 Chronicles 11:21 more glorious than the two among the three, and he was their ruler, but he did not come as far as the three. —
1 Chronicles 11:22 And Banaias son of Jodae, son of a mighty man, his works were many above Kabasael; he struck the two Ariel of Moab; and this same one went down and struck the lion in the pit on a day of snow.
1 Chronicles 11:23 And this same one struck the Egyptian man, a visible man of five cubits, and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s shuttle; and Banaias went down against him with a rod, and took the spear from the Egyptian’s hand and killed him with his own spear.
1 Chronicles 11:24 These things Banaias son of Jodae did, and he had a name among the three mighty men.
1 Chronicles 11:25 He was more glorious than the thirty, but he did not come to the three; and David appointed him over his clan.
1 Chronicles 11:26 And mighty men of the armies: Asael brother of Joab, Eleanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,
1 Chronicles 11:27 Sammoth the Adi, Chelles the Pheloni,
1 Chronicles 11:28 Horai son of Ekke the Thekoi, Abiezer the Anathothi,
1 Chronicles 11:29 Sobochai the Asothi, Eli the Ahoi,
1 Chronicles 11:30 Moorai the Netophathi, Cholod son of Nooza the Netophathi,
1 Chronicles 11:31 Aithi son of Ribai from the hill of Benjamin, Banaias the Pharathoni,
1 Chronicles 11:32 Uri from Nachaligaas, Abiel the Garabeththi,
1 Chronicles 11:33 Azmoth the Beermi, Eliaba the Salaboni,
1 Chronicles 11:34 Bennaias, Hosom the Gennouni, Jonathan son of Sola the Arari,
1 Chronicles 11:35 Achim son of Sachar the Arari, Elphal son of Ur,
1 Chronicles 11:36 Opher the Mochorathi, Achia the Pheloni,
1 Chronicles 11:37 Esrai the Charmali, Naarai son of Azobai,
1 Chronicles 11:38 Joel brother of Nathan, Mebaar son of Agari,
1 Chronicles 11:39 Selec the Ammonite, Nachor the Berthi, bearer of the gear of Joab son of Sarouia,
1 Chronicles 11:40 Ira the Jetheri, Gareb the Jetheri,
1 Chronicles 11:41 Urias the Chettite, Zabet son of Achlia,
1 Chronicles 11:42 Adina son of Saiza the Reubenite, a ruler, and thirty were with him,
1 Chronicles 11:43 Anan son of Moacha and Josaphat the Baithani,
1 Chronicles 11:44 Ozia the Astarothi, Samma and Jehiel sons of Chothan the Arari,
