1 Esdras 4:20 A man forsakes his own father who reared him, and his own country, and clings to his own wife;
1 Esdras 4:21 and with his wife he gives up his life, and remembers neither father nor mother nor country.
1 Esdras 4:22 And from this you must know that women rule you; do you not toil and labor and give and bring everything to women?
1 Esdras 4:23 And a man takes his sword and goes out to travel and rob and steal and sail upon the sea and rivers;
1 Esdras 4:24 and he faces the lion and walks in darkness, and when he steals and seizes and strips people, he carries it to his beloved.
1 Esdras 4:25 And a man loves his own wife more than his father and mother;
1 Esdras 4:26 and many went mad in their own minds because of women and became slaves because of them,
1 Esdras 4:27 and many perished and stumbled and sinned because of women.
1 Esdras 4:28 And now do you not believe me? Is the king not great in his authority? Do not all the countries fear to touch him?
1 Esdras 4:29 I was watching him and Apame, daughter of the remarkable Bartakos, the king's concubine, sitting at the king's right,
1 Esdras 4:30 and taking the diadem from the king's head and placing it upon herself, and she was slapping the king with her left hand.
1 Esdras 4:31 And besides these things the king, opening his mouth, was gazing at her; and if she smiles at him, he laughs; but if she becomes embittered against him, he flatters her so that she may be reconciled to him.
1 Esdras 4:32 O men, how are women not strong, since they act thus?
1 Esdras 4:33 And then the king and the magnates looked at one another.—
1 Esdras 4:34 And he began to speak about truth: Men, are women not strong? Great is the earth, and high is heaven, and swift in its course is the sun, because it turns in the circuit of heaven and runs back again to its own place in one day.
1 Esdras 4:35 Is he who does these things not great? And truth is great and stronger than all things.
1 Esdras 4:36 All the earth calls upon truth, and heaven blesses her, and all the works shake and tremble, and there is nothing unjust with him.
1 Esdras 4:37 Unjust is wine, unjust is the king, unjust are women, unjust are all the sons of men, and unjust are all their works, all such things; and there is no truth in them, and in their injustice they will perish.
1 Esdras 4:38 But truth remains and is strong for the age and lives and rules for the age of the age.
1 Esdras 4:39 And with her there is no showing partiality or accepting bribes, but she does what is just apart from all things unjust and evil; and all approve of her works, and there is nothing unjust in her judgment.
1 Esdras 4:40 And hers are the strength and the kingdom and the authority and the greatness of all the ages. Blessed is the God of truth.
1 Esdras 4:41 And he ceased speaking; and all the people then cried out, and then they said, Great is truth, and it prevails.
1 Esdras 4:42 Then the king said to him, Ask whatever you wish, more than the things written, and we will give it to you, since you were found wiser; and you shall sit next to me and shall be called my kinsman.
1 Esdras 4:43 Then he said to the king, Remember the vow which you vowed to build Jerusalem on the day when you received your kingdom,
1 Esdras 4:44 and to send out all the vessels taken from Jerusalem, which Cyrus set apart when he vowed to cut down Babylon, and vowed to send there.
1 Esdras 4:45 And you vowed to build the temple which the Idumeans burned when Judea was desolated by the Chaldeans.
1 Esdras 4:46 And now this is what I request of you, lord king, and what I ask you, and this is the greatness from you; I therefore beg that you perform the vow which you vowed with your mouth to perform for the king of heaven.—
1 Esdras 4:47 Then King Darius rose and kissed him and wrote for him the letters to all the stewards and local rulers and generals and satraps, that they should send him forward and all those with him going up to build Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 4:48 And to all the local rulers in Coele Syria and Phoenicia and those in Lebanon he wrote letters to convey cedar timber from Lebanon to Jerusalem, and that they should build the city with him.
1 Esdras 4:49 And he wrote to all the Judeans going up from the kingdom to Judea concerning their freedom, that no powerful man or satrap or local ruler or steward should come against their doors,
1 Esdras 4:50 and that all the country which they would possess should be free of taxation for them, and that the Idumeans should release the villages of the Judeans which they held,
1 Esdras 4:51 and that twenty talents each year should be given for the building of the temple until it was built,
1 Esdras 4:52 and for whole burnt offerings to be offered upon the altar daily, as they have a command to offer seventeen, another ten talents each year,
1 Esdras 4:53 and that all those coming up from Babylonia to establish the city should have freedom, both they and their children and all the priests coming up.
1 Esdras 4:54 And he also wrote concerning the provision and the priestly robe in which they serve in it.
1 Esdras 4:55 And for the Levites he wrote that the provision should be given until the day when the house was completed and Jerusalem built,
1 Esdras 4:56 and for all those guarding the city he wrote that allotments and wages should be given to them.
1 Esdras 4:57 And he sent out all the vessels which Cyrus set apart from Babylon; and all the things which Cyrus said to do, he himself also commanded to do and send to Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 4:58 And when the young man went out, he lifted his face to heaven toward Jerusalem and blessed the king of heaven, saying,
1 Esdras 4:59 From you is victory, and from you is wisdom, and yours is glory, and I am your servant.
1 Esdras 4:60 Blessed are you, who gave me wisdom; and to you I give thanks, master of the fathers.
1 Esdras 4:61 And he took the letters and went out to Babylon and reported to all his brothers.
1 Esdras 4:62 And they blessed the God of their fathers, because he gave them relief and release
1 Esdras 4:63 to go up and build Jerusalem and the temple upon which his name was named, and they feasted with music and joy seven days.

## Chapter 5

1 Esdras 5:1 And after these things the leaders of family houses were chosen to go up according to their tribes, and their wives and sons and daughters and their male servants and female servants and their livestock.
1 Esdras 5:2 And Darius sent with them a thousand horsemen until they were brought back to Jerusalem with peace and with music, drums and flutes;
1 Esdras 5:3 and all their brothers were playing, and he made them go up together with those.
1 Esdras 5:4 And these are the names of the men going up according to their families into the tribes according to their division.
1 Esdras 5:5 The priests, sons of Phinees son of Aaron: Jesus son of Josedek son of Saraios, and Joakim son of Zorobabel son of Salathiel, from the house of David, from the lineage of Phares, and of the tribe of Judah,
1 Esdras 5:6 who spoke wise words in the time of Darius king of the Persians, in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan, the first month.—
1 Esdras 5:7 And these are those from Judea who came up from the captivity of the sojourning, whom Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon deported to Babylon,
1 Esdras 5:8 and they returned to Jerusalem and the rest of Judea, each to his own city, those who came with Zorobabel and Jesus, Neemias, Zaraios, Resaios, Enenios, Mardochaios, Beelsaros, Aspharasos, Borolios, Roimos, Baana, their leaders.
1 Esdras 5:9 The number of those from the nation and their leaders: sons of Phoros, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
1 Esdras 5:10 Sons of Saphat, four hundred seventy-two. Sons of Aree, seven hundred fifty-six.
1 Esdras 5:11 Sons of Phaathmoab belonging to the sons of Jesus and Joab, two thousand eight hundred twelve.
1 Esdras 5:12 Sons of Olamos, one thousand two hundred fifty-four. Sons of Zatou, nine hundred forty-five. Sons of Chorbe, seven hundred five. Sons of Bani, six hundred forty-eight.
1 Esdras 5:13 Sons of Bebai, six hundred twenty-three. Sons of Asgad, one thousand three hundred twenty-two.
1 Esdras 5:14 Sons of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-seven. Sons of Bagoi, two thousand sixty-six. Sons of Adinos, four hundred fifty-four.
1 Esdras 5:15 Sons of Ater Ezekias, ninety-two. Sons of Kilan and Azetas, sixty-seven. Sons of Azouros, four hundred thirty-two.
1 Esdras 5:16 Sons of Annias, one hundred one. Sons of Arom, sons of Bassai, three hundred twenty-three. Sons of Ariphos, one hundred twelve.
1 Esdras 5:17 Sons of Baiterous, three thousand five. Sons from Baithlomon, one hundred twenty-three.
1 Esdras 5:18 Those from Netebas, fifty-five. Those from Enatos, one hundred fifty-eight. Those from Baitasmon, forty-two.
1 Esdras 5:19 Those from Kariathiarios, twenty-five. Those from Kapira and Berot, seven hundred forty-three.
1 Esdras 5:20 The Chadisai and Ammidioi, four hundred twenty-two. Those from Kiramas and Gabbe, six hundred twenty-one.
1 Esdras 5:21 Those from Makalon, one hundred twenty-two. Those from Baitolio, fifty-two. Sons of Niphis, one hundred fifty-six.
1 Esdras 5:22 Sons of another Kalamo and Onous, seven hundred twenty-five. Sons of Jerecho, three hundred forty-five.
1 Esdras 5:23 Sons of Sanaas, three thousand three hundred thirty.—
1 Esdras 5:24 The priests: sons of Jeddou son of Jesus belonging to the sons of Anasib, nine hundred seventy-two. Sons of Emmeros, one thousand fifty-two.
1 Esdras 5:25 Sons of Phassouros, one thousand two hundred forty-seven. Sons of Charme, one thousand seventeen.—
1 Esdras 5:26 And the Levites: sons of Jesus and Kadmielos and Bannos and Soudios, seventy-four.
1 Esdras 5:27 The temple singers: sons of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.
1 Esdras 5:28 The doorkeepers: sons of Saloum, sons of Atar, sons of Tolman, sons of Akoub, sons of Ateta, sons of Sobai, all one hundred thirty-nine.—
1 Esdras 5:29 The temple servants: sons of Esau, sons of Asipha, sons of Tabaoth, sons of Keras, sons of Soua, sons of Phadaios, sons of Labana, sons of Angaba,
1 Esdras 5:30 sons of Akoud, sons of Outa, sons of Ketab, sons of Agaba, sons of Sybai, sons of Anan, sons of Kathoua, sons of Geddour,
1 Esdras 5:31 sons of Jairos, sons of Daisan, sons of Noeba, sons of Chaseba, sons of Gazera, sons of Ozios, sons of Phinoe, sons of Asara, sons of Basthai, sons of Asana, sons of Maani, sons of Naphisi, sons of Akouph, sons of Achiba, sons of Asour, sons of Pharakim, sons of Basaloth,
1 Esdras 5:32 sons of Meedda, sons of Koutha, sons of Charea, sons of Barchous, sons of Serar, sons of Thomoi, sons of Nasi, sons of Atipha.
1 Esdras 5:33 Sons of Solomon's servants: sons of Assaphioth, sons of Pharida, sons of Jeeli, sons of Lozon, sons of Isdael, sons of Saphythi,
1 Esdras 5:34 sons of Agia, sons of Phakareth—sabie, sons of Sarothie, sons of Masias, sons of Gas, sons of Addous, sons of Soubas, sons of Apherra, sons of Barodis, sons of Saphat, sons of Amon.
1 Esdras 5:35 All the temple servants and the sons of Solomon's servants, three hundred seventy-two.—
1 Esdras 5:36 These came up from Thermeleth and Thelersas, their leader Charaath, Adan and Amar,
1 Esdras 5:37 and they could not declare their families and lineages, that they are from Israel: sons of Dalan son of Touban, sons of Nekodan, six hundred fifty-two.
1 Esdras 5:38 And from the priests, those claiming priesthood and not found: sons of Obbia, sons of Akkos, sons of Joddous, who took Augia as wife from the daughters of Pharzellaios and was called by his name;
1 Esdras 5:39 and when their genealogical record was sought in the register and was not found, they were excluded from serving as priests,
1 Esdras 5:40 and Neemias and Attharias told them not to partake of the holy things until a high priest should arise clothed with the manifestation and the truth.—
1 Esdras 5:41 And the total was: Israel from twelve years old, apart from male servants and female servants, forty-two thousand three hundred sixty; their male servants and female servants, seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; singers and psalm-singers, two hundred forty-five;
1 Esdras 5:42 four hundred thirty-five camels, and seven thousand thirty-six horses, two hundred forty-five mules, five thousand five hundred twenty-five beasts of burden.—
1 Esdras 5:43 And some of the leaders according to the families, when they arrived at the temple of God in Jerusalem, vowed to raise the house upon its site according to their ability,
1 Esdras 5:44 and to give to the sacred treasury for the works a thousand minas of gold and five thousand minas of silver and a hundred priestly robes.—
1 Esdras 5:45 And the priests and the Levites and those from the people were settled in Jerusalem and the country, and the temple singers and the doorkeepers and all Israel in their villages.
1 Esdras 5:46 And when the seventh month came, and each of the sons of Israel was in his own place, they gathered with one accord in the open space of the first gateway toward the east.
1 Esdras 5:47 And Jesus son of Josedek and his brothers the priests and Zorobabel son of Salathiel and his brothers arose and prepared the altar of the God of Israel,
1 Esdras 5:48 to offer whole burnt offerings upon it in accordance with the things prescribed in the book of Moses, the man of God.
1 Esdras 5:49 And some from the other nations of the land gathered to them. And they set the altar upright upon its site, because all the nations upon the land were hostile to them and overpowered them, and they offered sacrifices according to the appointed time and whole burnt offerings to the Lord, the morning and the evening offering,
1 Esdras 5:50 and held the feast of the pitching of tents, as it is commanded in the law, and sacrifices daily, as was fitting,
1 Esdras 5:51 and after these things continual offerings and sacrifices of sabbaths and new moons and all sanctified feasts.
1 Esdras 5:52 And as many as vowed a vow to God began to offer sacrifices to God from the new moon of the seventh month, and the temple of God had not yet been built.
1 Esdras 5:53 And they gave silver to the stonecutters and carpenters, and food and drink and joy to the Sidonians and Tyrians, so that they would bring cedar timber from Lebanon and convey rafts to the harbor of Joppe, according to the ordinance written to them from Cyrus king of the Persians.—
1 Esdras 5:54 And in the second year, having arrived at the temple of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, Zorobabel son of Salathiel and Jesus son of Josedek and their brothers and the priests, the Levites, and all those who arrived from the captivity in Jerusalem began,
1 Esdras 5:55 and laid the foundation of the temple of God on the new moon of the second month of the second year after coming into Judea and Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 5:56 And they stationed the Levites from twenty years old over the works of the Lord, and Jesus and the sons and the brothers and Kadmiel the brother and the sons of Jesus Hemadaboun and the sons of Joda son of Iliadoun, with the sons and brothers, all the Levites, stood with one accord as overseers working for the works in the house of God.
1 Esdras 5:57 And the builders built the temple of the Lord, and the priests stood robed with music and trumpets, and the Levites, sons of Asaph, having the cymbals, singing hymns to the Lord and blessing according to David king of Israel,
1 Esdras 5:58 and they cried out through hymns, giving thanks to the Lord, because his kindness and glory are for the ages toward all Israel.
1 Esdras 5:59 And all the people sounded trumpets and shouted with a great voice, singing hymns to the Lord at the raising of the house of the Lord.
1 Esdras 5:60 And from the priests, the Levites, and those presiding according to their families, the elders who had seen the house before this one came to its building with shouting and great weeping,
1 Esdras 5:61 and many with trumpets and joy with a great voice,
1 Esdras 5:62 so that the people could not hear the trumpets because of the people's weeping, for the crowd was sounding trumpets mightily, so as to be heard from afar.
1 Esdras 5:63 And the enemies of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin heard and came to learn what the sound of the trumpets was.
1 Esdras 5:64 And they learned that those from the captivity were building the temple for the Lord, the God of Israel,
1 Esdras 5:65 and they approached Zorobabel and Jesus and the leaders of the families and say to them, We shall build with you;
1 Esdras 5:66 for like you we heed your Lord and have sacrificed to him since the days of Asbasareth king of the Assyrians, who brought us here.
1 Esdras 5:67 And Zorobabel and Jesus and the leaders of the families of Israel said to them, It is not for you and us to build the house for the Lord our God;
1 Esdras 5:68 for we alone shall build for the Lord of Israel in accordance with what Cyrus king of the Persians commanded us.
1 Esdras 5:69 But the nations of the land, pressing upon those in Judea and besieging them, kept them from building,
1 Esdras 5:70 and making plots and popular agitations and conspiracies, prevented the completion of the building all the time of the life of King Cyrus.
1 Esdras 5:71 And they were kept from the building two years until the reign of Darius.

## Chapter 6

1 Esdras 6:1 And in the second year of Darius's reign, the prophets Angaios and Zacharias son of Eddi prophesied to the Judeans in Judea and Jerusalem in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, over them.
1 Esdras 6:2 Then Zorobabel son of Salathiel and Jesus son of Josedek arose and began to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, the prophets of the Lord being with them and helping them.
1 Esdras 6:3 At that very time Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phoenicia and Sathrabouzanes and their companions came to them and said to them,
1 Esdras 6:4 At whose order to you are you building this house and completing this roof and all the other things? And who are the builders completing these things?
1 Esdras 6:5 And the elders of the Judeans had favor, oversight having come upon the captivity from the Lord,
1 Esdras 6:6 and were not hindered from the building until Darius was informed about them and an answer was given.
1 Esdras 6:7 A copy of the letter which Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phoenicia and Sathrabouzanes and their companions, the governors in Syria and Phoenicia, wrote to Darius and sent:
1 Esdras 6:8 Greetings to King Darius. Let all things be known to our lord the king, that, arriving in the country of Judea and coming into the city Jerusalem, we found the elders of the Judeans from the captivity in the city Jerusalem building a great new house for the Lord with costly polished stones, timber being placed in the walls,
1 Esdras 6:9 and those works being done diligently, and the work prospering in their hands, and being completed in all splendor and care.
1 Esdras 6:10 Then we inquired of these elders, saying, At whose command to you are you building this house and laying the foundations of these works?
1 Esdras 6:11 We therefore questioned them to make known to you and write to you the men leading, and we asked them for the list of names of those presiding.
1 Esdras 6:12 And they answered us, saying, We are servants of the Lord who created heaven and earth.
1 Esdras 6:13 And the house had been built many years earlier through a great and strong king of Israel, and was completed.
1 Esdras 6:14 And since our fathers provoked to bitterness and sinned against the heavenly Lord of Israel, he handed them over into the hands of Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon, king of the Chaldeans;
1 Esdras 6:15 and they pulled down the house and burned it and took the people captive to Babylon.
1 Esdras 6:16 And in the first year of Cyrus's reign over the country of Babylonia, King Cyrus wrote that this house should be built;
1 Esdras 6:17 and the holy vessels, the gold and the silver ones, which Nabouchodonosor brought out of the house in Jerusalem and deposited in his own temple, King Cyrus again brought out of the temple in Babylon, and they were handed to Zorobabel and Sanabassaros the governor,
1 Esdras 6:18 and he was commanded to carry away all these vessels and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem, and that this temple of the Lord should be built upon the site.
1 Esdras 6:19 Then that Sanabassaros arrived and laid the foundations of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, and from then until now, being built, it has not reached completion.
1 Esdras 6:20 Now therefore, if it is judged fitting, O king, let an examination be made in the royal archives of the lord king in Babylon;
1 Esdras 6:21 and if it is found that the building of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem was undertaken with the approval of King Cyrus, and it is judged fitting by our lord the king, let him address us concerning these things.
1 Esdras 6:22 Then King Darius commanded an examination to be made in the royal archives situated in Babylon, and in Ecbatana, the fortress in the country of Media, one scroll was found, in which these things had been recorded:
1 Esdras 6:23 In the first year of Cyrus's reign, King Cyrus commanded the building of the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, where they sacrifice with continual fire,
1 Esdras 6:24 whose height is sixty cubits, width sixty cubits, with three courses of polished stone and one course of new native timber, and that the expense be given from the house of King Cyrus;
1 Esdras 6:25 and that the holy vessels of the house of the Lord, both gold and silver, which Nabouchodonosor brought out of the house in Jerusalem and carried away to Babylon, be restored to the house in Jerusalem where they had been laid, so that they may be placed there.
1 Esdras 6:26 And he commanded Sisinnes governor of Syria and Phoenicia and Sathrabouzanes and their companions and the appointed governors in Syria and Phoenicia to take care to keep away from the place, but to allow the servant of the Lord, Zorobabel, governor of Judea, and the elders of the Judeans to build that house of the Lord upon the site.
1 Esdras 6:27 And I also commanded it to be built completely, and attention to be given that they cooperate with those from the captivity of Judea until the house of the Lord is completed;
1 Esdras 6:28 and that from the taxation of Coele Syria and Phoenicia an allowance be diligently given to these men for sacrifices to the Lord, to Zorobabel the governor, for bulls and rams and lambs,
1 Esdras 6:29 and likewise also wheat and salt and wine and oil continually each year, as the priests in Jerusalem may prescribe to be expended daily, without dispute,
1 Esdras 6:30 so that libations may be offered to God Most High for the king and the children, and they may pray concerning their life.
1 Esdras 6:31 And he commanded that as many as transgress any of the things previously said and additionally written, or even annul them, a timber be taken from his own property and he be hanged upon it, and his possessions belong to the king.
1 Esdras 6:32 For these things may the Lord also, whose name has been called there, destroy every king and nation who will stretch out his hand to hinder or harm that house of the Lord in Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 6:33 I, King Darius, have decreed that it be diligently done according to these things.

## Chapter 7

1 Esdras 7:1 Then Sisinnes governor of Coele Syria and Phoenicia and Sathrabouzanes and their companions, following the things commanded by King Darius,
1 Esdras 7:2 oversaw the sacred works more diligently, cooperating with the elders of the Judeans and the temple superintendents.
1 Esdras 7:3 And the sacred works prospered as the prophets Angaios and Zacharias prophesied,
1 Esdras 7:4 and they completed these things through the ordinance of the Lord, the God of Israel,
1 Esdras 7:5 and with the approval of Cyrus and Darius and Artaxerxes king of the Persians the holy house was completed by the twenty-third of the month Adar in the sixth year of King Darius.
1 Esdras 7:6 And the sons of Israel and the priests and the Levites and the rest from the captivity who had joined did according to the things in the book of Moses;
1 Esdras 7:7 and they offered for the dedication of the temple of the Lord a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs,
1 Esdras 7:8 twelve male goats for the sin of all Israel, according to the number from the twelve tribal chiefs of Israel;
1 Esdras 7:9 and the priests and the Levites stood robed according to tribes over the works of the Lord, the God of Israel, according to the book of Moses, and the doorkeepers at each gateway.
1 Esdras 7:10 And the sons of Israel from the captivity held the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month, because the priests and the Levites were purified together,
1 Esdras 7:11 and all the sons of the captivity were not purified, because all the Levites were purified together,
1 Esdras 7:12 and they sacrificed the Passover for all the sons of the captivity and for their brothers the priests and for themselves.
1 Esdras 7:13 And the sons of Israel from the captivity ate, all those separated from the abominations of the nations of the land, seeking the Lord.
1 Esdras 7:14 And they held the feast of unleavened bread seven days, rejoicing before the Lord,
1 Esdras 7:15 because he turned the counsel of the king of the Assyrians toward them, to strengthen their hands for the works of the Lord, the God of Israel.

## Chapter 8

1 Esdras 8:1 And later than these things, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of the Persians, Esdras came up, son of Saraios son of Ezerios son of Chelkias son of Salemos,
1 Esdras 8:2 son of Saddoukos son of Achitob son of Amarios son of Ozios son of Bokka son of Abisoue son of Phinees son of Eleazar son of Aaron the first priest;
1 Esdras 8:3 this Esdras came up from Babylon, being a gifted scribe in the law of Moses issued by the God of Israel,
1 Esdras 8:4 and the king gave him glory, since he found favor before him for all his requests.
1 Esdras 8:5 And some of the sons of Israel and the priests and Levites and temple singers and doorkeepers and temple servants went up together to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes's reign, in the fifth month [this is the king's seventh year];
1 Esdras 8:6 for, leaving Babylon on the new moon of the first month, they arrived in Jerusalem on the new moon of the fifth month, according to the prosperous journey given them from the Lord over him.
1 Esdras 8:7 For Esdras possessed much knowledge, so as to omit nothing from the law of the Lord, and to teach all Israel all the ordinances and judgments from the commandments.
1 Esdras 8:8 And the written ordinance from King Artaxerxes arrived for Esdras the priest and reader of the law of the Lord, of which the following is a copy:
1 Esdras 8:9 King Artaxerxes to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of the Lord, greetings.
1 Esdras 8:10 And I, deciding upon humane things, commanded those willing from the nation of the Judeans who choose to go, and from the priests and the Levites, and those in our kingdom, to travel with you to Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 8:11 As many therefore as intend it, let them set out together, as has been decreed by me and the seven friends who are counselors,
1 Esdras 8:12 so that they may examine the matters concerning Judea and Jerusalem in accordance with what he has in the law of the Lord,
1 Esdras 8:13 and carry gifts to the Lord of Israel to Jerusalem, which I and the friends vowed, and all gold and silver which may be found in the country of Babylonia, for the Lord in Jerusalem, together with what has been given by the nation for the temple of their Lord in Jerusalem,
1 Esdras 8:14 both the gold and silver to be gathered for bulls and rams and lambs and the things accompanying them,
1 Esdras 8:15 so as to offer sacrifices upon the altar of their Lord in Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 8:16 And all that you may wish to do with gold and silver with your brothers, carry out according to the will of your God,
1 Esdras 8:17 and the holy vessels of the Lord given to you for the service of the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 8:18 And the remaining things, whatever may occur to you for the service of the temple of your God, you shall give from the royal treasury;
1 Esdras 8:19 and I, King Artaxerxes, commanded the treasurers of Syria and Phoenicia that whatever Esdras the priest and reader of the law of God Most High may send for, they should diligently give him, up to a hundred talents of silver,
1 Esdras 8:20 and likewise up to a hundred kors of wheat and a hundred measures of wine and salt in abundance;
1 Esdras 8:21 let all things according to the law of God be diligently carried out for God Most High, so that wrath may not come upon the kingdom of the king and the sons.
1 Esdras 8:22 And it is also said to you that no taxation or other imposition should come upon any of the priests and Levites and temple singers and doorkeepers and temple servants and officials of this temple, and that no one should have authority to impose anything upon them.
1 Esdras 8:23 And you, Esdras, according to the wisdom of God, appoint judges and justices to judge throughout Syria and Phoenicia all those who know the law of your God; and those who do not know it you shall teach.
1 Esdras 8:24 And all who transgress the law of your God and the royal law shall be diligently punished, whether with death or punishment or a monetary fine or removal.
1 Esdras 8:25 Blessed alone is the Lord, who put these things into the king's heart, to glorify his house in Jerusalem,
1 Esdras 8:26 and honored me before the king and those giving counsel and all his friends and magnates.
1 Esdras 8:27 And I became courageous according to the assistance of the Lord my God, and gathered men from Israel to go up with me.
1 Esdras 8:28 And these are the leaders according to their families and divisions who went up with me from Babylon in the reign of King Artaxerxes:
1 Esdras 8:29 from the sons of Phinees, Garsomos; from the sons of Jetamaros, Gamelos; from the sons of David, Attous son of Sechenias;
1 Esdras 8:30 from the sons of Phoros, Zacharias, and with him, according to the record, a hundred fifty men;
1 Esdras 8:31 from the sons of Phaathmoab, Eliaonias son of Zaraios, and with him two hundred men;
1 Esdras 8:32 from the sons of Zathoe, Sechenias son of Jezelos, and with him three hundred men; from the sons of Adinos, Ben—Jonathos, and with him two hundred fifty men;
1 Esdras 8:33 from the sons of Elam, Jesias son of Gotholios, and with him seventy men;
1 Esdras 8:34 from the sons of Saphatios, Zaraias son of Michaelos, and with him seventy men;
1 Esdras 8:35 from the sons of Joab, Abadias son of Jezelos, and with him two hundred twelve men;
1 Esdras 8:36 from the sons of Bani, Assalimoth son of Josaphios, and with him a hundred sixty men;
1 Esdras 8:37 from the sons of Babi, Zacharias son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight men;
1 Esdras 8:38 from the sons of Asgath, Joanes son of Akatan, and with him a hundred ten men;
1 Esdras 8:39 from the sons of Adonikam, the last ones, and these are their names: Eliphalatos, Jeouel and Samaias, and with them seventy men;
1 Esdras 8:40 from the sons of Bago, Outhi son of Istalkouros, and with him seventy men.
1 Esdras 8:41 And I gathered them at the river called Thera, and we camped there three days, and I examined them.
1 Esdras 8:42 And finding none there from the sons of the priests and from the Levites,
1 Esdras 8:43 I sent to Eleazar and Idouelos and Maasman and Elnatan and Samaias and Joribos, Nathan, Ennatan, Zacharias and Mesolamos, the leaders and knowledgeable men,
1 Esdras 8:44 and told them to go to Addaios, the leader in the place of the treasury,
1 Esdras 8:45 commanding them to speak to Addaios and his brothers and the treasurers in the place, to send us those who would serve as priests in the house of our Lord.
1 Esdras 8:46 And according to the mighty hand of our Lord they brought us knowledgeable men from the sons of Mooli son of Levi son of Israel: Asebebias and the sons and the brothers, eighteen;
1 Esdras 8:47 and Asebias and Announos and Osaias, a brother from the sons of Chanounaios, and their sons, twenty men;
1 Esdras 8:48 and from the temple servants whom David and the leaders gave for the work of the Levites, two hundred twenty temple servants; the list of names of all was recorded.
1 Esdras 8:49 And there I vowed a fast for the young men before our Lord,
1 Esdras 8:50 to seek from him a prosperous journey for us and for our children and livestock with us.
1 Esdras 8:51 For I was ashamed to ask the king for infantry and horsemen and an escort for safety against those opposing us;
1 Esdras 8:52 for we said to the king, The strength of our Lord shall be with those seeking him for every restoration.
1 Esdras 8:53 And again we entreated our Lord according to these things and found him gracious.
1 Esdras 8:54 And I set apart twelve men from the tribal chiefs of the priests, and Serebias and Asabias, and with them ten men from their brothers,
1 Esdras 8:55 and weighed out to them the silver and the gold and the holy vessels of the house of our Lord which the king himself and his counselors and magnates and all Israel gave.
1 Esdras 8:56 And having weighed them, I handed to them six hundred fifty talents of silver and silver vessels of a hundred talents and a hundred talents of gold and twenty gold vessels and bronze vessels from good bronze, shining, twelve vessels resembling gold.
1 Esdras 8:57 And I said to them, You also are holy to the Lord, and the vessels are holy, and the silver and gold are a votive offering to the Lord, the Lord of our fathers;
1 Esdras 8:58 keep awake and guard them until you hand them to the tribal chiefs of the priests and the Levites and the leaders of the families of Israel in Jerusalem, in the chambers of the house of our Lord.
1 Esdras 8:59 And the priests and the Levites who received the silver and gold and the vessels in Jerusalem brought them into the temple of the Lord.
1 Esdras 8:60 And setting out from the river Thera on the twelfth of the first month, we entered Jerusalem according to the mighty hand of our Lord upon us; and he delivered us on the way in from every enemy, and we came to Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 8:61 And when the third day there came, the silver and the gold were weighed and handed over in the house of our Lord to Marmothi son of Ourias the priest,
1 Esdras 8:62 —and with him Eleazar son of Phinees, and with them were Josabdos son of Jesus and Moeth son of Sabannos, the Levites—everything by number and weight, and all their weight was written at that very hour.
1 Esdras 8:63 And those who arrived from the captivity offered sacrifices to the Lord, the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-two lambs, twelve male goats for deliverance; everything a sacrifice to the Lord.
1 Esdras 8:64 And they delivered the king's ordinances to the royal stewards and the governors of Coele Syria and Phoenicia, and they glorified the nation and the temple of the Lord.
1 Esdras 8:65 And when these things were completed, the leaders approached me, saying,
1 Esdras 8:66 The nation of Israel and the rulers and the priests and the Levites did not separate the foreign nations of the land and their uncleannesses, those of the Canaanites and Chettites and Pherezites and Jebusites and Moabites and Egyptians and Idumeans;
1 Esdras 8:67 for both they and their sons dwelt with their daughters, and the holy seed was mingled with the foreign nations of the land, and the leaders and the magnates partook of this lawlessness from the beginning of the matter.
1 Esdras 8:68 And as soon as I heard these things, I tore the garments and the sacred robe and plucked some of the hair of the head and the beard, and sat down pensive and deeply grieved.
1 Esdras 8:69 And all who were ever moved by the word of the Lord of Israel gathered to me as I mourned over the lawlessness, and I sat deeply grieved until the evening sacrifice.
1 Esdras 8:70 And rising from the fast with the garments and the sacred robe torn, bending the knees and stretching out the hands toward the Lord, I was saying,
1 Esdras 8:71 Lord, I am ashamed, I am abashed before your face;
1 Esdras 8:72 for our sins multiplied above our heads, and our acts of ignorance rose as far as heaven
1 Esdras 8:73 from the times of our fathers, and we are in great sin until this day;
1 Esdras 8:74 and because of our sins and those of our fathers we were handed over, with our brothers and our kings and our priests, to the kings of the earth, to sword and captivity and plunder with shame until this day.
1 Esdras 8:75 And now in some small measure mercy came to us from you, Lord, that a root and a name should be left for us in the place of your sanctuary,
1 Esdras 8:76 and to uncover our light in the house of our Lord, to give us sustenance in the time of our slavery;
1 Esdras 8:77 and in our serving as slaves we were not forsaken by our Lord, but he put us in favor before the kings of the Persians,
1 Esdras 8:78 to give us sustenance and glorify the temple of our Lord and raise desolate Zion, to give us a firm support in Judea and Jerusalem.
1 Esdras 8:79 And now what shall we say, Lord, having these things? For we transgressed your ordinances, which you gave by the hand of your servants the prophets, saying,
1 Esdras 8:80 The land into which you enter to inherit is a land defiled with the defilement of the foreigners of the land, and they filled it with their uncleanness;
1 Esdras 8:81 and now do not marry your daughters to their sons, and do not take their daughters for your sons;
1 Esdras 8:82 and you shall not seek peace in your relations with them for all time, so that, being strong, you may eat the good things of the land and leave it as an inheritance to your sons for the age.
1 Esdras 8:83 And all the things happening to us come about because of our evil works and our great sins.
1 Esdras 8:84 For you, Lord, lightened our sins and gave us such a root; again we turned back to transgress your law, to mingle with the uncleanness of the nations of the land.
1 Esdras 8:85 Were you not angered with us to destroy us until no root and seed and name of ours remained?
1 Esdras 8:86 Lord of Israel, you are true; for we were left a root today.
1 Esdras 8:87 Behold, now we are before you in our lawless acts; for we cannot still stand before you because of these things.
1 Esdras 8:88 And when Esdras, praying, was making confession, weeping, prostrate upon the ground before the temple, a very great crowd from Jerusalem gathered to him, men and women and youths; for there was great weeping in the multitude.
1 Esdras 8:89 And Jechonias son of Jeelos, of the sons of Israel, called out and said to Esdras, We sinned against the Lord and married foreign women from the nations of the land; and now there is hope for Israel.
1 Esdras 8:90 In this let there be an oath for us to the Lord, to cast out all our wives from the foreigners with their children, as was judged fitting by you and as many as obey the law of the Lord.
1 Esdras 8:91 Rise and carry it out; for the matter is yours, and we are with you to give strength.
1 Esdras 8:92 And Esdras rose and put the tribal chiefs of the priests and Levites of all Israel under oath to do according to these things; and they swore.

## Chapter 9

1 Esdras 9:1 And Esdras rose from the courtyard of the temple and went into the chamber of Joanan son of Eliasibos,
1 Esdras 9:2 and lodging there, he tasted no bread and drank no water, mourning over the great lawless acts of the multitude.
1 Esdras 9:3 And a proclamation was made throughout Judea and Jerusalem that all those from the captivity should gather in Jerusalem;
1 Esdras 9:4 and as many as do not arrive within two or three days, according to the judgment of the presiding elders, their livestock shall be consecrated, and he himself shall be excluded from the multitude of the captivity.
1 Esdras 9:5 And those from the tribe of Judah and Benjamin gathered within three days in Jerusalem [this is the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month],
1 Esdras 9:6 and all the multitude sat together in the open space of the temple, trembling because of the present storm.
1 Esdras 9:7 And Esdras rose and said to them, You acted lawlessly and married foreign women, adding sin to Israel;
1 Esdras 9:8 and now give confession, glory to the Lord, the God of our fathers,
1 Esdras 9:9 and do his will and separate yourselves from the nations of the land and from the foreign women.
1 Esdras 9:10 And all the multitude cried out and said with a great voice, We shall do thus, as you have said;
1 Esdras 9:11 but the multitude is large and the season wintry, and we cannot stand in the open air, and we did not find, and the work for us is not of one day or two; for we sinned extensively in these things.
1 Esdras 9:12 But let the leaders of the multitude stand, and all those from our settlements who have foreign wives, let them arrive, having taken an appointed time;
1 Esdras 9:13 and the elders and judges of each place, until the wrath of the Lord for this matter is removed from us.
1 Esdras 9:14 Jonathas son of Azaelos and Jezias son of Thokanos undertook according to these things, and Mosollamos and Levis and Sabbataios assisted them in judgment.
1 Esdras 9:15 And those from the captivity did according to all these things.
1 Esdras 9:16 And Esdras the priest chose for himself men leading their families, all by name, and they sat together on the new moon of the tenth month to examine the matter.
1 Esdras 9:17 And the matters concerning the men keeping foreign wives were brought to an end by the new moon of the first month.
1 Esdras 9:18 And among the priests, those gathered were found having foreign wives:
1 Esdras 9:19 from the sons of Jesus son of Josedek and the brothers, Maseas and Eleazaros and Joribos and Jodanos;
1 Esdras 9:20 and they pledged their hands to cast out their wives, and rams for atonement for their ignorance.
1 Esdras 9:21 And from the sons of Emmer, Ananias and Zabdaios and Manes and Samaios and Jiel and Azarias.
1 Esdras 9:22 And from the sons of Phaisour, Elionais, Massias, Ismaelos and Nathanaelos and Okidelos and Salthas.—
1 Esdras 9:23 And from the Levites: Jozabdos and Semeis and Kolios [this is Kalitas] and Pathaios and Ooudas and Joanas;
1 Esdras 9:24 from the temple singers, Eliasibos, Bakchouros;
1 Esdras 9:25 from the doorkeepers, Salloumos and Tolbanes.—
1 Esdras 9:26 From Israel: from the sons of Phoros, Jermas and Jezias and Melchias and Miaminos and Eleazaros and Asibias and Bannaias;
1 Esdras 9:27 from the sons of Elam, Matanias and Zacharias, Jezrielos and Obadios and Jeremoth and Elias;
1 Esdras 9:28 and from the sons of Zamoth, Eliadas, Eliasimos, Othonias, Jarimoth and Sabathos and Zerdaias;
1 Esdras 9:29 and from the sons of Bebai, Joannes and Ananias and Zabdos and Emathis;
1 Esdras 9:30 and from the sons of Mani, Olamos, Mamouchos, Jedaios, Jasoubos and Asaelos and Jeremoth;
1 Esdras 9:31 and from the sons of Addi, Naathos and Moossias, Lakkounos and Naidos and Beskaspasmys and Sesthel and Balnouos and Manasseas;
1 Esdras 9:32 and from the sons of Annan, Elionas and Asaias and Melchias and Sabbaias and Simon Chosamaios;
1 Esdras 9:33 and from the sons of Asom, Maltannaios and Mattathias and Sabannaious and Eliphalat and Manasses and Semei;
1 Esdras 9:34 and from the sons of Baani, Jeremias, Momdios, Maeros, Jouel, Mamdai and Pedias and Anos, Karabasion and Eliasibos and Mamnitanaimos, Eliasis, Bannous, Elialis, Someis, Selemias, Nathanias; and from the sons of Ezora, Sessis, Ezril, Azaelos, Samatos, Zambris, Josepos;
1 Esdras 9:35 and from the sons of Nooma, Mazitias, Zabadaias, Edais, Jouel, Banaias.—
1 Esdras 9:36 All these married foreign women; and they sent them away with children.
1 Esdras 9:37 And the priests and the Levites and those from Israel dwelt in Jerusalem and in the country. On the new moon of the seventh month—and the sons of Israel were in their settlements—
1 Esdras 9:38 and all the multitude gathered with one accord in the open space of the temple gateway toward the east,
1 Esdras 9:39 and told Esdras the high priest and reader to bring the law of Moses handed down by the Lord, the God of Israel.
1 Esdras 9:40 And Esdras the high priest brought the law to all the multitude, from man to woman, and to all the priests to hear the law on the new moon of the seventh month;
1 Esdras 9:41 and he was reading in the open space before the temple gateway from dawn until midday before both men and women, and all the multitude gave their mind to the law.
1 Esdras 9:42 And Esdras the priest and reader of the law stood upon the wooden platform prepared,
1 Esdras 9:43 and beside him stood Mattathias, Sammous, Ananias, Azarias, Ourias, Ezekias, Baalsamos on the right,
1 Esdras 9:44 and on the left Phadaios, Misael, Melchias, Lothasoubos, Nabarias, Zacharias.
1 Esdras 9:45 And Esdras took up the book of the law before the multitude—for he presided gloriously before all—
1 Esdras 9:46 and when he unrolled the law, all stood upright. And Esdras blessed the Lord God Most High, God Sabaoth, almighty,
1 Esdras 9:47 and all the multitude cried out, Amen, and raising their hands up, falling upon the earth, they worshipped the Lord.
1 Esdras 9:48 Jesus and Anniouth and Sarabias, Jadinos, Jakoubos, Sabbataios, Autaias, Maiannas and Kalitas, Azarias and Jozabdos, Ananias, Phalias, the Levites, were teaching the law of the Lord and reading the law of the Lord to the multitude, at the same time imparting understanding of the reading.—
1 Esdras 9:49 And Attarates said to Esdras the high priest and reader and to the Levites teaching the multitude, to all,
1 Esdras 9:50 This day is holy to the Lord—and all were weeping as they heard the law—;
1 Esdras 9:51 go therefore, eat rich foods and drink sweet drinks, and send portions to those who have none,
1 Esdras 9:52 for the day is holy to the Lord; and do not be grieved, for the Lord will glorify you.
1 Esdras 9:53 And the Levites were commanding all the people, saying, This day is holy; do not be grieved.
1 Esdras 9:54 And all went away to eat and drink and rejoice and give portions to those who had none and rejoice greatly,
1 Esdras 9:55 because they were also given understanding in the words in which they were taught.—And they gathered together.

# 2 Esdras

The Apostolic Bible. Public domain. https://apostolic-bible.ysys9.chatgpt.site/license.html


## Chapter 1

2 Esdras 1:1 And in the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, so that the word of the Lord from the mouth of Jeremias would be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of the Persians, and he ordered a proclamation throughout his kingdom, indeed also in writing, saying,
2 Esdras 1:2 Thus said Cyrus king of the Persians: The Lord, the God of heaven, gave me all the kingdoms of the earth, and he charged me to build him a house in Jerusalem in Judea.
2 Esdras 1:3 Who among you is of all his people? And his God shall be with him, and he shall go up to Jerusalem in Judea, and let him build the house of the God of Israel [he is the God in Jerusalem].
2 Esdras 1:4 And everyone remaining from all the places where he himself sojourns, the men of his place shall take him up with silver and gold and equipment and livestock, together with the voluntary offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.—
2 Esdras 1:5 And the rulers of the families of Judah and Benjamin and the priests and the Levites arose, of all whose spirit God stirred to go up to build the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 1:6 And all those round about strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with equipment and livestock and gifts, apart from the voluntary offerings.
2 Esdras 1:7 And King Cyrus brought out the vessels of the house of the Lord which Nabouchodonosor took from Jerusalem and placed in the house of his god,
2 Esdras 1:8 and Cyrus king of the Persians brought them out into the hand of Mithradates the gasbarenos, and he counted them for Sasabasar ruler of Judah.
2 Esdras 1:9 And this is their number: thirty gold cooling vessels and a thousand silver cooling vessels, twenty-nine assorted items,
2 Esdras 1:10 thirty gold kephphoure and two hundred silver ones, and a thousand other vessels.
2 Esdras 1:11 All the vessels of gold and silver, five thousand four hundred, all going up with Sasabasar from the deportation, from Babylon to Jerusalem.

## Chapter 2

2 Esdras 2:1 And these are the sons of the country going up from the captivity of the deportation which Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon deported to Babylon, and they returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each man to his city,
2 Esdras 2:2 who came with Zorobabel: Jesus, Neemias, Saraias, Reelias, Mardochaios, Balasan, Masphar, Bagoui, Reoum, Baana. The number of men of the people of Israel:
2 Esdras 2:3 sons of Phoros, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
2 Esdras 2:4 Sons of Saphatia, three hundred seventy-two.
2 Esdras 2:5 Sons of Era, seven hundred seventy-five.

2 Esdras 2:7 Sons of Ailam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

2 Esdras 2:15 Sons of Adin, four hundred fifty-four.

2 Esdras 2:17 Sons of Basou, three hundred twenty-three.
2 Esdras 2:18 Sons of Jora, one hundred twelve.

2 Esdras 2:21 Sons of Bethlehem, one hundred twenty-three.
2 Esdras 2:22 Sons of Netopha, fifty-six.
2 Esdras 2:23 Sons of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.
2 Esdras 2:24 Sons of Asmoth, forty-two.
2 Esdras 2:25 Sons of Kariathiarim, Kaphira and Beroth, seven hundred forty-three.

2 Esdras 2:27 Men of Machmas, one hundred twenty-two.
2 Esdras 2:28 Men of Baithel and Aia, four hundred twenty-three.
2 Esdras 2:29 Sons of Nabou, fifty-two.
2 Esdras 2:30 Sons of Magebos, one hundred fifty-six.
2 Esdras 2:31 Sons of Elam—ar, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.
2 Esdras 2:32 Sons of Eram, three hundred twenty.
2 Esdras 2:33 Sons of Lod, Aroth and Ono, seven hundred twenty-five.
2 Esdras 2:34 Sons of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

2 Esdras 2:36 And the priests: sons of Jedoua belonging to the house of Jesus, nine hundred seventy-three.
2 Esdras 2:37 Sons of Emmer, one thousand fifty-two.
2 Esdras 2:38 Sons of Phassour, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.
2 Esdras 2:39 Sons of Erem, one thousand seven.—
2 Esdras 2:40 And the Levites: sons of Jesus and Kadmiel belonging to the sons of Odouia, seventy-four.
2 Esdras 2:41 The singers: sons of Asaph, one hundred twenty-eight.
2 Esdras 2:42 Sons of the gatekeepers: sons of Saloum, sons of Ater, sons of Telmon, sons of Akoub, sons of Atita, sons of Sabaou, all one hundred thirty-nine.—
2 Esdras 2:43 The Nathinaioi: sons of Souia, sons of Asouphe, sons of Tabaoth,
2 Esdras 2:44 sons of Keraos, sons of Soea, sons of Phadon,
2 Esdras 2:45 sons of Labano, sons of Agaba, sons of Akaboth,
