2 Esdras 2:50 sons of Asena, sons of Maonim, sons of Naphison,
2 Esdras 2:51 sons of Bakbouk, sons of Akipha, sons of Arour,
2 Esdras 2:52 sons of Basaloth, sons of Maouda, sons of Aresa,
2 Esdras 2:53 sons of Barkous, sons of Sisara, sons of Thema,
2 Esdras 2:54 sons of Nasoue, sons of Atoupha.
2 Esdras 2:55 Sons of Abdeselma: sons of Sati, sons of Asepherath, sons of Phadoura,
2 Esdras 2:56 sons of Jeela, sons of Darkon, sons of Gedel,
2 Esdras 2:57 sons of Saphatia, sons of Atil, sons of Phacherath—aseboin, sons of Emi.
2 Esdras 2:58 All the Nathinin and sons of Abdeselma, three hundred ninety-two.—
2 Esdras 2:59 And these are those who came up from Thelmeleth, Thelaresa, Charoub, Edan, Emmer, and they were unable to declare their family house and their seed, whether they are from Israel:
2 Esdras 2:60 sons of Dalaia, sons of Boua, sons of Tobia, sons of Nekoda, six hundred fifty-two.
2 Esdras 2:61 And from the sons of the priests: sons of Chabia, sons of Akous, sons of Berzellai, who took a wife from the daughters of Berzellai the Galaadite and was called by their name;
2 Esdras 2:62 these, the methoesim sought their record, and they were not found; and they were ἠγχιστεύθησαν [sense uncertain] from the priesthood,
2 Esdras 2:63 and Athersatha told them not to eat from the holy of holies until a priest should arise with the enlightening things and the perfect things.—
2 Esdras 2:64 And the whole assembly as one, forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
2 Esdras 2:65 apart from their slaves and their female servants, these seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven; and these male singers and female singers, two hundred;
2 Esdras 2:66 their horses, seven hundred thirty-six, their mules, two hundred forty-five,
2 Esdras 2:67 their camels, four hundred thirty-five, their asses, six thousand seven hundred twenty.—
2 Esdras 2:68 And some of the rulers of families, when they came to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem, made voluntary offerings for the house of God, to establish it upon its prepared site;
2 Esdras 2:69 according to their ability they gave to the treasury of the work pure gold, sixty-one thousand minas, and silver, five thousand minas, and a hundred kothonoi of the priests.—
2 Esdras 2:70 And the priests and the Levites and those from the people and the singers and the gatekeepers and the Nathinim settled in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

## Chapter 3

2 Esdras 3:1 And the seventh month arrived—and the sons of Israel were in their cities—and the people gathered as one man in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 3:2 And Jesus son of Josedek and his brothers the priests and Zorobabel son of Salathiel and his brothers arose and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer whole burnt offerings upon it according to the things written in the law of Moses, the man of God.
2 Esdras 3:3 And they prepared the altar upon its prepared site, because terror was upon them from the peoples of the lands, and a whole burnt offering to the Lord went up upon it in the morning and toward evening.
2 Esdras 3:4 And they kept the feast of tents according to what was written, and whole burnt offerings day by day, in number according to the ordinance, the requirement of a day on its day,
2 Esdras 3:5 and after this continual whole burnt offerings, and for the new moons and for all the sanctified feasts, and for everyone voluntarily offering a voluntary offering to the Lord.
2 Esdras 3:6 On day one of the seventh month they began to offer whole burnt offerings to the Lord; and the house of the Lord had not been founded.
2 Esdras 3:7 And they gave silver to the stonecutters and carpenters, and food and drink and oil to the Sedanin and the Sorin, to bring cedar timber from Lebanon to the sea of Joppe, according to the concession of Cyrus king of the Persians to them.—
2 Esdras 3:8 And in the second year of their coming to the house of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, Zorobabel son of Salathiel and Jesus son of Josedek and the remaining ones of their brothers, the priests and the Levites, and all those coming from the captivity to Jerusalem began, and they stationed the Levites from twenty years old and upward over those doing the works in the house of the Lord.
2 Esdras 3:9 And Jesus and his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, sons of Judah, stood over those doing the works in the house of God, sons of Enadad, their sons and their brothers, the Levites.
2 Esdras 3:10 And they laid foundations to build the house of the Lord, and the priests stood robed with trumpets, and the Levites, sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise the Lord according to the hands of David king of Israel,
2 Esdras 3:11 and they answered in praise and thanksgiving to the Lord, because it is good, because his mercy upon Israel is for the age. And all the people sounded a great voice to praise the Lord at the foundation of the house of the Lord.
2 Esdras 3:12 And many from the priests and the Levites and rulers of the families, the elders who saw the first house at its foundation and this house with their eyes, were weeping with a great voice, and a crowd with shouting and gladness raised a song;
2 Esdras 3:13 and the people were not distinguishing the sound of the shout of gladness from the sound of the people's weeping, because the people cried out with a great voice, and the sound was heard even from afar.

## Chapter 4

2 Esdras 4:1 And those afflicting Judah and Benjamin heard that the sons of the deportation were building a house for the Lord, the God of Israel,
2 Esdras 4:2 and approached Zorobabel and the rulers of the families and said to them, We shall build with you, because like you we seek your God, and we sacrifice to him since the days of Asaraddon king of Assour, who brought us here.
2 Esdras 4:3 And Zorobabel and Jesus and the remaining rulers of the families of Israel said to them, It is not for us and you to build a house for our God, because we ourselves together shall build for the Lord our God, as Cyrus king of the Persians commanded us.
2 Esdras 4:4 And the people of the land were weakening the hands of the people of Judah, and they were hindering them from building,
2 Esdras 4:5 and hiring those deliberating against them to scatter their counsel all the days of Cyrus king of the Persians and until the reign of Darius king of the Persians.
2 Esdras 4:6 And in the reign of Asoueros, at the beginning of his reign, they wrote a letter against those dwelling in Judah and Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 4:7 And in the days of Arthasastha, Tabeel wrote in peace to Mithradates, together also with his other fellow servants, to Arthasastha king of the Persians; the tax collector wrote a writing in Syrian and translated.
2 Esdras 4:8 Raoum baaltam and Samsai the scribe wrote one letter against Jerusalem to King Arthasastha.
2 Esdras 4:9 These things Raoum baaltam and Samsai the scribe and our remaining fellow servants determined, Dinaioi, Apharsathachaioi, Tarphallaioi, Apharsaioi, Archyaioi, Babylonians, Sousanachaioi [who are Elamites],
2 Esdras 4:10 and the remaining ones of the nations whom the great and honored Asennaphar deported and settled in the cities of Somoron, and the remnant beyond the river;
2 Esdras 4:11 this is the arrangement of the letter which they sent to him: To King Arthasastha, your servants, men beyond the river.
2 Esdras 4:12 Let it be known to the king that the Judeans who came up from you to us came to Jerusalem; they are building the rebellious and evil city, and they have repaired its walls and raised its foundations.
2 Esdras 4:13 Now therefore let it be known to the king that if that city is rebuilt and its walls repaired, there will be no tribute for you, nor will they give it; and this harms kings.
2 Esdras 4:14 And it is not permitted for us to see the king's disgrace; because of this we sent and made known to the king,
2 Esdras 4:15 that he may examine the book of the record of your fathers, and you will find and know that that city is a rebellious city and harms kings and countries, and there have been flights of slaves in its midst from times of old; because of these things this city was desolated.
2 Esdras 4:16 We therefore make known to the king that if that city is built and its walls repaired, there is no peace for you.
2 Esdras 4:17 And the king sent peace to Raoum baaltam and Samsai the scribe and their remaining fellow servants dwelling in Samaria and the remaining ones beyond the river, and says,
2 Esdras 4:18 The tax collector whom you sent to us was called before me.
2 Esdras 4:19 And a decision was issued by me, and we examined and found that that city rises against kings from days of old, and rebellions and flights occur in it,
2 Esdras 4:20 and strong kings arise over Jerusalem and rule all the west of the river, and full tribute and a portion are given to them.
2 Esdras 4:21 And now issue a decision to stop those men, and that city shall no longer be built, so that according to the decision
2 Esdras 4:22 you may be on guard against allowing relaxation in this matter, lest destruction multiply to the harm of kings.
2 Esdras 4:23 Then the tax collector of King Arthasastha read before Raoum and Samsai the scribe and their fellow servants; and they went in haste to Jerusalem and into Judah and stopped them with horses and force.
2 Esdras 4:24 Then the work of the house of God in Jerusalem ceased, and was idle until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.

## Chapter 5

2 Esdras 5:1 And Angaios the prophet and Zacharias son of Addo prophesied a prophecy to the Judeans in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel over them.
2 Esdras 5:2 Then Zorobabel son of Salathiel and Jesus son of Josedek arose and began to build the house of God in Jerusalem, and with them were the prophets of God, helping them.
2 Esdras 5:3 At that very time Thanthanai governor beyond the river and Satharbouzana and their fellow servants came against them and said such things to them: Who issued you a decision to build this house and complete this provision?
2 Esdras 5:4 Then they said these things to them: What are the names of the men building this city?
2 Esdras 5:5 And the eyes of God were upon the captivity of Judah, and they did not stop them until a decision was carried to Darius; and then a message was sent to the tax collector concerning this.
2 Esdras 5:6 A transcript of the letter which Thanthanai governor beyond the river and Satharbouzana and their fellow servants, the Apharsachaioi beyond the river, sent to King Darius;
2 Esdras 5:7 they sent a statement to him, and these things are written in it: To King Darius, all peace.
2 Esdras 5:8 Let it be known to the king that we went into the country of Judea, to the house of the great God, and it is being built with choice stones, and timber is being placed in the walls, and that work is being done skillfully and prospers in their hands.
2 Esdras 5:9 Then we questioned those elders and said thus to them, Who issued you a decision to build this house and complete this provision?
2 Esdras 5:10 And we asked them their names to make known to you, so as to write to you the names of the men who are their rulers.
2 Esdras 5:11 And they answered us with such a statement, saying, We are slaves of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building the house which had been built many years before this, and a great king of Israel built it and completed it
2 Esdras 5:12 for them. But from the time when our fathers provoked the God of heaven to anger, he gave them into the hands of Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon, the Chaldean, and he demolished this house and deported the people to Babylon.
2 Esdras 5:13 But in the first year of King Cyrus, King Cyrus issued a decision that this house of God should be built.
2 Esdras 5:14 And the vessels of the house of God, the gold and silver ones, which Nabouchodonosor brought out of the house in Jerusalem and carried away to the king's temple, King Cyrus brought out of the king's temple and gave to Sasabasar the treasurer over the treasury,
2 Esdras 5:15 and said to him, Take all the vessels and go, place them in the house in Jerusalem in their own place.
2 Esdras 5:16 Then that Sasabasar came and laid foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem; and from then until now it has been built and has not been completed.
2 Esdras 5:17 And now, if it is good to the king, let an examination be made in the treasury house of the king of Babylon, so that you may know that a decision was issued by King Cyrus to build that house of God in Jerusalem; and when the king knows concerning this, let him send to us.

## Chapter 6

2 Esdras 6:1 Then King Darius issued a decision and examined in the libraries where the treasure is laid in Babylon.
2 Esdras 6:2 And in a city, in the fortress of the city of the Medes, one scroll was found, and this was written in it: Memorandum:
2 Esdras 6:3 In the first year of King Cyrus, King Cyrus issued a decision concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let a house be built, and a place where they sacrifice the sacrifices; and he set an elevation, a height of sixty cubits, its width sixty cubits;
2 Esdras 6:4 and three strong stone courses and one wooden course; and the expense shall be given from the king's house;
2 Esdras 6:5 and the vessels of the house of God, the silver and gold ones, which Nabouchodonosor brought out of the house in Jerusalem and conveyed to Babylon, let them be given and go to the temple in Jerusalem, to the place where they were placed in the house of God.
2 Esdras 6:6 Now you shall give, governors beyond the river, Satharbouzana and their fellow servants, the Apharsachaioi beyond the river, being far from there,
2 Esdras 6:7 leave the work of the house of God alone; let the leaders of the Judeans and the elders of the Judeans build that house of God upon its site.
2 Esdras 6:8 And a decision was issued by me that you should never do anything with the elders of the Judeans toward building that house of God; and from the king's possessions, the tributes beyond the river, let expenses be diligently given to those men, so that it may not be stopped;
2 Esdras 6:9 and whatever deficiency there may be, both offspring of oxen and rams and lambs for whole burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine, oil, according to the word of the priests in Jerusalem, let it be given them day by day, whatever they ask,
2 Esdras 6:10 so that they may offer sweet smells to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.
2 Esdras 6:11 And a decision was issued by me that every man who changes this word, a timber shall be taken down from his house, and he shall be raised upright and fixed upon it, and his house shall be dealt with according to me.
2 Esdras 6:12 And God, whose name dwells there, will overthrow every king and people who stretches out his hand to change or destroy that house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, issued a decision; it shall be done diligently.
2 Esdras 6:13 Then Thanthanai governor beyond the river, Satharbouzana and his fellow servants did thus diligently according to what King Darius sent.
2 Esdras 6:14 And the elders of the Judeans were building, and the Levites, through the prophecy of Angaios the prophet and Zacharias son of Addo, and they rebuilt and completed it by the decision of the God of Israel and by the decision of Cyrus and Darius and Arthasastha, kings of the Persians.
2 Esdras 6:15 And they completed this house by the third day of the month Adar, which is the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
2 Esdras 6:16 And the sons of Israel, the priests and the Levites and the remaining sons of the deportation, held the dedication of the house of God with gladness.
2 Esdras 6:17 And they offered for the dedication of the house of God a hundred calves, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, twelve male goats for sin for all Israel, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
2 Esdras 6:18 And they stationed the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their portions for the service of God in Jerusalem, according to the writing of the book of Moses.
2 Esdras 6:19 And the sons of the deportation kept the Passover on the fourteenth of the first month.
2 Esdras 6:20 For the priests and the Levites were cleansed to a man, all clean, and slaughtered the Passover for all the sons of the deportation and for their brothers the priests and for themselves.
2 Esdras 6:21 And the sons of Israel ate the Passover, those from the deportation and everyone separating from the uncleanness of the nations of the land to join them, to seek the Lord, the God of Israel.
2 Esdras 6:22 And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with gladness, because the Lord gladdened them and turned the heart of the king of Assour toward them, to strengthen their hands in the works of the house of the God of Israel.

## Chapter 7

2 Esdras 7:1 And after these words, in the reign of Arthasastha king of the Persians, Esdras went up, son of Saraios son of Azarios son of Elkia,
2 Esdras 7:2 son of Saloum son of Saddouk son of Achitob,
2 Esdras 7:3 son of Samaria son of Esria son of Mareroth,
2 Esdras 7:4 son of Zaraia son of Saouia son of Bokki,
2 Esdras 7:5 son of Abisoue son of Phinees son of Eleazar son of Aaron the first priest;
2 Esdras 7:6 this Esdras went up from Babylon, and he was a swift scribe in the law of Moses which the Lord, the God of Israel, gave; and the king gave to him, because the hand of the Lord his God was upon him, in all that he himself sought.
2 Esdras 7:7 And some of the sons of Israel and some of the priests and some of the Levites, and the singers and the gatekeepers and the Nathinim, went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Arthasastha.
2 Esdras 7:8 And they came to Jerusalem in the fifth month; this is the king's seventh year;
2 Esdras 7:9 for on the first of the first month he himself laid the foundation of the ascent from Babylon, and on the first of the fifth month they came to Jerusalem, because the hand of his God was good upon him.
2 Esdras 7:10 For Esdras put it in his heart to seek the law and do it and teach ordinances and judgments in Israel.
2 Esdras 7:11 And this is the transcript of the decree which Arthasastha gave to Esdras the priest, the scribe of the book of the words of the Lord's commandments and his ordinances for Israel:
2 Esdras 7:12 Arthasastha king of kings to Esdras, scribe of the law of the God of heaven: The word and the answer are completed.
2 Esdras 7:13 A decision was issued by me that everyone in my kingdom from the people of Israel and priests and Levites who volunteers to go to Jerusalem should go with you;
2 Esdras 7:14 he was sent from before the king and the seven counselors to examine concerning Judea and Jerusalem according to the law of their God in your hand.
2 Esdras 7:15 And for the house of the Lord, silver and gold which the king and the counselors voluntarily offered to the God of Israel dwelling in Jerusalem,
2 Esdras 7:16 and all silver and gold, whatever you may find in all the country of Babylon, together with the voluntary offering of the people and priests voluntarily offering for the house of God in Jerusalem,
2 Esdras 7:17 and everything coming in, readily enter this in this book: calves, rams, lambs and their sacrifices and their libations, and you shall offer them upon the altar of the house of your God in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 7:18 And if it seems good to you and your brothers to do anything with the remainder of the silver and gold, do as is pleasing to your God.
2 Esdras 7:19 And the vessels given to you for the ministry of the house of God, hand over before God in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 7:20 And the remainder of the need of the house of your God, whatever it seems to you to give, you shall give from the king's treasury houses.
2 Esdras 7:21 And from me—I, King Arthasastha, issued a decision to all the treasuries beyond the river—that everything which Esdras the priest and scribe of the law of the God of heaven asks of you should be done readily,
2 Esdras 7:22 up to a hundred talents of silver and up to a hundred kors of wheat and up to a hundred baths of wine and up to a hundred baths of oil, and salt for which there is no written limit.
2 Esdras 7:23 Let everything which is in the decision of the God of heaven be done. Take care lest anyone attempt anything against the house of the God of heaven, lest wrath come upon the kingdom of the king and his sons.
2 Esdras 7:24 And it has been made known to you: among all the priests and Levites, singers, gatekeepers, Nathinim and ministers of this house of God, let there be no tribute for you; you shall not have authority to enslave them.
2 Esdras 7:25 And you, Esdras, according to the wisdom of God in your hand, appoint scribes and judges, so that they may judge all the people beyond the river, all those knowing the law of your God, and to the one not knowing you shall make it known.
2 Esdras 7:26 And everyone who does not readily do the law of God and the law of the king, judgment shall be executed upon him, whether to death or discipline or loss of possessions or bonds.
2 Esdras 7:27 Blessed is the Lord, the God of our fathers, who put it thus in the king's heart to glorify the house of the Lord in Jerusalem,
2 Esdras 7:28 and inclined mercy toward me in the eyes of the king and his counselors and all the king's exalted rulers. And I was strengthened, as the good hand of God was upon me, and gathered rulers from Israel to go up with me.

## Chapter 8

2 Esdras 8:1 And these are the rulers of their families, the guides going up with me in the reign of Arthasastha king of Babylon:
2 Esdras 8:2 from the sons of Phinees, Gersom; from the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; from the sons of David, Atous;
2 Esdras 8:3 from the sons of Sachania, from the sons of Phoros, Zacharias, and with him the company, a hundred fifty;
2 Esdras 8:4 from the sons of Phaathmoab, Eliana son of Zaraia, and with him two hundred males;
2 Esdras 8:5 from the sons of Zathoe, Sechenias son of Aziel, and with him three hundred males;
2 Esdras 8:6 and from the sons of Adin, Obeth son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males;
2 Esdras 8:7 and from the sons of Elam, Jesia son of Athelia, and with him seventy males;
2 Esdras 8:8 and from the sons of Saphatia, Zabdia son of Michael, and with him eighty males;
2 Esdras 8:9 and from the sons of Joab, Abadia son of Jiel, and with him two hundred eighteen males;
2 Esdras 8:10 and from the sons of Baani, Salimouth son of Josephia, and with him a hundred sixty males;
2 Esdras 8:11 and from the sons of Babi, Zacharia son of Babi, and with him seventy-eight males;
2 Esdras 8:12 and from the sons of Asgad, Joanan son of Akatan, and with him a hundred ten males;
2 Esdras 8:13 and from the sons of Adonikam, the last ones, and these are their names: Aliphalat, Jiel and Samaia, and with them sixty males;
2 Esdras 8:14 and from the sons of Bago, Outhi, and with him seventy males.
2 Esdras 8:15 And I gathered them at the river coming toward Eui, and we camped there three days. And I examined among the people and among the priests, and I found none of the sons of Levi there;
2 Esdras 8:16 and I sent men to Eleazar, Ariel, Samaia and Alonam and Jarib and Elnathan and Nathan and Zacharia and Mesoulam, and discerning men to Joarib and Elnathan,
2 Esdras 8:17 and brought them out before a ruler in the silver of the place and put words in their mouth to speak to their brothers, the Nathinim in the silver of the place, to bring us singers for the house of our God.
2 Esdras 8:18 And there came to us, as the hand of our God was good upon us, a man sachol from the sons of Mooli son of Levi son of Israel; and at first his sons and brothers came, eighteen;
2 Esdras 8:19 and Asebia and Osaia from the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
2 Esdras 8:20 and from the Nathinim whom David and the rulers gave for the service of the Levites, two hundred twenty Nathinim; all were gathered by names.
2 Esdras 8:21 And I proclaimed a fast there at the river Aoue, to humble ourselves before our God, to seek from him a straight way for us and our children and all our possessions.
2 Esdras 8:22 For I was ashamed to ask the king for a force and horsemen to save us from an enemy on the way, because we said to the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all those seeking him for good, and his might and his wrath upon all those forsaking him.
2 Esdras 8:23 And we fasted and sought from our God concerning this, and he heeded us.
2 Esdras 8:24 And I set apart twelve from the rulers of the priests, for Saraia, Asabia and with them ten from their brothers,
2 Esdras 8:25 and weighed out to them the silver and gold and the vessels of the first offering of the house of our God, which the king and his counselors and his rulers and all Israel who were found lifted up.
2 Esdras 8:26 And I weighed out into their hands six hundred fifty talents of silver and a hundred silver vessels and a hundred talents of gold,
2 Esdras 8:27 and twenty gold kaphoure for the journey, a thousand chamanim, and various vessels of good shining bronze, desirable among gold.
2 Esdras 8:28 And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord, and the vessels are holy, and the silver and gold are voluntary offerings to the Lord, the God of your fathers;
2 Esdras 8:29 keep awake and guard them until you stand before the rulers of the priests and the Levites and the rulers of the families in Jerusalem, in the tents of the house of the Lord.
2 Esdras 8:30 And the priests and the Levites received the weight of the silver and gold and the vessels, to bring to Jerusalem, to the house of our God.
2 Esdras 8:31 And we set out from the river Aoue on the twelfth of the first month to come to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was upon us, and he delivered us from the hand of an enemy and foe on the way.
2 Esdras 8:32 And we came to Jerusalem and stayed there three days.
2 Esdras 8:33 And it happened on the fourth day that we weighed out the silver and gold and vessels in the house of our God into the hand of Merimoth son of Ouria the priest—and with him Eleazar son of Phinees, and with them Jozabad son of Jesus and Noadia son of Banaia, the Levites—
2 Esdras 8:34 everything by number and weight, and all the weight was written. At that time,
2 Esdras 8:35 those who came from the captivity, sons of the sojourning, offered whole burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve calves for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, twelve male goats for sin, all whole burnt offerings to the Lord.
2 Esdras 8:36 And they gave the king's ordinance to the king's administrators and governors beyond the river, and they glorified the people and the house of God.

## Chapter 9

2 Esdras 9:1 And when these things were completed, the rulers approached me, saying, The people Israel and the priests and the Levites were not separated from the peoples of the lands in their abominations, the Chanani, the Ethi, the Pherezi, the Jebousi, the Ammoni, the Moabi, the Moseri and the Amori,
2 Esdras 9:2 for they took from their daughters for themselves and for their sons, and the holy seed was brought among peoples of the lands, and the hand of the rulers was foremost in this faithlessness.
2 Esdras 9:3 And when I heard this word, I tore my garments and was leaping, and I was plucking from the hairs of my head and from my beard, and I sat remaining still.
2 Esdras 9:4 And everyone pursuing the word of the God of Israel gathered to me over the faithlessness of the exiled community, and I was sitting, remaining still until the evening sacrifice.
2 Esdras 9:5 And at the evening sacrifice I arose from my humiliation; and as I tore my garments, I was leaping, and I bend upon my knees and spread out my hands toward the Lord God
2 Esdras 9:6 and said, Lord, I was ashamed and abashed to lift my face toward you, for our lawless deeds multiplied above our head, and our offenses grew great as far as heaven.
2 Esdras 9:7 From the days of our fathers we are in great offense until this day; and in our lawless deeds we were handed over, we and our kings and our sons, into the hand of kings of the nations, with sword and with captivity and with plunder and with shame of our face, as this day.
2 Esdras 9:8 And now the Lord our God dealt leniently with us, to leave something for us for salvation and to give us a support in the place of his sanctuary, to enlighten our eyes and give a little quickening in our slavery.
2 Esdras 9:9 For we are slaves, and in our slavery the Lord our God did not abandon us, and he inclined mercy upon us before kings of Persians, to give us quickening, for them to raise the house of our God and restore her desolate places, and to give us a fence in Judah and in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 9:10 What should we say, our God, after this? For we abandoned your commandments,
2 Esdras 9:11 which you gave us by the hand of your slaves the prophets, saying, The land into which you enter to inherit it is a land being displaced by the displacement of peoples of the nations in their abominations, with which they filled it from mouth to mouth in their uncleannesses;
2 Esdras 9:12 and now do not give your daughters to their sons, and do not take from their daughters for your sons, and you shall not seek out their peace and their good forever, so that you may grow strong and eat the good things of the land and bequeath them to your sons forever.
2 Esdras 9:13 And after everything coming upon us in our evil deeds and in our great offense; for there is none like our God, for you lightened our lawless deeds and gave us salvation;
2 Esdras 9:14 for we turned back to scatter your commandments and to intermarry with the peoples of the lands; do not be provoked against us to the point of consummation, so that there is no remnant and survivor.
2 Esdras 9:15 Lord, God of Israel, you are righteous, for we were left surviving, as this day; behold, we are before you in our offenses, for it is not possible to stand before you on account of this.

## Chapter 10

2 Esdras 10:1 And as Esdras prayed and as he confessed, weeping and praying before the house of God, a very great assembly gathered to him from Israel, men and women and young men, for the people wept and raised their voice, weeping.
2 Esdras 10:2 And Sechenias son of Jiiel, from the sons of Elam, answered and said to Esdras, We acted faithlessly toward our God and settled foreign wives from the peoples of the land; and now there is endurance for Israel in this.
2 Esdras 10:3 And now let us make a covenant with our God to cast out all the wives and what was born from them, as you wish; arise and frighten them with the commandments of our God, and let it happen according to the law.
2 Esdras 10:4 Arise, for the matter is upon you, and we are with you; be strong and act.
2 Esdras 10:5 And Esdras arose and made the rulers, the priests and Levites and all Israel swear to act according to this word, and they swore.
2 Esdras 10:6 And Esdras arose from before the house of God and went into the treasury of Joanan son of Elisoub, and he went there; he did not eat bread and did not drink water, for he was mourning over the faithlessness of the exiled community.
2 Esdras 10:7 And they carried a proclamation through Judah and through Jerusalem to all the sons of the exiled community, to be gathered into Jerusalem,
2 Esdras 10:8 and everyone who does not come within three days, according to the counsel of the rulers and the elders, all his property shall be devoted to destruction, and he shall be separated from the assembly of the exiled community.
2 Esdras 10:9 And all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered into Jerusalem within the three days; this was the ninth month. On the twentieth of the month all the people sat in the square of the house of God, because of their disturbance concerning the matter and because of the storm.
2 Esdras 10:10 And Esdras the priest arose and said to them, You acted faithlessly and settled foreign wives, to add to Israel's offense;
2 Esdras 10:11 and now give praise to the Lord, the God of your fathers, and do what is pleasing before him, and separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives.
2 Esdras 10:12 And the whole assembly answered and said, Great is this word of yours for us to do;
2 Esdras 10:13 but the people are many, and the season is wintry, and there is no ability to stand outside; and the work is not for one day and not for two, for we multiplied wrongdoing in this matter.
2 Esdras 10:14 Let our rulers, then, stand for the whole assembly, and let all those in our cities, whoever settled foreign wives, come at times by arrangements, and with them elders of each city and judges, to turn away the wrath of the anger of our God from us concerning this matter.
2 Esdras 10:15 Only Jonathan son of Asael and Jazia son of Thekoue were with me concerning this, and Mesoulam and Sabbathai the Levite were helping them.
2 Esdras 10:16 And the sons of the exiled community did so. And Esdras the priest and men who were rulers of ancestral families were set apart by house, and all by names, for they turned on the first day of the tenth month to investigate the matter.
2 Esdras 10:17 And they finished with all the men who settled foreign wives by the first day of the first month.
2 Esdras 10:18 And among the sons of the priests were found those who settled foreign wives: from the sons of Jesus son of Josedek and his brothers, Maasea and Eliezer and Jarib and Gadalia,
2 Esdras 10:19 and they gave their hand to put out their wives, and a ram from the sheep as an offering for offense, concerning their offense;
2 Esdras 10:20 and from the sons of Emmer, Anani and Zabdia;
2 Esdras 10:21 and from the sons of Eram, Masaia and Elia and Samaia and Jiiel and Ozia;
2 Esdras 10:22 and from the sons of Phasour, Elioenai, Maasaia and Ishmael and Nathanael and Jozabad and Elasa. –
2 Esdras 10:23 And from the Levites: Jozabad and Samou and Kolia [he is Kolitas] and Phathaia and Jodom and Eliezer;
2 Esdras 10:24 and from those singing, Elisaph; and from the gatekeepers, Sellem and Telem and Odoue. –
2 Esdras 10:25 And from Israel: from the sons of Phoros, Ramia and Jazia and Melchia and Meamin and Eleazar and Asabia and Banaia;
2 Esdras 10:26 and from the sons of Elam, Mathania and Zacharia and Jaiel and Abdia and Jarimoth and Elia;
2 Esdras 10:27 and from the sons of Zathoua, Elioenai, Elisoub, Mathania and Jarmoth and Zabad and Oziza;
2 Esdras 10:28 and from the sons of Babi, Joanan, Anania and Zabou, Othali;
2 Esdras 10:29 and from the sons of Banoui, Mesoulam, Malouch, Adaias, Jasoub and Salouia and Remoth;
2 Esdras 10:30 and from the sons of Phaathmoab, Edene, Chalel, Banaia, Masea, Mathania, Beselel and Banoui and Manasse;
2 Esdras 10:31 and from the sons of Eram, Eliezer, Jessia, Melchia, Samaia, Semeon,
2 Esdras 10:32 Benjamin, Malouch, Samaria;
2 Esdras 10:33 and from the sons of Esam, Mathani, Mathatha, Zabed, Eliphaleth, Jerami, Manasse, Semei;
2 Esdras 10:34 from the sons of Bani, Moodi, Amram, Ouel,
2 Esdras 10:35 Banaia, Badaia, Chelia,
2 Esdras 10:36 Oujechoa, Jeremoth, Eliasib,
2 Esdras 10:37 Mathania, Mathanai, and they acted,
2 Esdras 10:38 the sons of Banoui and the sons of Semei
2 Esdras 10:39 and Selemia and Nathan and Adaia,
2 Esdras 10:40 Machnadabou, Sesi, Sarou,
2 Esdras 10:41 Ezerel and Selemia and Samaria
2 Esdras 10:42 and Saloum, Amaria, Joseph;
2 Esdras 10:43 from the sons of Nabou, Jiiel, Mathathia, Sedem, Zambina, Jadai and Joel and Banaia. –
2 Esdras 10:44 All these took foreign wives and begot sons from them.

## Chapter 11

2 Esdras 11:1 Words of Neemias son of Achalia. And it happened in the month Chaseelou, in the twentieth year, and I was in Sousan abira,
2 Esdras 11:2 and Anani, one of my brothers, came, he and men of Judah, and I asked them concerning those saved, who were left from the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 11:3 And they said to me, Those remaining, who were left from the captivity there in the country, are in great evil and in reproach, and the walls of Jerusalem are torn down, and her gates were burned with fire.
2 Esdras 11:4 And it happened, when I heard these words, I sat and wept and mourned for days, and I was fasting and praying before the God of heaven
2 Esdras 11:5 and said, Not so, Lord, God of heaven, the strong, the great and the fearsome, keeping the covenant and mercy for those loving him and those keeping his commandments;
2 Esdras 11:6 let your ear, then, be attentive and your eyes opened to hear your slave's prayer, which I pray before you today, day and night, concerning the sons of Israel, your slaves, and I confess concerning the sins of the sons of Israel which we sinned against you. Both I and my father's house sinned;
2 Esdras 11:7 with dissolution we acted dissolutely toward you, and we did not keep the commandments and the ordinances and the judgments which you commanded Moses your servant.
2 Esdras 11:8 Remember, then, the word which you commanded Moses your servant, saying, If you act faithlessly, I will scatter you among the peoples;
2 Esdras 11:9 and if you turn toward me and keep my commandments and do them, if your dispersion is from the end of heaven, from there I will gather them and bring them into the place which I chose for my name to dwell there.
2 Esdras 11:10 And they are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed with your great power and with your mighty hand.
2 Esdras 11:11 Not so, Lord, but let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your slave and to the prayer of your servants who wish to fear your name, and give success, then, to your servant today and give him into compassion before this man. – And I was cupbearer to the king.

## Chapter 12

2 Esdras 12:1 And it happened in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year for King Arthasastha, and the wine was before me, and I took the wine and gave it to the king, and there was no other before him;
2 Esdras 12:2 and the king said to me, Why is your face evil, and are you not being moderate? This is nothing except evil of heart. And I feared very greatly.
2 Esdras 12:3 And I said to the king, Let the king live forever; why should my face certainly not become evil, since the city, the house of my fathers' tombs, was made desolate, and her gates were consumed with fire?
2 Esdras 12:4 And the king said to me, Concerning what do you seek this? And I prayed to the God of heaven
2 Esdras 12:5 and said to the king, If it is good to the king, and if your servant will be favored before you, so as to send him to Judah, to the city of my fathers' tombs, then I will rebuild it.
2 Esdras 12:6 And the king and the concubine sitting beside him said to me, Until when will your journey be, and when will you return? And it was pleasing before the king, and he sent me away, and I gave him a limit.
2 Esdras 12:7 And I said to the king, If it is good to the king, let him give me letters to the governors beyond the river, so as to convey me through until I come to Judah,
2 Esdras 12:8 and a letter to Asaph, keeper of the garden which belongs to the king, so as to give me timber to roof the gates, and for the wall of the city, and for a house which I will enter into it. And the king gave to me according to the good hand of God.
2 Esdras 12:9 And I came to the governors beyond the river and gave them the king's letters, and the king sent commanders of the force and horsemen with me. –
2 Esdras 12:10 And Sanaballat the Aroni and Tobia the slave, the Ammoni, heard, and it became evil to them that a man had come to seek good for the sons of Israel.
2 Esdras 12:11 And I came into Jerusalem and was there three days.
2 Esdras 12:12 And I arose at night, I and a few men with me; and I did not report to a man what God puts into my heart to do with Israel, and there is no beast with me except the beast upon which I ride.
2 Esdras 12:13 And I went out by the gate of the golela and toward the mouth of the spring of the figs and to the gate of the dung, and I was breaking in the wall of Jerusalem which they themselves pull down, and her gates were consumed by fire.
2 Esdras 12:14 And I passed to the gate of Ain and into the king's pool, and there was no place for the beast beneath me to pass through.
2 Esdras 12:15 And I was going up on the wall of the torrent at night, and I was breaking in the wall. And I was at the gate of the ravine and returned.
2 Esdras 12:16 And those guarding did not know what I went for and what I do, and to the Jews and to the priests and to those honored and to the generals and to the remaining ones doing the works, until then I did not report it.
2 Esdras 12:17 And I said to them, You see the evil in which we are in it, how Jerusalem is desolate and her gates were given to fire; come, and let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be a reproach.
2 Esdras 12:18 And I reported to them the hand of God, which is good upon me, and the king's words which he said to me, and I said, Let us arise and build. And their hands were strengthened for good. –
2 Esdras 12:19 And Sanaballat the Aroni and Tobia the slave, the Ammoni, and Gesam the Arabi heard and laughed at us and came against us and said, What is this matter which you do? Are you rebelling against the king?
2 Esdras 12:20 And I returned a word to them and said to them, The God of heaven, he himself will give us success, and we are his clean slaves, and we will build; and for you there is no portion and righteousness and memorial in Jerusalem.

## Chapter 13

2 Esdras 13:1 And Elisoub the great priest and his brothers the priests arose and built the sheep gate; they themselves sanctified it and set up its doors, and as far as the tower of the hundred they sanctified, as far as the tower of Ananeel,
2 Esdras 13:2 and at the hands of sons of men of Jericho, and at the hands of sons of Zakchour son of Amari.
2 Esdras 13:3 And the sons of Asana built the fish gate; they themselves roofed it and set up its doors and its locks and its bars.
2 Esdras 13:4 And at their hand, from Ramoth, a son of Ouria son of Akos held firm. And at their hand Mosollam son of Barachiou son of Masezebel held firm. And at their hand Sadok son of Baana held firm.
2 Esdras 13:5 And at their hand the Thekoin held firm, and adoriem did not bring their neck into their service.
2 Esdras 13:6 And Joida son of Phasek and Mesoulam son of Basodia made firm the gate of Isana; they themselves roofed it and set up its doors and its locks and its bars.
2 Esdras 13:8 And at their hand Ananias son of Rokeim made firm, and they left Jerusalem as far as the broad wall.
2 Esdras 13:9 And at their hand Raphaia, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made firm.
2 Esdras 13:10 And at their hand Jedaia son of Eromaph made firm, also opposite his house. And at his hand Atous son of Asbania made firm.
2 Esdras 13:11 And second, Melchias son of Eram and Asoub son of Phaathmoab made firm, also as far as the tower of the thannourim.
2 Esdras 13:12 And at his hand Saloum son of Alloes, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made firm, he and his daughters.
2 Esdras 13:13 Anoun and those dwelling in Zano made firm the gate of the ravine; they themselves built it and set up its doors and its locks and its bars, and a thousand cubits in the wall as far as the gate of the dung.
2 Esdras 13:14 And Melchia son of Rechab, ruler of the district of Bethacharm, made firm the gate of the dung, he and his sons, and they covered it and set up its doors and its locks and its bars.
2 Esdras 13:15 And the wall of the pool of the fleeces, at the king's shearing, and as far as the stairs descending from the city of David.
2 Esdras 13:16 Behind him Neemias son of Azabouch, ruler of half the district of Bethsour, made firm as far as the garden of David's tomb and as far as the pool that had been made and as far as Bethanggabarim.
2 Esdras 13:17 Behind him the Levites made firm, Raoum son of Bani. At his hand Asabia, ruler of half the district of Keila, made firm for his district.
2 Esdras 13:18 After him their brothers made firm, Beni son of Enadad, ruler of half the district of Keila.
2 Esdras 13:19 And at his hand Azour son of Jesus, ruler of Masphe, made firm a second measure of the tower of the ascent adjoining the corner.
2 Esdras 13:20 After him Barouch son of Zabou made firm a second measure, from the corner as far as the door of Bethelisoub the great priest.
2 Esdras 13:21 After him Meramoth son of Ouria son of Akos made firm a second measure, from the door of Bethelisoub as far as the end of Bethelisoub.
2 Esdras 13:22 And after him the priests, men of Achechar, made firm.
2 Esdras 13:23 And after him Benjamin and Asoub made firm opposite their house. After him Azaria son of Maasea son of Anania made firm beside his house.
2 Esdras 13:24 After him Bani son of Enadad made firm a second measure, from Bethazaria as far as the corner and as far as the bend,
2 Esdras 13:25 Phalal son of Euzai opposite the corner, and the tower projecting from the king's house, the upper one belonging to the court of the guard. And after him Phadaia son of Phoros.
2 Esdras 13:26 And the nathinim were dwelling in Ophal as far as the garden of the water gate eastward, and the projecting tower.
2 Esdras 13:27 After him the Thekoin made firm a second measure opposite the great projecting tower and as far as the wall of Ophla.
2 Esdras 13:28 Above the gate of the horses the priests made firm, each man opposite his house.
2 Esdras 13:29 After him Saddouk son of Emmer made firm opposite his house. And after him Samaia son of Sechenia, keeper of the gate of the east, made firm.
2 Esdras 13:30 After him Anania son of Selemia and Anoum son of Seleph, the sixth, made firm a second measure. After him Mesoulam son of Barchia made firm opposite his treasury.
2 Esdras 13:31 After him Melchia son of Saraphi made firm as far as Bethanathinim, and the dealers in small wares opposite the gate of Maphekad and as far as the ascent of the bend.
2 Esdras 13:32 And between the ascent of the sheep gate the smiths and the dealers in small wares made firm.
2 Esdras 13:33 And it happened, when Sanaballat heard that we are building the wall, it was evil to him, and he was greatly angered and laughed at the Jews.
2 Esdras 13:34 And he said before his brothers, Is this the power of Somoron, that these Jews build their own city?
2 Esdras 13:35 And Tobias the Ammanite came beside him, and they said to one another, Surely they will not sacrifice or eat at their place? Will not a fox go up and pull down their wall of stones? –
2 Esdras 13:36 Hear, our God, for we became an object of mockery, and turn their reproach upon their head, and give them over to mockery in a land of captivity,
2 Esdras 13:37 and do not cover over lawlessness.

## Chapter 14

2 Esdras 14:1 And it happened, when Sanaballat and Tobia and the Arabs and the Ammanites heard that growth had risen on the walls of Jerusalem, that the breaches began to be blocked up, it appeared very evil to them;
2 Esdras 14:2 and they all gathered together to come to array themselves for battle in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 14:3 And we prayed to our God and stationed advance guards against them day and night because of them.
2 Esdras 14:4 And Judah said, The strength of the enemies was broken, and the loose earth is much, and we will not be able to build in the wall.
2 Esdras 14:5 And those afflicting us said, They will not know and will not see until we come into their midst and murder them and stop the work.
2 Esdras 14:6 And it happened, when the Jews dwelling beside them came and said to us, They are coming up against us from all the places,
2 Esdras 14:7 then I stationed men in the lowest parts of the place behind the wall in the sheltered places, and I stationed the people by communities with their swords, their spears and their bows.
2 Esdras 14:8 And I saw and arose and said to those honored and to the generals and to the remaining people, Do not fear before them; remember our great and fearsome God, and array yourselves for battle for your brothers, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your houses.
2 Esdras 14:9 And it happened, when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God scattered their counsel, we all returned to the wall, each man to his work.
2 Esdras 14:10 And it happened, from that day half of those shaken out were doing the work, and half of them were holding out, and spears and shields and the bows and the breastplates and the rulers were behind the whole house of Judah,
2 Esdras 14:11 of those building in the wall. And those lifting with the carrying apparatus were with weapons; with one hand he was doing the work itself, and one was holding the missile.
2 Esdras 14:12 And the builders, each man girded with his sword upon his loin, were building, and the one sounding the horn was beside him.
2 Esdras 14:13 And I said to those honored and to the rulers and to the remaining people, The work is broad and great, and we are scattered upon the wall, each man far from his brother;
2 Esdras 14:14 in whatever place you hear the sound of the horn, there you shall gather to us, and our God will fight for us.
2 Esdras 14:15 And we were doing the work, and half of them were holding the spears, from the rising of dawn until the coming out of the stars.
2 Esdras 14:16 And at that time I said to the people, Lodge in the midst of Jerusalem, and let the night be for you an advance guard and the day work.
2 Esdras 14:17 And I was there, and the men of the advance guard were behind me, and there was not a man among us taking off his garments.

## Chapter 15

2 Esdras 15:1 And there was a great cry of the people and their wives against their brothers the Jews.
2 Esdras 15:2 And there were some saying, With our sons and with our daughters we are many; and we will take grain and eat and live.
2 Esdras 15:3 And there are some saying, Our fields and our vineyards and our houses, we pledge; and we will take grain and eat.
2 Esdras 15:4 And there are some saying, We borrowed silver for the king's taxes, our fields and our vineyards and our houses;
2 Esdras 15:5 and now our flesh is like the flesh of our brothers, our sons like their sons; and behold, we subject our sons and our daughters to oppression as slaves, and some of our daughters are being oppressed, and there is no power in our hands, and our fields and our vineyards belong to those honored. –
2 Esdras 15:6 And I was greatly grieved when I heard their cry and these words.
2 Esdras 15:7 And my heart took counsel within me, and I contended with those honored and the rulers and said to them, By exaction you exact, each man from his brother. And I set a great assembly against them
2 Esdras 15:8 and said to them, We have acquired our brothers the Jews who are sold to the nations, of our own free will; and do you sell your brothers? And they were silent and did not find a word.
2 Esdras 15:9 And I said, The matter which you do is not good; not so, in the fear of our God you shall go away from the reproach of the nations, our enemies.
2 Esdras 15:10 And my brothers and my acquaintances and I placed silver and grain among them; let us abandon this exaction, then.
2 Esdras 15:11 Return to them, then, as of today, their fields, their vineyards, their olive trees and their houses; and from the silver bring out to them the grain and the wine and the oil.
2 Esdras 15:12 And they said, We will give back and will not seek anything from them; thus we will do, as you say. And I called the priests and made them swear to act according to this word.
2 Esdras 15:13 And I shook out my mantle and said, Thus may God shake out every man who will not establish this word, from his house and from his labor, and thus he shall be shaken out and empty. And the whole assembly said, Amen, and they praised the Lord; and the people did this thing.
2 Esdras 15:14 From the day on which he commanded me to be their ruler in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year and until the thirty-second year for Arthasastha, twelve years, I and my brothers did not eat their forced levy;
2 Esdras 15:15 and the former forced levies, which before me they imposed heavily upon them, and they took from them in bread and in wine, in addition silver, forty didrachms, and those of theirs shaken out exercise authority over the people, and I did not act so because of fear of God.
2 Esdras 15:16 And in the work of the wall of these I did not take hold; I did not acquire a field; and all those gathered were there for the work.
2 Esdras 15:17 And the Jews, a hundred and fifty men, and those coming to us from the nations around us were at my table.
2 Esdras 15:18 And what was prepared for one day was one calf and six choice sheep, and a young goat was prepared for me, and at intervals of ten days, among all things, wine in abundance; and with these things I did not seek bread of the forced levy, for the service was heavy upon this people. –
2 Esdras 15:19 Remember for me, God, for good, all that I did for this people.

## Chapter 16

2 Esdras 16:1 And it happened, when it was heard by Sanaballat and Tobia and Gesam the Arabi and the remaining ones of our enemies that I built the wall, no breath was left in them. Until that time I had not set doors in the gates.
2 Esdras 16:2 And Sanaballat and Gesam sent to me, saying, Come, and let us gather together in the villages in the plain of Ono; and they were considering doing evil to me.
2 Esdras 16:3 And I sent messengers to them, saying, I am doing a great work and will not be able to go down, lest the work stop; when I complete it, I will go down to you.
2 Esdras 16:4 And they sent to me according to this word, and I sent to them according to these things.
2 Esdras 16:5 And Sanaballat sent to me his servant, and an opened letter in his hand.
2 Esdras 16:6 And it was written in it, It was heard among nations that you and the Jews consider rebelling; for this reason you build the wall, and you become their king;
2 Esdras 16:7 and in addition to these things you stationed prophets for yourself, so that you may sit in Jerusalem as king in Judah; and now these words will be reported to the king; and now come, let us take counsel together.
2 Esdras 16:8 And I sent to him, saying, It did not happen according to these words which you say, for from your heart you fabricate them.
2 Esdras 16:9 For they all frighten us, saying, Their hands will grow slack from this work, and it will not be done; and now I strengthened my hands.
2 Esdras 16:10 And I entered into the house of Semei son of Dalaia son of Meetabel – and he was confined – and he said, Let us gather into the house of God, into its midst, and close its doors, for they are coming at night to murder you.
2 Esdras 16:11 And I said, Who is the man who will enter into the house and live?
2 Esdras 16:12 And I recognized, and behold, God did not send him, for the prophecy was a word against me, and Tobias and Sanaballat hired
2 Esdras 16:13 a crowd against me, so that I might fear and do thus and sin and become an evil name for them, so that they might reproach me. –
2 Esdras 16:14 Remember, God, for Tobia and Sanaballat according to these deeds of his, and for Noadia the prophet and the remaining prophets who were frightening me.
2 Esdras 16:15 And the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Eloul, in fifty-two days.
2 Esdras 16:16 And it happened, when all our enemies heard, all the nations around us feared, and fear fell greatly in their eyes, and they knew that it came about from our God for this work to be completed. –
2 Esdras 16:17 And in those days letters from many honored men of Judah were going to Tobia, and those of Tobia were coming to them,
2 Esdras 16:18 for many in Judah were bound by oath to him, for he was son-in-law of Sechenia son of Erae, and Joanan his son took the daughter of Mesoulam son of Barachia as wife.
2 Esdras 16:19 And they were saying his words to me and carrying out my words to him, and Tobias sent letters to frighten me.

## Chapter 17

2 Esdras 17:1 And it happened, when the wall was built, I set up the doors, and the gatekeepers and those singing and the Levites were appointed.
2 Esdras 17:2 And I gave orders to Anania my brother and to Anania, ruler of the bira in Jerusalem, for he was like a truthful man and one fearing God beyond many,
2 Esdras 17:3 and I said to them, The gates of Jerusalem shall not be opened until the sun is up, and while they are still watching, let the doors be closed and wedged shut; and station advance guards from those dwelling in Jerusalem, each man at his guard post and each man opposite his house.
2 Esdras 17:4 And the city was broad and great, and the people few in it, and there were no houses built.
2 Esdras 17:5 And God put it into my heart, and I gathered those honored and the rulers and the people into companies; and I found a book of the company, those who went up among the first, and I found written in it,
2 Esdras 17:6 And these are sons of the country who went up from the captivity of the exiled community which Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon exiled, and they returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, each man to his city,
2 Esdras 17:7 with Zorobabel and Jesus and Neemias, Azaria, Daemia, Naemani, Mardochaios, Balsan, Maspharath, Esdras, Bagoi, Naoum, Baana, Masphar. Men of the people Israel:

2 Esdras 17:72 and the remaining people gave twenty thousand of gold and two thousand two hundred minas of silver and sixty-seven chothonoth of the priests. –
2 Esdras 17:73 And the priests and the Levites and the gatekeepers and those singing and those from the people and the nathinim and all Israel settled in their cities. And the seventh month arrived – and the sons of Israel were in their cities –

## Chapter 18

2 Esdras 18:1 and all the people gathered as one man into the broad space in front of the water gate. And they told Esdras the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the Lord commanded Israel.
2 Esdras 18:2 And Esdras the priest brought the law before the assembly, from man to woman, and everyone understanding to hear, on the first day of the seventh month,
2 Esdras 18:3 and he read in it from the hour when the sun shines through until the middle of the day, before the men and the women, and they were understanding, and the ears of all the people were toward the book of the law.
2 Esdras 18:4 And Esdras the scribe stood upon a wooden platform, and beside him stood Mattathias and Samaias and Ananias and Ouria and Elkia and Maasaia on his right, and on the left Phadaias and Misael and Melchias and Osam and Asabdana and Zacharias and Mosollam.
2 Esdras 18:5 And Esdras opened the book before all the people – for he was above the people – and it happened, when he opened it, all the people stood.
2 Esdras 18:6 And Esdras blessed the Lord, the great God, and all the people answered and said, Amen, lifting their hands, and they bent down and worshiped the Lord upon their face on the earth.
2 Esdras 18:7 And Jesus and Banaias and Sarabia were instructing the people in the law, and the people were at their station.
2 Esdras 18:8 And they read in the book of the law of God, and Esdras taught and explained distinctly in knowledge of the Lord, and the people understood in the reading. –
2 Esdras 18:9 And Neemias and Esdras the priest and scribe and the Levites instructing the people spoke and said to all the people, The day is holy to the Lord our God; do not mourn or weep; for all the people were weeping when they heard the words of the law.
2 Esdras 18:10 And he said to them, Go, eat rich foods and drink sweet drinks and send portions to those who do not have, for the day is holy to our Lord; and do not fall apart, for it is your strength.
2 Esdras 18:11 And the Levites were quieting all the people, saying, Be silent, for the day is holy, and do not fall down.
2 Esdras 18:12 And all the people went away to eat and drink and send portions and make great rejoicing, for they understood the words which he made known to them.
2 Esdras 18:13 And on the second day the rulers of the ancestral families for all the people, the priests and the Levites, gathered to Esdras the scribe to attend to all the words of the law.
2 Esdras 18:14 And they found written in the law which the Lord commanded Moses, that the sons of Israel should dwell in tents during a feast in the seventh month,
2 Esdras 18:15 and that they should signal with trumpets in all their cities and in Jerusalem. And Esdras said, Go out to the mountain and bring olive leaves and leaves of cypress trees and myrtle leaves and palm leaves and leaves of a dense tree, to make tents according to what is written.
2 Esdras 18:16 And the people went out and brought them and made tents for themselves, each man upon his roof, and in their courts and in the courts of the house of God and in the squares of the city and as far as the gate of Ephraim.
2 Esdras 18:17 And the whole assembly, those returning from the captivity, made tents and settled in tents; for from the days of Jesus son of Naue the sons of Israel had not done so until that day; and there was great rejoicing.
2 Esdras 18:18 And he read in the book of the law of God day by day, from the first day until the last day; and they held a feast for seven days, and on the eighth day a closing observance according to the judgment.

## Chapter 19

2 Esdras 19:1 And on the twenty-fourth day of this month the sons of Israel gathered in fasting and in sackcloth.
2 Esdras 19:2 And the sons of Israel separated themselves from every foreign son and stood and confessed their sins and the lawless deeds of their fathers.
2 Esdras 19:3 And they stood at their station and read in the book of the law of the Lord their God, and they were confessing to the Lord and worshiping the Lord their God.
2 Esdras 19:4 And on the ascent of the Levites stood Jesus and sons of Kadmiel, Sachania son of Sarabia, sons of Chanani, and they cried with a great voice to the Lord their God.
2 Esdras 19:5 And the Levites Jesus and Kadmiel said, Arise, bless the Lord your God from age to age, and they will bless the name of your glory and exalt it above every blessing and praise.
2 Esdras 19:6 And Esdras said, You yourself alone are Lord; you made heaven and the heaven of heaven and all their array, the earth and all that is in it, the seas and all that is in them, and you give life to all things, and the armies of the heavens worship you.
2 Esdras 19:7 You are the Lord God; you made your choice in Abram and brought him out of the country of the Chaldeans and placed upon him the name Abraham;
2 Esdras 19:8 and you found his heart faithful before you and made a covenant with him to give him the land of the Chananites and Chettites and Amorrites and Pherezites and Jebousites and Gergesites, and to his seed; and you established your words, for you are righteous.
2 Esdras 19:9 And you saw the humiliation of our fathers in Egypt and heard their cry at the Red Sea.
2 Esdras 19:10 And you gave signs in Egypt, in Pharaoh and in all his servants and in all the people of his land, for you knew that they acted arrogantly against them, and you made a name for yourself, as this day.
2 Esdras 19:11 And you broke open the sea before them, and they passed through the midst of the sea on dry ground, and those pursuing them you threw into the deep like a stone in mighty water.
2 Esdras 19:12 And in a pillar of cloud you guided them by day, and in a pillar of fire by night, to light for them the way in which they will travel.
2 Esdras 19:13 And you descended upon Mount Sina and spoke to them from heaven and gave them upright judgments and laws of truth, good ordinances and commandments.
2 Esdras 19:14 And you made known to them your holy sabbath; commandments and ordinances and law you commanded them by the hand of Moses your slave.
2 Esdras 19:15 And you gave them bread from heaven for their lack of grain and brought out water from rock for them for their thirst. And you told them to enter to inherit the land concerning which you stretched out your hand to give it to them.
2 Esdras 19:16 And they and our fathers acted arrogantly and hardened their neck and did not hear your commandments;
2 Esdras 19:17 and they refused to listen and did not remember your wonders which you did with them, and they hardened their neck and gave a beginning to return to their slavery in Egypt. And you are a merciful and compassionate God, long-suffering and abundant in mercy, and you did not abandon them.
2 Esdras 19:18 And moreover they also made themselves a cast calf and said, These are the gods who brought us out of Egypt; and they made great provocations to anger.
2 Esdras 19:19 And you in your many compassions did not abandon them in the wilderness; you did not turn away from them the pillar of cloud by day to guide them in the way, and the pillar of fire by night to light for them the way in which they will travel.
2 Esdras 19:20 And you gave your good spirit to instruct them, and you did not withhold your manna from their mouth, and you gave them water for their thirst.
2 Esdras 19:21 And forty years you nourished them in the wilderness; they did not lack; their garments did not grow old, and their feet did not split open.
2 Esdras 19:22 And you gave them kingdoms and peoples and divided them for them, and they inherited the land of Seon king of Esebon and the land of Og king of Basan.
2 Esdras 19:23 And you multiplied their sons like the stars of heaven and brought them into the land which you spoke of to their fathers, and they inherited it.
2 Esdras 19:24 And you wiped out before them those dwelling in the land of the Chananites and gave them into their hands, and their kings and the peoples of the land, to do to them as was pleasing before them.
2 Esdras 19:25 And they seized high cities and inherited houses full of all good things, hewn pits, vineyards and olive groves and every tree for food in abundance; and they ate and were filled and grew fat and lived luxuriously in your great goodness.
2 Esdras 19:26 And they changed and departed from you and threw your law behind their body and killed your prophets, who testified among them to turn them toward you, and they made great provocations to anger.
2 Esdras 19:27 And you gave them into the hand of those afflicting them, and they afflicted them; and they cried out to you at the time of their affliction, and you heard from your heaven and in your great compassions gave them saviors and saved them from the hand of those afflicting them.
2 Esdras 19:28 And when they rested, they turned back to do evil before you; and you abandoned them into the hands of their enemies, and they ruled over them. And again they cried out to you, and you listened from heaven and rescued them in your many compassions.
2 Esdras 19:29 And you testified to them to turn them to your law, and they did not hear, but in your commandments and in your judgments they sinned, which, if a man does them, he will live in them; and they gave a disobedient back and hardened their neck and did not hear.
2 Esdras 19:30 And you prolonged matters over them for many years and testified to them by your spirit through the hand of your prophets; and they did not give ear, and you gave them into the hand of peoples of the land.
2 Esdras 19:31 And you in your many compassions did not make an end of them and did not abandon them, for you are strong and merciful and compassionate.
2 Esdras 19:32 And now, our God, the strong, the great, the mighty and the fearsome, keeping your covenant and your mercy, let not all the hardship be made little before you which found us and our kings and our rulers and our priests and our prophets and our fathers, and among all your people, from the days of kings of Assour and until this day.
2 Esdras 19:33 And you are righteous in all things coming upon us, for you acted in truth, and we sinned.
2 Esdras 19:34 And our kings and our rulers and our priests and our fathers did not do your law and did not attend to your commandments and your testimonies which you testified to them.
2 Esdras 19:35 And they in your kingdom and in your abundant goodness which you gave them, and in the broad and rich land which you gave before them, did not serve you and did not turn away from their evil practices.
2 Esdras 19:36 Behold, today we are slaves, and the land which you gave our fathers to eat its fruit,
2 Esdras 19:37 is for the kings whom you gave over us in our sins, and they exercise authority over our bodies and over our beasts as is pleasing to them, and we are in great affliction.

2 Esdras 20:31 and not to give our daughters to the peoples of the land, and we will not take their daughters for our sons.
2 Esdras 20:32 And the peoples of the land who bring merchandise and every article for sale on the sabbath day to sell, we do not buy from them on the sabbath and on a holy day. And we will release the seventh year and the exaction of every hand.
2 Esdras 20:33 And we will establish commandments upon ourselves, to impose upon ourselves the giving of a third of the didrachm each year for the service of the house of our God,
2 Esdras 20:34 for bread of the presence and the continual sacrifice and for the continual whole burnt offering of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the feasts and for the holy things, and the offerings for sin to make atonement for Israel, and for works of the house of our God.
2 Esdras 20:35 And we cast lots concerning the lot of wood-bearing, the priests and the Levites and the people, to bring it into the house of our God, by house of our ancestral families, at appointed times, year by year, to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God, as it is written in the law,
2 Esdras 20:36 and to bring the first produce of our land and the first produce of the fruit of every tree, year by year, into the house of the Lord,
2 Esdras 20:37 and the firstborn of our sons and of our beasts, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our cattle and our flocks, to bring into the house of our God to the priests ministering in the house of our God.
2 Esdras 20:38 And the first portion of our grain and the fruit of every tree, of wine and of oil, we will bring to the priests into the treasury of the house of God; and a tenth of our land to the Levites. And the Levites themselves collect tithes in all the cities of our service,
2 Esdras 20:39 and the priest, a son of Aaron, shall be with the Levite at the Levite's tithe, and the Levites will bring up the tenth of the tenth into the house of our God, into the treasuries, into the house of God.
2 Esdras 20:40 For into the treasuries the sons of Israel and the sons of Levi will bring the first portions of grain and of wine and of oil, and there are the holy vessels and the priests who minister and the gatekeepers and those singing. And we will not abandon the house of our God.

## Chapter 21

2 Esdras 21:1 And the rulers of the people settled in Jerusalem, and the remaining people cast lots to bring one out of ten to settle in Jerusalem, the holy city, and nine portions in the cities.
2 Esdras 21:2 And the people blessed all the men volunteering to settle in Jerusalem.
2 Esdras 21:3 And these are the rulers of the country who settled in Jerusalem; and in the cities of Judah they settled, each man in his possession in their cities, Israel, the priests and the Levites and the nathinaians and the sons of Solomon's slaves;
2 Esdras 21:4 and in Jerusalem some of the sons of Judah and some of the sons of Benjamin settled. – From the sons of Judah: Athaia son of Azaia son of Zacharia son of Amaria son of Saphatia son of Malelel, and from the sons of Phares.
2 Esdras 21:5 And Maasia son of Barouch son of Chalaza son of Ozia son of Adaia son of Jorib son of Thezia son of the Seloni.
2 Esdras 21:6 All the sons of Phares dwelling in Jerusalem, four hundred and sixty-eight men of strength. –
2 Esdras 21:7 And these are sons of Benjamin: Selo son of Mesoulam son of Joad son of Phadaia son of Kolia son of Masaia son of Aithiel son of Jesia;
2 Esdras 21:8 and behind him Gebi, Seli, nine hundred and twenty-eight.
2 Esdras 21:9 And Joel son of Zechri was overseer over them, and Judas son of Asana was second over the city. –
2 Esdras 21:10 From the priests: also Jadia son of Jorib, Jachin,
2 Esdras 21:11 Saraia son of Elkia son of Mesoulam son of Saddouk son of Marioth son of Aitob, opposite the house of God.
2 Esdras 21:12 And their brothers doing the work of the house: Amasi son of Zacharia son of Phassour son of Melchia,
2 Esdras 21:13 rulers of ancestral families, two hundred and forty-two. And Amessai son of Esdriel,
2 Esdras 21:14 and his brothers, mighty in battle array, one hundred and twenty-eight, and overseer over them, Badiel. –
2 Esdras 21:15 And from the Levites, Samaia son of Asoub son of Ezri
2 Esdras 21:17 and Mathania son of Micha and Obed son of Samoui,
2 Esdras 21:18 two hundred and eighty-four.
2 Esdras 21:19 And the gatekeepers Akoub, Telamin, and their brothers, one hundred and seventy-two.
2 Esdras 21:22 And an overseer of Levites was a son of Bani, Ozi son of Asabia son of Micha. From the sons of Asaph, those singing opposite the work of the house of God;
2 Esdras 21:23 for the king's commandment was upon them.
2 Esdras 21:24 And Pathaia son of Baseza was at the king's hand for every matter concerning the people. –
2 Esdras 21:25 And toward the settlements in their field. And some of the sons of Judah settled in Kariatharbok
2 Esdras 21:26 and in Jesou
2 Esdras 21:27 and in Beersabee,
2 Esdras 21:30 and their settlements, Lachis and her fields; and they encamped in Beersabee.
2 Esdras 21:31 And the sons of Benjamin were from Gaba, Machamas.
