Psalms 92:3 The rivers lifted up, Lord; the rivers lifted up their voices;
Psalms 92:4 from the voices of many waters the billows of the sea are marvelous; marvelous in the heights is the Lord.
Psalms 92:5 Your testimonies were made very faithful; holiness befits your house, Lord, for length of days.

## Chapter 93

Psalms 93:1 A psalm for Dauid, on the fourth day of the week. The God of vengeances is the Lord; the God of vengeances spoke boldly.
Psalms 93:2 Be exalted, you who judge the earth; repay a repayment to the arrogant.
Psalms 93:3 Until when will sinners, Lord, until when will sinners boast,
Psalms 93:4 utter and speak injustice; will all those working lawlessness speak?
Psalms 93:5 They humbled your people, Lord, and harmed your inheritance;
Psalms 93:6 they killed a widow and a sojourner and murdered orphans,
Psalms 93:7 and said: The Lord will not see, nor will the God of Iakob understand.
Psalms 93:8 Understand, then, foolish ones among the people, and, fools, at last be sensible.
Psalms 93:9 Does not the one planting the ear hear, or does the one forming the eye not perceive?
Psalms 93:10 Will not the one disciplining nations reprove, the one teaching a human knowledge?
Psalms 93:11 The Lord knows the reasonings of humans, that they are vain.
Psalms 93:12 Blessed is a human whom you discipline, Lord, and teach from your law,
Psalms 93:13 to give him calm from evil days, until a pit is dug for the sinner.
Psalms 93:14 Because the Lord will not reject his people and will not abandon his inheritance,
Psalms 93:15 until righteousness returns to judgment, and all the upright in heart follow it. Interlude.
Psalms 93:16 Who will arise for me against those doing evil, or who will stand with me against those working lawlessness?
Psalms 93:17 If the Lord had not helped me, my soul would soon have sojourned in Hades.
Psalms 93:18 If I said: My foot has been shaken, your mercy, Lord, helps me;
Psalms 93:19 Lord, according to the multitude of my pains in my heart, your comforts loved my soul.
Psalms 93:20 Surely a throne of lawlessness will not be joined to you, the one forming toil by ordinance?
Psalms 93:21 They will hunt against a righteous one's soul and condemn innocent blood.
Psalms 93:22 And the Lord became a refuge for me, and my God a helper of my hope;
Psalms 93:23 and he will repay them their lawlessness, and according to their wickedness the Lord our God will make them vanish.

## Chapter 94

Psalms 94:1 Praise of a song for Dauid. Come, let us exult in the Lord; let us shout to God our savior;
Psalms 94:2 let us come before his face with acknowledgment and shout to him with psalms.
Psalms 94:3 Because the Lord is a great God and a great king over all the gods;
Psalms 94:4 because in his hand are the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his;
Psalms 94:5 because the sea is his, and he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.
Psalms 94:6 Come, let us bow and fall before him and weep before the Lord who made us;
Psalms 94:7 because he is our God, and we are a people of his pasture and sheep of his hand. Today, if you hear his voice,
Psalms 94:8 do not harden your hearts as in the provocation to bitterness, on the day of testing in the wilderness,
Psalms 94:9 where your fathers tested, tried and saw my works.
Psalms 94:10 Forty years I was vexed with that generation and said: They always stray in heart, and they did not know my ways,
Psalms 94:11 as I swore in my wrath: They shall not enter my rest.

## Chapter 95

Psalms 95:1 When the house was being built after the captivity; a song for Dauid. Sing a new song to the Lord; sing to the Lord, all the earth;
Psalms 95:2 sing to the Lord; bless his name; announce his salvation as good news day by day;
Psalms 95:3 announce his glory among the nations, his wonders among all the peoples.
Psalms 95:4 Because the Lord is great and greatly praiseworthy; he is fearsome over all the gods;
Psalms 95:5 because all the gods of the nations are demons, but the Lord made the heavens;
Psalms 95:6 acknowledgment and beauty are before him, holiness and magnificence in his sanctuary.
Psalms 95:7 Bring to the Lord, families of the nations; bring to the Lord glory and honor;
Psalms 95:8 bring to the Lord glory for his name; take up sacrifices and enter his courts;
Psalms 95:9 bow to the Lord in his holy court; let all the earth be shaken before his face.
Psalms 95:10 Say among the nations: The Lord reigned; for indeed he established the inhabited world, which will not be shaken; he will judge peoples in uprightness.
Psalms 95:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth exult; let the sea and its fullness be shaken;
Psalms 95:12 the plains and all the things in them will rejoice; then all the trees of the forest will exult
Psalms 95:13 before the face of the Lord, because he comes, because he comes to judge the earth; he will judge the inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in his truth.

## Chapter 96

Psalms 96:1 For Dauid, when his land is being established. The Lord reigned; let the earth exult; let many islands rejoice.
Psalms 96:2 Cloud and gloom are around him; righteousness and judgment are the establishment of his throne.
Psalms 96:3 Fire will go before him and burn his enemies around him;
Psalms 96:4 his lightnings shone upon the inhabited world; the earth saw and was shaken.
Psalms 96:5 The mountains melted like wax before the face of the Lord, before the face of the Lord of all the earth.
Psalms 96:6 The heavens announced his righteousness, and all the peoples saw his glory.
Psalms 96:7 Let all those bowing to carved things, those boasting in their idols, be ashamed; bow to him, all his angels.
Psalms 96:8 Sion heard and rejoiced, and the daughters of Ioudaia exulted because of your judgments, Lord;
Psalms 96:9 because you are the Lord Most High over all the earth; you were greatly exalted above all the gods.
Psalms 96:10 Those loving the Lord, hate evil; the Lord guards the souls of his holy ones; from the hand of sinners he will deliver them.
Psalms 96:11 Light rose for the righteous one, and gladness for the upright in heart.
Psalms 96:12 Rejoice in the Lord, righteous ones, and acknowledge the remembrance of his holiness.

## Chapter 97

Psalms 97:1 A psalm for Dauid. Sing a new song to the Lord, because the Lord did marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm saved for him.
Psalms 97:2 The Lord made his salvation known; before the nations he revealed his righteousness.
Psalms 97:3 He remembered his mercy to Iakob and his truth to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth saw the salvation of our God.
Psalms 97:4 Shout to God, all the earth; sing and exult and make music;
Psalms 97:5 sing to the Lord with a lyre, with a lyre and the voice of a psalm;
Psalms 97:6 with beaten trumpets and the sound of a horn trumpet shout before the king, the Lord.
Psalms 97:7 Let the sea and its fullness be shaken, the inhabited world and those dwelling in it;
Psalms 97:8 rivers will clap a hand together; the mountains will exult,
Psalms 97:9 because he comes to judge the earth; he will judge the inhabited world in righteousness and peoples in uprightness.

## Chapter 98

Psalms 98:1 A psalm for Dauid. The Lord reigned; let peoples be angry; the one sitting upon the cheroubin, let the earth be shaken.
Psalms 98:2 The Lord is great in Sion and high over all the peoples;
Psalms 98:3 let them acknowledge your great name, because it is fearsome and holy.
Psalms 98:4 And a king's honor loves judgment; you prepared upright things; you worked judgment and righteousness in Iakob.
Psalms 98:5 Exalt the Lord our God and bow to the footstool of his feet, because he is holy.
Psalms 98:6 Moyses and Aaron among his priests, and Samouel among those calling upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he heard them;
Psalms 98:7 in a pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and the ordinances he gave them.
Psalms 98:8 Lord our God, you heard them; God, you became gracious to them, and avenged all their practices.
Psalms 98:9 Exalt the Lord our God and bow toward his holy mountain, because the Lord our God is holy.

## Chapter 99

Psalms 99:1 A psalm for acknowledgment. Shout to the Lord, all the earth;
Psalms 99:2 serve the Lord in gladness; enter before him in exultation.
Psalms 99:3 Know that the Lord, he is God; he made us, and not we, his people and sheep of his pasture.
Psalms 99:4 Enter his gates with acknowledgment, his courts with hymns; acknowledge him; praise his name,
Psalms 99:5 because the Lord is good, his mercy is forever, and his truth to generation and generation.

## Chapter 100

Psalms 100:1 For Dauid, a psalm. Mercy and judgment I will sing to you, Lord;
Psalms 100:2 I will make music and understand in a blameless way; when will you come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart in the midst of my house.
Psalms 100:3 I did not set a lawless thing before my eyes; I hated those doing transgressions;
Psalms 100:4 a crooked heart did not cling to me; when the evil one turned away from me, I did not know him.
Psalms 100:5 The one secretly speaking against his neighbor, this one I pursued; one with an arrogant eye and an insatiable heart, with this one I did not eat.
Psalms 100:6 My eyes were upon the faithful of the earth, that they might sit with me; one walking in a blameless way, this one ministered to me.
Psalms 100:7 One practicing arrogance did not dwell in the midst of my house; one speaking unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.
Psalms 100:8 In the mornings I killed all the sinners of the earth, to destroy from the city of the Lord all those working lawlessness.

## Chapter 101

Psalms 101:1 A prayer for the poor one when he grows weary and pours out his supplication before the Lord.
Psalms 101:2 Hear my prayer, Lord, and let my cry come to you.
Psalms 101:3 Do not turn your face away from me; on whatever day I am afflicted, incline your ear toward me; on whatever day I call upon you, hear me quickly.
Psalms 101:4 Because my days failed like smoke, and my bones were roasted together like a roasting pan.
Psalms 101:5 My heart was struck like grass and dried up, because I forgot to eat my bread.
Psalms 101:6 From the voice of my groaning my bone clung to my flesh.
Psalms 101:7 I was likened to a wilderness pelican; I became like a night raven on a house site;
Psalms 101:8 I kept awake and became like a sparrow alone upon a roof.
Psalms 101:9 All day my enemies reproached me, and those praising me swore against me.
Psalms 101:10 Because I ate ashes like bread and mixed my drink with weeping,
Psalms 101:11 before the face of your wrath and your fury, because, lifting me, you dashed me down.
Psalms 101:12 My days declined like a shadow, and I dried up like grass.
Psalms 101:13 But you, Lord, remain forever, and your remembrance to generation and generation.
Psalms 101:14 You will arise and pity Sion, because it is time to pity her, because the time has come;
Psalms 101:15 because your slaves took pleasure in her stones and will pity her dust.
Psalms 101:16 And the nations will fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth your glory,
Psalms 101:17 because the Lord will build Sion and appear in his glory.
Psalms 101:18 He looked upon the prayer of the humble and did not despise their supplication.
Psalms 101:19 Let this be written for another generation, and a people being created will praise the Lord,
Psalms 101:20 because he leaned out from his holy height; the Lord looked from heaven upon the earth,
Psalms 101:21 to hear the groaning of those fettered, to release the sons of those put to death,
Psalms 101:22 to announce in Sion the name of the Lord and his praise in Ierousalem,
Psalms 101:23 when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to serve the Lord.
Psalms 101:24 He answered him in the way of his strength: Announce to me the fewness of my days;
Psalms 101:25 do not take me up halfway through my days; your years are in a generation of generations.
Psalms 101:26 In the beginning you, Lord, founded the earth, and the heavens are works of your hands;
Psalms 101:27 they will perish, but you will remain, and all will grow old like a garment, and like a covering you will change them, and they will be changed;
Psalms 101:28 but you are the same, and your years will not fail.
Psalms 101:29 The sons of your slaves will dwell, and their seed will be established forever.

## Chapter 102

Psalms 102:1 For Dauid. Bless the Lord, my soul, and, all things within me, his holy name;
Psalms 102:2 bless the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all his repayments;
Psalms 102:3 the one graciously forgiving all your lawless deeds, the one healing all your diseases;
Psalms 102:4 the one redeeming your life from corruption, the one crowning you with mercy and compassions;
Psalms 102:5 the one filling your desire with good things; your youth will be renewed like an eagle's.
Psalms 102:6 The Lord does deeds of mercy and judgment for all those wronged.
Psalms 102:7 He made his ways known to Moyses, his wishes to the sons of Israel.
Psalms 102:8 Compassionate and merciful is the Lord, patient and abundant in mercy;
Psalms 102:9 he will not be angry to the end or bear resentment forever;
Psalms 102:10 he did not act toward us according to our sins or repay us according to our lawless deeds,
Psalms 102:11 because according to the height of heaven from the earth the Lord strengthened his mercy upon those fearing him;
Psalms 102:12 as far as the east is from the west, he distanced our lawless deeds from us.
Psalms 102:13 Just as a father pities sons, the Lord pitied those fearing him,
Psalms 102:14 because he knew our formation; remember that we are dust.
Psalms 102:15 A human, his days are like grass; like a flower of the field, thus he will blossom;
Psalms 102:16 because a wind passed through him, and he will not exist and will no longer recognize his place.
Psalms 102:17 But the mercy of the Lord is from the age and to the age upon those fearing him, and his righteousness upon sons of sons,
Psalms 102:18 for those keeping his covenant and remembering his commandments to do them.
Psalms 102:19 The Lord prepared his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules all things.
Psalms 102:20 Bless the Lord, all his angels, mighty in strength, doing his word, to hear the voice of his words;
Psalms 102:21 bless the Lord, all his powers, his ministers doing his will;
Psalms 102:22 bless the Lord, all his works in every place of his dominion; bless the Lord, my soul.

## Chapter 103

Psalms 103:1 For Dauid. Bless the Lord, my soul. Lord my God, you were greatly magnified; you clothed yourself with acknowledgment and magnificence,
Psalms 103:2 wrapping yourself in light like a garment, stretching out heaven like a hide;
Psalms 103:3 the one roofing his upper chambers in waters, the one making clouds his mount, the one walking upon wings of winds;
Psalms 103:4 the one making his angels spirits and his ministers burning fire.
Psalms 103:5 He founded the earth upon its security; it will not be tilted for the age of the age.
Psalms 103:6 An abyss, like a garment, is his covering; waters will stand upon the mountains;
Psalms 103:7 at your rebuke they will flee; at the voice of your thunder they will be afraid.
Psalms 103:8 Mountains rise and plains descend to the place you founded for them;
Psalms 103:9 you placed a boundary which they will not pass, nor will they return to cover the earth.
Psalms 103:10 The one sending out springs in ravines; waters will pass between the mountains;
Psalms 103:11 they will give drink to all the wild beasts of the field; wild asses will receive for their thirst;
Psalms 103:12 upon them the birds of heaven will dwell; from the midst of the rocks they will give a voice.
Psalms 103:13 Watering mountains from his upper chambers; from the fruit of your works the earth will be filled.
Psalms 103:14 Making grass sprout for the beasts and green plants for the service of humans, to bring bread out of the earth;
Psalms 103:15 and wine gladdens a human's heart, to brighten a face with oil, and bread supports a human's heart.
Psalms 103:16 The trees of the plain will be filled, the cedars of Libanos which he planted;
Psalms 103:17 there sparrows will nest; the house of the heron leads them.
Psalms 103:18 The high mountains are for the deer; a rock is a refuge for the rock rabbits.
Psalms 103:19 He made a moon for seasons; the sun knew its setting.
Psalms 103:20 You placed darkness, and night came to be; in it all the wild beasts of the forest will pass,
Psalms 103:21 young lions roaring to seize and seek food for themselves from God.
Psalms 103:22 The sun rose, and they gathered, and they will lie down in their enclosures;
Psalms 103:23 a human will go out to his work and to his labor until evening.
Psalms 103:24 How your works were magnified, Lord; you made all things in wisdom; the earth was filled with your creation.
Psalms 103:25 This great and spacious sea, there are creeping things without number, small living creatures with great ones;
Psalms 103:26 there ships pass, this dragon which you formed to play with him.
Psalms 103:27 All expect you to give them food at the proper time.
Psalms 103:28 When you give to them, they will gather; but when you open your hand, all things will be filled with goodness.
Psalms 103:29 But when you turn away your face, they will be troubled; you will take away their spirit, and they will fail and return to their dust.
Psalms 103:30 You will send forth your spirit, and they will be created, and you will renew the face of the earth.
Psalms 103:31 Let the glory of the Lord be forever; the Lord will rejoice in his works;
Psalms 103:32 the one looking upon the earth and making it tremble, the one touching the mountains, and they smoke.
Psalms 103:33 I will sing to the Lord in my life; I will make music to my God as long as I exist;
Psalms 103:34 may my discourse be sweet to him, but I will rejoice in the Lord.
Psalms 103:35 May sinners fail from the earth, and lawless ones, so that they do not exist. Bless the Lord, my soul.

## Chapter 104

Psalms 104:1 Alleluia. Acknowledge the Lord and call upon his name; report his works among the nations;
Psalms 104:2 sing to him and make music to him; recount all his wonders.
Psalms 104:3 Be praised in his holy name; let the heart of those seeking the Lord rejoice;
Psalms 104:4 seek the Lord and be strengthened; seek his face continually.
Psalms 104:5 Remember his wonders which he did, his portents and the judgments of his mouth,
Psalms 104:6 seed of Abraam, his slaves, sons of Iakob, his chosen ones.
Psalms 104:7 He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
Psalms 104:8 He remembered his covenant forever, the word he commanded for a thousand generations,
Psalms 104:9 which he made with Abraam, and his oath to Isaak,
Psalms 104:10 and he established it for Iakob as an ordinance and for Israel as an everlasting covenant,
Psalms 104:11 saying: To you I will give the land of Chanaan, a measured portion of your inheritance.
Psalms 104:12 When they were few in number, very few and sojourners in it,
Psalms 104:13 and they passed from nation to nation, from a kingdom to another people;
Psalms 104:14 he did not permit a human to wrong them, and reproved kings on their behalf:
Psalms 104:15 Do not touch my anointed ones, and do not act wickedly against my prophets.
Psalms 104:16 And he called a famine upon the land; he shattered every support of bread;
Psalms 104:17 he sent a human before them; Ioseph was sold as a slave.
Psalms 104:18 They humbled his feet in fetters; his soul passed through iron
Psalms 104:19 until his word came; the utterance of the Lord refined him by fire.
Psalms 104:20 A king sent and released him, a ruler of peoples, and let him go;
Psalms 104:21 he made him lord of his house and ruler of all his possessions,
Psalms 104:22 to discipline his rulers as himself and make his elders wise.
Psalms 104:23 And Israel entered Egypt, and Iakob sojourned in the land of Cham;
Psalms 104:24 and he increased his people greatly and strengthened them beyond their enemies.
Psalms 104:25 He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal deceitfully with his slaves.
Psalms 104:26 He sent forth Moyses his slave, Aaron whom he chose;
Psalms 104:27 he placed in them the words of his signs and of his portents in the land of Cham.
Psalms 104:28 He sent forth darkness and darkened, and they provoked his words to bitterness.
Psalms 104:29 He turned their waters into blood and killed their fish.
Psalms 104:30 Their land swarmed with frogs in the chambers of their kings.
Psalms 104:31 He spoke, and a dog-fly came, and gnats in all their boundaries.
Psalms 104:32 He made their rains hail, burning fire in their land,
Psalms 104:33 and struck their vines and their fig trees and shattered every tree of their boundary.
Psalms 104:34 He spoke, and a locust came, and a young locust without number,
Psalms 104:35 and ate all the grass in their land and ate the fruit of their land.
Psalms 104:36 And he struck every firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their labor,
Psalms 104:37 and brought them out with silver and gold, and among their tribes there was no one weak.
Psalms 104:38 Egypt rejoiced at their departure, because fear of them fell upon them.
Psalms 104:39 He spread out a cloud as shelter for them, and fire to illuminate the night for them.
Psalms 104:40 They asked, and a quail came, and he filled them with bread of heaven;
Psalms 104:41 he broke open a rock, and waters flowed; rivers went through waterless places.
Psalms 104:42 Because he remembered his holy word to Abraam his slave,
Psalms 104:43 and brought out his people in exultation and his chosen ones in gladness.
Psalms 104:44 And he gave them lands of nations, and they inherited labors of peoples,
Psalms 104:45 so that they might keep his ordinances and seek out his law.

## Chapter 105

Psalms 105:1 Alleluia. Acknowledge the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.
Psalms 105:2 Who will speak the mighty deeds of the Lord, make all his praises heard?
Psalms 105:3 Blessed are those keeping judgment and doing righteousness at every time.
Psalms 105:4 Remember us, Lord, in the good pleasure of your people; visit us with your salvation,
Psalms 105:5 to see in the goodness of your chosen ones, to rejoice in the gladness of your nation, to be praised with your inheritance.
Psalms 105:6 We sinned with our fathers; we acted lawlessly; we acted unjustly.
Psalms 105:7 Our fathers in Egypt did not understand your wonders, did not remember the multitude of your mercy, and provoked bitterness as they went up in the Red Sea.
Psalms 105:8 And he saved them because of his name, to make his might known;
Psalms 105:9 and he rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up, and he guided them in an abyss as in a wilderness;
Psalms 105:10 and he saved them from the hand of those hating them and redeemed them from an enemy's hand;
Psalms 105:11 and water covered those afflicting them; not one of them remained.
Psalms 105:12 And they believed in his words and sang his praise.
Psalms 105:13 They hastened, they forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel;
Psalms 105:14 and they desired a desire in the wilderness and tested God in a waterless place.
Psalms 105:15 And he gave them their request and sent fullness into their souls.
Psalms 105:16 And they angered Moyses in the camp, and Aaron, the holy one of the Lord;
Psalms 105:17 the earth opened and swallowed Dathan and covered the assembly of Abiron;
Psalms 105:18 and fire was kindled in their assembly; a flame burned sinners.
Psalms 105:19 And they made a calf in Choreb and bowed to the carved thing;
Psalms 105:20 and they exchanged their glory for a likeness of a calf eating grass.
Psalms 105:21 They forgot God who saved them, who did great things in Egypt,
Psalms 105:22 marvelous things in the land of Cham, fearsome things upon the Red Sea.
Psalms 105:23 And he spoke of destroying them, had not Moyses his chosen one stood in the breach before him, to turn away his wrath so as not to destroy.
Psalms 105:24 And they despised a desirable land; they did not believe his word;
Psalms 105:25 and they grumbled in their dwellings; they did not hear the voice of the Lord.
Psalms 105:26 And he lifted his hand against them, to cast them down in the wilderness,
Psalms 105:27 and to cast their seed down among the nations and scatter them in the lands.
Psalms 105:28 And they were initiated to Beelphegor and ate sacrifices of the dead;
Psalms 105:29 and they provoked him with their practices, and the fall multiplied among them.
Psalms 105:30 And Phinees stood and made atonement, and the breaking ceased;
Psalms 105:31 and it was counted to him as righteousness, to generation and generation forever.
Psalms 105:32 And they angered him at water of contradiction, and Moyses was harmed because of them,
Psalms 105:33 because they provoked his spirit to bitterness, and he spoke distinctly with his lips.
Psalms 105:34 They did not destroy the nations which the Lord told them,
Psalms 105:35 and they mingled among the nations and learned their works;
Psalms 105:36 and they served their carved things, and it became a stumbling block for them;
Psalms 105:37 and they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons,
Psalms 105:38 and poured out innocent blood, blood of their sons and daughters whom they sacrificed to the carved things of Chanaan, and the land was bloodied with murder in the bloods,
Psalms 105:39 and defiled in their works, and they prostituted themselves in their practices.
Psalms 105:40 And the Lord was angry with fury against his people and abhorred his inheritance;
Psalms 105:41 and he handed them over into hands of nations, and those hating them ruled them;
Psalms 105:42 and their enemies afflicted them, and they were humbled beneath their hands.
Psalms 105:43 Often he delivered them, but they provoked him to bitterness with their counsel and were humbled in their lawless deeds.
Psalms 105:44 And he saw when they were afflicted, when he heard their supplication;
Psalms 105:45 and he remembered his covenant and relented according to the multitude of his mercy,
Psalms 105:46 and gave them to compassions before all those who took them captive.
Psalms 105:47 Save us, Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, to acknowledge your holy name, to boast in your praise.
Psalms 105:48 Blessed is the Lord, the God of Israel, from the age and to the age. And all the people will say: May it be, may it be. – –

## Chapter 106

Psalms 106:1 Alleluia. Acknowledge the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever;
Psalms 106:2 let those redeemed by the Lord say it, whom he redeemed from an enemy's hand.
Psalms 106:3 From the lands he gathered them, from east and west and north and sea.
Psalms 106:4 They wandered in the wilderness, in a waterless place; they did not find a way to a city of habitation,
Psalms 106:5 hungering and thirsting; their soul failed within them;
Psalms 106:6 and they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and he delivered them from their distresses,
Psalms 106:7 and guided them into an upright way, to go to a city of habitation.
Psalms 106:8 Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies and his wonders for the sons of humans,
Psalms 106:9 because he filled an empty soul and filled a hungry soul with good things. –
Psalms 106:10 Those sitting in darkness and a shadow of death, fettered in poverty and iron,
Psalms 106:11 because they provoked the utterances of God to bitterness and provoked the counsel of the Most High,
Psalms 106:12 and their heart was humbled in toils; they grew weak, and there was no one helping;
Psalms 106:13 and they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and he saved them from their distresses,
Psalms 106:14 and brought them out of darkness and a shadow of death and broke open their bonds.
Psalms 106:15 Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies and his wonders for the sons of humans,
Psalms 106:16 because he shattered bronze gates and broke iron bars. –
Psalms 106:17 He took hold of them out of the way of their lawlessness, for because of their lawless deeds they were humbled;
Psalms 106:18 their soul abhorred every food, and they approached as far as the gates of death;
Psalms 106:19 and they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and he saved them from their distresses;
Psalms 106:20 he sent his word and healed them and delivered them from their corruptions.
Psalms 106:21 Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies and his wonders for the sons of humans,
Psalms 106:22 and sacrifice a sacrifice of praise and declare his works in exultation. –
Psalms 106:23 Those descending to the sea in ships, doing work in many waters,
Psalms 106:24 they saw the works of the Lord and his wonders in the deep;
Psalms 106:25 he spoke, and a wind of storm arose, and its waves were exalted;
Psalms 106:26 they rise as far as the heavens and descend as far as the abysses; their soul melted in evils;
Psalms 106:27 they were troubled, they were shaken like one drunk, and all their wisdom was swallowed;
Psalms 106:28 and they cried out to the Lord when they were afflicted, and he brought them out of their distresses,
Psalms 106:29 and commanded the storm, and it settled into a breeze, and its waves were silent;
Psalms 106:30 and they rejoiced because they were quiet, and he guided them to a harbor of their desire.
Psalms 106:31 Let them acknowledge to the Lord his mercies and his wonders for the sons of humans;
Psalms 106:32 let them exalt him in an assembly of a people and praise him in a seat of elders. –
Psalms 106:33 He made rivers into a wilderness and outlets of waters into thirst,
Psalms 106:34 a fruitful land into brine, because of the evil of those dwelling in it.
Psalms 106:35 He made a wilderness into lakes of waters and a waterless land into outlets of waters,
Psalms 106:36 and settled hungry ones there, and they established a city of habitation,
Psalms 106:37 and sowed fields and planted vineyards and made fruit of produce,
Psalms 106:38 and he blessed them, and they were greatly multiplied, and he did not diminish their beasts.
Psalms 106:39 And they became few and were harmed by affliction of evils and pain.
Psalms 106:40 Contempt was poured out upon rulers, and he made them wander in an untrodden place and not a road.
Psalms 106:41 And he helped a needy one out of poverty and made families like sheep.
Psalms 106:42 Upright ones will see and rejoice, and all lawlessness will stop its mouth.
Psalms 106:43 Who is wise and will keep these things, and they will understand the mercies of the Lord?

## Chapter 107

Psalms 107:1 A song of a psalm for Dauid.
Psalms 107:2 My heart is ready, God, my heart is ready; I will sing and make music in my glory.
Psalms 107:3 Awake, psaltery and lyre; I will awake at dawn.
Psalms 107:4 I will acknowledge you among peoples, Lord, and sing to you among nations,
Psalms 107:5 because your mercy is great above the heavens, and your truth as far as the clouds.
Psalms 107:6 Be exalted above the heavens, God, and your glory above all the earth.
Psalms 107:7 So that your beloved ones may be delivered, save with your right hand and hear me.
Psalms 107:8 God spoke in his holy place: I will be exalted and divide Sikima, and measure out the valley of tents;
Psalms 107:9 Galaad is mine, and Manasse is mine, and Ephraim is the support of my head, Ioudas my king;
Psalms 107:10 Moab is the cauldron of my hope; upon Idumaia I will extend my sandal; foreigners were subjected to me.
Psalms 107:11 Who will lead me into a fortified city? Who will guide me as far as Idumaia?
Psalms 107:12 Is it not you, God, who rejected us? And you will not go out, God, with our forces.
Psalms 107:13 Give us help out of affliction; and a human's salvation is vain.
Psalms 107:14 In God we will do mighty deeds, and he will bring our enemies to nothing.

## Chapter 108

Psalms 108:1 For the end; for Dauid, a psalm. God, do not keep silent concerning my praise,
Psalms 108:2 because a sinner's mouth and a deceitful one's mouth were opened against me; they spoke against me with a deceitful tongue,
Psalms 108:3 and surrounded me with words of hatred and fought me without cause.
Psalms 108:4 In return for loving me they slandered me, but I prayed;
Psalms 108:5 and they placed evils against me in return for good things, and hatred in return for my love.
Psalms 108:6 Set a sinner over him, and let a slanderer stand at his right;
Psalms 108:7 when he is judged, may he go out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
Psalms 108:8 Let his days become few, and may another take his oversight;
Psalms 108:9 let his sons become orphans and his wife a widow;
Psalms 108:10 let his sons wander in displacement and beg; let them be cast out of their house sites.
Psalms 108:11 Let a lender search out all that belongs to him; let strangers plunder his labors;
Psalms 108:12 let there be no supporter for him, nor let there be one compassionate toward his orphans;
Psalms 108:13 let his children come to destruction; in one generation let his name be blotted out.
Psalms 108:14 May the lawlessness of his fathers be remembered before the Lord, and may the sin of his mother not be blotted out;
Psalms 108:15 let them be before the Lord continually, and may their remembrance be destroyed from the earth,
Psalms 108:16 because he did not remember to do mercy and pursued a human needy and poor and pierced in heart, to put him to death.
Psalms 108:17 And he loved a curse, and it will come to him; and he did not desire a blessing, and it will be distanced from him.
Psalms 108:18 And he clothed himself with a curse like a garment, and it entered like water into his inward parts and like oil into his bones;
Psalms 108:19 let it become for him like a garment he wraps around himself, and like a belt he continually girds himself with.
Psalms 108:20 This is the work from the Lord for those slandering me and those speaking evil things against my soul.
Psalms 108:21 And you, Lord, Lord, do mercy with me because of your name, because your mercy is good.
Psalms 108:22 Deliver me, because I am poor and needy, and my heart is troubled within me.
Psalms 108:23 Like a shadow when it declines, I was taken away; I was shaken off like locusts.
Psalms 108:24 My knees grew weak from fasting, and my flesh was changed because of oil.
Psalms 108:25 And I became a reproach to them; they saw me, they shook their heads.
Psalms 108:26 Help me, Lord my God; save me according to your mercy,
Psalms 108:27 and let them know that this is your hand, and you, Lord, did it.
Psalms 108:28 They will curse, and you will bless; let those rising against me be ashamed, but your slave will rejoice.
Psalms 108:29 Let those slandering me clothe themselves in disgrace and wrap their shame around themselves like a double cloak.
Psalms 108:30 I will greatly acknowledge the Lord with my mouth and praise him in the midst of many,
Psalms 108:31 because he stood at the right of a needy one, to save from those pursuing my soul.

## Chapter 109

Psalms 109:1 For Dauid, a psalm. The Lord said to my lord: Sit at my right, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.
Psalms 109:2 The Lord will send forth a rod of your strength from Sion, and rule in the midst of your enemies.
Psalms 109:3 With you is rule on the day of your strength, in the splendors of the holy ones; from the womb before the morning star I begot you.
Psalms 109:4 The Lord swore and will not relent: You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchisedek.
Psalms 109:5 The Lord at your right crushed kings on the day of his wrath;
Psalms 109:6 he will judge among the nations; he will fill with corpses; he will crush heads upon the land of many.
Psalms 109:7 He will drink from a torrent on the way; for this reason he will exalt a head.

## Chapter 110

Psalms 110:1 Alleluia. I will acknowledge you, Lord, with my whole heart, in a council of upright ones and an assembly.
Psalms 110:2 Great are the works of the Lord, sought out for all his wishes;
Psalms 110:3 acknowledgment and magnificence are his work, and his righteousness remains for the age of the age.
Psalms 110:4 He made a remembrance of his wonders; merciful and compassionate is the Lord;
Psalms 110:5 he gave food to those fearing him; he will remember his covenant forever.
Psalms 110:6 He announced the strength of his works to his people, to give them an inheritance of nations.
Psalms 110:7 The works of his hands are truth and judgment; all his commandments are faithful,
Psalms 110:8 supported for the age of the age, made in truth and uprightness.
Psalms 110:9 He sent redemption to his people; he commanded his covenant forever; holy and fearsome is his name.
Psalms 110:10 The beginning of wisdom is fear of the Lord; good understanding is for all those doing it. His praise remains for the age of the age.

## Chapter 111

Psalms 111:1 Alleluia. Blessed is a man fearing the Lord; he will greatly desire his commandments;
Psalms 111:2 his seed will be mighty in the land; a generation of upright ones will be blessed;
Psalms 111:3 glory and wealth are in his house, and his righteousness remains for the age of the age.
Psalms 111:4 Light rose in darkness for the upright, merciful and compassionate and righteous.
Psalms 111:5 Good is a man who pities and lends; he will manage his words with judgment;
Psalms 111:6 because he will not be shaken forever; a righteous one will be in everlasting remembrance.
Psalms 111:7 He will not be afraid of an evil report; his heart is ready to hope in the Lord.
Psalms 111:8 His heart has been supported; he will certainly not be afraid, until he looks upon his enemies.
Psalms 111:9 He scattered, he gave to the needy; his righteousness remains for the age of the age; his horn will be exalted in glory.
Psalms 111:10 A sinner will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt; the desire of sinners will perish.

## Chapter 112

Psalms 112:1 Alleluia. Praise the Lord, servants; praise the name of the Lord;
Psalms 112:2 may the name of the Lord be blessed from now and forever;
Psalms 112:3 from the rising of the sun until its setting praise the name of the Lord.
Psalms 112:4 The Lord is high over all the nations; his glory is above the heavens.
Psalms 112:5 Who is like the Lord our God, who dwells in the heights
Psalms 112:6 and looks upon the low things in heaven and on earth?
Psalms 112:7 The one raising a poor one from the earth and lifting a needy one from dung,
Psalms 112:8 to seat him with rulers, with rulers of his people;
Psalms 112:9 the one settling a barren woman in a house as a rejoicing mother of children.

## Chapter 113

Psalms 113:1 Alleluia. At the departure of Israel from Egypt, of the house of Iakob from a barbarian people,
Psalms 113:2 Ioudaia became his sanctuary, Israel his authority.
Psalms 113:3 The sea saw and fled; Iordanes turned backward;
Psalms 113:4 the mountains leaped like rams, and the hills like lambs of sheep.
Psalms 113:5 What is with you, sea, that you fled, and with you, Iordanes, that you withdrew backward?
Psalms 113:6 Mountains, that you leaped like rams, and hills like lambs of sheep?
Psalms 113:7 Before the face of the Lord the earth was shaken, before the face of the God of Iakob,
Psalms 113:8 who turned the rock into lakes of waters and the sheer rock into springs of waters.
Psalms 113:9 Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your mercy and your truth,
Psalms 113:10 lest the nations say: Where is their God?
Psalms 113:11 But our God is in heaven above; in the heavens and on the earth he did all that he wished.
Psalms 113:12 The idols of the nations are silver and gold, works of human hands;
Psalms 113:13 they have a mouth and will not speak; they have eyes and will not see;
Psalms 113:14 they have ears and will not hear; they have noses and will not smell;
Psalms 113:15 they have hands and will not feel; they have feet and will not walk; they will not give a voice in their throat.
Psalms 113:16 May those making them become like them, and all those trusting in them.
Psalms 113:17 The house of Israel hoped in the Lord; he is their helper and their defender.
Psalms 113:18 The house of Aaron hoped in the Lord; he is their helper and their defender.
Psalms 113:19 Those fearing the Lord hoped in the Lord; he is their helper and their defender.
Psalms 113:20 The Lord remembered us and blessed us; he blessed the house of Israel; he blessed the house of Aaron;
Psalms 113:21 he blessed those fearing the Lord, the small with the great.
Psalms 113:22 May the Lord add to you, to you and to your sons;
Psalms 113:23 you are blessed by the Lord who made heaven and earth.
Psalms 113:24 The heaven of heaven belongs to the Lord, but the earth he gave to the sons of humans.
Psalms 113:25 The dead will not praise you, Lord, nor all those descending into Hades,
Psalms 113:26 but we, the living, will bless the Lord from now and forever.

## Chapter 114

Psalms 114:1 Alleluia. I loved, because the Lord will hear the voice of my supplication,
Psalms 114:2 because he inclined his ear to me, and in my days I will call upon him.
Psalms 114:3 Birth pangs of death encompassed me; dangers of Hades found me; I found affliction and pain.
Psalms 114:4 And I called upon the name of the Lord: O Lord, deliver my soul.
Psalms 114:5 Merciful and righteous is the Lord, and our God has mercy.
Psalms 114:6 The Lord guards the infants; I was humbled, and he saved me.
Psalms 114:7 Turn back, my soul, to your rest, because the Lord benefited you,
Psalms 114:8 because he delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears and my feet from slipping.
Psalms 114:9 I will be pleasing before the Lord in a land of the living.

## Chapter 115

Psalms 115:1 Alleluia. I believed, therefore I spoke; but I was greatly humbled.
Psalms 115:2 I said in my ecstasy: Every human is a liar.
Psalms 115:3 What will I repay to the Lord for all that he repaid to me?
Psalms 115:4 I will take a cup of salvation and call upon the name of the Lord.
Psalms 115:6 Honored before the Lord is the death of his holy ones.
Psalms 115:7 O Lord, I am your slave, I am your slave and son of your maidservant. You broke open my bonds;
Psalms 115:8 to you I will sacrifice a sacrifice of praise;
Psalms 115:9 I will pay my vows to the Lord before all his people,
Psalms 115:10 in the courts of the house of the Lord, in your midst, Ierousalem.

## Chapter 116

Psalms 116:1 Alleluia. Praise the Lord, all the nations; praise him, all the peoples,
Psalms 116:2 because his mercy was strengthened upon us, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.

## Chapter 117

Psalms 117:1 Alleluia. Acknowledge the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.
Psalms 117:2 Let the house of Israel say, then, that he is good, that his mercy is forever;
Psalms 117:3 let the house of Aaron say, then, that he is good, that his mercy is forever;
Psalms 117:4 let all those fearing the Lord say, then, that he is good, that his mercy is forever.
Psalms 117:5 In affliction I called upon the Lord, and he heard me into spaciousness.
Psalms 117:6 The Lord is a helper for me; I will not fear what a human will do to me.
Psalms 117:7 The Lord is a helper for me, and I will look upon my enemies.
Psalms 117:8 It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in a human;
Psalms 117:9 it is better to hope in the Lord than to hope in rulers.
Psalms 117:10 All the nations surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord I warded them off;
Psalms 117:11 surrounding, they surrounded me, and in the name of the Lord I warded them off;
Psalms 117:12 they surrounded me like bees a honeycomb and were kindled like fire in thorns, and in the name of the Lord I warded them off.
Psalms 117:13 Being pushed, I was overturned to fall, and the Lord supported me.
Psalms 117:14 The Lord is my strength and my hymn, and he became salvation for me.
Psalms 117:15 A voice of exultation and salvation in tents of righteous ones: The right hand of the Lord did a mighty deed;
Psalms 117:16 the right hand of the Lord exalted me; the right hand of the Lord did a mighty deed.
Psalms 117:17 I will not die, but live and recount the works of the Lord.
Psalms 117:18 Disciplining, the Lord disciplined me, and did not hand me over to death.
Psalms 117:19 Open gates of righteousness for me; entering them, I will acknowledge the Lord.
Psalms 117:20 This is the gate of the Lord; righteous ones will enter it.
Psalms 117:21 I will acknowledge you, because you heard me and became salvation for me.
Psalms 117:22 A stone which the builders rejected, this became the head of a corner;
Psalms 117:23 this came to be from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
Psalms 117:24 This is the day which the Lord made; let us exult and rejoice in it.
Psalms 117:25 O Lord, save, then; O Lord, prosper, then.
Psalms 117:26 Blessed is the one coming in the name of the Lord; we have blessed you from the house of the Lord.
Psalms 117:27 The Lord is God and shone upon us; establish a feast with those covering with branches, as far as the horns of the altar.
Psalms 117:28 You are my God, and I will acknowledge you; you are my God, and I will exalt you; I will acknowledge you, because you heard me and became salvation for me.
Psalms 117:29 Acknowledge the Lord, because he is good, because his mercy is forever.

## Chapter 118

Psalms 118:1 Alleluia. 1. Alph. Blessed are the blameless in a way, those walking in the law of the Lord.
Psalms 118:2 Blessed are those searching out his testimonies; with a whole heart they will seek him out.
Psalms 118:3 For those working lawlessness did not walk in his ways.
Psalms 118:4 You commanded that your commandments be kept diligently.
Psalms 118:5 Would that my ways were directed to keep your ordinances.
Psalms 118:6 Then I will certainly not be ashamed when I look upon all your commandments.
Psalms 118:7 I will acknowledge you, Lord, in uprightness of heart, when I have learned the judgments of your righteousness.
Psalms 118:8 I will keep your ordinances; do not abandon me utterly.
Psalms 118:9 2. Beth. By what will the younger one set his way right? By keeping your words.
Psalms 118:10 With my whole heart I sought you out; do not thrust me away from your commandments.
Psalms 118:11 In my heart I hid your utterances, so that I might not sin against you.
Psalms 118:12 You are blessed, Lord; teach me your ordinances.
Psalms 118:13 With my lips I declared all the judgments of your mouth.
Psalms 118:14 In the way of your testimonies I delighted as in all wealth.
Psalms 118:15 I will ponder your commandments and perceive your ways.
Psalms 118:16 I will meditate upon your ordinances; I will not forget your words.
Psalms 118:17 3. Gimal. Repay your slave; I will live and keep your words.
Psalms 118:18 Uncover my eyes, and I will perceive your wonders from your law.
Psalms 118:19 I am a sojourner in the earth; do not hide your commandments from me.
Psalms 118:20 My soul longed to desire your judgments at every time.
Psalms 118:21 You rebuked arrogant ones; cursed are those turning aside from your commandments.
Psalms 118:22 Remove reproach and contempt from me, because I sought out your testimonies.
Psalms 118:23 For indeed rulers sat and spoke against me, but your slave pondered your ordinances.
Psalms 118:24 For indeed your testimonies are my meditation, and your ordinances my counsels.
Psalms 118:25 4. Delth. My soul clung to the ground; give me life according to your word.
Psalms 118:26 I declared my ways, and you heard me; teach me your ordinances.
Psalms 118:27 Make me understand the way of your ordinances, and I will ponder your wonders.
Psalms 118:28 My soul dripped from weariness; confirm me in your words.
Psalms 118:29 Remove a way of injustice from me, and have mercy on me with your law.
Psalms 118:30 I chose a way of truth; I did not forget your judgments.
Psalms 118:31 I clung to your testimonies; Lord, do not put me to shame.
Psalms 118:32 I ran a way of your commandments when you widened my heart.
Psalms 118:33 5. E. Instruct me by law, Lord, in the way of your ordinances, and I will seek it out continually.
Psalms 118:34 Make me understand, and I will search out your law and keep it with my whole heart.
Psalms 118:35 Guide me in a path of your commandments, because I desired it.
Psalms 118:36 Incline my heart to your testimonies and not to greed.
Psalms 118:37 Turn my eyes away so as not to see vanity; in your way give me life.
Psalms 118:38 Establish your utterance for your slave, for fear of you.
Psalms 118:39 Remove my reproach which I suspected; for your judgments are good.
Psalms 118:40 Behold, I desired your commandments; in your righteousness give me life.
Psalms 118:41 6. Ouau. And may your mercy come upon me, Lord, your salvation according to your utterance.
Psalms 118:42 And I will answer those reproaching me with a word, because I hoped in your words.
Psalms 118:43 And do not remove a word of truth from my mouth utterly, because I hoped in your judgments.
Psalms 118:44 And I will keep your law continually, forever and for the age of the age.
Psalms 118:45 And I walked in spaciousness, because I sought out your commandments.
Psalms 118:46 And I spoke of your testimonies before kings and was not ashamed.
Psalms 118:47 And I meditated upon your commandments which I loved greatly.
Psalms 118:48 And I lifted my hands toward your commandments which I loved, and pondered your ordinances.
Psalms 118:49 7. Zai. Remember your word to your slave, by which you made me hope.
Psalms 118:50 This comforted me in my humiliation, because your utterance gave me life.
Psalms 118:51 Arrogant ones acted lawlessly to an extreme, but I did not turn aside from your law.
Psalms 118:52 I remembered your judgments from the age, Lord, and was comforted.
Psalms 118:53 Despondency seized me because of sinners abandoning your law.
Psalms 118:54 Your ordinances were songs for me in the place of my sojourning.
Psalms 118:55 I remembered your name in the night, Lord, and kept your law.
Psalms 118:56 This came to be for me, because I sought out your ordinances.
Psalms 118:57 8. Eth. My portion, Lord; I said that I would keep your law.
Psalms 118:58 I supplicated your face with my whole heart; have mercy on me according to your utterance.
Psalms 118:59 I considered your ways and turned my feet back to your testimonies.
Psalms 118:60 I was prepared and was not troubled to keep your commandments.
Psalms 118:61 Cords of sinners entwined me, and I did not forget your law.
Psalms 118:62 At midnight I rose to acknowledge you for the judgments of your righteousness.
Psalms 118:63 I am a companion of all those fearing you and those keeping your commandments.
Psalms 118:64 The earth is full of your mercy, Lord; teach me your ordinances.
Psalms 118:65 9. Teth. You did goodness with your slave, Lord, according to your word.
Psalms 118:66 Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge, because I believed your commandments.
Psalms 118:67 Before I was humbled I transgressed; for this reason I kept your utterance.
Psalms 118:68 You are good, Lord, and in your goodness teach me your ordinances.
Psalms 118:69 The injustice of arrogant ones was multiplied against me, but with my whole heart I will search out your commandments.
Psalms 118:70 Their heart curdled like milk, but I meditated upon your law.
Psalms 118:71 It is good for me that you humbled me, so that I might learn your ordinances.
Psalms 118:72 The law of your mouth is good for me beyond thousands of gold and silver.
Psalms 118:73 10. Ioth. Your hands made me and formed me; make me understand, and I will learn your commandments.
Psalms 118:74 Those fearing you will see me and rejoice, because I hoped in your words.
Psalms 118:75 I knew, Lord, that your judgments are righteousness, and in truth you humbled me.
Psalms 118:76 Let your mercy, then, come to comfort me, according to your utterance to your slave.
Psalms 118:77 Let your compassions come to me, and I will live, because your law is my meditation.
Psalms 118:78 Let arrogant ones be ashamed, because unjustly they acted lawlessly against me; but I will ponder your commandments.
Psalms 118:79 Let those fearing you and those knowing your testimonies turn back to me.
Psalms 118:80 Let my heart become blameless in your ordinances, so that I may not be ashamed.
Psalms 118:81 11. Chaph. My soul fails for your salvation, and I hoped in your word.
Psalms 118:82 My eyes failed for your utterance, saying: When will you comfort me?
Psalms 118:83 Because I became like a wineskin in frost; I did not forget your ordinances.
Psalms 118:84 How many are the days of your slave? When will you make judgment for me against those pursuing me?
Psalms 118:85 Lawless ones recounted idle talk to me, but not like your law, Lord.
Psalms 118:86 All your commandments are truth; they pursued me unjustly; help me.
Psalms 118:87 They nearly finished me in the earth, but I did not abandon your commandments.
Psalms 118:88 According to your mercy give me life, and I will keep the testimonies of your mouth.
Psalms 118:89 12. Labd. Forever, Lord, your word remains in heaven.
Psalms 118:90 Your truth is to generation and generation; you founded the earth, and it remains.
Psalms 118:91 By your ordinance the day remains, because all things are your slaves.
Psalms 118:92 If your law were not my meditation, then I would have perished in my humiliation.
Psalms 118:93 I will certainly never forget your ordinances, because in them you gave me life, Lord.
Psalms 118:94 I am yours; save me, because I sought out your ordinances.
Psalms 118:95 Sinners waited for me to destroy me; I understood your testimonies.
Psalms 118:96 I saw an end of every completion; your commandment is very broad.
Psalms 118:97 13. Mem. How I loved your law, Lord; all day it is my meditation.
Psalms 118:98 Beyond my enemies you made me wise in your commandment, because it is mine forever.
Psalms 118:99 Beyond all those teaching me I understood, because your testimonies are my meditation.
Psalms 118:100 Beyond elders I understood, because I sought out your commandments.
Psalms 118:101 From every evil way I restrained my feet, so that I might keep your words.
Psalms 118:102 I did not turn aside from your judgments, because you instructed me by law.
Psalms 118:103 How sweet your utterances are to my throat, beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth.
Psalms 118:104 From your commandments I understood; for this reason I hated every way of injustice. [Because you instructed me by law.]
Psalms 118:105 14. Noun. Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my paths.
Psalms 118:106 I have sworn and established that I would keep the judgments of your righteousness.
Psalms 118:107 I was humbled to an extreme; Lord, give me life according to your word.
Psalms 118:108 Take pleasure, then, Lord, in the willing offerings of my mouth, and teach me your judgments.
Psalms 118:109 My soul is in my hands continually, and I did not forget your law.
Psalms 118:110 Sinners placed a trap for me, and I did not stray from your commandments.
Psalms 118:111 I inherited your testimonies forever, because they are the rejoicing of my heart.
Psalms 118:112 I inclined my heart to do your ordinances forever, for recompense.
Psalms 118:113 15. Samch. I hated lawless ones and loved your law.
Psalms 118:114 You are my helper and my supporter; I hoped in your word.
Psalms 118:115 Turn aside from me, those doing evil, and I will search out the commandments of my God.
Psalms 118:116 Support me according to your utterance, and I will live, and do not put me to shame in my expectation.
Psalms 118:117 Help me, and I will be saved and meditate upon your ordinances continually.
Psalms 118:118 You despised all those departing from your ordinances, because their thought is unjust.
Psalms 118:119 I counted all the sinners of the earth as transgressors; for this reason I loved your testimonies continually.
Psalms 118:120 Nail down my flesh from fear of you; for I was afraid of your judgments.
Psalms 118:121 16. Ain. I did judgment and righteousness; do not hand me over to those wronging me.
Psalms 118:122 Receive your slave for good; let arrogant ones not falsely accuse me.
Psalms 118:123 My eyes failed for your salvation and for the utterance of your righteousness.
Psalms 118:124 Act with your slave according to your mercy, and teach me your ordinances.
Psalms 118:125 I am your slave; make me understand, and I will know your testimonies.
Psalms 118:126 It is time for the Lord to act; they scattered your law.
Psalms 118:127 For this reason I loved your commandments beyond gold and topaz.
Psalms 118:128 For this reason I was directed toward all your commandments; I hated every unjust way.
Psalms 118:129 17. Phe. Marvelous are your testimonies; for this reason my soul searched them out.
Psalms 118:130 The disclosure of your words will give light and make infants understand.
Psalms 118:131 I opened my mouth and drew breath, because I longed for your commandments.
Psalms 118:132 Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgment for those loving your name.
Psalms 118:133 Direct my steps according to your utterance, and let no lawlessness rule me.
Psalms 118:134 Redeem me from false accusation of humans, and I will keep your commandments.
Psalms 118:135 Make your face shine upon your slave and teach me your ordinances.
Psalms 118:136 My eyes brought down streams of waters, since they did not keep your law.
Psalms 118:137 18. Sade. You are righteous, Lord, and your judgment is upright.
Psalms 118:138 You commanded your testimonies as righteousness and great truth.
Psalms 118:139 The zeal of your house melted me away, because my enemies forgot your words.
Psalms 118:140 Your utterance has been greatly refined by fire, and your slave loved it.
Psalms 118:141 I am younger and despised; I did not forget your ordinances.
Psalms 118:142 Your righteousness is righteousness forever, and your law is truth.
Psalms 118:143 Affliction and distress found me; your commandments are my meditation.
Psalms 118:144 Your testimonies are righteousness forever; make me understand, and I will live.
Psalms 118:145 19. Koph. I cried out with my whole heart; hear me, Lord; I will seek out your ordinances.
Psalms 118:146 I cried out to you; save me, and I will keep your testimonies.
Psalms 118:147 I went before at an untimely hour and cried out; I hoped in your words.
Psalms 118:148 My eyes went before toward dawn, to meditate upon your utterances.
Psalms 118:149 Hear my voice, Lord, according to your mercy; according to your judgment give me life.
Psalms 118:150 Those pursuing me with lawlessness drew near, but they were distanced from your law.
Psalms 118:151 You are near, Lord, and all your commandments are truth.
Psalms 118:152 From the beginning I knew from your testimonies that you founded them forever.
Psalms 118:153 20. Res. See my humiliation and deliver me, because I did not forget your law.
Psalms 118:154 Judge my judgment and redeem me; because of your word give me life.
Psalms 118:155 Salvation is far from sinners, because they did not seek out your ordinances.
Psalms 118:156 Your compassions are many, Lord; according to your judgment give me life.
Psalms 118:157 Many are those pursuing me and pressing me hard; I did not turn aside from your testimonies.
Psalms 118:158 I saw those breaking faith and melted away, because they did not keep your utterances.
Psalms 118:159 See that I loved your commandments; Lord, in your mercy give me life.
Psalms 118:160 The beginning of your words is truth, and all the judgments of your righteousness are forever.
Psalms 118:161 21. Sen. Rulers pursued me without cause, and my heart was afraid of your words.
Psalms 118:162 I will exult in your utterances like one finding many spoils.
Psalms 118:163 I hated and abhorred injustice, but I loved your law.
Psalms 118:164 Seven times in the day I praised you for the judgments of your righteousness.
Psalms 118:165 Much peace belongs to those loving your law, and there is no stumbling block for them.
Psalms 118:166 I expected your salvation, Lord, and loved your commandments.
Psalms 118:167 My soul kept your testimonies and loved them greatly.
Psalms 118:168 I kept your commandments and your testimonies, because all my ways are before you, Lord.
Psalms 118:169 22. Thau. Let my supplication approach before you, Lord; according to your utterance make me understand.

Psalms 118:174 I longed for your salvation, Lord, and your law is my meditation.
Psalms 118:175 My soul will live and praise you, and your judgments will help me.

## Chapter 119

Psalms 119:1 A song of the ascents. To the Lord I cried out when I was afflicted, and he heard me.
Psalms 119:2 Lord, deliver my soul from unjust lips and from a deceitful tongue.
Psalms 119:3 What might be given to you, and what might be added to you against a deceitful tongue?
Psalms 119:4 The sharpened arrows of the mighty one, with the wilderness coals.
Psalms 119:5 Alas for me, because my sojourning was prolonged; I dwelt with the dwellings of Kedar.
Psalms 119:6 My soul sojourned much.
Psalms 119:7 With those hating peace I was peaceful; when I spoke to them, they fought me without cause.

## Chapter 120

Psalms 120:1 A song of the ascents. I lifted my eyes to the mountains. From where will my help come?
Psalms 120:2 My help is from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
Psalms 120:3 Do not give your foot over to shaking, nor may he who guards you slumber.
Psalms 120:4 Behold, he who guards Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
Psalms 120:5 The Lord will guard you; the Lord is your shelter at your right hand;
Psalms 120:6 by day the sun will not burn you, nor the moon by night.
Psalms 120:7 The Lord will guard you from every evil; he will guard your soul.
Psalms 120:8 The Lord will guard your entrance and your exit from now and unto the age.

## Chapter 121

Psalms 121:1 A song of the ascents. I rejoiced at those who said to me, We shall go to the house of the Lord.
Psalms 121:2 Our feet were standing in your courts, Ierousalem.
Psalms 121:3 Ierousalem, being built as a city whose participation is together.
Psalms 121:4 For there the tribes went up, tribes of the Lord, a testimony to Israel, to acknowledge the name of the Lord;
Psalms 121:5 because there sat thrones for judgment, thrones over the house of Dauid.
Psalms 121:6 Ask Ierousalem, then, for the things pertaining to peace, and prosperity for those who love you;
Psalms 121:7 let there be peace, then, in your strength and prosperity in your towered fortresses.
Psalms 121:8 For the sake of my brothers and my neighbors I was speaking peace, then, concerning you;
Psalms 121:9 for the sake of the house of the Lord our God I sought good things for you.

## Chapter 122

Psalms 122:1 A song of the ascents. To you I lifted my eyes, to the one dwelling in heaven.
Psalms 122:2 Behold, as the eyes of slaves are toward the hands of their masters, as the eyes of a maidservant are toward the hands of her mistress, so our eyes are toward the Lord our God, until he may have compassion on us.
Psalms 122:3 Have mercy on us, Lord, have mercy on us, because we were greatly filled with contempt,
Psalms 122:4 our soul was filled still more. Reproach to those who prosper, and contempt to the arrogant.

## Chapter 123

Psalms 123:1 A song of the ascents. If it had not been that the Lord was among us, let Israel say, then,
Psalms 123:2 if it had not been that the Lord was among us when people rose up against us,
Psalms 123:3 then they would have swallowed us alive when their wrath was kindled against us;
Psalms 123:4 then the water drowned us; our soul passed through a torrent;
Psalms 123:5 then our soul passed through the water that cannot be withstood.
Psalms 123:6 Blessed is the Lord, who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
Psalms 123:7 Our soul was delivered like a little bird from the snare of the hunters; the snare was shattered, and we were delivered.
Psalms 123:8 Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

## Chapter 124

Psalms 124:1 A song of the ascents. Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Sion; he who dwells in Ierousalem will not be shaken unto the age.
Psalms 124:2 Mountains are around her, and the Lord is around his people from now and unto the age.
Psalms 124:3 Because he will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the righteous, so that the righteous may not stretch out their hands in lawlessness.
Psalms 124:4 Do good, Lord, to the good and to those upright in heart;
Psalms 124:5 but those who turn aside into crooked ways the Lord will lead away with those who work lawlessness. Peace upon Israel.

## Chapter 125

Psalms 125:1 A song of the ascents. When the Lord turned back the captivity of Sion, we became like those comforted.
Psalms 125:2 Then our mouth was filled with joy, and our tongue with exultation. Then they will say among the nations, The Lord did great things in acting with them.
Psalms 125:3 The Lord did great things in acting with us; we became glad.
Psalms 125:4 Turn back our captivity, Lord, like torrents in the south.
Psalms 125:5 Those who sow in tears will reap in exultation.
Psalms 125:6 Going, they were going and weeping, carrying their seeds; but coming, they will come in exultation, carrying their sheaves.

## Chapter 126

Psalms 126:1 A song of the ascents; for Salomon. Unless the Lord builds a house, those who build it labored in vain; unless the Lord guards a city, the one guarding kept awake in vain.
Psalms 126:2 It is in vain for you to rise early, to get up after sitting down, you who eat bread of pain, when he gives sleep to his beloved ones.
Psalms 126:3 Behold, sons are the inheritance of the Lord, the reward of the fruit of the womb.
Psalms 126:4 Like arrows in the hand of a mighty one, so are the sons of those shaken off.
Psalms 126:5 Blessed is a person who will fill his desire from them; they will not be put to shame when they speak to their enemies in a gate.

## Chapter 127

Psalms 127:1 A song of the ascents. Blessed are all who fear the Lord, who walk in his ways.
Psalms 127:2 You will eat the labors of your wrists; you are blessed, and it will be well with you.
Psalms 127:3 Your wife is like a flourishing vine in the sides of your house; your sons are like newly planted olive trees around your table.
Psalms 127:4 Behold, thus will a person who fears the Lord be blessed.
Psalms 127:5 May the Lord bless you from Sion, and may you see the good things of Ierousalem all the days of your life;
Psalms 127:6 and may you see sons of your sons. Peace upon Israel.

## Chapter 128

Psalms 128:1 A song of the ascents. Many times they made war on me from my youth, let Israel say, then,

Psalms 128:4 The righteous Lord cut apart the necks of sinners.

## Chapter 129

## Chapter 130

## Chapter 131

Psalms 131:1 A song of the ascents. Remember, Lord, Dauid and all his meekness,

Psalms 131:3 I shall not enter the dwelling of my house, I shall not go up upon the bed of my bedding,

Psalms 134:2 you who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God.

Psalms 134:5 Because I knew that the Lord is great, and our Lord is beyond all the gods;

Psalms 134:12 and gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his people.
Psalms 134:13 Lord, your name is unto the age; Lord, your memorial is unto generation and generation.

Psalms 134:15 The idols of the nations are silver and gold, works of human hands;
Psalms 134:16 they have a mouth and will not speak; they have eyes and will not see;
Psalms 134:17 they have ears and will not listen; [they have noses and will not smell; they have hands and will not feel; they have feet and will not walk; they will not utter a sound in their throat;] for there is not even breath in their mouth.

Psalms 134:19 House of Israel, bless the Lord; house of Aaron, bless the Lord;
Psalms 134:20 house of Leui, bless the Lord; you who fear the Lord, bless the Lord.
Psalms 134:21 Blessed is the Lord from Sion, he who dwells in Ierousalem.

Psalms 135:17 him who struck great kings, because his mercy is unto the age,

Psalms 135:19 Seon king of the Amorrites, because his mercy is unto the age,

## Chapter 136

Psalms 136:1 For Dauid. By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept when we remembered Sion.
Psalms 136:2 Upon the willows in her midst we hung our instruments;
Psalms 136:3 because there those who took us captive asked us for words of songs, and those who led us away for a hymn: Sing to us from the songs of Sion.

Psalms 136:5 If I forget you, Ierousalem, may my right hand be forgotten;

Psalms 136:9 blessed is he who will seize and dash your infants against the rock.

## Chapter 137

Psalms 137:1 For Dauid. I shall acknowledge you, Lord, with my whole heart, because you heard the words of my mouth, and before angels I shall sing to you.
Psalms 137:2 I shall bow down toward your holy temple and acknowledge your name for your mercy and your truth, because you magnified your oracle above every name.
Psalms 137:3 On whatever day I call upon you, hear me quickly; you will regard me greatly in my soul with strength.
Psalms 137:4 Let all the kings of the earth acknowledge you, Lord, because they heard all the words of your mouth,
Psalms 137:5 and let them sing in the ways of the Lord, because great is the glory of the Lord,
Psalms 137:6 because the Lord is high and looks upon the lowly things, and knows the lofty things from afar.
Psalms 137:7 If I walk in the midst of affliction, you will give me life; against the wrath of my enemies you stretched out your hand, and your right hand saved me.
Psalms 137:8 The Lord will repay on my behalf. Lord, your mercy is unto the age; do not abandon the works of your hands.

## Chapter 138

Psalms 138:1 For the end; a psalm for Dauid. Lord, you tested me and knew me;
Psalms 138:2 you knew my sitting and my rising; you understood my reasonings from afar;
Psalms 138:3 you traced out my path and my measuring cord, and foresaw all my ways.
Psalms 138:4 Because there is no word on my tongue,
Psalms 138:5 behold, Lord, you knew all things, the last and the ancient; you formed me and laid your hand upon me.
Psalms 138:6 Your knowledge became marvelous beyond me; it became mighty; I certainly cannot attain to it.
Psalms 138:7 Where shall I go from your spirit, and where shall I flee from your face?
Psalms 138:8 If I go up into heaven, you are there; if I go down into Hades, you are present;
Psalms 138:9 if I were to take up my wings at dawn and encamp at the ends of the sea,
Psalms 138:10 for even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.
Psalms 138:11 And I said, Then darkness will trample me, and night is illumination in my delight;
Psalms 138:12 because darkness will not be darkened from you, and night will be illuminated like day; as its darkness, so also its light.
Psalms 138:13 Because you acquired my kidneys, Lord; you took hold of me from my mother's womb.
Psalms 138:14 I shall acknowledge you, because I was fearfully made marvelous; marvelous are your works, and my soul knows exceedingly.
Psalms 138:15 My bone, which you made in secret, was not hidden from you. And my substance is in the lowest parts of the earth;
Psalms 138:16 your eyes saw my unworked substance, and in your book all will be written; by day they will be formed, and none among them.
Psalms 138:17 But to me your friends were greatly honored, God; their beginnings became greatly mighty;
Psalms 138:18 I shall count them, and they will be multiplied beyond sand; I awoke, and I am still with you.
Psalms 138:19 If you kill sinners, God, men of bloods, turn aside from me.
Psalms 138:20 Because you will speak for a reasoning; they will take your cities for vanity.
Psalms 138:21 Did I not hate those who hate you, Lord, and was I not wasting away over your enemies?
Psalms 138:22 I hated them with a complete hatred; they became enemies to me.
Psalms 138:23 Test me, God, and know my heart; examine me and know my paths,
Psalms 138:24 and see whether a way of lawlessness is in me, and lead me in an eternal way.

## Chapter 139

Psalms 139:3 who reasoned out injustices in their heart; the whole day they were arraying wars;

## Chapter 140

Psalms 140:1 A psalm for Dauid. Lord, I cried to you; hear me; attend to the voice of my supplication when I cry to you.
Psalms 140:2 Let my prayer be directed like incense before you, the lifting of my hands an evening sacrifice.
Psalms 140:3 Set, Lord, a guard for my mouth and a door of enclosure around my lips.
Psalms 140:4 Do not incline my heart to words of wickedness, to make excuses in sins with people who work lawlessness, and I shall certainly not join with their chosen ones.
Psalms 140:5 A righteous one will discipline me with mercy and reprove me, but let a sinner's oil not fatten my head, because still my prayer also is in their good pleasures.
Psalms 140:6 Their judges were swallowed up beside a rock; they will hear my words, because they became sweet.
Psalms 140:7 Like a thickness of earth was torn apart upon the earth, our bones were scattered beside Hades.
Psalms 140:8 Because toward you, Lord, Lord, are my eyes; in you I hoped; do not take away my soul.
Psalms 140:9 Guard me from a snare which they set for me, and from the stumbling blocks of those who work lawlessness.
Psalms 140:10 Sinners will fall in his net; I am alone until I pass by.

## Chapter 141

Psalms 141:6 I cried to you, Lord; I said, You are my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

## Chapter 142

Psalms 142:4 and my spirit grew despondent upon me; my heart was troubled within me.

## Chapter 143

Psalms 143:7 Send out your hand from on high; rescue me and deliver me from many waters, from the hand of foreign sons,
Psalms 143:8 whose mouth spoke vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of injustice.
Psalms 143:9 God, I shall sing a new song to you; on a ten-stringed psaltery I shall sing to you,

Psalms 143:11 Deliver me and rescue me from the hand of foreign sons, whose mouth spoke vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of injustice.
Psalms 143:12 Whose sons are like new plants grown strong in their youth, their daughters beautified, adorned all around like the likeness of a temple,
Psalms 143:13 their storehouses full, pouring out from this into that, their sheep bearing many young, multiplying in their exits,
Psalms 143:14 their oxen fat; there is no falling of a fence, nor a passage out, nor a cry in their squares.
Psalms 143:15 They called blessed the people who have these things; blessed are the people whose God is the Lord.

## Chapter 151

Psalms 151:3 And who will announce to my Lord? He himself is Lord; he himself hears.
