Sirach 24:34 See that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all who seek her out.

## Chapter 25

Sirach 25:1 In three things I was made beautiful and stood beautiful before the Lord and human beings: concord of brothers, and friendship of neighbors, and a wife and husband accommodating themselves to one another.
Sirach 25:2 But three kinds my soul hated, and I was greatly offended at their life: a proud poor man, and a rich liar, an old adulterer deficient in understanding.
Sirach 25:3 In youth you have not gathered, and how could you find in your old age?
Sirach 25:4 How beautiful is judgment for gray hairs, and for elders to know counsel.
Sirach 25:5 How beautiful is the wisdom of old men, and thought and counsel for the honored.
Sirach 25:6 The crown of old men is abundant experience, and their boast is fear of the Lord.
Sirach 25:7 Nine conceptions I called blessed in heart, and the tenth I will speak upon my tongue: a person rejoicing over children, living and looking upon the fall of enemies;
Sirach 25:8 blessed is he who lives with an understanding wife, and he who did not slip with his tongue, and he who did not serve one unworthy of himself;
Sirach 25:9 blessed is he who found prudence, and he who recounts to the ears of listeners;
Sirach 25:10 how great is he who found wisdom; but he is not above him who fears the Lord;
Sirach 25:11 fear of the Lord surpassed everything; he who holds it, to whom will he be likened?
Sirach 25:13 Every wound, but not a wound of the heart, and every wickedness, but not the wickedness of a woman;
Sirach 25:14 every affliction, but not an affliction from those who hate, and every vengeance, but not the vengeance of enemies.
Sirach 25:15 There is no head above the head of a snake, and there is no fury above the fury of an enemy.
Sirach 25:16 I will prefer to live with a lion and a dragon rather than live with a wicked woman.
Sirach 25:17 A woman's wickedness alters her appearance and darkens her face like a bear;
Sirach 25:18 in the midst of his neighbors her husband will recline, and unwillingly he sighed bitterly.
Sirach 25:19 Every evil is small compared with a woman's evil; may a sinner's lot fall upon her.
Sirach 25:20 A sandy ascent beneath an elder's feet, so is a talkative woman to a quiet man.
Sirach 25:21 Do not fall for a woman's beauty, and do not long for a woman.
Sirach 25:22 Wrath and shamelessness and great shame, if a woman provides for her husband.
Sirach 25:23 A humbled heart and a gloomy face and a wound of the heart are a wicked woman; slack hands and paralyzed knees is she who will not make her husband blessed.
Sirach 25:24 From a woman is the beginning of sin, and because of her we all die.
Sirach 25:25 Do not give water an outlet, nor a wicked woman freedom of speech;
Sirach 25:26 if she does not walk according to your hands, cut her off from your flesh.

## Chapter 26

Sirach 26:1 Blessed is the husband of a good wife, and the number of his days is double.
Sirach 26:2 A courageous wife gladdens her husband, and he will fulfill his years in peace.
Sirach 26:3 A good wife is a good portion; in the portion of those fearing the Lord she will be given;
Sirach 26:4 and the heart of rich and poor is good, at every time a cheerful face.
Sirach 26:5 At three things my heart was apprehensive, and at the fourth appearance I made supplication: slander of a city, and an assembly of a mob, and a false accusation, all grievous beyond death.
Sirach 26:6 Pain of heart and mourning is a woman jealous of a woman, and a scourge of the tongue communicating with everyone.
Sirach 26:7 A shaking ox yoke is a wicked woman; he who holds her is like one grasping a scorpion.
Sirach 26:8 Great wrath is a drunken woman, and she will not conceal her indecency.
Sirach 26:9 A woman's prostitution will be known in the raising of her eyes and in her eyelids.
Sirach 26:10 Over an unrestrained daughter strengthen your guard, lest, finding freedom, she use it for herself;
Sirach 26:11 guard against a shameless eye, and do not marvel if she transgresses against you;
Sirach 26:12 like a thirsty traveler she will open her mouth and drink from every nearby water; opposite every stake she will sit, and before an arrow she will open a quiver.
Sirach 26:13 A woman's grace will delight her husband, and her knowledge will fatten his bones.
Sirach 26:14 A gift of the Lord is a silent woman, and there is no exchange for a disciplined soul;
Sirach 26:15 grace upon grace is a modest woman, and no weight is worthy of a self-controlled soul.
Sirach 26:16 The sun rising in the Lord's heights, and the beauty of a good woman in the adornment of her house;
Sirach 26:17 a lamp shining upon a holy lampstand, and the beauty of a face upon a mature stature;
Sirach 26:18 golden pillars upon a silver base, and beautiful feet upon the breasts of a steadfast one.
Sirach 26:28 At two things my heart has been grieved, and at the third fury came upon me: a warrior lacking because of want, and understanding men if they are treated as refuse, one turning back from righteousness to sin; the Lord will prepare him for a sword.
Sirach 26:29 A merchant will scarcely be delivered from transgression, and a retailer will not be justified from sin.

## Chapter 27

Sirach 27:1 For the sake of profit many sinned, and he who seeks to increase will turn away an eye.
Sirach 27:2 Between the joints of stones a stake will be fixed, and between selling and buying sin will be crushed in.
Sirach 27:3 If he does not hold firmly in fear of the Lord with diligence, his house will quickly be overthrown.
Sirach 27:4 In the shaking of a sieve dung remains, so a person's refuse in his reasoning.
Sirach 27:5 A furnace tests a potter's vessels, and a person's testing is in his deliberation.
Sirach 27:6 The cultivation of a tree its fruit manifests, so does speech the thought of a person's heart.
Sirach 27:7 Before reasoning do not praise a man; for this is the testing of human beings.
Sirach 27:8 If you pursue what is just, you will attain it and put it on like a robe of glory reaching to the feet.
Sirach 27:9 Birds will lodge with their like, and truth will return to those who work it.
Sirach 27:10 A lion lies in ambush for prey, so does sin for those working unjust things.
Sirach 27:11 A pious person's discourse is wisdom continually, but the senseless changes like the moon.
Sirach 27:12 Among those without understanding observe the time, but among thoughtful people stay continually.
Sirach 27:13 The discourse of fools is an offense, and their laughter is in the luxury of sin.
Sirach 27:14 The talk of one swearing many oaths will make hairs stand up, and their quarrel is a stopping of ears.
Sirach 27:15 A quarrel of the proud is bloodshed, and their mutual abuse is a grievous hearing.
Sirach 27:16 He who reveals secrets destroyed trust and will certainly not find a friend for his soul.
Sirach 27:17 Cherish a friend and be faithful with him; but if you reveal his secrets, do not pursue after him.
Sirach 27:18 For just as a person lost his dead one, so you lost your neighbor's friendship;
Sirach 27:19 and as you released a bird from your hand, so you let your neighbor go and will not catch him.
Sirach 27:20 Do not pursue him, because he departed far away and escaped like a gazelle from a snare.
Sirach 27:21 For a wound can be bound, and for abuse there is reconciliation, but he who revealed secrets has given up hope.
Sirach 27:22 He who winks with an eye devises evils, and no one will remove them from him;
Sirach 27:23 before your eyes he will sweeten his mouth and marvel at your words, but afterward he will twist his mouth and put a stumbling block in your words.
Sirach 27:24 Many things I hated, and I did not liken them to him, and the Lord will hate him.
Sirach 27:25 He who throws a stone upward throws upon his own head, and a deceitful blow will make wounds.
Sirach 27:26 He who digs a pit will fall into it, and he who sets a snare will be caught in it.
Sirach 27:27 He who does wicked things, they will roll upon him, and he will certainly not know from where it comes to him.
Sirach 27:28 Mockery and reproach are for a proud person, and vengeance like a lion will lie in ambush for him.
Sirach 27:29 Those rejoicing at the fall of the pious will be caught in a snare, and pain will consume them before their death.
Sirach 27:30 Resentment and wrath, these too are abominations, and a sinful man will possess them.

## Chapter 28

Sirach 28:1 He who takes vengeance will find vengeance from the Lord, and he will surely keep his sins in remembrance.
Sirach 28:2 Forgive your neighbor's wrongdoing, and then, when you make supplication, your sins will be loosed.
Sirach 28:3 A person maintains wrath against a person, and seeks healing from the Lord?
Sirach 28:4 He has no mercy upon a person like himself, and makes supplication concerning his sins?
Sirach 28:5 He himself, being flesh, keeps resentment; who will make atonement for his sins?
Sirach 28:6 Remember the last things and cease being hostile, corruption and death, and abide in commandments.
Sirach 28:7 Remember commandments and do not bear resentment toward your neighbor, and the covenant of the Most High, and overlook ignorance.
Sirach 28:8 Abstain from a quarrel, and you will diminish sins; for a wrathful person will kindle a quarrel,
Sirach 28:9 and a sinful man will trouble friends and throw slander among those at peace.
Sirach 28:10 According to the fuel of the fire, so it will be kindled, and according to the strength of the quarrel it will be kindled; according to a person's strength his fury will be, and according to his wealth he will heighten his wrath.
Sirach 28:11 Strife being hurried on kindles fire, and a quarrel hurrying on pours out blood.
Sirach 28:12 If you blow into a spark, it will be kindled, and if you spit upon it, it will be extinguished; and both proceed from your mouth.
Sirach 28:13 Curse a whisperer and a double-tongued person; for he destroyed many who were at peace.
Sirach 28:14 A third tongue shook many and dispersed them from nation to nation and demolished fortified cities and overthrew houses of great men.
Sirach 28:15 A third tongue cast out courageous women and deprived them of their labors.
Sirach 28:16 He who attends to it will certainly not find rest, nor encamp with quietness.
Sirach 28:17 A blow of a whip makes a bruise, but a blow of a tongue will shatter bones.
Sirach 28:18 Many fell by the mouth of a sword, but not as many as those who have fallen through a tongue.
Sirach 28:19 Blessed is he who was sheltered from it, who did not pass through its fury, who did not pull its yoke and was not bound in its bonds;
Sirach 28:20 for its yoke is an iron yoke, and its bonds are bronze bonds;
Sirach 28:21 an evil death is its death, and Hades is more profitable than it.
Sirach 28:22 It will certainly not take hold of the pious, and in its flame they will not be burned.
Sirach 28:23 Those abandoning the Lord will fall into it, and among them it will be kindled and certainly not be extinguished; it will be sent against them like a lion and ravage them like a leopard.
Sirach 28:24 See, fence your possession around with thorns; bind up your silver and your gold;
Sirach 28:25 and for your words make a balance and a weight, and for your mouth make a door and a bar.
Sirach 28:26 Beware lest you slip by it, lest you fall before one lying in ambush.

## Chapter 29

Sirach 29:1 He who does mercy will lend to his neighbor, and he who strengthens with his hand keeps commandments.
Sirach 29:2 Lend to your neighbor in the time of his need, and repay your neighbor at the time;
Sirach 29:3 Establish your word and be faithful with him, and at every time you will find what you need.
Sirach 29:4 Many considered a loan as a windfall and provided trouble for those who helped them.
Sirach 29:5 Until he receives, he will kiss his hands and lower his voice over his neighbor's money; and at the time of repayment he will prolong the time and repay words of indifference and blame the time.
Sirach 29:6 If he prevails, he will scarcely recover half and reckon it as a windfall; but if not, he deprived him of his money and acquired him as an enemy without cause; curses and abuses he will repay him, and instead of honor he will repay him dishonor.
Sirach 29:7 Many turned away, not for the sake of wickedness; they were apprehensive of being deprived without cause.
Sirach 29:8 Nevertheless, be patient with a lowly person, and over almsgiving do not put him off.
Sirach 29:9 For the sake of the commandment help a needy person, and according to his want do not turn him away empty.
Sirach 29:10 Lose silver for a brother and friend, and let it not rust beneath the stone to destruction.
Sirach 29:11 Place your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it will profit you more than gold.
Sirach 29:12 Shut up almsgiving in your store chambers, and it will deliver you from every affliction;
Sirach 29:13 beyond a shield of strength and beyond a spear of weight it will fight for you before an enemy.
Sirach 29:14 A good man will become surety for his neighbor, and he who has lost shame will abandon him.
Sirach 29:15 Do not forget a surety's favors; for he gave his soul for you.
Sirach 29:16 A sinner will overturn a surety's good things, and one ungrateful in mind will abandon his rescuer.
Sirach 29:17 Surety destroyed many who were prospering and shook them like a wave of the sea;
Sirach 29:18 it displaced powerful men, and they wandered among foreign nations.
Sirach 29:19 A sinner falling into surety and pursuing contracts will fall into judgments.
Sirach 29:20 Help your neighbor according to your ability, and take heed to yourself lest you fall.
Sirach 29:21 The beginning of life is water and bread and clothing and a house covering indecency.
Sirach 29:22 Better is a poor person's life beneath a shelter of beams than splendid foods among strangers.
Sirach 29:23 With little and much have contentment, and you will certainly not hear the reproach of sojourning.
Sirach 29:24 An evil life is from house to house, and where you sojourn you will not open your mouth;
Sirach 29:25 you will entertain and give drink without thanks, and in addition to these you will hear bitter things:
Sirach 29:26 Come along, sojourner, adorn a table, and if anything is in your hand, feed me;
Sirach 29:27 go out, sojourner, from before honor; my brother has come to stay with me, there is need of the house.
Sirach 29:28 These things are heavy for a person having prudence, rebuke concerning lodging and reproach from a lender.

## Chapter 30

Sirach 30:1 He who loves his son will apply whips to him continually, that he may rejoice at his latter end;
Sirach 30:2 he who disciplines his son will benefit from him and boast of him among acquaintances;
Sirach 30:3 he who teaches his son will provoke his enemy to jealousy and exult over him before friends.
Sirach 30:4 His father died, and as though he did not die; for he left one like himself after him.
Sirach 30:5 In his life he saw and rejoiced, and at his death he was not grieved;
Sirach 30:6 before enemies he left an avenger, and for friends one repaying favor.
Sirach 30:7 He who pampers a son will bind up his wounds, and at every cry his inward parts will be troubled.
Sirach 30:8 An untamed horse turns out obstinate, and an unrestrained son turns out headlong.
Sirach 30:9 Nurse a child, and he will alarm you; play with him, and he will grieve you.
Sirach 30:10 Do not laugh with him, lest you suffer pain with him, and at the last you will gnash your teeth.
Sirach 30:11 Do not give him authority in youth;
Sirach 30:12 bruise his sides while he is an infant, lest, becoming obstinate, he disobey you.
Sirach 30:13 Discipline your son and labor upon him, that you may not stumble in his indecency.
Sirach 30:14 Better is a poor person healthy and strong in constitution than a rich person scourged in his body.
Sirach 30:15 Health and good condition are better than all gold, and a vigorous body than immeasurable prosperity.
Sirach 30:16 There is no wealth better than bodily health, and there is no gladness above joy of heart.
Sirach 30:17 Better is death than bitter life, and rest of an age than abiding sickness.
Sirach 30:18 Good things poured out upon a closed mouth are offerings of foods laid beside a grave.
Sirach 30:19 What does an offering benefit an idol? For it will neither eat nor smell; so is he who is driven out by the Lord.
Sirach 30:20 Looking with eyes and sighing, just like a eunuch embracing a virgin and sighing.
Sirach 30:21 Do not give your soul to grief, and do not afflict yourself in your counsel.
Sirach 30:22 Gladness of heart is a person's life, and a man's exultation is length of days.
Sirach 30:23 Deceive your soul and comfort your heart and remove grief far from you; for grief destroyed many, and there is no benefit in it.
Sirach 30:24 Jealousy and fury diminish days, and care brings old age before its time.
Sirach 30:25 A cheerful and good heart will attend to the dishes of its foods.

## Chapter 31

Sirach 31:1 Wakefulness over wealth wastes flesh, and care for it removes sleep.
Sirach 31:2 Care of wakefulness will remove drowsiness, and a heavy sickness will sober sleep away.
Sirach 31:3 A rich person labored in gathering money, and at rest is filled with his luxuries.
Sirach 31:4 A poor person labored in the diminution of livelihood, and at rest becomes needy.
Sirach 31:5 He who loves gold will not be justified, and he who pursues profits will be led astray by them.
Sirach 31:6 Many were given over to a fall for the sake of gold, and their destruction came before their face.
Sirach 31:7 It is a wood of stumbling for those enraptured by it, and every senseless person will be caught in it.
Sirach 31:8 Blessed is a rich person who was found blameless and who did not go after gold;
Sirach 31:9 who is he? And we will call him blessed; for he did wondrous things among his people.
Sirach 31:10 Who was tested by it and perfected? And it will be a boast for him. Who could transgress and did not transgress, and do evils and did not do them?
Sirach 31:11 His good things will be established, and an assembly will recount his almsgiving.
Sirach 31:12 Have you sat at a great table? Do not open your throat over it and do not say, Many indeed are the things upon it;
Sirach 31:13 remember that an evil eye is an evil. What has been created more evil than an eye? For this reason it weeps from every face.
Sirach 31:14 Wherever it looks, do not stretch out a hand and do not jostle with it in a dish.
Sirach 31:15 Understand your neighbor's things from yourself, and consider every matter.
Sirach 31:16 Eat like a human being the things set beside you, and do not chew greedily, lest you be hated.
Sirach 31:17 Cease first for the sake of discipline, and do not be insatiable, lest you stumble;
Sirach 31:18 and if you have sat among many, do not stretch out your hand before them.
Sirach 31:19 How sufficient for a disciplined person is a little, and upon his bed he does not pant.
Sirach 31:20 Healthy sleep is upon a moderate gut; he rose early, and his soul was with him. Pain of wakefulness and cholera and colic are with an insatiable man;
Sirach 31:21 and if you were forced with foods, rise, vomit far away, and you will rest.
Sirach 31:22 Hear me, child, and do not despise me, and at the last you will find my words; in all your works become skillful, and no sickness will certainly meet you.
Sirach 31:23 Lips will bless one generous with bread, and the testimony of his goodness is faithful.
Sirach 31:24 A city will grumble against one wicked with bread, and the testimony of his wickedness is exact.
Sirach 31:25 Do not show yourself a man with wine; for wine destroyed many.
Sirach 31:26 A furnace tests steel in tempering, so does wine hearts in the quarrel of the proud.
Sirach 31:27 Wine is equal to life for human beings, if you drink it in its measure. What life is there for one deprived of wine? And it was created for gladness for human beings.
Sirach 31:28 Exultation of heart and gladness of soul is wine drunk at its time in sufficient measure;
Sirach 31:29 bitterness of soul is much wine drunk in irritation and conflict.
Sirach 31:30 Drunkenness increases a senseless person's fury to stumbling, diminishing strength and adding wounds.
Sirach 31:31 At a drinking party of wine do not reprove your neighbor and do not despise him in his gladness; do not speak a word of reproach to him and do not afflict him with a demand.

## Chapter 32

Sirach 32:1 Did they appoint you leader? Do not exalt yourself; be among them as one of them, care for them and thus sit down;
Sirach 32:2 and having performed all your service, recline, that you may rejoice because of them and receive a crown for good order.
Sirach 32:3 Speak, elder, for it befits you, with exact knowledge, and do not hinder musical performances.
Sirach 32:4 Where there is a performance, do not pour out talk, and do not show wisdom untimely.
Sirach 32:5 A carbuncle seal upon a gold ornament is a concert of musicians at a drinking party of wine;
Sirach 32:6 in a gold setting an emerald seal is a melody of musicians over pleasant wine.
Sirach 32:7 Speak, young man, if there is need of you, scarcely twice if you are asked;
Sirach 32:8 sum up your speech, many things in a few; be as one knowing and at the same time silent.
Sirach 32:9 In the midst of great men do not make yourself equal, and while another speaks do not chatter much.
Sirach 32:10 Before thunder lightning hastens, and before a modest person grace will go forth.
Sirach 32:11 At the hour rise and do not lag behind; run off home and do not be sluggish;
Sirach 32:12 there play and do your intended things, and do not sin with a proud word.
Sirach 32:13 And over these things bless him who made you and drenches you from his good things.
Sirach 32:14 He who fears the Lord will accept discipline, and those rising early will find favor.
Sirach 32:15 He who seeks the law will be filled with it, and he who acts hypocritically will stumble in it.
Sirach 32:16 Those fearing the Lord will find judgment and kindle ordinances like light.
Sirach 32:17 A sinful person will avoid reproof and find a decision according to his wish.
Sirach 32:18 A man of counsel will certainly not overlook a thought; a stranger and a proud person will not cower in fear.
Sirach 32:19 Without counsel do nothing, and when you have done it do not regret it.
Sirach 32:20 Do not walk on a way of stumbling, and do not stumble on stony places.
Sirach 32:21 Do not trust in an unobstructed way
Sirach 32:22 and guard against your children.
Sirach 32:23 In every work trust your soul; for this too is keeping commandments.
Sirach 32:24 He who trusts the law attends to commandments, and he who has trusted the Lord will not be diminished.

## Chapter 33

Sirach 33:1 No evil will meet him who fears the Lord, but in testing he will again be delivered.
Sirach 33:2 A wise man will not hate the law, but he who acts hypocritically in it is like a ship in a storm.
Sirach 33:3 An understanding person will trust the law, and the law is faithful to him like an inquiry of manifestations.
Sirach 33:4 Prepare speech and thus you will be heard; bind together discipline and answer.
Sirach 33:5 A wagon wheel is a fool's inward parts, and his deliberation is like a turning axle.
Sirach 33:6 A horse for mating is like a mocking friend; beneath everyone sitting upon it it neighs.
Sirach 33:7 Why does a day surpass a day, when all the light of a day of the year is from the sun?
Sirach 33:8 By the Lord's knowledge they were separated, and he varied seasons and festivals;
Sirach 33:9 some of them he exalted and sanctified, and some of them he placed among the number of days.
Sirach 33:10 And all human beings are from the ground, and Adam was created from earth;
Sirach 33:11 in an abundance of knowledge the Lord separated them and varied their ways;
Sirach 33:12 some of them he blessed and exalted, and some of them he sanctified and brought near himself; some of them he cursed and humbled and overturned them from their station.
Sirach 33:13 As a potter's clay in his hand – all his ways according to his pleasure – , so are human beings in the hand of him who made them, to repay them according to his judgment.
Sirach 33:14 Opposite evil is good, and opposite death is life, so opposite a pious person is a sinner;
Sirach 33:15 and thus look into all the works of the Most High, two by two, one opposite the other.
Sirach 33:16 And I, last, kept watch like one gleaning after grape gatherers;
Sirach 33:17 in the Lord's blessing I came before, and like a grape gatherer I filled a winepress.
Sirach 33:18 Consider that I have not labored for myself alone, but for all who seek discipline.
Sirach 33:19 Hear me, great men of the people, and leaders of the assembly, give ear.
Sirach 33:20 To son and wife, brother and friend, do not give authority over you in your life; and do not give another your money, lest, regretting it, you make supplication for it.
Sirach 33:21 While you still live and breath is in you, do not exchange yourself with any flesh;
Sirach 33:22 for it is better for your children to make supplication to you than for you to look into your sons' hands.
Sirach 33:23 In all your works be preeminent; do not put a blemish on your honor.
Sirach 33:24 On the day of the completion of the days of your life and at the time of death distribute an inheritance.
Sirach 33:25 Fodder and rod and loads for a donkey, bread and discipline and work for a household servant.
Sirach 33:26 Work with a servant, and you will find rest; relax your hands toward him, and he will seek freedom.
Sirach 33:27 A yoke and a strap will bend a neck, and for a maleficent household servant there are racks and tortures;
Sirach 33:28 put him to work, that he may not be idle, for idleness taught much evil;
Sirach 33:29 set him to works as befits him, and if he does not obey, make his fetters heavy.
Sirach 33:30 And do not be excessive toward any flesh, and without judgment do nothing.
Sirach 33:31 If you have a household servant, let him be as you, because with blood you acquired him;
Sirach 33:32 if you have a household servant, treat him as a brother, because you will need him as your soul;
Sirach 33:33 if you ill-treat him and, departing, he runs away, on what road will you seek him?

## Chapter 34

Sirach 34:1 Empty and false hopes are for a man without understanding, and dreams give wings to the senseless.
Sirach 34:2 Like one grasping a shadow and pursuing wind, so is he who attends to dreams;
Sirach 34:3 this against that is a vision of dreams, a likeness of a face opposite a face.
Sirach 34:4 From an unclean thing what will be cleansed? And from a false thing what will be true?
Sirach 34:5 Divinations and omens and dreams are vain, and the heart imagines like that of a woman in labor;
Sirach 34:6 if it is not sent from the Most High in an inspection, do not give your heart to them;
Sirach 34:7 for dreams led many astray, and they fell away while hoping in them.
Sirach 34:8 Without falsehood the law will be accomplished, and wisdom is perfection in a faithful mouth.
Sirach 34:9 A man who has wandered knew many things, and one of abundant experience will recount understanding;
Sirach 34:10 he who was not tested knows few things, but he who has wandered will increase skillfulness.
Sirach 34:11 I have seen many things in my wandering, and my understanding is more than my words;
Sirach 34:12 many times I was endangered as far as death, and I was preserved because of these things.
Sirach 34:13 The spirit of those fearing the Lord will live; for their hope is upon him who saves them.
Sirach 34:14 He who fears the Lord will be apprehensive of nothing and will certainly not be cowardly, because he is his hope.
Sirach 34:15 Blessed is the soul of him who fears the Lord; to whom does he attend? And who is his support?
Sirach 34:16 The Lord's eyes are upon those who love him, a shield of might and a support of strength, shelter from scorching heat and shelter from midday, protection from stumbling and help against falling,
Sirach 34:17 raising the soul and illuminating eyes, giving healing, life and blessing.
Sirach 34:18 One sacrificing from injustice, a blemished offering, and gifts of the lawless are not for favor.
Sirach 34:19 The Most High does not take pleasure in offerings of the ungodly, nor by a multitude of sacrifices does he make atonement for sins.
Sirach 34:20 One slaughtering a son before his father is he who brings a sacrifice from the money of the needy.
Sirach 34:21 The bread of the needy is the life of the poor; he who deprives them of it is a person of blood.
Sirach 34:22 He who takes away livelihood murders his neighbor, and he who withholds a hired worker's wage pours out blood.
Sirach 34:23 One building and one demolishing; what did they benefit beyond labors?
Sirach 34:24 One praying and one cursing; whose voice will the Master listen to?
Sirach 34:25 One washing from a dead person and again touching him, what did he benefit in his bathing?
Sirach 34:26 So is a person fasting over his sins and again going and doing the same things; who will listen to his prayer? And what did he benefit in being humbled?

## Chapter 35

Sirach 35:1 He who keeps the law increases offerings; he who attends to commandments sacrifices a salvation offering.
Sirach 35:2 One repaying favor offers fine flour, and he who does almsgiving sacrifices a praise offering.
Sirach 35:3 The Lord's pleasure is to depart from wickedness, and atonement is to depart from injustice.
Sirach 35:4 Do not appear before the Lord empty; for all these things are for the sake of the commandment.
Sirach 35:5 A righteous person's offering fattens an altar, and its fragrance is before the Most High.
Sirach 35:6 A righteous man's sacrifice is acceptable, and its remembrance will not be forgotten.
Sirach 35:7 With a good eye glorify the Lord, and do not diminish the firstfruit of your hands.
Sirach 35:8 In every gift make your face cheerful, and in gladness sanctify a tenth.
Sirach 35:9 Give to the Most High according to his gift and with a good eye according to what your hand finds;
Sirach 35:10 because the Lord is one who repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.
Sirach 35:11 Do not bribe, for he will not accept, and do not attend to an unjust sacrifice;
Sirach 35:12 because the Lord is a judge, and with him there is no regard for a person's honor.
Sirach 35:13 He will not show partiality against a poor person and will listen to the supplication of one wronged;
Sirach 35:14 he will certainly not overlook an orphan's petition and a widow if she pours out speech;
Sirach 35:15 do not a widow's tears descend upon her cheek, and the cry against him who brought them down?
Sirach 35:16 He who serves with good will will be accepted, and his supplication will reach as far as clouds;
Sirach 35:17 a lowly person's prayer passed through clouds, and until it draws near he will certainly not be comforted;
Sirach 35:18 and he will certainly not withdraw until the Most High inspects, and he will judge for the righteous and execute judgment.
Sirach 35:19 And the Lord will certainly not delay, nor will he be patient with them,
Sirach 35:20 until he crushes the loins of the merciless and repays vengeance to the nations,
Sirach 35:21 until he removes the multitude of the insolent and shatters the scepters of the unjust,
Sirach 35:22 until he repays a person according to his actions and the works of human beings according to their thoughts,
Sirach 35:23 until he judges his people's case and gladdens them in his mercy.
Sirach 35:24 Beautiful is mercy at the time of his affliction, like rain clouds at a time of drought.

## Chapter 36

Sirach 36:1 Have mercy on us, Master, God of all, and look upon us and put your fear upon all the nations;
Sirach 36:2 raise your hand against foreign nations, and let them see your might.
Sirach 36:3 Just as before them you were sanctified among us, so before us may you be magnified among them;
Sirach 36:4 and let them know you, just as we too knew that there is no God except you, Lord.
Sirach 36:5 Renew signs and vary wonders, glorify your hand and right arm;
Sirach 36:6 rouse fury and pour out wrath, remove an adversary and wipe out an enemy.
Sirach 36:7 Hasten the time and remember the oath, and let them recount your great deeds.
Sirach 36:8 In wrath of fire let the survivor be devoured, and may those afflicting your people find destruction.
Sirach 36:9 Shatter the heads of hostile rulers who say, There is none except us.
Sirach 36:10 Gather all the tribes of Iakob and give them an inheritance as from the beginning.
Sirach 36:11 Have mercy, Lord, on a people called by your name and Israel, whom you likened to a firstborn.
Sirach 36:12 Have pity on the city of your sanctuary, Ierusalem, the place of your rest;
Sirach 36:13 fill Sion with the recounting of your virtues, and your people from your glory.
Sirach 36:14 Give testimony to your creatures in the beginning, and raise up prophecies in your name;
Sirach 36:15 give a reward to those awaiting you, and let your prophets be found trustworthy.
Sirach 36:16 Listen, Lord, to the supplication of your petitioners according to Aaron's blessing concerning your people,
Sirach 36:17 and all those upon the earth will know that you are the Lord, the God of the ages.
Sirach 36:18 A belly will eat every food, but there is food better than food.
Sirach 36:19 A throat tastes foods of the hunt, so an understanding heart false words.
Sirach 36:20 A twisted heart will give grief, and a person of abundant experience will repay him.
Sirach 36:21 A woman will accept every male, but there is a daughter better than a daughter.
Sirach 36:22 A woman's beauty makes a face cheerful and surpasses every human desire;
Sirach 36:23 if mercy and gentleness are upon her tongue, her husband is not like sons of human beings.
Sirach 36:24 He who acquires a wife begins a possession, a helper corresponding to him and a pillar of rest.
Sirach 36:25 Where there is no fence, a possession will be plundered; and where there is no wife, he will sigh as he wanders.
Sirach 36:26 For who will trust a readily equipped robber leaping from city to city?
Sirach 36:27 So with a person not having a nest and lodging wherever evening overtakes him.

## Chapter 37

Sirach 37:1 Every friend will say, I too have befriended; but there is a friend who is a friend in name alone.
Sirach 37:2 Is there not grief even to death in a companion and friend turning into enmity?
Sirach 37:3 O wicked thought, from where were you rolled in to cover the dry land with deceit?
Sirach 37:4 A companion enjoys a friend's gladness, and at a time of affliction will be opposite him;
Sirach 37:5 a companion labors with a friend for the sake of his belly; before war he will take a shield.
Sirach 37:6 Do not forget a friend in your soul, and do not fail to remember him in your wealth.
Sirach 37:7 Every counselor extols counsel, but there is one counseling for himself.
Sirach 37:8 Guard your soul against a counselor, and know first what his need is – for he too will counsel for himself – , lest he cast a lot against you
Sirach 37:9 and say to you, Your way is good, and stand on the opposite side to see what will happen to you.
Sirach 37:10 Do not take counsel with him who looks askance at you, and hide counsel from those who envy you,
Sirach 37:11 with a woman about her rival and with a coward about war, with a merchant about exchange and with a buyer about selling, with a grudging person about thankfulness and with a merciless person about kindness, with a sluggard about any work and with an annual hired worker about completion, with an idle household servant about much work; do not attend to these for any counsel;
Sirach 37:12 but remain continually with a pious man whom you know to keep commandments, who in his soul is according to your soul, and if you stumble, he will suffer pain with you.
Sirach 37:13 And establish counsel of heart, for there is none more faithful to you than it;
Sirach 37:14 for a man's soul has sometimes been accustomed to report more than seven watchers sitting on a height at a lookout.
Sirach 37:15 And over all these things make supplication to the Most High, that he may direct your way in truth.
Sirach 37:16 The beginning of every work is a word, and before every action is counsel.
Sirach 37:17 A trace of change of heart causes four parts to spring up,
Sirach 37:18 good and evil, life and death, and that which continually rules them is a tongue.
Sirach 37:19 There is a skillful man, an instructor of many, and for his own soul he is useless.
Sirach 37:20 There is one showing wisdom in words who is hated; this one will lack all food;
Sirach 37:21 for grace was not given him from the Lord, because he was deprived of all wisdom.
Sirach 37:22 There is one wise for his own soul, and the fruits of his understanding are faithful upon his mouth.
Sirach 37:23 A wise man will discipline his own people, and the fruits of his understanding are faithful.
Sirach 37:24 A wise man will be filled with blessing, and all who see will call him blessed.
Sirach 37:25 A man's life is in a number of days, and the days of Israel are without number.
Sirach 37:26 The wise will inherit trust among his people, and his name will live into the age.
Sirach 37:27 Child, in your life test your soul, and see what is evil for it and do not give it that;
Sirach 37:28 for not all things benefit all, and not every soul takes pleasure in everything.
Sirach 37:29 Do not be insatiable in every luxury, and do not pour yourself out upon dishes;
Sirach 37:30 for in many foods there will be disease, and insatiability will draw near as far as cholera;
Sirach 37:31 through insatiability many died, but he who takes heed will add life.

## Chapter 38

Sirach 38:1 Honor a physician according to his services with his honors, for the Lord created him too;
Sirach 38:2 for healing is from the Most High, and from a king he will receive a gift.
Sirach 38:3 A physician's knowledge will raise his head, and before great men he will be admired.
Sirach 38:4 The Lord created medicines from earth, and a prudent man will not be offended at them.
Sirach 38:5 Was water not sweetened by wood, that his strength might be known?
Sirach 38:6 And he gave human beings knowledge, to be glorified in his wonders;
Sirach 38:7 with them he healed and removed his pain; a perfumer will make a mixture with these,
Sirach 38:8 and his works will certainly not be finished, and peace from him is upon the face of the earth.
Sirach 38:9 Child, in your sickness do not be neglectful, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you;
Sirach 38:10 remove transgression and straighten your hands and cleanse your heart from every sin;
Sirach 38:11 give fragrance and a memorial of fine flour, and fatten an offering as one who does not exist.
Sirach 38:12 And give a physician a place, for the Lord created him too, and let him not depart from you, for there is need of him too.
Sirach 38:13 There is a time when success too is in their hands;
Sirach 38:14 for they too will make supplication to the Lord, that he may grant them success in rest and healing for the sake of livelihood.
Sirach 38:15 May he who sins before him who made him fall into a physician's hands.
Sirach 38:16 Child, over a dead person bring down tears, and as one suffering terrible things begin a lament; and according to his due wrap up his body and do not overlook his burial.
Sirach 38:17 Make weeping bitter and mourning fervent, and perform the mourning according to his worth, one day and two, for the sake of slander, and be comforted because of grief;
Sirach 38:18 for from grief death comes forth, and grief of heart will bend strength.
Sirach 38:19 In affliction grief too remains, and a poor person's life is against the heart.
Sirach 38:20 Do not give your heart to grief; remove it, remembering the last things;
Sirach 38:21 do not forget, for there is no return, and you will not benefit this one, and you will harm yourself.
Sirach 38:22 Remember my judgment, because yours too is so; yesterday for me and today for you.
Sirach 38:23 At a dead person's rest give rest to his remembrance, and be comforted concerning him at the departure of his spirit.
Sirach 38:24 A scribe's wisdom is in the opportunity of leisure, and he who is lessened in his business will become wise.
Sirach 38:25 How will he become wise who holds a plow and boasts in the shaft of a goad, driving oxen and occupied with their works, and whose discourse is about sons of bulls?
Sirach 38:26 He will give his heart to producing furrows, and his wakefulness is for fodder for heifers.
Sirach 38:27 So is every artisan and master artisan, who passes night as day; those engraving engravings of seals, and his persistence is to vary the design; he will give his heart to making a painting resemble, and his wakefulness is to finish a work.
Sirach 38:28 So is a smith sitting near an anvil and studying works of iron; vapor of fire will melt his flesh, and in the heat of a furnace he will struggle; to the sound of a hammer he will incline his ear, and opposite the likeness of a vessel are his eyes; he will give his heart to completing works, and his wakefulness is to adorn at completion.
Sirach 38:29 So is a potter sitting at his work and turning a wheel with his feet, who continually lies in care over his work, and all his labor is by number;
Sirach 38:30 with his arm he will shape clay, and before his feet he will bend his strength; he will give his heart to finishing the glaze, and his wakefulness is to clean a furnace.
Sirach 38:31 All these trusted in their hands, and each shows wisdom in his work;
Sirach 38:32 without them a city will not be inhabited, and they will not sojourn or walk about.
Sirach 38:33 But for a council of the people they will not be sought, and in an assembly they will not leap forward; on a judge's seat they will not sit, and a covenant of judgment they will not consider.
Sirach 38:34 Nor will they manifest discipline and judgment, and in parables they will not be found, but they will support the creation of an age, and their supplication is in the work of their craft.

## Chapter 39

Sirach 39:1 Except for him who gives his soul and considers the law of the Most High, he will seek out the wisdom of all the ancients and be occupied with prophecies,
Sirach 39:2 he will preserve the discourse of renowned men and enter together into the turns of parables,
Sirach 39:3 he will seek out hidden things of proverbs and be occupied with riddles of parables.
Sirach 39:4 Among great men he will serve and before leaders he will appear; in the land of foreign nations he will pass, for he tested good and evil things among human beings.
Sirach 39:5 He will give his heart to rising early toward the Lord who made him and make supplication before the Most High; and he will open his mouth in prayer and make supplication concerning his sins.
Sirach 39:6 If the great Lord wills, he will be filled with a spirit of understanding; he will rain down utterances of his wisdom and in prayer confess to the Lord;
Sirach 39:7 he will direct his counsel and knowledge and consider his hidden things;
Sirach 39:8 he will manifest the discipline of his teaching and boast in the law of the Lord's covenant.
Sirach 39:9 Many will praise his understanding, and until the age it will not be erased; his remembrance will not depart, and his name will live for generations of generations;
Sirach 39:10 nations will recount his wisdom, and an assembly will proclaim his praise;
Sirach 39:11 if he remains, he will leave a name greater than a thousand, and if he rests, he makes it for himself.
Sirach 39:12 Still, having considered, I will recount, and like the full moon I was filled.
Sirach 39:13 Listen to me, holy sons, and sprout like a rose growing by a stream of water
Sirach 39:14 and like frankincense give a fragrant scent and blossom a blossom like a lily. Spread a scent and praise with a song, bless the Lord over all the works,
Sirach 39:15 give greatness to his name and confess in his praise with songs of lips and with lyres, and thus you will say in confession:
Sirach 39:16 All the works of the Lord are exceedingly good, and every command will be in its time; one cannot say, What is this? For what is this? For all things will be sought in their time.
Sirach 39:17 At his word water stood like a heap, and at the utterance of his mouth reservoirs of waters.
Sirach 39:18 In his command is all pleasure, and there is none who will diminish his salvation.
Sirach 39:19 The works of all flesh are before him, and one cannot be hidden from his eyes;
Sirach 39:20 from the age to the age he looked, and nothing is wondrous before him.
Sirach 39:21 One cannot say, What is this? For what is this? For all things have been created for their uses.
Sirach 39:22 His blessing covered like a river and drenched dry land like a flood;
Sirach 39:23 so nations will inherit his wrath, as he turned waters into brine.
Sirach 39:24 His ways are straight for the holy, so for the lawless stumbling blocks;
Sirach 39:25 good things have been created for the good from the beginning, so for sinners evil things.
Sirach 39:26 The beginning of every need for a person's life: water and fire and iron and salt and fine wheat flour and milk and honey, blood of a grape and oil and clothing;
Sirach 39:27 all these are for good things for the pious, so for sinners they will turn into evil things.
Sirach 39:28 There are spirits which have been created for vengeance, and in his fury he strengthened their scourges; at the time of completion they will pour out strength and abate the fury of him who made them.
Sirach 39:29 Fire and hail and famine and death, all these have been created for vengeance;
Sirach 39:30 teeth of beasts and scorpions and vipers and a sword avenging the ungodly to destruction;
Sirach 39:31 in his command they will rejoice, and upon the earth they will be prepared for uses, and in their times they will not transgress a word.
Sirach 39:32 For this reason from the beginning I was established and considered and left in writing:
Sirach 39:33 All the works of the Lord are good, and he will supply every need in its hour,
Sirach 39:34 and one cannot say, This is more evil than that, for all things will be approved in their time.
Sirach 39:35 And now with all heart and mouth sing hymns and bless the Lord's name.

## Chapter 40

Sirach 40:1 Great occupation has been created for every person, and a heavy yoke upon the sons of Adam from the day of departure from their mother's womb until the day of return to the mother of all;
Sirach 40:2 their deliberations and fear of heart, thought of expectation, the day of death.
Sirach 40:3 From one sitting upon a glorious throne even to one humbled in earth and ashes,
Sirach 40:4 from one wearing violet and a crown even to one clothed in raw linen, fury and jealousy and trouble and tumult and fear of death and resentment and strife.
Sirach 40:5 And at the time of rest upon a bed, sleep of night alters his knowledge;
Sirach 40:6 a little, as nothing, in rest, and after that in dreams, as on a day of watching, troubled in the vision of his heart, as one who has escaped from before war;
Sirach 40:7 at the time of his need he awoke, and was astonished at no fear.
Sirach 40:8 With all flesh, from human being to beast, and upon sinners sevenfold beyond these;
Sirach 40:9 death and blood and strife and sword, afflictions, famine and crushing and scourge.
Sirach 40:10 Against the lawless all these were created, and because of them the flood occurred.
Sirach 40:11 All things which are from earth return to earth, and those from waters turn back to the sea.
Sirach 40:12 Every gift and injustice will be erased, and faithfulness will stand into the age.
Sirach 40:13 The money of the unjust will dry up like a river and resound like great thunder in rain;
Sirach 40:14 when he opens hands he will rejoice; so those transgressing will cease utterly.
Sirach 40:15 Offspring of the ungodly will not multiply branches, and unclean roots are upon a sheer rock;
Sirach 40:16 reed grass beside every water and river bank will be plucked out before every grass.
Sirach 40:17 Grace is like a garden amid blessings, and almsgiving will remain into the age.
Sirach 40:18 The life of a self-sufficient person and a worker will be sweetened, and above both is he who finds a treasure.
Sirach 40:19 Children and building a city establish a name, and above both a blameless wife is reckoned.
Sirach 40:20 Wine and music gladden a heart, and above both is love of wisdom.
Sirach 40:21 A flute and a harp sweeten melodies, and above both is a pleasant tongue.
Sirach 40:22 An eye will desire grace and beauty, and above both the greenness of a crop.
Sirach 40:23 A friend and companion meeting at the time, and above both a wife with a husband.
Sirach 40:24 Brothers and help are for a time of affliction, and above both almsgiving will rescue.
Sirach 40:25 Gold and silver will establish a foot, and above both counsel is approved.
Sirach 40:26 Money and strength will raise a heart, and above both is fear of the Lord; there is no diminution in fear of the Lord, and there is no need to seek help in it;
Sirach 40:27 fear of the Lord is like a garden of blessing, and above all glory it covered him.
Sirach 40:28 Child, do not live a life of begging; it is better to die than to beg.
Sirach 40:29 A man looking to a stranger's table, his existence is not in the reckoning of life; he will defile his soul with strangers' foods; but a knowledgeable and disciplined man will guard himself.
Sirach 40:30 In a shameless person's mouth begging will be sweetened, and in his belly fire will burn.

## Chapter 41

Sirach 41:1 O death, how bitter your remembrance is to a person at peace in his possessions, to a man undistracted and prospering in all things and still strong enough to receive food.
Sirach 41:2 O death, good is your judgment for a person needy and diminishing in strength, extremely aged and distracted about everything and disobedient and having lost endurance.
Sirach 41:3 Do not be apprehensive of death's judgment; remember those before you and those after;
Sirach 41:4 this is the judgment from the Lord for all flesh, and why do you refuse the pleasure of the Most High? Whether ten or a hundred or a thousand years, there is no reproof of life in Hades.
Sirach 41:5 Children of sinners become abominable children, and those associating with the dwellings of the ungodly;
Sirach 41:6 the inheritance of sinners' children will perish, and with their seed reproach will remain continually.
Sirach 41:7 Children will blame an ungodly father, because through him they will be reproached.
Sirach 41:8 Woe to you, ungodly men, who abandoned the law of God Most High;
Sirach 41:9 and if you are born, you will be born for a curse, and if you die, you will be allotted to a curse.
Sirach 41:10 All things which are from earth will go away to earth, so the ungodly from a curse to destruction.
Sirach 41:11 The mourning of human beings is in their bodies, but the name of sinners, not good, will be erased.
Sirach 41:12 Care about a name, for it will remain for you more than a thousand great treasures of gold;
Sirach 41:13 of a good life there is a number of days, and a good name will remain into an age.
Sirach 41:14 Keep discipline in peace, children; but hidden wisdom and unseen treasure, what benefit is in both?
Sirach 41:15 Better is a person hiding his folly than a person hiding his wisdom.
Sirach 41:16 Therefore be ashamed at my utterance; for it is not good to preserve every shame, and not all things are approved by all in faithfulness.
Sirach 41:17 Be ashamed before father and mother concerning prostitution, and before leader and ruler concerning falsehood,
Sirach 41:18 before judge and ruler concerning transgression, and before congregation and people concerning lawlessness,
Sirach 41:19 before partner and friend concerning injustice, and before the place where you sojourn concerning theft,
Sirach 41:20 before God's truth and covenant, and for planting an elbow over bread,
Sirach 41:21 for contempt of receiving and giving, and before those greeting you concerning silence,
Sirach 41:22 for looking at a courtesan, and for turning away a relative's face,
Sirach 41:23 for taking away a portion and a gift, and for observing a married woman,
Sirach 41:24 for meddling with his maidservant, and do not stand over her bed,
Sirach 41:25 before friends concerning words of reproach, and after giving do not reproach,
Sirach 41:26 for repeating also a word heard, and for uncovering secret words;
Sirach 41:27 and you will be truly modest and find favor before every person.

## Chapter 42

Sirach 42:1 Do not be ashamed concerning these things, and do not show partiality so as to sin:
Sirach 42:2 concerning the law of the Most High and covenant, and concerning judgment to justify the ungodly,
Sirach 42:3 concerning a partner's and travelers' word, and concerning giving an inheritance to companions,
Sirach 42:4 concerning the exactness of a balance and weights, and concerning acquiring many things and few,
Sirach 42:5 concerning profit from merchants' selling, and concerning much discipline of children, and making a wicked household servant's side bleed;
Sirach 42:6 over a wicked woman a seal is good, and where hands are many, lock up;
Sirach 42:7 whatever you hand over, do so by number and weight, and giving and receiving, everything in writing;
Sirach 42:8 concerning discipline of an unthinking person and a fool and an extremely aged person disputing with young people; and you will be truly disciplined and approved before every living being.
Sirach 42:9 A daughter is hidden wakefulness for a father, and care for her removes sleep; in her youth, lest she pass her prime, and when married, lest she be hated;
Sirach 42:10 in virginity, lest she be profaned and become pregnant in her father's house; being with a husband, lest she transgress, and when married, lest she become barren.
Sirach 42:11 Over an unrestrained daughter strengthen your guard, lest she make you a delight for enemies, talk in a city and an outcast of the people, and shame you in a multitude of many.
Sirach 42:12 Do not look at any person for beauty, and do not sit together in the midst of women;
Sirach 42:13 for from garments a moth comes forth, and from a woman a woman's wickedness.
Sirach 42:14 Better is a man's wickedness than a beneficent woman, and a woman shaming to reproach.
Sirach 42:15 I will now remember the Lord's works, and what I have seen I will recount; in the Lord's words are his works.
Sirach 42:16 The sun, illuminating, looked upon everything, and his work is full of the Lord's glory.
Sirach 42:17 He did not enable the Lord's holy ones to recount all his wonders, which the Lord Almighty established for the whole to be supported in his glory.
Sirach 42:18 Abyss and heart he traced out, and their cunning devices he considered; for the Most High knew every knowledge and looked into the sign of an age,
Sirach 42:19 reporting the things that have passed and the things that will be, and revealing traces of hidden things;
Sirach 42:20 No thought escaped him; not even one word was hidden from him.
Sirach 42:21 He adorned the great things of his wisdom, as he is before the age and into the age; neither was he added to nor diminished, and he needed no counselor.
Sirach 42:22 How desirable are all his works, and one can behold them as a spark;
Sirach 42:23 all these live and remain into the age for all uses, and all obey.
Sirach 42:24 All things are double, one opposite the other, and he made nothing deficient;
Sirach 42:25 one established the other's good things, and who will be filled looking upon his glory?

## Chapter 43

Sirach 43:1 The pride of height is a firmament of purity, the appearance of heaven in a vision of glory.
Sirach 43:2 The sun, at its appearance proclaiming at its departure, is a wondrous vessel, a work of the Most High;
Sirach 43:3 at its midday it dries up a country, and before its burning heat who will withstand?
Sirach 43:4 One blowing a furnace is amid works of burning heat, the sun threefold, burning mountains; blowing out fiery vapors and flashing rays, it dims eyes.
Sirach 43:5 Great is the Lord who made it, and at his words it hastened its course.
Sirach 43:6 And the moon in all things is for its time, a showing of times and a sign of an age;
Sirach 43:7 from the moon is the sign of a festival, a luminary diminishing to completion.
Sirach 43:8 A month is according to its name, increasing wondrously in change, a vessel of encampments on high, shining in the firmament of heaven.
Sirach 43:9 The beauty of heaven is the glory of stars, an ornament illuminating in the Lord's heights;
Sirach 43:10 at the words of a holy one they will stand according to judgment and certainly not slacken in their watches.
Sirach 43:11 See a bow and bless him who made it exceedingly beautiful in its radiance;
Sirach 43:12 it encircled heaven in a circuit of glory; hands of the Most High stretched it.
Sirach 43:13 By his command he hastened snow, and he speeds the lightnings of his judgment;
Sirach 43:14 for this reason treasuries were opened, and clouds flew out like birds;
Sirach 43:15 by his greatness he strengthened clouds, and hailstones were shattered;
Sirach 43:16 and at his appearance mountains will be shaken; at his will a south wind will blow.
Sirach 43:17 The voice of his thunder reproached earth, and a storm of the north and a whirlwind.
Sirach 43:18 Like birds flying down he sprinkles snow, and like a locust settling is its descent; an eye will marvel at the beauty of its whiteness, and a heart will be astounded at its falling.
Sirach 43:19 And frost like salt he pours upon earth, and when frozen it becomes points of stakes.
Sirach 43:20 A cold north wind will blow, and ice will freeze upon water; upon every gathering of water it will settle, and the water will put it on like a breastplate.
Sirach 43:21 It will devour mountains and burn a wilderness and quench green grass like fire.
Sirach 43:22 Healing of all things speedily is mist; dew meeting it will bring cheer from scorching heat.
Sirach 43:23 By his reasoning he stilled an abyss and planted islands in it.
Sirach 43:24 Those sailing the sea recount its danger, and at the hearing of our ears we marvel;
Sirach 43:25 and there are extraordinary and wondrous works, the variety of every living creature, the creation of sea monsters.
Sirach 43:26 Because of him his messenger prospers, and at his word all things are held together.
Sirach 43:27 We will say many things and certainly not reach the end, and the conclusion of words is, He is the whole.
Sirach 43:28 Glorifying, where will we have strength? For he is great beyond all his works.
Sirach 43:29 Fearsome is the Lord and exceedingly great, and wondrous is his might.
Sirach 43:30 Glorifying the Lord, exalt him as much as you can, for he will surpass even still; and exalting him, increase in strength; do not grow weary, for you will certainly not reach him.
Sirach 43:31 Who has seen him and will recount? And who will magnify him as he is?
Sirach 43:32 Many hidden things are greater than these, for we have seen few of his works;
Sirach 43:33 for the Lord made all things and gave wisdom to the pious.

## Chapter 44

Sirach 44:1 Let us now praise glorious men and our fathers by descent;
Sirach 44:2 the Lord created much glory, his greatness from an age.
Sirach 44:3 Those ruling in their kingdoms and men renowned in power; those counseling in their understanding, those reporting in prophecies;
Sirach 44:4 leaders of a people in counsels and in understanding of the people's writing, wise words in their discipline;
Sirach 44:5 those seeking out melodies of musicians and recounting verses in writing;
Sirach 44:6 rich men supplied with strength, at peace in their dwellings;
Sirach 44:7 all these were glorified in generations, and in their days were a boast.
Sirach 44:8 There are some of them who left a name for the recounting of praises;
Sirach 44:9 and there are those of whom there is no remembrance, and they perished as though they had not existed and became as though they had not come to be, and their children after them.
Sirach 44:10 But these are men of mercy, whose righteous deeds were not forgotten;
Sirach 44:11 with their seed it will remain, their descendants a good inheritance;
Sirach 44:12 in the covenants their seed stood, and their children because of them;
Sirach 44:13 until an age their seed will remain, and their glory will not be erased;
Sirach 44:14 their bodies were buried in peace, and their name lives for generations;
Sirach 44:15 peoples will recount their wisdom, and an assembly proclaims their praise.
Sirach 44:16 Enoch pleased the Lord and was transferred, an example of repentance for the generations.
Sirach 44:17 Noe was found perfect, righteous; at a time of wrath he became an exchange; through him a remnant came to be for the earth when a flood occurred;
Sirach 44:18 covenants of an age were established with him, that all flesh might not be erased by a flood.
Sirach 44:19 Abraam is a great father of a multitude of nations, and none was found like him in glory;
Sirach 44:20 who kept the law of the Most High and entered a covenant with him; in his flesh he established a covenant, and in testing he was found faithful;
Sirach 44:21 for this reason by an oath he established for him that nations be blessed in his seed, to multiply him like the dust of the earth and raise his seed like stars and give them an inheritance from sea to sea and from a river to the extremity of the earth.
Sirach 44:22 And in Isaak he established thus because of Abraam his father.
Sirach 44:23 The blessing of all human beings and a covenant he caused to rest upon Iakob's head; he recognized him in his blessings and gave to him as an inheritance; and he distinguished his portions, among twelve tribes he divided them.

## Chapter 45

Sirach 45:1 And from him he brought forth a man of mercy finding favor in the eyes of all flesh, loved by God and human beings, Moyses, whose remembrance is in blessings;
Sirach 45:2 he likened him to the glory of holy ones and magnified him in the fears of enemies;
Sirach 45:3 at his words he made signs cease; he glorified him before the face of kings; he commanded him concerning his people and showed him of his glory;
Sirach 45:4 in faithfulness and gentleness he sanctified him; he chose him from all flesh;
Sirach 45:5 he made him hear his voice and brought him into the gloom and gave him commandments face to face, a law of life and knowledge, to teach Iakob a covenant and Israel his judgments.
Sirach 45:6 Aaron he exalted as a holy one like him, his brother from the tribe of Levi;
Sirach 45:7 he established him as a covenant of an age and gave him the priesthood of a people; he made him blessed in adornment and girded him with a robe of glory;
Sirach 45:8 he clothed him with the perfection of boasting and strengthened him with instruments of strength, breeches and a robe reaching to the feet and a shoulder garment;
Sirach 45:9 and he encircled him with little pomegranates, with very many golden bells all around, to sound a voice in his steps, to make a sound audible in a temple as a remembrance for sons of his people;
Sirach 45:10 with a holy robe, gold and violet and purple, the work of an embroiderer, an oracle of judgment, manifestations of truth, with spun scarlet, an artisan's work,
Sirach 45:11 with costly stones of seal engraving in a gold setting, a stone worker's work, for a remembrance in an engraved inscription according to the number of tribes of Israel;
Sirach 45:12 a golden crown above a turban, an impression of a seal of holiness, a boast of honor, a work of strength, adorned objects of desire for eyes;
Sirach 45:13 before him such beautiful things had not come to be; until an age no one of another race put them on except his sons alone and his descendants continually.
Sirach 45:14 His sacrifices will be offered wholly, continually twice each day.
Sirach 45:15 Moyses filled his hands and anointed him with holy oil; it became for him a covenant of an age, and for his seed in the days of heaven, to minister to him and also serve as priest and bless his people in the name.
Sirach 45:16 He chose him from every living being to bring an offering to the Lord, incense and fragrance for a remembrance, to make atonement for your people.
Sirach 45:17 He gave him authority in his commandments, in covenants of judgments, to teach Iakob the testimonies and illuminate Israel in his law.
Sirach 45:18 Strangers banded together against him and envied him in the wilderness, the men around Dathan and Abiron and the congregation of Kore, in fury and wrath;
Sirach 45:19 the Lord saw and did not take pleasure, and they were brought to an end in fury of wrath; he did portents to them, to consume them in the fire of his flame.
Sirach 45:20 And he added glory to Aaron and gave him an inheritance; firstfruits of first produce he allotted him, bread among the first he prepared as a fullness;
Sirach 45:21 for they too will eat the Lord's sacrifices, which he gave both to him and to his seed.
Sirach 45:22 But in the people's land he will not inherit, and he has no portion among the people; for he himself is your portion and inheritance.
Sirach 45:23 And Phinees son of Eleazar is third in glory, in his being zealous in fear of the Lord and his standing at the people's turning in the goodness of his soul's readiness; and he made atonement for Israel.
Sirach 45:24 For this reason a covenant of peace was established for him, to preside over holy things and his people, that for him and his seed there might be the greatness of priesthood into the ages.
Sirach 45:25 And a covenant for David son of Iessai from the tribe of Iouda, an inheritance of a king, son from son alone; Aaron's inheritance is also for his seed.
Sirach 45:26 May he give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things may not vanish, and their glory for their generations.

## Chapter 46

Sirach 46:1 Mighty in war is Iesous of Naue, and a successor of Moyses in prophecies, who became, according to his name, great for the salvation of his chosen ones, to take vengeance upon enemies rising up, so as to give Israel an inheritance.
Sirach 46:2 How he was glorified in raising his hands and stretching out a sword against cities.
Sirach 46:3 Who before him stood thus? For he brought on the Lord's wars.
Sirach 46:4 Was not the sun hindered by his hand, and did not one day become as two?
Sirach 46:5 He called upon the Most High ruler when enemies pressed him all around, and the great Lord listened to him with hailstones of mighty power;
Sirach 46:6 he dashed war down upon a nation and at the descent destroyed those resisting, that nations might know his full armor, because his war is before the Lord.
Sirach 46:7 For he too followed after the ruler and in the days of Moyses did mercy, he and Chaleb son of Iephonne, to resist before an assembly, to restrain a people from sin and abate murmuring of wickedness.
Sirach 46:8 And they, being two, were preserved out of six hundred thousand foot soldiers, to bring them into an inheritance, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
Sirach 46:9 And the Lord gave Chaleb strength, and until old age it remained with him, for him to mount the height of the land, and his seed held an inheritance,
Sirach 46:10 so that all the sons of Israel might see that it is good to walk after the Lord.
Sirach 46:11 And the judges, each by his own name, whose heart did not prostitute itself and who did not turn away from the Lord, may their remembrance be in blessings;
Sirach 46:12 may their bones bloom again from their place, and their name be exchanged anew upon sons of those glorified among them.
Sirach 46:13 Loved by his Lord, Samouel, a prophet of the Lord, established a kingdom and anointed rulers over his people;
Sirach 46:14 by the Lord's law he judged a congregation, and the Lord inspected Iakob;
Sirach 46:15 in his faithfulness he was proven exact as a prophet, and in his utterances he was known as faithful in vision.
Sirach 46:16 And he called upon the Lord, the ruler, when his enemies pressed all around, with the offering of a suckling lamb;
Sirach 46:17 and the Lord thundered from heaven and with a great sound made his voice audible
Sirach 46:18 and wiped out leaders of Tyrians and all rulers of Phylistiim.
Sirach 46:19 And before the time of sleep of an age he testified before the Lord and his anointed, Money and even sandals I have not taken from any flesh; and no person accused him.
Sirach 46:20 And after falling asleep he prophesied and showed a king his death and raised his voice from earth in prophecy, to erase a people's lawlessness.

## Chapter 47

Sirach 47:1 And after him Nathan arose to prophesy in the days of David.
Sirach 47:2 As fat separated from a salvation offering, so was David from the sons of Israel.
Sirach 47:3 With lions he played as with young goats, and with bears as with lambs of sheep.
Sirach 47:4 In his youth did he not kill a giant and remove reproach from a people by raising a hand with a sling stone and casting down Goliath's pride?
Sirach 47:5 For he called upon the Lord Most High, and he gave strength in his right hand to remove a person powerful in war, to raise the horn of his people.
Sirach 47:6 Thus with myriads they glorified him and praised him with the Lord's blessings, when a diadem of glory was brought to him;
Sirach 47:7 for he wiped out enemies all around and brought to nothing the hostile Phylistiim; until today he shattered their horn.
Sirach 47:8 In every work of his he gave confession to the holy Most High with an utterance of glory; with all his heart he sang hymns and loved him who made him.
Sirach 47:9 And he established psalm singers opposite the altar, and from their sound to sweeten melodies;
Sirach 47:10 he gave festivals comeliness and adorned seasons to completion, in their praising his holy name and the sanctuary sounding from morning.
Sirach 47:11 The Lord took away his sins and raised his horn into an age and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.
Sirach 47:12 After him a knowledgeable son arose, and because of him he lodged in spaciousness;
Sirach 47:13 Salomon reigned in days of peace, for whom God gave rest all around, that he might establish a house in his name and prepare a sanctuary into the age.
Sirach 47:14 How you were made wise in your youth and filled like a river with understanding.
Sirach 47:15 Your soul covered earth, and you filled it with parables of riddles;
Sirach 47:16 to distant islands your name reached, and you were loved in your peace;
Sirach 47:17 in songs and proverbs and parables and interpretations countries marveled at you.
Sirach 47:18 In the name of the Lord God, called the God of Israel, you gathered gold like tin and multiplied silver like lead.
Sirach 47:19 You inclined your loins to women, and you were ruled in your body;
Sirach 47:20 you put a blemish on your glory and profaned your seed, to bring wrath upon your children and be pierced at your senselessness,
Sirach 47:21 for the sovereignty to become divided and from Ephraim to rule a disobedient kingdom.
Sirach 47:22 But the Lord will certainly not abandon his mercy and will certainly not destroy any of his words, nor erase his chosen one's offspring, and the seed of him who loved him he will certainly not remove; and to Iakob he gave a remnant, and to David a root from him.
Sirach 47:23 And Salomon rested with his fathers and left after him from his seed the people's senselessness, and Roboam, deficient in understanding, who made a people revolt by his counsel.
Sirach 47:24 And Ieroboam son of Nabat, who caused Israel to sin and gave Ephraim a way of sin; and their sins increased exceedingly, to remove them from their land;
Sirach 47:25 and they sought out every wickedness until vengeance came upon them.

## Chapter 48

Sirach 48:1 And Elias arose, a prophet like fire, and his word burned like a torch;
Sirach 48:2 who brought famine upon them and by his zeal made them few;
Sirach 48:3 by the Lord's word he held back heaven; thus he brought down fire three times.
Sirach 48:4 How you were glorified, Elias, in your wonders; and who is like you in boasting?
Sirach 48:5 He who raised a dead person from death and from Hades by the word of the Most High;
Sirach 48:6 he who brought down kings to destruction and honored ones from their bed;
Sirach 48:7 hearing reproof at Sina and judgments of vengeance at Choreb;
Sirach 48:8 he who anoints kings for repayment and prophets as successors after him;
Sirach 48:9 he who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, in a chariot of fiery horses;
Sirach 48:10 he who was recorded in reproofs for times, to abate wrath before fury, to turn a father's heart toward a son and establish the tribes of Iakob.
Sirach 48:11 Blessed are those who saw you and those who have fallen asleep in love; for we too will surely live.
Sirach 48:12 Elias, who was sheltered in a whirlwind, and Elisaie was filled with his spirit; and in his days he was not shaken by a ruler, and no one oppressed him.
Sirach 48:13 No word surpassed him, and in sleep his body prophesied;
Sirach 48:14 and in his life he did portents, and at death his works were wonders.
Sirach 48:15 In all these things the people did not repent, and they did not depart from their sins, until they were plundered from their land and dispersed in all the earth.
Sirach 48:16 And the people was left very few, and a ruler in the house of David; some of them did what was pleasing, but some multiplied sins.
Sirach 48:17 Ezekias fortified his city and brought water into its midst; with iron he dug sheer rock and built fountains for waters.
Sirach 48:18 In his days Sennacherim came up and sent Rapsakes, and departed; and he raised his hand against Sion and boasted greatly in his pride.
Sirach 48:19 Then their hearts and hands were shaken, and they suffered labor pains like women giving birth;
Sirach 48:20 and they called upon the merciful Lord, spreading their hands toward him. And the holy one from heaven quickly listened to them and redeemed them by the hand of Esaias;
Sirach 48:21 he struck the camp of the Assyrians, and his angel wiped them out.
Sirach 48:22 For Ezekias did what was pleasing to the Lord and strengthened himself in the ways of David his father, which Esaias commanded, the prophet great and faithful in his vision.
Sirach 48:23 In his days the sun went backward, and he added life to a king.
Sirach 48:24 With a great spirit he saw the last things and comforted those mourning in Sion.
Sirach 48:25 Until the age he showed the things that will be, and hidden things before they came to be.

## Chapter 49

Sirach 49:1 The remembrance of Iosias is like a composition of incense prepared by a perfumer's work; in every mouth it will be sweetened like honey and like music at a drinking party of wine.
Sirach 49:2 He was directed in the turning of a people and removed abominations of lawlessness;
Sirach 49:3 he directed his heart toward the Lord; in days of the lawless he strengthened piety.
Sirach 49:4 Except for David and Ezekias and Iosias, all transgressed a transgression; for they abandoned the law of the Most High; the kings of Iouda ceased;
Sirach 49:5 for they gave their horn to others and their glory to a foreign nation.
Sirach 49:6 They burned a chosen city of a sanctuary and made its ways desolate
Sirach 49:7 by the hand of Ieremias; for they afflicted him, and he was sanctified in the womb as a prophet to uproot and afflict and destroy, likewise to build and plant.
Sirach 49:8 Iezekiel, who saw a vision of glory, which he showed him upon a chariot of cheroubin;
Sirach 49:9 for he too remembered the enemies in a rainstorm, and to do good to those straightening ways.
Sirach 49:10 And may the bones of the twelve prophets bloom again from their place; for they comforted Iakob and redeemed them in faithfulness of hope.
Sirach 49:11 How shall we magnify Zorobabel? He too is like a seal upon a right hand,
Sirach 49:12 so is Iesous son of Iosedek, who in their days built a house and raised a holy temple for the Lord, prepared for glory of an age.
Sirach 49:13 And great is the remembrance of Neemias, who raised for us fallen walls and established gates and bars and rebuilt our house sites.
Sirach 49:14 No one was created upon the earth such as Enoch; for he too was taken up from the earth.
Sirach 49:15 Nor was a man born like Ioseph, a leader of brothers, a support of a people, and his bones were inspected.
Sirach 49:16 Sem and Seth were glorified among human beings, and above every living being in creation was Adam.

## Chapter 50

Sirach 50:1 Simon son of Onias, the great priest, who in his life repaired a house and in his days strengthened a temple;
Sirach 50:2 and by him was founded the height of a double wall, a high support of the temple enclosure;
Sirach 50:3 in his days a reservoir of waters was hewn out, a pit with a circumference like that of a sea;
Sirach 50:4 he who cared for his people against falling and strengthened a city in a siege.
Sirach 50:5 How he was glorified amid the surrounding people, at his departure from the house of the curtain;
Sirach 50:6 like a morning star in the midst of clouds, like a full moon in its days,
Sirach 50:7 like a sun shining upon the temple of the Most High, and like a bow illuminating in clouds of glory,
Sirach 50:8 like a blossom of roses in days of new produce, like lilies at an outlet of water, like a shoot of Lebanon in days of summer,
Sirach 50:9 like fire and frankincense upon a firepan, like a vessel of gold wholly hammered, adorned with every costly stone,
Sirach 50:10 like an olive budding fruits and like a cypress rising into clouds.
Sirach 50:11 When he took up a robe of glory and put on the perfection of boasting, in ascending the holy altar he glorified the enclosure of the sanctuary;
Sirach 50:12 and when he received portions from priests' hands, and himself stood by the hearth of the altar, around him was a crown of brothers like a growth of cedars in Lebanon, and they surrounded him like trunks of palms,
Sirach 50:13 and all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the Lord's offering in their hands before all the assembly of Israel,
Sirach 50:14 and ministering the completion upon altars, to adorn an offering of the Most High Almighty,
Sirach 50:15 he stretched his hand over a libation bowl and poured a libation from the blood of a grape; he poured into the foundations of the altar a fragrant scent for the Most High, king of all.
Sirach 50:16 Then the sons of Aaron cried out; with hammered trumpets they sounded, they made a great voice audible for a remembrance before the Most High;
Sirach 50:17 then all the people together hastened and fell upon their face upon the earth, to worship their Lord, God Almighty, Most High;
Sirach 50:18 and the psalm singers praised with their voices; with very great sound a melody was sweetened;
Sirach 50:19 and the people made supplication to the Lord Most High in prayer before the merciful one, until the Lord's adornment was completed and they finished his ministry.
Sirach 50:20 Then, coming down, he raised his hands over all the assembly of the sons of Israel, to give the Lord's blessing from his lips and boast in his name;
Sirach 50:21 and they repeated their worship to receive the blessing from the Most High.
Sirach 50:22 And now bless the God of all, who does great things everywhere, who raises our days from the womb and deals with us according to his mercy.
