Isaiah 48:13 and my hand founded the earth, and my right hand established heaven; I will call them, and they will stand together
Isaiah 48:14 and all be gathered and hear. Who announced these things to them? Loving you, I did your desire against Babylon, to take away the seed of the Chaldeans.
Isaiah 48:15 I spoke, I called, I brought him and prospered his way.
Isaiah 48:16 Draw near to me and hear these things; from the beginning I did not speak in secret or in a dark place of earth; when it happened, I was there, and now the Lord has sent me, and his spirit.
Isaiah 48:17 Thus says the Lord who rescued you, the Holy One of Israel, I am your God; I have shown you so that you may find the way in which you will go.
Isaiah 48:18 And if you had heard my commands, your peace would have become like a river and your righteousness like a wave of the sea;
Isaiah 48:19 and your seed would have become like the sand and the offspring of your womb like the dust of the earth; nor will you even now be destroyed, nor will your name perish before me.
Isaiah 48:20 Come out of Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans; announce a voice of gladness, and let this become audible; announce as far as the furthest part of the earth; say, The Lord rescued his slave Iakob.
Isaiah 48:21 And if they thirst, he will lead them through a desert; he will bring out water from a rock for them; a rock will be split, and water will flow, and my people will drink.
Isaiah 48:22 There is no rejoicing for the impious, says the Lord.

## Chapter 49

Isaiah 49:1 Hear me, islands, and pay attention, nations; after a long time it will stand, says the Lord. From my mother's womb he called my name
Isaiah 49:2 and made my mouth like a sharp sword, and under the shelter of his hand he hid me; he made me like a chosen arrow and sheltered me in his quiver.
Isaiah 49:3 And he said to me, You are my slave, Israel, and in you I will be glorified.
Isaiah 49:4 And I said, I labored emptily and gave my strength to vanity and nothing; therefore my judgment is with the Lord, and my toil before my God.
Isaiah 49:5 And now thus says the Lord who formed me from the womb as a slave for himself, to gather Iakob and Israel to him—I will be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God will be my strength—
Isaiah 49:6 and he said to me, It is great for you to be called my servant, to establish the tribes of Iakob and turn back the dispersion of Israel; behold, I have made you a covenant of a race, a light of nations, so that you may be salvation as far as the furthest part of the earth.
Isaiah 49:7 Thus says the Lord who rescued you, the God of Israel, Sanctify the one despising his soul, the one abhorred by the nations of the slaves of the rulers; kings will see him and rise, and rulers will worship him for the sake of the Lord; because the Holy One of Israel is faithful, and I chose you.
Isaiah 49:8 Thus says the Lord, At an acceptable time I listened to you, and on a day of salvation I helped you and gave you for a covenant of nations, to establish the earth and inherit an inheritance of a desert,
Isaiah 49:9 saying to those in bonds, Come out, and to those in darkness to be uncovered. And on all their ways they will graze, and on all the paths will be their pasture;
Isaiah 49:10 they will not hunger or thirst, nor will scorching heat or the sun strike them, but the one having mercy on them will comfort and lead them through springs of waters;
Isaiah 49:11 and I will make every mountain a way and every path a pasture for them.
Isaiah 49:12 Behold, these come from far away, these from the north and these from the sea, and others from the land of the Persians.
Isaiah 49:13 Be glad, heavens, and let the earth exult; let the mountains burst forth gladness and the hills righteousness, because God had mercy on his people and comforted the humble of his people.
Isaiah 49:14 But Sion said, The Lord abandoned me, and the Lord forgot me.
Isaiah 49:15 Will a woman forget her child, so as not to have mercy on the offspring of her womb? But even if a woman should forget these, I will not forget you, said the Lord.
Isaiah 49:16 Behold, upon my hands I painted your walls, and you are before me continually;
Isaiah 49:17 and quickly you will be built by those by whom you were pulled down, and those desolating you will come out of you.
Isaiah 49:18 Lift your eyes around and see all; behold, they were gathered and came to you; I live, says the Lord, that you will put on all of them and put them around you like a bride's adornment.
Isaiah 49:19 Because your deserted places and the destroyed and fallen things will now be cramped because of those dwelling, and those swallowing you will be far removed from you.
Isaiah 49:20 For your sons whom you lost will say into your ears, The place is narrow for me; make a place for me so that I may dwell.
Isaiah 49:21 And you will say in your heart, Who begot these for me? But I am childless and a widow, and who reared these for me? But I was left alone, and where were these for me?
Isaiah 49:22 Thus says the Lord, Behold, I lift my hand to the nations and will raise my signal to the islands, and they will bring your sons in a bosom and lift your daughters upon shoulders,
Isaiah 49:23 and kings will be your fosterers and ruling women your nurses; upon the face of the earth they will worship you and lick the dust of your feet; and you will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.
Isaiah 49:24 Will someone take spoils from a giant? And if someone takes captive unjustly, will he be saved?
Isaiah 49:25 Thus says the Lord, If someone takes a giant captive, he will take spoils; and taking from a strong one, he will be saved; but I will judge your judgment, and I will rescue your sons;
Isaiah 49:26 and those who afflicted you will eat their flesh and drink their blood like new wine and become drunk, and all flesh will perceive that I am the Lord who rescued you and who upholds the strength of Iakob.

## Chapter 50

Isaiah 50:1 Thus says the Lord, What is the document of your mother's divorce, by which I sent her away? Or to what creditor have I sold you? Behold, for your sins you were sold, and for your lawless deeds I sent your mother away.
Isaiah 50:2 Why was it that I came and there was no human? I called and there was no one obeying? Does my hand lack strength to rescue? Or do I lack strength to deliver? Behold, by my threat I will desolate the sea and make rivers desolate, and their fish will dry up because there is no water and die in thirst.
Isaiah 50:3 And I will clothe heaven with darkness and make its covering like sackcloth.
Isaiah 50:4 The Lord gives me a tongue of discipline, to know at a time when it is necessary to say a word; he appointed morning for me; he added an ear for me to hear;
Isaiah 50:5 and the discipline of the Lord opens my ears, but I do not disobey or contradict.
Isaiah 50:6 I have given my back to scourges and my cheeks to blows, and I did not turn my face away from the shame of spittings;
Isaiah 50:7 and the Lord became my helper; therefore I was not abashed, but I made my face like solid rock and knew that I would certainly not be ashamed.
Isaiah 50:8 Because the one who justified me draws near; who is the one contending with me? Let him stand against me together; and who is the one contending with me? Let him draw near me.
Isaiah 50:9 Behold, the Lord helps me; who will harm me? Behold, all of you will grow old like a garment, and as a moth he will devour you.
Isaiah 50:10 Who among you is the one fearing the Lord? Let him hear the voice of his servant; those going in darkness have no light; trust in the name of the Lord and lean upon God.
Isaiah 50:11 Behold, all of you kindle fire and strengthen a flame; go by the light of your fire and by the flame which you kindled; because of me these things happened to you; in grief you will sleep.

## Chapter 51

Isaiah 51:1 Hear me, those pursuing justice and seeking the Lord; look toward the solid rock which you hewed and toward the pit of the cistern which you dug.
Isaiah 51:2 Look toward Abraam your father and toward Sarra who labored to bear you, because he was one, and I called him and blessed him and loved him and multiplied him.
Isaiah 51:3 And you I will now comfort, Sion, and I comforted all her deserted places and will make her deserted places like a paradise of the Lord; they will find gladness and exultation in her, thanksgiving and a voice of praise. —
Isaiah 51:4 Hear me, hear, my people, and kings, give ear to me, because a law will come forth from me, and my judgment as a light of nations.
Isaiah 51:5 My righteousness draws near quickly, and my salvation will come forth like light, and nations will hope in my arm; islands will wait for me and hope in my arm.
Isaiah 51:6 Lift your eyes toward heaven and look toward the earth below, because heaven was established like smoke, and the earth will grow old like a garment, and those dwelling on the earth will die like these, but my salvation will be forever, and my righteousness will certainly not fail. —
Isaiah 51:7 Hear me, those knowing judgment, my people, whose heart contains my law; do not fear the reproach of humans and do not be defeated by their contempt.
Isaiah 51:8 For like a garment it will be eaten by time and like wool eaten by a moth; but my righteousness will be forever, and my salvation for generations of generations.
Isaiah 51:9 Awake, awake, Ierusalem, and put on the strength of your arm; awake as at the beginning of a day, as a generation of eternity. Are you not
Isaiah 51:10 the one desolating a sea, the abundant water of an abyss? The one making the depths of the sea a way of crossing for those being rescued
Isaiah 51:11 and redeemed? For by the Lord they will turn back and come into Sion with gladness and eternal exultation; for upon their head are exultation and praise, and gladness will seize them; pain and grief and groaning fled away.
Isaiah 51:12 I am, I am the one comforting you; know whom you were wary of, that you feared a mortal human and a son of a human, who dried up like grass.
Isaiah 51:13 And you forgot God who made you, who made heaven and founded the earth, and you feared always, all the days, the face of the fury of the one afflicting you; for in the manner that he counseled to take you away—and now where is the fury of the one afflicting you?
Isaiah 51:14 For when you are saved, he will not stand or delay;
Isaiah 51:15 because I am your God who troubles the sea and makes her waves sound; the Lord Sabaoth is my name.
Isaiah 51:16 I will put my words into your mouth and shelter you under the shadow of my hand, with which I established heaven and founded the earth; and he will say to Sion, You are my people.
Isaiah 51:17 Awake, awake, rise, Ierusalem who drank the cup of fury from the hand of the Lord; for you drank out and emptied the cup of falling, the bowl of fury.
Isaiah 51:18 And there was no one comforting you from all your children whom you bore, and there was no one holding your hand, not even from all your sons whom you raised up.
Isaiah 51:19 These two are opposed to you; who will grieve with you? Fall and destruction, famine and sword; who will comfort you?
Isaiah 51:20 Your sons who are perplexed, who sleep at the end of every exit like a half-boiled beet, who are full of the Lord's fury, weakened through the Lord God.
Isaiah 51:21 Therefore hear, humbled woman and drunk, not from wine;
Isaiah 51:22 thus says the Lord God who judges his people, Behold, I have taken from your hand the cup of falling, the bowl of fury, and you will not continue to drink it any longer;
Isaiah 51:23 and I will cast it into the hands of those who wronged you and those who humbled you, who said to your soul, Bend down, so that we may pass; and you made your back equal to the earth outside for those passing by.

## Chapter 52

Isaiah 52:1 Awake, awake, Sion; put on your strength, Sion, and put on your glory, Ierusalem, the holy city; an uncircumcised and unclean one will no longer continue to pass through you.
Isaiah 52:2 Shake off the dust and rise, sit, Ierusalem; take off the bond of your neck, captive daughter of Sion.
Isaiah 52:3 Because thus says the Lord, You were sold for nothing, and you will be redeemed without silver.
Isaiah 52:4 Thus says the Lord, My people went down into Egypt formerly to sojourn there, and they were led to the Assyrians by force;
Isaiah 52:5 and now why are you here? Thus says the Lord. Because my people was taken for nothing, marvel and wail; thus says the Lord. Because of you my name is continually blasphemed among the nations.
Isaiah 52:6 Therefore my people will know my name on that day, that I am he who speaks; I am present,
Isaiah 52:7 like beauty upon the mountains, like feet of one announcing good news of a report of peace, like one announcing good things, because I will make your salvation audible, saying to Sion, Your God will reign;
Isaiah 52:8 because the voice of those guarding you was raised, and with the voice they will be glad together, because eyes will see eye to eye when the Lord has mercy on Sion.
Isaiah 52:9 Let the deserted places of Ierusalem burst forth gladness together, because the Lord had mercy on her and rescued Ierusalem.
Isaiah 52:10 And the Lord will uncover his holy arm before all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation from God.
Isaiah 52:11 Depart, depart, come out from there, and do not touch an unclean thing; come out of her midst, be separated, those carrying the vessels of the Lord;
Isaiah 52:12 because you will not come out with trouble or go in flight, for the Lord will go before you, and the one gathering you is the Lord, the God of Israel.
Isaiah 52:13 Behold, my servant will understand and be exalted and glorified exceedingly.
Isaiah 52:14 In the manner that many will be astounded at you—thus your appearance will be without glory among humans, and your glory among humans—
Isaiah 52:15 thus many nations will marvel at him, and kings will hold their mouth shut; because those to whom it was not announced concerning him will see, and those who have not heard will understand. —

## Chapter 53

Isaiah 53:1 Lord, who believed our report? And to whom was the arm of the Lord revealed?
Isaiah 53:2 We announced before him like a child, like a root in thirsty land; he has no appearance or glory; and we saw him, and he had no appearance or beauty;
Isaiah 53:3 but his appearance was dishonored, failing beyond all humans, a human who is in a blow and knows to bear sickness, because his face has been turned away; he was dishonored and not reckoned.
Isaiah 53:4 This one bears our sins and suffers pain concerning us, and we reckoned him to be in toil and in a blow and in mistreatment.
Isaiah 53:5 But he was wounded because of our lawless deeds and has been made sick because of our sins; the discipline of our peace is upon him; by his bruise we were healed.
Isaiah 53:6 All of us wandered like sheep; each human wandered on his way; and the Lord delivered him to our sins.
Isaiah 53:7 And he, because of being mistreated, does not open the mouth; like a sheep he was led to slaughter, and like a lamb voiceless before the one shearing it, thus he does not open his mouth.
Isaiah 53:8 In the humiliation his judgment was taken away; who will recount his generation? Because his life is taken from the earth, because of the lawless deeds of my people he was led to death.
Isaiah 53:9 And I will give the evil ones in exchange for his burial and the rich in exchange for his death, because he did not do lawlessness, nor was deceit found in his mouth.
Isaiah 53:10 And the Lord desires to cleanse him of the blow; if you give for sin, your soul will see long-lived seed; and the Lord desires to take away
Isaiah 53:11 from the toil of his soul, to show him light and form him with understanding, to justify a righteous one serving many well, and he himself will bear their sins.
Isaiah 53:12 Therefore he himself will inherit many and divide spoils of the strong, because his soul was delivered to death, and he was reckoned among the lawless; and he himself bore sins of many and was delivered because of their sins.

## Chapter 54

Isaiah 54:1 Be glad, barren woman who does not give birth; burst forth and cry out, woman not in labor, because the children of the desolate woman are many, more than those of the one having the husband, for the Lord said it.
Isaiah 54:2 Broaden the place of your tent and of your curtains; pitch them, do not spare; lengthen your cords and strengthen your stakes.
Isaiah 54:3 Spread out yet to the right and to the left, and your seed will inherit nations, and you will settle desolated cities.
Isaiah 54:4 Do not fear because you were put to shame, nor be abashed because you were reproached, because you will forget eternal shame and certainly not remember the reproach of your widowhood.
Isaiah 54:5 Because the Lord is the one making you; the Lord Sabaoth is his name; and the one who rescued you is himself the God of Israel; he will be called so in all the earth.
Isaiah 54:6 The Lord has not called you as an abandoned and fainthearted woman or as a woman hated from youth, said your God;
Isaiah 54:7 for a little time I abandoned you, and with great mercy I will have mercy on you;
Isaiah 54:8 in a little fury I turned my face away from you, and with eternal mercy I will have mercy on you, said the Lord who rescued you.
Isaiah 54:9 From the water in Noe's time this is for me; according as I swore to him at that time concerning the earth, not to be angry at you any longer or, in threatening you,
Isaiah 54:10 for the mountains to be removed, nor will your hills be moved; thus neither will the mercy from me for you fail, nor will the covenant of your peace be removed; for the Lord said, I am propitious to you.
Isaiah 54:11 Humble and unsettled woman, you were not comforted; behold, I prepare a carbuncle as your stone and sapphire as your foundations,
Isaiah 54:12 and I will make your battlements jasper and your gates stones of crystal and your enclosure chosen stones,
Isaiah 54:13 and all your sons taught by God, and your children in much peace.
Isaiah 54:14 And in righteousness you will be built; keep away from injustice, and you will not fear, and trembling will not draw near you.
Isaiah 54:15 Behold, proselytes will approach you through me and flee to you.
Isaiah 54:16 Behold, I create you, not like a smith blowing coals and bringing forth a vessel for work; but I created you not for destruction, to destroy
Isaiah 54:17 every perishable vessel. Against you I will not prosper it, and every voice will rise against you for judgment; you will defeat all of them, and those guilty toward you will be in it. There is an inheritance for those serving the Lord, and you will be righteous for me, says the Lord.

## Chapter 55

Isaiah 55:1 Thirsty ones, go for water, and all who have no silver, go, buy and drink without silver and the price of wine, and fat.
Isaiah 55:2 Why are you valued for silver, and your toil not for fullness? Hear me, and you will eat good things, and your soul will luxuriate in good things.
Isaiah 55:3 Pay attention with your ears and follow my ways; listen to me, and your soul will live in good things; and I will covenant with you an eternal covenant, the faithful holy things of David.
Isaiah 55:4 Behold, I have given him as a testimony among nations, a ruler and one commanding nations.
Isaiah 55:5 Nations which did not know you will call upon you, and peoples which do not understand you will flee to you for the sake of your God, the Holy One of Israel, because he glorified you.
Isaiah 55:6 Seek God and, when finding him, call upon him; and whenever he draws near you,
Isaiah 55:7 let the impious one leave his ways and a lawless man his counsels, and let him turn to the Lord, and he will be shown mercy, because he will abundantly forgive your sins.
Isaiah 55:8 For my counsels are not like your counsels, nor are my ways like your ways, says the Lord;
Isaiah 55:9 but as heaven is distant from earth, thus my way is distant from your ways, and your thoughts from my mind.
Isaiah 55:10 For as rain or snow comes down from heaven and certainly does not turn back until it saturates the earth, and she brings forth and sprouts and gives seed to the sower and bread for eating,
Isaiah 55:11 thus will be my utterance which comes out of my mouth; it will certainly not turn back until whatever I desired is accomplished, and I will prosper your ways and my commands.
Isaiah 55:12 For in gladness you will go out, and in joy you will be taught; for the mountains and hills will leap out, welcoming you in joy, and all the trees of the field will clap with the branches,
Isaiah 55:13 and instead of thorny burnet a cypress will come up, and instead of fleabane a myrtle will come up; and the Lord will be for a name and for an eternal sign and will not fail.

## Chapter 56

Isaiah 56:1 Thus says the Lord, Guard judgment, do righteousness, for my salvation drew near to arrive, and my mercy to be revealed.
Isaiah 56:2 Blessed is a man doing these things and a human clinging to them and guarding the sabbaths so as not to profane them and preserving his hands so as not to do an injustice.
Isaiah 56:3 Let the foreigner attached to the Lord not say, The Lord will surely separate me from his people; and let the eunuch not say that, I am a dry tree.
Isaiah 56:4 Thus says the Lord, To the eunuchs, all who guard my sabbaths and choose what I desire and cling to my covenant,
Isaiah 56:5 I will give them in my house and within my wall a renowned place, better than sons and daughters; I will give them an eternal name, and it will not fail.
Isaiah 56:6 And the foreigners attached to the Lord to serve him and love the name of the Lord, to be male slaves and female slaves for him, and all those guarding my sabbaths so as not to profane them and clinging to my covenant,
Isaiah 56:7 I will bring them into my holy mountain and gladden them in my house of prayer; their whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices will be acceptable upon my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations,
Isaiah 56:8 said the Lord who gathers the scattered ones of Israel, that, I will gather a gathering to him.
Isaiah 56:9 All the wild beasts, come, eat, all the beasts of the wood.
Isaiah 56:10 See that all have been blinded; they did not know to understand; all are mute dogs; they will not be able to bark, dreaming of a bed, loving to doze.
Isaiah 56:11 And the dogs are shameless in soul, not knowing fullness; and they are evil, not knowing understanding; all followed their ways, each according to his own.

## Chapter 57

Isaiah 57:1 See how the righteous one perished, and no one takes it to heart, and righteous men are taken away, and no one considers. For the righteous one has been taken away from the face of injustice;
Isaiah 57:2 his burial will be in peace; he has been taken away from the midst.
Isaiah 57:3 But you draw near here, lawless sons, seed of adulterers and of a prostitute;
Isaiah 57:4 in what did you luxuriate? And against whom did you open your mouth? And against whom did you let loose your tongue? Are you not children of destruction, lawless seed?
Isaiah 57:5 Those appealing to the idols under dense trees, slaughtering their children in the ravines between the rocks.
Isaiah 57:6 That is your portion, this your lot, and to those you poured libations and to those you brought up sacrifices; will I therefore not be angry at these things?
Isaiah 57:7 Upon a high and lofty mountain, there is your bed, and there you brought up sacrifices.
Isaiah 57:8 And behind the posts of your door you put your memorials; you thought that if you departed from me, you would have something more; you loved those sleeping with you,
Isaiah 57:9 and multiplied your prostitution with them and made many those far away from you, and sent envoys beyond your boundaries and turned back and were humbled as far as Hades.
Isaiah 57:10 In your many journeys you labored and did not say, I will cease strengthening myself; because you did these things, therefore you did not supplicate me,
Isaiah 57:11 you. Whom were you wary of, that you feared and lied to me and did not remember me or take me into your mind or into your heart? And I, seeing you, overlook, and you did not fear me.
Isaiah 57:12 And I will announce my righteousness and your evils which will not benefit you.
Isaiah 57:13 When you cry out, let them deliver you in your affliction; for wind will take all these, and a tempest will carry them away. But those clinging to me will acquire land and inherit my holy mountain.
Isaiah 57:14 And they will say, Clear ways before him and take stumbling blocks away from the way of my people.
Isaiah 57:15 Thus says the Lord Most High who dwells in lofty places forever, Holy among holy ones is his name, the Lord Most High resting among holy ones and giving patience to fainthearted ones and giving life to those broken in heart:
Isaiah 57:16 I will not avenge myself upon you forever or be angry with you continually; for a spirit will come out from me, and I made every breath.
Isaiah 57:17 Because of sin I grieved him a little and struck him and turned my face away from him, and he was grieved and went gloomy in his ways.
Isaiah 57:18 I have seen his ways and healed him and comforted him and gave him true comfort,
Isaiah 57:19 peace upon peace to those far away and those who are near; and the Lord said, I will heal them.
Isaiah 57:20 But the unjust will be tossed thus and will not be able to rest.
Isaiah 57:21 There is no rejoicing for the impious, said the Lord God.

## Chapter 58

Isaiah 58:1 Cry out in strength and do not spare; lift your voice like a trumpet and announce to my people their sins and to the house of Iakob their lawless deeds.
Isaiah 58:2 They seek me day by day and desire to know my ways; like a people having done righteousness and not abandoned the judgment of its God, they now ask me for a righteous judgment and desire to draw near God,
Isaiah 58:3 saying, Why did we fast and you did not see? We humbled our souls and you did not know? For in the days of your fasts you find your desires and goad all those under your hand.
Isaiah 58:4 If you fast for disputes and fights and strike a humble one with fists, why do you fast for me as today, for your voice to be heard in a cry?
Isaiah 58:5 I did not choose this fast or a day for a human to humble his soul; not even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ash beneath you, not even thus will you call it an acceptable fast.
Isaiah 58:6 I did not choose such a fast, says the Lord, but loose every bond of injustice, dissolve the strangling cords of violent transactions, send the crushed ones away in release, and tear apart every unjust written contract;
Isaiah 58:7 break your bread for a hungry one and bring roofless poor ones into your house; if you see a naked one, clothe him, and you will not overlook those of the household of your seed.
Isaiah 58:8 Then your light will burst forth early, and your healings will spring up quickly, and your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of God will surround you;
Isaiah 58:9 then you will cry out, and God will hear you; while you are still speaking, he will say, Behold, I am present. If you take away from yourself a bond and a pointing of the hand and an utterance of grumbling,
Isaiah 58:10 and give bread to a hungry one from your soul and fill a humbled soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your darkness will be like midday.
Isaiah 58:11 And your God will be with you continually; and you will be filled just as your soul desires, and your bones will be fattened, and you will be like a saturated garden and like a spring whose water did not fail, and your bones will spring up like vegetation and be fattened, and they will inherit for generations of generations.
Isaiah 58:12 And your eternal deserted places will be built, and your foundations will be eternal for generations of generations; and you will be called Builder of Fences, and you will cause the paths between to cease.
Isaiah 58:13 If you turn your foot away from the sabbaths so as not to do your desires on the holy day, and you will call the sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work or speak a word in wrath from your mouth,
Isaiah 58:14 and you will be trusting in the Lord, and he will bring you up upon the good things of the earth and feed you the inheritance of Iakob your father; for the mouth of the Lord spoke these things.

## Chapter 59

Isaiah 59:1 Does the hand of the Lord lack strength to save? Or did he make his ear heavy so as not to hear?
Isaiah 59:2 But your sins separate between you and God, and because of your sins he turned his face away from you so as not to have mercy.
Isaiah 59:3 For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with sins, and your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditates injustice.
Isaiah 59:4 No one speaks righteous things, nor is there a true judgment; they have trusted in vain things and speak empty things, because they conceive toil and give birth to lawlessness.
Isaiah 59:5 They broke eggs of asps and weave a spider's web; and the one going to eat of their eggs, breaking one, found a wind-egg, and in it a basilisk;
Isaiah 59:6 their web will not be for a garment, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.
Isaiah 59:7 And their feet run to wickedness, swift to pour out blood; and their reasonings are reasonings of senseless ones; destruction and misery are in their ways.
Isaiah 59:8 And they do not know a way of peace, and there is no judgment in their ways; for their paths which they travel are perverted, and they do not know peace.
Isaiah 59:9 Therefore judgment departed from them, and righteousness will certainly not overtake them; while they waited for light, darkness came to be for them; waiting for brightness, they walked at an untimely hour.
Isaiah 59:10 They will feel a wall like blind ones, and as though eyes do not exist, they will feel; and they will fall at midday as at midnight; like dying ones they will groan.
Isaiah 59:11 Like a bear and like a dove they will go together; we waited for judgment, and there is none; salvation has departed far from us.
Isaiah 59:12 For our lawlessness is abundant before you, and our sins stood against us; for our lawless deeds are within us, and we knew our injustices;
Isaiah 59:13 we acted impiously and lied and departed from following our God; we spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated unjust words from our heart;
Isaiah 59:14 and we pushed judgment backward, and righteousness has departed far away, because truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not pass through by a straight way.
Isaiah 59:15 And truth has been taken away, and they removed the mind from understanding; and the Lord saw, and it did not please him, because there was no judgment.
Isaiah 59:16 And he saw, and there was no man, and he considered, and there was no one who would uphold, and he defended against them with his arm and was established by mercy.
Isaiah 59:17 And he put on righteousness like a breastplate and put a helmet of salvation upon the head and put on a garment of vengeance and the covering,
Isaiah 59:18 as one who will repay recompense, reproach to the adversaries.
Isaiah 59:19 And those from the west will fear the name of the Lord, and those from the rising of the sun the glorious name; for the wrath from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with fury.
Isaiah 59:20 And the one rescuing will come for the sake of Sion and turn impieties away from Iakob.
Isaiah 59:21 And this is the covenant from me for them, said the Lord; my spirit which is upon you, and the utterances which I gave into your mouth, will certainly not fail from your mouth and from the mouth of your seed, for the Lord said it, from now and forever.

## Chapter 60

Isaiah 60:1 Be illumined, be illumined, Ierusalem, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord has risen upon you.
Isaiah 60:2 Behold, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations; but upon you the Lord will appear, and his glory will be seen upon you.
Isaiah 60:3 And kings will go by your light and nations by your brightness.
Isaiah 60:4 Lift your eyes around and see your children gathered; behold, all your sons have come from far away, and your daughters will be lifted upon shoulders.
Isaiah 60:5 Then you will see and fear and be astounded in heart, because wealth of sea and nations and peoples will turn to you. And there will come to you
Isaiah 60:6 herds of camels, and camels of Madiam and Gaipha will cover you; all will come from Saba, carrying gold, and bring frankincense and announce the good news of the Lord's salvation.
Isaiah 60:7 And all the sheep of Kedar will be gathered to you, and rams of Nabaioth will come to you, and they will be brought up acceptably upon my altar, and my house of prayer will be glorified.
Isaiah 60:8 Who are these who fly like clouds and like doves with chicks?
Isaiah 60:9 Islands waited for me, and ships of Tharsis among the first, to bring your children from far away, and silver and gold with them, because of the holy name of the Lord and because the Holy One of Israel is glorious.
Isaiah 60:10 And foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will stand beside you; for because of my wrath I struck you, and because of mercy I loved you.
Isaiah 60:11 And your gates will be opened continually; by day and night they will not be shut, to bring to you the power of nations and kings being led.
Isaiah 60:12 For the nations and kings who will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be desolated with desolation.
Isaiah 60:13 And the glory of Lebanon will come to you in cypress and pine and cedar together, to glorify my holy place.
Isaiah 60:14 And sons of those who humbled you and provoked you will go to you in fear, and you will be called City of the Lord, Sion of the Holy One of Israel.
Isaiah 60:15 Because you have become abandoned and hated, and there was no one helping, I will also make you an eternal exultation, a gladness for generations of generations.
Isaiah 60:16 And you will suck milk of nations and eat wealth of kings, and you will know that I am the Lord who saves you and delivers you, the God of Israel.
Isaiah 60:17 And instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and instead of iron I will bring you silver, and instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and instead of stones iron. And I will give your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness;
Isaiah 60:18 and injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor destruction or misery within your boundaries, but your walls will be called Salvation, and your gates Carving.
Isaiah 60:19 And the sun will not be for you for light of day, nor will the rising of the moon illumine the night for you, but the Lord will be an eternal light for you, and God your glory.
Isaiah 60:20 For the sun will not set for you, and the moon will not fail for you; for the Lord will be an eternal light for you, and the days of your mourning will be fulfilled.
Isaiah 60:21 And your people are all righteous, and forever they will inherit the earth, he guarding the planting, works of his hands for glory.
Isaiah 60:22 The very small one will become thousands, and the least one a great nation; I, the Lord, will gather them at the time.

## Chapter 61

Isaiah 61:1 The spirit of the Lord is upon me, because of which he anointed me; he has sent me to announce good news to poor ones, to heal those broken in heart, to proclaim release to captives and recovery of sight to blind ones,
Isaiah 61:2 to call an acceptable year of the Lord and a day of recompense, to comfort all those mourning,
Isaiah 61:3 for glory to be given to those mourning Sion instead of ash, an anointing of gladness to those mourning, an attire of glory instead of a spirit of despondency; and they will be called generations of righteousness, a planting of the Lord for glory.
Isaiah 61:4 And they will build eternal deserted places, raise up those desolated formerly, and renew deserted cities desolated for generations.
Isaiah 61:5 And foreigners will come shepherding your sheep, and those of another tribe as plowmen and vinedressers;
Isaiah 61:6 but you will be called priests of the Lord, ministers of God; you will devour the strength of nations and be marveled at in their wealth.
Isaiah 61:7 Thus a second time they will inherit the earth, and eternal gladness will be above their head.
Isaiah 61:8 For I am the Lord who loves righteousness and hates things seized through injustice; and I will give their toil to righteous ones and covenant an eternal covenant with them.
Isaiah 61:9 And their seed and their offspring will be known among the nations; everyone seeing them will recognize them, that these are seed blessed by God,
Isaiah 61:10 and with gladness they will be glad in the Lord. — Let my soul exult in the Lord, for he clothed me with a garment of salvation and a tunic of gladness; like a bridegroom he put a headdress upon me, and like a bride he adorned me with adornment.
Isaiah 61:11 And like earth growing its flower and like a garden its seeds, thus the Lord will bring forth righteousness and exultation before all the nations.

## Chapter 62

Isaiah 62:1 Because of Sion I will not be silent, and because of Ierusalem I will not desist, until my righteousness comes forth like light, and my salvation will burn like a torch.
Isaiah 62:2 And nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory, and he will call you by your new name which the Lord will name.
Isaiah 62:3 And you will be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord and a diadem of kingship in the hand of your God.
Isaiah 62:4 And you will no longer be called Abandoned, and your land will not be called Desert; for you will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.
Isaiah 62:5 And like a young man living with a virgin, thus your sons will dwell with you; and it shall be in the manner that a bridegroom will be glad over a bride, thus the Lord will be glad over you.
Isaiah 62:6 And upon your walls, Ierusalem, I appointed guards the whole day and the whole night, who to the end will not be silent, remembering the Lord.
Isaiah 62:7 For there is none like you, if he establishes and makes Ierusalem a boast upon the earth.
Isaiah 62:8 The Lord swore by his right hand and by the strength of his arm, Surely I will not give your grain and your foods to your enemies any longer, and surely foreign sons will not drink your wine for which you toiled any longer;
Isaiah 62:9 but those gathering will eat them and praise the Lord, and those gathering will drink them in my holy dwellings.
Isaiah 62:10 Go through my gates and make a road for my people and scatter the stones out of the way; raise a signal to the nations.
Isaiah 62:11 For behold, the Lord made it audible as far as the furthest part of the earth, Say to the daughter of Sion, Behold, your Savior arrives, having his own wage and the work before his face.
Isaiah 62:12 And he will call him a holy people redeemed by the Lord, but you will be called a sought-after city and not abandoned.

## Chapter 63

Isaiah 63:1 Who is this who arrives from Edom, a redness of garments from Bosor, thus beautiful in a robe, with violence, with strength? I discourse righteousness and a judgment of salvation.
Isaiah 63:2 Why are your garments red and your clothes as from a treader of a winepress?
Isaiah 63:3 Full of what has been trampled, and of the nations there is no man with me, and I trampled them in fury and crushed them like earth and brought their blood down to earth.
Isaiah 63:4 For a day of recompense came upon them, and a year of redemption is present.
Isaiah 63:5 And I looked, and there was no helper; and I considered, and no one upheld; and my arm rescued them, and my fury came upon them.
Isaiah 63:6 And I trampled them in my wrath and brought their blood down to earth.
Isaiah 63:7 I remembered the mercy of the Lord, the excellences of the Lord in everything which the Lord repays to us; the Lord is a good judge for the house of Israel; he brings upon us according to his mercy and according to the abundance of his righteousness.
Isaiah 63:8 And he said, Are not my people children who will certainly not reject? And he became salvation for them
Isaiah 63:9 from every affliction. Not an envoy or an angel, but the Lord himself saved them because he loved them and spared them; he himself redeemed them and took them up and raised them up all the days of eternity.
Isaiah 63:10 But they disobeyed and provoked his holy spirit, and he turned to enmity toward them, and he himself warred against them.
Isaiah 63:11 And the one who brought up the shepherd of the sheep from the earth remembered eternal days; where is the one who put the holy spirit among them?
Isaiah 63:12 The one who led Moyses by the right hand, the arm of his glory? He prevailed over water before him to make an eternal name for himself.
Isaiah 63:13 He led them through the abyss like a horse through a desert, and they did not grow weary.
Isaiah 63:14 And like livestock through a plain, a spirit came down from the Lord and guided them; thus you led your people to make yourself a name of glory.
Isaiah 63:15 Turn from heaven and see from the house of your holiness and glory; where are your zeal and your strength? Where is the abundance of your mercy and your compassions, that you held back from us?
Isaiah 63:16 For you are our father, because Abraam did not know us, and Israel did not recognize us, but you, Lord, are our father; rescue us; from the beginning your name is upon us.
Isaiah 63:17 Why did you lead us astray, Lord, from your way, harden our hearts so as not to fear you? Turn back because of your slaves, because of the tribes of your inheritance,
Isaiah 63:18 so that we may inherit a little of your holy mountain; our adversaries trampled your sanctuary.
Isaiah 63:19 We became as at the beginning, when you did not rule us, nor was your name called upon us. If you open heaven, trembling will seize mountains because of you, and they will melt,

## Chapter 64

Isaiah 64:1 as wax melts from fire. And fire will burn up the adversaries, and the name of the Lord will be manifest among the adversaries; before you nations will be troubled.
Isaiah 64:2 When you do the glorious things, trembling will seize mountains because of you.
Isaiah 64:3 From eternity we did not hear, nor did our eyes see a god apart from you, and your works which you will do for those waiting for mercy.
Isaiah 64:4 For he will meet those doing justice, and they will remember your ways. Behold, you were angry, and we sinned; therefore we were led astray.
Isaiah 64:5 And we all became like unclean ones; all our righteousness is like the rag of a menstruating woman; and we flowed away like leaves because of our lawless deeds; thus wind will carry us.
Isaiah 64:6 And there is no one calling upon your name and remembering to take hold of you, because you turned your face away from us and delivered us over because of our sins. —
Isaiah 64:7 And now, Lord, you are our father, and we are clay, all a work of your hands;
Isaiah 64:8 do not be very angry with us and do not remember our sins at a time. And now look, because all of us are your people.
Isaiah 64:9 The city of your holy one became desolate; Sion became like a desert; Ierusalem became a curse.
Isaiah 64:10 The house, our holy place, and the glory which our fathers blessed became burned by fire, and all the glorious things fell together.
Isaiah 64:11 And at all these things you held back, Lord, and were silent and humbled us exceedingly.

## Chapter 65

Isaiah 65:1 I became manifest to those not seeking me; I was found by those not inquiring of me; I said, Behold, I am, to the nation who did not call my name.
Isaiah 65:2 I spread out my hands the whole day toward a disobedient and contradicting people, who did not go by a true way, but after their sins.
Isaiah 65:3 This people who provokes me before me continually—they sacrifice in the gardens and burn incense upon the bricks to the demons which do not exist;
Isaiah 65:4 and in the tombs and in the caves they sleep for dreams, those eating pork and broth of sacrifices; all their vessels are stained;
Isaiah 65:5 those saying, Far away from me, do not draw near me, because I am clean; this is smoke of my fury; fire burns in it all the days.
Isaiah 65:6 Behold, it is written before me, I will not be silent until I repay into their bosom;
Isaiah 65:7 their sins and those of their fathers, says the Lord, who burned incense upon the mountains and reproached me upon the hills—I will repay their works into their bosom.
Isaiah 65:8 Thus says the Lord, In the manner that a grape berry will be found in the cluster, and they will say, Do not ruin it, because a blessing of the Lord is in it, thus I will do for the sake of the one serving me; for this one's sake I will certainly not destroy all.
Isaiah 65:9 And I will bring out the seed from Iakob and that from Iouda, and it will inherit my holy mountain, and my chosen ones and my slaves will inherit and dwell there.
Isaiah 65:10 And in the wood there will be dwellings of flocks, and a ravine of Achor for a resting place of herds for my people who sought me.
Isaiah 65:11 But you who abandoned me and forget my holy mountain and prepare a table for the demon and fill a mixed drink for Fortune,
Isaiah 65:12 I will deliver you to a sword; all will fall in slaughter, because I called you and you did not obey; I spoke and you disregarded and did evil before me and chose what I did not desire.
Isaiah 65:13 Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, those serving me will eat, but you will hunger; behold, those serving me will drink, but you will thirst; behold, those serving me will be glad, but you will be ashamed;
Isaiah 65:14 behold, those serving me will exult in gladness, but you will cry out because of the toil of your heart and wail from a breaking of spirit.
Isaiah 65:15 For you will leave your name for fullness to my chosen ones, but the Lord will kill you. But for those serving him a new name will be called,
Isaiah 65:16 which will be blessed upon the earth; for they will bless the true God, and those swearing upon the earth will swear by the true God; for they will forget their former affliction, and it will not rise upon their heart. —
Isaiah 65:17 For heaven will be new and the earth new, and they will certainly not remember the former things, nor will they come upon their heart,
Isaiah 65:18 but they will find gladness and exultation in her, because behold, I make Ierusalem an exultation and my people a gladness.
Isaiah 65:19 And I will exult over Ierusalem and be glad over my people, and a voice of weeping or a voice of crying will certainly no longer be heard in her.
Isaiah 65:20 And there will certainly not be there one untimely or an elder who will not fulfill his time; for the young one will be a hundred years old, and the sinner dying a hundred years old will also be accursed.
Isaiah 65:21 And they will build houses and themselves dwell in them and plant vineyards and themselves eat their produce;
Isaiah 65:22 and they will certainly not build and others dwell in them, and they will certainly not plant and others eat; for according to the days of the tree of life will be the days of my people; they will make old the works of their toils.
Isaiah 65:23 But my chosen ones will not labor in emptiness or produce children for a curse, because they are seed blessed by God, and their offspring will be with them.
Isaiah 65:24 And it shall be that before they cry out, I will listen to them; while they are still speaking, I will say, What is it?
Isaiah 65:25 Then wolves and lambs will graze together, and a lion will eat straw like an ox, and a snake earth like bread; they will not do wrong or ruin upon my holy mountain, says the Lord.

## Chapter 66

Isaiah 66:1 Thus says the Lord, Heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet; what house will you build for me? Or what place of my rest?
Isaiah 66:2 For my hand made all these things, and all these things are mine, says the Lord; and upon whom will I look except upon the humble and quiet one trembling at my words?
Isaiah 66:3 But the lawless one sacrificing a calf to me is like the one killing a dog, and the one bringing up fine flour like swine's blood, the one giving frankincense for a memorial like a blasphemer; and these chose their ways and their abominations which their soul desired,
Isaiah 66:4 and I will choose their mockeries and repay their sins to them, because I called them and they did not obey me; I spoke and they did not hear, and they did evil before me and chose what I did not desire.
Isaiah 66:5 Hear the utterance of the Lord, those trembling at his word; say, our brothers, to those hating us and abhorring us, so that the name of the Lord may be glorified and seen in their gladness, and those will be ashamed.
Isaiah 66:6 A voice of crying from a city, a voice from a temple, a voice of the Lord repaying recompense to the opponents.
Isaiah 66:7 Before the woman in labor gave birth, before the pain of the pangs came, she escaped and bore a male.
Isaiah 66:8 Who heard such a thing, and who has seen thus? Did a land labor in one day, or was a nation also born at once? Because Sion labored and bore her children.
Isaiah 66:9 But I gave this expectation, and you did not remember me, said the Lord. Did I not, behold, make one giving birth and one barren? said God.
Isaiah 66:10 Be glad, Ierusalem, and celebrate in her, all those loving her; rejoice with joy, all who mourn over her,
Isaiah 66:11 so that you may suck and be filled from the breast of her comfort, so that, sucking out, you may delight from the entrance of her glory.
Isaiah 66:12 Because thus says the Lord, Behold, I turn toward them like a river of peace and like an overflowing torrent the glory of nations; their children will be lifted upon shoulders and comforted upon knees.
Isaiah 66:13 As if a mother comforts someone, thus I too will comfort you, and in Ierusalem you will be comforted.
Isaiah 66:14 And you will see, and your heart will rejoice, and your bones will spring up like vegetation; and the hand of the Lord will be known to those revering him, and he will threaten the disobedient.
Isaiah 66:15 For behold, the Lord will come like fire, and his chariots like a tempest, to repay vengeance in fury and expulsion in a flame of fire.
Isaiah 66:16 For by the fire of the Lord all the earth will be judged, and by his sword all flesh; many will be wounded by the Lord.
Isaiah 66:17 Those purifying and cleansing themselves for the gardens, and in the porches eating pork and the abominations and the now, will be consumed together, said the Lord,
Isaiah 66:18 and I know their works and their reasoning. I come to gather all the nations and tongues, and they will come and see my glory.
Isaiah 66:19 And I will leave signs upon them and send saved ones from them to the nations, to Tharsis and Phoud and Loud and Mosoch and Thobel and into Hellas and into the distant islands, who have not heard my name or seen my glory, and they will announce my glory among the nations.
Isaiah 66:20 And they will bring your brothers from all the nations as a gift to the Lord, with horses and chariots, in mule carriages with canopies, into the holy city Ierusalem, said the Lord, as the sons of Israel would bring me their sacrifices with psalms into the house of the Lord.
Isaiah 66:21 And from them I will take priests and Leuites for myself, said the Lord.
Isaiah 66:22 For in the manner that the new heaven and the new earth which I make remain before me, says the Lord, thus your seed and your name will stand.
Isaiah 66:23 And it shall be month after month and sabbath after sabbath that all flesh will come before me to worship in Ierusalem, said the Lord.
Isaiah 66:24 And they will come out and see the limbs of the humans who have transgressed against me; for their worm will not die, and their fire will not be extinguished, and they will be a sight for all flesh.

# Jeremiah

The Apostolic Bible. Public domain. https://apostolic-bible.ysys9.chatgpt.site/license.html


## Chapter 1

Jeremiah 1:1 The utterance of God which came upon Ieremias, the son of Chelkias, from the priests, who dwelt in Anathoth in the land of Beniamin;
Jeremiah 1:2 which became a word of God to him in the days of Iosias son of Amos, king of Iouda, in the thirteenth year of his reign;
Jeremiah 1:3 and it came in the days of Ioakim son of Iosias, king of Iouda, until the eleventh year of Sedekias son of Iosias, king of Iouda, until the captivity of Ierusalem in the fifth month.
Jeremiah 1:4 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Jeremiah 1:5 Before I formed you in the womb I know you, and before you came out of the womb I have sanctified you; I have appointed you a prophet to nations.
Jeremiah 1:6 And I said, O Master Lord, behold, I do not know how to speak, because I am young.
Jeremiah 1:7 And the Lord said to me, Do not say that, I am young, because to all to whom I send you away you will go, and according to everything that I command you, you will speak;
Jeremiah 1:8 do not fear before them, because I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:9 And the Lord stretched his hand toward me and touched my mouth, and the Lord said to me, Behold, I have given my words into your mouth;
Jeremiah 1:10 behold, I have appointed you today over nations and kingdoms, to uproot and dig down and destroy and rebuild and plant.
Jeremiah 1:11 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying, What do you see, Ieremias? And I said, A rod of nut wood.
Jeremiah 1:12 And the Lord said to me, You have seen well, because I have kept watch over my words to do them. —
Jeremiah 1:13 And a word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? And I said, A cauldron heated from beneath, and its face from the face of the north.
Jeremiah 1:14 And the Lord said to me, From the face of the north evils will blaze out upon all those dwelling on the earth.
Jeremiah 1:15 Because behold, I call together all the kingdoms from the north of the earth, says the Lord, and they will come and each set his throne at the porches of the gates of Ierusalem and against all the walls around her and against all the cities of Iouda.
Jeremiah 1:16 And I will speak to them with judgment concerning all their wickedness, how they abandoned me and sacrificed to foreign gods and worshiped the works of their hands.
Jeremiah 1:17 And you gird your waist and rise and say to them everything that I command you; do not fear before them or be frightened before them, because I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:18 Behold, I have made you on this day like a strong city and like a strong bronze wall to all the kings of Iouda and its rulers and the people of the land,
Jeremiah 1:19 and they will war against you and certainly not prevail against you, because I am with you to deliver you, said the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:2 And he said, Thus says the Lord, I remembered the mercy of your youth and the love of your completion, that you followed the Holy One of Israel, says the Lord,
Jeremiah 1:3 holy Israel. To the Lord he is the beginning of his produce; all those eating him will offend; evils will come upon them, declares the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:4 Hear a word of the Lord, house of Iakob and every family of the house of Israel.
Jeremiah 1:5 Thus says the Lord, What offense did your fathers find in me, that they departed far from me and went after vain things and were made vain?
Jeremiah 1:6 And they did not say, Where is the Lord who brought us up from the land of Egypt, who guided us in the desert, in an unbounded and untrodden land, in a waterless and fruitless land, in a land in which nothing traveled and no son of a human dwelt there?
Jeremiah 1:7 And I brought you into Karmel for you to eat its fruits and its good things; and you entered and defiled my land and made my inheritance an abomination.
Jeremiah 1:8 The priests did not say, Where is the Lord? And those clinging to the law did not know me, and the shepherds acted impiously toward me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and went after a useless thing.
Jeremiah 1:9 Therefore I will yet contend with you, says the Lord, and with the sons of your sons I will contend.
Jeremiah 1:10 Because cross into the islands of Chettiim and see, and send into Kedar and consider exceedingly, and see whether such things have happened.
Jeremiah 1:11 Will nations exchange their gods? And these are not gods. But my people exchanged its glory, from which they will not be benefited.
Jeremiah 1:12 Heaven was astounded at this and shuddered exceedingly, beyond measure, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:13 Because my people did two evil things; they abandoned me, a spring of water of life, and dug for themselves broken cisterns which will not be able to hold water.
Jeremiah 1:14 Is Israel a slave or house-born? Why did he become plunder?
Jeremiah 1:15 Lions roared against him and gave their voice, who made his land a desert, and his cities were dug down so as not to be inhabited.
Jeremiah 1:16 And sons of Memphis and Taphnas knew you and mocked you.
Jeremiah 1:17 Did not your abandoning me do these things to you? says the Lord your God.
Jeremiah 1:18 And now what have you to do with the way of Egypt, to drink water of Geon? And what have you to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink water of rivers?
Jeremiah 1:19 Your apostasy will discipline you, and your wickedness will reprove you; and know and see that your abandoning me is bitter for you, says the Lord your God; and I was not pleased with you, says the Lord your God.
Jeremiah 1:20 Because from eternity you shattered your yoke, tore apart your bonds and said, I will not serve, but I will go upon every high hill and beneath every shady tree; there I will abandon myself to my prostitution.
Jeremiah 1:21 But I planted you a fruitful vine, entirely true; how were you turned to bitterness, the foreign vine?
Jeremiah 1:22 If you wash yourself with natron and multiply cleansing herb for yourself, you have been stained in your injustices before me, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:23 How will you say, I was not defiled and did not go after Baal? See your ways in the burial ground and know what you did. Late her voice wailed; her ways
Jeremiah 1:24 she broadened toward waters of a desert; in desires of her soul she was borne by a spirit, she was delivered over; who will turn her back? All those seeking her will not grow weary; in her humiliation they will find her.
Jeremiah 1:25 Turn your foot away from a rough way and your throat from thirst. But she said, I will be courageous; because she had loved strangers and went after them.
Jeremiah 1:26 As the shame of a thief when he is captured, thus the sons of Israel will be ashamed, they and their kings and their rulers and their priests and their prophets.
Jeremiah 1:27 To the wood they said that, You are my father, and to the stone, You begot me, and they turned backs toward me and not their faces; and in the time of their evils they will say, Rise and save us.
Jeremiah 1:28 And where are your gods which you made for yourself? Will they rise and save you in a time of your mistreatment? Because according to the number of your cities were your gods, Iouda, and according to the number of passages of Ierusalem they sacrificed to Baal.
Jeremiah 1:29 Why do you speak to me? All of you acted impiously and all of you acted lawlessly toward me, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 1:30 In vain I struck your children; you did not accept discipline; a sword devoured your prophets like a destroying lion, and you did not fear.
Jeremiah 1:31 Hear a word of the Lord, Thus says the Lord, Did I become a desert for Israel or a land made barren? Why did my people say, We will not be ruled and will not come to you any longer?
Jeremiah 1:32 Will a bride forget her adornment and a virgin her breastband? But my people forgot me for days of which there is no number.
Jeremiah 1:33 What good thing will you yet pursue in your ways to seek love? Not thus, but you too acted wickedly to defile your ways.
Jeremiah 1:34 And in your hands blood of innocent souls was found; I did not find them in break-ins, but upon every oak.
Jeremiah 1:35 And you said, I am innocent, but let his fury turn away from me. Behold, I contend with you in your saying, I did not sin.
Jeremiah 1:36 Why did you greatly disdain to repeat your ways? And because of Egypt you will be put to shame, just as you were put to shame because of Assour.
Jeremiah 1:37 Because from here too you will go out, and your hands upon your head, because the Lord rejected your hope, and you will not prosper in it.

## Chapter 3

Jeremiah 3:1 If a man sends his wife away, and she departs from him and becomes another man's, will she, returning, still return to him? Will that woman not, being defiled, be defiled? And you prostituted yourself among many shepherds; and were you returning to me? says the Lord.
Jeremiah 3:2 Lift your eyes straight ahead and see; where were you not stained? Upon the ways you sat for them like a deserted crow and defiled the land in your prostitutions and in your wickedness.
Jeremiah 3:3 And you had many shepherds as a stumbling block for yourself; you acquired the appearance of a prostitute; you were utterly shameless toward all.
Jeremiah 3:4 Did you not call me as a house and father and leader of your virginity?
Jeremiah 3:5 Will it remain forever or be preserved for strife? Behold, you spoke and did these evil things and prevailed.
Jeremiah 3:6 And the Lord said to me in the days of Iosias the king, You saw what the dwelling of Israel did to me; they went upon every high mountain and beneath every wooded tree and prostituted themselves there.
Jeremiah 3:7 And I said after she prostituted herself in all these things, Return to me, and she did not return; and faithless Iouda saw her faithlessness.
Jeremiah 3:8 And I saw that, concerning all the things in which the dwelling of Israel was caught committing adultery, I also sent her away and gave her a document of divorce into her hands; and faithless Iouda did not fear and went and prostituted herself too.
Jeremiah 3:9 And her prostitution became nothing, and she committed adultery with the wood and the stone.
Jeremiah 3:10 And in all these things faithless Iouda did not turn to me from her whole heart, but in falsehood.
Jeremiah 3:11 And the Lord said to me, Israel justified his soul in comparison with faithless Iouda.
Jeremiah 3:12 Go and read these words toward the north, and you will say, Turn to me, dwelling of Israel, says the Lord, and I will not set my face against you, because I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not be wrathful toward you forever.
Jeremiah 3:13 Only know your injustice, because you acted impiously toward the Lord your God and spread your ways to strangers beneath every wooded tree, but you did not obey my voice, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 3:14 Turn back, departed sons, says the Lord, because I will rule over you and take you, one from a city and two from a family, and bring you into Sion,
Jeremiah 3:15 and I will give you shepherds according to my heart, and they will shepherd you, shepherding with knowledge.
Jeremiah 3:16 And it shall be, if you are multiplied and increased upon the earth in those days, says the Lord, they will no longer say, Ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel; it will not rise upon the heart, it will not be named or visited and will not be made any longer;
Jeremiah 3:17 in those days and at that time they will call Ierusalem Throne of the Lord, and all the nations will be gathered into her and will no longer go after the thoughts of their evil heart.
Jeremiah 3:18 In those days the house of Iouda will come together to the house of Israel, and they will come together from the land of the north and from all the countries to the land which I gave their fathers to inherit.
Jeremiah 3:19 And I said, May it be, Lord, because I will set you among children and give you a chosen land, an inheritance of God Almighty of nations; and I said, You will call me Father and will not turn away from me.
Jeremiah 3:20 Only, as a woman deals faithlessly with the one living with her, thus the house of Israel dealt faithlessly with me, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 3:21 A voice was heard from lips, of weeping and supplication of sons of Israel, because they did wrong in their ways, forgot their holy God.
Jeremiah 3:22 Turn back, returning sons, and I will heal your fractures. Behold, we will be slaves to you, because you are the Lord our God.
Jeremiah 3:23 Truly the hills and the power of the mountains were for falsehood, but through the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
Jeremiah 3:24 But shame consumed the toils of our fathers from our youth, their sheep and their calves and their sons and their daughters.
Jeremiah 3:25 We slept in our shame, and our dishonor covered us, because before our God we sinned, we and our fathers, from our youth until this day, and we did not obey the voice of the Lord our God.

## Chapter 4

Jeremiah 4:1 If Israel turns back, says the Lord, he will turn to me; if he removes his abominations from his mouth and is wary before me,
Jeremiah 4:2 and swears, The Lord lives, with truth and in judgment and in righteousness, nations will also bless in her and in him praise God in Ierusalem.
Jeremiah 4:3 Because thus says the Lord to the men of Iouda and those dwelling in Ierusalem, Break up fallow ground for yourselves and do not sow upon thorns.
Jeremiah 4:4 Be circumcised to your God and circumcise your hardness of heart, men of Iouda and those dwelling in Ierusalem, lest my fury come out like fire and blaze up, and there will be no one extinguishing, because of the wickedness of your practices.
Jeremiah 4:5 Announce in Iouda, and let it be heard in Ierusalem; say, Signal upon the earth with a trumpet and cry out greatly; say, Be gathered, and let us enter the walled cities.
Jeremiah 4:6 Taking up, flee to Sion; hasten, do not stand, because I bring evils from the north and great destruction.
Jeremiah 4:7 A lion went up from his lair; one destroying nations set out and came out from his place to make the earth a desolation, and cities will be pulled down so as not to be inhabited.
Jeremiah 4:8 At these things gird yourselves with sackcloth and beat yourselves and raise a cry, because the fury of the Lord did not turn away from you.
Jeremiah 4:9 And it shall be on that day, says the Lord, that the heart of the king and the heart of the rulers will perish, and the priests will be astounded, and the prophets will marvel.
Jeremiah 4:10 And I said, O Master Lord, surely, deceiving, you deceived this people and Ierusalem, saying, There will be peace for you, and behold, the sword reached as far as their soul.
Jeremiah 4:11 At that time they will say to this people and to Ierusalem, A spirit of wandering in the desert; the way of the daughter of my people is not toward what is clean or toward what is holy.
Jeremiah 4:12 A spirit of fullness will come to me; but now I speak judgments to them.
Jeremiah 4:13 Behold, he will go up like a cloud, and his chariots like a tempest; his horses are swifter than eagles; woe to us, because we suffer misery.
Jeremiah 4:14 Wash your heart from wickedness, Ierusalem, so that you may be saved; until when will reasonings of your toils exist in you?
Jeremiah 4:15 Because a voice of one announcing will come from Dan, and toil will be heard from Mount Ephraim.
Jeremiah 4:16 Remind nations, Behold, they have come; announce in Ierusalem, Gathered bands come from a land far away and gave their voice against the cities of Iouda.
Jeremiah 4:17 Like those guarding a field they came against her all around, because you neglected me, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 4:18 Your ways and your practices did these things to you; this is your wickedness, because it is bitter, because it reached as far as your heart.
Jeremiah 4:19 My belly, my belly, I suffer pain, and the organs of my heart; my soul rages, my heart is torn; I will not be silent, because my soul heard a voice of a trumpet, a cry of war.
Jeremiah 4:20 And it calls misery destruction, because all the earth has suffered misery; suddenly the tent has suffered misery; my tent coverings were torn apart.
Jeremiah 4:21 Until when will I see those fleeing, hearing a voice of trumpets?
Jeremiah 4:22 Because those leading my people did not know me; they are senseless sons and not intelligent; they are wise in doing evil, but they did not recognize doing good.
Jeremiah 4:23 I looked upon the earth, and behold, nothing, and toward heaven, and its lights were not there;
Jeremiah 4:24 I saw the mountains, and they were trembling, and all the hills troubled;
Jeremiah 4:25 I looked, and behold, there was no human, and all the birds of heaven were frightened;
Jeremiah 4:26 I saw, and behold, Karmel was desolate, and all the cities burned with fire before the Lord, and before the wrath of his fury they disappeared.
Jeremiah 4:27 Thus says the Lord, All the earth will be desolate, but I will certainly not make an end.
Jeremiah 4:28 At these things let the earth mourn, and let heaven above grow dark, because I spoke and will not repent; I set out and will not turn away from her.
Jeremiah 4:29 From the sound of a horseman and a drawn bow every country withdrew; they slipped into the caves and hid in the groves and went up upon the rocks; every city was abandoned; no human dwells in them.
Jeremiah 4:30 And what will you do, if you put on scarlet and adorn yourself with golden adornment and if you paint your eyes with antimony? Your beautification is in vain; your lovers rejected you; they seek your soul.
Jeremiah 4:31 Because I heard a voice like a woman in labor, of your groaning like one giving birth for the first time, a voice of the daughter of Sion; she will grow weak and let her hands drop, Alas for me, because my soul fails over those killed.

## Chapter 5

Jeremiah 5:1 Run around in the ways of Ierusalem and see and know and seek in her squares, if you find a man, if there is one doing judgment and seeking faithfulness, and I will be propitious to them, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 5:2 The Lord lives, they say; do they not therefore swear upon falsehoods?
Jeremiah 5:3 Lord, your eyes are toward faithfulness; you scourged them, and they did not suffer; you made an end of them, and they did not desire to accept discipline; they made their faces harder than rock and did not desire to turn back.
Jeremiah 5:4 And I said, Perhaps they are poor, because they had no strength, because they did not know a way of the Lord and a judgment of God;
Jeremiah 5:5 I will go to the great ones and speak to them, because they recognized a way of the Lord and a judgment of God; and behold, with one accord they shattered a yoke, tore apart bonds.
Jeremiah 5:6 Therefore a lion from the wood struck them, and a wolf as far as the houses destroyed them, and a leopard kept watch against their cities; all those going out from them will be hunted, because they multiplied their impieties, were strong in their turnings away.
Jeremiah 5:7 For which of these shall I become propitious to you? Your sons abandoned me and swore by those who are not gods; and I fed them, and they committed adultery and lodged in houses of prostitutes.
Jeremiah 5:8 They became horses mad for females; each neighed toward his neighbor's wife.
Jeremiah 5:9 Will I not visit for these things? says the Lord; or will my soul not avenge itself upon such a nation?
Jeremiah 5:10 Go up upon her battlements and dig down, but do not make an end; leave her supports, because they are the Lord's.
Jeremiah 5:11 Because, rejecting, the house of Israel and the house of Iouda rejected me, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 5:12 They lied to their own Lord and said, These things are not; evils will not come upon us, and we will not see sword and famine;
Jeremiah 5:13 our prophets were for wind, and a word of the Lord did not exist in them; thus it will be for them.
Jeremiah 5:14 Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty, Because you spoke this utterance, behold, I have made my words in your mouth fire and this people wood, and it will devour them.
Jeremiah 5:15 Behold, I bring a nation upon you from far away, house of Israel, says the Lord, a nation of whose tongue you will not understand the voice;
Jeremiah 5:16 all are strong
Jeremiah 5:17 and will devour your harvest and your bread and devour your sons and your daughters and devour your sheep and your calves and devour your vineyards and your fig orchards and your olive groves; and they will thresh your strong cities in which you have trusted, with a sword.
Jeremiah 5:18 And it shall be in those days, says the Lord your God, I will certainly not make an end of you.
Jeremiah 5:19 And it shall be when you say, For what reason did the Lord our God do all these things to us? And you will say to them, As you served foreign gods in your land, thus you will serve foreigners in a land not yours.
Jeremiah 5:20 Announce these things to the house of Iakob, and let it be heard in Iouda.
Jeremiah 5:21 Hear indeed these things, foolish and heartless people; they have eyes and do not see; they have ears and do not hear.
Jeremiah 5:22 Will you not fear me? says the Lord, or will you not be wary before me? The one who appointed sand as a boundary for the sea, an eternal ordinance, and she will not cross it, and she will be troubled and will not be able, and her waves will sound and she will not cross it.
Jeremiah 5:23 But this people acquired an unhearing and disobedient heart, and they turned aside and departed;
Jeremiah 5:24 and they did not say in their heart, Let us indeed fear the Lord our God who gives us early and late rain at a time of fulfillment of the ordinance of harvest, and he guarded it for us.
Jeremiah 5:25 Your lawless deeds turned these things aside, and your sins removed the good things from you;
Jeremiah 5:26 because impious ones were found among my people, and they set snares to destroy men and were capturing them.
Jeremiah 5:27 Like a set snare full of birds, thus their houses are full of deceit; therefore they grew great and rich;
Jeremiah 5:28 and they transgressed judgment, did not judge an orphan's judgment, and did not judge a widow's judgment.
Jeremiah 5:29 Will I not visit for these things? says the Lord, or will my soul not avenge itself upon such a nation?
Jeremiah 5:30 Astonishment and fearful things happened upon the earth.
Jeremiah 5:31 The prophets prophesy unjust things, and the priests clapped with their hands, and my people loved it thus; and what will you do afterward?

## Chapter 6

Jeremiah 6:1 Grow strong, sons of Beniamin, from the midst of Ierusalem, and in Thekoue signal with a trumpet, and above Baithacharma raise a sign, because evils have peered out from the north, and great destruction comes to be,
Jeremiah 6:2 and your height will be taken away, daughter of Sion.
Jeremiah 6:3 Shepherds and their flocks will come into her and pitch tents against her all around, and each will shepherd with his hand.
Jeremiah 6:4 Prepare yourselves against her for war; rise, and let us go up against her at midday; woe to us, because the day has inclined, because the shadows of evening fail.
Jeremiah 6:5 Rise, and let us go up by night and destroy her foundations.
Jeremiah 6:6 Because thus says the Lord, Cut out her trees; pour out a force against Ierusalem; O false city, she is entirely oppression.
Jeremiah 6:7 As a cistern cools water, thus her wickedness cools; impiety and misery will be heard in her before her continually. With toil and scourge
Jeremiah 6:8 you will be disciplined, Ierusalem, lest my soul depart from you, lest I make you an untrodden land which will not be inhabited.
Jeremiah 6:9 Because thus says the Lord, Glean, glean like a vine the remnants of Israel; turn back like the one harvesting toward his basket.
Jeremiah 6:10 To whom shall I speak and testify, and he will hear? Behold, their ears are uncircumcised, and they cannot hear; behold, the utterance of the Lord became a reproach for them; they will certainly not desire to hear it.
Jeremiah 6:11 And I filled my fury and held back and did not make an end of them; I will pour it out upon infants outside and upon a gathering of young men together, because man and woman will be captured, an elder with one full of days;
Jeremiah 6:12 and their houses will be turned over to others, fields and their wives together, because I will stretch my hand against those dwelling in this land, says the Lord.
Jeremiah 6:13 Because from their small one even to the great one all accomplished lawless things; from priest even to false prophet all did false things.
Jeremiah 6:14 And they healed the fracture of my people, treating it as nothing and saying, Peace, peace; and where is peace?
Jeremiah 6:15 They were put to shame, because they failed; and not even thus, being ashamed, were they put to shame, and they did not know their dishonor. Therefore they will fall in their fall and perish at the time of their visitation, said the Lord.
Jeremiah 6:16 Thus says the Lord, Stand upon the ways and see, and ask for the eternal paths of the Lord and see what is the good way, and walk in it, and you will find purification for your souls; and they said, We will not go.
Jeremiah 6:17 I have appointed watchmen over you; hear the voice of the trumpet; and they said, We will not hear.
Jeremiah 6:18 Therefore the nations heard, and those shepherding their flocks.
Jeremiah 6:19 Hear, earth; behold, I bring evils upon this people, the fruit of their turning away, because they did not pay attention to my words and rejected my law.
Jeremiah 6:20 Why do you bring frankincense from Saba to me and cinnamon from a land far away? Your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices did not please me.
Jeremiah 6:21 Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I give weakness upon this people, and in it fathers and sons together will be weak; a neighbor and the one near him will perish.
Jeremiah 6:22 Thus says the Lord, Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations will be raised from the furthest part of the earth;
Jeremiah 6:23 they will hold bow and spear; it is bold and will not have mercy; its voice is like a surging sea; upon horses and chariots it will form up like fire for war against you, daughter of Sion.
Jeremiah 6:24 We heard their report; our hands were paralyzed; affliction held us, pangs like a woman giving birth.
Jeremiah 6:25 Do not go out into a field and do not walk in the ways, because a sword of the enemies sojourns all around.
Jeremiah 6:26 Daughter of my people, gird yourself with sackcloth, sprinkle yourself with ash, make for yourself mourning for a beloved one, a pitiable beating, because suddenly misery will come upon you.
Jeremiah 6:27 I have given you as an assayer among tested peoples, and you will know me when I test their way;
Jeremiah 6:28 all are unhearing, going crookedly, bronze and iron; all are corrupted.
Jeremiah 6:29 A bellows failed from fire, lead failed; in emptiness a silversmith works silver; their wickedness did not melt.
Jeremiah 6:30 Call them rejected silver, because the Lord rejected them.
Jeremiah 6:2 Hear a word of the Lord, all Ioudaia;
Jeremiah 6:3 thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, Correct your ways and your practices, and I will settle you in this place.
Jeremiah 6:4 Do not trust in yourselves, in false words, because they will not benefit you at all, saying, Temple of the Lord, temple of the Lord it is.
