Ezekiel 4:3 and take an iron pan for yourself and place it as an iron wall between you and the city and prepare your face against it, and it shall be under confinement, and you shall confine it; this is a sign for the sons of Israel. —
Ezekiel 4:4 And you shall lie upon your left side and place the injustices of the house of Israel upon it, according to the number of the days, a hundred and fifty, which you shall lie upon it, and bear their injustices.
Ezekiel 4:5 And I have given you their two injustices for a number of days, a hundred and ninety days. And you shall bear the injustices of the house of Israel
Ezekiel 4:6 and complete all these things; and you shall lie upon your right side and bear the injustices of the house of Iouda forty days. I have appointed you a day for a year.
Ezekiel 4:7 And for the confinement of Ierusalem you shall prepare your face and make your arm firm and prophesy against it.
Ezekiel 4:8 And behold, I have given bonds upon you, and do not turn from your side onto your side until the days of your confinement are completed. —
Ezekiel 4:9 And take for yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt and put them into one earthen vessel and make them into bread for yourself, and according to the number of the days which you sleep upon your side, a hundred and ninety days, you shall eat them.
Ezekiel 4:10 And your food which you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat them.
Ezekiel 4:11 And you shall drink water by measure, the sixth of a hin; from time to time you shall drink.
Ezekiel 4:12 And you shall eat them as a barley cake baked in ashes; in lumps of human dung you shall bake them before their eyes
Ezekiel 4:13 and say, Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel, Thus shall the sons of Israel eat unclean things among the nations.
Ezekiel 4:14 And I said, By no means, Lord God of Israel; behold, my soul has not been defiled in uncleanness, and I have not eaten anything dead of itself or taken by beasts from my birth until now, nor has any stale meat entered my mouth.
Ezekiel 4:15 And he said to me, Behold, I have given you cow dung instead of human dung, and you shall make your bread upon it.
Ezekiel 4:16 And he said to me, Son of man, behold, I break the support of bread in Ierusalem, and they shall eat bread by weight and in want and drink water by measure and in destruction,
Ezekiel 4:17 so that they become wanting bread and water; and a person and his brother will be destroyed and waste away in their injustices. —

## Chapter 5

Ezekiel 5:1 And you, son of man, take for yourself a sword sharper than a barber's razor; acquire it for yourself and bring it upon your head and upon your beard. And take a balance of weights and divide them;
Ezekiel 5:2 a fourth you shall burn with fire amid the city at the completion of the days of confinement; and take a fourth and burn it up in its midst; and a fourth you shall cut with a sword round about it; and a fourth you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw a sword behind them.
Ezekiel 5:3 And take from there a few in number and gather them in your mantle.
Ezekiel 5:4 And from these take yet more and throw them into the midst of the fire and burn them up with fire; from it fire will go out. And you shall say to all the house of Israel,
Ezekiel 5:5 Thus says the Lord, This is Ierusalem; I have placed her amid the nations and the countries round about her.
Ezekiel 5:6 And you shall speak my just requirements to the lawless woman from the nations and my statutes from the countries round about her, because they rejected my just requirements and did not walk in my statutes, in them.
Ezekiel 5:7 Therefore thus says the Lord, Because your impulse is from the nations round about you and you did not walk in my statutes and did not do my just requirements, but neither have you acted according to the just requirements of the nations round about you,
Ezekiel 5:8 therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I am against you and will execute judgment in your midst before the nations
Ezekiel 5:9 and do in you what I have not done and what I will not do the like of again, according to all your abominations.
Ezekiel 5:10 Therefore fathers shall eat children in your midst, and children shall eat fathers; and I will execute judgments in you and scatter all your remnants to every wind.
Ezekiel 5:11 Therefore, I live, says the Lord, surely because you defiled my holy things with all your abominations, I too will reject you; my eye will not spare, and I too will not have mercy.
Ezekiel 5:12 A fourth of you will be consumed in death; and a fourth of you will be brought to an end in famine in your midst; and a fourth of you I will scatter them to every wind; and a fourth of you will fall by sword round about you, and I will draw a sword behind them.
Ezekiel 5:13 And my wrath and my anger against them will be completed, and you will recognize that I the Lord have spoken in my zeal when I complete my anger against them.
Ezekiel 5:14 And I will make you a wilderness and your daughters round about you before everyone passing through,
Ezekiel 5:15 and you will be lamented and wretched among the nations round about you when I execute judgments in you in the vengeance of my wrath; I the Lord have spoken.
Ezekiel 5:16 When I send out my missiles of famine upon them, and they will be for failure, and I will break your support of bread.
Ezekiel 5:17 And I will send out famine and evil beasts against you and punish you, and death and blood will pass over you, and I will bring a sword against you round about; I the Lord have spoken.

## Chapter 6

Ezekiel 6:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 6:2 Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them
Ezekiel 6:3 and say, Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord: Thus says the Lord to the mountains and the hills and the ravines and the valleys, Behold, I bring a sword upon you, and your high places will be destroyed,
Ezekiel 6:4 and your altars and your precincts will be crushed, and I will cast down your wounded before your idols
Ezekiel 6:5 and scatter your bones round about your altars.
Ezekiel 6:6 In all your habitation the cities will be made desolate and the high places destroyed, so that your altars may be destroyed, and your idols will be crushed and your precincts removed,
Ezekiel 6:7 and wounded ones will fall in your midst, and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 6:8 When there are among you those escaping from sword among the nations and in your scattering in the countries,
Ezekiel 6:9 and those escaping among you will remember me among the nations where they were taken captive there; I have sworn against their heart which prostitutes itself away from me and against their eyes which prostitute themselves after their practices, and they will beat their faces for all their abominations;
Ezekiel 6:10 and they will recognize that I the Lord have spoken.
Ezekiel 6:11 Thus says the Lord, Clap with the hand and stamp with the foot and say, Well done, well done, over all the abominations of the house of Israel; by sword and by death and by famine they will fall.
Ezekiel 6:12 The one near will fall by sword, and the one far away will end in death, and the one enclosed will be brought to an end in famine, and I will complete my anger against them.
Ezekiel 6:13 And you will know that I am the Lord when your wounded are amid your idols round about your altars, upon every high hill and beneath a shady tree, where they gave there a fragrant smell to all their idols.
Ezekiel 6:14 And I will stretch my hand against them and make the land destruction and ruin, from the wilderness Deblatha, from all the habitation; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 7

Ezekiel 7:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 7:2 And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel, An end has come, the end has come upon the four wings of the earth;
Ezekiel 7:3 the end has come
Ezekiel 7:4 upon you who inhabit the land; the time has come, the day has drawn near, not with tumults nor with birth pangs.
Ezekiel 7:5 Now from nearby I will pour out my anger upon you and complete my wrath in you and judge you in your ways and bring all your abominations upon you;
Ezekiel 7:6 my eye will not spare, nor shall I have mercy, because I will bring your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will recognize that I am the Lord who strikes.
Ezekiel 7:7 Now the end is against you, and I will send against you and punish you in your ways and bring all your abominations upon you;
Ezekiel 7:8 my eye will not spare you, nor shall I have mercy, because I will bring your way upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 7:9 Because thus says the Lord,
Ezekiel 7:10 Behold, the end has come, behold, the day of the Lord; even if the rod has blossomed, insolence has risen up.
Ezekiel 7:11 And he will break the support of a lawless one, and not with tumult nor with haste.
Ezekiel 7:12 The time has come, behold, the day; let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not lament;
Ezekiel 7:13 because the buyer shall no longer return to the seller, and a person will not prevail in the eye of his life.
Ezekiel 7:14 Blow with a trumpet and judge all things together.
Ezekiel 7:15 War with sword outside, and famine and death within; the one in the plain will end by sword, but those in the city famine and death will bring to an end.
Ezekiel 7:16 And those escaping among them will escape and be upon the mountains; I will kill all, each in his injustices.
Ezekiel 7:17 All hands will grow faint, and all thighs will be defiled with moisture,
Ezekiel 7:18 and they will gird themselves with sackcloth, and amazement will cover them, and upon every face shame will be upon them, and upon every head baldness.
Ezekiel 7:19 Their silver will be thrown in the squares, and their gold will be disregarded; their souls shall certainly not be filled, and their bellies shall certainly not be filled; because it became a torment of their injustices.
Ezekiel 7:20 Choice ornaments they made into pride, and images of their abominations they made from them; for this reason I have given them to them for uncleanness.
Ezekiel 7:21 And I will hand them into the hands of foreigners to plunder them and to the pests of the earth as spoils, and they will profane them.
Ezekiel 7:22 And I will turn my face away from them, and they will defile my oversight and enter them without guard and profane them;
Ezekiel 7:23 and they will make a confusion, because the land is full of peoples and the city full of lawlessness.
Ezekiel 7:24 And I will turn away the arrogance of their strength, and their holy things will be defiled.
Ezekiel 7:25 Expiation will come and seek peace, and there will be none.
Ezekiel 7:26 Woe upon woe will be, and report upon report will be, and a vision will be sought from a prophet, and law will perish from a priest and counsel from elders.
Ezekiel 7:27 A ruler will clothe himself in destruction, and the hands of the people of the land will be paralyzed; according to their ways I will deal with them and in their judgments punish them; and they will know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 8

Ezekiel 8:1 And it happened in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth of the month, I sat in the house, and the elders of Iouda sat before me, and the hand of the Lord came upon me,
Ezekiel 8:2 and I saw, and behold, a likeness of a man, from his waist downward fire, and from his waist upward like the appearance of electrum.
Ezekiel 8:3 And he stretched a likeness of a hand and took me by my crown, and a spirit took me up between earth and heaven and brought me to Ierusalem in a vision of God, to the entrance of the inner gate facing north, where was the pillar of the possessor.
Ezekiel 8:4 And behold, there was the glory of the Lord God of Israel, according to the vision which I saw in the plain.
Ezekiel 8:5 And he said to me, Son of man, look up with your eyes toward the north; and I looked up with my eyes toward the north, and behold, from the north to the gate toward the east.
Ezekiel 8:6 And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what these do? They do great lawless deeds here, to keep away from my holy things; and you will yet see greater lawless deeds.
Ezekiel 8:7 And he brought me to the entrance of the court
Ezekiel 8:8 and said to me, Son of man, dig; and I dug, and behold, one door.
Ezekiel 8:9 And he said to me, Enter and see the lawless deeds which these do here;
Ezekiel 8:10 and I entered and saw, and behold, vain abominations and all the idols of the house of Israel drawn upon it round about,
Ezekiel 8:11 and seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel, and Iezonias son of Saphan stood amid them before their face, and each held his incense burner in the hand, and the vapor of the incense rose.
Ezekiel 8:12 And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do, each of them in their hidden chamber? Because they said, The Lord does not see, the Lord has abandoned the land.
Ezekiel 8:13 And he said to me, You will yet see greater lawless deeds which these do.
Ezekiel 8:14 And he brought me to the entrance of the gate of the Lord's house facing north, and behold, there women sat lamenting Thammouz,
Ezekiel 8:15 and he said to me, Son of man, have you seen? And you will yet see practices greater than these.
Ezekiel 8:16 And he brought me into the inner court of the Lord's house, and behold, at the entrance of the Lord's temple, between the ailam and the altar, about twenty men, their backs toward the Lord's temple and their faces opposite, and these worship the sun;
Ezekiel 8:17 and he said to me, Have you seen, son of man? Is it a small thing for the house of Iouda to do the lawless deeds which they have done here? Because they filled the land with lawlessness, and behold, they are as ones sneering.
Ezekiel 8:18 And I will deal with them in wrath; my eye will not spare, nor shall I have mercy.

## Chapter 9

Ezekiel 9:1 And he cried into my ears with a great voice, saying, The vengeance of the city has drawn near; and each held the instruments of destruction in his hand.
Ezekiel 9:2 And behold, six men were coming from the way of the high gate facing north, and each had an axe in his hand; and one man amid them clothed in a robe reaching the feet, and a sapphire girdle upon his waist; and they entered and stood adjoining the bronze altar.
Ezekiel 9:3 And the glory of the God of Israel, which was upon them, rose from the cheroubin to the open court of the house. And he called the man clothed in the robe reaching the feet, who had the girdle upon his waist,
Ezekiel 9:4 and said to him, Pass through the midst of Ierusalem and put the sign upon the foreheads of the men who groan and suffer over all the lawless deeds being done in her midst.
Ezekiel 9:5 And to these he said in my hearing, Go after him into the city and strike, and do not spare with your eyes and do not have mercy;
Ezekiel 9:6 kill elder and young man and maiden and infants and women unto obliteration, but do not draw near to any upon whom is the sign; and begin from my holy things. And they began from the elderly men who were within the house.
Ezekiel 9:7 And he said to them, Defile the house and fill the roads with dead ones, going out, and strike.
Ezekiel 9:8 And it happened as they struck, and I fall upon my face and cried out and said, Alas for me, Lord, are you obliterating the remnants of Israel when you pour out your wrath upon Ierusalem?
Ezekiel 9:9 And he said to me, The injustice of the house of Israel and Iouda has grown exceedingly, exceedingly great, because the land was filled with many peoples, and the city was filled with injustice and uncleanness; because they said, The Lord has abandoned the land, the Lord does not look upon it.
Ezekiel 9:10 And my eye will not spare, nor shall I have mercy; I have brought their ways upon their heads.
Ezekiel 9:11 And behold, the man clothed in the robe reaching the feet and girded with the girdle about his waist, and he answered, saying, I have done as you commanded me.

## Chapter 10

Ezekiel 10:1 And I saw, and behold, above the firmament over the head of the cheroubin, like a sapphire stone, a likeness of a throne upon them.
Ezekiel 10:2 And he said to the man clothed in the robe, Enter amid the wheels beneath the cheroubin and fill your handfuls with coals of fire from amid the cheroubin and scatter them upon the city; and he entered before me.
Ezekiel 10:3 And the cheroubin stood on the right of the house as the man entered, and the cloud filled the inner court.
Ezekiel 10:4 And the glory of the Lord rose from the cheroubin to the open court of the house, and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the radiance of the Lord's glory;
Ezekiel 10:5 and the sound of the wings of the cheroubin was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Saddai speaking.
Ezekiel 10:6 And it happened when he commanded the man clothed in the holy robe, saying, Take fire from amid the wheels, from amid the cheroubin, and he entered and stood adjoining the wheels,
Ezekiel 10:7 and he stretched his hand into the midst of the fire which was amid the cheroubin and took and gave into the hands of him clothed in the holy robe, and he took and went out.
Ezekiel 10:8 And I saw the cheroubin, a likeness of human hands beneath their wings.
Ezekiel 10:9 And I saw, and behold, four wheels stood adjoining the cheroubin, one wheel adjoining one cheroub, and the appearance of the wheels like the appearance of a carbuncle stone.
Ezekiel 10:10 And their appearance was one likeness for the four, as when a wheel is amid a wheel.
Ezekiel 10:11 As they went, they went toward their four sides; they did not turn as they went, because toward whatever place the one leading part looked, they went and did not turn as they went.
Ezekiel 10:12 And their backs and their hands and their wings and the wheels were full of eyes round about, for their four wheels;
Ezekiel 10:13 and these wheels were called Gelgel in my hearing;
Ezekiel 10:15 and the cheroubin rose. This is the living creature which I saw by the river Chobar.
Ezekiel 10:16 And when the cheroubin went, the wheels went, and these adjoined them; and when the cheroubin raised their wings to rise aloft from the earth, their wheels did not turn;
Ezekiel 10:17 when they stood, they stood, and when they rose aloft, they rose aloft with them, because a spirit of life was in them.
Ezekiel 10:18 And the glory of the Lord went out from the house and mounted upon the cheroubin,
Ezekiel 10:19 and the cheroubin took up their wings and rose aloft from the earth before me as they went out, and the wheels adjoined them, and they stood at the entrance of the opposite gate of the Lord's house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above upon them.
Ezekiel 10:20 This is the living creature which I saw beneath the God of Israel by the river Chobar, and I knew that they are cheroubin.
Ezekiel 10:21 Four faces to each, and eight wings to each, and a likeness of human hands beneath their wings.
Ezekiel 10:22 And the likeness of their faces, these are the faces which I saw beneath the glory of the God of Israel by the river Chobar, and each of them went facing their face.

## Chapter 11

Ezekiel 11:1 And a spirit took me up and brought me to the opposite gate of the Lord's house, facing east; and behold, at the entrance of the gate about twenty-five men, and I saw amid them Iezonias son of Ezer and Phaltias son of Banaias, the leaders of the people.
Ezekiel 11:2 And the Lord said to me, Son of man, these are the men who devise vain things and plan an evil plan in this city,
Ezekiel 11:3 who say, Have not the houses been built recently? This is the pot, and we the meat.
Ezekiel 11:4 Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, son of man.
Ezekiel 11:5 And the spirit of the Lord fell upon me and said to me, Say, Thus says the Lord, Thus you said, house of Israel, and I know the designs of your spirit.
Ezekiel 11:6 You multiplied your dead in this city and filled her roads with wounded ones.
Ezekiel 11:7 Therefore thus says the Lord, Your dead whom you struck in her midst, these are the meat, and she is the pot, and I will bring you out from her midst.
Ezekiel 11:8 You fear a sword, and I will bring a sword upon you, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 11:9 And I will bring you out from her midst and hand you into the hands of foreigners and execute judgments among you.
Ezekiel 11:10 You will fall by sword; upon the borders of Israel I will judge you; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 11:11 She will not be a pot for you, and you shall certainly not become meat in her midst; upon the borders of Israel I will judge you,
Ezekiel 11:12 and you will recognize that I am the Lord. —
Ezekiel 11:13 And it happened as I prophesied, and Phaltias son of Banaias died, and I fall upon my face and cried with a great voice and said, Alas, alas, Lord, you are bringing the remnants of Israel to an end.
Ezekiel 11:14 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 11:15 Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and all the house of Israel have been brought to an end, to whom those dwelling in Ierusalem said, Keep far away from the Lord; to us the land has been given for an inheritance.
Ezekiel 11:16 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, I will thrust them away into the nations and scatter them into all the earth, and I will be a small sanctuary for them in the countries where they enter there.
Ezekiel 11:17 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, And I will receive them from the nations and gather them from the countries where I scattered them in them, and give them the land of Israel.
Ezekiel 11:18 And they will enter there and remove all her abominations and all her lawless deeds from her.
Ezekiel 11:19 And I will give them another heart and put a new spirit in them and tear the stone heart out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
Ezekiel 11:20 so that they walk in my ordinances and keep my just requirements and do them; and they shall be a people to me, and I shall be God to them.
Ezekiel 11:21 And toward the heart of their abominations and their lawless deeds, as their heart went, I have brought their ways upon their heads, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 11:22 And the cheroubin raised their wings, and the wheels adjoined them, and the glory of the God of Israel was upon them above them;
Ezekiel 11:23 and the glory of the Lord rose from amid the city and stood upon the mountain which was opposite the city.
Ezekiel 11:24 And a spirit took me up and brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision, in the spirit of God; and I rose from the vision which I saw,
Ezekiel 11:25 and spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord which he showed me.

## Chapter 12

Ezekiel 12:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 12:2 Son of man, you dwell amid their injustices, who have eyes to see and do not see and have ears to hear and do not hear, because it is a house provoking to bitterness.
Ezekiel 12:3 And you, son of man, prepare for yourself the baggage of captivity by day before them and go into captivity from your place to another place before them, so that they may see, because it is a house provoking to bitterness.
Ezekiel 12:4 And you shall bring out your baggage as baggage of captivity by day before their eyes, and you shall go out in the evening as a captive goes out;
Ezekiel 12:5 before them dig through the wall for yourself and pass out through it;
Ezekiel 12:6 before them you shall be taken up upon shoulders and go out hidden; you shall cover your face and certainly not see the land; because I have made you a portent for the house of Israel.
Ezekiel 12:7 And I did thus according to all that he commanded me, and brought out baggage as baggage of captivity by day and in the evening dug through the wall for myself and went out hidden; I was taken up upon shoulders before them. —
Ezekiel 12:8 And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying,
Ezekiel 12:9 Son of man, did not the house of Israel, the house provoking to bitterness, say to you, What are you doing?
Ezekiel 12:10 Say to them, Thus says the Lord Lord, The ruler and the leader in Ierusalem and all the house of Israel who are in their midst,
Ezekiel 12:11 say that I perform portents in her midst; as I have done, so it will be for them; they will go in removal and in captivity,
Ezekiel 12:12 and the ruler in their midst will be lifted upon shoulders and go out hidden through the wall, and he will dig through to go out through it; he will cover his face so that he may not be seen by an eye, and he himself will not see the land.
Ezekiel 12:13 And I will spread my net over him, and he will be captured in my enclosure, and I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans, and he will not see it and will end there.
Ezekiel 12:14 And all those round about him, his helpers and all who support him, I will scatter to every wind and draw a sword behind them;
Ezekiel 12:15 and they will know that I am the Lord when I scatter them among the nations, and I will scatter them in the countries.
Ezekiel 12:16 And I will leave among them men few in number from sword and famine and death, so that they recount all their lawless deeds among the nations where they entered there; and they will know that I am the Lord. —
Ezekiel 12:17 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 12:18 Son of man, you shall eat your bread with pain and drink your water with torment and affliction
Ezekiel 12:19 and say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord to those dwelling in Ierusalem upon the land of Israel, They will eat their bread with want and drink their water with destruction, so that the land with its fullness may be destroyed, for all who dwell in it are in impiety;
Ezekiel 12:20 and their inhabited cities will be made desolate, and the land will be for destruction; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 12:21 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 12:22 Son of man, what is this proverb of yours upon the land of Israel, saying, The days are far away, a vision has perished?
Ezekiel 12:23 Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord, I will turn away this proverb, and the house of Israel shall no longer say this proverb, because you shall speak to them, The days and the word of every vision have drawn near;
Ezekiel 12:24 because there will no longer be any false vision and one divining pleasing things amid the sons of Israel,
Ezekiel 12:25 because I the Lord will speak my words, I will speak and do and certainly not delay any longer, because in your days, house provoking to bitterness, I will speak a word and do it, says the Lord. —
Ezekiel 12:26 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 12:27 Son of man, behold, the house of Israel provoking to bitterness, saying, they say, The vision which this one sees is for many days, and this one prophesies for distant times.
Ezekiel 12:28 Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord, All my words which I speak shall certainly no longer be delayed; I will speak and do, says the Lord.

## Chapter 13

Ezekiel 13:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 13:2 Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and you shall prophesy and say to them, Hear the word of the Lord,
Ezekiel 13:3 Thus says the Lord, Woe to those prophesying from their heart and seeing nothing at all.
Ezekiel 13:4 Your prophets, Israel, are like foxes in the wildernesses;
Ezekiel 13:5 they did not stand in a firm position and gathered flocks against the house of Israel; those saying, On the day of the Lord, did not rise;
Ezekiel 13:6 seeing false things, divining vain things, those saying, The Lord says, and the Lord has not sent them, and they began to establish a word.
Ezekiel 13:7 Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?
Ezekiel 13:8 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, Because your words are false and your divinations vain, therefore behold, I am against you, says the Lord,
Ezekiel 13:9 and I will stretch my hand against the prophets who see false things and utter vain things; they will not be in the discipline of my people nor be inscribed in the register of the house of Israel, and they will not enter the land of Israel; and they will know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 13:10 Because they misled my people, saying, Peace, peace, and there was no peace, and this one builds a wall, and they plaster it, whether it will fall,
Ezekiel 13:11 say to those plastering, It will fall, and there will be flooding rain, and I will put stones for hurling against their joints, and they will fall, and a lifting wind, and it will be torn apart.
Ezekiel 13:12 And behold, the wall has fallen, and will they not say to you, Where is your plaster which you plastered?
Ezekiel 13:13 Therefore thus says the Lord, And I will break forth a lifting blast with wrath, and flooding rain will be in my anger, and I will bring the stones for hurling in wrath unto an end
Ezekiel 13:14 and tear down the wall which you plastered, and it will fall; and I will lay it upon the earth, and its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with reproofs; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 13:15 And I will complete my wrath against the wall and against those plastering it, and it will fall. And I said to you, There is no wall nor those plastering it,
Ezekiel 13:16 prophets of Israel who prophesy concerning Ierusalem and who see peace for her, and there is no peace, says the Lord. —
Ezekiel 13:17 And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their heart and prophesy against them
Ezekiel 13:18 and say, Thus says the Lord, Woe to those sewing cushions upon every elbow of an arm and making coverings upon every head of every age, to pervert souls; the souls of my people were perverted, and they preserved souls.
Ezekiel 13:19 And they profaned me toward my people for a handful of barley and for fragments of bread, to kill souls which ought not to die and to preserve souls which ought not to live, when you utter things to a people who hear vain utterances.
Ezekiel 13:20 Therefore thus says the Lord Lord, Behold, I am against your cushions upon which you entangle souls there, and I will tear them from your arms and send out the souls whose souls you pervert, into scattering;
Ezekiel 13:21 and I will tear your coverings and rescue my people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hands for entanglement; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 13:22 Because you perverted the heart of a righteous one unjustly, and I did not pervert him, and strengthened the hands of a lawless one so that he should not at all turn from his evil way and live,
Ezekiel 13:23 therefore you shall certainly not see false things nor divine divinations any longer, and I will rescue my people from your hand; and you will know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 14

Ezekiel 14:1 And men from the elders of Israel came to me and sat before my face.
Ezekiel 14:2 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 14:3 Son of man, these men placed their thoughts upon their hearts and set the punishment of their injustices before their face; shall I, answering, answer them?
Ezekiel 14:4 Therefore speak to them and say to them, Thus says the Lord, Any person from the house of Israel who places his thoughts upon his heart and sets the punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to the prophet, I the Lord will answer him in the things in which his thought is entangled,
Ezekiel 14:5 so that he turn the house of Israel aside according to their hearts alienated from me in their thoughts.
Ezekiel 14:6 Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord Lord, Return and turn away from your practices and from all your impieties and turn your faces.
Ezekiel 14:7 Because any person from the house of Israel and from the sojourners sojourning in Israel who is alienated from me and places his thoughts upon his heart and sets the punishment of his injustice before his face and comes to the prophet to inquire of him concerning me, I the Lord will answer him in that in which he is entangled in it;
Ezekiel 14:8 and I will set my face against that person and make him a wilderness and destruction and remove him from amid my people; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 14:9 And if the prophet is misled and speaks, I the Lord have misled that prophet and will stretch my hand against him and destroy him from amid my people Israel.
Ezekiel 14:10 And they will bear their injustice; according to the wrong of the inquirer and according to the wrong, likewise it will be for the prophet,
Ezekiel 14:11 so that the house of Israel may no longer stray from me, and that they may no longer be defiled in all their transgressions; and they shall be a people to me, and I shall be God to them, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 14:12 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 14:13 Son of man, if a land sins against me by committing a transgression, and I stretch my hand against it and break its support of bread and send out famine upon it and remove human and beasts from it,
Ezekiel 14:14 and if these three men are in its midst, Noe and Daniel and Iob, they will be saved in their righteousness, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 14:15 And if I bring evil beasts upon the land and punish it and it becomes destruction and there is none passing through from the face of the beasts,
Ezekiel 14:16 and these three men are in its midst, I live, says the Lord, no sons or daughters will be saved, but they alone will be saved, and the land will become ruin.
Ezekiel 14:17 Or also if I bring a sword upon that land and say, Let a sword pass through the land, and I remove human and beast from it,
Ezekiel 14:18 and these three men are in its midst, I live, says the Lord, they shall certainly not rescue sons nor daughters; they alone will be saved.
Ezekiel 14:19 Or also if I send death upon that land and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to destroy human and beast from it,
Ezekiel 14:20 and Noe and Daniel and Iob are in its midst, I live, says the Lord, no sons or daughters shall be left; they in their righteousness will rescue their souls.
Ezekiel 14:21 Thus says the Lord, But if I also send out my four evil acts of vengeance, sword and famine and evil beasts and death, upon Ierusalem, to destroy human and beast from her,
Ezekiel 14:22 and behold, left in her are her survivors who bring sons and daughters out of her, behold, they go out to you, and you will see their ways and their thoughts and change your mind concerning the evils which I brought upon Ierusalem, all the evils which I brought upon her,
Ezekiel 14:23 and they will comfort you, because you will see their ways and their thoughts and recognize that I have not done in vain all that I did in her, says the Lord.

## Chapter 15

Ezekiel 15:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 15:2 And you, son of man, what could the wood of the vine become, among all the wood of the branches which are among the trees of the forest?
Ezekiel 15:3 Will they take wood from it to make it into workmanship? Will they take a peg from it to hang any vessel upon it?
Ezekiel 15:4 Except that it has been given to fire for consumption; the yearly pruning from it the fire consumes, and it fails utterly; will it be useful for workmanship?
Ezekiel 15:5 Not even while it is still whole will it be for workmanship. Much less, if fire also consumes it utterly, will it still be for workmanship?
Ezekiel 15:6 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, As the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to fire for consumption, so I have given those dwelling in Ierusalem.
Ezekiel 15:7 And I will set my face against them; they will go out from fire, and fire will devour them, and they will recognize that I am the Lord when I set my face against them.
Ezekiel 15:8 And I will give the land to destruction because they committed a transgression, says the Lord.

## Chapter 16

Ezekiel 16:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 16:2 Son of man, testify to Ierusalem concerning her lawless deeds
Ezekiel 16:3 and say, Thus says the Lord to Ierusalem, Your root and your birth are from the land of Chanaan; your father an Amorrite, and your mother a Chettaia.
Ezekiel 16:4 And your birth: on the day when you were born, they did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water nor salted with salt nor wrapped in swaddling clothes,
Ezekiel 16:5 nor did my eye spare you, to do one of all these things for you, to feel anything for you, and you were cast upon the face of the plain in the crookedness of your soul on the day when you were born.
Ezekiel 16:6 And I passed by you and saw you smeared in your blood and said to you, From your blood, life;
Ezekiel 16:7 multiply; like the sprouting of the field I have made you. And you multiplied and grew great and entered cities of cities; your breasts were raised, and your hair grew, but you were naked and indecent.
Ezekiel 16:8 And I passed through you and saw you, and behold, your time was a time of those lodging, and I spread my wings over you and covered your indecency; and I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became mine.
Ezekiel 16:9 And I washed you in water and washed your blood off you and anointed you with oil
Ezekiel 16:10 and clothed you in embroidered things and shod you in blue and girded you with fine linen and wrapped you in woven hair,
Ezekiel 16:11 and adorned you with adornment and placed bracelets around your hands and a necklace around your neck,
Ezekiel 16:12 and put a ring around your nostril and little rings upon your ears and a crown of boasting upon your head;
Ezekiel 16:13 and you were adorned with gold and silver, and your coverings were fine linen and woven hair and embroidery; you ate fine flour and oil and honey and became exceedingly beautiful.
Ezekiel 16:14 And your name went out among the nations in your beauty, because it was perfected in comeliness, in the beauty which I set upon you, says the Lord. —
Ezekiel 16:15 And you trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself on account of your name and poured out your prostitution upon every passerby, which shall not be.
Ezekiel 16:16 And you took from your garments and made sewn idols for yourself and prostituted yourself upon them; and you shall certainly not enter, nor shall it happen.
Ezekiel 16:17 And you took the vessels of your boasting from my gold and from my silver, from what I gave you, and made male images for yourself and prostituted yourself with them;
Ezekiel 16:18 and you took your embroidered apparel and clothed them, and my oil and my incense you placed before their face;
Ezekiel 16:19 and my bread which I gave you — fine flour and oil and honey I fed you — and you placed them before their face for a fragrant smell; and it happened, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 16:20 And you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore and sacrificed them to them for consumption, as though your prostitution were a small thing,
Ezekiel 16:21 and slaughtered your children and gave them when you performed rites of aversion with them.
Ezekiel 16:22 This beyond all your prostitution, and you did not remember the days of your infancy, when you were naked and indecent and lived smeared in your blood.
Ezekiel 16:23 And it happened after all your wickedness, says the Lord,
Ezekiel 16:24 and you built yourself a house of prostitution and made yourself an exposed place in every square,
Ezekiel 16:25 and at the beginning of every road you built your brothels and ruined your beauty and spread your legs for every passerby and multiplied your prostitution;
Ezekiel 16:26 and you prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, your neighbors, great of flesh, and prostituted yourself in many ways to provoke me to anger.
Ezekiel 16:27 But if I stretch my hand against you, and I will remove your statutes and hand you over to the desires of those who hate you, daughters of foreigners who turn you aside from your way in which you acted impiously.
Ezekiel 16:28 And you prostituted yourself with the daughters of Assour and were not filled even thus; and you prostituted yourself and were not filled.
Ezekiel 16:29 And you multiplied your covenants toward the land of the Chaldeans and were not filled even with these.
Ezekiel 16:30 How shall I deal with your daughter, says the Lord, when you do all these things, works of a prostitute woman? And you prostituted yourself threefold
Ezekiel 16:31 in your daughters; you built your brothel at every beginning of a road and made your platform in every square and became like a prostitute gathering wages.
Ezekiel 16:32 The adulterous woman is like you, receiving wages from her husband;
Ezekiel 16:33 she gave wages to all who prostituted her, and you have given wages to all your lovers and loaded them with gifts to come to you from round about in your prostitution.
Ezekiel 16:34 And in you it became reversed in comparison with women in your prostitution, and they have prostituted themselves with you when you gave wages, and wages were not given to you, and in you things became reversed. —
Ezekiel 16:35 Therefore, prostitute, hear the word of the Lord,
Ezekiel 16:36 Thus says the Lord, Because you poured out your bronze, and your shame will be uncovered in your prostitution toward your lovers and in all the thoughts of your lawless deeds and in the blood of your children whom you gave them.
Ezekiel 16:37 Therefore behold, I gather all your lovers against you, with whom you mingled among them, and all whom you loved, with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you round about and uncover your wickedness to them, and they will see all your shame;
Ezekiel 16:38 and I will punish you with the punishment of an adulteress and one pouring out blood and place you in blood of wrath and jealousy.
Ezekiel 16:39 And I will hand you into their hands, and they will tear down your brothel and pull down your platform and strip you of your apparel and take the vessels of your boasting and leave you naked and indecent.
Ezekiel 16:40 And they will bring crowds against you and stone you with stones and slaughter you with their swords.
Ezekiel 16:41 And they will burn your houses with fire and execute acts of vengeance in you before many women; and I will turn you away from your prostitution, and you shall certainly no longer give wages.
Ezekiel 16:42 And I will let my wrath loose upon you, and my jealousy will be removed from you, and I will rest and certainly no longer be concerned.
Ezekiel 16:43 Because you did not remember the day of your infancy and grieved me in all these things, and behold, I have brought your ways upon your head, says the Lord; and thus you committed impiety on top of all your lawless deeds.
Ezekiel 16:44 These are all the things which they said against you in a proverb, saying, As the mother, so the daughter.
Ezekiel 16:45 You are a daughter of your mother who rejected her husband and her children, and a sister of your sisters who rejected their husbands and their children; your mother a Chettaia, and your father an Amorrite.
Ezekiel 16:46 Your elder sister is Samareia, she and her daughters, who dwells on your left; and your sister younger than you, who dwells on your right, is Sodoma and her daughters.
Ezekiel 16:47 And not even thus did you walk in their ways nor act according to their lawless deeds; in a little while you surpassed them in all your ways.
Ezekiel 16:48 I live, says the Lord, your sister Sodoma, she and her daughters, has not done as you and your daughters did.
Ezekiel 16:49 But this was the lawless deed of Sodoma your sister: pride; in fullness of bread and abundance of wine she and her daughters lived luxuriously; this belonged to her and her daughters, and they did not support the hand of a poor and needy one.
Ezekiel 16:50 And they boasted greatly and committed lawless deeds before me, and I removed them as I saw.
Ezekiel 16:51 And Samareia did not sin according to half your sins; and you multiplied your lawless deeds beyond them and justified your sisters in all your lawless deeds which you did.
Ezekiel 16:52 And you, bear your torment, in which you corrupted your sisters by your sins in which you acted lawlessly beyond them and justified them beyond yourself; and you, be ashamed and receive your dishonor when you justify your sisters.
Ezekiel 16:53 And I will turn back their reversals, the reversal of Sodoma and her daughters, and turn back the reversal of Samareia and her daughters, and turn back your reversal in their midst,
Ezekiel 16:54 so that you bear your torment and be dishonored for all that you did when you provoked me to anger.
Ezekiel 16:55 And your sister Sodoma and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning, and Samareia and her daughters will be restored as they were from the beginning, and you and your daughters will be restored as you were from the beginning.
Ezekiel 16:56 And was not Sodoma your sister a report in your mouth in the days of your pride,
Ezekiel 16:57 before your wickedness was uncovered, as now you are a reproach of daughters of Syria and all those round about her, daughters of foreigners surrounding you round about?
Ezekiel 16:58 Your impieties and your lawless deeds, you have borne them, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 16:59 Thus says the Lord, And I will deal with you as you did, as you dishonored these things by transgressing my covenant.
Ezekiel 16:60 And I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your infancy and establish an everlasting covenant for you.
Ezekiel 16:61 And you will remember your way and be utterly dishonored when you receive your sisters older than you together with those younger than you, and I will give them to you for building up and not from your covenant.
Ezekiel 16:62 And I will establish my covenant with you, and you will recognize that I am the Lord,
Ezekiel 16:63 so that you remember and be ashamed, and it may no longer be yours to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I make expiation for you for all that you did, says the Lord.

## Chapter 17

Ezekiel 17:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 17:2 Son of man, recount a narrative and speak a parable to the house of Israel
Ezekiel 17:3 and say, Thus says the Lord, The great eagle, great of wing, long in span, full of claws, who has the leading role to enter Lebanon, and he took the choice parts of the cedar,
Ezekiel 17:4 he nipped off the tips of the tender growth and brought them to the land of Chanaan, placed them in a walled city.
Ezekiel 17:5 And he took from the seed of the land and placed it in the plain, a plant by much water; he appointed it to be watched over.
Ezekiel 17:6 And it sprouted and became a weak vine and small in size to appear; its branches were upon it, and its roots were beneath it. And it became a vine and made shoots and stretched its climbing growth.
Ezekiel 17:7 And there was another great eagle, great of wing, abundant in claws, and behold, this vine was entwined toward him, and its roots toward him, and it sent out its branches to him to water it with the clod of its planting.
Ezekiel 17:8 In a good plain by much water this one is nourished, to make shoots and bear fruit, to become a great vine.
Ezekiel 17:9 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, Will it prosper? Will not the roots of its tender growth and the fruit rot, and all its early growth dry up? And not with a great arm nor with many people to tear it out from its roots.
Ezekiel 17:10 And behold, it is nourished; will it prosper? Will it not, as soon as the scorching wind touches it, dry up with drying? With the clod of its sprouting it will dry up.
Ezekiel 17:11 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 17:12 Son of man, say indeed to the house provoking to bitterness, Do you not know what these things were? Say, When the king of Babylon comes against Ierusalem, and he will take her king and her rulers and bring them to himself to Babylon.
Ezekiel 17:13 And he will take from the seed of the kingship and make a covenant with him and bring him under a curse; and he will take the leaders of the land,
Ezekiel 17:14 that it become a weak kingdom, not to be raised at all, to keep his covenant and establish it.
Ezekiel 17:15 And he will revolt from him, to send out his own messengers to Egypt to give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does contrary things be saved? And transgressing a covenant, will he be saved?
Ezekiel 17:16 I live, says the Lord, surely in the place of the king who made him king, he who dishonored my curse and transgressed my covenant, with him amid Babylon he will end.
Ezekiel 17:17 And not with great power nor with a great crowd will Pharao make war for him, in casting up a rampart and in building missile stations to take away souls.
Ezekiel 17:18 And he dishonored an oath by transgressing a covenant, and behold, he has given his hand and did all these things to him; will he be saved?
Ezekiel 17:19 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, I live, surely my covenant which he transgressed and my oath which he dishonored, I will bring them upon his head.
Ezekiel 17:20 And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in his enclosure.
Ezekiel 17:21 In all his battle array they will fall by sword, and the remnants I will scatter to every wind; and you will recognize that I the Lord have spoken. —
Ezekiel 17:22 Because thus says the Lord, And I will take from the choice parts of the cedar, from the top of their heart I will nip off and I will plant upon a high mountain; and I will hang him
Ezekiel 17:23 on a lofty mountain of Israel and plant, and it will bring out a shoot and make fruit and become a great cedar, and every beast will rest beneath it, and every bird will rest under its shadow; its branches will be restored.
Ezekiel 17:24 And all the trees of the plain will know that I am the Lord who humbles a high tree and raises a low tree and dries a green tree and makes a dry tree flourish; I the Lord have spoken and will do.

## Chapter 18

Ezekiel 18:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 18:2 Son of man, what is this proverb of yours among the sons of Israel, saying, The fathers ate unripe grapes, and the children's teeth were set on edge?
Ezekiel 18:3 I live, says the Lord, this proverb shall no longer be spoken in Israel;
Ezekiel 18:4 because all souls are mine; as the father's soul, so also the son's soul, they are mine; the soul that sins, it will die. —
Ezekiel 18:5 But the person who is righteous, doing judgment and righteousness,
Ezekiel 18:6 will not eat upon the mountains and certainly not lift his eyes toward the thoughts of the house of Israel and certainly not defile his neighbor's wife and not approach a woman in menstruation,
Ezekiel 18:7 and certainly not oppress a person, will return a debtor's pledge and does not seize plunder, will give his bread to the hungry and clothe a naked one,
Ezekiel 18:8 and will not give his silver at interest and not take an excess and turn his hand away from injustice, will execute righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor,
Ezekiel 18:9 and has walked in my ordinances and kept my just requirements to do them, this one is righteous, he will live with life, says the Lord. —
Ezekiel 18:10 And if he begets a pestilent son who pours out blood and commits sins,
Ezekiel 18:11 he did not walk in the way of his righteous father, but also ate upon the mountains and defiled his neighbor's wife,
Ezekiel 18:12 and oppressed a poor and needy one and seized plunder and did not return a pledge and set his eyes upon the idols, has committed lawlessness,
Ezekiel 18:13 gave at interest and took an excess, this one will not live with life; he did all these lawless deeds; by death he will be put to death, his blood will be upon him. —
Ezekiel 18:14 But if he begets a son, and he sees all his father's sins which he did, and fears and does not act according to these,
Ezekiel 18:15 has not eaten upon the mountains and did not set his eyes upon the thoughts of the house of Israel and did not defile his neighbor's wife,
Ezekiel 18:16 and did not oppress a person and did not take a pledge and did not seize plunder, gave his bread to the hungry and clothed a naked one,
Ezekiel 18:17 and turned his hand away from injustice, did not take interest nor excess, did righteousness and walked in my ordinances, he will not end in his father's injustices; he will live with life.
Ezekiel 18:18 But his father, if afflicting he afflicts and seizes plunder, did contrary things amid my people and will die in his injustice. —
Ezekiel 18:19 And you will say, Why did the son not bear his father's injustice? Because the son did righteousness and mercy, kept all my statutes and did them; he will live with life.
Ezekiel 18:20 But the soul that sins will die; the son will not bear his father's injustice, nor will the father bear his son's injustice; the righteousness of a righteous one will be upon him, and the lawlessness of a lawless one will be upon him.
Ezekiel 18:21 And if the lawless one turns from all his lawless deeds which he did and keeps all my commandments and does righteousness and mercy, he will live with life, shall certainly not die.
Ezekiel 18:22 All his transgressions which he did will not be remembered; in his righteousness which he did he will live.
Ezekiel 18:23 Would I desire with desire the death of the lawless one, says the Lord, rather than his turning from his evil way and living?
Ezekiel 18:24 But when a righteous one turns from his righteousness and does injustice according to all the lawless deeds which the lawless one did, all his righteous deeds which he did shall certainly not be remembered; in his transgression which he committed and in his sins which he sinned, in them he will die. —
Ezekiel 18:25 And you said, The Lord's way is not straight. Hear indeed, all the house of Israel; is my way not straight? Is it not your way that is not straight?
Ezekiel 18:26 When the righteous one turns from his righteousness and commits a transgression and dies, in the transgression which he did, in it he will die.
Ezekiel 18:27 And when a lawless one turns from his lawlessness which he did and executes judgment and righteousness, this one preserved his soul
Ezekiel 18:28 and turned from all his impieties which he did; he will live with life, shall certainly not die.
Ezekiel 18:29 And the house of Israel says, The Lord's way does not go rightly. Does my way not go rightly, house of Israel? Is it not your way that does not go rightly?
Ezekiel 18:30 Each according to his way I will judge you, house of Israel, says the Lord; return and turn away from all your impieties, and they will not be a punishment of injustice for you.
Ezekiel 18:31 Cast away from yourselves all your impieties which you committed against me and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why do you die, house of Israel?
Ezekiel 18:32 Because I do not desire the death of him who dies, says the Lord.

## Chapter 19

Ezekiel 19:1 And you, take up a lament over the ruler of Israel
Ezekiel 19:2 and say, What is your mother? A cub; she became amid lions, amid lions she multiplied her cubs.
Ezekiel 19:3 And one of her cubs leaped away, became a lion and learned to seize plunder, ate people.
Ezekiel 19:4 And nations heard against him, he was captured in their destruction, and they brought him in a muzzle to the land of Egypt.
Ezekiel 19:5 And she saw that he was rejected from her and her confidence perished, and she took another of her cubs, appointed him a lion.
Ezekiel 19:6 And he moved about amid lions, became a lion and learned to seize plunder, ate people;
Ezekiel 19:7 and he ranged in his boldness and made their cities desolate and destroyed a land and its fullness from the sound of his roaring.
Ezekiel 19:8 And nations from countries round about set against him and spread their nets over him; he was captured in their destruction;
Ezekiel 19:9 and they placed him in a muzzle and in a cage, he came to the king of Babylon, and he brought him into prison, so that his voice should not be heard upon the mountains of Israel. —
Ezekiel 19:10 Your mother is like a vine, like a flower in a pomegranate tree planted in water; her fruit and her shoot came from much water.
Ezekiel 19:11 And she had a rod of strength over a tribe of leaders, and she was raised in her size amid trunks and saw her size in the multitude of her branches.
Ezekiel 19:12 And she was broken in wrath, thrown upon earth, and the scorching wind dried her choice parts; her rod of strength was punished and dried up, fire consumed it.
Ezekiel 19:13 And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land;
Ezekiel 19:14 and fire went out from a rod of her choice parts and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her. A tribe is for a parable of lament and will be for lament.

## Chapter 20

Ezekiel 20:1 And it happened in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of the house of Israel came to inquire of the Lord and sat before my face.
Ezekiel 20:2 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 20:3 Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, Thus says the Lord, Do you come to inquire of me? I live, I will not answer you, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 20:4 Shall I punish them with punishment? Son of man, testify to them concerning their fathers' lawless deeds
Ezekiel 20:5 and say to them, Thus says the Lord, From the day when I chose the house of Israel and made myself known to the seed of the house of Iakob and became known to them in the land of Egypt and took hold of them with my hand, saying, I am the Lord your God,
Ezekiel 20:6 on that day I took hold of them with my hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt into the land which I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb beyond all the earth.
Ezekiel 20:7 And I said to them, Let each cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not be defiled in the practices of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
Ezekiel 20:8 And they revolted from me and did not wish to hear me, did not cast away the abominations of their eyes and did not abandon the practices of Egypt. And I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them, to complete my anger among them amid the land of Egypt.
Ezekiel 20:9 And I acted so that my name should not be profaned at all before the nations among whom they are, among whom I became known to them before them by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
Ezekiel 20:10 And I brought them out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the wilderness
Ezekiel 20:11 and gave them my ordinances and made my just requirements known to them, which a person shall do and live in them.
Ezekiel 20:12 And I gave them my sabbaths to be a sign between me and them, that they know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
Ezekiel 20:13 And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, Walk in my ordinances. And they did not walk and rejected my just requirements which a person shall do and live in them, and greatly profaned my sabbaths. And I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness to consume them.
Ezekiel 20:14 And I acted so that my name should not be profaned at all before the nations before whose eyes I brought them out.
Ezekiel 20:15 And I raised my hand against them in the wilderness, not at all to bring them into the land which I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb beyond all the earth,
Ezekiel 20:16 because they rejected my just requirements and did not walk in my ordinances, in them, and profaned my sabbaths and went after the thoughts of their hearts.
Ezekiel 20:17 And my eye spared them from obliterating them, and I did not bring them to an end in the wilderness.
Ezekiel 20:18 And I said to their children in the wilderness, Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers and do not keep their just requirements and do not mingle in their practices and do not be defiled;
Ezekiel 20:19 I am the Lord your God; walk in my ordinances and keep my just requirements and do them,
Ezekiel 20:20 and sanctify my sabbaths, and let them be a sign between me and you, to know that I am the Lord your God.
Ezekiel 20:21 And their children also provoked me to bitterness; they did not walk in my ordinances and did not keep my just requirements to do them, which a person shall do and live in them, and profaned my sabbaths. And I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to complete my anger against them;
Ezekiel 20:22 and I acted so that my name should not be profaned at all before the nations before whose eyes I brought them out.
Ezekiel 20:23 And I raised my hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the countries,
Ezekiel 20:24 because they did not do my just requirements and rejected my ordinances and profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers' thoughts.
Ezekiel 20:25 And I gave them ordinances not good and just requirements in which they will not live in them.
Ezekiel 20:26 And I will defile them in their gifts when I pass through every thing opening a womb, so that I destroy them.
Ezekiel 20:27 Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, Thus says the Lord, Until this your fathers provoked me to anger in their transgressions in which they transgressed against me.
Ezekiel 20:28 And I brought them into the land for which I raised my hand to give it to them, and they saw every high hill and every shady tree and sacrificed there to their gods and appointed there a fragrant smell and poured out their libations there.
Ezekiel 20:29 And I said to them, What is Abama, that you enter there? And they called its name Abama until this day.
Ezekiel 20:30 Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord, Are you defiled in your fathers' lawless deeds and do you prostitute yourselves after their abominations?
Ezekiel 20:31 And in the firstfruits of your gifts, in the things set apart, you are defiled in all your thoughts until this day. And shall I answer you, house of Israel? I live, says the Lord, I will not answer you, nor shall this rise upon your spirit.
Ezekiel 20:32 And it will not be as you say, We shall be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, to serve wood and stones.
Ezekiel 20:33 Therefore I live, says the Lord, with a mighty hand and a high arm and wrath poured out I will reign over you;
Ezekiel 20:34 and I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered in them, with a mighty hand and a high arm and wrath poured out;
Ezekiel 20:35 and I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and contend with you there face to face.
Ezekiel 20:36 As I contended with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord;
Ezekiel 20:37 and I will lead you under my rod and bring you in by number
Ezekiel 20:38 and select from among you the impious and the rebels, because I will bring them out from their sojourning, and they will not enter the land of Israel; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 20:39 And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord Lord, Remove, each, his practices; and after these things, surely you will hear me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and your practices;
Ezekiel 20:40 because upon my holy mountain, upon a high mountain, says the Lord Lord, there all the house of Israel will serve me completely, and there I will receive and there I will inspect your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your things set apart in all your holy things;
Ezekiel 20:41 in a fragrant smell I will receive you when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries in which you were scattered in them, and I will be sanctified among you before the eyes of the peoples.
Ezekiel 20:42 And you will recognize that I am the Lord when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land for which I raised my hand to give it to your fathers.
Ezekiel 20:43 And there you will remember your ways and your practices in which you were defiled in them, and beat your faces for all your wickedness.
Ezekiel 20:44 And you will recognize that I am the Lord when I deal thus with you so that my name may not be profaned according to your evil ways and according to your corrupted practices, says the Lord.

## Chapter 21

Ezekiel 21:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 21:2 Son of man, set your face against Thaiman and look upon Darom and prophesy against the leading forest Nageb
Ezekiel 21:3 and say to the forest Nageb, Hear the word of the Lord: Thus says the Lord Lord, Behold, I kindle fire in you, and it will devour in you every green tree and every dry tree; the kindled flame will not be quenched, and in it every face will be burned from east to north;
Ezekiel 21:4 and all flesh will recognize that I the Lord burned it, and it will not be quenched.
Ezekiel 21:5 And I said, By no means, Lord Lord; they say to me, Is not this spoken as a parable?
Ezekiel 21:6 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 21:7 Therefore prophesy, son of man, and set your face against Ierusalem and look upon their holy things and prophesy against the land of Israel
Ezekiel 21:8 and say to the land of Israel, Behold, I am against you and will draw my dagger from its sheath and destroy unjust and lawless from you;
Ezekiel 21:9 because I will destroy unjust and lawless from you, so my dagger will go out from its sheath against all flesh from east to north;
Ezekiel 21:10 and all flesh will recognize that I the Lord drew my dagger from its sheath, and it will no longer return.
Ezekiel 21:11 And you, son of man, groan with the crushing of your waist and groan in pains before their eyes.
Ezekiel 21:12 And it will be, if they say to you, For what do you groan? And you shall say, Over the report, because it comes, and every heart will be shattered, and all hands will be paralyzed, and all flesh and every spirit will faint, and all thighs will be defiled with moisture; behold, it comes and will be, says the Lord Lord. —
Ezekiel 21:13 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 21:14 Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and be enraged,
Ezekiel 21:15 so that you slaughter victims; be sharpened so that you become glittering; ready for paralysis, slaughter, despise, thrust away every tree.
Ezekiel 21:16 And he made it ready for his hand to hold; a sword was whetted, it is ready to be given into the hand of one piercing through.
Ezekiel 21:17 Cry out and howl, son of man, because it came among my people, it among all the leaders of Israel; they will sojourn upon sword, it came among my people; therefore clap upon your hand.
Ezekiel 21:18 Because it has been justified; and what if even a tribe was rejected? It will not be, says the Lord Lord.
Ezekiel 21:19 And you, son of man, prophesy and clap hand upon hand and double a sword; the third sword of wounded ones is the great sword of wounded ones and will dismay them,
Ezekiel 21:20 so that the heart may be shattered and the weak multiplied at every gate of theirs; they have been handed over as victims of sword; it has been made well for slaughter, made well for glittering.
Ezekiel 21:21 Pass through, be sharpened on the right and on the left, wherever your face is stirred up.
Ezekiel 21:22 And I too will clap my hand against my hand and let my wrath loose; I the Lord have spoken. —
Ezekiel 21:23 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 21:24 And you, son of man, arrange for yourself two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to enter; from one country the two will go out, and a hand at the beginning of a city's road; at the beginning
Ezekiel 21:25 of a road you shall arrange for a sword to enter against Rabbath of the sons of Ammon and against Ioudaia and against Ierusalem in her midst.
Ezekiel 21:26 Because the king of Babylon will stand upon the ancient road at the beginning of the two roads to divine a divination, to shake a rod and inquire among the carved images and inspect a liver on his right.
Ezekiel 21:27 The oracle came against Ierusalem, to cast a rampart, to open a mouth in shouting, to raise a voice with a cry, to cast a rampart against her gates and cast a mound and build missile stations.
Ezekiel 21:28 And he is to them as one divining a divination before them, and he reminding of his injustices, to be remembered.
Ezekiel 21:29 Therefore thus says the Lord, Because you brought your injustices to remembrance when your impieties were uncovered, so that your sins might be seen in all your impieties and in your practices, because you brought them to remembrance, in these you will be caught.
Ezekiel 21:30 And you, profane lawless leader of Israel, whose day has come, an end in a time of injustice,
Ezekiel 21:31 thus says the Lord, You removed the turban and put on the crown; this will not be such; you humbled the high and raised the low.
Ezekiel 21:32 Injustice, injustice I will make it, nor will this be such, until he comes to whom it belongs, and I will hand it to him. —
Ezekiel 21:33 And you, son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord to the sons of Ammon and to their reproach, and you shall say, Sword, sword, drawn for victims and drawn for an end, arise so that you glitter
Ezekiel 21:34 in your vain vision and in your divining false things, to hand you over upon the necks of lawless wounded ones whose day has come, an end in a time of injustice.
Ezekiel 21:35 Turn back, do not lodge in this place where you were born; in your own land I will judge you
Ezekiel 21:36 and pour out my anger upon you, with the fire of my anger blow upon you and hand you into the hands of barbarous men fashioning destruction.
Ezekiel 21:37 In fire you will be food; your blood will be amid your land; there shall certainly be no remembrance of you, because I the Lord have spoken.

## Chapter 22

Ezekiel 22:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 22:2 And you, son of man, will you judge the city of bloodshed? And show her all her lawless deeds
Ezekiel 22:3 and say, Thus says the Lord Lord, O city pouring out blood in her midst that her time may come, and making thoughts against herself to defile her,
Ezekiel 22:4 in their blood which you poured out you have transgressed, and in your thoughts which you made you were defiled, and you brought your days near and brought the time of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the countries
Ezekiel 22:5 which draw near to you and which are far away from you, and they will mock you: The renowned one is unclean and abundant in lawless deeds.
Ezekiel 22:6 Behold, the leaders of the house of Israel, each toward his relatives, mingled together in you so that they pour out blood;
Ezekiel 22:7 they spoke evil of father and mother in you and dealt with the sojourner in injustices in you, oppressed orphan and widow in you;
Ezekiel 22:8 and they despised my holy things and profaned my sabbaths in you.
Ezekiel 22:9 Robber men are in you to pour out blood in you, and they ate upon the mountains in you, did unholy things in your midst.
Ezekiel 22:10 They uncovered a father's shame in you and humbled a woman sitting apart in uncleannesses in you;
Ezekiel 22:11 each acted lawlessly with his neighbor's wife, and each defiled his daughter-in-law in impiety, and each humbled his sister, his father's daughter, in you.
Ezekiel 22:12 They took gifts in you to pour out blood, took interest and excess in you; and you completed the completion of your wickedness in oppression, but forgot me, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 22:13 But if I strike my hand against my hand over the things you have completed, which you did, and over your bloodshed which occurred in your midst,
Ezekiel 22:14 will your heart endure? Will your hands prevail in the days when I act in you? I the Lord have spoken and will do.
Ezekiel 22:15 And I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you in the countries, and your uncleanness will cease from you,
Ezekiel 22:16 and I will take possession in you before the eyes of the nations; and you will know that I am the Lord. —
Ezekiel 22:17 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 22:18 Son of man, behold, the house of Israel has become to me all mixed with bronze and iron and tin and lead, mixed amid silver.
Ezekiel 22:19 Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, Because you all became one mixture, therefore I receive you into the midst of Ierusalem.
Ezekiel 22:20 As silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are received into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire into it to be melted, so I will receive you in my anger and gather and melt you
Ezekiel 22:21 and blow upon you with the fire of my anger, and you will be melted in her midst.
Ezekiel 22:22 As silver is melted amid a furnace, so you will be melted in her midst; and you will recognize that I the Lord poured out my wrath upon you. —
Ezekiel 22:23 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 22:24 Son of man, say to her, You are a land not wetted, nor did rain come upon you on a day of anger;
Ezekiel 22:25 whose leaders in her midst are like roaring lions seizing plunder, devouring souls with power, taking valuables in injustice, and your widows were multiplied in your midst.
Ezekiel 22:26 And her priests rejected my law and profaned my holy things; they did not distinguish between holy and profane and did not distinguish between unclean and clean and covered their eyes from my sabbaths, and I was profaned in their midst.
Ezekiel 22:27 Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing plunder, to pour out blood, so that they gain with greed.
Ezekiel 22:28 And her prophets plastering them will fall, seeing vain things, divining false things, saying, Thus says the Lord, and the Lord has not spoken;
Ezekiel 22:29 oppressing the people of the land with injustice and plundering plunder, oppressing poor and needy and not dealing with the sojourner with judgment.
Ezekiel 22:30 And I sought among them a man walking rightly and standing before my face wholly in the land's time, so as not to obliterate her utterly, and found none.
Ezekiel 22:31 And I poured out my wrath upon her with the fire of my anger to bring to an end; I have brought their ways upon their heads, says the Lord Lord.

## Chapter 23

Ezekiel 23:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 23:2 Son of man, two women were daughters of one mother
Ezekiel 23:3 and prostituted themselves in Egypt in their youth; there their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.
Ezekiel 23:4 And their names were Oola the elder and Ooliba her sister. And they became mine and bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samareia is Oola, and Ierusalem is Ooliba.
Ezekiel 23:5 And Oola prostituted herself away from me and set her desire upon her lovers, upon the Assyrians who drew near her,
Ezekiel 23:6 clothed in blue, leaders and generals; all choice young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
Ezekiel 23:7 And she gave her prostitution to them; all choice sons of Assyrians, and toward all whom she desired, she was defiled in all her thoughts.
Ezekiel 23:8 And she did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, because they lay with her in her youth, and they deflowered her and poured out their prostitution upon her.
Ezekiel 23:9 Therefore I handed her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of sons of Assyrians whom she desired.
Ezekiel 23:10 They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters and killed her by sword; and she became a talk among women, and they executed acts of vengeance upon her for the daughters. —
Ezekiel 23:11 And her sister Ooliba saw and corrupted her desire beyond her and her prostitution beyond her sister's prostitution.
Ezekiel 23:12 She desired the sons of the Assyrians, leaders and generals near her, clothed in well-bordered garments, horsemen riding upon horses; all choice young men.
Ezekiel 23:13 And I saw that she has been defiled; one way for the two.
Ezekiel 23:14 And she added to her prostitution and saw men painted upon the wall, images of Chaldeans painted with a stylus,
Ezekiel 23:15 girded with embroidered things upon their waists, and dyed tiaras upon their heads, a threefold appearance of all, a likeness of sons of Chaldeans of their native land,
Ezekiel 23:16 and she desired them at the sight of her eyes and sent out messengers to them to the land of the Chaldeans.
Ezekiel 23:17 And sons of Babylon came to her into a bed of those lodging and defiled her in her prostitution, and she was defiled with them; and her soul departed from them.
Ezekiel 23:18 And she uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her shame, and my soul departed from her, as my soul departed from her sister.
Ezekiel 23:19 And you multiplied your prostitution to recall the days of your youth in which you prostituted yourself in Egypt,
Ezekiel 23:20 and you desired the Chaldeans, whose flesh was like that of donkeys, and their genitals the genitals of horses.
Ezekiel 23:21 And you revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt in your lodging, where were the breasts of your youth. —
Ezekiel 23:22 Therefore, Ooliba, thus says the Lord, Behold, I stir up your lovers against you, from whom your soul departed, and I will bring them against you round about,
Ezekiel 23:23 sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Phakoud and Soue and Koue and all sons of Assyrians with them, choice young men, all governors and generals, men of the third rank and renowned ones riding upon horses;
Ezekiel 23:24 and all will come against you from the north, chariots and wheels with a crowd of peoples, large shields and small shields, and they will set a guard against you round about; and I will set judgment before their face, and they will punish you with their judgments.
Ezekiel 23:25 And I will put my jealousy in you, and they will deal with you in the anger of wrath; they will remove your nose and your ears and cast down your remnants by sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and fire will devour your remnants.
Ezekiel 23:26 And they will strip you of your apparel and take the vessels of your boasting.
Ezekiel 23:27 And I will turn your impieties away from you and your prostitution from the land of Egypt, and you shall certainly not lift your eyes toward them and certainly no longer remember Egypt.
Ezekiel 23:28 Because thus says the Lord Lord, Behold, I hand you into the hands of those whom you hate, from whom your soul departed;
Ezekiel 23:29 and they will deal with you in hatred and take all your labors and your toils, and you will be naked and indecent, and the shame of your prostitution and your impiety will be uncovered. And your prostitution
Ezekiel 23:30 did these things to you when you prostituted yourself after nations and were defiled in their thoughts.
Ezekiel 23:31 You walked in your sister's way, and I will give her cup into your hands.
Ezekiel 23:32 Thus says the Lord, You shall drink your sister's cup, the deep and wide one, abundant to bring to an end;
Ezekiel 23:33 you will be filled with drunkenness and faintness; and the cup of destruction, the cup of your sister Samareia,
Ezekiel 23:34 and you shall drink it; and I will turn away her feasts and her new moons; because I have spoken, says the Lord.
