Ezekiel 23:35 Therefore thus says the Lord, Because you forgot me and cast me behind your body, you too bear your impiety and your prostitution. —
Ezekiel 23:36 And the Lord said to me, Son of man, will you not judge Oola and Ooliba? And you shall announce their lawless deeds to them,
Ezekiel 23:37 because they committed adultery, and blood is in their hands; they committed adultery with their thoughts and led their children whom they bore to me through fire offerings for them.
Ezekiel 23:38 They even did these things to me: they defiled my holy things and profaned my sabbaths.
Ezekiel 23:39 And when they slaughtered their children to their idols, they also entered my holy things to profane them; and because they did thus amid my house.
Ezekiel 23:40 And because for the men coming from afar, to whom they sent out messengers, and as soon as they came, immediately you washed and painted your eyes with antimony and adorned yourself with adornment
Ezekiel 23:41 and sat upon a spread couch, and an adorned table before her face. And my incense and my oil, they delighted in them.
Ezekiel 23:42 And they struck up a sound of harmony; and toward men from a multitude of people coming from the wilderness, and they gave bracelets upon their hands and a crown of boasting upon their heads.
Ezekiel 23:43 And I said, Do they not commit adultery with these? And deeds of a prostitute, and she herself prostituted herself.
Ezekiel 23:44 And they entered to her as they enter to a prostitute woman, so they entered to Oola and to Ooliba to commit lawlessness.
Ezekiel 23:45 And righteous men, they will punish them with the punishment of an adulteress and the punishment of blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands.
Ezekiel 23:46 Thus says the Lord Lord, Bring a crowd against them and set turmoil and plundering among them
Ezekiel 23:47 and stone them with stones of crowds and pierce them through with their swords; they will kill their sons and their daughters and burn their houses.
Ezekiel 23:48 And I will turn impiety away from the land, and all women will be disciplined and certainly not act according to their impieties.
Ezekiel 23:49 And your impiety will be brought upon you, and you will bear the sins of your thoughts; and you will know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 24

Ezekiel 24:1 And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
Ezekiel 24:2 Son of man, write for yourself for a day, from this day on which the king of Babylon pressed against Ierusalem, from this very day,
Ezekiel 24:3 and speak a parable against the house provoking to bitterness and say to them, Thus says the Lord, Set the pot and pour water into it
Ezekiel 24:4 and put into it the cut pieces, every good cut piece, leg and shoulder with flesh removed from the bones,
Ezekiel 24:5 taken from choice animals, and burn the bones underneath them; it boiled, it boiled, and her bones have been boiled in her midst.
Ezekiel 24:6 Therefore thus says the Lord, O city of bloodshed, a pot in which there is corrosion, and the corrosion did not go out from her; limb by limb he brought out from her, no lot fell upon her.
Ezekiel 24:7 Because her blood is in her midst, I have set it upon a smooth rock; I have not poured it upon the earth to cover earth over it.
Ezekiel 24:8 That wrath may rise for vengeance to be executed, I have put her blood upon a smooth rock so as not to cover it.
Ezekiel 24:9 Therefore thus says the Lord, I too will make the firebrand great
Ezekiel 24:10 and multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the meat may melt and the broth be diminished,
Ezekiel 24:11 and it stand upon the coals, so that her bronze may be burned and heated and melt amid her uncleanness, and her corrosion cease,
Ezekiel 24:12 and her abundant corrosion shall certainly not go out from her; her corrosion will be put to shame,
Ezekiel 24:13 because you were defiled. And what if you are not yet cleansed until I fill my wrath?
Ezekiel 24:14 I the Lord have spoken, and it will come, and I will do; I will not hold back nor have mercy; according to your ways and according to your thoughts I will judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed and according to your thoughts judge you, the unclean renowned one, abundant in provoking to bitterness.
Ezekiel 24:15 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 24:16 Son of man, behold, I take from you the desirable things of your eyes in battle array; you shall certainly not mourn nor weep.
Ezekiel 24:17 There is a groan of blood, of waist, of mourning; your hair shall not be intertwined upon you, and your footwear on your feet; you shall certainly not be comforted by their lips nor eat the bread of men.
Ezekiel 24:18 And I spoke to the people in the morning as he commanded me, and my wife died in the evening, and in the morning I did as I was commanded.
Ezekiel 24:19 And the people said to me, Will you not announce to us what these things are which you do?
Ezekiel 24:20 And I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 24:21 Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord, Behold, I profane my holy things, the arrogance of your strength, the desirable things of your eyes, and the things for which your souls spare; and your sons and your daughters whom you abandoned will fall by sword.
Ezekiel 24:22 And you shall do as I have done; you will not be comforted from their mouth and will not eat the bread of men,
Ezekiel 24:23 and your hair upon your head, and your footwear on your feet; you shall neither mourn nor weep and will waste away in your injustices and comfort, each, his brother.
Ezekiel 24:24 And Iezekiel will be a portent for you; according to all that he did you shall do when these things come; and you will recognize that I am the Lord. —
Ezekiel 24:25 And you, son of man, will not, on the day when I take from them their strength, the elevation of their boasting, the desirable things of their eyes and the elevation of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
Ezekiel 24:26 on that day the survivor come to you to announce into your ears?
Ezekiel 24:27 On that day your mouth will be opened toward the survivor, and you will speak and certainly no longer be made mute; and you will be a portent for them, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 25

Ezekiel 25:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 25:2 Son of man, set your face against the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them
Ezekiel 25:3 and say to the sons of Ammon, Hear the word of the Lord: Thus says the Lord, Because you rejoiced over my holy things because they were profaned, and over the land of Israel because it was destroyed, and over the house of Iouda because they went into captivity,
Ezekiel 25:4 therefore behold, I hand you over to the sons of Kedem for an inheritance, and they will encamp with their equipment in you and place their dwellings in you; they will eat your fruits, and they will drink your richness.
Ezekiel 25:5 And I will make the city of Ammon pastures of camels and the sons of Ammon a pasture of sheep; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 25:6 Because thus says the Lord, Because you clapped your hand and stamped with your foot and rejoiced from your soul over the land of Israel,
Ezekiel 25:7 therefore I will stretch my hand against you and make you plunder among the nations and destroy you from the peoples and bring you to destruction from the countries; and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 25:8 Thus says the Lord, Because Moab said, Behold, the house of Israel and Iouda is like all the nations,
Ezekiel 25:9 therefore behold, I paralyze Moab's shoulder from the cities of his extremities, a choice land, the house of Asimouth above a spring of a seaside city.
Ezekiel 25:10 To the sons of Kedem against the sons of Ammon I have given them for an inheritance, so that no remembrance of the sons of Ammon may be;
Ezekiel 25:11 and upon Moab I will execute vengeance, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 25:12 Thus says the Lord, Because Idoumaia acted by executing vengeance upon the house of Iouda and bore a grudge and exacted punishment,
Ezekiel 25:13 therefore thus says the Lord, And I will stretch my hand against Idoumaia and destroy human and beast from her and make her desolate, and those pursued from Thaiman will fall by sword;
Ezekiel 25:14 and I will put my vengeance upon Idoumaia by the hand of my people Israel, and they will act in Idoumaia according to my anger and according to my wrath; and they will recognize my vengeance, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 25:15 Therefore thus says the Lord, Because the foreigners acted in vengeance and raised up vengeance, rejoicing from the soul to obliterate forever,
Ezekiel 25:16 therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I will stretch my hand against the foreigners and destroy Cretans and destroy the remnants inhabiting the coast;
Ezekiel 25:17 and I will execute great acts of vengeance among them, and they will recognize that I am the Lord when I put my vengeance upon them.

## Chapter 26

Ezekiel 26:1 And it happened in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 26:2 Son of man, because Sor said over Ierusalem, Well done, she was crushed, the nations have perished, she turned to me, the full one has been made desolate,
Ezekiel 26:3 therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I am against you, Sor, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.
Ezekiel 26:4 And they will cast down the walls of Sor and cast down your towers, and I will winnow her dust away from her and make her a smooth rock;
Ezekiel 26:5 she will be a drying place for nets amid the sea, because I have spoken, says the Lord; and she will be plunder for the nations,
Ezekiel 26:6 and her daughters in the plain will be killed by sword; and they will know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 26:7 Because thus says the Lord, Behold, I bring against you, Sor, Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon from the north [he is king of kings], with horses and chariots and horsemen and a gathering of exceedingly many nations.
Ezekiel 26:8 This one will kill your daughters in the plain by sword and set an advance guard against you and build round about and make a rampart against you round about and an encirclement of weapons and place his spears opposite you;
Ezekiel 26:9 your walls and your towers he will cast down with his swords.
Ezekiel 26:10 From the multitude of his horses their dust will cover you, and from the sound of his horsemen and the wheels of his chariots your walls will be shaken as he enters your gates, as one entering a city from a plain.
Ezekiel 26:11 With the hoofs of his horses they will trample all your squares; he will kill your people by sword and bring the foundation of your strength down to the earth.
Ezekiel 26:12 And he will plunder your wealth and spoil your possessions and cast down your walls and pull down your desirable houses and throw your stones and your wood and your dust into the midst of the sea.
Ezekiel 26:13 And he will stop the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your harps shall certainly no longer be heard.
Ezekiel 26:14 And I will make you a smooth rock, you will be a drying place for nets; you shall certainly no longer be built, because I spoke, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 26:15 Because thus says the Lord Lord to Sor, Will not the islands be shaken from the sound of your fall, when wounded ones groan, when a sword is drawn in your midst?
Ezekiel 26:16 And all the rulers from the nations of the sea will descend from their thrones and remove the headdresses from their heads and strip off their embroidered apparel; with dismay they will be dismayed, sit upon the earth and fear their destruction and groan over you;
Ezekiel 26:17 and they will take up a lament over you and say to you, How were you brought down from the sea, the praised city which gave her fear to all who inhabit her?
Ezekiel 26:18 And the islands will fear from the day of your fall.
Ezekiel 26:19 Because thus says the Lord Lord, When I make you a desolate city like the cities which will not be inhabited, when I bring the abyss upon you and much water covers you,
Ezekiel 26:20 and I will bring you down to those descending into a pit, to a people of old, and settle you in the depths of the earth as an everlasting wilderness with those descending into a pit, so that you may not be inhabited nor rise upon a land of life.
Ezekiel 26:21 I will make you destruction, and you will no longer exist forever, says the Lord Lord.

## Chapter 27

Ezekiel 27:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 27:2 Son of man, take up a lament over Sor
Ezekiel 27:3 and say to Sor, who dwells at the entrance of the sea, the trading place of the peoples from many islands, Thus says the Lord to Sor, You said, I put my beauty around myself.
Ezekiel 27:4 In the heart of the sea, for Beelim, your sons put beauty around you.
Ezekiel 27:5 Cedar from Sanir was built for you; strips of cypress planks from Lebanon were taken to make fir masts for you.
Ezekiel 27:6 From Basanitis they made your oars; your holy things they made from ivory, wooded houses from the islands of the Chettiin.
Ezekiel 27:7 Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became your covering, to put glory around you and wrap you in blue and purple from the islands of Elisai, and became your coverings.
Ezekiel 27:8 And your rulers who inhabit Sidon and Aradians became your rowers; your wise ones, Sor, who were in you, these were your pilots.
Ezekiel 27:9 The elders of the Byblians and their wise ones were in you, these strengthened your counsel; and all the ships of the sea and their rowers became yours toward the farthest west.
Ezekiel 27:10 Persians and Lydians and Libyans were in your army, your warrior men hung shields and helmets in you, these gave your glory.
Ezekiel 27:11 Sons of Aradians and your army were guards upon your walls, in your towers; they hung their quivers upon your moorings round about; these perfected your beauty.
Ezekiel 27:12 Carthaginians were your merchants from the abundance of all your strength; silver and gold and iron and tin and lead they gave for your market.
Ezekiel 27:13 Hellas and the whole and the neighboring lands, these traded with you in human souls and gave bronze vessels for your commerce.
Ezekiel 27:14 From the house of Thergama they gave horses and horsemen for your market.
Ezekiel 27:15 Sons of Rhodians were your merchants from islands; they multiplied your commerce with ivory tusks, and for the imported things you gave your payments in return,
Ezekiel 27:16 people as your merchandise from the abundance of your mixed wares, myrrh and embroidered things from Tharsis, and Ramoth and Chorchor they gave for your market.
Ezekiel 27:17 Ioudas and the sons of Israel, these were your merchants in the sale of grain and perfumes and cassia, and first honey and oil and resin they gave into your mixed wares.
Ezekiel 27:18 Damascus was your merchant from the abundance of all your wealth; wine from Chelbon and wool from Miletos;
Ezekiel 27:19 and wine they gave for your market. From Asel worked iron and a wheel are among your mixed wares.
Ezekiel 27:20 Daidan were your merchants with choice beasts for chariots.
Ezekiel 27:21 Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar, these were your merchants through your hand, camels and rams and lambs with which they trade with you.
Ezekiel 27:22 Merchants of Saba and Ragma, these were your merchants with foremost spices and good stones, and gold they gave for your market.
Ezekiel 27:23 Charran and Channa, these were your merchants. Assour and Charman were your merchants,
Ezekiel 27:24 bringing merchandise, blue and choice treasures bound with cords and cypress things.
Ezekiel 27:25 Ships, in them Carthaginians were your merchants in the multitude among your mixed wares, and you were filled and made exceedingly heavy in the heart of the sea.
Ezekiel 27:26 In much water your rowers led you; the south wind crushed you in the heart of the sea.
Ezekiel 27:27 There were your riches and your payment and that of your mixed wares and your rowers and your pilots and your counselors and your traders from your mixed wares and all your warrior men in you and all your gathering in your midst; they will fall in the heart of the sea on the day of your fall.
Ezekiel 27:28 At the sound of your cry your pilots will fear with fear,
Ezekiel 27:29 and all your rowers will descend from the ships, and the passengers and the bowmen of the sea will stand upon the earth
Ezekiel 27:30 and shout over you with their voice and cry bitterly and place earth upon their head and spread ash beneath themselves.
Ezekiel 27:32 And their sons will take up a lament over you and a lamentation for you,
Ezekiel 27:33 How great a payment did you find from the sea? You filled nations from your multitude and from your mixed wares enriched all kings of the earth.
Ezekiel 27:34 Now you were crushed in the sea, in the depth of water; your mixed wares and all your gathering in your midst fell, all your rowers.
Ezekiel 27:35 All who inhabit the islands grew gloomy over you, and their kings were dismayed with dismay, and their face shed tears.
Ezekiel 27:36 Merchants from nations hissed at you; you became destruction and shall no longer be forever.

## Chapter 28

Ezekiel 28:1 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 28:2 And you, son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, Thus says the Lord, Because your heart was raised, and you said, I am God, I have inhabited a dwelling of God in the heart of the sea, but you are a human and not God, and you made your heart like God's heart,
Ezekiel 28:3 are you wiser than Daniel? Did wise ones not instruct you in their knowledge?
Ezekiel 28:4 Did you not by your knowledge or your understanding make wealth for yourself and gold and silver in your treasuries?
Ezekiel 28:5 By your abundant knowledge and your commerce you multiplied your wealth; your heart was raised in your wealth.
Ezekiel 28:6 Therefore thus says the Lord, Since you made your heart like God's heart,
Ezekiel 28:7 in return for this behold, I bring against you foreign pests from nations, and they will draw their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge and lay your beauty low unto destruction
Ezekiel 28:8 and bring you down, and you will die the death of wounded ones in the heart of the sea.
Ezekiel 28:9 Will you, speaking, say, I am God, before those killing you? But you are a human and not God. In a multitude
Ezekiel 28:10 of uncircumcised ones you will perish in the hands of foreigners; because I spoke, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 28:11 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 28:12 Son of man, take up a lament over the ruler of Tyre and say to him, Thus says the Lord Lord, You are a seal of likeness and a crown of beauty;
Ezekiel 28:13 you were in the delight of God's paradise; you have bound upon yourself every good stone, sardion and topaz and emerald and carbuncle and sapphire and jasper and silver and gold and ligyrion and agate and amethyst and chrysolite and beryl and onyx, and you filled your treasuries and your storehouses in you with gold from the day when you were created.
Ezekiel 28:14 With the cheroub I placed you upon God's holy mountain; you were amid fiery stones.
Ezekiel 28:15 You were blameless in your days from the day when you were created until the wrongs were found in you.
Ezekiel 28:16 From the abundance of your commerce you filled your chambers with lawlessness and sinned and were wounded away from God's mountain, and the cheroub led you from amid fiery stones.
Ezekiel 28:17 Your heart was raised on account of your beauty, your knowledge was corrupted with your beauty; because of the multitude of your sins I threw you upon the earth, gave you before kings to be made an example.
Ezekiel 28:18 Because of the multitude of your sins and the injustices of your commerce you profaned your holy places; and I will bring fire out from your midst, this will devour you; and I will make you ash upon your earth before all who see you.
Ezekiel 28:19 And all who know you among the nations will grow gloomy over you; you became destruction and shall no longer exist forever.
Ezekiel 28:20 And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 28:21 Son of man, set your face against Sidon and prophesy against her
Ezekiel 28:22 and say, Thus says the Lord, Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you, and you will know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you, and I will be sanctified in you.
Ezekiel 28:23 Blood and death in your squares, and wounded ones will fall by swords in you round about you; and they will know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 28:24 And they will no longer be to the house of Israel a prickle of bitterness and a thorn of pain, from all those round about them who dishonored them; and they will know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 28:25 Thus says the Lord Lord, And I will gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered there, and I will be sanctified in them before the peoples and the nations; and they will dwell upon their land which I have given to my servant Iakob,
Ezekiel 28:26 and they will dwell upon it in hope and build houses and plant vineyards and dwell in hope, when I execute judgment upon all who dishonored them among those round about them; and they will know that I am the Lord their God and the God of their fathers.

## Chapter 29

Ezekiel 29:1 In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the first of the month, a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 29:2 Son of man, set your face against Pharao king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
Ezekiel 29:3 and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharao, the great dragon sitting in the midst of his rivers, who says, The rivers are mine, and I made them.
Ezekiel 29:4 And I will put traps in your jaws and attach the fish of your river to your wings, and bring you up from the midst of your river, and all the fish of your river,
Ezekiel 29:5 and cast you down quickly, and all the fish of your river. You shall fall upon the face of the plain, and you shall certainly not be gathered, and you shall certainly not be wrapped up; I have given you to the beasts of the earth and to the birds of heaven for devouring.
Ezekiel 29:6 And all those inhabiting Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because you became a reed staff for the house of Israel.
Ezekiel 29:7 When they took hold of you with their hand, you were crushed; and when every hand prevailed against them, and when they rested upon you, you were shattered and broke all their loins together.
Ezekiel 29:8 Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy men and livestock from you;
Ezekiel 29:9 and the land of Egypt shall be destruction and desert, and they shall know that I am the Lord, because you say, The rivers are mine, and I made them.
Ezekiel 29:10 Therefore behold, I am against you and against all your rivers, and I will give the land of Egypt over to desert and sword and destruction, from Magdolon and Syene and as far as the borders of the Ethiopians.
Ezekiel 29:11 A man's foot shall certainly not pass through it, and a beast's foot shall certainly not pass through it, and it shall not be inhabited for forty years.
Ezekiel 29:12 And I will give its land over to destruction in the midst of a desolated land, and its cities shall be in the midst of desolated cities for forty years; and I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the countries.
Ezekiel 29:13 Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered,
Ezekiel 29:14 and I will turn back the captivity of the Egyptians and settle them in the land of Pathoures, in the land from which they were taken; and it shall be a lowly dominion
Ezekiel 29:15 beside all the dominions; it shall certainly no longer be exalted over the nations, and I will make them few, so that they shall not be more numerous among the nations.
Ezekiel 29:16 And they shall no longer be for the house of Israel a hope reminding them of lawlessness when they follow after them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 29:17 And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, on the first of the first month, a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 29:18 Son of man, Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon subjected his force to great servitude against Tyre; every head bald and every shoulder shedding hair, and no wage came to him and to his force against Tyre and for the servitude with which they served against it.
Ezekiel 29:19 Thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I give the land of Egypt to Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon, and he shall plunder its plunder and despoil its spoils, and it shall be a wage for his force;
Ezekiel 29:20 in return for his service with which he served against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt. Thus says the Lord Lord:
Ezekiel 29:21 On that day a horn shall spring up for the whole house of Israel, and to you I will give an opened mouth in their midst; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 30

Ezekiel 30:1 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 30:2 Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Oh, oh, the day!
Ezekiel 30:3 For the day of the Lord is near; it shall be a day, an end of nations.
Ezekiel 30:4 And a sword shall come upon the Egyptians, and there shall be disturbance in Ethiopia, and wounded ones shall fall in Egypt, and its foundations shall collapse together.
Ezekiel 30:5 Persians and Cretans and Lydians and Libyans and all the mixed peoples, and some of the sons of my covenant, shall fall by the sword in it.
Ezekiel 30:6 And the supports of Egypt shall fall, and the insolence of its strength shall come down from Magdolon to Syene; they shall fall by the sword in it, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 30:7 And it shall be desolated in the midst of desolated countries, and their cities shall be in the midst of desolated cities;
Ezekiel 30:8 and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I put fire upon Egypt and all those helping it are shattered.
Ezekiel 30:9 On that day messengers shall go out, hastening to make Ethiopia disappear, and there shall be disturbance among them on the day of Egypt, for behold, it comes. –
Ezekiel 30:10 Thus says the Lord Lord: And I will destroy a multitude of Egyptians by the hand of Nabouchodonosor king of Babylon,
Ezekiel 30:11 him and his people; pestilent ones sent from nations to destroy the land, and they shall all draw their swords against Egypt, and the land shall be filled with wounded ones.
Ezekiel 30:12 And I will make their rivers desolate, and destroy the land and its fullness in the hands of foreigners; I, the Lord, have spoken. –
Ezekiel 30:13 For thus says the Lord Lord: And I will destroy magnates from Memphis and rulers from the land of Egypt, and they shall no longer exist.
Ezekiel 30:14 And I will destroy the land of Pathoures and put fire upon Tanis and execute vengeance in Diospolis,
Ezekiel 30:15 and pour out my wrath upon Sais, the strength of Egypt, and destroy the multitude of Memphis;
Ezekiel 30:16 and I will put fire upon Egypt, and Syene shall be disturbed with disturbance, and in Diospolis there shall be a bursting forth, and waters shall be poured out.
Ezekiel 30:17 Young men of Heliopolis and Boubastos shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go in captivity.
Ezekiel 30:18 And in Taphnas the day shall grow dark when I shatter there the scepters of Egypt, and the insolence of its strength shall perish there, and a cloud shall cover it, and its daughters shall be led away captive.
Ezekiel 30:19 And I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 30:20 And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 30:21 Son of man, I shattered the arms of Pharao king of Egypt, and behold, it was not bound up for healing to be given, for a poultice to be put upon it, for strength to be given to take hold of a sword.
Ezekiel 30:22 Therefore thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I am against Pharao king of Egypt, and I will shatter his arms, the strong ones and the outstretched ones, and cast down his sword from his hand,
Ezekiel 30:23 and scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries;
Ezekiel 30:24 and I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword into his hand, and he shall bring it upon Egypt and plunder its plunder and despoil its spoils.
Ezekiel 30:25 And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharao shall fall; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I put my sword into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall extend it over the land of Egypt.
Ezekiel 30:26 And I will scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries; and they shall all know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 31

Ezekiel 31:1 And it happened in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 31:2 Son of man, say to Pharao king of Egypt and to his multitude, To whom have you likened yourself in your height?
Ezekiel 31:3 Behold, Assour, a cypress in Lebanon, and beautiful in its shoots and high in stature; its top came into the midst of clouds;
Ezekiel 31:4 water nourished it, the abyss raised it high; it led its rivers around its plants and sent out its collections of water to all the trees of the plain.
Ezekiel 31:5 Because of this its stature was raised above all the trees of the plain, and its branches spread wide from much water.
Ezekiel 31:6 In its shoots all the birds of heaven nested, and beneath its branches all the beasts of the plain gave birth; in its shade every multitude of nations dwelt.
Ezekiel 31:7 And it became beautiful in its height through the multitude of its branches, because its roots came into much water.
Ezekiel 31:8 Such cypresses did not exist in the paradise of God, and pines were not like its shoots, and firs did not become like its branches; no tree in the paradise of God was likened to it in its beauty,
Ezekiel 31:9 through the multitude of its branches, and the trees of the paradise of God's delight envied it. –
Ezekiel 31:10 Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you became great in stature and put your top into the midst of clouds, and I saw when it was raised high,
Ezekiel 31:11 I also delivered it into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he brought about its destruction.
Ezekiel 31:12 And foreign pestilent ones from nations utterly destroyed it and cast it down upon the mountains; in all the ravines its branches fell, and its trunks were shattered in every plain of the earth, and all the peoples of the nations came down from their shelter and razed it to the ground.
Ezekiel 31:13 Upon its fall all the birds of heaven rested, and upon its trunks all the beasts of the field came,
Ezekiel 31:14 so that all the trees in the water might not be raised high in their stature; and they did not put their top into the midst of clouds, and all those drinking water did not stand against them in their height; all were given over to death, to the depth of the earth, in the midst of sons of men, to those descending into a pit. –
Ezekiel 31:15 Thus says the Lord Lord: On the day when it descended into Hades, the abyss mourned it, and I stopped its rivers and held back a multitude of water, and Lebanon grew dark over it; all the trees of the plain fainted over it.
Ezekiel 31:16 At the sound of its fall the nations were shaken, when I brought it down into Hades with those descending into a pit, and all the trees of delight and the choice ones of Lebanon, all those drinking water, comforted it in the earth.
Ezekiel 31:17 For they too descended with it into Hades among those wounded by a sword, and its seed, those dwelling under its shelter, perished in the midst of their life.
Ezekiel 31:18 To whom were you likened? Descend, and be brought down with the trees of delight into the depth of the earth; in the midst of the uncircumcised you shall lie with those wounded by a sword. Thus Pharao and the multitude of his strength, says the Lord Lord.

## Chapter 32

Ezekiel 32:1 And it happened in the eleventh year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 32:2 Son of man, take up a lament over Pharao king of Egypt, and you shall say to him, You were likened to a lion of nations, and you were like a dragon in the sea, and you were butting with your rivers and disturbing water with your feet and trampling your rivers.
Ezekiel 32:3 Thus says the Lord: And I will cast over you nets of many peoples and bring you up with my hook,
Ezekiel 32:4 and stretch you out upon the earth; plains shall be filled with you, and I will seat upon you all the birds of heaven, and fill with you all the beasts of all the earth;
Ezekiel 32:5 and I will put your flesh upon the mountains and fill them with your blood,
Ezekiel 32:6 and the earth shall be watered from your excrements, from your multitude upon the mountains; I will fill ravines with you.
Ezekiel 32:7 And when you are extinguished I will cover heaven and darken its stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall certainly not show its light;
Ezekiel 32:8 all those showing light in heaven shall grow dark over you, and I will put darkness upon your land, says the Lord Lord.
Ezekiel 32:9 And I will provoke the heart of many peoples to anger when I bring your captivity into the nations, into a land which you did not know.
Ezekiel 32:10 And many nations shall be gloomy over you, and their kings shall be beside themselves with consternation when my sword flies before their faces, awaiting their fall from the day of your fall.
Ezekiel 32:11 For thus says the Lord: A sword of the king of Babylon shall come to you
Ezekiel 32:12 with swords of giants, and I will cast down your strength; all pestilent ones from nations, and they shall destroy the insolence of Egypt, and all its strength shall be shattered.
Ezekiel 32:13 And I will destroy all its livestock from much water, and a man's foot shall certainly no longer disturb it, and a footprint of livestock shall certainly not trample it.
Ezekiel 32:14 Thus then their waters shall be still, and their rivers shall flow like oil, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 32:15 When I give Egypt over to destruction and the land is desolated with its fullness, when I scatter all those dwelling in it, then they shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 32:16 It is a lament, and you shall lament it, and the daughters of the nations shall lament it; over Egypt and over all its strength they shall lament it, says the Lord Lord.
Ezekiel 32:17 And it happened in the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth of the month, a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 32:18 Son of man, lament over the strength of Egypt, and the nations shall bring down its daughters dead into the depth of the earth, to those descending into a pit;
Ezekiel 32:20 in the midst of those wounded by a sword they shall fall with him, and all his strength shall lie down.
Ezekiel 32:21 And the giants shall say to you, Be in the depth of a pit; of whom are you better? Descend and lie down with the uncircumcised in the midst of those wounded by a sword.
Ezekiel 32:22 There Assour and all his assembly, all wounded, were placed there, and their burial is in the depth of a pit, and his assembly came to be around his tomb, all the wounded who have fallen by a sword,
Ezekiel 32:23 who put their fear upon the land of life.
Ezekiel 32:24 There Ailam and all his force around his tomb, all the wounded who have fallen by a sword, and those descending uncircumcised into the depth of the earth, who have put their fear upon the land of life, and they received their torment with those descending into a pit,
Ezekiel 32:25 in the midst of wounded ones.
Ezekiel 32:26 There Mosoch and Thobel were placed, and all their strength around his tomb, all his wounded, all uncircumcised ones wounded by a sword, who have put their fear upon the land of life;
Ezekiel 32:27 and they lay down with the giants who have fallen from of old, who descended into Hades with weapons of war and put their swords under their heads; and their lawlessnesses came upon their bones, because they terrified giants in the land of life.
Ezekiel 32:28 And you shall lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those wounded by a sword.
Ezekiel 32:29 There the rulers of Assour were placed, who gave his strength over to a wound of a sword; these lay down with wounded ones, with those descending into a pit.
Ezekiel 32:30 There the rulers of the north, all generals of Assour, those descending wounded, with their fear and their strength, lay down uncircumcised with those wounded by a sword, and bore their torment with those descending into a pit.
Ezekiel 32:31 King Pharao shall see those, and be comforted over all their strength, says the Lord Lord.
Ezekiel 32:32 For I have put his fear upon the land of life, and he shall lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised, with those wounded by a sword, Pharao and all his multitude, says the Lord Lord.

## Chapter 33

Ezekiel 33:1 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 33:2 Son of man, speak to the sons of your people, and you shall say to them, A land upon which I bring a sword, and the people of the land take one man from among them and appoint him for themselves as a watchman,
Ezekiel 33:3 and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the trumpet and signals to the people,
Ezekiel 33:4 and the one hearing hears the sound of the trumpet and does not take heed, and the sword comes and overtakes him, his blood shall be upon his head;
Ezekiel 33:5 because, having heard the sound of the trumpet, he did not take heed, his blood shall be upon him; and this one, because he took heed, rescued his soul.
Ezekiel 33:6 And the watchman, if he sees the sword coming and does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not take heed, and the sword comes and takes a soul from among them, this soul was taken because of its own lawlessness, and I will require the blood from the watchman's hand.
Ezekiel 33:7 And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for the house of Israel, and you shall hear a word from my mouth.
Ezekiel 33:8 When I say to the sinner, By death you shall be put to death, and you do not speak so that the ungodly may take heed to keep from his way, the lawless one himself shall die in his lawlessness, but I will require his blood from your hand.
Ezekiel 33:9 But if you forewarn the ungodly of his way, to turn away from it, and he does not turn away from his way, this one shall die in his ungodliness, and you have rescued your own soul. –
Ezekiel 33:10 And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, Thus you spoke, saying, Our errors and our lawlessnesses are upon us, and in them we are wasting away; and how shall we live?
Ezekiel 33:11 Say to them, I live, thus says the Lord: I do not desire the death of the ungodly as I desire that the ungodly turn away from his way and live. Turn away with a turning away from your way; and why do you die, house of Israel?
Ezekiel 33:12 Say to the sons of your people, A righteous man's righteousness shall certainly not rescue him on the day when he goes astray, and an ungodly man's lawlessness shall certainly not harm him on the day when he turns away from his lawlessness; and a righteous man shall certainly not be able to be saved.
Ezekiel 33:13 When I say to the righteous man, This one has trusted in his righteousness, and he commits lawlessness, all his righteous deeds shall certainly not be remembered; in his injustice which he committed, in it he shall die.
Ezekiel 33:14 And when I say to the ungodly, By death you shall be put to death, and he turns away from his sin and does judgment and righteousness,
Ezekiel 33:15 and returns a pledge and repays what was seized, walks in ordinances of life so as not to do wrong, he shall live with life and shall certainly not die;
Ezekiel 33:16 all his sins which he committed shall certainly not be remembered; because he did judgment and righteousness, in them he shall live.
Ezekiel 33:17 And the sons of your people shall say, The way of the Lord is not straight; and this way of theirs is not straight.
Ezekiel 33:18 When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits lawlessnesses, he shall also die in them;
Ezekiel 33:19 and when the sinner turns away from his lawlessness and does judgment and righteousness, in them he himself shall live.
Ezekiel 33:20 And this is what you said, The way of the Lord is not straight; I will judge you, each in his ways, house of Israel.
Ezekiel 33:21 And it happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month of our captivity, the one who had escaped came to me from Ierusalem, saying, The city has been captured.
Ezekiel 33:22 And the hand of the Lord came upon me in the evening before he came, and opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and my mouth, having been opened, was no longer restrained.
Ezekiel 33:23 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 33:24 Son of man, those inhabiting the desolated places upon the land of Israel say, Abraam was one and possessed the land, and we are more numerous; the land has been given to us for a possession.
Ezekiel 33:25 Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord Lord:
Ezekiel 33:27 I live: surely those in the desolated places shall fall by a sword, and those upon the face of the plain shall be given to the beasts of the field for devouring, and those in the fortified places and those in the caves I will kill with death.
Ezekiel 33:28 And I will make the land desolate, and the insolence of its strength shall perish, and the mountains of Israel shall be desolated because there is no one passing through.
Ezekiel 33:29 And they shall know that I am the Lord; and I will make their land desolate, and it shall be desolated because of all their abominations which they committed.
Ezekiel 33:30 And you, son of man, the sons of your people who speak about you beside the walls and in the gateways of the houses, and speak, a man to his brother, saying, Let us come together and hear the things proceeding from the Lord,
Ezekiel 33:31 come to you as a people comes together, and sit before you and hear your words, and they shall certainly not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart is after defilements.
Ezekiel 33:32 And you become to them like the sound of a sweet-voiced, well-tuned psaltery, and they shall hear your words and shall certainly not do them.
Ezekiel 33:33 And when it comes, they shall say, Behold, it comes; and they shall know that a prophet was in their midst.

## Chapter 34

Ezekiel 34:1 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 34:2 Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to the shepherds, Thus says the Lord Lord: O shepherds of Israel, do shepherds feed themselves? Do the shepherds not feed the sheep?
Ezekiel 34:3 Behold, you consume the milk and clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fat one, and you do not feed my sheep;
Ezekiel 34:4 you did not strengthen the weak one, and did not restore the sick one's body, and did not bind up the shattered one, and did not turn back the straying one, and did not seek the lost one, and you worked the strong one with toil.
Ezekiel 34:5 And my sheep were scattered because there were no shepherds, and became food for all the beasts of the field;
Ezekiel 34:6 and my sheep were scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill, and were scattered upon the face of all the earth, and there was no one seeking them out or turning them back.
Ezekiel 34:7 Therefore, shepherds, hear a word of the Lord:
Ezekiel 34:8 I live, says the Lord Lord: surely, because my sheep became plunder and my sheep became food for all the beasts of the plain because there were no shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out my sheep, and the shepherds fed themselves but did not feed my sheep,
Ezekiel 34:9 because of this, shepherds,
Ezekiel 34:10 thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I am against the shepherds, and I will require my sheep from their hands and turn them away from shepherding my sheep, and the shepherds shall no longer feed them; and I will rescue my sheep from their mouth, and they shall no longer be food for them.
Ezekiel 34:11 For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will seek out my sheep and attend to them.
Ezekiel 34:12 Just as the shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud among separated sheep, so I will seek out my sheep and drive them away from every place where they were scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.
Ezekiel 34:13 And I will bring them out of the nations and gather them from the countries and bring them into their land, and feed them upon the mountains of Israel and in the ravines and in every inhabited place of the land;
Ezekiel 34:14 in good pasture I will feed them, and on the high mountain of Israel shall be their folds; there they shall lie down and there they shall rest in good delight, and in rich pasture they shall be fed upon the mountains of Israel.
Ezekiel 34:15 I will feed my sheep and I will give them rest, and they shall know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord Lord:
Ezekiel 34:16 I will seek the lost one and turn back the straying one and bind up the shattered one and strengthen the failing one and guard the strong one, and feed them with judgment.
Ezekiel 34:17 And you, sheep, thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between sheep and sheep, rams and goats;
Ezekiel 34:18 and is it not enough for you that you grazed the good pasture, and trampled the remainder of your pasture with your feet? And you drank the settled water and disturbed the rest with your feet;
Ezekiel 34:19 and my sheep grazed what your feet had trampled and drank the water disturbed by your feet.
Ezekiel 34:20 Therefore thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between a strong sheep and a weak sheep.
Ezekiel 34:21 With your sides and shoulders you push, and with your horns you were butting, and you were squeezing out every failing one.
Ezekiel 34:22 And I will save my sheep, and they shall certainly no longer be plunder, and I will judge between ram and ram.
Ezekiel 34:23 And I will raise up over them one shepherd, and he shall shepherd them, my servant Dauid, and he shall be their shepherd;
Ezekiel 34:24 and I, the Lord, shall be a God to them, and Dauid a ruler in their midst; I, the Lord, have spoken.
Ezekiel 34:25 And I will make with Dauid a covenant of peace and make evil beasts disappear from the land, and they shall dwell in the desert and sleep in the woods.
Ezekiel 34:26 And I will place them around my mountain; and I will give you rain, rain of blessing.
Ezekiel 34:27 And the trees in the plain shall give their fruit, and the land shall give its strength, and they shall dwell upon their land in hope of peace, and they shall know that I am the Lord when I shatter their yoke; and I will rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
Ezekiel 34:28 And they shall no longer be plunder for the nations, and the beasts of the earth shall certainly no longer eat them; and they shall dwell in hope, and there shall be no one terrifying them.
Ezekiel 34:29 And I will raise up for them a plant of peace, and they shall no longer be perishing by famine upon the land, and shall certainly no longer bear the reproach of nations.
Ezekiel 34:30 And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, and they are my people, the house of Israel, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 34:31 You are my sheep and sheep of my flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord Lord.

## Chapter 35

Ezekiel 35:1 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 35:2 Son of man, turn your face toward mount Seir and prophesy against it,
Ezekiel 35:3 and say, Thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I am against you, mount Seir, and I will extend my hand against you and make you desolate, and you shall be desolated,
Ezekiel 35:4 and I will make a desolation for your cities, and you shall be desolate; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 35:5 Because you became an everlasting enemy and lay in ambush for the house of Israel with deceit, in the hand of enemies, with a sword in a time of injustice at the end,
Ezekiel 35:6 therefore, I live, says the Lord Lord: surely you sinned unto blood, and blood shall pursue you.
Ezekiel 35:7 And I will make mount Seir a desert and a desolated place, and destroy men and livestock from it,
Ezekiel 35:8 and fill the hills and your ravines with your wounded, and in all your plains those wounded by a sword shall fall in you.
Ezekiel 35:9 I will make you an everlasting desolation, and your cities shall certainly no longer be inhabited; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 35:10 Because you said, The two nations and the two countries shall be mine, and I will inherit them, and the Lord is there,
Ezekiel 35:11 therefore, I live, says the Lord, and I will do to you according to your enmity, and I will be known to you when I judge you;
Ezekiel 35:12 and you shall know that I am the Lord. I heard the sound of your blasphemies, because you said, The mountains of Israel are desolate, they have been given to us for devouring;
Ezekiel 35:13 and you spoke boastfully against me with your mouth; I heard.
Ezekiel 35:14 Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of all the earth I will make you desolate;
Ezekiel 35:15 you shall be desolate, mount Seir, and all Idoumaia shall be utterly consumed; and you shall know that I am the Lord their God.

## Chapter 36

Ezekiel 36:1 And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say to the mountains of Israel, Hear a word of the Lord:
Ezekiel 36:2 Thus says the Lord Lord: Because the enemy said against you, Well done! Everlasting deserts have become a possession for us,
Ezekiel 36:3 therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you came up as talk upon a tongue and as a reproach to nations,
Ezekiel 36:4 therefore, mountains of Israel, hear a word of the Lord: Thus says the Lord to the mountains and the hills and the ravines and the torrents and the utterly desolated and vanished places and the abandoned cities, which became plunder and something trampled for the nations remaining round about;
Ezekiel 36:5 therefore thus says the Lord Lord: Surely in the fire of my wrath I spoke against the remaining nations and against all Idoumaia, because they gave my land to themselves for a possession with rejoicing, dishonoring souls in order to destroy in plunder;
Ezekiel 36:6 therefore prophesy to the land of Israel and say to the mountains and the hills and the ravines and the valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, in my jealousy and in my wrath I spoke because you bore reproaches of nations;
Ezekiel 36:7 therefore I will raise my hand against the nations around you; these shall receive their dishonor;
Ezekiel 36:8 but your grapes and your fruit, mountains of Israel, my people shall eat, because they draw near to coming.
Ezekiel 36:9 For behold, I am for you and will look upon you, and you shall be cultivated and sown.
Ezekiel 36:10 And I will multiply men upon you, the whole house of Israel completely, and the cities shall be inhabited, and the desolated land shall be built up.
Ezekiel 36:11 And I will multiply men and livestock upon you and settle you as at your beginning, and do good to you as in your former times; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 36:12 And I will bring forth men upon you, my people Israel, and they shall inherit you, and you shall be a possession for them; and you shall certainly no longer be bereaved of children by them.
Ezekiel 36:13 Thus says the Lord Lord: Because they said to you, You are one devouring men, and you became bereaved of children by your nation,
Ezekiel 36:14 therefore you shall no longer eat men and shall no longer bereave your nation of children, says the Lord Lord.
Ezekiel 36:15 And the dishonor of nations shall no longer be heard against you, and you shall certainly not bear reproaches of peoples, says the Lord Lord.
Ezekiel 36:16 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 36:17 Son of man, the house of Israel dwelt upon their land and defiled it in their way and in their idols and in their uncleannesses; like the uncleanness of the woman sitting apart was their way before my face.
Ezekiel 36:18 And I poured out my wrath upon them,
Ezekiel 36:19 and scattered them into the nations and winnowed them into the countries; according to their way and according to their sin I judged them.
Ezekiel 36:20 And they entered into the nations where they entered, and profaned my holy name when it was said of them, These are the Lord's people, and they have gone out of his land.
Ezekiel 36:21 And I spared them because of my holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations where they entered.
Ezekiel 36:22 Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: I do not act for you, house of Israel, but for my holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered.
Ezekiel 36:23 And I will sanctify my great name which was profaned among the nations, which you profaned in their midst, and the nations shall know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
Ezekiel 36:24 And I will take you out of the nations and assemble you from all the lands and bring you into your land.
Ezekiel 36:25 And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you shall be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and from all your idols, and I will cleanse you.
Ezekiel 36:26 And I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you, and remove the stone heart from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
Ezekiel 36:27 And I will put my spirit within you and cause you to walk in my just requirements and keep my judgments and do them.
Ezekiel 36:28 And you shall dwell upon the land which I gave to your fathers, and you shall be a people to me, and I shall be a God to you.
Ezekiel 36:29 And I will save you from all your uncleannesses and call for the grain and multiply it, and I will not put famine upon you;
Ezekiel 36:30 and I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you may not receive a reproach of famine among the nations.
Ezekiel 36:31 And you shall remember your evil ways and your practices which were not good, and be disgusted before their face in your lawlessnesses and over your abominations.
Ezekiel 36:32 I do not act because of you, says the Lord Lord; it shall be known to you. Be ashamed and abashed because of your ways, house of Israel.
Ezekiel 36:33 Thus says the Lord: On the day when I cleanse you from all your lawlessnesses, I will also settle the cities, and the desolate places shall be built up.
Ezekiel 36:34 And the land which had vanished shall be cultivated, whereas it had become a vanished land before the eyes of everyone passing by.
Ezekiel 36:35 And they shall say, That land which had vanished became like a garden of delight, and the desolate and vanished and demolished cities were established as fortified ones.
Ezekiel 36:36 And the nations, as many as remain around you, shall know that I, the Lord, built up the demolished places and planted the vanished places; I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it.
Ezekiel 36:37 Thus says the Lord: Yet for this I shall be sought by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will multiply them, men like sheep.
Ezekiel 36:38 Like holy sheep, like the sheep of Ierusalem in its feasts, so the desolate cities shall be full of flocks of men; and they shall know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 37

Ezekiel 37:1 And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and the Lord brought me out in spirit and placed me in the midst of the plain, and this was full of human bones;
Ezekiel 37:2 and he led me around them all about, and behold, very many upon the face of the plain, very dry.
Ezekiel 37:3 And he said to me, Son of man, shall these bones live? And I said, Lord, you know these things.
Ezekiel 37:4 And he said to me, Prophesy over these bones, and you shall say to them, Dry bones, hear a word of the Lord:
Ezekiel 37:5 Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I bring into you a spirit of life,
Ezekiel 37:6 and I will put sinews upon you and bring flesh up upon you and stretch skin over you and put my spirit into you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 37:7 And I prophesied as he commanded me. And it happened while I was prophesying, and behold, a shaking, and it brought the bones together, each to its joint.
Ezekiel 37:8 And I saw, and behold, sinews and flesh were growing upon them, and skin was coming up over them above, and there was no spirit in them.
Ezekiel 37:9 And he said to me, Prophesy, son of man, prophesy to the spirit and say to the spirit, Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead ones, and let them live.
Ezekiel 37:10 And I prophesied as he commanded me; and the spirit entered into them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, a very great assembly.
Ezekiel 37:11 And the Lord spoke to me, saying, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel, and they say, Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished, we have ceased to be heard.
Ezekiel 37:12 Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I open your tombs and will bring you up out of your tombs and bring you into the land of Israel,
Ezekiel 37:13 and you shall know that I am the Lord when I open your graves, to bring my people up out of the graves.
Ezekiel 37:14 And I will put my spirit into you, and you shall live, and I will place you upon your land, and you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 37:15 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 37:16 Son of man, take for yourself a staff and write upon it Ioudas and the sons of Israel attached to him; and you shall take for yourself a second staff and write upon it, For Ioseph, a staff of Ephraim and all the sons of Israel added to him.
Ezekiel 37:17 And you shall join them to one another for yourself into one staff, to bind them, and they shall be in your hand.
Ezekiel 37:18 And it shall be, when the sons of your people say to you, Will you not tell us what these things are to you?
Ezekiel 37:19 that you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will take the tribe of Ioseph which is through the hand of Ephraim and the tribes of Israel attached to him and put them upon the tribe of Iouda, and they shall be one staff in the hand of Iouda.
Ezekiel 37:20 And the staffs upon which you wrote shall be in your hand before them,
Ezekiel 37:21 and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I take the whole house of Israel from the midst of the nations where they entered, and I will gather them from all those around them and bring them into the land of Israel;
Ezekiel 37:22 and I will make them one nation in my land and in the mountains of Israel, and there shall be one ruler of them, and they shall no longer be two nations, nor shall they certainly be divided any longer into two kingdoms,
Ezekiel 37:23 so that they may no longer be defiled with their idols. And I will deliver them from all their lawlessnesses in which they sinned and cleanse them, and they shall be a people to me, and I, the Lord, shall be a God to them.
Ezekiel 37:24 And my servant Dauid shall be a ruler in their midst, and there shall be one shepherd of all; for they shall walk in my ordinances and keep my judgments and do them.
Ezekiel 37:25 And they shall dwell upon their land which I have given to my servant Iakob, where their fathers dwelt; and they themselves shall dwell upon it, and Dauid my servant shall be their ruler forever.
Ezekiel 37:26 And I will make with them a covenant of peace; an everlasting covenant shall be with them; and I will put my holy places in their midst forever.
Ezekiel 37:27 And my dwelling shall be among them, and I shall be their God, and they shall be my people.
Ezekiel 37:28 And the nations shall know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when my holy places are in their midst forever.

## Chapter 38

Ezekiel 38:1 And a word of the Lord came to me, saying,
Ezekiel 38:2 Son of man, set your face against Gog and the land of Magog, ruler of Ros, Mosoch and Thobel, and prophesy against him,
Ezekiel 38:3 and say to him, Thus says the Lord Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Ros, Mosoch and Thobel,
Ezekiel 38:4 and I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen, all clothed in breastplates, a great assembly, shields and helmets and swords,
Ezekiel 38:5 Persians and Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and shields,
Ezekiel 38:6 Gomer and all those around him, the house of Thergama from the extremity of the north and all those around him, and many nations with you;
Ezekiel 38:7 be prepared, prepare yourself, you and all your assembly, those gathered with you, and you shall be an advance guard for me.
Ezekiel 38:8 After many days he shall be prepared, and at the end of years he shall come and arrive at the land turned away from a sword, of those gathered from many nations, upon the land of Israel, which became wholly desolate; and this one has come out of nations, and they shall all dwell in peace.
Ezekiel 38:9 And you shall go up like rain and come like a cloud to cover a land, and you shall be there, and all those around you and many nations with you.
Ezekiel 38:10 Thus says the Lord Lord: And it shall be on that day, words shall come up upon your heart, and you shall devise evil thoughts,
Ezekiel 38:11 and say, I will go up upon an abandoned land; I will come upon those resting in quietness and dwelling in peace, all inhabiting a land in which there is no wall or bars, and they have no doors,
Ezekiel 38:12 to plunder plunder and despoil their spoils, to turn your hand upon the desolated land which was settled, and upon a nation gathered from many nations, who have acquired possessions, dwelling upon the navel of the earth.
Ezekiel 38:13 Saba and Daidan and Carthaginian merchants and all their villages shall say to you, Are you coming for plunder, to plunder and despoil spoils? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, to carry away a possession, to despoil spoils?
Ezekiel 38:14 Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord: On that day, when my people Israel are settled in peace, shall you not be roused?
Ezekiel 38:15 And you shall come from your place, from the extremity of the north, and many nations with you, all riders of horses, a great assembly and a large force,
Ezekiel 38:16 and you shall go up against my people Israel like a cloud to cover a land; it shall be at the end of the days, and I will bring you up against my land, so that all the nations may know me when I am sanctified in you before them.
Ezekiel 38:17 Thus says the Lord Lord to Gog: You are the one about whom I spoke before former days through the hand of my servants, prophets of Israel, in those days and years, to bring you against them.
Ezekiel 38:18 And it shall be on that day, on the day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, says the Lord Lord, my wrath shall rise,
Ezekiel 38:19 and my jealousy. In the fire of my anger I spoke: Surely on that day there shall be a great shaking upon the land of Israel,
Ezekiel 38:20 and the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the beasts of the plain and all the creeping things creeping upon the earth and all men upon the face of the earth shall be shaken from the presence of the Lord, and the mountains shall be torn apart, and the ravines shall fall, and every wall shall fall upon the earth.
Ezekiel 38:21 And I will call every terror against him, says the Lord; a man's sword shall be against his brother.
Ezekiel 38:22 And I will judge him with death and blood and flooding rain and hailstones, and I will rain fire and sulfur upon him and upon all those with him and upon many nations with him.
Ezekiel 38:23 And I will be magnified and sanctified and glorified and known before many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.

## Chapter 39

Ezekiel 39:1 And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Ros, Mosoch and Thobel,
Ezekiel 39:2 and I will gather you and guide you and bring you up from the extremity of the north and lead you up onto the mountains of Israel.
Ezekiel 39:3 And I will destroy your bow from your left hand and your arrows from your right hand, and cast you down
Ezekiel 39:4 upon the mountains of Israel, and you shall fall, and all those around you, and the nations with you shall be given to multitudes of birds; to every winged creature and all the beasts of the plain I have given you to be devoured.
Ezekiel 39:5 Upon the face of the plain you shall fall, because I have spoken, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 39:6 And I will send fire upon Gog, and the islands shall be inhabited in peace; and they shall know that I am the Lord.
Ezekiel 39:7 And my holy name shall be known in the midst of my people Israel, and my holy name shall no longer be profaned; and the nations shall know that I am the Lord, holy in Israel.
Ezekiel 39:8 Behold, it comes, and you shall know that it shall be, says the Lord Lord; this is the day of which I spoke.
Ezekiel 39:9 And those inhabiting the cities of Israel shall go out and burn with the weapons, shields and poles and bows and arrows and hand staffs and spears; and they shall burn fire with them for seven years.
Ezekiel 39:10 And they shall certainly not take wood from the plain, nor shall they certainly cut it from the woods, but they shall burn the weapons with fire; and they shall plunder those who plundered them and despoil those who despoiled them, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 39:11 And it shall be on that day, I will give Gog a renowned place, a memorial in Israel, the common grave of those who came against it beside the sea, and they shall build around the mouth of the ravine; and they shall bury Gog there and all his multitude, and it shall be called, The gai, the common grave of Gog.
Ezekiel 39:12 And the house of Israel shall bury them, so that the land may be cleansed, in seven months;
Ezekiel 39:13 and all the people of the land shall bury them, and it shall be a renown for them on the day when I was glorified, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 39:14 And they shall continually assign men traversing the land to bury those remaining upon the face of the earth, to cleanse it after the seven months, and they shall search out.
Ezekiel 39:15 And everyone passing through the land and seeing a human bone shall build a sign beside it, until those burying bury it in the gai, the common grave of Gog;
Ezekiel 39:16 for indeed the name of the city is Common Grave; and the land shall be cleansed.
Ezekiel 39:17 And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord: Say to every winged bird and to all the beasts of the plain, Be gathered and come, be gathered from all those round about to my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you, a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel, and you shall eat flesh and drink blood.
Ezekiel 39:18 You shall eat flesh of giants and drink blood of rulers of the earth, rams and calves and goats, and the calves all fattened.
Ezekiel 39:19 And you shall eat fat to fullness and drink blood to drunkenness from my sacrifice which I sacrificed for you.
Ezekiel 39:20 And you shall be filled at my table with horse and rider, giant and every warrior man, says the Lord.
Ezekiel 39:21 And I will put my glory among you, and all the nations shall see my judgment which I executed, and my hand which I brought upon them.
Ezekiel 39:22 And the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God from this day and beyond.
Ezekiel 39:23 And all the nations shall know that the house of Israel was taken captive because of their sins, because they rejected me, and I turned my face away from them and delivered them into the hands of their enemies, and they all fell by a sword.
Ezekiel 39:24 According to their uncleannesses and according to their lawless deeds I did to them, and turned my face away from them.
Ezekiel 39:25 Therefore thus says the Lord Lord: Now I will turn back the captivity of Iakob and have mercy on the house of Israel and be jealous for my holy name.
Ezekiel 39:26 And they shall receive their own dishonor and the injustice which they committed, when they are settled upon their land in peace, and there shall be no one terrifying them.
Ezekiel 39:27 When I turn them back from the nations and gather them from the countries of the nations, I shall also be sanctified in them before the nations,
Ezekiel 39:28 and they shall know that I am the Lord their God when I appear to them among the nations.
Ezekiel 39:29 And I will no longer turn my face away from them, because I poured out my wrath upon the house of Israel, says the Lord Lord.

## Chapter 40

Ezekiel 40:1 And it happened in the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the first month, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the city was captured, on that day the hand of the Lord came upon me and brought me
Ezekiel 40:2 in a vision of God into the land of Israel, and placed me upon a very high mountain, and upon it was something like a city's structure opposite.
Ezekiel 40:3 And he brought me in there, and behold, a man, and his appearance was like the appearance of shining bronze, and in his hand was a builders' cord and a measuring reed, and he stood at the gate.
Ezekiel 40:4 And the man said to me, Have you seen, son of man? See with your eyes and hear with your ears and set in your heart everything that I show you, because you have entered here in order that I may show you, and you shall show everything that you see to the house of Israel.
Ezekiel 40:5 And behold, an enclosure outside the house round about; and in the man's hand was a reed, the measure six cubits, by a cubit and a palm, and he measured the outer wall, its breadth equal to the reed and its height equal to the reed.
Ezekiel 40:6 And he entered the gate facing east by seven steps and measured the ailam of the gate, equal to the reed,
Ezekiel 40:7 and the thee, equal to the reed in length and equal to the reed in breadth, and the ailam between the thaielatha, six cubits, and the second thee, equal to the reed in breadth and equal to the reed in length, and the ailam, five cubits,
Ezekiel 40:8 and the third thee, equal to the reed in breadth and equal to the reed in length,
Ezekiel 40:9 and the ailam of the gateway beside the ailam of the gate, eight cubits, and the aileu, two cubits, and the ailam of the gate on the inside,
Ezekiel 40:10 and the thee of the gate, thee opposite, three on this side and three on that side, and one measure for the three and one measure for the ailam on this side and that side.
Ezekiel 40:11 And he measured the breadth of the door of the gateway, ten cubits, and the width of the gateway, thirteen cubits,
Ezekiel 40:12 and a cubit added upon the front of the theim on this side and that side, and the thee, six cubits on this side and six cubits on that side.
Ezekiel 40:13 And he measured the gate from the wall of the thee to the wall of the thee, a breadth of twenty-five cubits, this gate opposite a gate;
Ezekiel 40:14 and the open space of the ailam of the gate, sixty cubits, twenty theim of the gate round about;
Ezekiel 40:15 and the open space of the gate outside to the open space of the ailam of the gate inside, fifty cubits;
Ezekiel 40:16 and concealed windows upon the theim and upon the ailam inside the gate of the court round about, and likewise for the ailam, windows round about inside, and upon the ailam, palms on this side and that side.
Ezekiel 40:17 And he brought me into the inner court, and behold, chambers and colonnades around the court, thirty chambers in the colonnades,
Ezekiel 40:18 and the porticoes behind the gates, along the length of the gates, the lower colonnade.
Ezekiel 40:19 And he measured the breadth of the court from the open space of the outer gate on the inside to the open space of the gate facing outside, a hundred cubits, of the one facing east. And he brought me to the north,
Ezekiel 40:20 and behold, a gate facing north for the outer court, and he measured it, both its length and its breadth.
Ezekiel 40:21 And its thee, three on this side and three on that side, and its aileu and its ailammo and its palms, and it came to be according to the measures of the gate facing east, fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its width.
Ezekiel 40:22 And its windows and its ailammo and its palms were as the gate facing east; and by seven steps they went up to it, and the ailammo were inside.
Ezekiel 40:23 And a gate for the inner court faced the north gate, in the manner of the gate facing east, and he measured the court from gate to gate, a hundred cubits.
Ezekiel 40:24 And he brought me southward, and behold, a gate facing south, and he measured it and the thee and the aileu and the ailammo according to these measures.
Ezekiel 40:25 And its windows and the ailammo round about were as the windows of the ailam, fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its width.
Ezekiel 40:26 And it had seven steps, and ailammo inside, and it had palms, one on this side and one on that side, upon the aileu.
Ezekiel 40:27 And a gate opposite a gate of the inner court toward the south; and he measured the court from gate to gate, a hundred cubits the width toward the south.
Ezekiel 40:28 And he brought me into the inner court of the gate toward the south, and measured the gate according to these measures,
Ezekiel 40:29 and the thee and the aileu and the ailammo according to these measures; and it and the ailammo had windows round about; fifty cubits its length, and the width twenty-five cubits.
Ezekiel 40:31 And ailammo toward the outer court, and palms for the aileu, and eight steps.
Ezekiel 40:32 And he brought me into the gate facing east and measured it according to these measures,
Ezekiel 40:33 and the thee and the aileu and the ailammo according to these measures; and it and the ailammo had windows round about, fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its width.
Ezekiel 40:34 And ailammo toward the inner court, and palms upon the aileu on this side and that side, and it had eight steps.
Ezekiel 40:35 And he brought me into the gate toward the north and measured according to these measures,
Ezekiel 40:36 and the thee and the aileu and the ailammo; and it had windows round about, and its ailammo; fifty cubits its length and twenty-five cubits its width.
Ezekiel 40:37 And the ailammo toward the outer court, and palms for the aileu on this side and that side, and it had eight steps.
Ezekiel 40:38 Its chambers and its doorways and its ailammo were at the gate
Ezekiel 40:39 of the second, a drain, so that they may slaughter in it the offerings for sin and for ignorance;
Ezekiel 40:40 and behind the channel of the whole burnt offerings of the one facing north, two tables toward the east, and behind the second and the ailam of the gate, two tables eastward,
Ezekiel 40:41 four on this side and four on that side behind the gate; upon them they shall slaughter the sacrifices, opposite the eight tables of the sacrifices.
Ezekiel 40:42 And four tables of the whole burnt offerings, of hewn stone, a cubit and a half in breadth and two cubits and a half in length and a cubit in height; upon them they shall place the implements with which they slaughter there the whole burnt offerings and the sacrifices.
Ezekiel 40:43 And they shall have a hewn cornice of a palm inside round about, and above upon the tables, roofs for shelter from rain and from dryness.
Ezekiel 40:44 And he brought me into the inner court, and behold, two recesses in the inner court, one behind the gate facing north, extending toward the south, and one behind the gate toward the south but facing north.
Ezekiel 40:45 And he said to me, This recess facing south is for the priests keeping the charge of the house,
Ezekiel 40:46 and the recess facing north is for the priests keeping the charge of the altar; those are the sons of Saddouk who draw near from Leui to the Lord to minister to him.
Ezekiel 40:47 And he measured the court, a length of a hundred cubits and a width of a hundred cubits on its four sides, and the altar opposite the house.
Ezekiel 40:48 And he brought me into the ailam of the house. And he measured the ail of the ailam, five cubits the breadth on this side and five cubits on that side, and the width of the doorway, fourteen cubits, and the shoulders of the door of the ailam, three cubits on this side and three cubits on that side;
Ezekiel 40:49 and the length of the ailam, twenty cubits, and the width, twelve cubits; and by ten steps they went up to it; and pillars were upon the ailam, one on this side and one on that side.

## Chapter 41

Ezekiel 41:1 And he brought me into the temple, for which he measured the ailam, six cubits the breadth on this side and six cubits the width of the ailam on that side,
Ezekiel 41:2 and the width of the gateway, ten cubits, and the shoulders of the gateway, five cubits on this side and five cubits on that side; and he measured its length, forty cubits, and the width, twenty cubits.
Ezekiel 41:3 And he entered the inner court and measured the ail of the doorway, two cubits, and the doorway, six cubits, and the shoulders of the doorway, seven cubits on this side and seven cubits on that side.
Ezekiel 41:4 And he measured the length of the doors, forty cubits, and a width of twenty cubits in front of the temple. And he said, This is the holy of holies.
Ezekiel 41:5 And he measured the wall of the house, six cubits, and the width of the side chamber, four cubits round about.
Ezekiel 41:6 And the side chambers, side chamber upon side chamber, thirty-three twice, and a space in the wall of the house in the side chambers round about, for those taking hold to see, so that they might not touch the walls of the house at all.
Ezekiel 41:7 And the width of the upper one of the side chambers was according to the addition from the wall toward the upper one around the house, so that it might widen above, and they might ascend from the lower ones to the upper rooms and from the middle ones to the third story.
Ezekiel 41:8 And the thrael of the house, a height round about, a space of the side chambers equal to the reed, a space of six cubits.
Ezekiel 41:9 And the width of the wall of the side chamber outside, five cubits; and the remaining spaces between the side chambers of the house
Ezekiel 41:10 and between the recesses, a width of twenty cubits, the circuit around the house.
Ezekiel 41:11 And the doors of the recesses opened onto the remaining space of the one door toward the north; and the one door toward the south, and the width of the opening of the remaining space, five cubits in breadth round about.
Ezekiel 41:12 And the dividing structure in front of the remaining space toward the sea, seventy cubits, the breadth of the wall of the dividing structure five cubits, a width round about, and its length ninety cubits.
Ezekiel 41:13 And he measured opposite the house a length of a hundred cubits, and the remaining spaces and the dividing structures and their walls, a length of a hundred cubits,
