Ezekiel 41:14 and the width in front of the house and the remaining spaces opposite, a hundred cubits.
Ezekiel 41:15 And he measured the length of the dividing structure in front of the remaining space behind that house, and the remaining spaces on this side and that side, a hundred cubits the length. And the temple and the corners and the outer ailam
Ezekiel 41:16 were paneled, and the windows latticed, openings for light round about for the three, so as to look through; and the house and the adjoining parts were covered in wood round about, and the floor, and from the floor to the windows, and the windows opening threefold for looking through.
Ezekiel 41:17 And as far as beside the inner one and as far as the outer one, and upon the whole wall round about inside and outside,
Ezekiel 41:18 cheroubin were carved, and palms between cheroub and cheroub; two faces for the cheroub,
Ezekiel 41:19 a man's face toward the palm on this side and that side, and a lion's face toward the palm on this side and that side; the whole house was carved round about,
Ezekiel 41:20 from the floor to the paneling, the cheroubin and palms carved.
Ezekiel 41:21 And the holy place and the temple opened out square. Before the holy places was an appearance like the sight
Ezekiel 41:22 of a wooden altar, three cubits its height, and the length two cubits and the width two cubits; and it had horns, and its base and its walls were wooden; and he said to me, This is the table before the face of the Lord.
Ezekiel 41:23 And two doorways for the temple and the holy place;
Ezekiel 41:24 two door leaves for the two hinged doorways, two door leaves for the one and two door leaves for the second door.
Ezekiel 41:25 And carving upon them, and upon the door leaves of the temple, cheroubin and palms according to the carving of the holy places, and fine timbers in front of the ailam outside,
Ezekiel 41:26 and concealed windows. And he measured on this side and that side, to the ceilings of the ailam and the joined side chambers of the house.

## Chapter 42

Ezekiel 42:1 And he brought me out into the outer court eastward, opposite the gate toward the north; and he brought me in, and behold, five recesses adjoining the remaining space and adjoining the dividing structure toward the north,
Ezekiel 42:2 a hundred cubits in length toward the north, and the breadth fifty cubits,
Ezekiel 42:3 laid out in the manner of the gates of the inner court and in the manner of the colonnades of the outer court, arranged in rows, three porticoes facing one another.
Ezekiel 42:4 And opposite the recesses, a walkway ten cubits in breadth, a hundred cubits in length; and their doorways toward the north.
Ezekiel 42:5 And the upper walkways likewise, because the colonnade projected from it, from the lower colonnade, and the space; thus a colonnade and a space, and thus porticoes;
Ezekiel 42:6 because they were triple and did not have pillars like the pillars of the outer ones, therefore they projected beyond the lower and middle ones from the ground.
Ezekiel 42:7 And an opening outside in the manner of the recesses of the outer court facing opposite the recesses toward the north, a length of fifty cubits;
Ezekiel 42:8 because the length of the recesses facing into the outer court was fifty cubits, and these are facing those; the whole, a hundred cubits.
Ezekiel 42:9 And the doors of these recesses of the entrance toward the east, to enter through them from the outer court,
Ezekiel 42:10 were along the opening of the walkway at the beginning. – And the parts toward the south, in front of the south, in front of the remaining space and in front of the dividing structure, recesses,
Ezekiel 42:11 and the walkway before them according to the measures of the recesses toward the north, and according to their length and according to their width and according to all their exits and according to all their turnings and according to their openings and according to their doorways
Ezekiel 42:12 of the recesses toward the south, and according to the doorways from the beginning of the walkway, as toward an opening of a reed's space, and eastward to enter through them. –
Ezekiel 42:13 And he said to me, The recesses toward the north and the recesses toward the south which are in front of the spaces, these are the recesses of the holy place, in which the priests, sons of Saddouk, who draw near to the Lord, shall eat there the holy of holies; and there they shall put the holy of holies and the sacrifice and the offerings for sin and the offerings for ignorance, because the place is holy.
Ezekiel 42:14 No one shall enter there except the priests; they shall not go out from the holy place into the outer court, so that those presenting may always be holy, and may not touch their apparel in which they minister in them, because they are holy; and they shall put on other garments when they touch the people. –
Ezekiel 42:15 And the measuring of the house inside was completed. And he brought me out by the way of the gate facing east and measured the outline of the house round about in order.
Ezekiel 42:16 And he stood behind the gate facing east and measured five hundred with the measuring reed;
Ezekiel 42:17 and he turned toward the north and measured the front toward the north, five hundred cubits with the measuring reed;
Ezekiel 42:18 and he turned toward the sea and measured the front toward the sea, five hundred with the measuring reed;
Ezekiel 42:19 and he turned toward the south and measured opposite the south, five hundred with the measuring reed;
Ezekiel 42:20 the four sides by the same reed. And he arranged it, and their enclosure round about, five hundred eastward and five hundred cubits in width, to distinguish between the holy places and the outer wall in the arrangement of the house.

## Chapter 43

Ezekiel 43:1 And he brought me to the gate facing east and led me out,
Ezekiel 43:2 and behold, the glory of the God of Israel was coming by the way of the gate facing east, and the sound of the camp was like the sound of many doubling their voices, and the earth shone out like brightness from the glory round about.
Ezekiel 43:3 And the vision which I saw was according to the vision which I saw when I was entering to anoint the city, and the vision of the chariot which I saw was according to the vision which I saw at the river Chobar; and I fall upon my face.
Ezekiel 43:4 And the glory of the Lord entered the house by the way of the gate facing east.
Ezekiel 43:5 And a spirit took me up and brought me into the inner court, and behold, the house was full of the glory of the Lord.
Ezekiel 43:6 And I stood, and behold, a voice from the house of one speaking to me, and the man stood beside me.
Ezekiel 43:7 And he said to me, Have you seen, son of man, the place of my throne and the place of the footprint of my feet, in which my name shall dwell in the midst of the house of Israel forever? And the house of Israel shall no longer profane my holy name, they and their leaders, with their prostitution and with the murders of the leaders in their midst,
Ezekiel 43:8 when they place my threshold among their thresholds and my doorposts adjoining their doorposts, and they made my wall as adjoining me and them, and profaned my holy name with their lawlessnesses which they were committing; and I crushed them in my wrath and in murder.
Ezekiel 43:9 And now let them thrust their prostitution and the murders of their leaders away from me, and I will dwell in their midst forever.
Ezekiel 43:10 And you, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, and they shall cease from their sins; and its appearance and its arrangement,
Ezekiel 43:11 and they themselves shall receive their punishment concerning all that they did. And you shall draw the house and its exits and its structure, and make known to them all its ordinances and all its laws, and draw it before them, and they shall keep all my just requirements and all my ordinances and do them;
Ezekiel 43:12 and the drawing of the house upon the summit of the mountain, all its boundaries round about, holy of holies.
Ezekiel 43:13 And these are the measures of the altar, by a cubit of a cubit and a palm; a hollow, a cubit in depth and a cubit the width, and a cornice upon its rim round about, a span. And this is the height of the altar:
Ezekiel 43:14 from the depth of the beginning of its hollow to the great lower propitiatory, two cubits, and the width a cubit; and from the small propitiatory to the great propitiatory, four cubits, and a width of a cubit;
Ezekiel 43:15 and the ariel, four cubits, and from the ariel and above the horns, a cubit.
Ezekiel 43:16 And the ariel, twelve cubits in length by twelve cubits in breadth, square on its four sides;
Ezekiel 43:17 and the propitiatory, fourteen cubits in length by fourteen cubits in width on its four sides; and its cornice circling it round about, half a cubit, and its surrounding space a cubit round about; and its steps facing east.
Ezekiel 43:18 And he said to me, Son of man, thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: These are the ordinances of the altar on the day of its making, to offer whole burnt offerings upon it and pour blood against it.
Ezekiel 43:19 And you shall give to the priests, the Levites from the seed of Saddouk who draw near to me, says the Lord God, to minister to me, a calf from the cattle for sin;
Ezekiel 43:20 and they shall take from its blood and put it upon the four horns of the altar and upon the four corners of the propitiatory and upon the base round about, and make atonement for it;
Ezekiel 43:21 and they shall take the calf for sin, and it shall be burned in the separated part of the house outside the holy places.
Ezekiel 43:22 And on the second day they shall take two unblemished kids of goats for sin and make atonement for the altar as they made atonement with the calf;
Ezekiel 43:23 and after you complete the atonement, they shall present an unblemished calf from the cattle and an unblemished ram from the sheep,
Ezekiel 43:24 and you shall present them before the Lord, and the priests shall cast salt upon them and offer them as whole burnt offerings to the Lord.
Ezekiel 43:25 For seven days you shall prepare a kid for sin each day, and a calf from the cattle and a ram from the sheep; they shall prepare unblemished ones
Ezekiel 43:26 for seven days; and they shall make atonement for the altar and cleanse it and fill their hands.
Ezekiel 43:27 And it shall be from the eighth day and beyond, the priests shall prepare upon the altar your whole burnt offerings and your offerings of deliverance. And I will accept you, says the Lord.

## Chapter 44

Ezekiel 44:1 And he turned me back by the way of the outer gate of the holy places facing east, and it was shut.
Ezekiel 44:2 And the Lord said to me, This gate shall be shut; it shall not be opened, and no one shall certainly pass through it, because the Lord, the God of Israel, shall enter through it, and it shall be shut;
Ezekiel 44:3 for the leader, this one shall sit in it to eat bread before the Lord; by the way of the ailam of the gate he shall enter, and by its way he shall go out. –
Ezekiel 44:4 And he brought me in by the way of the gate toward the north, opposite the house, and I saw, and behold, the house of the Lord was full of glory, and I fall upon my face.
Ezekiel 44:5 And the Lord said to me, Son of man, set in your heart and see with your eyes and hear with your ears everything that I speak with you, according to all the ordinances of the house of the Lord and according to all its laws; and you shall set your heart upon the entrance of the house, according to all its exits in all the holy places.
Ezekiel 44:6 And you shall say to the house provoking bitterness, to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God: Let all your lawlessnesses suffice you, house of Israel,
Ezekiel 44:7 in that you brought in foreign sons, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my holy places, and they were profaning them when you presented bread, fat and blood, and you were transgressing my covenant in all your lawlessnesses,
Ezekiel 44:8 and you appointed them to keep charges in my holy places.
Ezekiel 44:9 Therefore thus says the Lord God: No foreign son, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter my holy places, among all the sons of foreigners who are in the midst of the house of Israel,
Ezekiel 44:10 but only the Levites who leapt away from me when Israel went astray from me after their thoughts, and they shall receive their injustice,
Ezekiel 44:11 and shall be in my holy places ministering as doorkeepers at the gates of the house and ministering to the house; these shall slaughter the whole burnt offerings and the sacrifices for the people, and these shall stand before the people to minister to them.
Ezekiel 44:12 Because they were ministering to them before the face of their idols, and it became for the house of Israel a punishment for injustice, for this reason I raised my hand against them, says the Lord God,
Ezekiel 44:13 and they shall not draw near to me to serve as priests to me, nor to approach the holy things of the sons of Israel, nor my holy of holies, and they shall receive their dishonor in the straying in which they strayed.
Ezekiel 44:14 And they shall assign them to keep the charges of the house for all its works and for everything they may do. –
Ezekiel 44:15 The priests, the Levites, the sons of Saddouk, who kept the charges of my holy places when the house of Israel went astray from me, these shall approach me to minister to me and stand before my face to present to me a sacrifice, fat and blood, says the Lord God.
Ezekiel 44:16 These shall enter my holy places, and these shall approach my table to minister to me, and they shall keep my charges.
Ezekiel 44:17 And it shall be, when they enter the gates of the inner court, they shall put on linen robes and shall not put on woolen ones when they minister from the gate of the inner court;
Ezekiel 44:18 and they shall have linen turbans upon their heads and linen breeches upon their loins, and shall not gird themselves tightly.
Ezekiel 44:19 And when they go out into the outer court to the people, they shall take off their robes in which they minister, and put them in the recesses of the holy places, and put on other robes, and shall certainly not sanctify the people with their robes.
Ezekiel 44:20 And they shall not shave their heads and shall not strip their hair bare; covering, they shall cover their heads.
Ezekiel 44:21 And no priest shall certainly drink wine when they enter the inner court.
Ezekiel 44:22 And they shall not take for themselves as a wife a widow or a woman cast out, but only a virgin from the seed of Israel; and if a widow is left by a priest, they shall take her.
Ezekiel 44:23 And they shall teach my people between holy and profane, and make known to them between unclean and clean.
Ezekiel 44:24 And these shall preside over a judgment of blood, to distinguish; they shall uphold my just requirements and judge my judgments and keep my laws and my ordinances in all my feasts, and sanctify my sabbaths.
Ezekiel 44:25 And they shall not come to a human soul so as to be defiled, except for his father and mother and son and daughter and brother and sister who has not become a man's wife, he shall be defiled.
Ezekiel 44:26 And after he is cleansed, he shall count out seven days for himself;
Ezekiel 44:27 and on the day when they enter the inner court to minister in the holy place, they shall present a propitiation, says the Lord God.
Ezekiel 44:28 And it shall be an inheritance for them; I am an inheritance for them, and a possession shall not be given to them among the sons of Israel, because I am their possession.
Ezekiel 44:29 And these shall eat the sacrifices and the offerings for sin and the offerings for ignorance, and everything set apart in Israel shall be theirs;
Ezekiel 44:30 firstfruits of everything and the firstborn of everything and all the portions taken from all your firstfruits shall be for the priests; and you shall give your first produce to the priest, to put your blessings upon your houses.
Ezekiel 44:31 And the priests shall not eat anything that has died of itself or been taken by beasts, from the birds or from the livestock.

## Chapter 45

Ezekiel 45:1 And when you measure out the land as an inheritance, you shall set apart a firstfruit for the Lord, holy, from the land, twenty-five thousand in length and twenty thousand in width; it shall be holy in all its boundaries round about.
Ezekiel 45:2 And from this there shall be for a sanctuary five hundred by five hundred, square round about, and a space of fifty cubits for it round about.
Ezekiel 45:3 And from this measurement you shall measure a length of twenty-five thousand and a width of ten thousand, and in it shall be the sanctuary, holy of holies;
Ezekiel 45:4 from the land it shall be for the priests ministering in the holy place, and shall be for those drawing near to minister to the Lord, and it shall be for them a place for houses set apart for their sanctification.
Ezekiel 45:5 Twenty-five thousand in length and ten thousand in width shall be for the Levites ministering to the house, for them as a possession, cities to inhabit.
Ezekiel 45:6 And you shall give the possession of the city five thousand in width and twenty-five thousand in length; like the firstfruit of the holy places they shall be for the whole house of Israel.
Ezekiel 45:7 And for the leader, on this side and on that side of the firstfruits of the holy places, for the possession of the city, in front of the firstfruits of the holy places and in front of the possession of the city, the parts toward the sea, and from the parts toward the sea toward the east; and the length like one of the portions from the boundaries toward the sea, and the length to the boundaries toward the east of the land;
Ezekiel 45:8 and it shall be a possession for him in Israel, and the leaders of Israel shall no longer oppress my people, and the house of Israel shall inherit the land according to their tribes. –
Ezekiel 45:9 Thus says the Lord God: Let it suffice you, leaders of Israel; remove injustice and misery and do judgment and righteousness, take oppression away from my people, says the Lord God.
Ezekiel 45:10 Let there be for you a just balance and a just measure and a just choinix.
Ezekiel 45:11 The measure and the choinix shall equally be one for receiving; the choinix a tenth of the gomor, and the measure a tenth of the gomor; it shall be equal in relation to the gomor.
Ezekiel 45:12 And the weight, twenty obols; the five shekels, five, and the ten shekels, ten, and the mina shall be fifty shekels for you.
Ezekiel 45:13 And this is the firstfruit which you shall set apart: a sixth of the measure from the gomor of wheat, and a sixth of the oiphi from the kor of barley.
Ezekiel 45:14 And the ordinance of the oil: a kotyle of oil from ten kotylai, because the ten kotylai are a gomor.
Ezekiel 45:15 And a sheep from the ten sheep, a portion taken from all the clans of Israel, for sacrifices and for whole burnt offerings and for an offering of deliverance, to make atonement for you, says the Lord God.
Ezekiel 45:16 And all the people shall give this firstfruit to the leader of Israel.
Ezekiel 45:17 And through the leader shall be the whole burnt offerings, and the sacrifices and the libations shall be in the feasts and in the new moons and in the sabbaths and in all the feasts of the house of Israel; he himself shall prepare the offerings for sin and the sacrifice and the whole burnt offerings and the offerings of deliverance, to make atonement for the house of Israel.
Ezekiel 45:18 Thus says the Lord God: In the first month, on the first of the month, you shall take an unblemished calf from the cattle to make atonement for the holy place.
Ezekiel 45:19 And the priest shall take from the blood of the atonement and put it upon the doorposts of the house and upon the four corners of the temple and upon the altar and upon the doorposts of the gate of the inner court.
Ezekiel 45:20 And thus you shall do in the seventh month, on the first of the month; you shall take a portion from each one and make atonement for the house.
Ezekiel 45:21 And in the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, the pascha shall be a feast for you; for seven days you shall eat unleavened things.
Ezekiel 45:22 And on that day the leader shall prepare for himself and the house and for all the people of the land a calf for sin.
Ezekiel 45:23 And for the seven days of the feast he shall prepare whole burnt offerings for the Lord, seven calves and seven unblemished rams each day for the seven days, and a kid of goats for sin each day.
Ezekiel 45:24 And as a sacrifice you shall prepare a cake for the calf and a cake for the ram, and a hin of oil for the cake.
Ezekiel 45:25 And in the seventh month, on the fifteenth of the month, at the feast you shall prepare according to the same things for seven days, as the offerings for sin and as the whole burnt offerings and as the manaa and as the oil.

## Chapter 46

Ezekiel 46:1 Thus says the Lord God: The gate in the inner court facing east shall be shut for the six working days, but on the day of the sabbaths it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
Ezekiel 46:2 And the leader shall enter by the way of the ailam of the gate outside and stand at the thresholds of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his whole burnt offerings and his offerings of deliverance; and he shall worship upon the threshold of the gate and go out, and the gate shall certainly not be shut until evening.
Ezekiel 46:3 And the people of the land shall worship at the thresholds of that gate on the sabbaths and on the new moons before the Lord.
Ezekiel 46:4 And the leader shall present the whole burnt offerings to the Lord: on the day of the sabbaths, six unblemished lambs and an unblemished ram,
Ezekiel 46:5 and a manaa, a cake for the ram, and for the lambs a sacrifice, a gift of his hand, and a hin of oil for the cake;
Ezekiel 46:6 and on the day of the new moon, an unblemished calf and six lambs, and a ram shall be unblemished,
Ezekiel 46:7 and a cake for the ram and a cake for the calf shall be a manaa, and for the lambs as his hand may produce, and a hin of oil for the cake.
Ezekiel 46:8 And when the leader enters, he shall enter by the way of the ailam of the gate, and by the way of the gate he shall go out.
