## Chapter 1

2 Peter 1:1 Simeon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who obtained a faith equally precious with ours in the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
2 Peter 1:2 May grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
2 Peter 1:3 as his divine power has given us all things pertaining to life and godliness, through the knowledge of the one who called us through glory and excellence,
2 Peter 1:4 through which the greatest and precious promises have been given to us, so that through these you may become partakers of divine nature, having escaped the corruption in the world in desire.
2 Peter 1:5 And for this very thing also, bringing in all diligence, supply in your faith excellence, and in excellence knowledge,
2 Peter 1:6 and in knowledge self-control, and in self-control endurance, and in endurance godliness,
2 Peter 1:7 and in godliness brotherly love, and in brotherly love love.
2 Peter 1:8 For these things, belonging to you and increasing, make you neither idle nor unfruitful toward the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
2 Peter 1:9 For the one to whom these things are not present is blind, being shortsighted, having taken forgetfulness of the cleansing of his former sins.
2 Peter 1:10 Therefore rather, brothers, be diligent to make your calling and election firm, for doing these things you will certainly never stumble.
2 Peter 1:11 For thus the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly supplied to you.
2 Peter 1:12 Therefore I will not neglect always to remind you concerning these things, although you know and have been established in the present truth.
2 Peter 1:13 But I consider it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminder,
2 Peter 1:14 knowing that the putting off of my tent is soon, as also our Lord Jesus Christ indicated to me.
2 Peter 1:15 But I will also be diligent that after my departure you may at each time be able to make remembrance of these things.
2 Peter 1:16 For not having followed cleverly devised myths did we make known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but having become eyewitnesses of his majesty.
2 Peter 1:17 For having received honor and glory from God the Father, such a voice having been brought to him by the magnificent glory: This is my beloved Son, in whom I took pleasure,
2 Peter 1:18 and we heard this voice brought from heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.
2 Peter 1:19 And we have the prophetic word firmer, to which you do well to pay attention as to a lamp shining in a murky place, until day shines through and the light-bearer rises in your hearts,
2 Peter 1:20 knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture comes from its own interpretation.
2 Peter 1:21 For prophecy was never brought by man's will, but the holy men of God spoke, being carried by the Holy Spirit.

## Chapter 2

2 Peter 2:1 But there also arose false prophets among the people, as there will also be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in heresies of destruction, even denying the master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
2 Peter 2:2 And many will follow their destructions, because of whom the way of truth will be blasphemed.
2 Peter 2:3 And in greed they will trade in you with fabricated words, for whom the judgment from long ago is not idle, and their destruction does not slumber.
2 Peter 2:4 For if God did not spare angels having sinned, but having cast them into Tartarus with chains of gloom, handed them over, kept for judgment,
2 Peter 2:5 and did not spare the ancient world, but guarded Noah, an eighth, a herald of righteousness, having brought a flood upon a world of ungodly ones,
2 Peter 2:6 and having reduced the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes, condemned them to overthrow, having set an example of those about to be ungodly,
2 Peter 2:7 and rescued righteous Lot, being oppressed by the conduct of the lawless in licentiousness,
2 Peter 2:8 for by sight and hearing the righteous one, dwelling among them, was tormenting a righteous soul day after day with lawless works,
2 Peter 2:9 the Lord knows how to rescue godly ones out of trial, but to keep unrighteous ones being punished for a day of judgment,
2 Peter 2:10 and especially those going after flesh in desire of defilement and despising lordship. Daring, self-willed, they do not tremble, blaspheming glories,
2 Peter 2:11 whereas angels, being greater in strength and power, do not bring a blasphemous judgment against them before the Lord.
2 Peter 2:12 But these, like irrational natural animals born for capture and corruption, blaspheming in things they do not know, will be utterly corrupted in their corruption,
2 Peter 2:13 receiving a wage of unrighteousness, considering luxury in daytime a pleasure, spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceits, feasting together with you,
2 Peter 2:14 having eyes full of an adulteress and unceasing from sin, enticing unstable souls, having a heart trained in greeds, children of a curse.
2 Peter 2:15 Having left the straight way, they wandered, having followed the way of Balaam of Bosor, who loved a wage of unrighteousness.
2 Peter 2:16 But he had a rebuke of his own lawlessness: a voiceless beast of burden, having spoken with a man's voice, restrained the prophet's madness.
2 Peter 2:17 These are waterless springs, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the gloom of darkness has been kept forever.
2 Peter 2:18 For speaking swollen things of vanity, they entice in fleshly desires, in licentiousness, those who truly escaped those conducting themselves in wandering,
2 Peter 2:19 promising them freedom, themselves being slaves of corruption; for by what someone has been overcome, by this he has also been enslaved.
2 Peter 2:20 For if, having escaped the defilements of the world in the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, but having again become entangled in these, they are overcome, their last things have become worse than the first.
2 Peter 2:21 For it was better for them not to have known the way of righteousness than, having known it, to turn back from the holy commandment handed down to them.
2 Peter 2:22 But the thing of the true proverb has happened to them: A dog having returned to its own vomit, and a sow having washed, to a rolling in mud.

## Chapter 3

2 Peter 3:1 This is already a second letter I write to you, beloved, in which I stir up your sincere understanding by reminder,
2 Peter 3:2 to remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Savior from our apostles,
2 Peter 3:3 knowing this first, that mockers will come at the last of the days, walking according to their own desires,
2 Peter 3:4 and saying: Where is the promise of his coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things remain thus from the beginning of creation.
2 Peter 3:5 For this escapes them willingly, that heavens existed long ago, and earth standing together out of water and through water by the word of God,
2 Peter 3:6 through which the world then, having been flooded with water, perished.
2 Peter 3:7 But the present heavens and earth have been stored up by his word for fire, being kept for a day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
2 Peter 3:8 But let this one thing not escape you, beloved, that one day before the Lord is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
2 Peter 3:9 The Lord does not delay the promise, as some consider delay, but is patient toward us, not wishing any to perish but all to come to repentance.
2 Peter 3:10 But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a rushing sound, and the elements, burning, will be dissolved, and earth and the works in it will be burned up.
2 Peter 3:11 Therefore, all these things being dissolved, what kind ought you to be in holy conducts and godlinesses,
2 Peter 3:12 expecting and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which heavens being set on fire will be dissolved, and elements burning melt.
2 Peter 3:13 But according to his promise we expect new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.
2 Peter 3:14 Therefore, beloved, expecting these things, be diligent to be found by him unspotted and blameless in peace,
2 Peter 3:15 and consider the patience of our Lord salvation, as also our beloved brother Paul, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,
2 Peter 3:16 as also in all the letters, speaking in them concerning these things, in which are some things difficult to understand, which the unlearned and unstable twist, as also the remaining Scriptures, toward their own destruction.
2 Peter 3:17 Therefore you, beloved, knowing beforehand, guard yourselves so that, being carried away together by the wandering of the lawless, you may not fall from your own firmness.
2 Peter 3:18 But grow in grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to a day of eternity. Amen.

# 1 John

The Apostolic Bible. Public domain. https://apostolic-bible.ysys9.chatgpt.site/license.html


## Chapter 1

1 John 1:1 What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we beheld and our hands touched, concerning the word of life,
1 John 1:2 and the life was manifested, and we have seen and testify and announce to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and was manifested to us,
1 John 1:3 what we have seen and heard we announce to you, so that you also may have fellowship with us; and our fellowship is also with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
1 John 1:4 And these things we write to you so that our joy may be fulfilled.
1 John 1:5 And this is the promise which we have heard from him and report to you, that God is light, and there is no darkness at all in him.
1 John 1:6 If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in darkness, we lie and do not do the truth.
1 John 1:7 But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from every sin.
1 John 1:8 If we say that we do not have sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
1 John 1:9 If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and cleanse us from every unrighteousness.
1 John 1:10 If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

## Chapter 2

1 John 2:1 My little children, these things I write to you so that you may not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.
1 John 2:2 And he is atonement concerning our sins, but not concerning ours only, but also concerning the whole world.
1 John 2:3 And by this we know that we have known him, if we keep his commandments.
1 John 2:4 The one saying: I have known him, and not keeping his commandments, is a liar, and in this one the truth is not.
1 John 2:5 But whoever keeps his word, truly in this one the love of God has been perfected. By this we know that we are in him.
1 John 2:6 The one saying he remains in him ought himself also to walk thus, just as that one walked.
1 John 2:7 Brothers, I do not write a new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning; the old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.
1 John 2:8 Again I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.
1 John 2:9 The one saying he is in the light and hating his brother is in the darkness until now.
1 John 2:10 The one loving his brother remains in the light, and there is no stumbling block in him.
1 John 2:11 But the one hating his brother is in the darkness and walks in the darkness, and does not know where he goes, because the darkness blinded his eyes.
1 John 2:12 I write to you, little children, because the sins have been forgiven you because of his name.
1 John 2:13 I write to you, fathers, because you have known the one from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, children, because you have known the Father.
1 John 2:14 I wrote to you, fathers, because you have known the one from the beginning. I wrote to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.
1 John 2:15 Do not love the world nor the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
1 John 2:16 Because everything in the world, the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes and the arrogance of life, is not from the Father but is from the world.
1 John 2:17 And the world is passing away, and its desire; but the one doing the will of God remains forever.
1 John 2:18 Children, it is a last hour; and as you heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen, from which we know that it is a last hour.
1 John 2:19 They went out from us, but they were not from us; for if they were from us, they would have remained with us, but so that they might be manifested, that not all are from us.
1 John 2:20 And you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things.
1 John 2:21 I did not write to you because you do not know the truth, but because you know it, and because every lie is not from the truth.
1 John 2:22 Who is the liar if not the one denying that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, the one denying the Father and the Son.
1 John 2:23 Everyone denying the Son does not have the Father either.
1 John 2:24 Therefore you, let what you heard from the beginning remain in you. If what you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.
1 John 2:25 And this is the promise which he himself promised us, the eternal life.
1 John 2:26 These things I wrote to you concerning those deceiving you.
1 John 2:27 And you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you have no need that anyone teach you; but as the same anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true and is not a lie, and as it taught you, you will remain in him.
1 John 2:28 And now, little children, remain in him, so that when he is manifested we may have boldness and not be put to shame away from him at his coming.
1 John 2:29 If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone doing righteousness has been begotten from him.

## Chapter 3

1 John 3:1 See what kind of love the Father has given us, so that we may be called children of God. Because of this the world does not know us, because it did not know him.
1 John 3:2 Beloved, now we are children of God, and it has not yet been manifested what we will be; but we know that if he is manifested, we will be like him, because we will see him as he is.
1 John 3:3 And everyone having this hope upon him purifies himself, just as that one is pure.
1 John 3:4 Everyone doing sin also does lawlessness, and sin is lawlessness.
1 John 3:5 And you know that that one was manifested so that he might take away our sins, and sin is not in him.
1 John 3:6 Everyone remaining in him does not sin; everyone sinning has not seen him nor known him.
1 John 3:7 Little children, let no one deceive you. The one doing righteousness is righteous, just as that one is righteous.
1 John 3:8 The one doing sin is from the devil, because from the beginning the devil sins. For this the Son of God was manifested, so that he might dissolve the works of the devil.
1 John 3:9 Everyone begotten from God does not do sin, because his seed remains in him; and he cannot sin, because he has been begotten from God.
1 John 3:10 By this the children of God and the children of the devil are manifest: everyone not doing righteousness is not from God, and the one not loving his brother.
1 John 3:11 Because this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another,
1 John 3:12 not as Cain was from the evil one and slaughtered his brother. And for what reason did he slaughter him? Because his works were evil, but those of his brother righteous.
1 John 3:13 Do not marvel, my brothers, if the world hates you.
1 John 3:14 We know that we have passed from death into life, because we love the brothers. The one not loving the brother remains in death.
1 John 3:15 Everyone hating his brother is a murderer, and you know that every murderer does not have eternal life remaining in him.
1 John 3:16 By this we have known love, because that one laid down his soul for us; and we ought to lay down our souls for the brothers.
1 John 3:17 But whoever has the livelihood of the world, and sees his brother having need, and closes his inward parts against him, how does the love of God remain in him?
1 John 3:18 My little children, let us not love in word nor in tongue, but in work and truth.
1 John 3:19 And by this we know that we are from the truth, and before him we will persuade our hearts,
1 John 3:20 because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.
1 John 3:21 Beloved, if our heart does not condemn us, we have boldness toward God,
1 John 3:22 and whatever we ask we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things pleasing before him.
1 John 3:23 And this is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
1 John 3:24 And the one keeping his commandments remains in him, and he in him; and by this we know that he remains in us, from the Spirit which he gave us.

## Chapter 4

1 John 4:1 Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
1 John 4:2 By this know the Spirit of God: every spirit confessing Jesus Christ having come in flesh is from God.
1 John 4:3 And every spirit not confessing Jesus Christ having come in flesh is not from God; and this is that of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming, and now is already in the world.
1 John 4:4 You are from God, little children, and have overcome them, because the one in you is greater than the one in the world.
1 John 4:5 They are from the world; because of this they speak from the world, and the world hears them.
1 John 4:6 We are from God. The one knowing God hears us; the one who is not from God does not hear us. From this we know the Spirit of truth and the spirit of wandering.
1 John 4:7 Beloved, let us love one another, because love is from God, and everyone loving has been begotten from God and knows God.
1 John 4:8 The one not loving did not know God, because God is love.
1 John 4:9 In this the love of God was manifested in us, that God has sent his only-begotten Son into the world so that we may live through him.
1 John 4:10 In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as atonement concerning our sins.
1 John 4:11 Beloved, if God thus loved us, we also ought to love one another.
1 John 4:12 No one has ever beheld God. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love is perfected in us.
1 John 4:13 By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us from his Spirit.
1 John 4:14 And we have beheld and testify that the Father has sent the Son as Savior of the world.
1 John 4:15 Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him and he in God.
1 John 4:16 And we have known and believed the love which God has in us. God is love, and the one remaining in love remains in God, and God in him.
1 John 4:17 In this love has been perfected with us, so that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as that one is, we also are in this world.
1 John 4:18 There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts fear outside, because fear has punishment; but the one fearing has not been perfected in love.
1 John 4:19 We love him because he first loved us.
1 John 4:20 If anyone says: I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar; for the one not loving his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?
1 John 4:21 And this commandment we have from him, that the one loving God should also love his brother.

## Chapter 5

1 John 5:1 Everyone believing that Jesus is the Christ has been begotten from God, and everyone loving the one who begot also loves the one begotten from him.
1 John 5:2 By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
1 John 5:3 For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments; and his commandments are not heavy.
1 John 5:4 Because everything begotten from God overcomes the world; and this is the victory which overcame the world, our faith.
1 John 5:5 Who is the one overcoming the world if not the one believing that Jesus is the Son of God?
1 John 5:6 This is the one who came through water and blood, Jesus the Christ; not in the water only, but in the water and in the blood. And the Spirit is the one testifying, because the Spirit is the truth.
1 John 5:7 Because there are three testifying in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit, and these three are one.
1 John 5:8 And there are three testifying on earth, the Spirit and the water and the blood, and the three are unto the one.
1 John 5:9 If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater, because this is the testimony of God which he has testified concerning his Son.
1 John 5:10 The one believing in the Son of God has the testimony in himself; the one not believing God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony which God has testified concerning his Son.
1 John 5:11 And this is the testimony, that God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
1 John 5:12 The one having the Son has life; the one not having the Son of God does not have life.
1 John 5:13 These things I wrote to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life, and so that you may believe in the name of the Son of God.
1 John 5:14 And this is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
1 John 5:15 And if we know that he hears us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests which we have asked from him.
1 John 5:16 If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not unto death, he will ask, and he will give him life, to those sinning not unto death. There is a sin unto death; not concerning that do I say that he should ask.
1 John 5:17 All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not unto death.
1 John 5:18 We know that everyone begotten from God does not sin, but the one begotten from God keeps himself, and the evil one does not touch him.
1 John 5:19 We know that we are from God, and the whole world lies in the evil one.
1 John 5:20 But we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know the true one; and we are in the true one, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.
1 John 5:21 Little children, guard yourselves from the idols. Amen.

Jude 1:20 But you, beloved, building yourselves upon your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit,

Revelation 4:9 And whenever the living creatures will give glory and honor and thanksgiving to the one sitting upon the throne, the one living forever and ever,
Revelation 4:10 the twenty-four elders will fall before the one sitting upon the throne, and worship the one living forever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
Revelation 4:11 You are worthy, Lord, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, because you created all things, and because of your will they are and were created.

## Chapter 5

Revelation 5:1 And I saw upon the right hand of the one sitting upon the throne a book written within and behind, sealed with seven seals.
Revelation 5:2 And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a great voice: Who is worthy to open the book and loose its seals?
Revelation 5:3 And no one in heaven nor upon the earth nor beneath the earth was able to open the book nor look at it.
Revelation 5:4 And I wept much because no one was found worthy to open and read the book, nor look at it.
Revelation 5:5 And one of the elders says to me: Do not weep; behold, the lion from the tribe of Judah, the root of David, overcame, to open the book and loose its seven seals.
Revelation 5:6 And I saw, and behold, in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the elders, a lamb standing as slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent into all the earth.
Revelation 5:7 And he came and has taken the book from the right hand of the one sitting upon the throne.
Revelation 5:8 And when he took the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the lamb, each having harps and golden bowls full of incenses, which are the prayers of the saints.
Revelation 5:9 And they sing a new song, saying: You are worthy to take the book and open its seals, because you were slaughtered and bought us for God in your blood from every tribe and tongue and people and nation,
Revelation 5:10 and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign upon the earth.
Revelation 5:11 And I saw and heard a voice of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders, and thousands of thousands,
Revelation 5:12 saying with a great voice: Worthy is the lamb who has been slaughtered to receive the power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing.
Revelation 5:13 And every creature which is in heaven and on the earth and beneath the earth and upon the sea, the things which are, and all the things in them, I heard saying: To the one sitting upon the throne and to the lamb, the blessing and the honor and the glory and the dominion forever and ever.
Revelation 5:14 And the four living creatures were saying: Amen. And the twenty-four elders fell and worshiped the one living forever and ever.

## Chapter 6

Revelation 6:1 And I saw when the lamb opened one of the seals, and heard one of the four living creatures saying as a voice of thunder: Come and see.
Revelation 6:2 And I saw, and behold, a white horse, and the one sitting upon it having a bow; and a crown was given him, and he went out overcoming and so that he might overcome.
Revelation 6:3 And when he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying: Come and see.
Revelation 6:4 And another horse went out, fiery red, and to the one sitting upon it was given to take peace from the earth, and so that they might slaughter one another; and a great sword was given him.
Revelation 6:5 And when he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying: Come and see. And I saw, and behold, a black horse, and the one sitting upon it having a balance in his hand.
Revelation 6:6 And I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying: A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenixes of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine.
Revelation 6:7 And when he opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying: Come and see.
Revelation 6:8 And I saw, and behold, a pale green horse, and the one sitting upon it, his name Death, and Hades follows with him; and authority was given them to kill over the fourth of the earth with sword and with famine and with death and by the beasts of the earth.
Revelation 6:9 And when he opened the fifth seal, I saw beneath the altar the souls of those slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the testimony which they had.
Revelation 6:10 And they were crying with a great voice, saying: Until when, holy and true master, do you not judge and avenge our blood upon those dwelling on the earth?
Revelation 6:11 And white robes were given to each, and it was said to them that they should rest yet a little time, until both their fellow slaves and their brothers, those about to be killed as they also were, should be fulfilled.
Revelation 6:12 And I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and behold, a great earthquake occurred, and the sun became black as a sack of hair, and the moon became as blood,
Revelation 6:13 and the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree casts its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind.
Revelation 6:14 And heaven was separated as a book being rolled up, and every mountain and island were moved from their places.
Revelation 6:15 And the kings of the earth and the great ones and the rich and the commanders of thousands and the powerful and every slave and every free one hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains,
Revelation 6:16 and say to the mountains and the rocks: Fall upon us and hide us from the face of the one sitting upon the throne and from the wrath of the lamb,
Revelation 6:17 because the great day of his wrath came, and who is able to stand?

## Chapter 7

Revelation 7:1 And after these things I saw four angels standing upon the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that wind might not blow upon the earth nor upon the sea nor upon any tree.
Revelation 7:2 And I saw another angel coming up from the rising of the sun, having a seal of the living God, and he cried with a great voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
Revelation 7:3 saying: Do not harm the earth nor the sea nor the trees, until we seal the slaves of our God upon their foreheads.
Revelation 7:4 And I heard the number of those sealed: a hundred forty-four thousand sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel.
Revelation 7:5 From the tribe of Judah twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand sealed;
Revelation 7:6 from the tribe of Asher twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand sealed;
Revelation 7:7 from the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand sealed;
Revelation 7:8 from the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand sealed.
Revelation 7:9 After these things I saw, and behold, a great crowd which no one was able to number, from every nation and tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and before the lamb, clothed in white robes, and palms in their hands,
Revelation 7:10 and crying with a great voice, saying: Salvation to the one sitting upon the throne of our God, and to the lamb.
Revelation 7:11 And all the angels had stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell before the throne upon their face and worshiped God,
Revelation 7:12 saying: Amen. The blessing and the glory and the wisdom and the thanksgiving and the honor and the power and the strength to our God forever and ever. Amen.
Revelation 7:13 And one of the elders answered, saying to me: These clothed in the white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?
Revelation 7:14 And I have said to him: Lord, you know. And he said to me: These are those coming out of the great affliction, and they washed their robes and whitened their robes in the blood of the lamb.
Revelation 7:15 Because of this they are before the throne of God, and serve him day and night in his temple, and the one sitting upon the throne will dwell in a tent over them.
Revelation 7:16 They will hunger no more, nor thirst anymore, nor will the sun fall upon them, nor any heat,
Revelation 7:17 because the lamb in the midst of the throne will shepherd them and guide them to living springs of waters, and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

## Chapter 8

Revelation 8:1 And when he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
Revelation 8:2 And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given them.
Revelation 8:3 And another angel came and stood upon the altar, having a golden censer; and much incense was given him, so that he might give it to the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar before the throne.
Revelation 8:4 And the smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of the saints from the hand of the angel before God.
Revelation 8:5 And the angel has taken the censer and filled it from the fire of the altar and cast it to the earth, and there were voices and thunders and lightnings and an earthquake.
Revelation 8:6 And the seven angels having the seven trumpets prepared themselves so that they might trumpet.
Revelation 8:7 And the first angel trumpeted, and there came hail and fire mingled with blood, and it was cast to the earth, and the third of the trees was burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
Revelation 8:8 And the second angel trumpeted, and as a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea, and the third of the sea became blood,
Revelation 8:9 and the third of the creatures in the sea, those having souls, died, and the third of the ships was destroyed.
Revelation 8:10 And the third angel trumpeted, and a great star fell from heaven, burning as a lamp, and it fell upon the third of the rivers and upon the springs of waters.
Revelation 8:11 And the name of the star is called Wormwood; and the third becomes wormwood, and many of men died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
Revelation 8:12 And the fourth angel trumpeted, and the third of the sun was struck, and the third of the moon and the third of the stars, so that the third of them might be darkened, and the day might not shine for the third of it, and the night likewise.
Revelation 8:13 And I saw and heard one angel flying in midheaven, saying with a great voice: Woe, woe, woe to those dwelling upon the earth, from the remaining voices of the trumpet of the three angels about to trumpet.

## Chapter 9

Revelation 9:1 And the fifth angel trumpeted, and I saw a star having fallen from heaven to the earth, and the key of the shaft of the abyss was given him.
Revelation 9:2 And he opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke went up from the shaft as smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the shaft.
Revelation 9:3 And from the smoke locusts came out to the earth, and authority was given them as the scorpions of the earth have authority.
Revelation 9:4 And it was said to them that they should not harm the grass of the earth nor any green thing nor any tree, except only the men who do not have the seal of God upon their foreheads.
Revelation 9:5 And it was given them that they should not kill them, but that they should be tormented for five months; and their torment as a scorpion's torment when it strikes a man.
Revelation 9:6 And in those days men will seek death and will not find it, and will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
Revelation 9:7 And the likenesses of the locusts were like horses prepared for war, and upon their heads as crowns like gold, and their faces as faces of men.
Revelation 9:8 And they had hairs as hairs of women, and their teeth were as those of lions.
Revelation 9:9 And they had breastplates as iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings as a sound of chariots of many horses running into war.
Revelation 9:10 And they have tails like scorpions, and stings were in their tails, and their authority to harm men for five months.
Revelation 9:11 And they have over them as king the angel of the abyss; his name in Hebrew Abaddon, and in Greek he has the name Apollyon.
Revelation 9:12 The one woe passed; behold, two woes still come after these things.
Revelation 9:13 And the sixth angel trumpeted, and I heard one voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God,
Revelation 9:14 saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet: Loose the four angels bound at the great river Euphrates.
Revelation 9:15 And the four angels were loosed, those prepared for the hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill the third of men.
Revelation 9:16 And the number of armies of the cavalry was two myriads of myriads, and I heard their number.
Revelation 9:17 And thus I saw the horses in the vision and those sitting upon them, having fiery and hyacinth-colored and sulfurous breastplates; and the heads of the horses as heads of lions, and from their mouths go out fire and smoke and sulfur.
Revelation 9:18 By these three the third of men were killed, from the fire and from the smoke and from the sulfur going out from their mouths.
Revelation 9:19 For their authorities are in their mouth, for their tails are like serpents, having heads, and with them they harm.
Revelation 9:20 And the rest of men, who were not killed in these plagues, did not even repent from the works of their hands, so as not to worship the demons and the idols, the golden and the silver and the bronze and the stone and the wooden, which can neither see nor hear nor walk.
Revelation 9:21 And they did not repent from their murders nor from their sorceries nor from their fornication nor from their thefts.

## Chapter 10

Revelation 10:1 And I saw another strong angel coming down from heaven, clothed with a cloud, and a rainbow upon the head, and his face as the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire.
Revelation 10:2 And he had in his hand an opened little book, and placed his right foot upon the sea and the left upon the earth,
Revelation 10:3 and cried with a great voice, as a lion roars; and when he cried, the seven thunders spoke their own voices.
Revelation 10:4 And when the seven thunders spoke their own voices, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven saying to me: Seal what the seven thunders spoke, and do not write these things.
Revelation 10:5 And the angel whom I saw standing upon the sea and upon the earth raised his hand into heaven,
Revelation 10:6 and swore by the one living forever and ever, who created heaven and the things in it and the earth and the things in it and the sea and the things in it, that there will be time no more,
Revelation 10:7 but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to trumpet, the mystery of God should also be completed, as he proclaimed the good news to his own slaves, the prophets.
Revelation 10:8 And the voice which I heard from heaven again speaking with me and saying: Go, take the opened little book in the hand of the angel standing upon the sea and upon the earth.
Revelation 10:9 And I went to the angel, saying to him: Give me the little book. And he says to me: Take and eat it up, and it will make your belly bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.
Revelation 10:10 And I took the little book from the hand of the angel and ate it up, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I ate it, my belly was made bitter.
Revelation 10:11 And he says to me: You must prophesy again concerning peoples and nations and tongues and many kings.

## Chapter 11

Revelation 11:1 And a reed like a rod was given me, saying: Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar and those worshiping in it.
Revelation 11:2 And the court within the temple, cast outside and do not measure it, because it was given to the nations, and they will tread the holy city for forty-two months.
Revelation 11:3 And I will give to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for a thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sacks.
Revelation 11:4 These are the two olive trees and two lampstands standing before the God of the earth.
Revelation 11:5 And if anyone wishes to harm them, fire goes out from their mouth and devours their enemies; and if anyone wishes to harm them, thus he must be killed.
Revelation 11:6 These have authority to shut heaven, so that rain may not fall in the days of their prophecy; and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague as often as they wish.
Revelation 11:7 And when they complete their testimony, the beast coming up from the abyss will make war with them and overcome them and kill them.
Revelation 11:8 And their corpses upon the street of the great city, which is called spiritually Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.
Revelation 11:9 And those from the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will look at their corpses for three and a half days, and will not allow their corpses to be placed in tombs.
Revelation 11:10 And those dwelling upon the earth will rejoice over them and be glad, and will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those dwelling upon the earth.
Revelation 11:11 And after the three and a half days a spirit of life from God entered upon them, and they stood upon their feet, and great fear fell upon those observing them.
Revelation 11:12 And they heard a great voice from heaven saying to them: Come up here. And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies observed them.
Revelation 11:13 And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth of the city fell, and in the earthquake seven thousand names of men were killed, and the rest became fearful and gave glory to the God of heaven.
Revelation 11:14 The second woe passed; behold, the third woe comes quickly.
Revelation 11:15 And the seventh angel trumpeted, and there were great voices in heaven, saying: The kingdoms of the world became those of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign forever and ever.
Revelation 11:16 And the twenty-four elders sitting before God upon their thrones fell upon their faces and worshiped God,
Revelation 11:17 saying: We thank you, Lord God Almighty, who is and who was and who is coming, because you have taken your great power and reigned.
Revelation 11:18 And the nations were enraged, and your wrath came, and the time of the dead to be judged, and to give the reward to your slaves the prophets and to the saints and to those fearing your name, the small and the great, and to destroy those destroying the earth.
Revelation 11:19 And the temple of God in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen in his temple, and there were lightnings and voices and thunders and an earthquake and great hail.

## Chapter 12

Revelation 12:1 And a great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon beneath her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars.
Revelation 12:2 And having in the womb, she cries, suffering birth pains and being tormented to give birth.
Revelation 12:3 And another sign was seen in heaven, and behold, a great fiery red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems.
Revelation 12:4 And his tail drags the third of the stars of heaven and cast them to the earth; and the dragon has stood before the woman about to give birth, so that when she gives birth he may devour her child.
Revelation 12:5 And she gave birth to a male son, who is about to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was snatched to God and his throne.
Revelation 12:6 And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, so that there they may nourish her for a thousand two hundred sixty days.
Revelation 12:7 And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon fought, and his angels,
Revelation 12:8 and they did not prevail, nor was their place found anymore in heaven.
Revelation 12:9 And the great dragon was cast out, the ancient serpent, the one called Devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited world; he was cast to the earth, and his angels were cast with him.
Revelation 12:10 And I heard a great voice saying in heaven: Now came the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of his Christ, because the accuser of our brothers was cast down, the one accusing them before our God day and night.
Revelation 12:11 And they overcame him because of the blood of the lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their soul until death.
Revelation 12:12 Because of this rejoice, heavens and those dwelling in tents in them. Woe to those dwelling on the earth and the sea, because the devil came down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has a little time.
Revelation 12:13 And when the dragon saw that he was cast to the earth, he pursued the woman who gave birth to the male.
Revelation 12:14 And the two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she may fly into the wilderness, into her place, where she is nourished there for a time and times and half a time, away from the face of the serpent.
Revelation 12:15 And the serpent cast from his mouth after the woman water as a river, so that he might make her carried away by the river.
Revelation 12:16 And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river which the dragon cast from his mouth.
Revelation 12:17 And the dragon was enraged at the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, those keeping the commandments of God and having the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Revelation 12:18 And I stood upon the sand of the sea.

## Chapter 13

Revelation 13:1 And I saw a beast coming up from the sea, having seven heads and ten horns, and upon its horns ten diadems, and upon its heads a name of blasphemy.
Revelation 13:2 And the beast which I saw was like a leopard, and its feet as those of a bear, and its mouth as a mouth of a lion; and the dragon gave it his power and his throne and great authority.
Revelation 13:3 And I saw one of its heads as slaughtered to death, and its wound of death was healed, and there was wonder in all the earth after the beast.
Revelation 13:4 And they worshiped the dragon who gave authority to the beast, and worshiped the beast, saying: Who is like the beast? Who can make war with it?
Revelation 13:5 And a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies was given it, and authority to act for forty-two months was given it.
Revelation 13:6 And it opened its mouth for blasphemy toward God, to blaspheme his name and his tent and those dwelling in tents in heaven.
Revelation 13:7 And it was given it to make war with the saints and overcome them, and authority was given it over every tribe and tongue and nation.
Revelation 13:8 And all those dwelling upon the earth will worship it, whose names have not been written in the book of life of the lamb slaughtered from the foundation of the world.
Revelation 13:9 If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
Revelation 13:10 If anyone gathers captivity, he goes into captivity; if anyone will kill with a sword, he must be killed with a sword. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
Revelation 13:11 And I saw another beast coming up from the earth, and it had two horns like a lamb, and was speaking as a dragon.
Revelation 13:12 And it exercises all the authority of the first beast before it, and makes the earth and those dwelling in it worship the first beast, whose wound of death was healed.
Revelation 13:13 And it does great signs, so that it even makes fire come down from heaven to the earth before men.
Revelation 13:14 And it deceives those dwelling upon the earth because of the signs which it was given it to do before the beast, saying to those dwelling upon the earth to make an image to the beast which has the wound of the sword and lived.
Revelation 13:15 And it was given it to give spirit to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast might even speak and make as many as do not worship the image of the beast be killed.
Revelation 13:16 And it makes all, the small and the great and the rich and the poor and the free and the slaves, so that it may give them a mark upon their right hand or upon their foreheads,
Revelation 13:17 and so that no one may be able to buy or sell except the one having the mark or the name of the beast or the number of its name.
Revelation 13:18 Here is wisdom. The one having understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is a number of a man, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.

## Chapter 14

Revelation 14:1 And I saw, and behold, a lamb standing upon Mount Zion, and with him a hundred forty-four thousand having the name of his Father written upon their foreheads.
Revelation 14:2 And I heard a voice from heaven as a voice of many waters and as a voice of great thunder, and I heard a voice of harpists playing on their harps.
Revelation 14:3 And they sing as a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one was able to learn the song except the hundred forty-four thousand, those bought from the earth.
Revelation 14:4 These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those following the lamb wherever he goes. These were bought from men, a firstfruits to God and to the lamb.
Revelation 14:5 And in their mouth deceit was not found, for they are without blemish before the throne of God.
Revelation 14:6 And I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having eternal good news to proclaim to those dwelling upon the earth, and every nation and tribe and tongue and people,
Revelation 14:7 saying with a great voice: Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment came; and worship the one who made heaven and earth and sea and springs of waters.
Revelation 14:8 And another angel followed, saying: Fell, fell Babylon, the great city, because she has made all nations drink from the wine of the wrath of her fornication.
Revelation 14:9 And a third angel followed them, saying with a great voice: If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives a mark upon his forehead or upon his hand,
Revelation 14:10 he also will drink from the wine of the wrath of God, mixed unmixed in the cup of his anger, and will be tormented with fire and sulfur before the holy angels and before the lamb.
Revelation 14:11 And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest day and night, those worshiping the beast and its image, and if anyone receives the mark of its name.
Revelation 14:12 Here is endurance of the saints; here are those keeping the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
Revelation 14:13 And I heard a voice from heaven saying to me: Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on. Yes, says the Spirit, so that they may rest from their labors, and their works follow with them.
Revelation 14:14 And I saw, and behold, a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having upon his head a golden crown and in his hand a sharp sickle.
Revelation 14:15 And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a great voice to the one sitting upon the cloud: Send your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap came for you, because the harvest of the earth has dried.
Revelation 14:16 And the one sitting upon the cloud cast his sickle upon the earth, and the earth was reaped.
Revelation 14:17 And another angel came out of the temple in heaven, himself also having a sharp sickle.
Revelation 14:18 And another angel came out of the altar, having authority over the fire, and called with a great cry to the one having the sharp sickle, saying: Send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the earth, because its grapes have ripened.
Revelation 14:19 And the angel cast his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast into the great winepress of the wrath of God.
Revelation 14:20 And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress as far as the bridles of the horses, for a thousand six hundred stadia.

## Chapter 15

Revelation 15:1 And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous, seven angels having seven plagues, the last, because in them the wrath of God was completed.
Revelation 15:2 And I saw as a glassy sea mingled with fire, and those overcoming the beast and its image and its mark, the number of its name, standing upon the glassy sea, having harps of God.
Revelation 15:3 And they sing the song of Moses, slave of God, and the song of the lamb, saying: Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God Almighty; righteous and true are your ways, king of the saints.
Revelation 15:4 Who will certainly not fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? Because you alone are holy; because all the nations will come and worship before you, because your righteous ordinances were manifested.
Revelation 15:5 And after these things I saw, and behold, the temple of the tent of testimony in heaven was opened,
Revelation 15:6 and the seven angels having the seven plagues came out of the temple, clothed in pure and splendid linen and girded around the breasts with golden belts.
Revelation 15:7 And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, the one living forever and ever.
Revelation 15:8 And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power, and no one was able to enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels should be completed.

## Chapter 16

Revelation 16:1 And I heard a great voice from the temple saying to the seven angels: Go and pour out the bowls of the wrath of God into the earth.
Revelation 16:2 And the first went away and poured out his bowl upon the earth, and there came a bad and evil sore upon the men having the mark of the beast and those worshiping its image.
Revelation 16:3 And the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead one, and every living soul died in the sea.
Revelation 16:4 And the third angel poured out his bowl into the rivers and into the springs of the waters, and it became blood.
Revelation 16:5 And I heard the angel of the waters saying: You are righteous, Lord, the one who is and who was and the holy one, because you judged these things,
Revelation 16:6 because they poured out blood of saints and prophets, and you gave them blood to drink, for they are worthy.
Revelation 16:7 And I heard another from the altar saying: Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
Revelation 16:8 And the fourth angel poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was given him to scorch men with fire.
Revelation 16:9 And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, the one having authority over these plagues, and did not repent to give him glory.
Revelation 16:10 And the fifth angel poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became darkened, and they were chewing their tongues from the pain,
Revelation 16:11 and blasphemed the God of heaven from their pains and from their sores, and did not repent from their works.
Revelation 16:12 And the sixth angel poured out his bowl upon the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried, so that the way of the kings from the risings of the sun might be prepared.
Revelation 16:13 And I saw from the mouth of the dragon and from the mouth of the beast and from the mouth of the false prophet three unclean spirits like frogs.
Revelation 16:14 For they are spirits of demons doing signs, to go out to the kings of the earth and of the whole inhabited world, to gather them to war of that great day of God Almighty.
Revelation 16:15 Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is the one watching and keeping his garments, so that he may not walk naked and they see his shame.
Revelation 16:16 And he gathered them into the place called in Hebrew Armageddon.
Revelation 16:17 And the seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and a great voice came out from the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying: It has happened.
Revelation 16:18 And there were voices and thunders and lightnings, and there was a great earthquake, such as had not occurred since men came to be upon the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.
Revelation 16:19 And the great city became three parts, and the cities of the nations fell, and Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the wrath of his anger.
Revelation 16:20 And every island fled, and mountains were not found.
Revelation 16:21 And great hail, as of a talent's weight, comes down from heaven upon men, and men blasphemed God from the plague of the hail, because its plague is exceedingly great.

## Chapter 17

Revelation 17:1 And one of the seven angels having the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying to me: Come, I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute sitting upon the many waters,
Revelation 17:2 with whom the kings of the earth committed fornication, and those dwelling on the earth were made drunk from the wine of her fornication.
Revelation 17:3 And he carried me away into a wilderness in the Spirit, and I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet beast full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
Revelation 17:4 And the woman was clothed with purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold and precious stone and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and uncleanness of her fornication,
Revelation 17:5 and upon her forehead a name written: Mystery, Babylon the great, the mother of the prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.
Revelation 17:6 And I saw the woman drunk from the blood of the saints and from the blood of the witnesses of Jesus, and seeing her I marveled with great wonder.
Revelation 17:7 And the angel said to me: Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast bearing her, the one having the seven heads and the ten horns.
Revelation 17:8 The beast which you saw was and is not, and is about to come up from the abyss and go into destruction; and those dwelling upon the earth will marvel, whose names have not been written upon the book of life from the foundation of the world, seeing the beast, that it was and is not, although it is.
Revelation 17:9 Here is the understanding having wisdom: the seven heads are seven mountains, where the woman sits upon them.
Revelation 17:10 And they are seven kings; the five fell, and the one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes, he must remain a little.
Revelation 17:11 And the beast which was and is not, he himself also is an eighth, and is from the seven, and goes into destruction.
Revelation 17:12 And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom, but receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
Revelation 17:13 These have one purpose, and will give their own power and authority to the beast.
Revelation 17:14 These will make war with the lamb, and the lamb will overcome them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings; and those with him are called and chosen and faithful.
Revelation 17:15 And he says to me: The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples and crowds and nations and tongues.
Revelation 17:16 And the ten horns which you saw upon the beast, these will hate the prostitute, and will make her desolated and naked, and will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.
Revelation 17:17 For God gave into their hearts to do his purpose, and to do one purpose, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be completed.
Revelation 17:18 And the woman whom you saw is the great city having kingship over the kings of the earth.

## Chapter 18

Revelation 18:1 And after these things I saw an angel coming down from heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated from his glory.
Revelation 18:2 And he cried in strength with a great voice, saying: Fell, fell Babylon the great, and became a dwelling of demons and a prison of every unclean spirit and a prison of every unclean and hated bird,
Revelation 18:3 because all the nations have drunk from the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth became rich from the power of her luxury.
Revelation 18:4 And I heard another voice from heaven saying: Come out of her, my people, so that you may not partake together of her sins, and so that you may not receive from her plagues,
Revelation 18:5 because her sins followed as far as heaven, and God remembered her wrongdoings.
Revelation 18:6 Give back to her as she also gave back to you, and double to her double according to her works; in the cup which she mixed, mix double for her.
Revelation 18:7 As much as she glorified herself and lived luxuriously, so much give her torment and mourning, because in her heart she says: I sit as a queen, and I am not a widow, and I will certainly not see mourning.
Revelation 18:8 Because of this in one day her plagues will come, death and mourning and famine, and she will be burned up with fire, because strong is the Lord God judging her.
Revelation 18:9 And the kings of the earth who committed fornication and lived luxuriously with her will weep for her and mourn over her, when they see the smoke of her burning,
Revelation 18:10 standing from afar because of the fear of her torment, saying: Woe, woe, the great city Babylon, the strong city, because in one hour your judgment came.
Revelation 18:11 And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo anymore,
Revelation 18:12 cargo of gold and silver and precious stone and pearl and fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet, and every thyine wood and every ivory vessel and every vessel from most precious wood and bronze and iron and marble,
Revelation 18:13 and cinnamon and incenses and ointment and frankincense and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat and cattle and sheep, and of horses and carriages and bodies, and souls of men.
Revelation 18:14 And the ripe fruit of the desire of your soul departed from you, and all the rich and splendid things departed from you, and you will certainly not find them anymore.
Revelation 18:15 The merchants of these things, those who became rich from her, will stand from afar because of the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
Revelation 18:16 and saying: Woe, woe, the great city clothed with fine linen and purple and scarlet, and gilded with gold and precious stone and pearls,
Revelation 18:17 because in one hour so great wealth was desolated. And every helmsman and all the company upon the ships and sailors and as many as work the sea stood from afar,
Revelation 18:18 and were crying, seeing the smoke of her burning, saying: Who is like the great city?
Revelation 18:19 And they cast dust upon their heads and were crying, weeping and mourning, saying: Woe, woe, the great city, in which all having ships in the sea became rich from her costliness, because in one hour she was desolated.
Revelation 18:20 Rejoice over her, heaven and the holy apostles and the prophets, because God judged your judgment against her.
Revelation 18:21 And one strong angel lifted a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying: Thus with a rush Babylon the great city will be cast, and will certainly not be found anymore.
Revelation 18:22 And a sound of harpists and musicians and flute players and trumpeters will certainly not be heard in you anymore; and any craftsman of any craft will certainly not be found in you anymore, and a sound of a mill will certainly not be heard in you anymore.
Revelation 18:23 And a light of a lamp will certainly not shine in you anymore, and a voice of bridegroom and bride will certainly not be heard in you anymore, because your merchants were the great ones of the earth, because by your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
Revelation 18:24 And in her was found blood of prophets and saints and of all those slaughtered upon the earth.

## Chapter 19

Revelation 19:1 And after these things I heard a great voice of a great crowd in heaven saying: Hallelujah, the salvation and the glory and the honor and the power to the Lord our God,
Revelation 19:2 because true and righteous are his judgments, because he judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth in her fornication, and avenged the blood of his slaves from her hand.
Revelation 19:3 And a second time they have said: Hallelujah. And her smoke goes up forever and ever.
Revelation 19:4 And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell and worshiped God, the one sitting upon the throne, saying: Amen, hallelujah.
Revelation 19:5 And a voice came out from the throne, saying: Praise our God, all his slaves and those fearing him, both the small and the great.
Revelation 19:6 And I heard as a voice of a great crowd and as a voice of many waters and as a voice of strong thunders, saying: Hallelujah, because the Lord God Almighty reigned.
Revelation 19:7 Let us rejoice and exult and give him the glory, because the marriage of the lamb came, and his wife prepared herself.
Revelation 19:8 And it was given her that she might clothe herself with pure and splendid fine linen, for the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints.
Revelation 19:9 And he says to me: Write: Blessed are those called to the supper of the marriage of the lamb. And he says to me: These are the true words of God.
Revelation 19:10 And I fell before his feet to worship him, and he says to me: See that you do not; I am your fellow slave and of your brothers having the testimony of Jesus. Worship God. For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.
Revelation 19:11 And I saw heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and the one sitting upon it called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he judges and makes war.
Revelation 19:12 And his eyes as a flame of fire, and upon his head many diadems, having a name written which no one knows except himself,
Revelation 19:13 and clothed in a garment dipped in blood, and his name is called the Word of God.
Revelation 19:14 And the armies in heaven were following him upon white horses, clothed in white and pure fine linen.
Revelation 19:15 And from his mouth goes out a sharp sword, so that with it he may strike the nations; and he himself will shepherd them with an iron rod, and he himself treads the winepress of the wine of the wrath and of the anger of God Almighty.
Revelation 19:16 And he has upon the garment and upon his thigh the name written: King of kings and Lord of lords.
Revelation 19:17 And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried with a great voice, saying to all the birds flying in midheaven: Come and gather to the supper of the great God,
Revelation 19:18 so that you may eat flesh of kings and flesh of commanders of thousands and flesh of strong ones and flesh of horses and of those sitting upon them, and flesh of all, free and slaves and small and great.
Revelation 19:19 And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered to make war with the one sitting upon the horse and with his army.
Revelation 19:20 And the beast was seized, and with it the false prophet who did the signs before it, by which he deceived those receiving the mark of the beast and those worshiping its image; the two were cast living into the lake of fire burning with sulfur.
Revelation 19:21 And the rest were killed with the sword of the one sitting upon the horse, the one going out from his mouth, and all the birds were filled from their flesh.

## Chapter 20

Revelation 20:1 And I saw an angel coming down from heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain upon his hand.
Revelation 20:2 And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years,
Revelation 20:3 and cast him into the abyss and shut him in and sealed over him, so that he might not deceive the nations anymore until the thousand years should be completed; and after these things he must be loosed for a little time.
Revelation 20:4 And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given them; and the souls of those beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who did not worship the beast nor its image and did not receive the mark upon their forehead and upon their hand; and they lived and reigned with Christ for the thousand years.
Revelation 20:5 But the rest of the dead did not live again until the thousand years should be completed. This is the first resurrection.
Revelation 20:6 Blessed and holy is the one having part in the first resurrection; over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him for a thousand years.
Revelation 20:7 And when the thousand years should be completed, Satan will be loosed from his prison,
Revelation 20:8 and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them to war, whose number is as the sand of the sea.
Revelation 20:9 And they went up upon the breadth of the earth and encircled the camp of the saints and the beloved city, and fire came down from God out of heaven and devoured them.
Revelation 20:10 And the devil deceiving them was cast into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
Revelation 20:11 And I saw a great white throne and the one sitting upon it, from whose face earth and heaven fled, and a place was not found for them.
Revelation 20:12 And I saw the dead, small and great, standing before God, and books were opened, and another book was opened, which is of life; and the dead were judged from the things written in the books according to their works.
Revelation 20:13 And the sea gave the dead in it, and death and Hades gave the dead in them, and they were judged, each according to their works.
Revelation 20:14 And death and Hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
Revelation 20:15 And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

## Chapter 21

Revelation 21:1 And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth passed away, and the sea is no more.
Revelation 21:2 And I, John, saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
Revelation 21:3 And I heard a great voice from heaven saying: Behold, the tent of God with men, and he will dwell in a tent with them, and they will be his peoples, and God himself will be with them, their God.
Revelation 21:4 And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death will be no more, nor mourning nor cry nor pain will be anymore, because the first things departed.
Revelation 21:5 And the one sitting upon the throne said: Behold, I make all things new. And he says to me: Write, because these words are true and faithful.
Revelation 21:6 And he said to me: It has happened. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give to the one thirsting from the spring of the water of life freely.
Revelation 21:7 The one overcoming will inherit all things, and I will be God to him, and he will be the son to me.
Revelation 21:8 But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and fornicators and sorcerers and idolaters and all the false ones, their part in the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is second death.
Revelation 21:9 And one of the seven angels having the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came to me and spoke with me, saying: Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the lamb.
Revelation 21:10 And he carried me away in the Spirit upon a great and high mountain, and showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
Revelation 21:11 having the glory of God, and its luminary like a most precious stone, as a jasper stone shining like crystal,
Revelation 21:12 and having a great and high wall, having twelve gates, and upon the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel.
Revelation 21:13 From the east three gates, from the north three gates, from the south three gates, from the west three gates.
Revelation 21:14 And the wall of the city having twelve foundations, and in them names of the twelve apostles of the lamb.
Revelation 21:15 And the one speaking with me had a golden reed, so that he might measure the city and its gates and its wall.
Revelation 21:16 And the city lies foursquare, and its length is as much as also the breadth; and he measured the city with the reed to twelve thousand stadia. Its length and breadth and height are equal.
Revelation 21:17 And he measured its wall, a hundred forty-four cubits, a man's measure, which is an angel's.
Revelation 21:18 And the building of its wall was jasper, and the city pure gold, like pure glass.
Revelation 21:19 And the foundations of the wall of the city adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
Revelation 21:20 the fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh hyacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
Revelation 21:21 And the twelve gates twelve pearls; each one of the gates was from one pearl, and the street of the city pure gold, as transparent glass.
Revelation 21:22 And I did not see a temple in it, for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, and the lamb.
Revelation 21:23 And the city has no need of the sun nor of the moon to shine in it, for the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp the lamb.
Revelation 21:24 And the nations of those being saved will walk in its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory and honor into it.
Revelation 21:25 And its gates will certainly not be shut by day, for night will not be there.
Revelation 21:26 And they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it.
Revelation 21:27 And anything defiling and doing abomination and falsehood will certainly not enter into it, except those written in the book of life of the lamb.

## Chapter 22

Revelation 22:1 And he showed me a pure river of water of life, splendid as crystal, going out from the throne of God and of the lamb.
Revelation 22:2 In the midst of its street, and on this side and that side of the river, a tree of life producing twelve fruits, giving its fruit each month, and the leaves of the tree for healing of the nations.
Revelation 22:3 And every curse will be no more, and the throne of God and of the lamb will be in it, and his slaves will serve him,
Revelation 22:4 and they will see his face, and his name upon their foreheads.
Revelation 22:5 And night will not be there, and they have no need of a lamp and light of sun, because the Lord God illuminates them, and they will reign forever and ever.
Revelation 22:6 And he said to me: These words are faithful and true; and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show his slaves what must happen soon.
Revelation 22:7 Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is the one keeping the words of the prophecy of this book.
Revelation 22:8 And I, John, the one seeing these things and hearing; and when I heard and saw, I fell to worship before the feet of the angel showing me these things.
Revelation 22:9 And he says to me: See that you do not; for I am your fellow slave and of your brothers the prophets and of those keeping the words of this book. Worship God.
Revelation 22:10 And he says to me: Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book, because the time is near.
Revelation 22:11 The one doing injustice, let him do injustice still; and the one being filthy, let him be filthy still; and the righteous one, let him be justified still; and the holy one, let him be sanctified still.
Revelation 22:12 And behold, I come quickly, and my reward with me, to give back to each as his work will be.
Revelation 22:13 I am the Alpha and the Omega, beginning and end, the first and the last.
Revelation 22:14 Blessed are those doing his commandments, so that their authority will be over the tree of life, and they may enter through the gates into the city.
Revelation 22:15 But outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the fornicators and the murderers and the idolaters and everyone loving and doing falsehood.
Revelation 22:16 I, Jesus, sent my angel to testify these things to you concerning the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the splendid and morning star.
Revelation 22:17 And the Spirit and the bride say: Come. And the one hearing, let him say: Come. And the one thirsting, let him come; and the one wishing, let him take water of life freely.
Revelation 22:18 For I testify together to everyone hearing the words of the prophecy of this book: If anyone adds to these things, God will add upon him the plagues written in this book.
Revelation 22:19 And if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his part from the book of life and from the holy city and the things written in this book.
Revelation 22:20 The one testifying these things says: Yes, I come quickly. Amen. Yes, come, Lord Jesus.
Revelation 22:21 The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.
